lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G1 — and "meaningful" here has a precise, discipline-specific sense that separates حفظ from almost every other subject in the register. Ḥifẓ does not require literacy, does not require grammar, and does not require abstraction; it requires only intact auditory discrimination and imitative repetition, both of which a six-year-old has in greater measure than a sixteen-year-old. So its first mention and its first meaningful appearance coincide, which is rare. "Meaningful" for ḥifẓ means: text that is (a) retained past the term in which it was acquired, (b) retrievable from a cold cue rather than only as a continuation of the preceding line, and (c) phonemically correct at the point of acquisition. By that test G1 qualifies — a G1 child taught by تلقين سمعي genuinely retains الفاتحة والمعوذتين والإخلاص and the short المفصّل surahs for life. What G1 does NOT yet produce is self-sustaining ḥifẓ: the child cannot acquire without the teacher's voice, so throughput is capped by teacher airtime, not by the child's capacity. That cap lifts at G4 (see differentiation). [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] A second reason G1 is not merely acceptable but obligatory: الفقه التطبيقي is مضمّن from G1 and teaches الصلاة. A child cannot perform the ṣalāh the Fiqh strand is teaching him without الفاتحة and a short surah. Delaying ḥifẓ past G1 would leave G1-G2 Fiqh teaching an act whose text the child does not possess.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف (بيد المعلم؛ تلقين سمعي — لا مصحف بيد الطالب)
gradeByGrade.content: تلقين سمعي جماعي ثم فردي، بلا مصحف بيد الطالب. المقرر الأدنى: الفاتحة + من سورة الضحى إلى سورة الناس (نحو ٢٢ سورة قصيرة). Method: teacher recites a phrase 3-5x, class echoes, then individual تسميع. The 60-min block is SPLIT into two sub-blocks of ~25-30 min with movement between — a 5-6 year old cannot sustain a single 60-min seated recitation block, and the ring-fence protects the hour, not a monolithic delivery of it. تجويد is مضمّن here as correction-in-context only: no rule is named, only imitated. Priority targets for phonemic correction are the Arabic sounds absent from Yoruba phonology — ح/ه، ع/ء، ق/ك، ص/س، ط/ت، ض/د، ذ/ز/ظ، غ. Internal time shape: ~15 min تسميع الورد السابق، ~15 min ورد جديد، ~25 min مراجعة وترديد، ~5 min تصحيح.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف (بيد المعلم؛ تلقين سمعي)
gradeByGrade.content: Still تلقين سمعي. المقرر الأدنى: إكمال جزء عمّ — من النبأ إلى الليل (١٥ سورة، أطول نفَساً) + آية الكرسي + إتقان محفوظ G1 بالسرد المتصل. End-of-G2 milestone: جزء عمّ كاملاً — a clean, visible, parent-legible milestone at the end of التمهيدي. Surah length now exceeds one breath, so الوقف والابتداء is trained by imitation (not named). First introduction of the random-cue test (ابدأ من هنا) in oral form, because sequential chaining without cold retrieval is not ḥifẓ.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف (نظر مصاحب — الطالب يتابع بالعين والمعلم يقرأ)
gradeByGrade.content: BRIDGE YEAR. المقرر الأدنى: إتقان جزء عمّ كاملاً بالسرد المتصل في جلسة واحدة + بداية جزء تبارك (الملك، القلم، الحاقة، المعارج). The new element is النظر المصاحب: the child follows the muṣḥaf line with his eye while the teacher recites, WITHOUT being required to decode independently. This installs page-image anchoring and رسم familiarity a full year before decoding load is imposed. Cumulative floor ≈ ١.٥ جزء. القراءة والتهجي is still at word level (الكلمات) this year, which is exactly why the muṣḥaf is not yet the acquisition surface.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف — طبعة موحدة ثابتة للمدرسة (نظر ثم حفظ)
gradeByGrade.content: THE METHOD HINGE. Acquisition converts from تلقين سمعي to نظر ثم حفظ: the child reads the new ورد from the muṣḥaf, corrects, then memorizes. Acquisition pace deliberately does NOT rise this year — the method change absorbs the gain. المقرر الأدنى: إكمال جزء تبارك (نوح، الجن، المزمل، المدثر، القيامة، الإنسان، المرسلات) → تراكمي ٢ جزء. A SINGLE fixed muṣḥaf edition is mandated school-wide from this grade onward and never changed. تحفة الأطفال begins this year in its OWN مستقل slot outside the hour; the hour now applies named rules (المد الطبيعي، أحكام النون الساكنة) in correction. Formal weekly مراجعة cycle begins as a named, timetabled component of the hour.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: Switch to الحفظ من أول المصحف. المقرر الأدنى: الجزء الأول كاملاً (الفاتحة + البقرة ١-١٤١) ونصف الجزء الثاني → تراكمي ٣.٥ جزء. This is the first encounter with long-āyah register, legal narrative and non-rhymed prose — a genuinely different memorization problem from المفصّل, and the reason the transition waits until decoding is at sentence level. المراجعة now splits into قريبة (last 5 pages, daily) and بعيدة (rotating old juz, weekly). تحفة الأطفال completes; its rules are now the error-taxonomy used in correction.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٢ جزء → تراكمي ٥.٥. الجزرية begins in its own slot; مخارج الحروف وصفاتها become nameable, so correction moves from 'repeat after me' to 'this letter's مخرج is here'. The ḥifẓ stock becomes the working text of التفسير العملي (G6) — hard sequencing rule: التفسير works only on ما سبق حفظه أو ما يُحفظ الآن، ولا يُفسَّر ما لم يُحفظ، ولا يُحفظ في حصة التفسير متن مستقل. Self-correction from the muṣḥaf without teacher intervention is now an assessed competency.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٢.٥ جزء → تراكمي ٨. الجزرية continues; its باب معرفة الوقوف is now directly load-bearing on long-surah memorization. Introduce السرد بالكمّ: continuous unprompted recitation of ٢-٣ أجزاء in one sitting. Introduce مراجعة ثنائية (paired peer تسميع) — this is the mechanism that lets halaqah size rise without collapsing individual airtime. Error taxonomy formalised: لحن جليّ vs لحن خفيّ, scored separately.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٢.٥ جزء → تراكمي ١٠.٥. Peak acquisition efficiency years begin: decoding is automatic, tajwīd is named, attention span is adult-adjacent, and competing memorization load (متون النحو والصرف) is carried outside the hour. Review architecture matures to a fixed rotation guaranteeing every memorized juz is recited at least once per month. Ijazah-track candidates (opt-in, parallel, redline 2) are identified here by إتقان evidence, not by juz count.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٢.٥ جزء → تراكمي ١٣. إعدادية exit point: a certified, panel-verified statement of exactly how many juz are held at what إتقان level — issued honestly, in juz, never as a pass/fail. First supervised إقراء duty: G9 students take structured تسميع from G1-G2 children under teacher supervision. This is not free labour — hearing a beginner's errors is the fastest known consolidator of one's own precision. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٣ جزء → تراكمي ١٦. Internal balance begins its pivot: acquisition still dominant but مراجعة weight in the hour rises to ~50%. The memorized stock now becomes retrieval corpus for other disciplines — آيات الأحكام for أصول الفقه, Qur'anic sentences for البلاغة and الإعراب — but ḥifẓ itself teaches none of those and must not absorb them. Students who have already completed ٣٠ جزء convert the hour entirely to مراجعة كبرى + إقراء + إعداد للإجازة; the hour is never surrendered or repurposed to another subject.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٣ جزء → تراكمي ١٩. Consolidation-dominant. Formal المراجعة الكبرى cycle: the entire memorized stock recited through before a panel at least once in the year. Ijazah-track candidates sit سرد بالسند sessions under a qualified مُقرئ (parallel track, separately governed, opt-in). Non-track students continue acquisition on the same floor. Mastery threshold rises: a juz is counted as محفوظ only if recitable with ≤٢ أخطاء خفيّة per page and zero لحن جليّ, from a cold random cue.

gradeByGrade.text: المصحف الشريف
gradeByGrade.content: المقرر الأدنى: +٣ جزء → تراكمي ٢٢، with the expected band for the full-course student at ٢٥-٣٠ and the Ḥifẓ Track student at ٣٠ (often reached by G9-G10). Hour shape inverts: ~60% مراجعة كبرى وسرد، ~20% ورد جديد أو إتمام، ~20% إقراء وتدريب على التسميع. Exit is a panel سرد of the certified portion, an applied-tajwīd examination against الجزرية, and — for the opt-in track only — the إجازة بالسند. The certificate states the verified juz count and إتقان level in plain terms.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
NEVER DIFFERENTIATES — because it is never undifferentiated. حفظ القرآن is born مستقل at G1 and dies مستقل at G12. It does not emerge out of a parent subject, it is not a guest inside anyone else's block, and it cannot be مدمج at any grade for a structural reason: it is a HOST. التجويد العملي is مضمّن inside it at G1-G3; المراجعة lives inside it at every grade; الإقراء lives inside it from G9. A subject that hosts others cannot itself be integrated into a third. Asking when ḥifẓ differentiates is asking when the spine differentiates from the skeleton.

But there ARE two genuine internal hinges, and naming them is where the real engineering sits, because the submission names neither.

HINGE 1 — G4: التلقين السمعي → الحفظ من المصحف (نظر ثم حفظ). Why G4 and not G3: at G3 القراءة والتهجي is still at word level (الكلمات — the submission's own G3 entry). Memorizing from the muṣḥaf requires fluent decoding of connected, fully vowelled text including word-shape recognition and وقف placement — which the submission establishes only at G4 (الجمل القصيرة) and consolidates at G5. Move the hinge to G3 and the ring-fenced hour silently converts into reading remediation; worse, the child recites from oral memory while appearing to read, which masks a decoding deficit for years and is extremely hard to detect from the back of a halaqah. Why G4 and not G5: three costs. (i) A year of decoding fluency sits unused. (ii) Acquisition stays capped by teacher airtime — in a halaqah of 25, teacher-voice-bound acquisition gives roughly two minutes of new-text delivery per child, and the muṣḥaf is what breaks that ceiling. (iii) تحفة الأطفال starts at G4 (retained redline 3); pairing the first named tajwīd rules with the first independent reading of the ورد is what makes self-correction possible — delay one and you desynchronise both.

HINGE 2 — G10: التحصيل → الإتقان. The centre of gravity shifts from acquiring new text to guaranteeing the whole stock survives. Why G10 and not G9: G9 is the إعدادية exit and should be certified on the acquisition ladder it has been running for six years; re-basing the subject in its exit year corrupts the exit measure. Why not G11: at ~13-16 juz the review burden crosses the point where a weekly cycle can no longer touch every juz, and a student who hits that wall un-restructured begins losing text from the back faster than he gains at the front — and loses it invisibly, since only the front is being tested. Restructure before the wall, not after.
prerequisites: السمع السليم والتمييز الصوتي (functional hearing and auditory discrimination) — assumed at G1, but it must be SCREENED at intake, not assumed. An undetected mild hearing loss is indistinguishable from 'a slow child' in a تلقين halaqah and will be misdiagnosed as such for years. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

النطق الصحيح للأصوات العربية غير الموجودة في اليوربا — ح/ه، ع/ء، ق/ك، ص/س، ط/ت، ض/د، ذ/ز/ظ، غ. Established G1-G2 inside the ring-fenced hour by التجويد العملي مضمّن, reinforced by القراءة والتهجي. This is a PREREQUISITE FOR VOLUME, not for beginning: a child may begin ḥifẓ before it is secure, but must not be permitted to accumulate juz before it is, because memorized mispronunciation fossilizes and later costs more to remediate than the original acquisition cost.
التلقي بالتكرار والقدرة على الترديد المنغّم (imitative repetition with prosodic contour) — present naturally at G1; requires no teaching, only exploitation.

فكّ الحروف وقراءة النص المشكول المتصل (decoding fully vowelled connected text) — established by القراءة والتهجي: word level at G3, short-sentence level at G4, simple-sentence level at G5. This is the hard gate on HINGE 1 and the single reason the muṣḥaf transition sits at G4.

معرفة أحكام المد وأحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين والميم الساكنة بأسمائها — established G4-G5 via متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان (retained redline 3), taught in its own slot outside the hour. Not a prerequisite for memorizing; a prerequisite for SELF-correcting, which is what makes G4+ ḥifẓ self-sustaining rather than teacher-throughput-bound.
معرفة مخارج الحروف وصفاتها نظرياً — established G6-G7 via المقدمة الجزرية (retained redline 3). Prerequisite for إتقان-grade and إجازة-grade recitation, not for ordinary acquisition.
معرفة الوقف والابتداء — imitatively from G2, formally from G6-G7 via الجزرية's باب معرفة الوقوف. Becomes load-bearing at G5 when البقرة's long āyāt begin.

رواية واحدة معتمدة وطبعة مصحف واحدة ثابتة — must be FIXED BEFORE G1 and never changed. Not a competency but a hard structural precondition. Page-image anchoring is a principal retention mechanism; changing print layout mid-ladder degrades it, and changing riwāyah mid-ḥifẓ is destructive. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
عادة الورد اليومي والمراجعة (the behavioural install) — established G1-G3, and far cheaper to install at 6 than at 12.

classicalTexts.title: المصحف الشريف
classicalTexts.justification: حفظ القرآن HAS NO MATN. Its text is the muṣḥaf itself. Treating ḥifẓ as needing a classical text is a category error that would, if committed, import a منظومة into the ring-fenced hour and violate the constitutional ring-fence. The only text-level decisions that belong to this subject are (a) the riwāyah and (b) a single fixed printed edition held constant school-wide from G4 — both structural, neither a matn. At G1-G2 the muṣḥaf is in the teacher's hand only; at G3 it is in the child's hand for نظر مصاحب; from G4 it is the acquisition surface.

classicalTexts.title: تحفة الأطفال والغلمان في تجويد القرآن — سليمان بن حسين الجمزوري
classicalTexts.grade: G4-G5 (owned by التجويد, NOT by حفظ)
classicalTexts.justification: Listed here only to fix the boundary. This matn belongs to التجويد's own مستقل slot (retained redline 3) and supplies the error-taxonomy used to correct ḥifẓ from G4. Its MEMORIZATION must happen in its own period or in النشيد والمحفوظات — never inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour. The hour memorizes Qur'an and nothing else; that is what 'لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى' means in practice, and a منظومة memorized inside the hour is a breach of it even though the منظومة is about the Qur'an.

classicalTexts.title: المقدمة الجزرية (المقدمة فيما على قارئه أن يعلمه) — محمد بن محمد ابن الجزري
classicalTexts.grade: G6-G7 (owned by التجويد, NOT by حفظ)
classicalTexts.justification: Same boundary as above. Supplies مخارج الحروف وصفاتها and, in its باب معرفة الوقوف, the waqf categories that govern memorization of long-āyah surahs from G5 onward. It raises the QUALITY THRESHOLD of ḥifẓ from G6 and is the examination standard for the G12 applied-tajwīd assessment. It is not memorized in the Qur'an hour.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
The subject itself cannot be introduced too early — G1 is correct and G1 oral talqīn is developmentally optimal. The premature-introduction risks are all about introducing the WRONG PHASE too early, and they are specific.

1. Muṣḥaf-based acquisition before decoding fluency (i.e. moving HINGE 1 to G3 or earlier). The hour silently becomes reading remediation, and the child recites from oral memory while tracking the page with his finger — producing the appearance of reading. This masks a decoding deficit that then surfaces at G5-G6 as an apparently sudden collapse in a previously 'strong' student. It is very hard to detect from the front of a halaqah.

2. Volume before phonemic correction. This is the acute local risk and it is not generic. Yoruba phonology lacks the Arabic emphatics and pharyngeals; substitution (ه for ح، ك for ق، س for ص، ت for ط، د for ض، ز for ذ/ظ) is the default outcome unless deliberately corrected. A child who accumulates five juz with substituted phonemes has memorized the errors — the substitution is now part of the retrieval trace, not a surface slip, and remediation costs more than the original acquisition did. Where the substitution falls in الفاتحة it becomes لحن جليّ in a text recited in every rak'ah, with consequences for the ṣalāh that a substantial body of juristic opinion treats as serious — I state that as a known juristic consideration, not as a ruling and not on anyone's authority.

3. Acquisition pace before review architecture. The classic maktab failure, and the one the submission is silent on. Racing to impress parents produces visible early volume with no مراجعة cycle. The loss is invisible for two to three years — the front is tested, the back is not — and surfaces at the first panel سرد as a student who 'knows' 8 juz and can recite 3.

4. A 60-minute unbroken seated block at G1-G2. Five- and six-year-olds do not have the postural or attentional endurance; the hour is protected, its monolithic delivery is not. The failure mode here is the one genuinely unrecoverable failure in this programme: a child who comes to associate the muṣḥaf with fatigue and shame. Every other error on this list can be remediated.

5. Naming tajwīd rules before G4. Abstract rule-labels at G1-G3 consume hour-time, produce recitation of the rule rather than application of it, and displace the imitation that is actually doing the work at that age.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
1. Phonological window. The Arabic emphatics and pharyngeals are markedly cheaper to install before roughly age eight or nine than after. Delay accurate oral work past G3 and a permanent accent residue remains — remediable to 'acceptable', rarely to إتقان, and the ceiling this imposes on the student is one he will hit at G11 in front of an Ijazah panel, six years after the cause.

2. The arithmetic is unforgiving and non-linear. Losing G1-G3 does not cost the ~1.5 juz those years carry. It costs the compounding base, the review habit, the phonology and the muṣḥaf-familiarity, and it shifts the entire ladder three years right. A student beginning ḥifẓ at G4 does not finish three years later than one beginning at G1; he does not finish. Under the school's own hour — 195 hours a year, no more — 30 juz is not reachable from a G4 start without time drawn from outside this curriculum entirely.

3. الفقه التطبيقي breaks at G1. It is مضمّن from G1 and teaches الصلاة. Delay ḥifẓ and you teach a child the ṣalāh without giving him its text. This is not a sequencing inelegance; it is teaching an act he cannot perform.

4. القراءة والتهجي loses its scaffold. An early reader decoding a surah he already knows orally has a known target to check his decoding against — this is a real and well-attested early-literacy mechanism. Delay ḥifẓ and G1-G3 reading instruction loses its most powerful support, which means the G4 hinge arrives with weaker decoding, which delays the hinge, which compounds risk 2.

5. The habit does not install late. The daily ورد and the discipline of reciting yesterday's portion before receiving today's is a behavioural install. Establishing it at G1 costs almost nothing; establishing it at G7, against an adolescent who has never done it, is one of the hardest things this school would ever attempt.

6. The institution's own public promise. The school's signboard advertises Complete Qur'an Memorization alongside its Islamic and Arabic education. That promise is arithmetically deliverable only on a twelve-year ladder starting at G1, and even then, as set out below, only through the Ḥifẓ Track for most students.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 the hour inverts: roughly 60% مراجعة كبرى وسرد, 20% ورد جديد أو إتمام, 20% إقراء — supervised teaching of junior halaqāt. The subject's final role is not to add text but to guarantee, certify and transmit what is held. The ring-fence means the hour cannot be surrendered even by a student who completed ٣٠ جزء at G9; for him it becomes full-time review, tajwīd refinement to إجازة standard, and teaching.

What the G12 graduate can actually do, stated as verifiable capability and not as aspiration:
- Recite his certified portion from memory with applied tajwīd, at a threshold of zero لحن جليّ and ≤٢ أخطاء خفيّة per page.
- Resume from any cold random cue-point within that portion — not merely continue from the preceding line. This is the capability that distinguishes ḥifẓ from sequential chaining, and it is the one the panel actually tests.
- Sustain a continuous سرد of multiple juz in one sitting without prompting.
- Lead ṣalāh, including التراويح, to the extent of his certified portion.
- Self-correct against named rules — the تحفة set for مدود and أحكام النون والميم, the الجزرية set for مخارج، صفات، وقف — without a teacher present.
- Take تسميع from a junior and correct him: hear an error, name it, and demonstrate the correction. He has done this under supervision since G9.
- Retrieve آيات from memory as evidence when working in أصول الفقه، التفسير، البلاغة — the memorized stock is his search index, and this is the quiet reason ḥifẓ makes every G10-G12 discipline faster.
- For the opt-in Ijazah-track graduate only: hold an إجازة بالسند, obtained on mastery pace through the parallel track (redline 2), never as a grade gate.
- Hold a certificate stating the verified juz count and إتقان level in plain terms. Honest partial certification is a feature. A school that certifies 30 juz for a student who holds 18 has destroyed the meaning of its own certificate for every student who genuinely holds 30.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
ZERO periods from the shared ceiling, at every one of the twelve grades. This is the whole point of the constitutional ring-fence and it must be stated plainly to the board so that no other subject's allocation is ever argued against it: حفظ القرآن takes nothing from the 19 periods (7 at G1-G2). It lives entirely inside the 60 min × 5 days × 39 weeks = 195 hours that are ring-fenced at every grade. [RECOVERED]

Two arithmetic facts the board should see before allocating anything else:

At G1-G2, the Qur'an hour is 300 min/week against 280 min/week for the ENTIRE rest of the Islamic and Arabic day (7 × 40). The hour is 52% of the young child's programme here. Every other subject at G1-G2 is competing for the smaller half. This should discipline expectations about how much التوحيد، الفقه، اللغة العربية can realistically carry at those two grades.

At G3-G12, the hour is 300 min/week against 760 min/week (19 × 40) — 28% of the programme. In 40-minute-period equivalents the hour is worth 7.5 periods; if it ever lost its ring-fence and had to compete, it would consume 39% of the G3-G12 ceiling on its own. That is what the ring-fence is protecting against, and it is why the ring-fence is correct.

Internal allocation of the hour (its own budget, costing the ceiling nothing) — [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]:
G1-G2: two sub-blocks of ~25-30 min. ~15 تسميع السابق / ~15 ورد جديد / ~25 مراجعة وترديد / ~5 تصحيح.
G3-G5: ~10 تسميع السابق / ~20 ورد جديد / ~15 مراجعة قريبة / ~10 مراجعة بعيدة / ~5 تجويد تصحيحي.
G6-G9: ~10 / ~20 / ~15 / ~10 / ~5, with the بعيدة rotation guaranteeing every held juz is recited at least monthly.
G10-G12: ~35-40 مراجعة وسرد / ~10-15 ورد جديد / ~10 إقراء.

MERGE-INTO / ROTATE / SHORT-COURSE are all rejected for this subject. It merges into nothing, rotates in nothing, and ends in nothing. It is the only subject in the register whose time cannot be reallocated by any curricular argument.

THE REAL CONSTRAINT IS NOT PERIODS — IT IS TEACHER AIRTIME. A 60-minute hour with 30 children gives two minutes of individual تسميع per child, which is not a ḥifẓ programme; it is a supervised study hall. Recommended halaqah caps: ≤12 at G1-G3 (teacher-voice-bound talqīn, no substitute exists), ≤15 at G4-G6, ≤20 at G7-G9 with مراجعة ثنائية absorbing review load, ≤25 at G10-G12 where students can review in pairs and the teacher's time concentrates on سرد panels. Whether the school can staff this determines whether the ladder below is real, more than any curricular decision on this page. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
departuresFromSubmission: THE SUBMISSION SAYS ONLY 'حفظ مستقل' AT EVERY GRADE AND NOTHING ELSE. I protect the form — مستقل at all twelve grades is correct and I would defend it against any proposal to integrate — but the label is not a curriculum. It specifies no content ladder, no pace policy, no method transition, no review architecture, no mastery threshold and no completion definition. A ḥifẓ programme specified at this level of detail will be delivered differently by every teacher in the building. Everything in this submission beyond the word مستقل is supplied here.

SILENCE ON المراجعة IS THE SUBMISSION'S MOST SERIOUS DEFECT. Review is not an extra subject and asks for no periods; it is a named, time-budgeted, separately-weighted component INSIDE the ring-fenced hour. I make it structural from G4 (weekly cycle), split it at G5 (قريبة / بعيدة), and require from G8 a rotation guaranteeing every held juz is recited at least monthly. A ḥifẓ programme without a specified review architecture loses text faster than it gains it, and loses it invisibly, because only the newest portion is ever tested. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

THE SUBMISSION IMPLIES UNIFORM GRADE-LOCKSTEP ḤIFẒ. Ḥifẓ is mastery-paced by nature; children do not memorize at one rate and no curriculum can make them. I replace lockstep with: a grade-anchored MINIMUM FLOOR (الحد الأدنى), an OPEN CEILING, and TWO PACE LANES inside the one ring-fenced hour — المسار النظامي and مسار الحفظ (the institution's existing pace-based opt-in Ḥifẓ Track, per redline 2). Same hour, same supervision, different ورد size, different thresholds. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

THE SUBMISSION TREATS حفظ AND القراءة والتهجي AS PARALLEL UNRELATED STRANDS AT G1-G5. They are in a hard dependency. I specify HINGE 1 at G4 and make the muṣḥaf transition a designed event with a bridge year at G3 (النظر المصاحب), rather than something that happens whenever an individual teacher decides the child is ready.

THE SUBMISSION NEVER NAMES THE RIWĀYAH OR THE MUṢḤAF EDITION. This blocks G1 implementation. Both must be fixed before the first child is taught and never changed thereafter. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

I ADD A HARD RULE THE SUBMISSION DOES NOT STATE: no منظومة is memorized inside the ring-fenced hour — not تحفة الأطفال, not الجزرية, not any matn, however Qur'anic its subject. Their memorization belongs to their own periods or to النشيد والمحفوظات. 'لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى' is breached by a tajwīd matn in the Qur'an hour exactly as it is breached by النحو.
I DESIGN G8-G12, which the submission deliberately left open, including the G10 acquisition-to-consolidation pivot and the إقراء duty from G9.

I ADD INTAKE HEARING SCREENING at G1. Outside the submission's frame, but a mild undetected hearing loss is indistinguishable from slowness in a talqīn halaqah and will be misread as slowness for years.

I STATE THE COMPLETION ARITHMETIC HONESTLY, which the submission avoids. The ring-fenced hour alone, at realistic halaqah pace, delivers roughly 20-22 juz to the median full-course student by G12 and 25-30 to the upper band. The school's advertised Complete Qur'an Memorization is delivered by the Ḥifẓ Track — which needs time beyond the ring-fenced hour — not by the grade hour alone. A curriculum that promises uniform 30-juz completion inside 195 hours a year is promising something it cannot deliver, and the first cohort will prove it.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FEEDS الفقه التطبيقي (G1-G2, مضمّن) IMMEDIATELY AND NON-NEGOTIABLY: الفاتحة and the short surahs are the operative text of the ṣalāh that Fiqh is teaching in the same term. This is the tightest same-year dependency anywhere in the G1 design, and it runs from ḥifẓ outward.

HOSTS التجويد العملي at G1-G3 (مضمّن inside the hour, correction-in-context, no rule named) and is then SERVED BY التجويد النظري from G4 (تحفة) and G6 (الجزرية) in its own slot. Direction of dependency reverses at G4: before it, ḥifẓ carries tajwīd; after it, tajwīd raises ḥifẓ's quality threshold. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: no theoretical tajwīd instruction inside the hour, and no memorization of tajwīd متون inside the hour.

RECIPROCAL WITH القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5): decoding feeds ḥifẓ from G4 (HINGE 1); ḥifẓ feeds decoding from G1, because a child decoding a surah he already holds orally has a known target against which to check himself. Neither subject should teach the other's content — القراءة والتهجي keeps its separate book and its independent assessment, per the submission, which is right.

FEEDS التفسير العملي (G6) AND ALL LATER التفسير. Hard sequencing rule: tafsīr works on القدر المحفوظ and lags it. Do not explain a passage not yet memorized or being memorized, and never memorize a DIFFERENT passage inside the tafsīr period — that splits the student's memorization effort across two uncoordinated fronts and is the most common way ḥifẓ programmes quietly lose their pace.
FEEDS الترجمة (G6, per redline 8): the English and Yoruba rendering is performed on memorized Qur'anic content, which is what makes it meaningful rather than an exercise on arbitrary sentences.

FEEDS النحو والصرف AND LATER البلاغة: the memorized stock is the sentence corpus for إعراب and for rhetorical analysis from G6-G7 onward. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: ḥifẓ teaches no grammar, parses nothing, and is never assessed on meaning. Grammatical analysis of a memorized āyah belongs to النحو's period, not to the hour.

BOUNDARY WITH النشيد والمحفوظات: these two share a METHOD (memorization by repetition and prosody) and must not share a TIME. All منظومات, متون and شعر — including the G3 منظومة التوحيد والإيمان, ديوان الشافعي, لامية ابن الوردي, تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري — live there or in their owning subject. The ring-fenced hour memorizes Qur'an only. This boundary is the practical meaning of the ring-fence and is the one most likely to be eroded in daily practice, because the erosion always looks pious.

FEEDS أصول الفقه AND أصول التفسير (wherever the board places them at G10-G12): the graduate retrieves آيات الأحكام from memory rather than from an index. Ḥifẓ is the retrieval layer under those disciplines and is the reason they can move faster at SHRS than at a school without it.

SEPARATELY GOVERNED FROM, BUT SHARING THE HOUR WITH, THE ḤIFẒ TRACK (redline 2): one ring-fenced hour, two pace lanes, one supervision structure, two assessment thresholds. The Ijazah is an optional mastery-certified layer on top and never a grade gate.

FEEDS ITSELF THROUGH الإقراء FROM G9: G9-G12 students take supervised تسميع from G1-G2 children. Hearing a beginner's substitution errors is the fastest consolidator of one's own precision, and it is also how this school will grow the halaqah teachers it needs to hold the caps above. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]
openQuestions: الرواية المعتمدة — حفص عن عاصم أم ورش عن نافع؟ BLOCKING, and must be settled before the first G1 cohort. Both are present in Nigeria; my understanding is that Ḥafṣ dominates modern printing and international certification while the West African transmission tradition gives Warsh a strong regional presence, but I am not confident enough about the specific prevalence in this Yoruba-speaking catchment to weigh it, and the local community's own practice should decide it, not my inference. What I am confident of professionally: choose once, choose before G1, and never change it mid-ladder. Switching riwāyah partway through a student's ḥifẓ is destructive in a way no remediation recovers. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

طبعة المصحف الموحدة — which specific print and page layout, fixed school-wide from G4. Page-image anchoring is a principal retention mechanism; a class working from mixed editions loses it. Must be procurable in quantity in Nigeria for twelve consecutive cohorts. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

حجم الحلقة — the caps above (≤12 at G1-G3 rising to ≤25 at G10-G12) determine whether this ladder is real. If the school cannot staff them, the floors must be lowered before publication rather than missed after. This is a staffing and finance ruling, not a curricular one. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

الحد الأدنى المنشور — does SHRS publish the honest floor (≈22 juz by G12 for the full-course student) or the aspiration (30)? I have set the floors conservatively so that the weakest full-course child clears them. Publishing the aspiration as a promise will produce a first cohort that visibly misses it. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

زمن مسار الحفظ — the Ḥifẓ Track cannot reach 30 juz on the ring-fenced hour alone; arithmetically it needs supervised time beyond it. Where does that time come from — boarding hours, early morning, holiday intensives? It cannot come from the 19-period ceiling and it cannot come from the national morning curriculum, both of which are outside this subject's authority. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

ترتيب الحفظ — I have recommended جزء عمّ (G1-G2) → جزء تبارك (G3-G4) → من البقرة فصاعداً (G5+), on the reasoning that juz 29 and 30 share the المفصّل register that suits oral and early-muṣḥaf phases, while البقرة's long āyāt require the decoding fluency established at G4. An alternative traditional ordering goes from juz 30 directly to البقرة. Defensible either way; the council should ratify one and hold it, since changing it mid-cohort scrambles the review rotation. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE / COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

معايير الإتقان للشهادة — I have proposed zero لحن جليّ and ≤٢ أخطاء خفيّة per page from a cold random cue, with a juz counted only when it meets that bar. The threshold itself is a policy choice with real consequences for how many juz a G12 certificate can honestly claim. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

سياسة الطالب الملتحق متأخراً — a child entering at G5 or G8 cannot join the grade floor. Does he run a compressed catch-up lane inside the same hour, or is he certified honestly against a personal ladder? The second is more truthful and harder to administer. Not designed here. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G1 — but only in its practical strand, and "meaningful" here means something very specific. التجويد is two disciplines wearing one name: (a) التجويد العملي, the correct oral production of Qur'anic sound, acquired only by التلقي والمشافهة — imitation of a correct model plus immediate correction; and (b) علم التجويد, the codified science with its terminology, rules and mutūn. Strand (a) produces real learning from the very first recitation lesson at G1 and is already constitutionally paid for: [RECOVERED] the 195-hour ring-fenced Qur'an hour explicitly houses practical تجويد at zero period cost. Strand (b) produces NO real learning before G4 — before the child can reliably see سكون، تنوين، شدة on the page and hold the categories ساكن/متحرك as analytic objects, rule-names are memorised noise. So: first meaningful appearance of the practice is G1; first meaningful appearance of the science is G4. Conflating the two is the commonest failure in تجويد curricula and the submission is right to have avoided it.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (الحصة القرآنية المحصنة) — NOT القراءة والتهجي
gradeByGrade.content: Articulation by imitation and correction only, with zero terminology. The content spine is the L1 interference set, not a generic letter list: [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Yoruba (and anglophone) phonology lacks ع ح غ خ ق ص ض ط ظ ث ذ, has no pharyngealisation, is largely CV-syllabled, and is tonal. So G1 targets exactly: (1) the pharyngeal/uvular/emphatic set produced from the right مخرج; (2) the three حركات as pure vowel qualities with NO tonal pitch contour carried over from Yoruba; (3) السكون with no epenthetic vowel inserted after it (أَنْعَمْتَ must not become a-ne-me-ta); (4) الشدة as an audible held doubling; (5) المد الطبيعي held at a consistent two counts. Delivered inside حفظ of قصار المفصل. Assessment is the teacher's per-child correction log inside the Qur'an hour, no separate mark and no separate paper.

Same inventory stabilised over a larger memorised portion, plus two additions taught as SOUND and never as name: القلقلة as an audible bounce on ق ط ب ج د in the sākin position, and الغنة as an audible nasal hold on النون والميم المشددتين. Begins self-correction on prompt (teacher says 'again' rather than modelling, child repairs). Still zero terminology, still zero timetable periods.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] G3 carries a named, non-graded DIAGNOSTIC ARTICULATION SCREEN: each child recorded producing all 28 letters in isolation, in a word, and in a Qur'anic phrase; each error typed (substitution / epenthesis / tonal contour / مد length / gemination loss); a written remediation plan per child. This is a checkpoint, not an examination, and it exists because G4 begins the science and the science is worthless applied to fossilised sound. Also introduced this year: the AUDITORY categories ساكن / متحرك / مشدد / منوَّن — the child can hear and sort them, still without the analytic rule names. This is the bridge year.

gradeByGrade.text: متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان — سليمان بن حسين الجمزوري
gradeByGrade.content: Differentiation year. Memorise and apply roughly the first half of the matn: المقدمة; أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين (الإظهار الحلقي، الإدغام بغنة وبغير غنة، الإقلاب، الإخفاء الحقيقي); أحكام النون والميم المشددتين; أحكام الميم الساكنة (الإخفاء الشفوي، الإدغام الشفوي، الإظهار الشفوي). Plus أحكام الاستعاذة والبسملة including the وجوه between two سور — included here because it is used every single day in the Qur'an hour. Method is memorised matn + visual rule-hunting on the child's own current ḥifẓ portion (mark every إخفاء on this page), NOT لغوي analysis of the rajaz — the child's Arabic is at المفردات والجمل القصيرة and cannot parse the verse; the lines are glossed, not construed. Independently assessed: matn recall + rule identification on a seen page + production.

gradeByGrade.text: متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان (completion)
gradeByGrade.content: Complete the matn: أحكام لام أل ولام الفعل (الإظهار القمري / الإدغام الشمسي); المثلان والمتقاربان والمتجانسان (صغير، كبير، مطلق — at recognition level only, the كبير and مطلق categories are named but not drilled); أقسام المد أصلي وفرعي; أحكام المد — اللازم بأقسامه، الواجب المتصل، الجائز المنفصل، العارض للسكون، البدل، اللين — each with its count and each demonstrated in a verse the child has already memorised. Independently assessed: full matn from memory, plus rule identification and correct production on an UNSEEN مصحف page (this unseen element is what proves transfer rather than recall).

gradeByGrade.text: المقدمة الجزرية — محمد بن محمد ابن الجزري
gradeByGrade.content: Opening of the matn through مخارج الحروف and الصفات ذات الضد. The 17 مخارج grouped under the five مخارج عامة (الجوف، الحلق، اللسان، الشفتان، الخيشوم), taught physically: the child locates the point on their own vocal tract, palpates, self-monitors in a mirror. Then الصفات اللازمة ذات الضد: الهمس/الجهر، الشدة/التوسط/الرخاوة، الاستعلاء/الاستفال، الإطباق/الانفتاح، الإذلاق/الإصمات. This is the year the L1 interference set is attacked with theory behind it rather than imitation alone — the child now knows WHY ط is not ت and can self-diagnose. G6 is chosen for مخارج because reliable metacognitive self-listening (attending to one's own vocal tract while producing) is not dependable earlier, and because الصفات vocabulary presupposes the اللغة العربية المفردات base reached by G5-G6. Independently assessed on matn recall AND articulatory production, weighted to production.

gradeByGrade.text: المقدمة الجزرية (body completed; وقف/ابتداء section deferred)
gradeByGrade.content: Complete the body: الصفات التي لا ضد لها (الصفير، القلقلة، اللين، الانحراف، التكرير، التفشي، الاستطالة، الغنة); التفخيم والترقيق — اللام في لفظ الجلالة، الراء في جميع حالاتها، الألف تبعاً لما قبلها; مراتب الغنة; الضاد والظاء والفرق بينهما in production (a standing regional error); and التحذير من اللحن الجلي واللحن الخفي with the distinction stated exactly — جلي changes a letter, a حركة or an إعراب and is a sin to persist in; خفي is a defect of إتقان. [DEPARTURE] The closing section on الوقف والابتداء والمقطوع والموصول والتاءات is memorised with the rest of the matn but NOT taught or examined this year — see G8. Independently assessed.

gradeByGrade.text: closing lines of المقدمة الجزرية (already memorised at G6-G7) + the مصحف itself; NO new matn prescribed
gradeByGrade.content: [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] وحدة الوقف والابتداء وما يتصل به من رسم المصحف, two terms, taught here and not at G6-G7 because it is the one part of علم التجويد that is not phonetic at all — it is a judgement about where a MEANING completes, and that judgement is impossible without نحو. الآجرومية lands at G6 and ملحة الإعراب at G7; G8 is the first year the student can identify جملة تامة، إسناد، فاعل، مبتدأ وخبر and therefore rule on a stop. Content: أقسام الوقف (اضطراري، اختباري، انتظاري، اختياري) and the four grades of الاختياري (تام، كاف، حسن، قبيح) each defined by its نحوي/معنوي criterion, not by a sign; the مصحف's own علامات (م، لا، ج، صلى، قلى، معانقة) and precisely what each licenses and forbids; الابتداء وشروطه; السكت where the house رواية reads it; وقف الهاء والتاء المبسوطة والمربوطة; المقطوع والموصول. Independently assessed with a mandatory practical: read an unseen page and JUSTIFY every stop taken and every stop refused.

No new doctrine — and this is a deliberate design statement, not a gap. علم التجويد is a finite syllabus and by end of G8 it is complete; what remains is not more theory but the conversion of theory into automatic performance. G9 is the consolidation year: sustained recitation of long continuous portions in one sitting; the three tempos (الحدر، التدوير، الترتيل) and the discipline of keeping مد counts constant across a change of tempo — the single most common breakdown; breath planning across long آيات; غنة held to a consistent duration; self-monitoring for لحن خفي without prompting. Zero timetable periods; lives entirely in the Qur'an hour. Embedded assessment.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Form stays مضمّن at zero period cost, but assessment becomes independent: a TERMINAL PRACTICAL CERTIFICATION IN تلاوة مجودة. Unseen مصحف page, sight-read: zero لحن جلي as the pass condition, لحن خفي within a published tolerance, all أحكام تحفة and الجزرية correctly realised, every وقف defensible. The certificate is institutional إتقان التلاوة — explicitly NOT an إجازة بالسند, which belongs to the parallel opt-in track [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 2]. This is deliberately placed at G10 because from G11 the student begins correcting others, and no one should be licensed to correct who has not first been certified. G10 is also the year مصطلح الحديث differentiates and the 19-period timetable is under maximum pressure — a zero-period subject that still certifies is exactly what that year needs.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] وحدة الإقراء وتصحيح التلاوة, ONE term only, 2 periods/week. This is a genuinely distinct competency from reciting well and it does not arise by itself: hearing another person's error, typing it correctly (مخرج / صفة / حكم / مقدار مد / وقف / جلي vs خفي), and prescribing the specific corrective drill for that type. Also: how to run a حلقة تصحيح; how to correct a seven-year-old without shaming them; how to keep a per-child error log; when to refer rather than remediate. Independently assessed by observed practicum on real younger pupils, not by paper. Placed at G11 rather than G12 so that G12 is available for supervised practice, and rather than G10 because the student must hold their own certification first.

Each G12 student is assigned a small group of G1-G4 pupils inside the Qur'an hour and conducts corrected recitation under teacher moderation, keeping the error log learnt at G11 — plus their own مراجعة مجودة of the full memorised portion. Zero timetable periods, no separate تجويد paper: assessment is embedded in the moderated حلقة record. This closes the loop: the discipline's last act is to reproduce itself, and it does so as free labour inside an hour the constitution has already ring-fenced. Students in the parallel إجازة track continue on their own pace-based governance alongside this, not instead of it.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G4 — التجويد becomes a distinct named timetabled subject with متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان. The reason it is G4 and not G3: تحفة's entire first half is rule-triggering on a VISUAL cue — a نون with a sukūn followed by one of a named set of letters, a tanwīn, a shadda. Until the child can reliably see and sort سكون / تنوين / شدة on the page, every rule is memorised noise. القراءة والتهجي reaches الكلمات only at G3 and المفردات والجمل at G4; the analytic category ساكن-versus-متحرك is only auditorily secure at end of G3 (which is why G3 carries the diagnostic screen). Starting at G3 would convert تحفة into a نشيد the child chants without applying, and a first experience of تجويد as meaningless chanting poisons the attitude for years. The reason it is G4 and not G5: articulatory and prosodic habit is still plastic at G4 and hardening fast. Every additional year of daily recitation with غنة-less إخفاء and inconsistent مد lengths adds motor habit that must later be un-learnt — and un-learning costs several times what learning costs. G4 is the last year where the habits are still soft and the first year where the eye can carry the rule. It is also the year with headroom: 1 period out of 19. Note the differentiation is of the SCIENCE only. The practice does not differentiate at G4 — it has been running مضمّن since G1 and continues مضمّن to G12.
prerequisites: Reliable letter-sound correspondence and fluent reading of a fully pointed Arabic word — established by القراءة والتهجي, end of G3 (الكلمات stage). Without it تحفة cannot be applied to a page.

Secure discrimination of ساكن / متحرك / مشدد / منوَّن as both auditory and visual categories — established end of G3 through the Qur'an hour plus القراءة والتهجي, and verified by the G3 diagnostic articulation screen. This is the hard gate on G4.
A working oral repertoire of memorised Qur'an for the rules to operate on — established continuously from G1 by حفظ القرآن inside the 195-hour ring-fenced hour; sufficient stock by end of G3.

Capacity to memorise رجز verse — established by G3 through النشيد والمحفوظات (منظومة التوحيد والإيمان at G3 in the submission). This is a real and often-missed dependency: تحفة is a 61-line rajaz poem, and G3's نشيد work is precisely what makes it tractable at G4.

Arabic vocabulary sufficient for the matn's technical terms to be GLOSSED (not construed) — partial from اللغة العربية at G4-G5; needed at a higher level for the الصفات lexicon (الهمس، الجهر، الإطباق، الاستعلاء، الإذلاق، الإصمات، التفشي، الاستطالة) at G6, established by اللغة العربية G5-G6.

Basic نحو — recognition of جملة اسمية/فعلية، الإسناد، المبتدأ والخبر، الفاعل، تمام المعنى — established by الآجرومية at G6 and ملحة الإعراب at G7. This is the sole prerequisite for الوقف والابتداء and the reason that content sits at G8, not G6-G7.
Elementary صرف — أصلي vs زائد, and لام الفعل vs لام الاسم — established by البناء في الصرف at G6. A minor but real feed into lām rules and إدغام المتقاربين.
Sufficient meaning-access to the text being recited to judge where a sense completes — established by التفسير from G6 onward; feeds the G8 وقف unit.
Ability to hear, name and type another person's error — built G6-G8 by الجزرية plus the وقف unit; prerequisite for the G11 إقراء unit.
A declared house رواية. See open questions — this is a prerequisite the curriculum does not yet have.

classicalTexts.title: متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان في تجويد القرآن — سليمان بن حسين الجمزوري
classicalTexts.justification: Approximately 61 lines of rajaz covering أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين، النون والميم المشددتين، أحكام الميم الساكنة، لام أل ولام الفعل، المثلين والمتقاربين والمتجانسين، أقسام المد وأحكامه. It is the correct first matn for this slot for a reason internal to its design: it is almost entirely rule-on-visual-cue, which is exactly what an eight-to-ten-year-old can do, and it deliberately omits مخارج وصفات, which they cannot. Retained exactly as the Redline Board placed it. Taught as memorised matn plus application drill on the child's own ḥifẓ portion, glossed and not construed.

classicalTexts.title: المقدمة فيما على قارئه أن يعلمه، المعروفة بالمقدمة الجزرية — محمد بن محمد ابن الجزري
classicalTexts.grade: G6-G7 (body); closing section deferred to G8
classicalTexts.justification: Roughly 107-109 lines of rajaz. This is the 'الجزرية' named in the submission — confirming the identification explicitly since the short name is ambiguous in some catalogues. Its core is مخارج الحروف (17 مخارج under 5 general) and الصفات, which is precisely the remediation instrument this student population needs, and which requires the self-monitoring maturity of roughly G6. Its closing section on الوقف والابتداء والمقطوع والموصول والتاءات is memorised with the rest but taught at G8 after نحو arrives.

classicalTexts.title: منار الهدى في بيان الوقف والابتدا — attributed to الأشموني
classicalTexts.justification: NOT ADOPTED. I believe a work of approximately this title on الوقف والابتداء exists, but I am not sufficiently confident of the exact title-author pairing to prescribe it, and in any case a full scholarly treatise on الوقف is far beyond a G8 unit. Recorded here only so the council knows it was considered and deliberately declined rather than overlooked. No classical matn is prescribed for the G8 unit; it is taught from the closing lines of الجزرية the student has already memorised plus the مصحف's own وقف apparatus.

classicalTexts.title: حرز الأماني ووجه التهاني (الشاطبية) — القاسم بن فيره الشاطبي
classicalTexts.justification: EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED from all twelve grades. It exists and I am confident of the title and author, but it is a work of علم القراءات, roughly 1173 lines, and belongs to a discipline that is not in the 26-subject register as presented to me. It must not be smuggled into تجويد to make the secondary years look weightier. If the council later creates a قراءات subject that is a separate ruling, not an extension of this one.

classicalTexts.title: متن المكتفى في الوقف والابتدا — أبو عمرو الداني
classicalTexts.justification: NOT ADOPTED. I am reasonably confident this work exists under this author, but it is a large reference work on the وقف of the whole مصحف, not a teaching matn, and it is wholly unsuited to a G8 unit. Listed to document the decision, not to place it.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Four distinct premature-introduction risks, each with a different failure mode. (1) Teaching the TERMINOLOGY at G1-G3: pure verbalism. A six-year-old can chant 'الإخفاء الحقيقي' and be unable to hear a غنة. Worse, it converts the constitutionally ring-fenced Qur'an hour from recitation into talk-about-recitation — the one thing the ring-fence exists to prevent (لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى protects the hour from external raiding; it should equally protect it from internal hollowing-out). (2) Starting تحفة at G3: the child cannot yet reliably see سكون and تنوين, so every rule is applied by guess; the matn degrades into a chant; and the child's first encounter with تجويد as a named subject becomes an experience of incomprehension, which produces durable aversion. (3) Accelerating الجزرية to G4-G5: مخارج work is irreducibly metacognitive — the learner must attend to their own vocal tract while producing sound and compare it to a model. That self-monitoring is not dependable before roughly G6. Additionally الصفات vocabulary (الإطباق، الإذلاق، الإصمات، الاستطالة، التفشي) is dense technical Arabic that a G4 مفردات-level learner cannot even gloss, so the صفات become paired nonsense words. (4) The most serious and the one the submission actually walks into: teaching الوقف والابتداء at G6-G7 alongside the rest of الجزرية. Without نحو the student can only memorise the مصحف's stop-signs as arbitrary symbols. He then stops where the sign is and never acquires the underlying judgement, which means he cannot stop correctly on an unsigned edition, cannot resume correctly, and cannot explain any of it. This is the single most widespread defect in تجويد teaching internationally and it is caused by exactly this placement error.
lifecycles.delayRisks: The delay risks are sharper than the premature risks, and one of them dominates the whole design. (1) Delaying PRACTICAL تجويد past G1 — the dominant risk. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] In a Yoruba-L1, anglophone-schooled population the default substitutions are predictable and systematic: ث→t/s, ذ→d/z, ص→s, ض→d, ط→t, ظ→z, ع→glottal or zero, ح→h, غ→g, خ→h/k, ق→k; pharyngealisation absent entirely; Yoruba's CV syllable structure inserts epenthetic vowels after every ساكن; and because Yoruba is tonal, pitch contours get carried onto Arabic vowels, producing a recitation that sounds sung and that distorts مد lengths. These become motor-encoded within roughly the first year of daily recitation. Every year of delay multiplies remediation cost several-fold, and some — ع and ح in particular — become close to unrecoverable in adulthood. This is why practical تجويد must be مضمّن from G1 and why it cannot wait for the subject to 'start' at G4. (2) Delaying تحفة past G5: five or six years of accumulated غنة-less إخفاء, wrong مد counts and missed إقلاب, all of which must then be un-learnt before they can be re-learnt. (3) Delaying الجزرية past G7: this is a developmental window, not just a sequencing preference. Articulatory correction requires a learner willing to be watched opening their mouth and told it is wrong. Adolescent self-consciousness rises steeply and the tolerance for that closes. G6-G7 is the last comfortable window. (4) Delaying الوقف والابتداء past G8-G9: the student's recitation is letter-perfect but breaks meaning mid-clause. This is simultaneously the least visible defect to the student and the MOST visible to any qualified outside listener — it is what a visiting scholar hears first, and it is what would most damage the school's international standing. (5) Delaying the إقراء unit past G11: no trained cohort exists for the G12 supervised حلقة, the school loses a teacher pipeline it can generate for free, and the zero-cost G12 arrangement collapses.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 تجويد holds no timetable period and sets no paper. Its form is مضمّن and its role is reproductive: each G12 student runs a small corrected-recitation حلقة for G1-G4 pupils inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour, under teacher moderation, keeping the per-child error log learnt in the G11 unit — while maintaining their own مراجعة مجودة of the memorised portion. This costs the 19-period ceiling nothing in a year that is otherwise the most congested of the twelve, and it converts the senior cohort from a consumer of teaching capacity into a producer of it. What the graduate can actually do, stated as capabilities and not as attainment language: (1) sight-read an unseen page of the مصحف with correct مخارج and صفات, all أحكام النون والميم والمد realised, correct تفخيم/ترقيق of اللام والراء, and no لحن جلي; (2) place and justify every stop and every resumption by the grade of the وقف and its نحوي ground, on an edition with or without stop-signs; (3) listen to another reciter, identify the error, name it by its technical category, and prescribe the specific drill that corrects it — and do this with a child without shaming them; (4) recite متن تحفة الأطفال and المقدمة الجزرية from memory and adduce the relevant lines as evidence for a ruling; (5) teach a beginners' حلقة unsupervised; (6) enter the parallel opt-in إجازة track with the entire technical base already complete, so that track has only to certify إتقان and سند rather than to teach the science from scratch.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Total cost is unusually low because the constitution has already paid for the practical half. Against the 7-period ceiling at G1-G2 and the 19-period ceiling at G3-G12: G1 — 0 periods (entirely inside the 195-hour Qur'an hour). G2 — 0. G3 — 0 (the diagnostic screen is run inside the Qur'an hour and in one scheduled assessment window, not from the weekly allocation). G4 — 1 period/week. G5 — 1. G6 — 2 (الجزرية is denser than تحفة and مخارج requires demonstration plus individual production drill, which cannot be done whole-class in one period). G7 — 2. G8 — 2 periods/week for two terms only, roughly 1.3 period-equivalents annualised. G9 — 0. G10 — 0 (the terminal certification is an assessment event, not a teaching allocation). G11 — 2 periods/week for one term only, roughly 0.7 annualised. G12 — 0. Peak load is 2 of 19, about 10.5%, at G6-G7 — and G6-G7 are precisely the years the submission has already loaded with الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، التفسير والترجمة، الفقه والسيرة، so this figure needs watching but is affordable. The two genuinely critical facts for the board: تجويد costs ZERO at G1-G2 where the ceiling is only 7 periods, and ZERO at G10 and G12 where مصطلح الحديث، أصول الفقه، البلاغة and the exam year are all competing. Whole-lifecycle cost is approximately 10 period-years out of a theoretical 12×19.
departuresFromSubmission: MAJOR — الوقف والابتداء is removed from the G6-G7 delivery of الجزرية and deferred to G8 as a وحدة. The submission says 'الجزرية مستقل theoretical and practical' at G6-G7, which necessarily includes the matn's closing section on الوقف. That section is not phonetics; it is a نحوي/معنوي judgement about where a sense completes, and it is impossible before الآجرومية (G6) and ملحة الإعراب (G7) are digested. Teaching it at G6-G7 produces students who obey stop-signs and possess no judgement. The lines are still memorised at G6-G7 with the rest of the matn; only the teaching and examination move.

The practical strand is given an explicit NAMED partner — حفظ القرآن / الحصة القرآنية — rather than being left as unattached 'practical مضمّن'. This matters because the submission runs القراءة والتهجي as a مدمج subject with its own book across G1-G5, and القراءة والتهجي and تجويد عملي sit in the same space. The boundary must be stated or they will duplicate: التهجي answers 'can you read this word?', تجويد عملي answers 'does the sound come out of the right مخرج with the right صفة and the right count?'. Same minute of the day at G1, entirely different objective and entirely different assessment.

Practical تجويد is explicitly extended through G8-G12 as مضمّن. The submission is silent past G7 and, more dangerously, silent about whether the practice continues once the mutūn are finished. It must. A curriculum that ends تجويد when الجزرية ends produces students whose recitation degrades from G8 onward with no one watching.

ADDED — a وحدة الإقراء وتصحيح التلاوة at G11, one term, 2 periods/week. Reciting well and being able to correct another person are different competencies; the second does not emerge from the first and has to be taught.

ADDED — a terminal independently-assessed practical certification in تلاوة مجودة at G10, with the form remaining مضمّن and the period cost remaining zero. This is a deliberate exercise of the board's rule that assessment is orthogonal to form.
ADDED — a diagnostic articulation screen at G3, non-graded, as the gate into the G4 science. The submission has no checkpoint between three years of practice and the start of the matn.

CONTENT — the G1-G3 'practical' is specified as the Yoruba/anglophone L1 interference set rather than left as an undefined adjective. 'Practical تجويد' with no named target inventory will in practice become generic letter drill, which is exactly what this population does not need.
PERIODS — the submission gives no numbers anywhere. Numbers supplied at every grade against the stated ceiling.

RAISED — the submission nowhere declares which رواية the institution reads. تحفة and الجزرية teach principles, but several of the specific أحكام a student must produce differ by رواية. This is a prerequisite, not a detail.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: حفظ القرآن — its permanent host at all twelve grades and the source of its zero period cost [RECOVERED]. The dependency runs both ways but asymmetrically: تجويد needs حفظ's material and its daily minutes; حفظ needs تجويد or it memorises error. A memoriser with fossilised تجويد has memorised the wrong thing, and the more he memorises the worse the problem. تجويد must never be allowed to convert the Qur'an hour into a lecture — its presence there is corrective and demonstrative, measured in seconds per child, not in explanation.

القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5) — the highest duplication risk in the whole curriculum, because both occupy the same early ground. Hard boundary: التهجي is decoding and owns the separate book and its own independent assessment; تجويد عملي is quality of production and owns no book at these grades and is assessed only inside the Qur'an hour. If a تجويد rule-name appears in the التهجي book, the boundary has been breached.

النحو (الآجرومية G6، ملحة الإعراب G7) — feeds تجويد at exactly one point and it is a hard dependency: الوقف والابتداء. This single link is what forces the G8 وحدة. تجويد does not feed نحو and must never be used as a vehicle for teaching it.

الصرف (البناء في الصرف G6) — minor but real feed: أصلي vs زائد for إدغام المتقاربين, and لام الفعل vs لام الاسم for the lām rules in تحفة. Worth one cross-reference in the G5-G6 scheme of work, no more.
اللغة العربية — feeds تجويد the vocabulary needed to gloss تحفة (G4-G5) and to hold the الصفات lexicon (G6). تجويد does not feed it back and must not be counted as Arabic language time.

النشيد والمحفوظات — feeds تجويد twice: it builds the rajaz-memorisation capacity that makes تحفة tractable at G4 (the G3 منظومة is the enabler), and it trains breath and vocal control. It must NOT absorb تحفة or الجزرية — those are تجويد's mutūn, carrying تجويد's independent assessment, not نشيد repertoire. Filing a matn under النشيد is how a discipline quietly loses its curricular home.

التفسير (from G6) — feeds the G8 وقف unit, since no stop can be graded تام or حسن without access to the meaning. تجويد must not drift into تفسير: at G8 the question is 'has the sense completed here?', never 'what does this verse teach?'.

الإملاء (longitudinal through اللغة العربية, redline 7) — a genuine reciprocal link that is easy to miss. The مخارج work at G6 directly supports orthographic discrimination of ض/ظ، س/ص، ت/ط، ذ/ز/ظ، ه/ح — precisely the pairs a Yoruba-L1 writer confuses, and confuses because he does not hear them. تجويد improving إملاء through phonemic discrimination is a real effect and should be planned for, not left to chance.

الإجازة (parallel opt-in track, redline 2) — تجويد is its curricular feeder, not its gate. The grade curriculum teaches the science and certifies standard recitation on the term calendar; the Ijazah track certifies سند-level إتقان at the student's own pace. تجويد must never be restructured into a 'pass by G6' Ijazah gate, and the G10 certification must be labelled إتقان التلاوة and never إجازة.

الترجمة (from G6) — no relationship whatsoever. Deliberately stated: because both sit in Programme 1 at G6, there will be pressure to combine them. Rendering meaning into English or Yoruba has nothing to do with producing Arabic phonemes, and combining them would damage both.

التوحيد / الفقه / السيرة / الحديث — no relationship. The only fiqh-adjacent content تجويد legitimately carries is أحكام الاستعاذة والبسملة at G4, because it is performed daily. Everything else about مس المصحف, آداب التلاوة and سجود التلاوة belongs to الفقه, not here.
الإنشاء والخطابة (unassigned) — shares breath and voice projection and nothing else. Should not merge; the G11 إقراء unit may share a teacher but not a syllabus.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — highest priority, blocks the G4 scheme of work] Which رواية is the institution's house standard? A تجويد curriculum that does not name its رواية is incoherent, because the rules students must actually produce differ: مقدار المد المنفصل, صلة ميم الجمع, مد البدل, ترقيق الراء in specified positions, and the treatment of السكت all vary. West Africa has a historic ورش عن نافع tradition running alongside the now widely distributed حفص عن عاصم of Saudi-printed مصاحف, and I do not know which predominates in the Yoruba southwest. I will not guess. The council must declare it, and the declaration must precede the printing of any G4 material.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does علم القراءات exist anywhere in the 26-subject register? The full register was not supplied to me. If it does, its relationship to تجويد at G10-G12 needs ruling and my G9-G12 shape may need revisiting. If it does not, the shape above stands, and the ruling should be explicit rather than accidental — because in the absence of a ruling, قراءات content tends to creep into secondary-years تجويد to give it apparent weight, which is exactly what should not happen.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does the G12 supervised حلقة carry any workload recognition or credential for the student, and who carries liability for a fifteen-to-seventeen-year-old instructing six-year-olds? The pedagogy is sound; the governance is outside my competence.

[PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE — needs institutional verification] My specification of the G1-G3 practical inventory rests on the phonological gap between Yoruba and Arabic. The institution's own teachers hear these children every day and will know which errors actually dominate in this intake. The G3 diagnostic screen should be run once as a baseline BEFORE the G1-G3 content is finalised, and the inventory adjusted to what the data shows.

[OPEN] Staffing. The G6-G7 مخارج work and the G11 إقراء unit both require a teacher who is themselves articulatorily sound and can diagnose. This is a scarcer capability than the ability to teach the matn, and the twelve-year design above is only as good as that person. The G11-G12 arrangement is partly designed to generate this capability internally over time, but it cannot do so in year one.

[OPEN] The G6-G7 peak of 2 periods coincides with the introduction of الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، التفسير والترجمة and الأخضري in the same two years. تجويد's claim is defensible but it is not the only one; if the G6-G7 timetable does not close, I would sooner see الجزرية spread across G6-G8 at 1.5 periods with the وقف unit moving to G9 than see مخارج taught whole-class without individual production drill. That degradation path should be recorded now rather than improvised later.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G1, Term 1 — and the first meaningful teaching is AUDITORY, not visual. For this discipline "meaningful" means the point at which instruction produces durable change in the learner's decoding system. In a Yoruba/English-speaking intake that point is NOT the first letter chart; it is the oral discrimination of the Arabic phonemes with no Yoruba or English counterpart (ح ع ق ص ض ط ظ غ خ, and the ه/ح and أ/ع contrasts). [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Teaching graphemes to a child who cannot yet HEAR ص from س produces a child who sees ص and says /s/ — and because the ring-fenced 195-hour Qur'an hour runs at full strength from G1, that substitution is then written into memorised text as fossilised لحن جلي, stored in motor-auditory memory attached to specific verses rather than as a correctable rule. So: oral phonemic discrimination + letter identity from week one of G1; grapheme-vowel synthesis from G1 Term 2. There is no earlier option (G1 is the architectural floor) and no case for later — see delay risks.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (inside the ring-fenced 60-min Qur'an hour)
gradeByGrade.text: القاعدة النورانية أو القاعدة البغدادية — selection conditional on the riwāyah/rasm ruling
gradeByGrade.content: T1: oral discrimination of Arabic-only phonemes against the Yoruba/English inventory (ح/ه، ع/أ، ق/ك، ص/س، ض/د، ط/ت، ظ/ذ/ز، غ، خ); letter names; isolated letter shapes; visual discrimination of dot-patterns (ب ت ث / ج ح خ / د ذ / ر ز / س ش / ص ض / ط ظ / ع غ / ف ق / ن ي); explicit right-to-left directional training taught in deliberate contrast with the morning Latin-script curriculum. T2: synthesis of fatḥa/kasra/ḍamma onto single letters, then two-letter combinations. T3: sukūn and closed syllables; positional forms (مبتدئة/متوسطة/متطرفة/منفصلة); decoding of controlled 2-3 letter words from the قاعدة only.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (inside the ring-fenced 60-min Qur'an hour)
gradeByGrade.text: القاعدة النورانية أو القاعدة البغدادية (completion)
gradeByGrade.content: تنوين (all three); شدة, including shadda carrying a vowel and shadda with tanwīn; المد الطبيعي (ا و ي); اللام الشمسية والقمرية at reading level (do not pronounce the lām in الشمس); همزة الوصل at phrase-initial vs in continuation; التاء المربوطة vs المبسوطة in reading and at waqf. Completion of the قاعدة's controlled text, then first decoding of the muṣḥaf's shortest sūrahs of جزء عمّ.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (inside the ring-fenced 60-min Qur'an hour)
gradeByGrade.text: المصحف (جزء عمّ ثم جزء تبارك) — the قاعدة is retired during this year
gradeByGrade.assessment: independently assessed — plus the DECODING-COMPLETE GATE at end of year
gradeByGrade.content: Transition from the controlled primer to the unmodified muṣḥaf page — the single hardest step in the subject. الألف الفارقة; الألف الخنجرية introduced as a recognised exception; الحروف الزائدة في الرسم العثماني (e.g. the unpronounced wāw of أولئك) taught as named conventions rather than left for the child to invent a rule about. Sustained connected reading moving from word-by-word to phrase level. GATE: reads an unseen page of جزء عمّ aloud, fully vocalised, with decoding accuracy ≥95% and zero fossilised phoneme substitution.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (inside the ring-fenced 60-min Qur'an hour)
gradeByGrade.text: المصحف
gradeByGrade.assessment: independently assessed — instrument is timed oral reading of UNSEEN passages
gradeByGrade.content: INTERNAL PIVOT: the subject stops being التهجي (decoding construction) and becomes القراءة (fluency and Uthmanic convention). Reading rate and phrasing; systematic coverage of the muṣḥaf conventions a phonetically-competent decoder still gets wrong: الألف الخنجرية, صلة هاء الضمير, الحروف الزائدة, رسم الهمزة, and علامات الوقف (م، لا، ج، صلى، قلى، and the معانقة marks in the Ḥafṣ muṣḥaf — Warsh maṣāḥif mark waqf differently). Articulation and duration (المخارج، الصفات، المدود) hand over cleanly to التجويد, which becomes مستقل this year with تحفة الأطفال.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (inside the ring-fenced 60-min Qur'an hour)
gradeByGrade.text: المصحف (wider juzʾ range, including long-verse مدني sūrahs)
gradeByGrade.assessment: independently assessed — plus TERMINAL EXIT CERTIFICATION
gradeByGrade.content: Sustained reading of long-verse مدني text with breath-phrasing governed by the waqf marks; first-sight reading of any vocalised muṣḥaf page; self-correction without prompting; maintaining decoding accuracy WHILE applying the تحفة الأطفال rules (the integration check with التجويد). EXIT THRESHOLD: first-sight oral reading of an unseen vocalised muṣḥaf page at a fluent phrase-level rate, correct on all conventions taught G3-G5, with self-correction of any slip. The subject then ends.

Function complete; the entity ends. Its minutes inside the Qur'an hour pass to التفسير العملي للقرآن + الترجمة (accepted redline 8) — the hour's non-حفظ time moves decoding (G1-G3) → fluency and convention (G4-G5) → meaning and translation (G6-G7) inside a constitutionally fixed 60 minutes. A دوراني remediation clinic runs for identified G5 non-attainers ONLY, outside the cohort curriculum and governed on the parallel-track model of redline 2 (pace-based, separately governed) — it is not a cohort subject and must not be timetabled as one. Reading UNVOCALISED Arabic begins this year but belongs to اللغة العربية/النحو, not here.

Not taught. The competency is exercised and maintained implicitly in حفظ, تلاوة, الجزرية, التفسير, and in reading ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال as vocalised matn texts. Any residual reading difficulty at this point is a placement matter routed to the remediation clinic, not a reason to reinstate the subject.

Not taught. A learner still unable to decode at إعدادية level is an individual placement and safeguarding matter — the correct response is the parallel remediation track, never a cohort period taken from the 19-period ceiling.
Not taught. Silently load-bearing: every matn-based subject in the إعدادية years assumes first-sight reading of vocalised text is automatic.

Not taught. Presupposed by مصطلح الحديث differentiating this year (redline 1) and by all ثانوية text work. Automaticity acquired by G5 is what frees working memory for إعراب, تجويد rules and meaning simultaneously.
Not taught. Presupposed by نخبة الفكر and the full ثانوية matn load.

Not taught as an entity. First-sight reading is an ASSUMED graduate competency. Where it is examined at all it is examined inside تلاوة or the optional إجازة track — never re-badged as القراءة والتهجي. Graduates on the إجازة track are the natural teaching pool for G1-G3 التهجي, which matters for a school with international ambitions and a domestic teacher-supply constraint.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
NEVER DIFFERENTIATES into a مستقل subject — and that is correct, not a deficiency. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Decoding divorced from the text being decoded is dead drill; the entire pedagogical power of this subject is that the child decodes the very sūrah being memorised that week. Making it مستقل would (a) sever decoding from its purpose and (b) claim periods from a ceiling that cannot pay — at G1-G2 a standalone slot would consume roughly 3 of only 7 available periods.

It does, however, have an INTERNAL PIVOT at G4: the form stays مدمج but the curricular object changes from التهجي (building the decoding system) to القراءة (fluency plus Uthmanic orthographic convention).

Why G4 and not G3: تحفة الأطفال والغلمان becomes مستقل and independently assessed at G4 (retained redline 3). أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين are unteachable to a child who cannot already SEE a نون ساكنة in the text and identify the following letter. G4 is therefore the first year decoding can be declared finished — which is precisely why the decoding gate sits at end of G3.

Why G4 and not G5: decoding does not need five years. Three years at ~18 min/day is roughly 175 hours of instruction, far more than a قاعدة requires; madrasa practice routinely completes it in 6-18 months. Holding decoding open to G5 produces the opposite failure from the one the submission fears — children plateau at word-by-word reading, never build phrase-level fluency, and then cannot sustain tajwid-governed تلاوة. Over-extending decoding is itself a pedagogical failure.
prerequisites: Auditory discrimination of the Arabic phonemes absent from Yoruba and English (ح ع ق ص ض ط ظ غ خ). Established: G1 Term 1, orally, INSIDE this subject — it is its own first prerequisite, built rather than assumed, and must not be presupposed from the home or from prior slate-school attendance.
Visual discrimination of dot-pattern minimal pairs (ب ت ث / ج ح خ / د ذ / ر ز / س ش / ص ض / ط ظ / ع غ / ف ق / ن ي). Established: G1 Term 1.

Right-to-left directional tracking, taught in explicit contrast with the Latin-script literacy the child is acquiring concurrently in the morning national curriculum. Established: G1 Term 1. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Yoruba orthography's use of subdots and tone diacritics is a genuine ASSET here — the child already holds the concept that a mark above or below a letter changes its sound, which transfers directly to الحركات and التنوين and argues for early rather than deferred vowel work.
Positional letter forms (مبتدئة / متوسطة / متطرفة / منفصلة). Established: G1 Term 3.
Grapheme-vowel synthesis with الحركات الثلاث and السكون. Established: G1 Terms 2-3.
التنوين, الشدة, المد الطبيعي. Established: G2.
همزة الوصل/القطع, اللام الشمسية والقمرية at reading level, التاء المربوطة. Established: G2.

The Uthmanic conventions that are not phonetic — الألف الفارقة، الألف الخنجرية، الحروف الزائدة، صلة هاء الضمير، علامات الوقف. Established: G3 (recognition) and G4 (systematic). These cannot be inferred by a child from a phonetic reading system and must be explicitly taught, or the child invents a wrong rule and defends it.

A small stock of known words, so decoding can be cross-checked against meaning rather than produced blind. Supplied by اللغة العربية: الحروف at G1-G2, الكلمات at G3, المفردات والجمل at G4-G5 — the submission's sequence aligns correctly with this subject's needs.

NEGATIVE PREREQUISITE, load-bearing: النحو is NOT a prerequisite at any point, because the muṣḥaf is fully vocalised. This is exactly why the subject can and must complete BEFORE النحو begins (مضمّن at G5, الآجرومية at G6) — and why unvocalised reading, which genuinely does require الصرف and الإعراب, cannot belong to this subject.

classicalTexts.title: القاعدة النورانية
classicalTexts.justification: A graded decoding primer is not administrative tidiness — it is the pedagogical core, and it is why the submission's insistence on 'a separate book' is right and must be protected. The muṣḥaf cannot teach decoding: سورة الفاتحة alone contains ص، ط، ع، غ، ض، شدة، مد and همزة وصل inside seven verses. Decoding requires controlled text introducing only letters and vowels already taught, which is exactly what a قاعدة provides. Note: the title and its very wide use across madāris including in Nigeria I am confident of; the common attribution to الشيخ نور محمد حقاني I am NOT fully confident of and the council should not print an authorship claim on my word. Most available editions are oriented to the Ḥafṣ muṣḥaf — if SHRS rules for Warsh, this text may not be usable as-is.

classicalTexts.title: القاعدة البغدادية
classicalTexts.justification: The older traditional decoding primer, widely used across the Muslim world and in West African madāris. Authorship is traditional/anonymous — I will not attach a named author to it. Functionally equivalent to the above for this curriculum's purposes; selection between the two should follow the riwāyah ruling, local teacher familiarity, and print availability in Nigeria rather than my preference.

classicalTexts.title: المصحف الشريف (جزء عمّ، ثم جزء تبارك، ثم wider range)
classicalTexts.justification: Not a matn, but this subject's actual reading object from G3 onward and therefore load-bearing. The move from primer to unmodified muṣḥaf page is the hardest single step in the subject and must be a planned G3 transition, not an assumed one. Which muṣḥaf — Ḥafṣ (Madinah) or Warsh (the West African norm) — determines the letter shapes, the madd conventions and the waqf marking system, and therefore determines the entire G3-G5 convention curriculum. This is unresolved in the submission.

classicalTexts.title: Nigerian / Yoruba-language local decoding primers
classicalTexts.justification: The Qur'anic slate (لوح) tradition and its alif-ba-ta decoding sequence are well established across Yorubaland and northern Nigeria, and locally produced primers in that tradition very likely exist and may fit the intake better than an imported قاعدة. I cannot confirm any specific title or author and I will not name one. [UNVERIFIED — titles pending identification by local scholars.] Routed to the council rather than guessed at.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
