There is no "too early" in grade terms — G1 is the architectural floor and the subject belongs there. The real premature-introduction risks are all WITHIN-YEAR sequencing failures, and they are severe:

1. GRAPHEMES BEFORE PHONEMES (the sharpest risk in the subject). Starting letter charts before auditory discrimination is secure produces a child who sees ص and says /s/, ع and says /ʔ/, ح and says /h/. Because the ring-fenced 195-hour Qur'an hour runs at full strength from G1, that substitution is immediately written into memorised text. Fossilised لحن جلي attached to specific memorised verses is stored as motor-auditory habit, not as a rule, and is disproportionately expensive to repair at G6-G9 — the child must re-learn verse by verse, not rule by rule.

2. THE MUṢḤAF BEFORE THE قاعدة IS COMPLETE. Putting the unmodified Uthmanic page in front of a child mid-primer means meeting الألف الخنجرية, الحروف الزائدة and صلة الهاء with no rule available. Children do not tolerate an unexplained page; they invent a rule and then defend it. Wrong self-generated rules are harder to displace than no rule.

3. COLLAPSING WRITING INTO READING AT G1. Redline 7 already keeps الإملاء longitudinal inside اللغة العربية, which is correct and protects this subject. The residual risk is a teacher assessing G1-G2 decoding by asking the child to WRITE — an encoding instrument measuring the inverse competency, which systematically under-reports the reading ability of children with immature motor control and mislabels them as failing readers.

4. NIGERIA-SPECIFIC DIRECTIONAL INTERFERENCE. Arabic RTL decoding is being installed in the same weeks the morning national curriculum installs Latin-script LTR phonics. Mirror-writing and left-start reading follow. The mitigation is not delay — it is explicit contrast teaching, naming the difference aloud from the first lesson.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Delay is the far more expensive error, and it is expensive in ways that are specific to SHRS's own architecture:

1. THE 195-HOUR HOUR RUNS ANYWAY. The Qur'an hour is constitutionally identical at every grade from G1. A child who cannot decode does those 195 hours on تلقين — pure oral imitation. That means memorisation throughput is capped by teacher voice availability, independent مراجعة at home is impossible, and the child cannot self-check a single verse. Each year of delay is roughly 195 hours running at reduced yield; three years is roughly 585 hours.

2. IT BREAKS AN ACCEPTED REDLINE DOWNSTREAM. تحفة الأطفال at G4 presupposes decoding-complete. If decoding is not finished by end of G3, the retained progression تحفة (G4-G5) → الجزرية (G6-G7) — redline 3 — cannot run. Delaying this subject does not merely slow this subject; it silently invalidates a Board decision in another discipline.

3. IT BLOCKS THE WHOLE G6 GATE. الآجرومية (G6), البناء في الصرف (G6), الأخضري (G6) and التفسير العملي + الترجمة (G6, redline 8) all require reading a text. A non-decoding G6 cohort stalls النحو, الصرف, الفقه and التفسير simultaneously.

4. ADOLESCENT-ONSET DECODING IS SOCIALLY COMPOUNDING. A G7 learner who cannot read the muṣḥaf in front of peers avoids reading; avoidance removes the practice that would fix it; the gap widens rather than closes. Remediation at G7+ is therefore not four years late in instructional terms — it is four years late plus an acquired avoidance behaviour.

5. SILENT FAILURE TRANSFER. If the subject ends at G5 with no named exit threshold, a child who never became fluent simply vanishes into G6 التفسير where no one owns their decoding. This is the specific danger of terminating any foundational subject, and it is why the exit gate and the named remediation route are not optional refinements.
lifecycles.g12Role:
The subject does not exist at G12 — and its G12 role is exactly that invisibility. It is the single most load-bearing competency in the school that occupies no G12 time.

What the graduate can actually do because of it:
- Pick up any vocalised muṣḥaf in the school's ruled riwāyah and read it aloud accurately AT FIRST SIGHT, including correct handling of همزة الوصل, الألف الخنجرية, صلة هاء الضمير, الحروف الزائدة and the waqf marks — none of which is derivable from phonics and all of which was explicitly taught G3-G5.
- Prepare new memorisation and conduct مراجعة without a teacher present. This is what converts the Qur'an hour from a teacher-rate-limited resource into a self-sustaining one, and it is the reason the hour can be constitutionally identical at 195 hours from G1 to G12 while its internal composition changes.
- Read the vocalised matn literature (ملحة الإعراب، لامية الأفعال، الجزرية، الأخضري، نخبة الفكر at G10-G11) without decoding effort.
- Most importantly: because decoding is AUTOMATIC rather than merely possible, the graduate's working memory is free to hold تجويد rules, إعراب and meaning at the same time while reading. That is the actual payoff, and it is the technical reason the subject must finish early and completely rather than run long — a partially automatic decoder spends capacity on decoding and has none left for تلاوة or تفسير.
- Secondary institutional role: graduates who took the optional إجازة track (redline 2) are the natural teaching pool for G1-G3 التهجي — relevant to a school with international ambitions and a domestic teacher-supply constraint.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
ZERO periods from the contested pool at every single grade. This is the subject's most valuable structural property and the Board should weigh it as such.

PRIMARY PROPOSAL — minutes inside the ring-fenced 60-minute Qur'an hour, not periods from the 19/7 ceiling:
- G1: 20-25 min/day (≈100-125 min/week). 0 of the 7 periods.
- G2: 20 min/day (≈100 min/week). 0 of 7.
- G3: 15 min/day (≈75 min/week). 0 of 19.
- G4: 10 min/day (≈50 min/week). 0 of 19.
- G5: 8-10 min/day (≈40-50 min/week). 0 of 19.
- G6-G12: 0. Remediation runs outside the timetable on the parallel-track model.

WHY THIS IS LEGITIMATE, NOT AN EVASION: the constitution ring-fences the hour against being "cut in favour of another subject." القراءة والتهجي is not another subject competing for the hour — it is the ACCESS CONDITION for the hour itself. A G1 child who cannot decode cannot do حفظ from the muṣḥaf at all, only تلقين. The ring-fence protects this work; it does not exclude it. The declining minute profile above is also what lets the hour stay constitutionally fixed at 195 hours while its content shifts: decoding (G1-G3) → fluency and convention (G4-G5) → meaning and translation (G6-G7, redline 8).

HONEST CAVEAT: the governing text names حفظ and practical تجويد as living inside the hour; it does NOT name القراءة والتهجي. Placing it there is a reading, not a recovery. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION — requires ratification.]

FALLBACK IF THE COUNCIL RULES IT "مادة أخرى": 3 of 7 periods at G1-G2, 2 of 19 at G3, 1 of 19 at G4-G5. At G1-G2 that consumes 43% of the entire non-Qur'an budget and, with اللغة العربية at 2 and التوحيد/الفقه العملي at 2, fills all 7 periods exactly — leaving zero slack and no room for النشيد. I record this as arithmetically possible but strongly against the interest of اللغة العربية at the two most fragile grades.

CONTENTION FLAG: حفظ القرآن and practical تجويد are also claiming these same 60 minutes at G1-G3. Three independent claims on one hour is not an allocation. My minimum non-negotiable, for arbitration: 20 min at G1-G2, 15 at G3, 10 at G4, 8 at G5, 0 thereafter.
departuresFromSubmission: NAMED THE PARTNER. The submission says مدمج but never states with what — incoherent under the school's own vocabulary, which defines مدمج as combination with ONE NAMED partner discipline. Partner is حفظ القرآن, and the placement is inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour. This is not a labelling fix: it is what makes the subject cost zero periods against a 7-period ceiling at G1-G2.

SPLIT THE G1-G5 BLOCK IN TWO. The submission treats G1-G5 as one undifferentiated run. Override: التهجي (decoding construction) G1-G3, القراءة (fluency + Uthmanic convention) G4-G5. Decoding does not need five years — three years at ~18 min/day is ~175 hours, far beyond what a قاعدة requires. Over-extending decoding produces children who plateau at word-by-word reading and can never sustain phrase-level تلاوة.

IMPOSED A HARD DECODING GATE AT END OF G3. Derived, not preferred: تحفة الأطفال becomes مستقل and independently assessed at G4 (redline 3), and أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين are unteachable to a child who cannot see a نون ساكنة in the text. The submission's implicit G5 completion date silently breaks an accepted redline in another discipline.

IMPOSED A TERMINAL EXIT THRESHOLD AND REMEDIATION ROUTE AT G5. The submission ends the subject with no gate. Ending a foundational subject without a named threshold means non-attainers disappear into G6 التفسير where nobody owns their decoding. Remediation is a دوراني clinic for identified individuals, governed on redline 2's parallel-track model — never a cohort period.

SPECIFIED THE ASSESSMENT INSTRUMENT BY STAGE, which the submission leaves open. G1-G2 must be ORAL ONE-TO-ONE ONLY — assessing decoding by writing is an إملاء instrument measuring the inverse competency and will mislabel children with immature motor control. G4-G5 must use UNSEEN passages — otherwise a child 'reads' a page they have memorised and the instrument measures حفظ, not reading. This confound is endemic in Qur'an schools and the submission does nothing to prevent it.

ESCALATED THE UNRESOLVED RIWĀYAH/RASM QUESTION. The submission is silent on whether the school reads Ḥafṣ or Warsh. That ruling determines the primer, the letter shapes, the madd conventions and the entire G3-G5 waqf-mark curriculum. It cannot be left implicit in a subject whose whole content is the script.

STATED THE الإملاء BOUNDARY, absent from the submission. القراءة والتهجي is decoding (grapheme→phoneme); الإملاء is encoding (phoneme→grapheme). Inverse operations on one system. Redline 7 correctly keeps الإملاء longitudinal in اللغة العربية; I add the coordination requirement that both must run on a SINGLE agreed letter-and-vowel sequence, or the child learns one order for reading and a different one for writing.

NOT OVERRIDDEN — protected: the G1 start (correct), the مدمج form (correct at every grade, and it must never become مستقل), the separate book (correct and pedagogically essential, not administrative), independent assessment throughout (correct), and termination before G6 (correct). The submission's G6 substitution of التفسير العملي + الترجمة into the same slot is a clean and coherent succession and I endorse it explicitly.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FEEDS حفظ القرآن — the primary relationship. Converts the ring-fenced hour from تلقين-dependent to self-sustaining: a decoding-fluent child can prepare new حفظ and run مراجعة without a teacher's voice. This is the subject's entire institutional justification.
FEEDS التجويد, non-negotiably. تحفة الأطفال at G4 (redline 3) is literally unteachable without decoding-complete, and الجزرية at G6-G7 compounds the dependency. The G3 gate exists to serve this.
FEEDS التفسير العملي and الترجمة at G6 (redline 8). Meaning cannot be rendered from text that cannot be read, in any language.
FEEDS النحو and الصرف and الفقه indirectly — الآجرومية, البناء في الصرف and الأخضري all arrive at G6 as texts to be read. A non-decoding G6 cohort stalls four disciplines at once.
FEEDS اللغة العربية by installing the grapheme-phoneme system that الإملاء then reverses.

FED BY اللغة العربية — vocabulary stock, so decoding can be cross-checked against meaning rather than produced blind. The submission's sequence (الحروف G1-G2 → الكلمات G3 → المفردات والجمل G4-G5) aligns correctly and should not be disturbed.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE التجويد. التجويد owns المخارج، الصفات، and the أحكام (durations, غنة, إدغام). This subject owns identification and synthesis. The live border is articulation — a child must produce ع to decode it. Ruling: this subject teaches only DISCRIMINATIVE articulation, enough to distinguish and produce the phoneme; التجويد owns systematic المخارج والصفات from G4. Since practical تجويد is مضمّن in the same hour at G1-G3, one teacher does both in practice — the traceability lives in the assessment, not the timetable, which is exactly what مدمج requires.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE اللغة العربية's reading. اللغة العربية owns reading non-Qur'anic Arabic, and from G6 owns reading UNVOCALISED Arabic. Explicit ruling: unvocalised reading does NOT belong to this subject at any grade. It is not a phonics problem — no amount of better decoding lets a child read غير مشكول. It is a grammar problem: the reader supplies vowels from أوزان الصرف and الإعراب. It therefore cannot start before الصرف and النحو are underway (G6) and it cannot live in the Qur'an programme.

MUST NOT BECOME الإملاء, and الإملاء must not be smuggled in here (redline 7). Decoding and encoding are inverse operations and must be assessed separately — but they must share one letter-and-vowel sequence. This requires an explicit coordination agreement with the اللغة العربية specialist; without it the child meets the letters in one order for reading and another for writing.

SHARES A BOUNDARY WITH النشيد والمحفوظات (G3-G7) without overlapping it. النشيد builds oral fluency and prosody but is memorisation of poetry, not decoding; it must not be treated as reading practice, and reading must not be assessed through it.
CONTENDS WITH حفظ القرآن AND practical التجويد for the same 60 ring-fenced minutes at G1-G3. Not a conflict I can resolve alone — flagged for arbitration with a stated minimum.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Riwāyah and rasm: does SHRS read Ḥafṣ (Madinah muṣḥaf) or Warsh (the West African norm)? This determines the primer, the letter shapes, the madd conventions and the entire G3-G5 waqf-mark curriculum. Nothing in this subject can be finalised without it, and an off-the-shelf قاعدة may be unusable under a Warsh ruling.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Ratify that القراءة والتهجي may occupy minutes inside the constitutionally ring-fenced Qur'an hour on the ground that it is the access condition for the hour rather than 'مادة أخرى'. If ruled otherwise, the subject must take 3 of 7 periods at G1-G2 and the اللغة العربية allocation at those grades must be re-cut.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Arbitrate the 60-minute split at G1-G3 between حفظ القرآن, practical تجويد and القراءة والتهجي. Three specialists independently claiming the same hour is not an allocation. My stated minimum: 20 min G1-G2, 15 G3, 10 G4, 8 G5.

[UNVERIFIED] Which primer, in practice? القاعدة النورانية and القاعدة البغدادية are the two I can name with confidence. Locally produced Nigerian primers in the لوح / alif-ba-ta tradition may fit the intake better, but I cannot confirm any specific title or author and will not guess. Needs local scholarly identification before procurement.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is Yoruba-language mediation permitted in G1-G2 instruction? Almost certainly necessary for phoneme-contrast teaching with six-year-olds, and almost certainly already the practice — but it interacts with the school's stated international ambitions and with the Arabic-immersion posture of Programme 2, so it should be ruled rather than assumed.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Entry variation. A substantial share of G1 entrants will arrive from local Qur'anic schools already partly decoding, and others with none. Does SHRS place strictly by grade? Recommendation: a G1 entry diagnostic with differentiation INSIDE the hour, not acceleration out of grade — but the placement policy is the council's.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does the optional إجازة track (redline 2) have a decoding-level entry point for exceptional early readers, or does it begin only at حفظ level? Relevant because the strongest G3 decoders are identifiable years before the track would otherwise notice them.

[PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE — needs institutional confirmation] The G5 exit threshold I have proposed (first-sight fluent reading of an unseen vocalised page, correct on all taught conventions, with self-correction) needs calibration against a real SHRS cohort before it is written into regulations. A threshold set too high manufactures failure; set too low it certifies nothing and the silent-failure-transfer risk returns.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G1, مضمّن inside القراءة والتهجي. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] I override the submission, which first names this subject at G3. For this discipline "meaningful" does not mean a timetable line — it means the learner is producing Arabic sounds and rhythms he would not otherwise produce, and retaining a planned repertoire he can reproduce on demand. A six-year-old Yoruba-speaking child chanting a deliberately constructed نشيد targeting ع ح خ غ ق ص ض ط ظ ث ذ is doing exactly that from week one. Yoruba is a tone language with no pharyngeals and no emphatics; the child's default prosody and articulation will transfer into Arabic unless displaced early, and chant is the only instrument at G1-G2 that displaces both at once while costing zero periods out of a 7-period week. Starting at G3 forfeits the two years in which this is cheapest and most durable, and hands التجويد at G4-G7 an accent-correction problem instead of a foundation. Note carefully: this first appearance is مضمّن and carries no separate block — "meaningful" and "visible on a timetable" are different claims, and this subject earns the first without ever needing the second.

gradeByGrade.content: Planned chant repertoire built against Yoruba's phoneme gaps: short أناشيد drilling ع ح خ غ ق ص ض ط ظ ث ذ in contrastive pairs; نشيد الحروف الهجائية tied to the letters being decoded that week in القراءة والتهجي; ترديد of the cadence (not the doctrine) of آداب formulae — بسملة، سلام، دعاء الطعام. Group chant, unaccompanied voice, 4-6 minutes at the opening of the القراءة والتهجي block, five days. No text, no book of its own. Also supplies the تلقين/ترديد method used inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour — method only, never time.

Same daily slot, repertoire extends from syllable-level to word- and short-phrase-level chant matching the اللغة العربية vocabulary (الحروف والمفردات). Introduce controlled breath: chanting a full line on one breath, stopping where the teacher stops. Introduce solo turn-taking inside group chant so individual articulation becomes audible to the teacher. Target: each child holds ~8-10 short pieces in memory and can start any of them unprompted.

gradeByGrade.text: [UNVERIFIED] منظومة التوحيد والإيمان — title not confirmed as a specific classical work; NOT adopted (see below)
gradeByGrade.content: First year the subject carries its own named outcomes and its own line on the term report, while still costing no timetable line of its own. Repertoire: 60-80 lines total for the year of short affirmative أبيات — أركان الإيمان and أركان الإسلام in verse, آداب الطالب, أبيات في بر الوالدين — drawn from a school-compiled مجموعة, not a long doctrinal منظومة. Learners now memorise FROM a vowelled written text, not only by ear, because القراءة والتهجي has made decoding reliable; this is the year memorisation stops being echo and becomes reading-supported retention. Assessment: termly استظهار (accuracy from memory) plus إلقاء (audible articulation, correct stopping), reported separately from اللغة العربية's own mark. [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION departure] The submitted منظومة التوحيد والإيمان is not adopted: I cannot confirm it as a named classical work, and a long doctrinal منظومة chanted by eight-year-olds raises the same hazard redline 6 identifies at نواقض الإسلام — formulae containing كفر/شرك vocabulary, memorised without the عقيدة vocabulary to hold them, in a Yoruba Muslim community where family practice varies. Affirmative content only at G3.

gradeByGrade.text: [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification] (submission: القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية; redline 4 binds — not incorporated, not substituted)
gradeByGrade.content: Repertoire ~80-100 lines: أبيات في الأخلاق والآداب والحث على العلم from the school مجموعة. The slot the submission filled with an unidentified لامية is held open and explicitly marked pending identification; no replacement text is proposed and none should be improvised. Second function this year: النشيد supplies the chanted تلقين by which تحفة الأطفال والغلمان is committed to memory — but the متن, its content and its mark belong wholly to التجويد. النشيد owns the method; التجويد owns the text. No double assessment.

gradeByGrade.text: [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification] (submission: الفواكه الساقطة; redline 4 binds — not incorporated, not substituted)
gradeByGrade.content: Repertoire ~100 lines. First written استظهار: the learner transcribes memorised lines from memory with correct إملاء — this is where redline 7's longitudinal إملاء skill is exercised on real text rather than dictation drills. Pieces lengthen from 4-6 line مقطوعات to 12-20 line units, which is the first demand on sustained memory architecture rather than rote span. Chanted تلقين continues to serve تحفة الأطفال's completion in التجويد.

gradeByGrade.text: مقطوعات من ديوان الإمام الشافعي (fixed selection, 20-30 lines for the year)
gradeByGrade.assessment: independently assessed (the literary مقطوعات only; the technical متون are assessed by their owning subjects)
gradeByGrade.content: [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION — deliberate contraction] G6 is the heaviest new-متن year in the whole ladder: الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء في الصرف and الأخضري all arrive at once, each independently assessed, on top of the ring-fenced daily Qur'an hour. Memorisation capacity, not timetable space, is the binding constraint here. The subject therefore contracts to مضمّن and its literary load is cut to 20-30 lines for the whole year. Its dominant function at G6 is service: it supplies the chanted delivery by which الجزرية، الآجرومية and البناء are memorised inside their own lessons. Also the first year the memorised line is parsed — the learner is asked to إعراب one word in a line he already holds, which is the hinge between sound and text. I override the submitted 'ديوان الإمام الشافعي + لامية ابن الوردي': two collections at G6 is unaffordable against Qur'an retention, and a ديوان is not a syllabus — a fixed line-count selection is.

gradeByGrade.text: لامية ابن الوردي (complete, ~77 lines, across the year)
gradeByGrade.content: First complete single قصيدة of the ladder — one poem, beginning to end, rather than selections. لامية ابن الوردي is the correct first whole poem: didactic, morally framed, vocabulary within reach of a learner who has الآجرومية, and short enough to finish in a year that is also absorbing ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال. Learners recite it, parse selected أبيات using ملحة-level إعراب, and paraphrase in Arabic. The subject remains مضمّن because G7's memorisation budget is again fully committed to new متون. Chanted تلقين continues to serve ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال in النحو and الصرف.

gradeByGrade.text: تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري
gradeByGrade.content: One term of three, 1 period/week — the subject's only dedicated time in twelve years, and its nearest approach to a distinct identity. The technical متون of G6-G7 are now consolidated rather than being acquired, freeing memorisation capacity for the first time since G5; and the learner possesses ملحة-level إعراب plus لامية الأفعال morphology, so he can parse a classical qasida rather than echo it. Work: memorise the تائية, إعراب of its تقديم/تأخير and poetic word order, and formal إلقاء technique — نبر, وقف/ابتداء in verse as distinct from prose, تمثيل المعنى without theatricality. This is the term in which recitation becomes performance of understood text.

gradeByGrade.text: مختارات من ديوان المتنبي (fixed selection)
gradeByGrade.content: One term of three, 1 period/week. Final dedicated term. Repertoire moves from didactic verse to verse valued as poetry — the learner meets compression, imagery and rhetorical force before البلاغة names any of it. Deliberate sequencing point: by the end of G9 the learner holds several hundred lines in a handful of recurring metres and can hear when a line is broken, without owning a single عروضي term. That ear is the asset العروض inherits. After this term the subject has no further dedicated time; its remaining life is carried.

gradeByGrade.text: بانت سعاد لكعب بن زهير
gradeByGrade.content: Handover year. Repertoire growth continues but is now selected and assessed by النقد والآداب as its primary corpus — memorisation is the mode in which that subject's texts are held, not a separate activity. النشيد's residual contribution is the memorisation and delivery standard (accuracy threshold, إلقاء quality) applied to whatever النقد والآداب sets. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] This siting assumes النقد والآداب exists at G10; if that subject's specialist places it later, the fallback host is اللغة العربية and the form stays مضمّن.

gradeByGrade.text: مختارات من المعلقات
gradeByGrade.content: The memorised stock becomes functional: quotation deployed inside composed and delivered Arabic, and delivery technique carried into oration. النشيد contributes the recitation half (transmitted text performed); الإنشاء والخطابة owns the composition half (original text produced). Same caveat as G10 on host availability.

gradeByGrade.text: Graduation portfolio drawn from G3-G11, plus one substantial قصيدة chosen by the student from an approved list
gradeByGrade.content: Bounded capstone: one term, 1 period/week, with a defined beginning and end. The graduate curates his accumulated محفوظات to a stated cumulative threshold, adds one new substantial قصيدة of his own choosing, and presents it in a public مجلس إلقاء — recited from memory, parsed on demand, paraphrased, and contextualised. This is not new teaching; it is the conversion of twelve years of carried repertoire into a demonstrable, certifiable capability, and it is the point at which the institution can see and show what this nearly-free subject actually built.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: Never differentiates into مستقل — and this is the correct asymmetry, not an omission. The reason is structural: النشيد والمحفوظات has no unowned content. Every body of knowledge it might claim already belongs to a named neighbour — metre to العروض, figurative analysis to البلاغة, literary judgement and history to النقد والآداب, delivery and composition to الإنشاء والخطابة, the technical متون to التجويد/النحو/الصرف, the Qur'an to the ring-fenced hour. What remains genuinely its own is a METHOD (تلقين، ترديد، استظهار) and a REPERTOIRE. A method is best taught inside the thing it serves; a repertoire is best held inside the subject that reads it. Granting مستقل status would force this subject to annex content from neighbours in order to justify its slot, which redline 9 forbids, and would cost 1-2 of only 19 periods that no other discipline can spare. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Its nearest approach to differentiation is the G8-G9 دوراني rotation — one term per year, its only dedicated time in the ladder. Why G8 and not G7: at G7 the memorisation budget is fully committed to ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال arriving simultaneously, and a dedicated repertoire slot would compete directly with the constitutionally ring-fenced Qur'an hour for the same finite retention capacity — the one thing this subject must never do. By G8 those متون are consolidated rather than being acquired, and, decisively, the learner now has ملحة-level إعراب and لامية-level morphology, so he can parse a classical qasida instead of echoing it. Reciting text you can parse is a categorically different act from reciting text you cannot, and G8 is the first grade where the second is available. Why not G9: delaying the إلقاء consolidation to G9 alone pushes it into the window where العروض and البلاغة are likely differentiating, and the learner would meet metre analytically before owning a settled performed repertoire. The ear must precede the scansion; invert that order and العروض becomes an abstract exercise in counting.
prerequisites: Stable production of the Arabic phonemes absent from Yoruba (ع ح خ غ ق ص ض ط ظ ث ذ) — established G1-G2 through القراءة والتهجي and the Qur'an hour's practical تجويد. Required before any text is memorised, because a mispronounced memorised line fossilises: the error is rehearsed hundreds of times and is far harder to remove than to prevent.

Reliable decoding of fully vowelled Arabic — established G3 (القراءة والتهجي, separate book, independently assessed). This is the gate for the subject acquiring its own named outcomes at G3: below it, memorisation is pure ear and the learner cannot self-correct against a text.
Breath control and a working sense of وقف/ابتداء — established G4-G5 through تحفة الأطفال in التجويد. A بيت is a breath unit; without this the learner breaks lines wherever his air runs out.

Arabic vocabulary sufficient that memorised lines carry meaning — established progressively G3-G5 (اللغة العربية: الكلمات → المفردات والجمل البسيطة). This is the hardest prerequisite to honour and the easiest to fake.
إعراب of a simple sentence — established G6 (الآجرومية). Gate for moving repertoire from didactic/moral verse to literary verse; before it, poetic word order is simply noise.
Morphological recognition of أوزان — established G6-G7 (البناء في الصرف, لامية الأفعال). Needed to handle poetic morphology and to recognise licensed deviation rather than read it as error.
إعراب of displaced word order (تقديم/تأخير) — established G7 (ملحة الإعراب). This is the specific gate for the G8 دوراني rotation and the reason that rotation cannot sit at G7.

Written accuracy sufficient to transcribe from memory — established G5-G6 via الإملاء as a longitudinal skill inside اللغة العربية (redline 7). Required for the written استظهار component from G5 onward.

classicalTexts.title: ديوان الإمام الشافعي
classicalTexts.justification: Exists as a named, widely printed collection. Important honesty caveat the board must record: the ديوان is a later compilation and the attribution of individual pieces to الشافعي himself is contested by its own editors. Teach the selections as verse transmitted under his name, not as his verified composition — and use that fact as the learner's first small lesson in transmission and attribution. Retained from the submission but reduced from an open 'ديوان' to a fixed line count, because naming a ديوان is not specifying a syllabus.

classicalTexts.title: لامية ابن الوردي
classicalTexts.justification: By عمر بن الوردي (d. 749/1349). Confident it exists as named. Roughly 77 lines, didactic and morally framed, vocabulary within reach of a learner holding الآجرومية — the right first COMPLETE poem of the ladder. Moved from the submission's G6 to G7 so it does not land in the heaviest new-متن year.

classicalTexts.title: تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري
classicalTexts.justification: By أبو إسحاق الإلبيري (d. 460/1067), Andalusian. Confident it exists as named; note it circulates under several designations (قصيدة الإلبيري, وصية الإلبيري) so the council should fix one printed edition. Longer and syntactically more demanding than ابن الوردي, which is why it is moved from the submission's G7 to G8, where ملحة-level إعراب supports it.

classicalTexts.title: ديوان المتنبي (fixed selection)
classicalTexts.justification: Exists as named; confident. Selected because it moves the learner from verse valued for its lesson to verse valued as poetry, giving البلاغة and النقد والآداب a corpus already in memory. The specific poems must be fixed by the council, not left as 'selections'.

classicalTexts.title: بانت سعاد (قصيدة كعب بن زهير)
classicalTexts.justification: Exists as named; confident. Roughly 58 lines. Sits at the junction of جاهلي diction and the Prophetic era, so it does double duty with السيرة without duplicating it. Lexically demanding — hence G10, not earlier.

classicalTexts.title: المعلقات (fixed selection)
classicalTexts.justification: The collection exists as named; confident. Selections only, chosen by النقد والآداب. The council should note that some معلقة content requires editorial selection for a school context.

classicalTexts.title: منظومة التوحيد والإيمان
classicalTexts.justification: I cannot confirm this as a specific named classical work; it may be a local composition, which would be perfectly legitimate but must be identified as such rather than carried as though it were a recognised متن. Flagged additionally on pedagogical grounds: a long doctrinal منظومة chanted at age eight raises the hazard redline 6 identifies at نواقض الإسلام. The G3 repertoire is made affirmative instead.

classicalTexts.title: القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية
classicalTexts.justification: Redline 4 binds: exact work and author unconfirmed. The G4 slot is held open and marked [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification]. No substitute is proposed and none should be improvised; a wrong attribution here would be a scholarly failure, not a scheduling detail.

classicalTexts.title: الفواكه الساقطة
classicalTexts.justification: Redline 4 binds: title unidentified. G5 slot held open and marked [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification]. Same treatment as the G4 slot.

classicalTexts.title: لامية العرب (المنسوبة إلى الشنفرى)
classicalTexts.justification: The poem exists as named and is confidently attested; its attribution to الشنفرى was already disputed within the classical tradition. Offer it only with that dispute taught openly. Lexically very demanding — G12 portfolio choice rather than a set text.

classicalTexts.title: بردة البوصيري (الكواكب الدرية في مدح خير البرية)
classicalTexts.justification: Exists as named; confident. Raised here only because any محفوظات repertoire committee will encounter it, and it should be ruled on deliberately rather than drifting in. Several of its lines are widely read as غلو and would sit badly against the عقيدة line this institution takes (نواقض الإسلام at G5). My recommendation is not to adopt it, but that is a ruling for the council, not for me.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Four specific hazards, none generic. (1) COMPETING WITH THE RING-FENCED HOUR. This is the only risk that touches a constitutional provision. Memorisation capacity is finite in a way period-space is not: a child carrying الجزرية + الآجرومية + البناء + الأخضري in one year, plus two literary dīwāns as the submission proposes at G6, will shed retention somewhere, and the thing that sheds first is the material with the least immediate assessment pressure — which is the Qur'an, precisely because its hour is protected and unhurried. An overloaded محفوظات programme degrades حفظ القرآن without ever appearing to take a single minute from it. This is why G6-G7 contract rather than expand. (2) MEANINGLESS MEMORISATION CONTAMINATING METHOD. If literary qasida repertoire arrives before decoding and vocabulary are secure (before roughly G5-G6), the child memorises phonetic strings and learns, durably, that Arabic memorisation is sound without sense. He then applies that same method to the Qur'an — the exact inversion of what this institution exists to produce, and very hard to unlearn once it has succeeded at getting him marks. (3) DOCTRINAL CHANT AHEAD OF DOCTRINAL VOCABULARY. Chant is the most memorable and least examined medium in the school; whatever is set to rhythm is retained verbatim and repeated outside class. A منظومة containing كفر/شرك vocabulary, chanted by an eight-year-old in a Yoruba Muslim community where household practice varies considerably, is a live pastoral hazard — the child will apply it, socially, to relatives, with a confidence the verse lent him and his understanding does not support. Redline 6's protective framing requirement applies with more force here than in عقيدة lessons, not less, because chant travels home and عقيدة prose does not. (4) PERFORMANCE PRESSURE BEFORE ARTICULATORY STABILITY. Competition and assembly إلقاء before roughly G5 fossilises wrong مخارج under the excitement of an audience — the child performs his errors fluently and is rewarded for it. Solo public إلقاء should stay inside the classroom until G5 and off the stage until the G8 rotation.
lifecycles.delayRisks: Also four, equally specific. (1) THE PROSODIC WINDOW CLOSES. This is the strongest single argument in this submission and the reason I override the G3 start. Yoruba is a tone language; its intonational contours transfer wholesale into a learner's Arabic and, if not displaced early, become permanent. A child who has not chanted Arabic before roughly G4 carries Yoruba prosody into his recitation for life, and التجويد at G4-G7 then spends its time fighting an accent rather than building on a foundation. The cost of the delay is paid by another subject, which is why it is easy to miss in a timetable review. (2) العروض, البلاغة AND النقد والآداب INHERIT NOTHING. These three subjects all presuppose a corpus the student already holds. Deny them that and they are taught from isolated specimen lines on a board — which is the classic and well-documented failure mode of Arabic literary instruction to non-native speakers, producing students who can define استعارة and scan بحر الكامل but have never been moved by a line of Arabic. The G8-G9 rotation exists precisely to guarantee the inheritance. (3) THE GRADUATE CANNOT STAND AND DELIVER. Delay إلقاء past G9 and the school produces a graduate who reads Arabic competently and cannot perform it. For an institution with international ambitions this is the specific, visible capability that signals quality to every external audience — competitions, visiting scholars, parents, partner institutions — and it is the one that cannot be retrofitted in the final year. (4) METHOD TRANSFER RUNS BOTH WAYS. The تلقين/ترديد/استظهار craft that this subject teaches is the same craft the Qur'an hour consumes daily. Deferring it does not protect حفظ القرآن; it leaves حفظ القرآن to improvise its own method, badly, child by child.
lifecycles.g12Role: A bounded وحدة of one term, not a taught subject: the graduate curates his accumulated repertoire, adds one substantial قصيدة of his own choosing, and presents it in a public مجلس إلقاء. What the graduate can actually DO because of it, stated as capability rather than coverage: (a) recite from memory, with controlled delivery and correct articulation, a cumulative portfolio — [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION, threshold proposed for ratification] not less than roughly 500 lines of classical Arabic verse accumulated across G3-G12, counted EXCLUDING the technical متون owned by التجويد/النحو/الصرف and excluding the Qur'an entirely; (b) parse on demand any line he recites, and paraphrase it in Arabic; (c) render selected lines into English and Yoruba, feeding الترجمة's own assessment rather than duplicating it; (d) hear that a line is metrically broken before he scans it, and then scan it, because العروض has since named what his ear already knew; (e) quote appropriately and from memory inside his own composed Arabic and his خطابة; (f) teach a منظومة to younger learners by chant — which matters institutionally, because this school's own teaching pipeline runs through its graduates, and the تلقين craft is transmitted by demonstration or not at all; (g) represent the school in مسابقات and public occasions. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] The Ijazah precedent (redline 2) transfers cleanly here: an opt-in, pace-based محفوظات certificate for students who exceed the portfolio threshold costs the timetable nothing, reuses governance the institution already has, and gives the exceptional student somewhere to go that does not require inflating the subject for everyone else.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Total lifetime cost stays below one period-equivalent per week at every point in the ladder — and that cheapness is the argument for the design, not an apology for it. G1-G2 (7-period ceiling): ZERO new periods. ~5 minutes daily (~25 min/week) at the opening of the existing القراءة والتهجي block. Asking for one standalone period here would consume 14% of the entire non-Qur'an timetable for an activity that works better distributed in five-minute bursts than concentrated in one forty-minute block. G3-G5 (19-period ceiling): ZERO new periods. ~20 min/week drawn from within the اللغة العربية allocation, plus opening ترديد at assembly, which costs no timetable at all. The board should record that اللغة العربية's existing periods are carrying this, so the integration is visible as a cost rather than assumed as free. G6-G7: ZERO new periods. The chanted تلقين sits inside التجويد/النحو/الصرف lessons that already exist; the single annual qasida sits inside اللغة العربية. Deliberately the lowest-cost years in the ladder, because memorisation capacity — not period-space — is what is scarce at G6-G7. G8-G9: 1 period/week for ONE term of three ≈ 0.33 period-equivalent across the year, and only in its term. This is the single request for dedicated time in twelve years and the only line that touches the 19-period ceiling; it takes the slot from whichever subject the board judges can carry a one-term reduction, and I would rather lose the rotation entirely than fund it from the Qur'an hour. G10-G11: ZERO new periods (مضمّن in النقد والآداب / الإنشاء والخطابة). G12: 1 period/week for one term ≈ 0.33 annual equivalent. One practical note from the school's own rooms: classes of roughly forty make individual إلقاء assessment expensive in wall-clock time. Assess by rotating sample within group chant at G1-G5, and reserve full individual assessment for the G8-G9 rotation and the G12 وحدة, where it is affordable and where it counts.
departuresFromSubmission: FIRST APPEARANCE: submission starts at G3; I start meaningful teaching at G1 as مضمّن. The G1-G2 prosodic and articulatory window is the cheapest and most durable point of intervention for Yoruba-speaking learners, and skipping it hands التجويد an accent-correction problem at G4-G7.

STATUS: the submission lists النشيد والمحفوظات as a named line at G3-G7 alongside subjects that hold real timetable slots. I refuse مستقل status at every one of the twelve grades. Against a 19-period ceiling, and with every candidate body of content already owned by a named neighbour, a standalone slot would have to be funded by annexation — which redline 9 forbids.

G6 LOAD: submission sets ديوان الإمام الشافعي + لامية ابن الوردي at G6, the same year that الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء في الصرف, الأخضري, التفسير العملي and الترجمة all arrive independently assessed. This is the clearest overload in the submission and it is paid for out of Qur'an retention. Cut to a fixed 20-30 line selection.
G7 LOAD: تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري moved from G7 to G8, where ملحة-level إعراب supports parsing it and where the متن-acquisition load has eased.

SPECIFICATION: 'ديوان الشافعي' and 'ديوان الشافعي + تائية' are not syllabus specifications — a ديوان is a collection, not a course. Replaced throughout with named texts or fixed line-count selections the council can actually ratify and a teacher can actually deliver.

G3 TEXT: منظومة التوحيد والإيمان not adopted — I cannot confirm it as a named classical work, and a long doctrinal منظومة set to chant at age eight carries the redline-6 hazard in its most transmissible form, since chant travels out of the classroom and prose does not. G3 repertoire made affirmative.

BOUNDARY: the submission leaves ambiguous whether النشيد والمحفوظات memorises the technical متون or merely accompanies them. I draw the line explicitly — this subject owns the METHOD, the home discipline owns the TEXT and the MARK. تحفة, الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء, ملحة and لامية الأفعال are never assessed here. No double assessment anywhere in the ladder.

G8-G12: the submission stops at G7. I supply the remaining five grades and, more importantly, I terminate this subject's independent existence at G9 rather than letting it run to G12 by default. Running it to G12 would be the symmetrical answer and the wrong one.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: حفظ القرآن — FEEDS it (supplies the تلقين/ترديد/استظهار method and the breath and rhythm control) but must NEVER draw on its ring-fenced hour, and must never compete with it for memorisation capacity, which is the subtler and more dangerous of the two. Hard boundary: Qur'anic text is never used as محفوظات repertoire material. Reciting the Qur'an as نشيد misframes what it is and what the protected hour is for.
القراءة والتهجي — FED BY it (decoding) and is its G1-G3 host. The two are natural partners: one gives the child the letter, the other gives him a reason to say it aloud fifty times.

التجويد — mutual. التجويد establishes articulation and breath (prerequisites 1 and 3); النشيد returns the chanted delivery through which تحفة الأطفال and الجزرية are memorised. The متون and their marks stay with التجويد.

اللغة العربية — FEEDS it heavily and is its G3-G7 host. Memorised classical text is the principal route into fuṣḥā register and idiom for second-language learners, and in a Yoruba-speaking context that route is not one option among several; it is the one that works.

النحو and الصرف — FEED it (parsing capability, prerequisites 5-7) and are FED BY it (chanted memorisation of الآجرومية, البناء, ملحة, لامية الأفعال, and later ألفية ابن مالك if adopted). Content and assessment remain wholly theirs.

العروض — the single most important downstream relationship. النشيد supplies the pre-analytic ear; by the time العروض differentiates the learner should already hold hundreds of lines in a few recurring metres, so العروض names what he already hears rather than teaching him to count. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: النشيد never teaches البحور or التفعيلات analytically. Ear only, until العروض owns it.
البلاغة — FEEDS it with a corpus in memory. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: no استعارة/تشبيه/كناية terminology taught here, ever.

النقد والآداب — FEEDS it with the primary corpus, then becomes its host at G10. Literary judgement cannot be taught to a student with no memorised text. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: no literary history, schools or periodisation taught here.

الإنشاء والخطابة — FEEDS it with delivery technique and a stock of quotable verse, then becomes its host at G11. Boundary: محفوظات is transmitted text performed; خطابة is original text composed and delivered. Different competencies, separately assessed.
الإملاء — reciprocal. Written استظهار from G5 gives redline 7's longitudinal إملاء skill real text to be exercised on, instead of isolated dictation.
الترجمة — from G6 (redline 8), memorised lines are useful rendering material into English and Yoruba. That output is الترجمة's assessment, not this subject's.

التوحيد، العقيدة، الفقه — may host doctrinal and fiqh منظومات and borrow the chant method, but doctrinal framing, content and assessment stay entirely with them. This subject sets nothing to rhythm that its owning discipline has not first cleared.
السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي — light overlap at G10 via بانت سعاد, which sits at the junction of جاهلي diction and the Prophetic era. Complementary, not duplicative.

التربية الإسلامية — MUST NOT DUPLICATE, and must not become its overflow. النشيد is not the place to park assembly content, moral songs or character-formation material that belongs to التربية الإسلامية with its own progression. This subject is a discipline, not a container.

الدراسات الحديثة، المنطق وعلم الكلام، أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، الحديث، مصطلح الحديث، التفسير — no substantive relationship. Stated explicitly so that no later reviewer manufactures one for the sake of symmetry.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Programme governance. This subject is registered under القرآن وعلومه, which is correct for G1-G6 where its function is Qur'an-serving (method, ear, breath, memorisation craft). From G7-G8 its function becomes literary and its natural governance is اللغة وعلومها. Recommend the migration at G8 be recorded explicitly rather than left ambiguous, so that ownership of the repertoire and of the assessment standard has one address at every grade.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Mode of إنشاد. I have designed throughout for unaccompanied vocal chant, group and solo, with no instrumental accompaniment. That is the safe default for an institution of this orientation, but it is a ruling the council should record in its own words rather than one I should assume on its behalf.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] The G3-G5 doctrinal repertoire. If the institution wants a verified doctrinal منظومة in the early repertoire, it must name one it can authenticate. I have deliberately not proposed a substitute for منظومة التوحيد والإيمان, and no one should improvise one.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] West African repertoire. There is a genuine Nigerian and Ilorin tradition of Arabic poetry that would be a substantial asset here — locally rooted and simultaneously a credential for the school's international ambitions. I cannot name specific works with the confidence this board requires. Recommend commissioning a verified local compilation from scholars who can attest the texts directly.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] بردة البوصيري: adopt, adopt with excisions, or exclude. My recommendation is to exclude, but the ruling belongs to the council and should be made deliberately rather than by drift.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — DEPENDENCY] My G10-G11 مضمّن placements assume النقد والآداب exists at G10 and الإنشاء والخطابة at G11. Those lifecycles are being determined by other specialists. If either lands elsewhere, the fallback host is اللغة العربية and the form stays مضمّن; the repertoire standard must not be orphaned.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Ratification of the cumulative threshold (~500 lines across G3-G12, excluding متون and excluding the Qur'an). The number is a considered proposal, not a recovered figure, and it should be tested against one real cohort before it is written into the graduation profile.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether to open an opt-in محفوظات mastery certificate on the Ijazah model (redline 2). It costs the timetable nothing and reuses governance the institution already operates.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Funding the G8-G9 rotation. It is the one request in this submission that touches the 19-period ceiling, and the period must come from somewhere. I would rather the board drop the rotation than fund it from the Qur'an hour.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Coordination of the G12 وحدة with any capstone the الإنشاء والخطابة specialist proposes. The competencies are distinct — memorised transmitted text performed versus original composed oration — but one public occasion could reasonably carry both assessments, and two separate occasions in a final term may be more than the calendar can hold.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G3 in the embedded sense; G6 as a discipline with its own traceable progression. "Meaningful" for التفسير must be defined against a specific regional pathology, not generically. A child who hears "this sura is about seeking refuge with Allah" has learned something about the Qur'an but nothing about التفسير — التفسير is the operation of getting from the Arabic to the meaning. So: (a) the first point where a pupil is doing something with the Arabic rather than receiving a rendering is G3, when اللغة العربية reaches الكلمات and the pupil can be handed a Qur'anic word (رب، الناس، النار، قل) and asked what it means — that produces learning attributable to التفسير and it costs zero periods because it lives inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]; (b) the first point where التفسير produces learning with its own progression, its own book and its own assessment is G6, when الآجرومية and البناء في الصرف land in the same year and the pupil can for the first time say WHY a verse means what it means. The submission's G6 start is correct as a differentiation point and wrong as a start point — it leaves G1-G5 silent, and five years of silence is where the damage is done [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE].

gradeByGrade.content: Meaning of each sura as it is memorized, given orally in Yoruba (and simple English) by the حفظ teacher at the point of memorization: one or two sentences — who is being addressed, what is being commanded, described or promised. Covers الفاتحة والناس والفلق والإخلاص والمسد والنصر والكوثر and whatever else the حفظ pace reaches. No Arabic-to-Arabic glossing, no terminology, no book, no timetable slot, zero periods. Its purpose at this grade is not knowledge of tafsir but the prevention of a habit: the pupil must never once complete a sura without being told it means something. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION — the submission leaves G1 empty for this subject]

Same mechanism extended to the G2 memorization set. Added: oral recognition of 8-12 high-frequency Qur'anic words when the teacher says them (الله، رب، الناس، النار، الجنة، قل، يوم، خير). The pupil can answer, in Yoruba, 'what does this sura talk about?' for every sura held. Still oral, still zero periods — which matters absolutely at G2, where only ~7 timetabled periods exist in the whole week [RECOVERED] and any timetabled tafsir would have to be taken from القراءة والتهجي, the gate to everything else.

gradeByGrade.partner: حفظ القرآن (supported by اللغة العربية: الكلمات)
gradeByGrade.content: The shift from receiving a rendering to handling the Arabic. The pupil is shown or told a Qur'anic word and gives its meaning; cumulative target ~60-80 high-frequency Qur'anic words, drawn from and feeding the G3 اللغة العربية الكلمات work rather than duplicating it. States the subject of each memorized sura in Yoruba and in short Arabic phrases. ASSESSMENT MECHANISM: from G3 the حفظ oral examination carries a معنى السورة component alongside the recitation component — this is embedded assessment with teeth, and it is what stops the meaning layer from decaying into an aspiration nobody checks [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION].

Cumulative ~150 Qur'anic words. Sentence-level meaning: the pupil gives the meaning of a memorized sura verse by verse, not as a block summary. First contact with context, borrowed from الحديث والسيرة (مدمج at G4): which event or person a sura refers to where the sura itself makes it plain (الفيل، المسد، الضحى). No أسباب النزول as a category and no chain-of-transmission language — that is not what this is.

Consolidation year and readiness gate for G6. Meaning-coverage of جزء عم completed (the corpus itself is complete well before this on any normal pace for a 195-hour annual hour [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE — actual pace is the حفظ specialist's call]). Cumulative ~250 Qur'anic words. The pupil recognizes recurring Qur'anic openings and structures by ear and by sight — يا أيها الذين آمنوا، قل، إن، من، أرأيت — WITHOUT grammatical terminology, which deliberately arrives one year later. The G5 النحو والصرف مضمّن work and this work are held apart on purpose: G5 teaches the structures, G6 names them and turns the naming on the Qur'an.

gradeByGrade.text: تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي (teacher source; pupil book locally authored as 'التفسير العملي')
gradeByGrade.content: DIFFERENTIATION. التفسير العملي للقرآن الكريم: الفاتحة plus the قصار المفصل the pupil already carries, now handled as Arabic text rather than as remembered sound — word meaning, then sentence meaning, then the إعراب that fixes the sentence meaning, using precisely the categories acquired that same year from الآجرومية (مبتدأ وخبر، فاعل ومفعول به، الجار والمجرور، علامات الإعراب) and the أوزان from البناء في الصرف; then rendered into English and Yoruba. Separate book, independently assessed — the submission is right on both and they are protected [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, endorsed]. Mastery threshold: given a memorized short sura, the pupil parses each verse, states the meaning in Arabic, and renders it into both languages without a memorized translation script.

gradeByGrade.partner: الترجمة (English and Yoruba rendering) — FINAL year of this pairing
gradeByGrade.text: تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي (teacher source, continuing)
gradeByGrade.content: جزء تبارك plus سورة الحجرات (short, Madinan, high ethical yield, legally light). إعراب support now from ملحة الإعراب, اشتقاق from لامية الأفعال. First operational — not systematic — use of المكي والمدني and سبب النزول, taken from السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي (مدمج at G7): the pupil uses the fact that a sura is Makkan or Madinan to read it, without being taught علوم القرآن as a science. Rendering into English and Yoruba now at connected-paragraph rather than verse level. OVERRIDE: the submission writes 'التفسير مدمج' at G7 with no partner named, which is not a usable instructional form. The partner is الترجمة, and this is the last grade it holds.

gradeByGrade.text: تفسير الجلالين (pupil-read, subject to the عقيدة ruling — see open questions); an abridgment of تفسير ابن كثير as the alternative
gradeByGrade.content: SEPARATION FROM الترجمة, and the point التفسير becomes Programme 1's principal timetabled subject — budget-neutral, because القراءة والتهجي completes at G5 and the التجويد matn ladder (تحفة الأطفال → الجزرية) completes at G7, so التفسير inherits periods Programme 1 already held rather than taking any from Programmes 2 or 3 [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]. Content: verse-by-verse study of one medium sura (recommend سورة لقمان, then سورة الكهف); first reading of a classical tafsir in Arabic with the teacher, which is a distinct competence from being taught tafsir orally; التفسير بالمأثور introduced as a working rule of order — القرآن يُفسَّر بالقرآن، ثم بالسنة، ثم بأقوال الصحابة; غريب القرآن vocabulary work using the صرف acquired at G6-G7.

gradeByGrade.text: تفسير الجلالين (continuing), تفسير ابن كثير consulted
gradeByGrade.content: Sustained continuous tafsir of سورة يوسف — one unbroken narrative, Makkan, long enough to teach stamina, rich without being legally dense. المناسبة between verses (why this verse follows that one). أسباب النزول now handled as a category, sequenced with السيرة. Critically: the first explicit treatment of الإسرائيليات — the pupil is taught to notice when a tafsir narrates an unsourced story, to mark it, and to withhold judgement. This must happen while reading a real tafsir with a teacher present, not as an abstract warning, and it must happen before the pupil reads tafsir unsupervised.

gradeByGrade.text: تفسير الجلالين / تفسير ابن كثير; plus مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية if أصول التفسير is مدمج into this slot
gradeByGrade.content: التفسير التحليلي begins: سورة البقرة, first half, verse by verse, with full إعراب, with البلاغة once that discipline is in place, and with the method vocabulary named. This is the grade where تفسير stops being an explanation the pupil receives and becomes an operation the pupil performs on an unseen passage. INTERFACE: أصول التفسير must be in place by this grade. My recommendation is that it be مدمج into التفسير's own block with مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية as its matn, rather than taking separate periods — أصول التفسير taught away from applied tafsir is inert, and the 19-period ceiling at G10 is already carrying البلاغة، أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث and the نحو/صرف ladder [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — belongs jointly to me and the أصول التفسير specialist].

gradeByGrade.text: تفسير ابن كثير (primary for آيات الأحكام); تفسير الجلالين retained for pace
gradeByGrade.content: Two strands. (1) آيات الأحكام, selected and sequenced with أصول الفقه: آيات الطهارة والصلاة والصيام والزكاة، آية الدين، آيات المواريث — treated as the Qur'anic دليل and the mechanics of استنباط, with the فروع rulings left entirely to الفقه. (2) التفسير البياني of selected passages, drawing on البلاغة: تشبيه، استعارة، كناية، التقديم والتأخير، الالتفات، فاصلة الآية. Added: اختلاف المفسرين — how to read a difference of opinion between two مفسرين, what kinds of difference are تنوع and what kinds are تضاد. Mastery threshold: given two tafsirs on one verse, the pupil states what each says, why they differ, and what evidence each rests on.

gradeByGrade.text: تفسير ابن كثير and تفسير الجلالين read comparatively; تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي as the accessible third reading
gradeByGrade.content: التفسير الموضوعي — the pupil assembles and treats a theme across the Qur'an rather than reading one sura through: التوحيد في القرآن، الأخلاق في القرآن، القصص القرآني ودلالته، آيات الكون. Comparative reading of two مفسرين on one passage, written up. CAPSTONE: the pupil prepares and delivers a تفسير of an assigned sura or passage to an audience — in Arabic, then rendered into English and Yoruba — assessed on accuracy of meaning, evidence cited, correct handling of difference of opinion, and absence of unsupported narration presented as fact. This is the grade where التفسير functions as the integrating subject of the whole twelve years: نحو، صرف، بلاغة، حديث، فقه، أصول، عقيدة، سيرة all converge on one verse and are visibly used or visibly absent.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G6 — the submission is CORRECT and is protected here, but for a reason it does not state. التفسير differentiates at G6 because three enabling competencies land in that single year and not before: (1) الآجرومية [RETAINED, redline 3] supplies the إعراب apparatus — مبتدأ وخبر، فاعل ومفعول به، الجار والمجرور، علامات الإعراب — which is the minimum vocabulary for saying WHY a verse means what it means rather than merely WHAT it means; (2) البناء في الصرف [RETAINED, redline 3] supplies الميزان الصرفي and الاشتقاق, so the pupil can connect Qur'anic word families (غفر / غفور / غفار / مغفرة) instead of learning each as an isolated gloss; (3) five years of مضمّن meaning-attachment mean the first tafsir course explains a corpus the pupil already carries in memory and already half-understands, so the cognitive load is the analysis, not the content.

NOT G5: at G5 النحو is only مضمّن and no إعراب terminology exists. A timetabled tafsir at G5 could only deliver translation-by-dictation — the pupil would memorize a Yoruba rendering as a second text alongside the Arabic. That is not a slow version of التفسير; it is the opposite of it, and it would inoculate against the G6 course by making it feel like revision of something already "known."

NOT G7: delaying to G7 would leave G6's grammar and morphology learned for a full year without the Qur'an as their object, which is their strongest motivating application and the one the pupils actually care about. It would also push الترجمة's start past G6, contradicting redline 8 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION], which fixes الترجمة's beginning at G6 riding on التفسير العملي.
prerequisites: Fluent decoding of unvocalized-to-vocalized Arabic script, including unfamiliar Qur'anic words — القراءة والتهجي, functional by G4, secure by G5 (the subject completes there)
A memorized corpus large enough to explain — حفظ القرآن, ring-fenced 195-hour annual hour, continuous G1-G12; جزء عم complete by G4 at the latest on any normal pace [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]
Arabic vocabulary at sentence level — اللغة العربية: المفردات والجمل البسيطة, G5; plus ~250 high-frequency Qur'anic words cumulated مضمّن inside the Qur'an hour by G5
إعراب apparatus: مبتدأ وخبر، فاعل ومفعول به، الجار والمجرور، علامات الإعراب — النحو مضمّن at G5, then الآجرومية at G6. THIS IS THE GATE for differentiation at G6
Morphological derivation: الميزان الصرفي، المجرد والمزيد، اسم الفاعل واسم المفعول — البناء في الصرف at G6, لامية الأفعال at G7. Gate for غريب القرآن work from G8
Extended syntax for multi-clause verses (الجمل وأشباه الجمل، التوابع، الأساليب) — ملحة الإعراب at G7. Gate for مستقل status at G8
Narrative and chronological frame for المكي والمدني and أسباب النزول — السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي, مدمج from G4, مدمج at G7
Basic عقيدة/توحيد categories, so آيات الصفات and آيات الشرك are met with framing rather than cold — التوحيد والعقيدة مدمج G3-G7 [redline 5 keeps these integrated, which suits this subject]
Basic فقه categories, so آيات الأحكام are recognizable as legal text — الفقه التطبيقي G1-G5, then الأخضري at G6

البلاغة: تشبيه، استعارة، كناية، الخبر والإنشاء، التقديم والتأخير — must be established by G10 for التفسير البياني at G11. [INTERFACE — depends on البلاغة's own lifecycle, which is open; if البلاغة does not land by G10, the G11 بياني strand must be cut, not faked]
أصول الفقه: الأمر والنهي، العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين — must be established by G10-G11 for آيات الأحكام at G11. [INTERFACE — lifecycle open]
أصول التفسير method — must be in place by G10. My recommendation is that it be مدمج into التفسير's own block rather than separately timetabled [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
Yoruba and English literacy sufficient to render meaning accurately — supplied by the separate morning national curriculum (outside this scope) plus الترجمة at G6-G7

classicalTexts.title: تيسير الكريم الرحمن في تفسير كلام المنان (تفسير السعدي) — عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
classicalTexts.grade: G6-G9 (teacher source); retained as an accessible third reading at G12
classicalTexts.justification: Clear, short, modern-classical Arabic; meaning-focused; states the مقصد of a passage plainly; largely free of the إسرائيليات that make other tafsirs hazardous for young readers. It is the best available first continuous tafsir for a pupil whose نحو is only one year old. At G6-G7 it is the TEACHER's source and the pupil book is locally authored ('التفسير العملي'); the pupil does not read it directly until G8-G9.

classicalTexts.title: تفسير الجلالين — جلال الدين المحلي وجلال الدين السيوطي
classicalTexts.justification: The standard concise tafsir of the West African and Yoruba scholarly tradition, which matters institutionally: a graduate who has read الجلالين is legible to the local scholarly community in a way one who has not is not. One line per verse, tightly bound to إعراب, so it rewards exactly the grammar this curriculum builds. TWO HONEST CAVEATS: it presupposes نحو and is unusable before G8; and the two Jalāls were Ashʿarī, so some آيات الصفات carry تأويل, and there are brief unsourced narrations. Whether that is acceptable is a عقيدة-policy question for the Director General and the العقيدة specialist, not a تفسير-technique question — I flag it rather than deciding it.

classicalTexts.title: تفسير القرآن العظيم (تفسير ابن كثير) — إسماعيل بن عمر بن كثير
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (consulted), G11-G12 (primary for آيات الأحكام and comparative reading)
classicalTexts.justification: The standard تفسير بالمأثور: it shows the pupil the method being taught at G8 actually operating — Qur'an explained by Qur'an, then by sunnah, then by the Companions. It is also where the pupil meets narrations that the author himself weighs and rejects, which is the best possible training ground for the G9 إسرائيليات work. The complete work is far too long for school use; an abridgment is required.

classicalTexts.title: An abridgment of تفسير ابن كثير (e.g. عمدة التفسير by أحمد شاكر, or محمد علي الصابوني's مختصر)
classicalTexts.justification: Some abridgment is operationally necessary. I am NOT confident enough about the exact titles, editorial scope, or availability in Nigeria of any particular abridgment to specify one here, and naming the wrong edition would be a real error. The selection is a procurement decision requiring someone with the volumes in hand.

classicalTexts.title: أيسر التفاسير لكلام العلي الكبير — أبو بكر جابر الجزائري
classicalTexts.justification: A simple modern tafsir suitable as an alternative or supplement to السعدي in the middle years if procurement favours it. Listed as an option, not as a dependency of the design.

classicalTexts.title: مقدمة في أصول التفسير — ابن تيمية
classicalTexts.grade: G10, if أصول التفسير is مدمج into التفسير's block
classicalTexts.justification: Short, foundational, and precisely about the method question the G10 analytic course needs answered. NOTE OF SCOPE: this is a text of أصول التفسير, not of التفسير. I name it only because I am proposing that أصول التفسير attach to my block rather than take its own periods; if the council timetables أصول التفسير separately, this text belongs to that specialist's brief, not mine.

classicalTexts.title: أنوار التنزيل وأسرار التأويل (تفسير البيضاوي) — البيضاوي
classicalTexts.justification: Listed only to close it off explicitly. The work exists and is a landmark, but it is dense, heavily grammatical-theological, and saturated with kalām. It has no place anywhere in G1-G12 and should not be reached for merely because a G12 course wants to look advanced. It belongs to post-secondary study.

classicalTexts.title: القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية / الفواكه الساقطة
classicalTexts.justification: Not applicable to this subject. Both [UNVERIFIED] items in redline 4 sit in النشيد والمحفوظات (G4 and G5), not in التفسير. No part of this design depends on either, and I have not substituted anything for them.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Five specific risks, all of which attach to introducing التفسير as a TIMETABLED subject early — none of which attach to the مضمّن meaning-layer I am proposing at G1-G5, because that layer costs no periods and uses no analytic apparatus.

(1) PERIOD ARITHMETIC, G1-G2. Only ~7 periods exist in the whole week at G1-G2 [RECOVERED]. A timetabled tafsir there could only be funded by cutting القراءة والتهجي, which is the gate to literally every subject in Programmes 1, 2 and 3. That trade is catastrophic and non-recoverable.

(2) THE TRANSLATION-MEMORIZATION TRAP — the specific and severe one. Tafsir taught before إعراب cannot be analysis; it can only be a rendering the pupil memorizes. The result is an adult who can recite the Yoruba tafsir of a sura fluently and cannot say what أَرَأَيْتَ means or which word in the verse is the فاعل. This is worse than teaching no tafsir at all, because the pupil and the pupil's family both believe the tafsir has been learned, and the G6 analytic course then arrives at a class that thinks it already knows the material. That is why G5 is genuinely too early and why the G5 work deliberately teaches structures without naming them, leaving the naming to G6.

(3) UNFRAMED HAZARDOUS VERSE CLASSES. آيات الصفات before التوحيد والعقيدة has categories; آيات القتال والبراءة before the pupil can distinguish a historical occasion from a standing ruling; آيات المواريث والطلاق before any أصول. This is the same family of risk the Redline Board already identified in نواقض الإسلام at G5 [redline 6] — a child given text without framing will apply it, and will apply it to the people nearest to hand.

(4) الإسرائيليات RECEIVED AS FACT. Classical tafsirs carry narrative material of unknown provenance. A pupil who reads it before G9 has no mechanism to mark it as unsourced, and the stories are memorable in exactly the way the analysis is not. Once lodged at age nine they are extremely hard to dislodge at age sixteen.

(5) ENCROACHMENT ON THE RING-FENCE. A timetabled, assessed, book-bearing tafsir subject competing for the same suras as حفظ creates constant pressure to borrow minutes from the Qur'an hour for tafsir revision. The hour is constitutionally protected — لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى [RECOVERED] — and the protection holds best when nothing outside it has a reason to want its minutes.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Five specific risks, and the first is the reason I am overriding the submission's silent G1-G5.

(1) THE MEANINGLESS-RECITATION HABIT, FORMED AND SET. If meaning is first attached at G6, the pupil has by then spent five years and roughly 975 hours of ring-fenced Qur'an time memorizing sound. What forms in those five years is not a knowledge gap — it is an affective separation between reciting and understanding, in which the Qur'an is experienced as something performed rather than something said. Reversing that at G6 is far harder than never permitting it, and it is the single best-known weakness of the regional Qur'an-school model. A school with international ambitions that reproduces it has reproduced the thing it exists to improve on.

(2) redline 8 BECOMES UNWORKABLE. الترجمة is directed to begin at G6 riding on التفسير العملي [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION]. If the G6 pupil meets the content of those suras for the first time in the same lesson, the course is doing two hard new things at once — comprehension and rendering — and the translation work will collapse into memorized equivalents, defeating its own purpose. The G1-G5 مضمّن layer is what makes the G6 content already familiar and leaves the difficulty where it belongs, on the rendering.

(3) THE GRAMMAR LOSES ITS OBJECT. الآجرومية at G6 and البناء في الصرف at G6 are taught to pupils who want to understand the Qur'an. If التفسير is absent or late, نحو and صرف are learned as abstract systems, retention falls, and the pupils' own reason for tolerating them is removed. This is a motivation loss with measurable academic consequences in the hardest subjects in Programme 2.

(4) THE ANALYTIC LADDER COMPRESSES. If مستقل status arrives later than G8, then أصول التفسير at G10 has no applied base to be the أصول OF, آيات الأحكام at G11 collides with أصول الفقه in its own first year, and the G12 capstone rests on two or three years rather than seven. The G8 move is also the only budget-neutral moment available, since Programme 1 frees periods there and nowhere else.

(5) THE GRADUATE FAILS THE LOCAL TEST OF A SCHOLAR. In this region the visible mark of an عالم is the ability to stand and give tafsir, in Yoruba, to a lay congregation. A school that produces حفاظ who cannot do that will be received by its own community as a Qur'an school, not a School of Islamic and Arabic Studies — regardless of what its certificates say. التفسير is the subject on which that judgement is made.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 التفسير is the integrating subject of the entire twelve-year curriculum — the single place where نحو، صرف، بلاغة، حديث، فقه، أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، عقيدة and سيرة are all brought to bear on one verse, and where their absence is immediately visible. It is مستقل, 3 periods, independently assessed, and it carries the graduation capstone.

What the graduate can actually do because of it:
- Take an unseen passage of the Qur'an, parse it (إعراب), identify the غريب, and state its meaning in Arabic from the text rather than from memory.
- Read تفسير الجلالين and an abridged تفسير ابن كثير unaided, in Arabic, and follow the argument rather than the conclusion.
- State whether a passage is مكي or مدني and what follows from that; give a سبب نزول where one is established and say so when none is.
- Distinguish تفسير بالمأثور from تفسير بالرأي; recognize an unsourced narration in a tafsir and decline to repeat it as fact — the direct yield of the G9 الإسرائيليات work.
- Read a disagreement between two مفسرين, state what each holds, on what evidence, and whether the difference is اختلاف تنوع or اختلاف تضاد.
- Assemble a theme across the Qur'an (التفسير الموضوعي) rather than only reading one sura through.
- Prepare and deliver a تفسير session to a lay audience: in Arabic, then rendered accurately into English and Yoruba. This is the capstone assessment and it is also the actual social function the community will judge. It is assessed on accuracy of meaning, evidence cited, handling of difference, and absence of unsupported narration — not on fluency of delivery, which belongs to الخطابة.

What it is explicitly NOT: it does not certify ijāzah (that is the parallel opt-in track, redline 2); it does not make the graduate a مفسر; it does not close the subject. It produces someone equipped to continue in tafsir at a higher institution and competent to render the Qur'an's meaning responsibly in the meantime.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
G1-G5: ZERO timetabled periods. The entire مضمّن layer lives inside the ring-fenced 60-minute daily Qur'an hour, delivered by the حفظ teacher at the moment of memorization. This is not a convenience — at G1-G2 the whole timetable outside the Qur'an hour is ~7 periods [RECOVERED], and any non-zero request there would have to come out of القراءة والتهجي. The design is built so this subject asks for nothing until the pupil can use it.

G6: 2 periods of 19. One مدمج block with الترجمة, carrying a separate book, independently assessed.
G7: 2 periods of 19. Same block, final year of the pairing.
G8: 2 periods of 19, مستقل. BUDGET-NEUTRAL: Programme 1 releases periods at exactly this point — القراءة والتهجي completes at G5, and the التجويد matn ladder (تحفة الأطفال G4-G5 → الجزرية G6-G7) completes at G7. التفسير inherits periods Programme 1 already held. It takes nothing from Programme 2 or Programme 3, which is what makes G8 the only clean moment for this move [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION].
G9: 2 periods of 19.
G10: 2 periods of 19 as التفسير alone; 3 if أصول التفسير is مدمج into this block rather than separately timetabled — which is my recommendation, and which SAVES a period against timetabling أصول التفسير on its own. G10 is the tightest year in the whole twelve: البلاغة، أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث (redline 1) and the نحو/صرف ladder all press on the same 19.
G11: 3 periods of 19 — two strands (آيات الأحكام, التفسير البياني) genuinely need the third period, and by G11 القراءة، التجويد، الترجمة and the early integrated pairs have all released their claims.
G12: 3 periods of 19, including capstone preparation and delivery.

Total Programme 1 timetabled load across the ladder therefore stays roughly flat — it shifts from تجويد/قراءة in G1-G7 to تفسير in G8-G12 rather than adding to it. That is the fit, and it is a real one, not an aspiration.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY حفظ القرآن (continuous, ring-fenced): supplies the corpus. Direction of dependence is one-way — التفسير never takes minutes from the hour, and the G1-G5 meaning-layer is delivered BY the حفظ teacher INSIDE the hour, so it creates no competing claim on it.
FED BY القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5): supplies decoding. When it completes at G5, التفسير is the subject that inherits its purpose — reading the Qur'an now means reading it for sense.

FED BY اللغة العربية (continuous): supplies vocabulary and sentence sense. The ~250 Qur'anic words cumulated مضمّن by G5 are drawn from and feed back into the G3-G5 الكلمات/المفردات work — they are the SAME word list approached from the Qur'an's side, not a second list.
FED BY النحو (مضمّن G5, الآجرومية G6, ملحة الإعراب G7): supplies the إعراب apparatus. This is the load-bearing dependency and the reason differentiation is at G6.
FED BY الصرف (البناء في الصرف G6, لامية الأفعال G7): supplies اشتقاق for غريب القرآن work from G8.

FED BY السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي (مدمج from G4): supplies the chronological frame for المكي والمدني and أسباب النزول. At G4-G5 this runs the other way too — suras with plain historical referents (الفيل، المسد) give السيرة its Qur'anic anchor.

FED BY التوحيد والعقيدة (مدمج G3-G7, per redline 5): supplies the categories that make آيات الصفات and آيات الشرك safe to meet. Reciprocally, from G10 التفسير supplies العقيدة with its دليل — the pupil stops citing عقيدة positions and starts citing verses.
FED BY البلاغة (must land by G10 — lifecycle open): gate for التفسير البياني at G11. If البلاغة does not arrive, that strand is cut, not simulated.
FED BY أصول الفقه (must land by G10-G11 — lifecycle open): gate for آيات الأحكام at G11.

FED BY / SHARES A BLOCK WITH أصول التفسير (proposed G10): my recommendation is مدمج into التفسير's block, matn مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية. Before G10, the علوم القرآن notions التفسير needs (مكي/مدني، سبب نزول) are USED operationally inside my lessons without being TAUGHT as a science — that use is not the beginning of أصول التفسير and must not be counted as such.

FEEDS الترجمة (redline 8): carries it entirely at G6-G7 as the مدمج partner, then releases it at G8 so it can take its own independent trajectory — which redline 8 itself anticipates.
