Keeping the pairing past G7 would cap تفسير at the level of what can be translated and would keep الترجمة permanently subordinate.

FEEDS الفقه: التفسير establishes the Qur'anic دليل and the vocabulary of استنباط at G11. الفقه takes the فروع. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: التفسير does not rule on masā'il, does not run through the chapters of a fiqh matn, and does not compete with الأخضري (G6) or its successors.

FEEDS الإنشاء والخطابة (lifecycle open): supplies the content of خطبة and موعظة at G10-G12. The G12 capstone assesses the tafsir, not the delivery — delivery belongs to الخطابة and the two must not be double-marked.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE التجويد: no recitation-rule instruction of any kind inside التفسير, at any grade. تحفة الأطفال (G4-G5) and الجزرية (G6-G7) own that ladder entirely.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE الحديث / مصطلح الحديث: التفسير بالمأثور uses hadith as evidence from G8 but teaches no isnād criticism and no مصطلح terminology. مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10-G11 with نخبة الفكر [redline 1], and my G9 الإسرائيليات work is deliberately framed as 'this story has no stated source' — a reading habit — not as تضعيف, which would be poaching.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE حفظ القرآن: no memorization drills, no recitation marks, no sura-completion targets inside التفسير's assessment at any grade.

INTERFACE WITH THE إجازة TRACK (redline 2): the Ijazah track is حفظ/تجويد mastery, pace-based and opt-in. It carries no tafsir requirement, and التفسير's grade assessments run on the normal term calendar regardless of a pupil's Ijazah progress. Whether a parallel tafsir mastery layer should exist on that track is an open question, not an assumption.
departuresFromSubmission: G1-G5 SILENCE — the principal override. The submission has التفسير appear first at G6 and says nothing about meaning in G1-G5. I am inserting a مضمّن meaning-layer from G1, delivered inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour by the حفظ teacher, at ZERO timetabled cost, with embedded assessment from G3 via a معنى السورة component in the حفظ oral examination. Reason: five years of memorizing sound without sense does not leave a gap to be filled later, it forms a habit that has to be broken later, and that habit is the defining weakness of the regional model this school exists to improve on.

G7 PARTNER UNNAMED. The submission writes 'التفسير مدمج + separate book + independently assessed' at G7 and names no partner discipline. مدمج requires ONE named partner by the council's own form vocabulary; an unnamed مدمج is unimplementable. The partner is الترجمة, at G6 and G7, explicitly.

THE الترجمة PAIRING IS NOT PERMANENT. The submission gives no end to it. I end it at G7 and take التفسير مستقل at G8 — otherwise تفسير is permanently capped at the level of what a schoolchild can translate, and الترجمة is permanently prevented from the independent development redline 8 says it should have.

G8-G12 DESIGNED. The submission deliberately stops at G7. I have designed the remaining five grades: مستقل throughout, with a specific corpus ladder (لقمان/الكهف at G8, يوسف at G9, البقرة first half at G10, آيات الأحكام and التفسير البياني at G11, التفسير الموضوعي and the delivery capstone at G12).

NO TEXT BASE WAS NAMED. The submission calls the G6 course 'التفسير العملي للقرآن الكريم' — a course title, not a source. I am specifying: تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي as the teacher source at G6-G9, تفسير الجلالين as the pupil-read spine from G8 (conditional on a عقيدة ruling), تفسير ابن كثير in abridgment from G9.

ASSESSMENT SPECIFIED, NOT JUST ASSERTED. The submission says 'independently assessed' at G6 and G7 without saying against what. I have set mastery thresholds: at G6, parse and render a memorized short sura without a memorized translation script; at G11, state two مفسرين's positions and the evidence each rests on; at G12, deliver an assessed tafsir in three languages judged on evidence and on restraint with unsourced material.

I AM PROPOSING TO ABSORB أصول التفسير. The submission does not place أصول التفسير anywhere. I recommend it be مدمج into التفسير's block at G10 rather than separately timetabled — this is a claim on another specialist's subject and I flag it as requiring a joint ruling rather than asserting it.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is تفسير الجلالين acceptable as the pupil-read spine from G8? The two Jalāls were Ashʿarī and the text carries تأويل on some آيات الصفات, alongside brief unsourced narrations. Against that: it is the text of the local scholarly tradition and a graduate who has read it is legible to the community in a way one who has not is not. This is a عقيدة-policy question and belongs to the العقيدة specialist and the Director General, not to me. If the answer is no, the fallback is السعدي extended to G9 plus an abridged ابن كثير from G9, at some cost in concision and in local legibility.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does أصول التفسير take its own periods at G10-G12, or is it مدمج into التفسير's block with مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية as its matn? My recommendation is the latter — it saves a period in the tightest year in the ladder and أصول taught away from applied tafsir is inert. But this is a claim on another subject's territory.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] A formal reading of the ring-fence clause (لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى) confirming that the planned meaning-gloss at G1-G5 is teaching OF the Qur'an and therefore internal to the hour, not an incursion by another subject. Without a written ruling, a future head of school will eventually delete it as an encroachment — and it is the load-bearing element of this whole design.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Language of the G1-G5 gloss: Yoruba only, Yoruba and English, or Yoruba with Arabic phrases from G4? This determines حفظ teacher recruitment criteria and the specification of the G6 pupil book, and it cannot be left to individual teachers without the layer becoming uneven across classes.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Which long sura is the G10-G12 spine — البقرة, آل عمران, or النساء? I have specified البقرة first half at G10 on grounds of familiarity and coverage, but this interacts with the آيات الأحكام sequencing shared with أصول الفقه at G11 and should be settled jointly with that specialist before books are commissioned.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Should the parallel Ijazah track (redline 2) carry a tafsir mastery layer, or remain حفظ and تجويد only? I have designed on the assumption it remains حفظ/تجويد, so nothing in the grade curriculum depends on the answer — but if a tafsir Ijazah is wanted, its threshold must be defined before it is advertised.

[OPEN — DEPENDS ON OTHER BRIEFS] البلاغة and أصول الفقه both appear in the 26-subject register with open lifecycles, and my G11 design assumes both are established by G10. If either lands later, the corresponding G11 strand must be CUT rather than taught without its prerequisite. I would rather lose the بياني strand than fake it.

[PROCUREMENT, NOT DOCTRINE] Which abridgment of تفسير ابن كثير is actually obtainable in Nigeria at classroom quantities, and in what edition? I have deliberately not named one, because I am not confident enough about the exact titles and editorial scope of the available abridgments to commit the curriculum to one on recall alone.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance:
G6 — مضمّن inside التفسير العملي للقرآن والترجمة، with zero additional period cost.

"Meaningful" for this discipline cannot mean "first taught," because أصول التفسير is a SECOND-ORDER discipline: it regulates a first-order practice (تفسير). A second-order discipline taught before its first-order practice exists is a taxonomy of unknown territory — this is precisely the failure the Redline Board already identified when it moved نخبة الفكر out of G6 (accepted redline 1). I apply the same logic to my own subject rather than exempting it.

So the earliest meaningful moment is the moment the learner FIRST PRODUCES EXEGETICAL OUTPUT. Under accepted redline 8, that is G6: الترجمة إلى الإنجليزية واليوربا begins there, through التفسير العملي. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Translation is not adjacent to tafsir — it IS an act of tafsir. Every Yoruba or English word a G6 pupil chooses for a Qur'anic term is an unexamined exegetical commitment: choosing "Lord," "Oluwa," or "Olohun" for الرب; choosing a Yoruba word for التقوى; deciding whether استوى is rendered or left. The pupil is already doing the thing. Therefore the guard-rails are not premature at G6 — they are already late by the time the second lesson ends.

What is planned and taught at G6 is NOT terminology and NOT a system. It is three habits, named in plain Arabic, modelled by the teacher every lesson:
(1) القرآن يفسّر بعضه بعضًا — when a word is unclear, we look for the same word elsewhere in the Qur'an before we guess.
(2) بيّن النبي ﷺ معاني القرآن — some verses were explained by the Prophet, and that explanation outranks ours.
(3) لا نقول على الله ما لا نعلم — "I think it means" is not an answer; "I do not know" is a permitted and honourable answer.

This is real learning because it demonstrably changes the artefact the child produces. It is not a mention.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] I explicitly REFUSE the available alternative of an earlier ceremonial appearance at G3-G5. There is no تفسير subject before G6; a G4 lesson called أصول التفسير would consume a name and produce nothing.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, under any form. There is no تفسير subject at G1 and therefore no practice for a second-order discipline to govern. G1 Qur'an work is حفظ (the ring-fenced hour) and القراءة والتهجي — decoding, not meaning. What little meaning-work exists belongs to اللغة العربية (الحروف وقليل المفردات) and to الفقه التطبيقي/التوحيد العملي, and it belongs to them by right. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Nothing is to be labelled أصول التفسير at G1 even for register-completeness. Period cost: 0 of the 7 available.

Not taught. Unchanged from G1 and deliberately so. G2's اللغة العربية moves to الحروف والمفردات and الفقه التطبيقي to very short sentences; neither creates any exegetical act requiring regulation. The 7-period ceiling at G1-G2 is the tightest in the whole ladder and any claim on it by a meta-discipline would be indefensible. Period cost: 0.

Not taught. الحديث appears مضمّن at G3 for the first time, which begins — very slowly — building the later prerequisite that the Prophet's words are a source of explanation. That is الحديث's work, not أصول التفسير's, and must not be re-badged. Period cost: 0.

Not taught. G4 adds تحفة الأطفال والغلمان (tajwid, مستقل) and الحديث والسيرة مدمج. Note the boundary I am holding: تجويد owns الأداء, and the fact that a pupil now handles a matn does not mean he is ready for a matn ABOUT method. Period cost: 0.

Not taught. G5 is where النحو والصرف first appear (مضمّن, independently assessed) — the earliest of أصول التفسير's enabling tools begins here, but it is nowhere near load-bearing. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] G5 carries a specific temptation to be resisted: نواقض الإسلام is taught here under redline 6's protective framing, and a well-meaning teacher may reach for interpretive rules to handle the verses cited. That is not أصول التفسير; the protective framing belongs to العقيدة/التوحيد and to the redline-6 pedagogy already mandated. Period cost: 0.

FIRST MEANINGFUL APPEARANCE. Taught inside التفسير العملي للقرآن والترجمة إلى الإنجليزية واليوربا, which already has its own separate book and its own independent assessment; أصول التفسير takes NO block and NO additional period. Explicitly planned learning, three named habits, no terminology: (1) القرآن يفسّر بعضه بعضًا — before guessing a word, find it elsewhere in the Qur'an; the pupil keeps a two-column notebook of a word and its parallel موضع. (2) بيان النبي ﷺ — where a sound hadith explains a verse, it outranks our reading; delivered by the teacher naming the source aloud each time. (3) لا نقول على الله ما لا نعلم — 'I do not know' is a correct and rewarded answer; 'I feel it means' is not. Applied specifically to translation: the pupil is asked, for one verse per term, 'what does your Yoruba word commit you to that the Arabic does not say?' Embedded assessment = a traceable rubric strand within the existing التفسير mark ('cites a basis for the meaning given'), not a separate grade. Period cost: 0 additional.

Continues مضمّن inside التفسير (which the submission carries as مدمج + separate book + independently assessed). Thickened by the year's grammar: with ملحة الإعراب running at G7, the teacher can now show — with two or three worked verses across the year — that a change of إعراب changes the meaning. The habit named is أثر الإعراب في المعنى, and it belongs to أصول التفسير while the إعراب itself belongs to النحو. Also added: the five sources are now spoken as an ordered list when the teacher explains a verse (القرآن، السنة، أقوال الصحابة، لغة العرب، الاجتهاد المنضبط) — heard repeatedly, not memorised or examined. Still no matn, no chapters, no انواع. Period cost: 0 additional.

Continues مضمّن inside التفسير. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — this assumes التفسير is allocated at G8; G8-G12 are not yet designed and if التفسير has no G8 block, this strand has no host and the design breaks.] New this year, made possible by لامية الأفعال and البناء completing at G6-G7: غريب القرآن as a working habit — tracing an unfamiliar Qur'anic word to its root and وزن, and consulting a designated lexical authority rather than inferring from modern Arabic or from a translation. The pupil produces a small personal غريب glossary across the year. Also: the first explicit statement that the مفسرون differ, and that difference is normal and often complementary — laid down here as a fact, with the classification of difference deferred to G11. Period cost: 0 additional.

A bounded short course, ONE TERM ONLY: مدخل إلى علوم القرآن. Defined beginning and end, then it stops. Content is DESCRIPTIVE and HISTORICAL, deliberately not yet methodological or critical: نزول القرآن منجّمًا; المكي والمدني and how each is recognised; أسباب النزول — what a sabab is and that only some verses have one, taught as history not yet as a rule; جمع القرآن في عهد أبي بكر وعثمان ورسم المصحف; ترتيب السور والآيات; a plain introduction to اختلاف القراءات as a preserved reality (the interpretive consequences are held back to G11, the performance side stays entirely with التجويد). [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Placed at G9 precisely BECAUSE it is descriptive: it can be learned without مصطلح الحديث or أصول الفقه, and putting it here keeps G10 free for those two. It also supplies the vocabulary G11 will need — one cannot teach العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب to a learner who has never met a sabab. Independently assessed as a discrete unit examination — the first time this subject carries its own mark. Fed by السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي (established G5-G7). Period cost: 1 period/week, Term 2 only.

Returns to مضمّن inside التفسير, with NO dedicated block — and this is a deliberate, argued gap, not an oversight. G10 is the year مصطلح الحديث differentiates (accepted redline 1, G10-G11) and the year I recommend أصول الفقه differentiate. Both are second-order disciplines; both are أصول التفسير's suppliers. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Introducing a THIRD meta-discipline in the same year is a cognitive-load failure before it is a timetable failure: the learner would be simultaneously acquiring three unfamiliar rule-systems with overlapping vocabulary (العام والخاص appears in two of them) and would conflate them. So at G10 أصول التفسير deliberately takes nothing and instead cashes in what the neighbours are teaching: the التفسير teacher now says 'this report about the verse is ضعيف' and the learner, from مصطلح الحديث, knows what that means and what follows from it. Period cost: 0 additional.

POINT OF DIFFERENTIATION. Own subject identity, own matn, own examination, two periods a week for the full year. Spine: مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية, read with a teacher's شرح, supplemented by القواعد الحسان للسعدي for positive applied rules. Content, in order: (1) مصادر التفسير ranked and worked — تفسير القرآن بالقرآن، بالسنة، بأقوال الصحابة، بأقوال التابعين، بلغة العرب، ثم الاجتهاد; each source given real worked verses, not definitions. (2) اختلاف السلف في التفسير — اختلاف التنوع vs اختلاف التضاد, which is Ibn Taymiyya's central contribution and the single most useful thing a graduate can own, because most apparent disagreement among مفسرون dissolves under it. (3) التفسير بالرأي — the المحمود/المذموم distinction, with its conditions, taught as a licence-with-limits rather than a prohibition. (4) الإسرائيليات — their three categories and the rule of تصديق/تكذيب/توقف; taught NOW and not earlier because narrative is retained and caveats are not. (5) أسباب النزول as a RULE — العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب, now possible because the descriptive material landed at G9. (6) شروط المفسر وآدابه. (7) حكم ترجمة القرآن — الترجمة الحرفية vs التفسيرية, and why the Qur'an's translation is a translation of a تفسير; this is the year the G6-G10 translation practice finally receives its governing rules. (8) The shared apparatus (العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ، دلالات الألفاظ) is NOT taught here — it is taught once in أصول الفقه and only APPLIED here to Qur'anic examples. Assessment: written examination on the matn plus a coursework component requiring the learner to classify ten instances of مفسّر disagreement. Period cost: 2/week, ~10.5% of the 19 ceiling.
gradeByGrade.text: مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية (spine); القواعد الحسان لتفسير القرآن للسعدي (applied companion)

gradeByGrade.content: Merges into التفسير as its named partner, with outcomes kept separately traceable and separately examined. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] I deliberately DECLINE the obvious senior-year move of keeping it مستقل. أصول التفسير is by its own nature a مقدمة discipline — its classical literature is literally titled 'muqaddima' — acquired compactly once and then used permanently. It has no multi-year progressive body of content the way النحو does. A second مستقل year would manufacture content to fill a block. What G12 needs instead is a year of SUPERVISED USE. Content: sustained reading of a real مصنف — تفسير ابن كثير as the مأثور exemplar, تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي as the accessible contrast, with extracts (not continuous reading) from الطبري and القرطبي to compare منهج. The أصول strand within the block covers مناهج المفسرين (بالمأثور/بالرأي، الأثري، اللغوي، الفقهي) as a classification the learner applies to what he is actually reading; the contemporary abuses — التفسير العلمي المتكلف and reading modern ideology into the text — named and refuted with the G11 tools; and a translation-critique exercise against the institution's designated English and Yoruba renderings. Capstone (independently assessed, separate from the التفسير mark): a written and orally defended تفسير of an unseen passage of 10-20 verses. Period cost: 1/week drawn from التفسير's existing G12 allocation; 0 additional.
gradeByGrade.text: تفسير القرآن العظيم لابن كثير; تيسير الكريم الرحمن للسعدي; extracts from جامع البيان للطبري and الجامع لأحكام القرآن للقرطبي

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G11 — مستقل, with مقدمة ابن تيمية as its matn.

WHY NOT EARLIER THAN G11 (the binding argument): أصول التفسير is a consumer discipline. It does not generate its own apparatus; it borrows from two other second-order disciplines and spends its own time on what is proper to it. Both suppliers land at G10.

(a) مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10-G11 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, accepted redline 1]. أصول التفسير's largest single chapter is التفسير بالمأثور. Taught before مصطلح الحديث, that chapter can only be taught devotionally — "the Prophet said," "Ibn Abbas said" — with no capacity to ask whether the report is established. That produces a learner who accepts any attributed tafsir report, which is worse than a learner who has no rules at all, because he now has confidence. The الإسرائيليات chapter is unteachable without it: the whole rule of تصديق/تكذيب/توقف presupposes the ability to weigh a transmitted report.

(b) أصول الفقه [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — my recommendation is G10] owns العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ، دلالات الألفاظ. These are the SAME chapters, not similar ones. Placed at G10, أصول التفسير must either re-teach them from scratch (duplication the board has explicitly warned against) or teach them without their natural home. Placed at G11, it inherits them as owned tools and spends its two periods on what is genuinely its own: اختلاف التنوع والتضاد، الإسرائيليات، العبرة بعموم اللفظ، مناهج المفسرين، حكم الترجمة.

There is also a load argument, not merely a logical one: G10 already receives two new meta-disciplines with overlapping vocabulary. A third in the same year guarantees conflation.

WHY NOT LATER THAN G11: G12 must be the year the method is USED, not acquired. A discipline whose entire purpose is to govern a practice cannot be introduced in the terminal year and left unpractised — the graduate would leave having been examined on rules he never applied to an unfamiliar passage under supervision. One full year of supervised application is the minimum, and there is only one year after G11. Deferring acquisition to G12 would also leave the G6-G11 translation practice (redline 8) ungoverned for its entire run and then hand the learner its rules as he walks out.

A NOTE ON WHAT DIFFERENTIATES: G9 already gives the subject its first independent mark, but as a وحدة, not a differentiation — a bounded descriptive unit that ends. G11 is where it becomes a named discipline with a matn and a progression. The distinction matters: G9 supplies vocabulary, G11 supplies method.
prerequisites: Fluent Arabic decoding and a substantial حفظ base — the learner must be able to locate a parallel موضع in the Qur'an from memory or near-memory, which is what makes تفسير القرآن بالقرآن physically possible rather than theoretical. Established: القراءة والتهجي G1-G5; حفظ continuous from G1 in the ring-fenced hour. Operative by G5.

Arabic vocabulary and comprehension of simple sentences sufficient to read a verse FOR MEANING and not only for sound. Established: اللغة العربية G1-G5 (الحروف → المفردات → الجمل البسيطة). Operative by G5-G6. Without this, G6's مضمّن strand has nothing to attach to.

النحو to the level where a change of إعراب is seen to change the meaning. Established: الآجرومية G6 → ملحة الإعراب G7 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 3]. Operative by G8. This is the specific competence behind أثر الإعراب في المعنى at G8.
الصرف to the level of tracing a Qur'anic word to root and وزن, so that a غريب lookup is possible. Established: البناء في الصرف G6 → لامية الأفعال G7 [redline 3]. Operative by G8.

السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي — the Meccan and Medinan periods as distinct, the Companions as historical persons, the setting of the ʿUthmānic codex. Established: السيرة مضمّن G6, مدمج G7, continuing. Operative by G8. This is the load-bearing prerequisite for the G9 وحدة; without it المكي والمدني and جمع القرآن are dates without a world.

الحديث as a body of CONTENT — knowing what a hadith text looks like and that the Prophet explained verses. Established: مضمّن G3, الحديث والسيرة مدمج G4, continuing through G7. Operative by G7. Deliberately distinct from the next item.

مصطلح الحديث — صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as operative categories and إسناد as a concept. Established: G10-G11 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 1; نخبة الفكر is the matn]. This is the single prerequisite that fixes differentiation at G11 and not G10.

أصول الفقه — دلالات الألفاظ، العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ. NOT YET ALLOCATED. My recommendation: G10. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] If أصول الفقه lands at G11 concurrently, the two must be explicitly sequenced within the year (أصول الفقه first term). If it lands at G12 or not at all, G11 أصول التفسير must absorb a reduced version of these chapters and its allocation rises from 2 to 3 periods/week.

البلاغة — التشبيه، الاستعارة، المجاز، الكناية، and the أساليب of Qur'anic address. NOT YET ALLOCATED. My recommendation: G9-G10. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Needed so that the G11 handling of المتشابه and of figurative language is not the learner's first encounter with the idea that speech can mean other than its surface. If البلاغة is later than G10, G11 must carry a compensating minimum of two or three lessons, which is a poor substitute.

العقيدة settled on the divine attributes, so that آيات الصفات and المتشابه are met as an interpretive question by a learner whose belief is already stable. Established: التوحيد والعقيدة مدمج G5-G6, العقيدة مدمج G7, deepening through G10. Operative by G7 and reinforced before G11.

Practical experience of rendering Arabic into English and Yoruba — the lived experience of having to CHOOSE a word. Established: الترجمة from G6 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 8]. This is what makes 'translation is an interpretive act' land as recognition rather than as an assertion, and it is the specific reason the G6 مضمّن start is not premature.

A standing تفسير block at G6-G12 to act as host. Established G6-G7 in the submission; G8-G12 not yet designed. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] — this is a structural dependency, not a nicety: without a تفسير host at G8 and G10 the مضمّن strand has nowhere to live.

classicalTexts.title: مقدمة في أصول التفسير — شيخ الإسلام ابن تيمية
classicalTexts.justification: The spine of the G11 مستقل year, and the reason G11 is workable in two periods a week. It is a risala, not a mujallad — short enough to be read completely and slowly with شرح across 39 weeks, which is exactly the right shape for a مقدمة discipline. Its content maps onto the G11 syllabus almost exactly: مصادر التفسير in rank order, the اختلاف التنوع / اختلاف التضاد distinction, the treatment of الإسرائيليات, and the condemnation of التفسير بالرأي المذموم. The التنوع/التضاد distinction in particular is the highest-yield single idea in the discipline for a school graduate, because it converts most apparent مفسّر disagreement from a crisis into a pattern. Caution for the council: this text was written with a polemical edge and a teacher must frame it as method rather than as a weapon, or G11 pupils will leave able to accuse rather than able to interpret.

classicalTexts.title: القواعد الحسان لتفسير القرآن — عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
classicalTexts.justification: Applied companion to ابن تيمية, run in the second of the two weekly periods. Where the مقدمة is largely about BOUNDARIES (what not to do), السعدي gives positive, usable rules with Qur'anic worked examples, in unusually plain Arabic that a G11 learner who has done ملحة الإعراب can read with a teacher. It prevents the year from becoming purely prohibitive, which is the standard failure mode of a school-level أصول التفسير course. Not every rule need be covered; select roughly twenty-five across the year.

classicalTexts.title: فصول في أصول التفسير — مساعد بن سليمان الطيار
classicalTexts.grade: G11 (teacher's manual, not a pupil matn)
classicalTexts.justification: Contemporary, systematically arranged, and written for exactly this teaching problem: organising أصول التفسير into a sequence a course can follow. Recommended as the teacher's course-planning reference and for staff formation, NOT put in pupils' hands. Listed because the G11 course's viability depends on teacher capacity as much as on the matn.

classicalTexts.title: المنظومة الزمزمية في أصول التفسير (نظم الزمزمي)
classicalTexts.grade: G11 — optional, via the الإجازة parallel track only
classicalTexts.justification: A didactic poem versifying أصول/علوم التفسير material, commonly taught with a شرح and well suited to memorisation. My recommendation is that it be placed in the OPT-IN mastery track under accepted redline 2 rather than made compulsory in the grade course — a G11 timetable of two periods cannot carry both a matn to be understood and a manzuma to be memorised, and memorising method-rules before understanding them reproduces exactly the error this whole design is built to avoid. HONEST CAVEAT: I am confident the poem exists under this title and is taught; I am LESS certain of the precise identity and death-date of its author (commonly given as عبد العزيز بن علي الزمزمي المكي). The council should verify the printed edition and its attribution before adoption rather than take my attribution as settled.

classicalTexts.title: مباحث في علوم القرآن — مناع القطان
classicalTexts.justification: The G9 وحدة deliberately has NO pupil matn — see the justification under 'no classical matn at G9' below. This modern textbook is the recommended teacher source from which the one-term descriptive material (المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول، جمع القرآن، رسم المصحف) is compiled into an SHRS-authored booklet pitched at 14-year-olds. It is organised, uncontroversial in arrangement, and widely used as an institutional reference.

classicalTexts.title: الإتقان في علوم القرآن — جلال الدين السيوطي
classicalTexts.grade: reference only, not taught at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: Listed so the council understands why it is EXCLUDED as a teaching text despite being the canonical work of the field. It is an encyclopaedia of eighty anwāʿ, arranged for reference and not for instruction; assigning it to any grade in a 19-period ceiling would be a category error. Held in the school library and used by teachers preparing the G9 وحدة and the G11 course.

classicalTexts.title: تفسير القرآن العظيم — ابن كثير
classicalTexts.justification: The G12 year is the year the method is used, so its texts are tafsirs, not usul works. ابن كثير is the primary exemplar of التفسير بالمأثور and is the natural object on which the G11 apparatus is exercised: the learner can watch a mufassir cite a parallel verse, then a hadith, then a Companion's statement, then reject an isra'iliyya — the G11 syllabus enacted on the page. A selected portion, not the whole work.

classicalTexts.title: تيسير الكريم الرحمن في تفسير كلام المنان — عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
classicalTexts.justification: The accessible contrast to ابن كثير, and a manhaj comparison the learner can actually perceive: السعدي gives meaning and benefit with minimal isnad apparatus, ابن كثير builds from transmitted report. Setting the two side by side on the same passage is the cleanest possible exercise in مناهج المفسرين for a school graduate, and both are within reach of a G12 Arabic level.

classicalTexts.title: جامع البيان عن تأويل آي القرآن — ابن جرير الطبري
classicalTexts.justification: Extracts only, never continuous reading. Its purpose at G12 is narrow and specific: to let the learner see الطبري weigh multiple reported opinions and then state a preference with a reason (وأولى الأقوال بالصواب), which is the discipline's method visible in its earliest sustained form. Two or three passages across the year is sufficient; more would overwhelm a G12 reading level and consume the year.

classicalTexts.title: الجامع لأحكام القرآن — القرطبي
classicalTexts.justification: Extracts only, and for one purpose: to show the الفقهي منهج of tafsir, so that the learner sees how a ruling in الفقه (studied from الأخضري at G6 onward) is actually derived from an آية through method rather than asserted. This is where أصول التفسير visibly pays its debt to أصول الفقه.

classicalTexts.title: الفوز الكبير في أصول التفسير — شاه ولي الله الدهلوي
classicalTexts.justification: Recommended for staff formation rather than for any grade. Its scheme organising the Qur'an's subject matter into a small number of principal sciences gives a teacher a way to hold a whole sura's argument in view, which improves the G8-G10 مضمّن teaching considerably. Note for the council: it was composed in Persian and circulates in Arabic translation, so a specific edition must be designated. Not a pupil text at any grade.

classicalTexts.title: [NO CLASSICAL MATN AT G9 — deliberate]
classicalTexts.justification: Stated explicitly so that its absence is not read as an oversight to be filled later. The G9 وحدة has no classical matn because none of the candidates fits: الإتقان and البرهان are reference encyclopaedias, not teaching matns; the منظومة الزمزمية is a versified summary whose value is memorisation and which belongs at G11 in the opt-in track; and مقدمة ابن تيمية is methodological, not descriptive, and is reserved for G11. I decline to name a text for G9 rather than manufacture one. The وحدة runs on an SHRS-authored booklet compiled from the teacher sources above.

classicalTexts.title: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — designated English and Yoruba renderings of the Qur'an]
classicalTexts.justification: The G12 translation-critique exercise, and the whole G6-onward ترجمة strand under redline 8, require the institution to DESIGNATE which English and which Yoruba renderings are used, so that criticism is directed at a fixed text rather than at whatever a pupil brings. I will not name a specific Yoruba rendering: I am not confident enough of the title, translator and status of published Yoruba Qur'an translations to put one into a curriculum document, and a wrong attribution here would be a serious error in a Yoruba-speaking institution. The council must settle this with local scholarly consultation.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Specific to this discipline, not generic:

1. TAXONOMY WITHOUT REFERENT. A G6 pupil taught العام يبقى على عمومه حتى يرد المخصص has never experienced a general text being specified. The rule enters as an Arabic string to be recited back. This is exactly the failure the board diagnosed in نخبة الفكر at G6 (redline 1), and I am applying the diagnosis to my own subject rather than claiming an exemption for Programme 1.

2. المتشابه BEFORE العقيدة IS SETTLED — the most serious risk on this list. Presenting آيات الصفات to an 11- or 12-year-old as a "problem of interpretation" manufactures doubt in a child who had none. The verses are not the danger; the framing is. العقيدة must be stable (G5-G7, deepening to G10) before the same verses are reopened as a methodological question at G11. Getting this order wrong damages belief in the name of teaching method.

3. THE ISRAʾĪLIYYĀT ASYMMETRY. Narrative is retained; caveats are not. A child told a colourful isra'iliyya and then warned against it will remember the story for thirty years and the warning for a week. Teaching الإسرائيليات before the learner can independently evaluate a report — i.e. before مصطلح الحديث at G10-G11 — actively transmits the material it intends to inoculate against. This alone rules out any treatment of الإسرائيليات before G11.

4. SCRUPULOSITY OR EMPTY COMPLIANCE FROM EARLY "لا تفسّر بالرأي". Taught as a prohibition to a child who has no رأي yet to restrain, it produces one of two outcomes, both bad: a pupil frightened to think about the Qur'an at all, or a pupil who recites the prohibition and ignores it. Either is inflicted at precisely the age (G6-G8) when the institution is building the learner's relationship with the text. The G6-G10 strand therefore teaches "cite your basis" as a positive habit and reserves the prohibition's formal treatment, with its conditions and its permitted counterpart, for G11.

5. النسخ COLLIDING WITH THE HIFZ HOUR. A child who has memorised a verse in the ring-fenced hour and is then told in a classroom that it "no longer applies," without the fiqh apparatus to understand what is and is not abrogated, sustains real damage to the hifz relationship the constitution protects. النسخ waits for أصول الفقه.

6. TIMETABLE IMPOSSIBILITY AT G6-G7. G6 already carries الجزرية، الآجرومية، البناء، التوحيد والعقيدة، الفقه والسيرة، التفسير والترجمة، النشيد within 19 periods. There is no room, and my design requires none: the G6-G8 and G10 strands cost zero additional periods by design.

7. TEACHER-CAPACITY RISK IS WORSE EARLY. A primary-stage teacher asked to deliver أصول التفسير without having studied it will improvise, and improvised method is precisely the disease. Confined to modelled habits inside التفسير at G6-G10, the demand on the teacher is behavioural and trainable rather than scholarly.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Equally specific, and the reason I do NOT simply start this subject at G11:

1. FIVE YEARS OF HABITUATED UNPRINCIPLED INTERPRETATION. الترجمة begins at G6 by accepted redline 8. From that day the pupil is producing exegetical claims in English and Yoruba. If no method is modelled until G11, the institution will have supervised five years of unexamined interpretive habit and must then UNDO it. Removing an established habit costs more than forming it. This is the entire argument for the G6 مضمّن start and it is why "the prerequisites only land at G10" does not license silence before then.

2. THE VACUUM IS FILLED LOCALLY, NOT LEFT EMPTY. In a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian setting, tafsir is a public, oral, high-status genre — Ramadan tafsir gatherings, radio, and now video circulating on phones. Pupils encounter confident public interpretation constantly and from age six. If the school supplies no criteria for evaluating it, pupils do not remain neutral; they adopt whichever criteria the most compelling voice around them supplies. Delay here is not caution, it is abdication. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]

3. A GRADUATE WHO CAN PARSE BUT CANNOT ADJUDICATE. Without this subject, the SHRS graduate can recite with الجزرية-grade tajwid, parse with ملحة الإعراب, and quote a tafsir — but cannot say WHY one meaning is preferable to another, and cannot tell a sound transmitted interpretation from a plausible-sounding invention. That is the precise failure the whole twelve-year ladder exists to prevent, and it is invisible on every other subject's assessment.

4. THE INTERNATIONAL AMBITION FAILS AT ADMISSION. أصول التفسير is assumed entry competence for any tafsir-bearing programme abroad. A graduate arriving without it is placed below his actual Arabic and hifz level, which misrepresents the institution.

5. DEFERRING ACQUISITION TO G12 PRODUCES METHOD THAT IS EXAMINED AND NEVER USED. There would be no year of supervised application. The learner would take the paper and leave. This is why G11, not G12, and why G12 is مدمج practice rather than a second acquisition year.

6. UNGOVERNED CONTEMPORARY CLAIMS. الدراسات الحديثة will confront pupils with scientific-miracle claims and with orientalist arguments about the Qur'an. Without أصول التفسير's rules — including its rejection of التفسير العلمي المتكلف — pupils will meet these either with improvised defence or with unearned credulity. That subject NEEDS this one to have landed first.
lifecycles.g12Role:
FORM AT G12: مدمج with التفسير, one traceable period a week drawn from التفسير's existing block, independently assessed by capstone. The discipline does not survive G12 as a separate entity — and that is correct, not a demotion. أصول التفسير is a مقدمة discipline: acquired compactly once (G11), then permanently in service. Keeping it مستقل at G12 would force the invention of filler content.

WHAT G12 ACTUALLY DOES: sustained reading of real tafsir with the G11 apparatus in hand — ابن كثير as the مأثور exemplar against السعدي as the accessible contrast, with selected extracts from الطبري (to see a mufassir weigh reports and state a preference with a reason) and القرطبي (to see a fiqh ruling actually derived from an آية). Added as G12's own content: مناهج المفسرين as a classification applied to what is being read; the contemporary abuses named and refuted — التفسير العلمي المتكلف and the reading of modern ideology into the text; and a critique of the institution's designated English and Yoruba renderings against the Arabic.

WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO — stated as assessable performance on an UNSEEN passage of 10-20 verses, not as aspiration:
(a) State the meaning of the passage in Arabic and render it into English and Yoruba.
(b) For each meaning given, NAME ITS SOURCE CLASS — قرآن، سنة، قول صحابي، لغة العرب، اجتهاد — and be marked wrong for a meaning with no stated basis.
(c) Locate at least one parallel موضع elsewhere in the Qur'an bearing on the passage, from his own hifz.
(d) Report the sabab al-nuzul where one is established, and apply العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب correctly — i.e. not restrict a general ruling to its occasion.
(e) Where مفسرون differ, classify the difference as اختلاف تنوع or اختلاف تضاد, and say what follows in each case.
(f) Identify an إسرائيلية or a تفسير علمي متكلف when it appears in a commentary he is reading, and say on what ground he sets it aside.
(g) Take a published English or Yoruba translation of the passage and state SPECIFICALLY what the translation commits to that the Arabic leaves open.
(h) Say لا أدري, and say exactly where his competence stops and whom the question should go to.

Item (h) is the real terminal outcome of this subject and must carry marks. The purpose of teaching أصول التفسير in a school is not to produce mufassirūn at eighteen. It is to produce a graduate who knows what interpretation requires, can recognise when it has been done badly, and will not do it badly himself — including by knowing when not to do it at all. A graduate who leaves confident that he can interpret the Qur'an has been failed by this subject; a graduate who leaves able to say precisely why he cannot yet has been served by it.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the hard ceiling of ~19 periods/week at G3-G12 and ~7 at G1-G2. The design is built so that its cost is near-zero for most of its span, with a single 2-period peak in one year.

G1-G2: 0 periods. Not taught. (Ceiling 7 — this subject makes no claim on the tightest budget in the ladder.)

G3-G5: 0 periods. Not taught. (Ceiling 19.)

G6: 0 ADDITIONAL periods. مضمّن inside التفسير العملي والترجمة, which already holds its own block, separate book and independent assessment in the submission. The cost is a change in how the existing block is taught, plus roughly one staff-training day. This is the whole reason the G6 start is affordable.

G7: 0 additional. مضمّن inside التفسير.

G8: 0 additional. مضمّن inside التفسير. [Depends on التفسير holding a G8 block — see open questions.]

G9: 1 period/week, TERM 2 ONLY (~13 periods across the year). Expressed as a full-year weighting this is about 0.33 of a weekly slot — roughly 1.7% of the 19-period ceiling. Deliverable either as a dedicated term slot or by rotation against the تفسير block. This is the first real claim the subject makes on the timetable, and it is deliberately small and bounded.

G10: 0 additional. مضمّن inside التفسير — and the zero is DELIBERATE, to keep G10's budget clear for مصطلح الحديث and (recommended) أصول الفقه, both of which this subject consumes at G11.

G11: 2 periods/week, full year (78 periods). ~10.5% of the 19-period ceiling — the subject's single peak, taken once. Why exactly 2 and not 1 or 3: one period per week reduces مقدمة ابن تيمية to a reading exercise with no time for تطبيق, and a method course without application on real verses is the very thing this subject exists to prevent. Three would crowd a G11 already carrying مصطلح الحديث, العقيدة, الفقه, البلاغة and the Arabic disciplines. Two gives one period of matn-with-شرح and one of worked application, which is the minimum viable shape.
   CONTINGENCY: if أصول الفقه is NOT allocated by G11, this must rise to 3 periods/week, because the shared apparatus (العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ) would then have no other home. The council should treat 2 periods as conditional on the أصول الفقه decision.

G12: 0 additional. مدمج — 1 period/week of التفسير's existing G12 allocation (which should be no less than 3) explicitly designated to أصول/مناهج and separately traceable in the mark scheme.

WHOLE-LADDER COST: about 91 periods across twelve years, of which 78 fall in a single year. Every other year costs either nothing or one period for one term. An allocation that cannot fit is not a real allocation — this one fits, and it fits because the discipline is genuinely a مقدمة rather than a twelve-year progression, and I have designed it as what it is rather than as what would make it look important.
departuresFromSubmission: The submission is SILENT on أصول التفسير, so the substantive departures are from the default assumptions that silence invites rather than from stated positions. I list them as departures because each is a live temptation the board will otherwise fall into.

DEPARTURE FROM THE 'PROGRAMME 1 MEANS EARLY' ASSUMPTION. أصول التفسير sits in القرآن وعلومه alongside حفظ، التجويد، القراءة والتهجي — all of which begin at G1. I reject the symmetry. Those are first-order performance disciplines and belong at G1; this is a second-order regulatory discipline and cannot precede what it regulates. Programme membership is not a placement argument.

DEPARTURE FROM 'التفسير STARTS AT G6, SO أصول التفسير STARTS AT G6 AS A SUBJECT'. I place it at G6 but as مضمّن with zero period cost, refusing both available extremes: not absent (because الترجمة at G6 creates a genuine, immediate need) and not a subject (because it would be terminology without referent and there are no free periods at G6 regardless).

REFUSAL TO ASSIGN A MATN BEFORE G11. The natural institutional instinct, given this curriculum's strong and successful matn culture (تحفة → الجزرية، الآجرومية → ملحة، البناء → لامية), is to find a matn for every discipline and start it early. I decline. Method-rules memorised before they are understood is the precise error redline 1 corrected in نخبة الفكر, and a manzuma in أصول التفسير at G7 or G8 would reproduce it exactly.

REFUSAL TO MAKE IT مستقل AT G12. This is the departure most likely to be contested, because a senior-year 'principles of exegesis' block looks impressive on a prospectus. I judge it wrong: the discipline is a مقدمة acquired once, and a second acquisition year would require inventing content. G12 is مدمج practice, and the graduate is better for it.

DELIBERATE ZERO AT G10. Leaving a differentiating subject with no block in the year immediately before it differentiates looks like an error and will be read as one. It is deliberate: G10 belongs to مصطلح الحديث and أصول الفقه, both of which this subject consumes, and three overlapping meta-disciplines in one year would be conflated rather than learned.

EXTENSION OF REDLINE 1 BEYOND HADITH. The board applied 'no meta-discipline before its first-order content' to مصطلح الحديث. I am asserting it as a general architectural principle of this curriculum and applying it against my own subject's interests, which costs أصول التفسير four years of possible presence (G7-G10 as a named entity). I flag this so the board can ratify the principle explicitly rather than leave it as a one-off ruling about one text.

PROTECTION OF REDLINE 8, WITH AN ADDED OBLIGATION. الترجمة at G6 is correct and I defend it — meaningful Arabic content is the right vehicle and G6 is the right year. But the board should see the consequence it did not name: a translating pupil is an interpreting pupil. Redline 8 therefore CREATES the obligation for the G6 مضمّن strand. Keeping redline 8 without the strand would leave the institution supervising interpretation while teaching none.

CLAIMING THE علوم القرآن DESCRIPTIVE MATERIAL. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] No separate علوم القرآن subject appears in the register as given to me, while the PROGRAMME is named القرآن وعلومه. I have therefore housed المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول، جمع القرآن، رسم المصحف in أصول التفسير as a G9 وحدة. If the full 26-subject register does contain a distinct علوم القرآن entry, that material should move there and my G9 وحدة should be struck — my G11 and G12 design stands either way, but its G9 prerequisite would then be supplied by that subject instead.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: التفسير — its host, its purpose and its terminal partner. أصول التفسير is مضمّن within it G6-G8 and G10, and مدمج with it at G12. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: it must never become a parallel tafsir course covering verses التفسير is also covering. The division is clean — التفسير says what the passage means; أصول التفسير says on what basis anyone may say so. If a G11 lesson is spending its time explaining verses, it has drifted.

حفظ القرآن — supplies the text base that makes تفسير القرآن بالقرآن physically possible: a learner who can locate a parallel موضع from memory can do in seconds what a learner with an index does in minutes. STRICT BOUNDARY: the 195-hour ring-fenced hour is constitutionally protected (لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى) and أصول التفسير takes NOTHING from it at any grade, and must not be used as a justification for converting any part of it into meaning-work.

التجويد والقراءات (تحفة G4-G5 → الجزرية G6-G7) — sharpest boundary in Programme 1. التجويد owns الأداء entirely: makharij, sifat, ahkam, performance. أصول التفسير touches الأحرف السبعة والقراءات ONLY as an interpretive question — that a variant reading may yield a complementary meaning — and only at G9 (descriptively) and G11 (as a rule). It must never teach or assess a قراءة, and التجويد must never be asked to carry the interpretive consequence.
القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5) — pure feeder. Establishes decoding fluency without which no meaning-work is possible. No content overlap whatsoever; the relationship ends once fluency is achieved.

الترجمة (from G6, redline 8) — BIDIRECTIONAL, and the most important relationship in the early span. الترجمة supplies the felt need that makes the G6 مضمّن strand land (the pupil must CHOOSE a word, and discovers choices have consequences). أصول التفسير repays the debt at G11 by supplying الترجمة's governing rules — حكم ترجمة القرآن، الفرق بين الترجمة الحرفية والتفسيرية، أن ترجمة القرآن ترجمة لتفسيره. Without أصول التفسير, الترجمة at G6-G10 is an ungoverned exegetical practice.

مصطلح الحديث (G10-G11, نخبة الفكر — redline 1) — critical feeder, and the prerequisite that fixes differentiation at G11. أصول التفسير CONSUMES its verdicts (this report is صحيح/ضعيف) and must NOT re-teach its machinery: no أقسام الحديث, no علل, no جرح وتعديل in an أصول التفسير lesson. A one-sentence recall is the permitted maximum.

أصول الفقه (unallocated; recommend G10) — the sharpest DUPLICATION RISK in the entire register, because the overlapping chapters are not merely similar but identical: العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ، دلالات الألفاظ. Proposed division of labour: أصول الفقه OWNS the definitions and the تقسيم and teaches them once; أصول التفسير applies them to Qur'anic examples and adds only the tafsir-proper rules — العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب، اختلاف التنوع والتضاد، الإسرائيليات، مناهج المفسرين. Teaching them twice wastes periods the ceiling does not have; teaching them in neither leaves both subjects hollow.

الفقه (الأخضري G6 →) — receives. Via القرطبي extracts at G12 the graduate sees a ruling actually DERIVED from an آية by a method, rather than received as an assertion. This closes a loop the fiqh subject cannot close by itself.

العقيدة والتوحيد (integrated through the early and middle years — redline 5) — receives and constrains. أصول التفسير supplies the rules by which آيات الصفات and المتشابه are handled; العقيدة must have settled the belief BEFORE those verses are reopened methodologically at G11. CONSTRAINT ON ME: أصول التفسير must not slide into كلام — the theory of language and divine speech belongs to المنطق وعلم الكلام wherever that is placed.

النحو (الآجرومية G6 → ملحة الإعراب G7) — feeder. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: أصول التفسير never teaches إعراب. It teaches أثر الإعراب في المعنى — that a case-ending is a meaning-decision — which النحو has no occasion to teach.
الصرف (البناء G6 → لامية الأفعال G7) — feeder. Makes غريب القرآن lookup possible by root and وزن. أصول التفسير teaches no تصريف.

البلاغة (unallocated; recommend G9-G10) — feeder. Supplies التشبيه، الاستعارة، المجاز، الكناية, without which المتشابه and Qur'anic figurative language are met by a literalist. أصول التفسير must not teach البلاغة from scratch; if البلاغة lands after G10 this becomes a real gap requiring a compensating minimum at G11.

اللغة العربية (G1 onward) and الإملاء (longitudinal, redline 7) — foundational feeders. Note specifically: أصول التفسير is a WRITING-HEAVY subject at G11-G12 (classifying disagreements, defending an interpretation), so the longitudinal الإملاء strand and the Arabic writing competence it builds are load-bearing for its assessment, not incidental.

السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي (G5 مدمج → G6 مضمّن → G7 مدمج →) — direct feeder to the G9 وحدة. المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول، جمع القرآن are unintelligible without the period, the Companions as persons, and the ʿUthmānic episode in place.

الحديث (G3 مضمّن → G4-G7) — feeder at the CONTENT level, distinct from مصطلح. Supplies the lived knowledge that the Prophet explained verses, which is what makes 'السنة is the second source' a recognition rather than a claim.

الإنشاء والخطابة (unallocated) — receives, and is needed by me. The G12 capstone is a WRITTEN and ORALLY DEFENDED تفسير; the form, structure and delivery of that defence are الإنشاء والخطابة's to teach. If that subject is not allocated by G12, the capstone must be redesigned or it will assess rhetoric it never taught.

الدراسات الحديثة (unallocated) — receives, and needs this subject to land first. Contemporary claims about the Qur'an — scientific-miracle arguments, orientalist arguments about collection and variance — should be met with أصول التفسير's tools rather than improvised. أصول التفسير should explicitly supply the rule against التفسير العلمي المتكلف at G12 so that الدراسات الحديثة is not the place a pupil first meets it.

النقد والآداب، المنطق وعلم الكلام (unallocated) — المنطق, if taught, supports the critique of مناهج المفسرين at G12. No duplication in either direction: أصول التفسير does not teach argument forms, and neither subject adjudicates Qur'anic meaning.

التربية الإسلامية (unallocated) — boundary, not a relationship of supply. أدب المفسر at G11 is a set of CONDITIONS on a competence, not moral exhortation. If it is taught as exhortation it duplicates التربية الإسلامية and stops being method.

النشيد والمحفوظات (G3-G7 in the submission) — no relationship at G1-G7, and I make no claim on it. The one possible future link is memorisation of a منظومة in أصول التفسير at G11, which I have routed to the OPT-IN الإجازة track (redline 2) rather than into النشيد or the compulsory timetable.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Where is أصول الفقه placed? My G11 allocation of 2 periods/week assumes it lands at G10 and owns العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المجمل والمبين، النسخ، دلالات الألفاظ. If it lands at G11 concurrently, the two must be sequenced within the year (أصول الفقه first term). If it lands at G12 or is not allocated, G11 أصول التفسير must rise to 3 periods/week to absorb a reduced version of those chapters. This is the single decision my design is most sensitive to.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is التفسير in fact allocated as a standing block at G8, G9, G10, G11 and G12? G8-G12 are deliberately not yet designed. My G6-G10 مضمّن strand has NO independent existence — it lives entirely inside a تفسير block. If G8 or G10 has no تفسير block, the strand has no host and the G11 course will receive learners without the habits it assumes. This is a structural dependency, not a preference.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does the full 26-subject register contain a separate علوم القرآن entry? I could not see the complete register. I have housed the descriptive material (المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول، جمع القرآن، رسم المصحف) in أصول التفسير as a G9 وحدة on the assumption that it does not. If it does, that وحدة moves there and is struck from my allocation; my G11 and G12 design is unaffected but its G9 prerequisite would be supplied by that subject.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Where is البلاغة placed? G9-G10 is my recommendation and my assumption. If it falls after G10, the G11 treatment of المتشابه and of Qur'anic figurative language is weakened and needs a compensating minimum, which is an inferior arrangement the council should accept knowingly rather than by default.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Which English and which Yoruba renderings of the Qur'an are institutionally designated? Required for the G12 translation-critique exercise and, less formally, from G6 onward. I have deliberately NOT named a Yoruba rendering: I am not confident enough of titles, translators and status to put one in a curriculum document, and a wrong attribution in a Yoruba-speaking institution would be a serious error. This needs local scholarly consultation, not my guess.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Verification of المنظومة الزمزمية before adoption. I am confident the poem exists and is taught under this title; I am NOT confident of its author's precise identity and dates. Before it enters any SHRS document — even as an opt-in الإجازة text — a printed edition should be obtained and the attribution confirmed. I will not supply the attribution from memory.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Should the G11 مستقل course carry an الإجازة layer under redline 2? My recommendation is yes for the منظومة memorisation (opt-in, mastery-paced, separately governed) and NO for مقدمة ابن تيمية, which should stay a grade-curriculum text assessed on the normal term calendar. The principle: understanding is compulsory, memorisation of method-verse is optional.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Teacher capacity, and the scheduling consequence. A G11 مستقل أصول التفسير course requires a teacher who has himself studied the discipline, not a generalist with a شرح. The G6-G10 مضمّن strand requires only trainable classroom habits and can start immediately. If no qualified G11 teacher can be secured, the honest options are to defer the G11 differentiation by a year and strengthen the مضمّن strand, or to secure the teacher first — NOT to run the course with an unprepared teacher, which would model improvised method while teaching against it.

[FOR THE BOARD'S EXPLICIT RATIFICATION] Is 'no meta-discipline before its first-order content' now a general architectural principle of this curriculum, or a one-off ruling about نخبة الفكر at G6? I have applied it as a general principle and it has cost my own subject four years of possible presence. The same principle bears on أصول الفقه, البلاغة and المنطق. The board should adopt or reject it explicitly rather than let each specialist decide privately.

[NOTED, NOT A QUESTION FOR ME] Neither [UNVERIFIED] text — 'القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية' (G4 النشيد) nor 'الفواكه الساقطة' (G5 النشيد) — touches أصول التفسير at any grade. My design references neither and requires no substitute for either. I record this so the board can confirm that redline 4 leaves this subject's architecture unaffected.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G1 — but only after the submitted G1 content is overridden. For a second-language subject, "meaningful" means the teaching produces retained, usable language rather than exposure. The submission's G1 content (الحروف وقليل المفردات) would NOT be meaningful: القراءة والتهجي already owns the letter-sound system at G1 with its own book and its own independent assessment, so teaching الحروف again inside اللغة العربية is the same work done twice, and it yields no language — a child can trace ص and still be unable to answer ما هذا؟. What IS meaningful at G1 is purely oral Arabic: listening comprehension and spoken production. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] This is the decisive fact about SHRS's setting that the submission does not price in — the learner's L1 is Yoruba, the school language is English, and Arabic is an L2/L3 with no ambient community reinforcement. Oral acquisition capacity at age 6-7 is at its peak and there is no later window that is as cheap. If G1-G2 are spent on letters, the school forfeits the only two years in which spoken Arabic is nearly free, and it never recovers them. So: اللغة العربية appears meaningfully at G1, as an oral subject, with zero letters.

gradeByGrade.content: NO letters (القراءة والتهجي owns الحروف). Entirely oral: استماع وتحدث. لغة الفصل as real language, not vocabulary lists — اجلس، قم، افتح الكتاب، استمع، أعد، أحسنت. Greetings and permission formulae. The four question frames ما هذا؟ / من هذا؟ / أين...؟ / كم...؟ answered aloud. Concrete lexical fields the child physically inhabits: الأسرة، الجسم، الفصل، الطعام، الألوان، الأعداد ١-١٠، أدوات الوضوء والصلاة. الجملة الاسمية heard and imitated only (هذا كتاب، البابُ مفتوح) with no grammatical naming. Target: ~200-300 receptive words, ~100-150 productive, and the ability to obey an Arabic instruction without a Yoruba gloss. This lesson is also the proposed host for التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي مضمّن — the submission itself describes الفقه التطبيقي at G1 as pictures, gestures, practical situations and vocabulary, which is an oral-language lesson with fiqh content. Assessment is embedded and oral (a termly observation checklist against can-do statements): a written paper at G1 would test decoding, i.e. someone else's subject.

Oral base widened to ~500 receptive / ~250 productive. First reading FOR MEANING of words the child can already decode from القراءة والتهجي — the two subjects are deliberately synchronised so that اللغة العربية never asks the child to read a form he has not yet decoded. Production moves from single words to 2-3 word utterances. Added: negation (لا / ليس), possessive suffixes (كتابي، كتابُك), demonstratives (هذا/هذه/ذلك/تلك), the prepositions في، على، تحت، أمام، مع, plurals heard and used without the term الجمع. الكتابة begins here as letter formation and copying of known words (this is handwriting, not الإملاء). Independently assessed: an oral performance test (respond, name, ask, answer) plus a short copying/labelling paper. The oral component carries the greater weight and must not be quietly dropped for administrative convenience.

OVERRIDE of the submitted 'الكلمات'. The unit of work at G3 is the SENTENCE, not the word. A child who has decoded for two full years can already read words; holding him at word level for a third year wastes the year and is the first link in the chain that produces the G6 collapse. Content: four skills formally separated in the lesson plan. Reading vocalised paragraphs of 3-5 sentences with comprehension questions answered orally and then in writing. Writing full sentences from picture and question prompts. الإملاء begins مضمّن here (per accepted redline 7, hosted by this subject): dictation of known words, اللام الشمسية والقمرية، التاء المربوطة والمفتوحة، الهمزة في أول الكلمة، التنوين. Listening to a short read-aloud narrative and retelling it. Target ~600-800 words. Yoruba/English still permitted sparingly for glossing.

gradeByGrade.text: قصص النبيين للأطفال (graded reader, NOT a matn)
gradeByGrade.content: OVERRIDE of 'المفردات والجمل القصيرة' — that is a G2-G3 description. G4 works at paragraph level. Connected texts of 6-12 sentences read with inferential as well as literal comprehension. A graded narrative reader is introduced for volume — reading QUANTITY is the variable that separates L2 learners who become readers from those who do not, and it costs nothing but shelf stock. Verb tense used and understood (ذهب / يذهب / اذهب) without the terms الماضي/المضارع being made the object of study. Guided writing of 3-5 sentence paragraphs. إملاء منظور then إملاء اختباري. Target ~1,000 words. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] From G4 the اللغة العربية lesson is conducted in Arabic; Yoruba and English are withdrawn as the language of instruction in this subject. This is the single highest-leverage decision in the whole subject and it must be made at G4, not later — by G5 the class has learned that the teacher will always translate, and that habit is very hard to break.

gradeByGrade.text: قصص النبيين للأطفال (continuation)
gradeByGrade.content: PROTECTED from the submission: the submission's own decision to place النحو والصرف مضمّن with independent assessment at G5 is exactly right and must be defended. But the surrounding language description ('المفردات والجمل البسيطة') is overridden. G5 is the pivot year. Functional grammar taught inside the language lesson, through sentences, with no إعراب formalism and NO matn: الاسم والفعل والحرف، الجملة الاسمية والجملة الفعلية، المبتدأ والخبر، الفعل والفاعل، الضمائر المنفصلة والمتصلة، المفرد والمثنى والجمع، التذكير والتأنيث، الماضي والمضارع والأمر، and the three recognition patterns فَعَلَ / فاعِل / مَفْعُول. The child must be able to point at a فاعل in a sentence he has never seen before. Reading half-page vocalised texts. Writing a coherent paragraph. Target ~1,200-1,500 words. The grammar strand is assessed on its own paper so its outcomes stay traceable when it leaves this subject next year.

gradeByGrade.text: القراءة الراشدة [confidence: uncertain — verify before adoption]
gradeByGrade.content: HARD OVERRIDE. 'المفردات والجمل البسيطة' at G6 is incompatible with the G6 the rest of the submission describes, and this is the central defect in the paper. G6 simultaneously carries الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية and التفسير العملي with rendering into English and Yoruba — five Arabic-text loads — while claiming the student's Arabic is at 'simple sentences'. Both cannot be true. Since the matn progressions are retained by accepted redline 3, the language must rise to meet them. G6 content: النحو and الصرف have LEFT this subject (to الآجرومية and البناء) and must not be taught here in parallel. What remains and narrows: reading vocalised expository prose of 1-2 pages with inferential comprehension; deliberate front-loading of the metalanguage the matns use (باب، فصل، قسم، نوع، علامة، شرط، حكم، ينقسم إلى، يُشترط أن) so that الآجرومية is foreign in one way only — as a discipline — and not doubly foreign as unreadable Arabic as well; التلخيص (summarising a read text in the student's own Arabic); writing a description, a narration and a short letter; a 2-3 minute prepared oral presentation. Target ~1,800-2,000 words. EXIT STANDARD for G6, non-negotiable: the student reads a vocalised expository paragraph he has not seen before and answers questions on it in Arabic. If he cannot, الآجرومية is being memorised, not learned.

gradeByGrade.text: القراءة الراشدة [uncertain] / in-house مختارات
gradeByGrade.content: The submission leaves G7 unspecified for this subject; filled here. Longer texts; controlled first exposure to partially unvocalised writing (ḥarakāt retained only on ambiguous or unfamiliar words). التلخيص and إعادة الصياغة. The argumentative paragraph (claim + reason + example) as a new written form. Register awareness: the difference between how a matn writes, how a story writes, and how a person speaks. Dictionary skills — الكشف في المعجم بالجذر — placed HERE and not earlier because لامية الأفعال and الصرف at G7 are what first make the root visible to the student; the two interlock and the competency is only teachable once root awareness exists. This single skill converts the student from teacher-dependent to text-independent and is worth more than any additional grammar. Target ~2,500 words.

gradeByGrade.text: in-house مختارات نثرية غير مشكولة
gradeByGrade.content: The unvocalised transition year, and it deserves a whole year to itself. Reading unvocalised expository prose, with vowelling supplied only for proper nouns and genuine ambiguity, withdrawn progressively across the three terms. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] This is harder for a Yoruba-speaking learner than for an Arabophone one and the reason is specific: Yoruba orthography is transparent and marks its vowels and tones, so the student has no L1 experience whatsoever of reading with information deliberately omitted. He needs taught strategies — predicting from root, from pattern, from syntactic position — not just practice. A required extensive reading programme with a stated page count per term. Note-taking from spoken Arabic (a lecture, a khutbah). Multi-paragraph composition with a planning stage. Target ~3,000-3,500 words.

Terminal year as a general language subject; everything here is aimed at the handover. Independent reading of unvocalised authentic prose, both classical and modern. Essays of 500-800 words, planned, drafted and corrected. Listening comprehension from continuous spoken Arabic with note-taking. A formal oral examination as a distinct assessment component. Target ~4,000-5,000 words including the religious-technical register. EXIT STANDARD, and it is the gate for the whole secondary stage: the student reads an unseen unvocalised page of expository Arabic and reports its content accurately in Arabic, orally and in writing, without the teacher voicing it for him. A student who cannot do this at the end of G9 cannot study أصول الفقه or نخبة الفكر at G10-G11 in any real sense, and the board should treat failure here as a retention/intervention trigger, not a grade to be waved through.

The general language subject has finished its work; what continues is one named, traceable strand inside the literature subject: المطالعة الموسّعة — extensive independent reading with a reading log, and oral and written response. Deliberately kept broader than the literary canon (including non-literary and expository Arabic) so the pairing does not narrow the student's reading diet to أدب alone. Its outcomes are recorded and reported separately from the literary-critical outcomes, which is what مدمج requires. RISK TO WATCH, and it is a real one: in every school where a skills strand is paired with a content subject, the content subject eats the strand. The separate assessment record is the only thing that prevents it, so it is not optional bookkeeping.

وحدة اللغة العربية المعاصرة — one term, bounded, with a defined beginning and end. This unit exists for one reason the other twenty-five subjects do not serve: the school's international ambition. Every other Arabic contact the student has from G6 onward is in the classical and religious register. A graduate presenting at Madinah, al-Azhar, or any international Arabic examination also needs the contemporary register — journalistic and academic Arabic, the modern lexicon (اقتصاد، تقرير، مؤتمر، دراسة، بحث), broadcast listening, and the specific conventions of a proficiency examination. Placed at G11 and not G12 so that results return in time to act on before exit, and not earlier because the underlying reading competence is only secure from G9.

Not taught as a distinct entity, and this is the correct outcome rather than an omission. By G12 Arabic is not a subject in the timetable; it is the medium in which أصول الفقه، البلاغة، مصطلح الحديث، أصول التفسير، النقد والآداب، الإنشاء والخطابة and the Islamic sciences are taught, read and examined. A general 'Arabic lesson' sitting beside البلاغة and النقد والآداب and الإنشاء والخطابة at G12 would duplicate all three and would take periods from disciplines that genuinely need them. ASSESSMENT SURVIVES THE FORM, which is precisely the orthogonality the board asked for: a comprehensive Arabic proficiency examination across reading, listening, speaking and writing is sat as part of the G12 exit profile, certifying the competence built G1-G9 and maintained since, and candidates may additionally be entered for an external instrument. Form '—', independently assessed.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
This subject differentiates in the opposite direction from every other subject on the register, and the board should not read its entry as if it behaved like the others. اللغة العربية is not a discipline that emerges out of a parent block — it IS the parent block. It is a distinct named entity from G1, and النحو، الصرف، الإملاء، الإنشاء والخطابة، البلاغة، العروض، النقد والآداب and الترجمة all differentiate OUT OF IT over twelve years. So the analytically meaningful event for this subject is not its birth but its point of maximal narrowing, and that is G6.

WHY G6: الآجرومية arrives at G6 and البناء في الصرف arrives at G6 (both retained by accepted redline 3). From the moment a matn-based النحو subject exists on the timetable, continuing to teach grammar inside اللغة العربية is straight duplication and, worse, it teaches two incompatible grammars — a functional one in the language lesson and a definitional one in the matn — to the same child in the same week. At G6 اللغة العربية sheds grammar entirely and is redefined as the comprehension-and-production subject whose job is to make the matns readable.

WHY NOT G5: because at G5 there is no matn yet, and the functional grammar taught مضمّن inside the language lesson at G5 is exactly what makes G6 survivable. الآجرومية opens with definitions — الكلام هو اللفظ المركب المفيد بالوضع، أقسامه ثلاثة: اسم وفعل وحرف. A student who has spent G5 identifying اسم، فعل، حرف، مبتدأ، خبر، فاعل in live sentences meets those definitions as names for things he already recognises. A student who has not, meets them as sounds. Moving the handoff to G5 removes precisely the year that makes the matn teachable.

WHY NOT G7: because by G7 ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال are already running. If اللغة العربية still carried grammar through G6, the student would meet الآجرومية cold, spend G6 failing it, and then be handed a harder matn. The handoff must sit exactly on the G5→G6 boundary — one year of functional grammar, then out.

A second, smaller differentiation event, recorded for completeness: الإملاء is claimed by this subject from G3 as a مضمّن strand under accepted redline 7 and is never released, because it has no independent life as a timetable subject.
prerequisites: Normal L1 (Yoruba) oral development and school readiness — assumed at entry, G1. اللغة العربية is the entry subject of Programme 2 and deliberately presupposes no Arabic.

Letter-sound decoding of fully vocalised Arabic script — established by القراءة والتهجي, G1-G2, reinforced through G3. اللغة العربية must never ask a child to read a form القراءة والتهجي has not yet given him; the two syllabi are synchronised week by week, and this is a scheduling obligation on both subjects, not a wish.

Accurate articulation of the Arabic phonemes absent from Yoruba and English — ع ح خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق ذ ث — established by practical التجويد مضمّن inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour from G1. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] This is a substantial free gift from the institution's own design that the submission does not name: in most Arabic-as-L2 settings the language teacher has to build this phonology himself and it consumes months. Here 195 hours a year of supervised recitation does it. اللغة العربية should assume it and not rebuild it.
Arabic handwriting — letter formation and accurate copying. Claimed by this subject from G2 unless الخط exists as a separate register entry. Prerequisite for any written assessment from G3.
Fluent oral reading of vocalised connected text at phrase level — established by القراءة والتهجي by end of G3. Prerequisite for the paragraph-level work at G4.

A working productive vocabulary of roughly 1,000 words — established by اللغة العربية itself at G4. Prerequisite for the functional grammar of G5, because grammar taught on words the child does not know is grammar taught on nothing.

Functional grammar: اسم/فعل/حرف، الجملة الاسمية والفعلية، المبتدأ والخبر، الفعل والفاعل، الضمائر، الإفراد والتثنية والجمع، التذكير والتأنيث، الماضي والمضارع والأمر — established by اللغة العربية itself at G5 (مضمّن). Prerequisite for الآجرومية and البناء في الصرف at G6.
Root awareness (الجذر الثلاثي) and basic pattern recognition — established by الصرف at G6-G7 (البناء في الصرف, لامية الأفعال). Prerequisite for dictionary skills, which اللغة العربية teaches at G7.

Reading of vocalised expository prose with inferential comprehension — established by اللغة العربية at G6. Prerequisite for the unvocalised transition at G8 and, more urgently, for every matn-based subject from G6 onward.

Independent reading of unvocalised authentic prose — established by اللغة العربية at G8-G9. Prerequisite for the entire secondary stage: أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث (نخبة الفكر)، أصول التفسير، البلاغة، النقد والآداب all assume it from G10.

classicalTexts.title: NO classical matn is assigned to this subject at any grade — a stated principle, not an omission
classicalTexts.justification: [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] A متن is a compressed mnemonic for a discipline the student is already meeting; it presupposes the language, it does not teach it. Assigning one to اللغة العربية is the same category error that put نخبة الفكر beside الآجرومية at G6 and was correctly redlined out. اللغة العربية needs graded, four-skills, frequency-controlled teaching material written for non-native learners, plus volume of graded reading. The matns belong to النحو، الصرف، البلاغة and العروض, and this subject should be protected from the recurring institutional pressure to give it one so that it 'looks serious'.

classicalTexts.title: العربية بين يديك
classicalTexts.grade: Proposed spine, G1-G7 (adapted and re-sequenced, not followed page by page)
classicalTexts.justification: A four-skills communicative series for non-native learners, which is the correct genre for this subject and this setting. I am confident the series exists as named; it is associated with عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم الفوزان and colleagues, and I am slightly less certain of the full authorship list than of the title. It suits the G1-G4 oral-first design better than any grammar-syllabus series, because it front-loads listening and speaking. It must be re-sequenced, not adopted whole: its lexical fields assume an Arab or Gulf-resident child and will need Yoruba-context substitution.

classicalTexts.title: دروس اللغة العربية لغير الناطقين بها (the Madinah series)
classicalTexts.grade: Reference and reinforcement, G3-G7 — not the spine
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident this series exists as named and is by د. ف. عبد الرحيم (V. Abdur Rahim). Its virtue is rigorous grammatical grading; its limitation for SHRS is that it is a grammar syllabus in reading clothing and gives almost nothing to listening and speaking, which are exactly the skills a Yoruba-speaking learner will otherwise never acquire. Use it as the structured reinforcement stream behind a communicative spine, and use it especially at G5-G6 where it aligns well with the functional grammar and then with الآجرومية.

classicalTexts.title: قصص النبيين للأطفال
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident this work exists and is by أبو الحسن علي الندوي. It is graded Arabic narrative written deliberately for young non-Arab learners, with content that is religiously congruent so it earns its place twice. Its function here is reading VOLUME, not intensive study — the variable that most separates L2 learners who become readers from those who stall. It is a reader, not a matn, and must not be examined as content.

classicalTexts.title: القراءة الراشدة
classicalTexts.justification: I believe a graded Arabic reader of this title exists and is associated with the Nadwatul Ulama tradition in India, but I am NOT confident of the compiler or of the exact edition, and I will not guess. The board must inspect a physical copy and confirm title, compiler and level before adoption. If it cannot be verified, drop it and compile in-house مختارات instead — nothing in this design depends on it.

classicalTexts.title: النظرات / العبرات (مصطفى لطفي المنفلوطي)
classicalTexts.grade: Sampled only, G9 — a few pieces
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident both works exist and are by مصطفى لطفي المنفلوطي, and their accessible unvocalised prose suits the G9 transition. But they sit closer to النقد والآداب than to this subject, so اللغة العربية should sample two or three pieces as unvocalised reading practice and leave the literary-critical treatment to that subject. Flagged to the النقد والآداب specialist to avoid a collision.
