classicalTexts.title: General caveat on all of the above
classicalTexts.justification: My confidence ratings concern whether these works EXIST AS NAMED, and nothing more. They are not endorsements, and no scholar, university or ministry has approved this list. Physical copies must be inspected and levelled against the grade descriptors above before any of them is placed on a requisition.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Specific to this subject and this cohort, not generic:

1. THE SUBMITTED G1-G2 CONTENT IS ITSELF THE PREMATURE-INTRODUCTION RISK. Putting الحروف into اللغة العربية at G1-G2 when القراءة والتهجي already owns them means the child traces letters twice and finishes G2 unable to produce a spoken sentence. The cost is not the duplicated periods; it is the permanent loss of the ages 6-7 oral window in an environment with no ambient Arabic to recover it from.

2. Formal grammatical terminology before G5 produces metalanguage with no referent. A G3 child drilled on المبتدأ مرفوع can recite the rule and cannot find a مبتدأ in an unseen sentence. Worse, it inoculates him: when الآجرومية says the same thing properly at G6 he believes he already knows it and stops attending.

3. Written composition before decoding is automatic (before end G3) produces copying dressed as writing, and it teaches the child that writing means reproducing the board.

4. Unvocalised text before G8 is the most damaging of the early errors here, and the reason is specific to Yoruba speakers: Yoruba orthography is transparent and marks vowels and tones, so the learner has no L1 experience of reading with information deliberately withheld. Faced with unvowelled Arabic too early he guesses from shape, the guesses go uncorrected because they are often semantically plausible, and the mis-parsing habit persists into the secondary years where it silently corrupts his reading of فقه and أصول texts.

5. Turning the Arabic lesson into a religious-content lesson too early (the natural drift at G4-G6, because the Arabic teacher in an Islamic school reaches for the material he knows) narrows the lexicon to the devotional register. The student can read a page of فقه and cannot read a newspaper paragraph, a letter, or an academic abstract — which closes off exactly the international pathways the school wants open.

6. Beginning الترجمة inside this subject before G6, or allowing translation to become the routine method of the Arabic lesson at any grade, converts اللغة العربية into a Yoruba/English lesson about Arabic. Accepted redline 8 correctly gives الترجمة its own home at G6; اللغة العربية must stay in Arabic from G4.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
The delay risk is not hypothetical here. IT IS THE SUBMISSION AS WRITTEN, and this is the finding I would put first on the board's agenda.

1. THE G6 CONTRADICTION. The submission states اللغة العربية at G5 and G6 is 'المفردات والجمل البسيطة' — vocabulary and simple sentences — while the same G6 carries الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية, and التفسير العملي rendered into English and Yoruba. A student at 'simple sentences' cannot read الآجرومية. Both statements cannot be true of the same child in the same year. Since accepted redline 3 retains the matn progressions, the resolution must come from this subject: the language trajectory must be re-engineered so that the G6 student reads unseen vocalised expository prose with comprehension. If it is not, the failure mode is entirely predictable and is the standard failure of Arabic instruction across West Africa — the matns are memorised in Arabic and explained in Yoruba, the student can recite الكلام هو اللفظ المركب المفيد بالوضع and cannot use it, and the certificate at the end certifies recitation. Six years of ring-fenced Qur'an hours and nineteen periods a week would have produced a student who cannot read Arabic.

2. Delaying spoken fluency past G4. There is no ambient recovery in a Yoruba-speaking region. If the student does not speak Arabic by the end of the ابتدائية he will not speak it at all, and Arabic becomes for him a decoding-and-glossing skill rather than a language. This directly defeats the international ambition: a graduate arriving at Madinah or al-Azhar with strong text skills and no speech cannot follow a lecture, cannot ask a question, and cannot sit an oral examination, whatever his matn inventory.

3. Delaying the unvocalised transition past G9 caps the entire secondary stage at the teacher's voice. أصول الفقه، البلاغة، نخبة الفكر and أصول التفسير at G10-G12 all assume the student can read the text himself. If he cannot, every one of those subjects silently becomes dictation-and-explanation, they all slow to the same pace, and the G10-G12 timetable cannot deliver what it promises no matter how it is allocated.

4. Delaying sustained productive writing past G6 leaves الإنشاء والخطابة with no foundation whenever it begins. A student who has never written a planned paragraph cannot be taught to compose an address.

5. Delaying the modern register past G11 makes external proficiency certification impossible, and with it any externally legible claim about the graduate's Arabic.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 اللغة العربية has no timetabled form, and that is the mark of success rather than of neglect. Its function — carrying a Yoruba-speaking child from no Arabic to autonomous comprehension and production of unvocalised standard Arabic — is complete at the end of G9, maintained through G10 inside النقد والآداب and extended by the G11 modern-register unit. By G12 Arabic is not a subject; it is the medium in which أصول الفقه، البلاغة، مصطلح الحديث، أصول التفسير، النقد والآداب، الإنشاء والخطابة and the Islamic sciences are taught, read, discussed and examined. Retaining a general 'Arabic lesson' at G12 beside البلاغة، النقد والآداب and الإنشاء والخطابة would duplicate all three and take periods from disciplines that are still building.

The assessment does not disappear with the form. A comprehensive Arabic proficiency examination — reading, listening, speaking, writing — is sat as part of the G12 exit profile, and this subject owns the exit standard even though it owns no periods.

WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO BECAUSE OF THIS SUBJECT: read an unvocalised page of classical or modern Arabic prose at reading speed, opening a dictionary only for technical terms, and know how to open it — by root. Sit in an Arabic lecture or khutbah, follow it, and take notes in Arabic. Hold a sustained spoken conversation, answer an unprepared question, and be examined orally. Write several connected pages of controlled Arabic prose — a research paper, a formal letter, an essay — that an Arab reader would accept as written by someone educated rather than as translated. Read a contemporary Arabic newspaper or academic article, not only turāth. And present a certified proficiency result to an institution outside Nigeria.

That last item is the difference between a graduate who has studied Arabic texts and a graduate who has Arabic.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the [RECOVERED] ceiling of 19 periods/week at G3-G12 and 7 at G1-G2, with the 195-hour Qur'an hour ring-fenced and outside these figures.

G1-G2: 3 of 7. This is ~43% of the entire non-Qur'an budget for the youngest learners and I am asking for it deliberately. At the تمهيدي stage اللغة العربية and القراءة والتهجي together ARE Programme 2, and everything from G3 to G12 is built on what happens in these two years. Indicative G1-G2 fit: اللغة العربية 3 + القراءة والتهجي 3 + 1 shared practical block = 7 exactly. There is no slack; anything added at G1-G2 comes out of one of these three.

G3-G5: 5 of 19. Indicative fit at G5: اللغة العربية 5 + القراءة والتهجي 3 + تحفة الأطفال 2 + التوحيد والعقيدة 3 + الفقه والسيرة 2 + الحديث 1 + النشيد 1 = 17, leaving 2. Fits with margin.

G6-G8: 4 of 19. Indicative fit at G6: اللغة العربية 4 + الجزرية 2 + التفسير العملي/الترجمة 2 + النحو (الآجرومية) 2 + الصرف (البناء) 2 + التوحيد والعقيدة 2 + الفقه والسيرة 2 + النشيد 1 = 17, leaving 2. This is the tightest year in the ladder. I have checked it deliberately: 4 fits, 5 does not — asking for 5 at G6 would force something else off the timetable, and I am not asking for it. The drop from 5 to 4 at G6 is affordable only because النحو and الصرف leave this subject that year and take their content with them.

G9: 3 of 19, releasing periods as البلاغة، أصول الفقه and مصطلح الحديث enter the الإعدادية/ثانوية boundary. Terminal year of the subject proper.

G10: 2 of 19, and these 2 belong to the النقد والآداب allocation rather than being additional — the language strand is carried inside that pairing, not alongside it. Net new cost to the G10 timetable: zero.

G11: 2 of 19 FOR ONE TERM ONLY. Net annual cost roughly 0.7 of a period-slot.

G12: 0 periods. The exit examination is an assessment-calendar item, not a timetable item.

Total trajectory: 3 / 3 / 5 / 5 / 5 / 4 / 4 / 4 / 3 / 2 (shared) / 2 (one term) / 0. Every figure has been checked against a full indicative allocation for its grade, not asserted.
departuresFromSubmission: G1-G2 content overridden: الحروف is removed from اللغة العربية entirely. القراءة والتهجي already owns the letter-sound system at G1-G2 with its own book and its own independent assessment; running letters in both is duplication, and it burns the only window in which spoken Arabic is cheap for an L2 learner with no ambient Arabic. اللغة العربية at G1-G2 is oral: listening and speaking, zero letters.

G3 'الكلمات' overridden. The unit of work at G3 is the sentence. A child who has decoded for two years can already read words; a third year at word level is a wasted year and is the first link in the chain that produces the G6 contradiction.
G4 'المفردات والجمل القصيرة' overridden to paragraph-level reading, a graded reader for volume, and guided paragraph writing.

G5-G6 'المفردات والجمل البسيطة' overridden in the strongest terms. This is the submission's central defect regarding my subject. G5 must reach connected paragraphs plus the functional grammar the submission itself correctly places there; G6 must reach comprehension of unseen vocalised expository prose. Anything less and the retained G6 matn programme — الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية، التفسير العملي with two-language rendering — cannot be delivered as anything but memorisation with Yoruba explanation.

The submission marks القراءة والتهجي as 'مدمج' without naming the partner, which the board's own form vocabulary requires (مدمج = combined with ONE NAMED partner). Named here: القراءة والتهجي is مدمج with اللغة العربية at G1-G5, taught by one teacher in one block, with two traceable strands and two separate assessment records. اللغة العربية is the host and remains مستقل.

اللغة العربية TERMINATES as a general subject at the end of G9 — the submission designs no G8-G12 and this is a decision the board has not yet been asked to make. It does not run to G12. Two named residuals only: مدمج with النقد والآداب at G10, and a one-term وحدة at G11. G12 is '—'.

G12 carries an independent Arabic exit certification despite having no instructional form. This is a deliberate use of the board's own orthogonality principle and I want it recorded as such rather than read as an inconsistency.
اللغة العربية claims الإملاء as a مضمّن strand from G3 (this follows accepted redline 7 rather than departing from it) and claims الكتابة/handwriting from G2, which the submission assigns to no one.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION, flagged for other specialists] I propose that the اللغة العربية oral lesson is the مضمّن host for التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي at G1-G2. The submission describes الفقه التطبيقي at G1 as pictures, gestures, practical situations and vocabulary — which is an oral-language lesson with fiqh content. Content-based language teaching serves both subjects at no extra cost within the 7-period ceiling. The الفقه and التوحيد specialists must agree; I cannot assign their subjects a home unilaterally.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] From G4 the اللغة العربية lesson is conducted in Arabic, with Yoruba and English withdrawn as the language of instruction in this subject. The submission is silent on this. It is the single highest-leverage decision in the subject and it must be taken at G4 — by G5 the class has learned that the teacher always translates, and that expectation is very hard to reverse.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5): decoding of vocalised script. Strict boundary — اللغة العربية never teaches letter-sound correspondence and never asks a child to read a form القراءة والتهجي has not yet given him. The two syllabi must be synchronised week by week, which is a scheduling obligation on both.

FED BY practical التجويد مضمّن inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour (G1 onward): accurate articulation of ع ح خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق ذ ث, phonemes absent from Yoruba and English. This is a large free asset from the institution's own design. اللغة العربية assumes it and does not rebuild it.

FED BY حفظ القرآن (G1-G12), but with a caution the board should hear precisely. 195 hours a year is by far the largest Arabic input in the school — and by design it is input WITHOUT comprehension. It supplies phonology, prosody and a lexical reservoir; it does not supply meaning. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] اللغة العربية should deliberately harvest it: sequence high-frequency Qur'anic vocabulary from the جزء the class is currently memorising into the G3-G7 lexical syllabus, so that text already in the child's mouth becomes comprehensible retroactively. This costs zero periods and is the largest free gain available anywhere in Programme 2. The controlling rule: the teaching unit stays the language item, never the verse's meaning — the moment it becomes the verse's meaning, this is تفسير and belongs to another subject.

FEEDS النحو (G6+) and الصرف (G6+) and must not duplicate them. اللغة العربية carries functional grammar مضمّن at G5 ONLY, hands it over cleanly at the G5→G6 boundary, and runs no parallel grammar syllabus thereafter. Two competing grammars taught to one child in one week is worse than either alone.

FEEDS الترجمة (G6+, accepted redline 8) and must not become it. الترجمة has its own home in التفسير العملي; اللغة العربية stays in Arabic from G4. If translation becomes the routine method of the Arabic lesson, the Arabic lesson has stopped existing.

FEEDS الإنشاء والخطابة. اللغة العربية builds the written paragraph (G4), the summary (G6), the argumentative paragraph (G7), the planned multi-paragraph composition (G8) and the 500-800 word essay (G9). الإنشاء والخطابة should begin only after the planned composition is in place, and should take rhetorical shaping and oral delivery — not sentence construction, which is finished business by then.

FEEDS البلاغة. البلاغة is unteachable to a student who cannot already feel that two Arabic sentences saying the same thing say it differently. That sensitivity is built by the G8-G9 extensive reading, not by البلاغة itself. The grade البلاغة begins is a dependency I am flagging rather than deciding.

FEEDS النقد والآداب, and merges partly into it at G10. Boundary at G10: اللغة العربية contributes المطالعة الموسّعة as a separately assessed strand; النقد والآداب owns the literary-critical apparatus. The strand's separate assessment record is what keeps it from being absorbed.

FEEDS every text-based subject in Programme 3 from G6 onward — الأخضري، الحديث، التفسير، العقيدة، السيرة — and from G10, أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث (نخبة الفكر)، أصول التفسير، المنطق. All of these assume a reading competence only this subject builds. The G6 exit standard and the G9 exit standard are effectively gates on those subjects' feasibility and should be reported to their specialists as such.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE Programme 3 content. The strongest drift pressure on this subject, from G6 onward, is for the Arabic teacher in an Islamic school to fill the Arabic lesson with fiqh and hadith texts — familiar material, defensible-sounding. It duplicates Programme 3, it starves the language subject of general-register input, and it produces a graduate who can read الأخضري and not a newspaper. The lesson's reading diet must be audited for register breadth, not only for level.

MUST NOT ABSORB النشيد والمحفوظات, but should exploit it. Memorised verse — the ديوان الشافعي and لامية ابن الوردي material at G6-G7 — is a vocabulary and syntax reservoir already in the student's memory. اللغة العربية may draw on it for lexis and structure; it does not teach it, assess it, or claim its periods.

MUST NOT be confused with الإملاء. الإملاء has no independent timetable life (accepted redline 7); it is a مضمّن strand inside this subject from G3, with its own traceable outcomes: اللام الشمسية والقمرية، التاء المربوطة والمفتوحة، الهمزة بأنواعها، الألف اللينة، التنوين.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Which subject hosts التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي مضمّن at G1-G2? I propose the اللغة العربية oral lesson, because the submission's own description of الفقه التطبيقي at G1 (pictures, gestures, practical situations, vocabulary) is a description of an oral-language lesson. The الفقه and التوحيد specialists must consent — I cannot assign another discipline its home.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does الخط (handwriting) exist as an entry in the 26-subject register? I was not given the full register. If it does not, اللغة العربية claims letter formation and copying from G2. If it does, the boundary between الخط، الإملاء and اللغة العربية must be drawn before G2 materials are written.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] At which grade does البلاغة begin? My G9 allocation of 3 periods assumes it enters at G9 or G10. If it enters at G8, اللغة العربية must drop to 3 at G8 as well and the G8 unvocalised transition loses a period it cannot easily spare.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Should a single 1-period maintenance slot be retained at G12? My recommendation is no — by G12 Arabic is the medium and البلاغة، النقد والآداب and الإنشاء والخطابة cover the residual ground. The board should know the trade-off it is accepting: no timetabled subject at G12 has general language competence as its explicit charge, and if the G9 exit standard is not being reliably met, that gap becomes real. Revisit after the first cohort reaches G9.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — and this one can invalidate the whole design] Can SHRS staff Arabic-as-a-second-language oral methodology at G1-G4? Everything above depends on a G1-G2 teacher who can run a 40-minute lesson entirely in spoken Arabic with six-year-olds, and on a G4 teacher who can hold the Arabic-only line under parental pressure to translate. This is a staffing and teacher-development decision, not a curricular one, and no amount of syllabus design substitutes for it. If the staffing is not there, the honest response is to phase the design in from G1 as capacity is built, not to publish it and let it fail quietly.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Which external Arabic proficiency instrument for the G11 وحدة and the G12 exit certification? I am deliberately not naming one: I am not confident enough about the current availability, recognition and Nigerian test-centre access of any specific named examination to put it in a governing document, and a wrong name here would be acted on. The registrar should verify what is actually sittable in Nigeria and what Madinah, al-Azhar and comparable destinations actually recognise, then report back.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] At G10, does the language strand pair with النقد والآداب or with الإنشاء والخطابة? I have chosen النقد والآداب because reading volume is the residual need and literature supplies text. The counter-argument is real: النقد والآداب will tend to absorb the strand, whereas الإنشاء والخطابة would keep it productive. Either is defensible; the separate assessment record matters more than the choice.

[OPEN — verification] القراءة الراشدة must be physically verified (title, compiler, level) before it appears on any requisition. Nothing in this design depends on it; if it cannot be confirmed, compile in-house مختارات instead. I will not guess at its authorship.

[OPEN — measurement] The vocabulary targets given per grade (~300 at G2 rising to ~4,000-5,000 by G9) are [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] planning figures derived from general second-language reading requirements, not findings about Arabic learners in Yoruba-speaking Nigeria, of which I know no reliable study. They should be treated as a design hypothesis and tested against the first cohort's actual attainment at G3 and G6, then revised. If the G6 figure proves unreachable at 4 periods a week, the board faces a genuine choice between adding periods and moving الآجرومية — and it should face it with data rather than at the point of failure.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G5, مضمّن inside اللغة العربية. For النحو, "meaningful" has a hard test: the learner can make a syntactic judgement about a sentence whose meaning they already grasp WITHOUT translating it into Yoruba or English, and be right or wrong for a statable reason. Anything earlier than that is definition-recitation — the child can say "الفاعل هو الاسم المرفوع المذكور قبله فعله" and still cannot point to the فاعل in فتحَ اللهُ البابَ. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] There is a second, institution-specific reason G5 is the floor and not earlier: Yoruba has no case system and no grammatical gender, and English marks no case on nouns. The concept of الإعراب — that the END of a word changes according to its POSITION and that the change carries meaning — has no L1 or L2 analogue for these learners. It cannot be transferred; it must be constructed. Constructing it requires a stock of sentences the learner already understands, which اللغة العربية only delivers at G5 (الجمل البسيطة). The construction work IS the G5 embedded year, and the submission is right to place something there. It is wrong about what that something is.

gradeByGrade.content: النحو is not taught in any form. The substrate is being laid elsewhere and must not be labelled النحو: القراءة والتهجي builds letter-and-syllable decoding; اللغة العربية teaches الحروف وقليل المفردات. The only نحو-relevant exposure is receptive and oral — the child hears fully and correctly voweled Arabic sentences in the ring-fenced Qur'an hour and in classroom routine. At a 7-period ceiling, any period given to نحو is a period taken directly from decoding, which is the one thing that cannot be recovered later.

Still absent. اللغة العربية moves to الحروف والمفردات. Oral sentence frames (هذا كتابٌ / هذه مدرسةٌ) are used as LANGUAGE, never as grammar: the teacher models and the child imitates; no word is named اسم or فعل, no ending is explained. Deliberate instruction: teachers are to voice final حركات correctly and consistently in all classroom Arabic, because the ear is laying the data that G5 will name.

Still absent. اللغة العربية: الكلمات. The child begins to notice, through use only, that هذا and هذه select different words, and that words have singular and plural shapes. This is pattern-noticing, not النحو, and must not be given terminology. Competing load at G3 is real: القراءة والتهجي is still independently assessed and النشيد والمحفوظات begins. النحو claims nothing here.

Deliberately still absent — this is a NEW ENGINEERING DECISION against the temptation to ramp early. G4 is التجويد's differentiation year (تحفة الأطفال becomes مستقل and independently assessed); a second new named strand competes with it. Instead, اللغة العربية at G4 carries three named substrate obligations that النحو will cash at G5: (1) reading a full voweled short sentence fluently, with the final حركة voiced; (2) sorting words by what they DO in use — naming a thing vs reporting an action — with no terminology attached; (3) using the two sentence shapes by pattern. A specific institutional warning belongs at this grade: these children recite Qur'an daily with accurate endings, and a G4 teacher can easily mistake that fluency for grammatical readiness. Recitation accuracy is transmitted, not analysed. It is not evidence.

First meaningful appearance. Embedded in اللغة العربية (NOT paired with الصرف — see departures). Content is strictly functional and pre-terminological in ordering — the thing first, its name second: أقسام الكلمة (اسم، فعل، حرف) taught by the Ājurrūmiyyah's own علامات in working form (تنوين، الألف واللام، حروف الخفض for the اسم; قد، السين، سوف، تاء التأنيث الساكنة for the فعل), sorted from sentences the class already understands; الجملة الاسمية والجملة الفعلية by shape; الفاعل and المفعول به identified first by function (who did it / what it was done to) and only then by ضمة and فتحة; المبتدأ والخبر; and the pivotal concept — the last حركة of a word changes with its position and the change is the meaning — demonstrated on Qur'anic sentences the class has already memorised. Explicitly EXCLUDED at G5: الإعراب والبناء as theory, علامات الإعراب الفرعية, تقدير, المعربات بالحروف, any إعراب written out in full formula. Independently assessed (orthogonal to the embedded form) because the ladder to G12 has no slack and the school must know at the end of G5 whether G6 can safely open a matn. The assessment is performance-based: identify اسم/فعل/حرف in an unseen voweled sentence; name the doer and the thing done to; read the sentence aloud with correct endings; write one correct sentence with agreement. Not: recite a definition.

gradeByGrade.text: المقدمة الآجرومية
gradeByGrade.content: Differentiation year. Full matn, term-paced: T1 الكلام وأقسامه، الإعراب وأقسامه، علامات الإعراب الأصلية، المعرب بالحركات والمعرب بالحروف، الأفعال ورفع المضارع ونصبه وجزمه. T2 المرفوعات — الفاعل، نائب الفاعل، المبتدأ والخبر، كان وأخواتها، إن وأخواتها، ظن وأخواتها، التوابع الأربعة. T3 المنصوبات والمخفوضات. Method: تعريفات memorised, but every تعريف immediately cashed on a worked sentence drawn from the student's own محفوظ or from التفسير العملي being read the same year. Mandated coordination (not integration): اللغة العربية must have المثنى، جمع المذكر السالم، جمع المؤنث السالم and the الأسماء الخمسة in hand as FORMS before النحو reaches باب المعربات بالحروف in T1, or that باب degrades into an arbitrary list. Independently assessed; threshold is إعراب of a simple unseen voweled sentence naming both the علامة and its سبب. If the timetable yields only 2 periods, المخفوضات may be completed at تعريف level and left for G7's second pass to secure.

gradeByGrade.text: ملحة الإعراب
gradeByGrade.content: Second pass, in verse. ملحة الإعراب is not a level above الآجرومية — it is roughly the same ground re-presented as an أرجوزة with expansion, and its value is exactly that: a second, differently-shaped encounter with material already met, plus a portable memorised reference. This school's students memorise for a living; verse is their cheapest storage medium, and this is the grade to spend that advantage. Expansion beyond الآجرومية: fuller المنصوبات treatment, المعارف والنكرات, some تصريفي matter that must be handed to الصرف rather than taught twice. New and load-bearing at G7: التطبيق الإعرابي على المحفوظ — systematic إعراب of Qur'anic verses the student already holds by heart. This is the point where the constitutionally ring-fenced 195-hour Qur'an hour starts paying a نحو dividend at zero period cost. Independently assessed: حفظ of the أرجوزة (or a defined core — see open questions) plus إعراب of an unseen voweled verse.

gradeByGrade.text: قطر الندى وبل الصدى
gradeByGrade.content: Two things at once. (a) القطر Part 1 with ابن هشام's own شرح as the teacher's spine: الكلمة والكلام، الإعراب والبناء properly theorised for the first time، المعرب والمبني من الأسماء والأفعال، علامات الإعراب الفرعية and their causes، النكرة والمعرفة، المرفوعات revisited at analytic depth. (b) A named وحدة inside النحو: قراءة النص غير المشكول — the deliberate, timetabled crossing from voweled to unvoweled text. This is the single biggest cliff in the whole twelve years and in most madrasah systems it is never scheduled, only hoped for. Method: the same page given first voweled, then stripped, then a fresh unvoweled page; the student vowels it and defends each ending. Corpus drawn from الأخضري and the حديث متون already studied, so the reading load is familiar and only the script is new. Independently assessed, with the وحدة assessed separately from the matn — a student can pass القطر and still fail the unvoweled page, and the school must see that.

gradeByGrade.text: قطر الندى وبل الصدى
gradeByGrade.content: القطر completed: المنصوبات in full (المفعول المطلق، المفعول لأجله، المفعول فيه، المفعول معه، الحال، التمييز، الاستثناء، اسم لا، المنادى)، المجرورات والإضافة، إعمال المصدر واسم الفاعل، إعراب الجمل والمحل من الإعراب. That last chapter is the hinge of the whole discipline for this school: once a student can say whether a جملة occupies a محل, they can parse Qur'anic and حديث prose rather than only clauses. Unvoweled reading is now the default medium of the lesson, not an exercise. End of G9 is the gate: a student who cannot vowel and parse an unseen unvoweled page of الأخضري-level prose is not ready for G10's البلاغة، أصول الفقه or مصطلح الحديث, and the council should treat that as a real readiness check, not a formality.

gradeByGrade.text: ألفية ابن مالك
gradeByGrade.content: الألفية opens, with شرح ابن عقيل as the teacher's reference (أوضح المسالك for ابن هشام's arrangement where a second reading helps). Coverage G10: الكلام وما يتألف منه، المعرب والمبني، النكرة والمعرفة والموصولات، المبتدأ والخبر، كان وأخواتها، إن وأخواتها، لا النافية للجنس، ظن وأخواتها. What changes in KIND at G10 is not the topic list — much of it is third contact — but the object of study: from this grade the student meets الخلاف and التعليل, the نحاة arguing about العامل and التقدير, and learns to follow an argument in the discipline rather than absorb a ruling. That capability is what makes G10-G12 التفسير, أصول الفقه and مصطلح الحديث readable at all. Required حفظ is the أبيات of the أبواب actually covered, not the full thousand. Independently assessed.

gradeByGrade.text: ألفية ابن مالك
gradeByGrade.content: الألفية continued: الفاعل ونائب الفاعل، المفاعيل، الحال، التمييز، الاستثناء، الإضافة، إعمال المصدر واسم الفاعل والصفة المشبهة، التعجب، أفعل التفضيل، النعت والعطف والتوكيد والبدل، العدد. Weight tapers to make room for البلاغة and أصول الفقه, which are now in the timetable and which are themselves consuming نحو. Method shifts toward التطبيق: the week's إعراب set is drawn from the texts being read in OTHER subjects that same term — نخبة الفكر in مصطلح الحديث, the فقه matn, the تفسير passage — so النحو stops generating its own examples and starts servicing the curriculum. Independently assessed.

gradeByGrade.text: ألفية ابن مالك
gradeByGrade.content: Two functions, at reduced weight. (a) Completion of الألفية's remaining أبواب that the school elects to cover — الإضافة to المنادى، الترخيم، الاختصاص، التحذير والإغراء، الوقف — with الإعلال والإبدال والإدغام handed to الصرف, not taught twice. (b) A bounded وحدة in أصول النحو, descriptive and non-polemical: what counts as evidence in this discipline (السماع، القياس، الإجماع، الاستصحاب), what the البصري/الكوفي disagreement actually is, why a نحوي posits a محذوف or a عامل معنوي. Teacher-facing source: السيوطي's الاقتراح. The purpose is not to make grammarians — it is so a graduate reading any شرح in any Islamic science can tell a grammatical argument from a legal or theological one and not be lost. Alongside this, النحو's assessed output at G12 is the graduating performance: an unseen unvoweled printed page, correctly voweled and fully defended. Independently assessed. Whether this survives as مستقل or converts to مضمّن to relieve the G12 timetable is flagged as a council decision — I recommend مستقل.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G6, becoming مستقل with المقدمة الآجرومية as its matn. The reason it is there and nowhere else is specific on both sides. NOT G5: a named subject demands a syllabus, and at G5 the only syllabus النحو could have is definitions — the learner has جمل بسيطة but not the متن register, not the form-knowledge (المثنى، الجموع، الأسماء الخمسة) that باب المعربات بالحروف presupposes, and not yet stable comprehension-without-translation. Naming النحو at G5 therefore forces the teacher onto exactly the failure mode the discipline is most prone to. NOT G7: two reasons. First, arithmetic. The ladder الآجرومية (1 year) + ملحة الإعراب (1) + قطر الندى (2) + الألفية (3) is seven years and there are exactly seven grades from G6 to G12 at 2-3 periods a week. Starting at G7 costs a rung, and the rung that is always dropped is الألفية — the one that actually certifies the graduate. Second, and more importantly, G6 is when the CURRICULUM itself starts handing the student real Arabic prose: التفسير العملي with translation, and الأخضري in فقه. The student meets sentences that simple-sentence strategies no longer decode. النحو differentiates at the precise grade the learner acquires a problem that only النحو solves — and it arrives with peer support, since G6 is the year matn-handling is being established across three programmes at once, not a year النحو has to pioneer alone. [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION on the texts; [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] on the form being مستقل rather than the submitted مدمج.]
prerequisites: Fluent, accurate decoding of fully-voweled Arabic script at SENTENCE length, not word length, with the final حركة voiced. Established by القراءة والتهجي; secure by end of G3, consolidated G4.
A working high-frequency Arabic vocabulary large enough that an example sentence is understood rather than decoded. Established by اللغة العربية (الحروف → المفردات → الجمل القصيرة), by end of G4.

Comprehension of a simple Arabic sentence WITHOUT relay through Yoruba or English. Established by اللغة العربية by end of G4/G5. This is the hardest and most frequently missing prerequisite in non-Arabophone settings, and it is non-negotiable: إعراب performed on a sentence the student does not understand is arithmetic on nonsense, and the habit, once formed, persists into G10-G12 and hollows out التفسير and أصول الفقه.

Awareness that a word's final vowel varies systematically with its position. Supplied jointly by القراءة والتهجي and by daily recitation in the ring-fenced Qur'an hour (G1 onward); explicitly named and made an object of attention at G5. Note this has no L1/L2 analogue — Yoruba has no case and no grammatical gender, English marks no noun case — so it is built, not transferred.

Ability to write a short voweled Arabic sentence from dictation, including the حركات. Established longitudinally through الإملاء inside اللغة العربية (redline 7) by end of G4. Required because the written حركة IS the evidence of the analysis; a student who cannot write حركات cannot be assessed in النحو.

Familiarity with the register of classical matn — definitional prose and rajaz verse. Established by النشيد والمحفوظات from G3 and by تحفة الأطفال at G4-G5. Required before الآجرومية opens at G6, otherwise the matn's language is a second obstacle stacked on the grammar.

Recognition of المثنى، جمع المذكر السالم، جمع المؤنث السالم and الأسماء الخمسة as FORMS. Established by اللغة العربية at G5 as vocabulary patterning; needed within G6 Term 1, before النحو reaches المعربات بالحروف. This is an intra-year sequencing constraint, not an inter-year one, and must appear in the scheme of work.

A corpus of memorised, fully-voweled, syntactically varied Arabic sentences to analyse. Supplied continuously and at no period cost by the ring-fenced حفظ hour; sufficient in volume from G6, exploited systematically from G7. This is the institution's structural advantage over a conventional school and the design should be built to spend it.

classicalTexts.title: المقدمة الآجرومية — ابن آجروم الصنهاجي
classicalTexts.justification: The standard beginner matn: short, prose, architecturally complete (الكلام، الإعراب، المعربات، الأفعال، المرفوعات، المنصوبات، المخفوضات). Its completeness is precisely why النحو can be مستقل at G6 — it supplies a planned progression, not a topic list. Retained by accepted redline 3 and protected here without reservation. Teacher's شرح: التحفة السنية لمحمد محيي الدين عبد الحميد.

classicalTexts.title: ملحة الإعراب — القاسم بن علي الحريري
classicalTexts.justification: An أرجوزة on النحو with the author's own شرح, by the author of المقامات. Retained by accepted redline 3 and I protect it, but with the honest caveat that it is NOT a level above الآجرومية — it is a broadened second pass in verse. Stated that way it is excellent: a second differently-shaped encounter plus a memorisable portable reference, in the one grade where these students' memorisation habit is still cheap to recruit. A teacher's guide should mark where its presentation differs from the ordinary handbook treatment, so students are not confused at G8.

classicalTexts.title: قطر الندى وبل الصدى — ابن هشام الأنصاري
classicalTexts.justification: The intermediate step, with ابن هشام's own شرح. Carries the theorisation of الإعراب والبناء, علامات الإعراب الفرعية with their causes, and — decisively for this school — إعراب الجمل والمحل من الإعراب, which is the chapter that converts a clause-parser into a prose-reader. Two years at 3 periods is a realistic school pace for L2 learners.

classicalTexts.title: ألفية ابن مالك (الخلاصة) — محمد بن عبد الله بن مالك الطائي
classicalTexts.justification: The capstone, 1000 lines of رجز. Studied as the spine across three years via شرح ابن عقيل. Deliberate scoping decision: the GRADE curriculum covers selected أبواب with حفظ limited to the أبيات actually studied. Full حفظ of all thousand lines belongs in the parallel opt-in إجازة track (accepted redline 2's precedent), because a three-year 2-3 period allocation cannot honestly guarantee it for every student and promising it would be dishonest.

classicalTexts.title: شرح ابن عقيل على ألفية ابن مالك — بهاء الدين عبد الله بن عقيل
classicalTexts.justification: The standard teaching شرح of the Alfiyyah; determines depth more than the matn does. Teacher-facing, not a student text at this level.

classicalTexts.title: أوضح المسالك إلى ألفية ابن مالك — ابن هشام الأنصاري
classicalTexts.justification: ابن هشام's own systematic book arranged on the Alfiyyah. Useful as the second reading where شرح ابن عقيل is terse, and it keeps continuity with the same author the students met at G8-G9.

classicalTexts.title: التحفة السنية بشرح المقدمة الآجرومية — محمد محيي الدين عبد الحميد
classicalTexts.justification: Modern, clear شرح of the Ājurrūmiyyah with worked إعراب. Appropriate as the teacher's spine at G6 for staff who are themselves non-native speakers.

classicalTexts.title: النحو الواضح — علي الجارم ومصطفى أمين
classicalTexts.justification: Graded modern series that teaches through examples and exercises before definitions — the exact orientation the G5 embedded layer needs and a corrective to definition-first drift at G6-G7. Not a matn; an exercise and sequencing resource. Particularly suited to a non-Arabophone intake.

classicalTexts.title: جامع الدروس العربية — مصطفى الغلاييني
classicalTexts.justification: Comprehensive modern reference covering صرف and نحو. Useful for teacher preparation and for building exercise sets at G8-G12. Not a taught text.

classicalTexts.title: التطبيق النحوي — عبده الراجحي
classicalTexts.justification: Applied نحو at tertiary-entry level; a good source for the G11-G12 shift from taught-content to application. Teacher-facing; council should verify a suitable edition is procurable in Nigeria.

classicalTexts.title: شذور الذهب — ابن هشام الأنصاري
classicalTexts.justification: Exists and is a legitimate rung between القطر and الألفية. I am deliberately omitting it: inserting it would push الألفية into G11-G12 only and the ladder would not complete by graduation. Listed so the council knows the omission was a decision, not an oversight, and can reinstate it for an accelerated stream if it accepts the cost.

classicalTexts.title: مغني اللبيب عن كتب الأعاريب — ابن هشام الأنصاري
classicalTexts.justification: A post-Alfiyyah reference on حروف المعاني and إعراب الجمل, not a school text at any of these twelve grades. Named only to mark the ceiling of the ladder and as a possible selective reading in the parallel إجازة track.

classicalTexts.title: الاقتراح في أصول النحو — جلال الدين السيوطي
classicalTexts.grade: G12 (teacher-facing source for the أصول النحو وحدة)
classicalTexts.justification: Source for the bounded G12 unit on what counts as evidence in this discipline. Explicitly TEACHER-facing — it is not set as a student text and no student حفظ is attached. Council should confirm the edition before it enters a scheme of work.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Specific, in order of severity. (1) THE SELF-CONCEALING FAILURE. Opening الآجرومية at G4-G5 produces a class that recites الكلام هو اللفظ المركب المفيد بالوضع flawlessly and cannot find the فاعل in فتحَ اللهُ البابَ. This is the characteristic failure of madrasah نحو teaching worldwide and it is dangerous precisely because assessment by recitation REPORTS SUCCESS. The school would not discover it until G9, when the student meets unvoweled text and collapses, by which point four years are unrecoverable. (2) THE HOLLOW-ANALYSIS HABIT. If النحو arrives before اللغة العربية has delivered comprehension-without-translation, إعراب degenerates into pattern-matching on ending vowels. The student learns that analysis and understanding are separate activities — and that habit does not stay in النحو. It travels into G10-G12 التفسير and أصول الفقه and makes them recitational too. (3) THE RECITATION MIRAGE, unique to this institution. These children spend 195 ring-fenced hours a year reciting correctly-voweled Arabic. A G3-G4 teacher will hear that fluency and conclude the class is grammatically ready. It is not: the endings are transmitted by ear from a memorised master, not derived. This institution is at HIGHER risk of premature introduction than an ordinary school, precisely because of its strength. (4) ARBITRARY-LIST DAMAGE. Teaching المعربات بالحروف before the learner recognises المثنى، جمع المذكر السالم and الأسماء الخمسة as forms turns a rule into five memorised exceptions, and the student never recovers the underlying logic. (5) PERIOD CANNIBALISM, with hard numbers. At G1-G2 the ceiling is SEVEN periods a week. Any نحو there comes directly out of القراءة والتهجي — decoding, which is the one competence that cannot be retrofitted. At G3-G4, نحو periods come out of the vocabulary and comprehension work that is النحو's own prerequisite, so early introduction is self-defeating in the literal sense: it destroys its own foundation.
lifecycles.delayRisks: Specific, and the arithmetic is unforgiving. (1) THE LADDER DOES NOT FIT. الآجرومية (1 year) + ملحة الإعراب (1) + قطر الندى (2) + الألفية (3) = seven years, and G6-G12 is exactly seven grades. Differentiating at G7 instead of G6 costs one rung. In every school that has to drop a rung, the one dropped is الألفية — the capstone that makes the graduate credible. (2) THE UNVOWELED CLIFF BECOMES A WALL. If the G8 transition to النص غير المشكول slips, then مصطلح الحديث at G10-G11 (نخبة الفكر, per redline 1), أصول الفقه, and the فقه matn must all be taught from voweled editions. The graduate then cannot open a normally printed كتاب تراث — which is the single most consequential thing this entire twelve-year programme exists to produce. Everything else can be relearned; that capability cannot be faked. (3) البلاغة BECOMES VOCABULARY. علم المعاني is نحو read for meaning — التقديم والتأخير، الحذف والذكر، التعريف والتنكير، القصر، الفصل والوصل are all syntactic phenomena. A student without قطر الندى-level نحو cannot do البلاغة at all; they can only memorise its terms. Same for أصول الفقه's دلالات الألفاظ (العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، الأمر والنهي، المفهوم). Delay in النحو silently converts two G10-G12 subjects into terminology courses. (4) DELETING G5 BREAKS G6. Jumping from nothing at G4 to an open matn at G6 makes G6 a memorisation year, and a memorisation-built foundation under a seven-year ladder fails at G8, not at G6. The submission's G5 entry must be protected and strengthened — it is the load-bearing item and it looks like the disposable one. (5) THE MEMORISATION WINDOW CLOSES. At G5-G7 these students still take to verse memorisation readily — it is what they do every morning. By G9-G10 they resist rote أبيات. ملحة الإعراب at G7 and the الألفية core from G10 both depend on a willingness that is cheapest early and gets expensive fast. Delay does not just postpone the content; it raises its price.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 النحو stops being a body of content and becomes the graduate's working instrument, at reduced weight (2 periods) but retained identity. Its two G12 functions are completing الألفية's elected أبواب and a bounded وحدة in أصول النحو — descriptive, non-polemical: what counts as evidence in this discipline, what the البصري/الكوفي disagreement is about, why a نحوي posits a محذوف or a عامل معنوي. That unit exists so a graduate reading any شرح in any Islamic science can tell a GRAMMATICAL argument from a legal or theological one and not be lost in it. WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO BECAUSE OF THIS SUBJECT: (a) take an unseen, unvoweled printed page of classical prose — فقه, حديث, تفسير — vowel it correctly, and defend every ending they assigned; this is the certifying performance and it is assessed as such; (b) إعراب any verse of the Qur'an, including إعراب الجمل and whether a clause has a محل من الإعراب — cashing twelve years of ring-fenced حفظ into comprehension rather than storage; (c) read a نحوي's argument in a شرح and state what is at stake, without needing to adjudicate it; (d) find and fix a syntactic error in their own and another's Arabic writing, giving the reason; (e) hold ملحة الإعراب memorised in full and a defined core of الألفية, so that the reference travels with them and does not depend on a library; (f) lead a reading, teach a beginner matn, or enter a tertiary Arabic or Shariah programme with no remedial نحو. The negative statement matters as much: the G12 graduate is NOT a نحوي and the programme should not pretend otherwise. Original grammatical scholarship, full الألفية حفظ, and مغني اللبيب belong to the parallel إجازة track and to post-secondary study.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Against 19 periods/week at G3-G12 and 7 at G1-G2 (Qur'an hour excluded, being ring-fenced). G1 0 | G2 0 | G3 0 | G4 0 | G5 0 dedicated — approximately 1 of اللغة العربية's own periods ring-fenced inside its block for the نحو substrate, which must be written into اللغة العربية's scheme, not left to goodwill | G6 3 requested, 2 acceptable | G7 3 | G8 3 | G9 3 | G10 3 | G11 2 | G12 2. Totals over the differentiated span: 19-21 periods/week-years. FEASIBILITY CHECK AT G6, the tightest grade: التفسير العملي + الترجمة 2, الجزرية 2, اللغة العربية 3, النحو 3, الصرف 2, التوحيد والعقيدة 2, الفقه والسيرة (الأخضري) 3, الحديث 1, النشيد والمحفوظات 1, السيرة مضمّن 0 = 19 exactly. النحو at 3 is affordable at G6 only if اللغة العربية holds at 3 and nothing else expands; if اللغة العربية needs 4, النحو takes 2 and the المخفوضات section of الآجرومية is completed at تعريف level with mastery secured in G7's ملحة second pass. That fallback is designed in, not improvised. AT G10-G12 the taper is deliberate and is my contribution to relieving the secondary timetable, where البلاغة, أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث, الإنشاء والخطابة and الدراسات الحديثة all arrive: النحو gives back a period at G11 and holds only 2 at G12 because by then it is servicing other subjects' texts rather than generating its own. NOT NEGOTIABLE: G8-G9 at 3 periods. That is where قطر الندى and the unvoweled-text crossing sit, G8-G9 is الإعدادية and is the least crowded stretch of the ladder, and if those two years are shaved everything downstream fails.
departuresFromSubmission: G5 PARTNER CORRECTED — from 'مضمّن with الصرف' to 'مضمّن inside اللغة العربية'. This is a category error in the submission, not a preference. مضمّن means taught inside ANOTHER SUBJECT'S normal teaching; الصرف is a peer discipline, not a host, and at G5 الصرف has no timetabled existence to be embedded in (its own matn does not arrive until G6). Combining النحو with الصرف would be مدمج by definition, and at G5 neither has enough content to integrate. The host is اللغة العربية, which is where the sentences are.

G5 CONTENT SPECIFIED — the submission is silent on what G5 النحو actually is. Silence at exactly this point is where the ladder breaks, because a silent slot defaults to whatever the teacher has to hand, which is definitions. I am binding G5 to functional, pre-terminological content (أقسام الكلمة by working علامات، الجملتان، الفاعل والمفعول by function, the changing-ending concept on memorised Qur'anic sentences) and explicitly EXCLUDING الإعراب/البناء theory, علامات فرعية, تقدير, and written-out إعراب formulae.

G6 FORM CHANGED — مدمج to مستقل. The submission pairs النحو with الصرف. But الآجرومية is almost entirely نحو and البناء في الصرف is entirely صرف: there is no shared content to integrate, so مدمج here would be a timetabling convenience wearing a pedagogical label — precisely what the architecture's form vocabulary exists to prevent. مدمج also saves nothing: النحو 3 + الصرف 2 costs the same 5 periods whether it is one block or two. Meanwhile it costs something real — in a single block the discipline with the harder matn crowds the other, and at G6 both have a matn. مستقل matches the definition exactly: الآجرومية supplies its own recognised identity and planned progression. The genuine integration point (المعربات بالحروف needing المثنى/الجموع/الأسماء الخمسة as forms) is handled by a mandated intra-year sequencing requirement in the scheme of work, which is stronger than a shared block anyway.

G7 FORM CHANGED — مدمج to مستقل, same reasoning, plus one addition: ملحة الإعراب is a 375-line أرجوزة with a حفظ obligation. A memorisation target inside a shared block is the first thing dropped when the block runs behind.

G7 CONTENT ADDED — التطبيق الإعرابي على المحفوظ, systematic إعراب of Qur'anic verses the student already holds by heart. The submission does not connect النحو to the ring-fenced Qur'an hour at all. That hour is 195 constitutionally protected hours a year of correctly-voweled, syntactically rich Arabic that the student has already internalised, and it is this institution's single largest structural advantage over a conventional school. Not spending it on النحو is leaving the asset on the table.
G8-G12 DESIGNED where the submission is deliberately silent — قطر الندى at G8-G9, ألفية ابن مالك at G10-G12, taper to 2 periods at G11-G12 as النحو converts from taught content to applied instrument.

G8 وحدة ADDED AND NAMED — قراءة النص غير المشكول, the crossing from voweled to unvoweled text, given a scheduled year and its own assessment line separate from the matn. In most systems this crossing is hoped for rather than timetabled, and it is the failure that silently disables every متن-reading subject at G10-G12.

حفظ الألفية REASSIGNED — full memorisation of all thousand lines goes to the parallel opt-in إجازة track under accepted redline 2's precedent, not to the grade curriculum. A 2-3 period allocation across three years cannot honestly guarantee it for every student, and writing it into the grade curriculum would be a promise the timetable cannot keep.

شذور الذهب DELIBERATELY OMITTED — a legitimate rung, excluded on time grounds so that the ladder completes by G12. Recorded as a decision so the council can reinstate it for an accelerated stream with the cost visible.

G4 HELD EMPTY AGAINST THE TEMPTATION TO RAMP — I considered a G4 مضمّن layer to soften the run-up to G6 and rejected it. G4 is التجويد's differentiation year (تحفة الأطفال becomes مستقل and independently assessed); a second new named strand competes with it for exactly the same cognitive slot. Instead اللغة العربية at G4 carries three named substrate obligations that G5 cashes. This is a choice, not an omission.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY — القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5): decoding of voweled script at sentence length. Absolute precondition; without it النحو has no input. النحو must never be asked to remediate decoding.

FED BY — اللغة العربية (G1-G12): vocabulary, comprehension, sentence stock. The single most important feeder and the permanent host of the G5 layer. HARD BOUNDARY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: النحو must not become a vocabulary lesson, and اللغة العربية must never be reduced or displaced to make room for النحو — that would cut the branch it sits on. اللغة العربية holds at 3+ periods through G9 or النحو fails.

FED BY — الإملاء (longitudinal inside اللغة العربية, redline 7): writing حركات accurately. The written حركة is the EVIDENCE of the syntactic analysis; this is why the two must not be separated and why redline 7 is correct. Boundary: النحو does not teach orthography — همزة، تاء مربوطة، الألف اللينة are الإملاء's, permanently.

FED BY — حفظ القرآن (ring-fenced hour, G1-G12): supplies the analysis corpus at zero period cost. From G7 onward النحو must draw examples predominantly from the student's own محفوظ rather than from invented sentences. Boundary: النحو takes the text as data and does not touch recitation.

FED BY — النشيد والمحفوظات (G3+) and التجويد's تحفة الأطفال (G4-G5): habituation to memorising rajaz. This is what makes ملحة الإعراب at G7 and the الألفية core at G10 affordable. A curriculum without a verse-memorisation habit could not run this ladder.

PAIRED WITH — الصرف (G6+): the two halves of علم العربية. CLEAN BOUNDARY: any question about the FORM of a word (why كاتب and not مكتوب) is صرف; any question about its ENDING as a function of POSITION is نحو. The one genuine overlap is المعربات بالحروف, taught in النحو with the forms pre-taught elsewhere. Coordinated by scheme of work, not merged into one block. الإعلال والإبدال والإدغام at G12 belong to الصرف and must not be taught twice.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE — التجويد: a real collision risk that needs stating. Both disciplines deal in final حركات. التجويد transmits them as recitation; النحو derives them as analysis. النحو must not re-teach recitation, and التجويد must not offer grammatical explanations for endings — that confuses the basis of the two authorities in the student's mind.

FEEDS — التفسير (G6+) and أصول التفسير: from G8 onward إعراب IS the mechanism of تفسير, not an ornament on it. The G6 التفسير العملي is a consumer of النحو's G5-G6 output and should be sequenced to use it.
FEEDS — الحديث and مصطلح الحديث (G10-G11, نخبة الفكر per redline 1): reading متون as printed, i.e. unvoweled. The G8 وحدة is what makes نخبة الفكر readable at G10.

FEEDS — الفقه (G6+, الأخضري) and أصول الفقه: HARD DEPENDENCY THAT THE BOARD SHOULD RULE ON. أصول الفقه's دلالات الألفاظ — العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، الأمر والنهي، المفهوم والمنطوق — is built on syntax. أصول الفقه must NOT begin before قطر الندى-level competence is in place, i.e. not before G10. Starting it at G9 would produce a terminology course.

FEEDS — البلاغة: SECOND HARD DEPENDENCY. علم المعاني is literally نحو read for meaning — التقديم والتأخير، الحذف والذكر، التعريف والتنكير، القصر، الفصل والوصل are syntactic phenomena examined for effect. البلاغة must not begin before G10. BOUNDARY: النحو stops at 'this is مفعول به منصوب'; البلاغة asks why it was fronted. النحو must not stray into meaning-effects and البلاغة must not re-teach parsing.
FEEDS — الترجمة (G6+ per redline 8): translation out of Arabic is parsing plus rendering. النحو supplies the parse from G7. Boundary: النحو is not assessed on the English or Yoruba rendering.

FEEDS — الإنشاء والخطابة: النحو owns CORRECTNESS, الإنشاء owns EFFECTIVENESS. From G9 النحو's assessment may include production, but only as correctness; the generative and rhetorical task is الإنشاء's and النحو must not colonise it.

INDEPENDENT OF — العروض: prosody is metre and rhyme, not syntax. No dependency in either direction; the apparent kinship (both deal in verse) is superficial and the two should not be scheduled as a pair.

CONSUMERS ONLY, NO DEPENDENCY OWED — العقيدة والتوحيد، السيرة والتاريخ، التربية الإسلامية، الدراسات الحديثة: these consume Arabic reading ability, which النحو helps produce, but they impose no content requirements on it and النحو owes them no syllabus accommodation.
CLAIMED BY النحو, CONTESTABLE — أصول النحو as a bounded G12 وحدة. No other subject in the 26 will house it; أصول الفقه could argue for it. I claim it and flag the claim.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether النحو at G12 stays مستقل at 2 periods or converts to مضمّن inside التفسير/أصول الفقه to relieve the most crowded year in the ladder. I recommend مستقل — the أصول النحو unit has no other home and the graduating assessment needs an owner — but the timetable trade is the council's, not mine.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] G6 allocation of 2 versus 3 periods, which depends on اللغة العربية's and الفقه والسيرة's final claims against a ceiling that my worked example fills exactly at 19. At 2 periods, المخفوضات in الآجرومية completes at تعريف level and mastery defers to G7's second pass. That fallback is designed in, but the council should choose it knowingly.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether ملحة الإعراب is required حفظ in full (~375 lines) for every student at G7, or whether the grade curriculum requires a defined core with full حفظ in the parallel إجازة track. This materially changes G7's period cost.
[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether أصول النحو at G12 is owned by النحو or by أصول الفقه. I claim it for النحو; the claim is genuinely arguable and a ruling prevents both duplication and orphaning.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether شذور الذهب is inserted between القطر and الألفية for an accelerated stream, extending the ladder by a year and compressing الألفية into G11-G12 only. I have omitted it; reinstatement is a live option with a stated cost.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION, needs resourcing not ruling] G8-G9 requires a Nigerian-context exercise bank built around Yoruba L1 interference — specifically the absence of case marking and of grammatical gender in Yoruba, which means gender agreement errors and ending-omission are systematic rather than random for this intake. Imported Middle Eastern textbooks do not drill these. This is materials development, and if it is not commissioned the G8-G9 allocation will underperform regardless of the text chosen.

[OPERATIONAL] Which شرح is standard for الآجرومية and for قطر الندى. In النحو the شرح determines depth far more than the matn does, and staff who are themselves non-native speakers will teach to whatever شرح they are given. This should be decided centrally, not per teacher.

[OPERATIONAL] Teacher capability is the real constraint on this design and the council should look at it squarely. The G8 unvoweled-text وحدة and the G10-G12 الألفية years both require a teacher who can vowel an unseen page confidently and follow a grammatical argument. If that capability is not currently on staff, the ladder should be phased in from G6 upward as the first cohort advances, rather than launched at all grades at once.

[FOR THE BOARD'S WHOLE-CURRICULUM VIEW] My two hard sequencing claims — that أصول الفقه must not begin before G10, and البلاغة must not begin before G10, both waiting on قطر الندى-level نحو — constrain subjects I do not own. The specialists for those subjects should be asked to confirm or contest them before G10-G12 is allocated.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G4. For الصرف, "meaningful" has one operational test: the point at which a learner can produce a correct form of a word that was never taught to him. Anything short of that is vocabulary teaching wearing a morphology label. That test requires three things to be simultaneously true — the child decodes vocalised words without effort (delivered by القراءة والتهجي G1–G3), he holds enough verbs for a pattern to recur across them rather than appear once (اللغة العربية reaches المفردات والجمل القصيرة at G4), and he can write a table. All three land at G4, not before. So G4 is where تصريف الفعل الثلاثي السالم across الماضي/المضارع/الأمر begins to produce generative learning. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION — this is one year earlier than the submission, which begins الصرف at G5.] G1–G3 are honestly empty: at 7 periods/week (G1–G2) the child is on الحروف, and at G3 the scarce Arabic minutes must buy decoding fluency, which is load-bearing for every later year. Morphology taught before there is a word-stock to pattern over is taught on air.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and should not be. Of the 7 periods/week available, Arabic time is spent on الحروف وأصواتها and a small stock of مفردات. There is no verb stock, no decoding fluency, and no writing fluency — the three things morphology operates on. Any 'pattern awareness' claimed at this stage is indistinguishable from ordinary vocabulary learning and must not be entered on the register as الصرف.

Not taught. اللغة العربية is at الحروف والمفردات. One genuine but indirect contribution is being made elsewhere and should be recognised rather than duplicated: التجويد العملي (مضمّن, G1–G5) is training exactly the auditory discrimination — فتحة/ضمة/كسرة، سكون، شدة — on which the entire vowel-melody system of الصرف later depends. That ear is a صرف prerequisite being paid for by another programme at no cost to this one.

Deliberately left empty. اللغة العربية is at الكلمات — word level, which is الصرف's own level — and it is tempting to plant a مضمّن presence here. It should not be planted. G3's Arabic minutes must buy automatic decoding through القراءة والتهجي; a صرف line on the register at G3 invites a G3 صرف book and a G3 صرف mark, and the only place the periods could come from is reading. One preparatory instruction is issued instead, and it is اللغة العربية's design responsibility, not a صرف allocation: G3 vocabulary should be sequenced in root families (كَتَبَ / كِتَاب / كَاتِب taught together as related words, with no rule stated), so that the root idea — utterly foreign to a Yoruba-speaking child, whose L1 has no root-and-pattern morphology at all — has two years of quiet exposure before it is named at G4.

تصريف الفعل الثلاثي السالم, oral first and tabular second, on high-frequency classroom verbs (كَتَبَ، جَلَسَ، ذَهَبَ، دَرَسَ، حَفِظَ، لَعِبَ): الماضي with a reduced pronoun set (هو، هي، أنا، أنتَ، أنتِ، نحن), then المضارع, then الأمر للمخاطب. The root is named for the first time: words share three consonants, and the consonants carry the meaning while the vowels and additions carry the job. No الميزان الصرفي, no ف ع ل notation, no أبواب, no terminology beyond ماضٍ/مضارع/أمر. Assessment stays embedded inside اللغة العربية because at G4 morphological knowledge is not yet separable from vocabulary knowledge — a child who conjugates كتب correctly at G4 may simply have memorised six words, and an independent mark would not be measuring the discipline.

The full person-set paradigm of الثلاثي السالم in الماضي والمضارع, and الأمر across the مخاطب set. Then the first genuinely generative move: اسم الفاعل (فَاعِل) واسم المفعول (مَفْعُول) from the sound trilateral, taught as rules the child applies to roots he has not met. Two items are taught explicitly as سماعي, with the teacher stating plainly that there is no rule and the form must be heard and kept — مصدر الثلاثي (كِتَابَة، جُلُوس، ذَهَاب) and جمع التكسير. This warning is not pedantry: it is the specific inoculation against the commonest early-morphology failure, confident over-generalisation (*كَتْب for كِتَابَة). Also pre-taught here, at النحو's service rather than its own: the trichotomy اسم/فعل/حرف, so that G6's متن البناء is not waiting on it. Independent assessment begins at G5 and the submission is right to call for it — there is now a separable item to test: 'conjugate this verb you have not been taught; derive اسم الفاعل from this root.' That is a صرف question, not an اللغة العربية question.

gradeByGrade.text: متن البناء (البناء في الصرف)
gradeByGrade.content: الميزان الصرفي enters here and nowhere earlier: ف ع ل as positional placeholders, وزن extraction, الزيادة والحذف, and حروف الزيادة collected by the standard mnemonic سألتمونيها. Then متن البناء's own content: المجرد والمزيد; أبواب الثلاثي المجرد الستة with their مضارع vowel (نَصَرَ يَنْصُرُ، ضَرَبَ يَضْرِبُ، فَتَحَ يَفْتَحُ، عَلِمَ يَعْلَمُ، كَرُمَ يَكْرُمُ، حَسِبَ يَحْسِبُ); the first المزيد بحرف (أَفْعَلَ، فَعَّلَ، فَاعَلَ) taught together with what the pattern does to the meaning — التعدية، التكثير، المشاركة. That meaning-of-pattern content is the single highest-value hour in the whole early Arabic programme for a non-Arabophone learner, and it must not be dropped to save time. Scheduling instruction inside the combined block: the صرف component leads in Term 1, because الآجرومية's treatment of علامات الفعل، المعرب والمبني، نصب وجزم المضارع والأفعال الخمسة presupposes morphological identification of the forms it is inflecting.

gradeByGrade.text: لامية الأفعال لابن مالك (أبنية الأفعال والمصادر portion only)
gradeByGrade.content: المزيد completed: بحرفين (انْفَعَلَ، افْتَعَلَ، تَفَعَّلَ، تَفَاعَلَ، افْعَلَّ) and بثلاثة (اسْتَفْعَلَ، افْعَوْعَلَ، افْعَالَّ), plus الرباعي المجرد ومزيده, each with its معنى. Then the highest-yield rule in the discipline: المصدر القياسي للمزيد — أفعل/إفعال، فعّل/تفعيل، فاعل/مفاعلة، انفعل/انفعال، افتعل/افتعال، تفعّل/تفعُّل، تفاعل/تفاعُل، استفعل/استفعال. This single table unlocks the وزن of several hundred Qur'anic and hadith nouns at a stroke. Also المبني للمجهول من الصحيح. On the text: لامية الأفعال is RETAINED at G7 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 3], and I am not re-opening that. But the redline fixes the text-to-grade mapping, not the depth of treatment, and the depth is a specialist call: at G7 the لامية is taken as حفظ plus selective explication of its أبنية and مصادر sections only. Its المعتل and إعلال passages are dense — the same structural hazard the Board already struck down in نخبة الفكر at G6 — and are carried forward to G8–G9, where the poem is completed analytically. The منظومة form is an asset here: the النشيد والمحفوظات method (group chanting, cumulative recitation) is the delivery vehicle, and the حفظ capacity built by the ring-fenced Qur'an hour is what makes a versified matn survivable at age twelve.

gradeByGrade.text: لامية الأفعال (المعتل sections) + a modern exercise book (procurement decision, see open questions)
gradeByGrade.content: DIFFERENTIATION INTO مستقل. الصحيح والمعتل taxonomy; المهموز; المضعّف with its فكّ وإدغام; then the beginning of المعتل proper — المثال (وَعَدَ يَعِدُ، وَصَلَ يَصِلُ, with حذف الواو in المضارع والأمر) and الأجوف (قَالَ يَقُولُ، بَاعَ يَبِيعُ، خَافَ يَخَافُ), with الإعلال بالقلب, الإعلال بالحذف, and the behaviour of these verbs in الأمر and المجزوم (قُلْ، بِعْ، لم يَقُلْ). This is the year the learner is first asked to accept an underlying form that never surfaces — that قَالَ 'is really' قَوَلَ. That is a second and harder abstraction than the ف ع ل placeholder of G6, and it is the reason الإعلال sits here. 2 dedicated periods/week.

gradeByGrade.text: لامية الأفعال (completed)
gradeByGrade.content: الناقص (دَعَا، رَمَى، سَعَى) واللفيف المفروق (وَقَى يَقِي) والمقرون (طَوَى يَطْوِي); الإعلال systematised as بالقلب وبالنقل وبالحذف; الإبدال, with إبدال تاء الافتعال drilled hard (اصْطَبَرَ، اضْطَرَبَ، ازْدَجَرَ، ادَّعَى، اتَّقَى) because it is the commonest reason a student cannot find a Qur'anic word in a dictionary; الإدغام — واجبه وجائزه وممتنعه, kept explicitly distinct from the إدغام of التجويد; المشتقات completed (الصفة المشبهة، صيغ المبالغة، اسم التفضيل، اسما الزمان والمكان، اسم الآلة، المصدر الميمي ومصدر المرة والهيئة والمصدر الصناعي); جمع التكسير وأوزانه، جموع القلة والكثرة، صيغة منتهى الجموع. By the end of G9 the core body of the science is closed. 2 dedicated periods/week. This is the last year of independent standing, and that is by design, not by budget pressure.

Residue and payoff. Residue: التصغير، النسب، الوقف، همزة الوصل والقطع stated as the صرفي rule that generates it (وصل in الماضي الخماسي والسداسي وأمرهما ومصادرهما وفي الأمر الثلاثي) — which also retires a persistent spelling error and feeds الإملاء without duplicating it. Payoff: التجريد واستعمال المعجم — extracting the root from a word in running text and locating it in a root-ordered lexicon (لسان العرب، القاموس المحيط، المعجم الوسيط), including the hard cases where إعلال or إبدال has hidden the root (اتَّقَى ← و ق ي، قُلْ ← ق و ل، مِيزَان ← و ز ن). This competency is assessed as a timed performance task, not a written paper, and it is the specific thing that converts twelve years of teaching into lifelong independence. Plus التحليل الصرفي of continuous Qur'anic and hadith text. Roughly 1.5 of a 3–4 period combined النحو والصرف block.

No new صرف content exists to teach — the science is finite and was closed at G9. What remains is that صرف analysis is now a required, explicitly planned move inside text work: before any إعراب, state the word's وزن، جذر، صيغة، and what the صيغة contributes. Named contact points to be written into the schemes of work of the consuming subjects: البلاغة (صيغ المبالغة; اسم الفاعل للثبوت مقابل الفعل للتجدد; العدول عن صيغة إلى أخرى), أصول الفقه (صيغة الأمر افعل، صيغة النهي، دلالة المشتق، المطلق والمقيد), مصطلح الحديث (the entire terminology is an اسم فاعل / اسم مفعول system). Assessment is embedded in النحو and النصوص marks. Zero dedicated periods — this is deliberately given back to the timetable so that G8–G9's two periods can be afforded.

gradeByGrade.text: متن البناء ولامية الأفعال (as retained memory, revised)
gradeByGrade.content: A bounded terminal unit with a stated beginning and end — one term, roughly 1 period/week (~13 periods total) — doing two jobs. First, systematic revision of the whole صرف syllabus to external-examination and إجازة standard, since a G12 leaver aiming at Azhar-type or Madinah-type entry will meet a صرف paper and must meet it from a consolidated whole rather than from memories of G9. Second, التحليل الصرفي التطبيقي على النص القرآني: why غَفُور rather than غَافِر, the صيغة مبالغة weight of غَفَّار، رَحْمَن، رَحِيم, the قراءة difference مَالِك/مَلِك read as an اسم فاعل / صفة مشبهة distinction — and the rendering of these distinctions into English and Yoruba, which is where الترجمة turns morphology from a passive to an active competence. Independently assessed as a named component of the terminal Arabic-sciences examination.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: There are two distinct events and the board should not conflate them. (1) الصرف becomes a DISTINCT NAMED ENTITY at G6 — its own name on the register, its own matn (متن البناء), its own mark — while still taught مدمج with النحو. It is G6 and not G5 because الميزان الصرفي is an algebraic operation: ف ع ل must be held as positional placeholders that stand for any three consonants, and a learner who cannot do that treats الوزن as letter-matching and collapses at the first مزيد (he cannot weigh اسْتَخْرَجَ). That capacity for symbolic placeholding arrives around age eleven, i.e. G6 here. It is not G7 because الآجرومية lands at G6 [redline 3] and its whole treatment of علامات الفعل، المعرب والمبني، نصب وجزم المضارع، الأفعال الخمسة presupposes that the learner can identify the morphological forms being inflected; delay الميزان to G7 and G6's نحو becomes recitation. (2) الصرف DIFFERENTIATES INTO مستقل at G8, and holds that standing for exactly two years. It is G8 because that is when الإعلال والإبدال والمعتل arrive, and that body of content demands a second and harder abstraction than the ف ع ل placeholder — accepting an underlying form that never surfaces (قَالَ is analysed as قَوَلَ). Attempt that before the صحيح paradigms are automatic and the underlying form is not a simplification, it is a competing item to memorise, and the student doubles his load and hypercorrects. The صحيح paradigms become automatic at the end of G7. It is not G9 because المعتل alone — مثال، أجوف، ناقص، لفيف by two kinds, each with its أمر، مجزوم، مبني للمجهول ومشتقات — is a full year of work, and مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10–G11 [redline 1] with a terminology that is itself a morphological system (مُدلِّس vs مُدلَّس، مُرسِل vs مُرسَل، مَجروح vs جارح). Compress إعلال and معتل into G9 alone and the G10 redline placement inherits students who recognise forms but cannot produce them. It is also not مدمج at G8 because in every integrated block the discipline holding the examined text wins the minutes, and against الآجرومية's successor النحو would win every week.
prerequisites: Automatic decoding of vocalised three- and four-letter words with no hesitation — established G3 by القراءة والتهجي (G1–G3), consolidated G4–G5. This is why G3 carries no صرف: the periods that would fund it are the periods that fund this.

Accurate auditory and written discrimination of الحركات والسكون والشدة. الصرف is a vowel-melody system; a learner who cannot hear the difference between كَتَبَ / كُتِبَ / كَتَّبَ cannot do it at all. Established G2–G3 by القراءة والتهجي and, at no cost to this subject, by التجويد العملي مضمّن (G1–G5).

A productive stock of roughly 300–500 Arabic words including at least 60–80 verbs. A pattern is a generalisation over a vocabulary; with twenty verbs there is no generalisation available, only labels to memorise. Established G4–G5 by اللغة العربية (المفردات والجمل القصيرة/البسيطة).
Handwriting fluent enough to fill a conjugation table without the writing itself consuming the lesson. Established G4.

The trichotomy اسم / فعل / حرف. Formally delivered by الآجرومية at G6, but it must be pre-taught inside اللغة العربية at G5 [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] so that متن البناء at G6 is not waiting on its partner text to catch up.

Capacity to hold a symbolic placeholder — ف ع ل standing for any three consonants, by position not by letter. This is the cognitive gate for الميزان الصرفي and it is why الميزان is at G6 and not G4–G5. Established G6.

Tolerance for an underlying form that never surfaces (قَالَ analysed as قَوَلَ). A strictly harder abstraction than the placeholder, and the gate for الإعلال. Established G8 — which is why G8 is the مستقل point.

Memorisation capacity sufficient for a versified matn. Built continuously and for free by the ring-fenced Qur'an hour (G1–G12) and by النشيد والمحفوظات (G3+). This is what makes لامية الأفعال deliverable at G7.

classicalTexts.title: متن البناء (البناء في الصرف)
classicalTexts.justification: A short beginner's matn that enumerates أبواب التصريف — الثلاثي المجرد and its six أبواب, then المزيد بحرف وبحرفين وبثلاثة, then الرباعي — which is exactly the right instrument at G6: a catalogue of patterns, memorisable, converting the single-verb paradigms of G4–G5 into a system. Retained per redline 3. CAVEAT THE COUNCIL MUST ACT ON: the title and the existence of the text I am confident about; the authorship, commonly given as الدنقزي / الدنكزي, I am NOT confident about, including its spelling. Procure and print the matn with no author attribution until a printed edition has been checked by hand.
classicalTexts.confidence: confident as to title and existence; author UNVERIFIED — print no author name until checked

classicalTexts.title: لامية الأفعال لابن مالك
classicalTexts.grade: G7 (أبنية ومصادر portion), completed G8–G9 (معتل and إعلال portions)
classicalTexts.justification: A genuine and well-attested منظومة in الصرف by ابن مالك الأندلسي, the author of الألفية. Retained at G7 per redline 3. My specialist qualification concerns depth, not placement: it is a dense poem whose later passages on المعتل والإعلال are intermediate work, so at G7 it is taken as حفظ plus selective explication of its أبنية and مصادر sections, and its remaining sections are completed analytically at G8–G9 where the independent slot exists to do it properly. NOTE FOR THE BOARD: this is a different and verified work from 'القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية' flagged [UNVERIFIED] under redline 4 for النشيد. The two must not be confused in procurement or in the register — they share only the word لامية.

classicalTexts.title: شرح بحرق على لامية الأفعال (بحرق الحضرمي)
classicalTexts.grade: teacher reference for G7–G9; not a student text
classicalTexts.justification: The standard working commentary on the لامية and the obvious teacher's reference for the G7–G9 sequence. It is proposed as a staff resource only — it is not to be put in a student's hands at G7. Verify the printed edition and the author's full name before procurement rather than ordering on my say-so.
classicalTexts.confidence: confident as to existence; verify edition and full attribution before procurement

classicalTexts.title: التصريف العزي للزنجاني
classicalTexts.grade: not placed — listed as an alternative for G8–G9 if the لامية proves unworkable
classicalTexts.justification: A real and widely taught short صرف matn, historically significant enough to carry a commentary by التفتازاني. I am NOT proposing it — redline 3 has already fixed البناء → لامية and I am building on that. It is named only so the council has a verified fallback on record rather than improvising one later.
classicalTexts.confidence: confident as to existence; not proposed for adoption

classicalTexts.title: الشافية لابن الحاجب
classicalTexts.grade: NOT PLACED — explicitly rejected for G1–G12
classicalTexts.justification: Named here so that the register shows it was considered and declined, not overlooked. It is the major systematic matn of الصرف and precisely for that reason it does not belong anywhere in a school curriculum: it is a post-secondary text, and its natural home at SHRS is the opt-in الإجازة track [redline 2], not a timetabled grade. Placing it at G10–G12 would repeat the exact error the Board struck down with نخبة الفكر at G6.
classicalTexts.confidence: confident as to existence; deliberately not placed

lifecycles.lifecycleVerdict: continuous — but continuous from G4 only, with G1–G3 genuinely empty, and with the مستقل span deliberately confined to two years (G8–G9). The discipline does not disappear and does not merge away: it changes function three times. G4–G5 it is a vocabulary engine inside اللغة العربية. G6–G7 it is the metalinguistic substrate of النحو. G8–G9 it is an independent science being completed. G10–G12 it is an applied tool with a permanent traceable home in النحو and a bounded terminal unit at G12. The refusal to hold a standing slot at G10–G12 is a positive finding, not a budget concession: unlike النحو or البلاغة, الصرف has a bounded syllabus that genuinely closes, and a curriculum that keeps timetabling a finished science is either repeating itself or inventing content.
lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: ["الميزان الصرفي before G6: the child reads ف ع ل as three literal letters and learns the sentence 'وزن ضرب فعل' as a recited fact. The diagnostic symptom is that he cannot weigh اسْتَخْرَجَ — he tries to match letters instead of positions. Whole terms are spent and nothing transfers.","الإعلال before the صحيح paradigms are automatic (i.e. before G8): the student is asked to accept قَوَلَ as the 'real' form of قَالَ. With insecure surface forms, the underlying form is not a simplification but a second competing item, so load doubles rather than halves. Symptoms are hypercorrection — writing قَوَلَ, or conjugating *يَقْوُول.","أبواب الثلاثي المجرد الستة at G4–G5: a باب is a statistical generalisation over a stock of verbs.
