Given to a child holding twenty verbs, it is not a generalisation but six arbitrary labels, and it consumes the exact hours that should be building the stock that would make it meaningful two years later.","Teaching مصدر الثلاثي as if it were rule-governed at G4–G5 (it is سماعي): produces fluent, confident, wrong forms — *كَتْب for كِتَابَة — which are far harder to remove than an absence would have been. The teacher must state explicitly that there is no rule here.","Any independent timetabled slot before G8: at G3 the periods can only come from القراءة والتهجي, which damages the decoding fluency every later year depends on; at G4–G7 they can only come from اللغة العربية's vocabulary work, which starves الصرف itself of the material it operates on. Premature independence for this subject is self-defeating in a way it is not for most others.","Naming الصرف on the G1–G3 register at all, even as مضمّن: a register line generates a textbook, a teacher allocation and a mark. Given the 7-period ceiling at G1–G2, every one of those is paid for out of reading."]
lifecycles.delayRisks: ["Vocabulary growth stays linear instead of becoming multiplicative. Without patterns, اسْتَخْرَجَ / مُسْتَخْرِج / مُسْتَخْرَج / اسْتِخْرَاج are four separate items to memorise; with them, they are one root and three rules. For a Yoruba-L1 learner — and Yoruba has no root-and-pattern morphology whatever, marking tense with preverbal particles rather than internal vowel change, so nothing transfers from the L1 — linear vocabulary growth cannot reach text-reading competence inside 19 shared periods a week over twelve years. This is the single strongest argument for starting at G4 rather than G5.","الآجرومية at G6 collapses into recitation. علامات الفعل، المعرب والمبني، نصب وجزم المضارع، الأفعال الخمسة all presuppose that the learner can identify what he is inflecting. Delay morphology past G5 and the Board's retained G6 نحو placement fails for reasons that will be blamed on النحو.","مصطلح الحديث at G10–G11 [redline 1] becomes terminology memorisation. Its entire vocabulary is a morphological system: مُدلِّس against مُدلَّس, مُرسِل against مُرسَل, جارح against مَجروح, مُدرَج، مُعلَّل. A student who cannot read اسم الفاعل against اسم المفعول is memorising opaque labels and cannot reason with the categories. This gives الصرف a hard completion deadline of end-G9 that the Board's own accepted redline generates.","أصول الفقه's مباحث الألفاظ become unreachable. صيغة الأمر (افعل), صيغة النهي, دلالة المشتق, المطلق والمقيد are morphological arguments conducted in morphological vocabulary. Wherever أصول الفقه lands, it inherits a cohort that cannot follow its reasoning.","Qur'anic recitation stays phonetic. A حافظ who cannot weigh a word recites with the sound and without the access — precisely the outcome a school with three constitutional programmes exists to prevent, and the most expensive possible failure given that 195 hours a year are constitutionally ring-fenced for the recitation.","Dictionary independence never arrives. Root-ordered lexica — لسان العرب، القاموس المحيط، المعجم الوسيط — are physically unusable without تجريد, and the hard cases (اتَّقَى ← و ق ي، مِيزَان ← و ز ن) require إعلال and إبدال specifically. A graduate without this cannot continue learning after he leaves, which forecloses the international ambitions the school states, since Azhar-type and Madinah-type study assumes معجم independence on arrival.","Delaying إعلال past G9 leaves it nowhere to go. G10–G12 must carry أصول الفقه، البلاغة، مصطلح الحديث، أصول التفسير and the terminal examinations; a science pushed into those years will lose its minutes every week to whichever neighbour has an examined text."]
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 الصرف is no longer a subject being learned; it is a capability being exercised and certified, delivered through a bounded one-term وحدة (≈1 period/week) that revises the whole syllabus to external-examination and إجازة standard and applies it to the Qur'anic text. Concretely, the graduate can: take any Arabic word from a vocalised or unvocalised text and state its وزن، جذر، صيغة، and what the صيغة contributes to the meaning; conjugate any verb — صحيح or معتل, مجرد or مزيد — across الماضي والمضارع والأمر، معلوماً ومجهولاً، مثبتاً ومنفياً, unaided and for roots he has never met; find any word in a root-ordered dictionary including where إعلال or إبدال has buried the root (اتَّقَى ← و ق ي، قُلْ ← ق و ل، مِيزَان ← و ز ن، ازْدَجَرَ ← ز ج ر), which is the competency that makes him able to keep learning for the rest of his life without a teacher; read the technical vocabularies of مصطلح الحديث، أصول الفقه and البلاغة as transparent rather than opaque; explain a صرفي distinction in a Qur'anic verse — why غَفُور and not غَافِر, the مبالغة weight of غَفَّار, مَالِك against مَلِك as اسم فاعل against صفة مشبهة — and render that distinction accurately into English and Yoruba; produce correct derived forms in his own writing and speech in الإنشاء والخطابة; and carry متن البناء and لامية الأفعال in memory as a permanently available internal reference, which is what a matn is for and the reason the tradition versified this science in the first place.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: "Against the ring-fenced Qur'an hour (untouched — الصرف asks for nothing from it) and the 19/week ceiling (7 at G1–G2): G1 zero of 7. G2 zero of 7. G3 zero of 19 — deliberately returned to القراءة والتهجي. G4 zero dedicated; approximately one period-equivalent ring-fenced for morphology inside اللغة العربية's existing allocation. G5 zero dedicated; approximately one period-equivalent inside اللغة العربية, plus a named assessment component. G6 inside a combined النحو والصرف block of 4 periods/week, of which roughly 1.5 attributable to الصرف. G7 the same 4-period block, roughly 2 attributable (the لامية's حفظ load is real). G8 2 dedicated periods/week, مستقل. G9 2 dedicated periods/week, مستقل. G10 inside a combined النحو والصرف block of 3–4 periods, roughly 1.5 attributable. G11 zero dedicated; embedded in النحو and النصوص. G12 approximately 1 period/week for one term only — about 13 periods in the year. Peak ask is 2 of 19, about 10.5%, and only in two years out of twelve. The budget is deliberately shaped so that the G8–G9 independence is financed by asking for nothing at G1–G3 and nothing standing at G11–G12; I am not requesting a permanent twelve-year slot and the council should not grant one if I later ask."
relationshipToOtherSubjects: النحو — the closest neighbour and the largest duplication risk. The boundary must be stated once and enforced: الصرف owns the word before it enters the sentence (بنية الكلمة المفردة); النحو owns what happens to its end because of where it stands (أواخر الكلم، الإعراب والبناء). Concretely: forming المضارع is صرف, its رفع/نصب/جزم is نحو; forming صيغة منتهى الجموع is صرف, its being ممنوعاً من الصرف is نحو; building المبني للمجهول is صرف, handling نائب الفاعل is نحو. Flag the naming trap explicitly for teachers and students: الممنوع من الصرف is NOT a topic of علم الصرف — صرف in that phrase means التنوين. Partner discipline for الصرف at G6, G7, G10 and G11.

اللغة العربية — feeds الصرف before it can exist (verbs and word-stock, G3–G5) and is repaid many times over from G5 onward, since pattern knowledge multiplies vocabulary without buying new teaching time. This is the efficiency argument that justifies the whole allocation under a 19-period ceiling. Partner discipline at G4–G5.
القراءة والتهجي (G1–G5) — pure feeder, and the specific reason الصرف stays out of G1–G3. Nothing in morphology is reachable through hesitant decoding. It must never be displaced to make room here.

التجويد العملي and الجزرية — feeder in an unobvious way: the ear for الحركات والسكون والشدة that تجويد trains from G1 is the same discrimination الصرف depends on. One non-duplication warning: the إدغام of التجويد (between letters in recitation, across word boundaries) and the إدغام of الصرف (within the word's own structure, as in مَدَّ from م د د) are different operations with the same name, and students conflate them every year. Whoever teaches the second must open by distinguishing it from the first.

حفظ القرآن — a large silent feeder that costs nothing. A حافظ carries thousands of morphological exemplars already in memory; the صرف teacher should draw every example from memorised surahs, which gives free retrieval and honours the constitutional ring-fence without taking a minute from it.

الإملاء (longitudinal inside العربية, redline 7) — الصرف supplies the reasons behind several spelling rules and must not re-teach the drills: همزة الوصل والقطع follows from the verb's أبنية; الألف اللينة at word-end (ى in رَمَى from ر م ي، ا in دَعَا from د ع و) follows from the third radical. الإملاء drills the hand, الصرف gives the derivation. The coupling pays at G8–G10.
التفسير (G6+) and التفسير العملي — consumer. الصرف is what makes a تفسير lesson able to ask why the verse says غَفُور and not غَافِر.

الترجمة (G6+, redline 8) — consumer and a demanding test. Rendering into English and Yoruba forces the student to commit to what a صيغة actually means — causation in تفعيل, reciprocity in تفاعل, request in استفعال — which is precisely the meaning-of-pattern content taught at G6–G7. The two subjects reinforce each other more than either does with anything else on the register.

مصطلح الحديث (G10–G11, redline 1) — consumer with a hard dependency. Its entire terminology is an اسم فاعل / اسم مفعول system (مُدلِّس/مُدلَّس، مُرسِل/مُرسَل، جارح/مَجروح). The Board's own placement of مصطلح at G10 is what dates the صرف completion deadline at end-G9.

أصول الفقه (placement open) — consumer. مباحث الألفاظ are conducted in morphological vocabulary: صيغة الأمر، صيغة النهي، دلالة المشتق، المطلق والمقيد. If this subject is placed earlier than G10 the صرف schedule must be re-examined.
البلاغة (placement open) — consumer. صيغ المبالغة, the ثبوت of اسم الفاعل against the تجدد of الفعل, العدول عن صيغة إلى أخرى — all are morphological facts used for rhetorical ends.

العروض (placement open) — adjacent and dangerous. التقطيع العروضي uses a ف ع ل-derived notation (فَعُولُنْ، مَفَاعِيلُنْ) that LOOKS identical to الميزان الصرفي and is a completely different operation: prosodic, counting حركة and سكون as actually pronounced, indifferent to the root. Students who have learned الميزان will assume the two are the same thing unless told otherwise. Wherever العروض lands, its first lesson must explicitly separate the two notations. No one else on this board is likely to raise this.

النشيد والمحفوظات — allied in method rather than content. لامية الأفعال is itself a منظومة, so the chanting and cumulative-recitation method of النشيد is the delivery vehicle for the صرف متون, and memorised poetry supplies morphological exemplars at no cost.
الإنشاء والخطابة (placement open) — consumer, and the only place where the morphology is tested in production rather than recognition.
الحديث والسيرة والفقه والعقيدة والتوحيد — ordinary consumers through their Arabic texts; no design obligation beyond drawing examples from them.
المنطق وعلم الكلام، النقد والآداب، أصول التفسير، التربية الإسلامية، الدراسات الحديثة — no material relationship. I am not claiming one in order to look connected.
departuresFromSubmission: Starts at G4, not G5. The submission has الصرف first appear at G5. One year earlier is required because الآجرومية is fixed at G6 [redline 3] and needs a two-year morphological runway, and because the vocabulary-multiplier effect should begin the moment a verb stock exists. Cost: zero dedicated periods — G4 is مضمّن inside اللغة العربية.

Changes the G5 partner from النحو to اللغة العربية. The submission reads 'النحو والصرف مضمّن'. At G5 النحو has no content of its own to host anything — the pairing is two empty disciplines propping each other up. At G5 morphology is a vocabulary engine, not an إعراب prerequisite, so its partner is the subject that supplies and consumes vocabulary. The partner switches to النحو at G6, and the switch is principled rather than arbitrary: before metalanguage الصرف serves vocabulary, after metalanguage it serves إعراب.

Names the missing partner at G6 and G7. The submission says 'الصرف مدمج متن البناء في الصرف' and 'الصرف مدمج متن لامية الأفعال'. A matn is a text, not a partner discipline — مدمج requires ONE named partner, and it is النحو at both grades.

Fixes الميزان الصرفي at G6 exactly, and states the cognitive gate that puts it there rather than at G5. The submission does not specify when the الميزان enters; without that specification a G5 teacher will introduce it, and it will not take.

Qualifies the depth of لامية الأفعال at G7 without touching its retained placement. Redline 3 fixes the text at G7 and I am not re-opening it; but the redline fixes the mapping, not the treatment. At G7 the poem is حفظ plus selective explication of its أبنية ومصادر sections only, with the المعتل and إعلال passages carried to G8–G9. Taking it whole at G7 would reproduce the structural error the Board already identified in نخبة الفكر at G6.

Designs the entire G8–G12 span, which the submission leaves open, and confines مستقل standing to G8–G9 only. I am explicitly declining a standing slot at G10, G11 and G12 — الصرف is a finite science that closes at G9, and a curriculum that keeps timetabling a finished science repeats itself.

Adds the معجم / تجريد الجذر competency at G10 as an independently assessed performance task. It appears nowhere in the submission and it is the single deliverable that turns twelve years of teaching into post-graduation independence.

Flags that لامية الأفعال لابن مالك (G7, mine) is a verified and entirely different work from 'القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية' (G4 النشيد, [UNVERIFIED] under redline 4). The shared word لامية is the only thing they have in common and the register must not let them contaminate each other in procurement.

Attaches an authorship caveat to متن البناء. The text is retained per redline 3 and I am confident it exists as named, but I am not confident of its author's name or spelling and will not print one. This is a procurement instruction, not a curriculum change.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Author attribution for متن البناء. My recommendation is to retain the text and print it with no author name until a printed edition has been physically checked. I will not supply an attribution I am not sure of, and I would rather the register carry a blank than a wrong name.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Where do أصول الفقه, البلاغة and العروض land? My G8–G9 completion deadline is calculated against مصطلح الحديث at G10 [redline 1] and an assumption that أصول الفقه and البلاغة sit at G10–G12. If أصول الفقه is placed at G9, the صرف schedule must be re-examined, because its مباحث الألفاظ would then be running in parallel with the الإعلال year rather than after it.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Should the opt-in الإجازة track [redline 2] carry a صرف strand? My recommendation is yes: لامية الأفعال in full with شرح, taken at mastery pace, which gives the stronger students the poem's deferred sections earlier without imposing them on the grade cohort. This is exactly the kind of higher mastery layer the redline describes.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is the G12 وحدة timetabled inside the 19, or delivered as an examination-preparation block outside it alongside the other terminal subjects? The design works either way; the answer affects nine other subjects, so it is not mine to make.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Which modern exercise book supports G8–G9. I will not name one — I cannot verify what is currently in print and procurable in Nigeria, and naming a title I cannot confirm is the same failure as inventing a matn. This is a procurement task with a stated specification: graded exercises in الإعلال والإبدال والمعتل, fully vocalised, with answer keys.

[PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE, flagged for monitoring] The whole design assumes the Yoruba-L1 starting point, which means root-and-pattern morphology transfers from nothing in the learner's first language. If a significant intake arrives with prior Qur'anic-school Arabic or home Arabic, the G4–G5 pacing will be too slow for them and a differentiated route into the G6 البناء should be considered. This is an intake question the school can answer and I cannot.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G8. For البلاغة, "meaningful" has a precise operational test: the student can perform the discipline's one core operation — take a piece of real Arabic, restate its meaning in other Arabic words, compare the two versions, and give a reason why the original said it that way (مقتضى الحال). Anything short of that is definition-recitation, not البلاغة. That operation first becomes possible at G8, and only for explicitly marked comparison (التشبيه), because the student then holds: الإعراب of the nominal and verbal sentence [established G6, الآجرومية], the syntactic repertoire of ملحة الإعراب [G7], الاشتقاق والأوزان [G6-G7, البناء في الصرف ثم لامية الأفعال], and a memorised stock of Arabic verse and Qur'an to serve as شواهد [G3-G7 محفوظات + 195h/yr حفظ]. It is NOT first mentioned earlier and deliberately so: G1-G7 contain no البلاغة of any kind. What happens in G1-G7 is the accumulation of البلاغة's raw material (memorised text, vocabulary, إعراب), which is a different thing from teaching the discipline and must not be relabelled as البلاغة on a timetable. Full performance of the operation — on syntactic choice rather than explicit comparison, i.e. علم المعاني — is not possible until G10.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and no proto-form. The only thing happening that البلاغة will later draw on is the opening of the ring-fenced Qur'an hour (195h/yr) — the largest شواهد reservoir the school will ever have, acquired at zero timetable cost to this subject. Teachers may say a verse is beautiful; that is تحبيب, it is not planned learning, and it must not be recorded as بلاغة.

Not taught. Learner is still at الحروف والمفردات; there is no sentence for a rhetorical choice to be made in. Any 'introduction to beautiful speech' at this age is decorative and would consume part of a 7-period ceiling that الحروف/القراءة/التوحيد العملي/الفقه التطبيقي have a far stronger claim on.

Not taught. Significant for البلاغة only as the year the النشيد والمحفوظات strand opens — the first deliberate deposit of memorised Arabic verse. البلاغة's request to the محفوظات owner starts here: choose pieces partly for their شواهد value (clear imagery, clean comparison), because this stock is what G8-G9 will analyse.

Not taught. الحديث والسيرة مدمج begins supplying narrative prose and the prophetic similes (e.g. المؤمن للمؤمن كالبنيان) that G8 will use. Note: the G4 النشيد slot is [UNVERIFIED] in the submission; البلاغة plans no شواهد on it and designs around it.

Not taught. النحو والصرف مضمّن begins — البلاغة's prerequisite ladder starts climbing here, but a discipline may not be taught in the same year its foundation is first being laid. The G5 النشيد slot is also [UNVERIFIED]; excluded from البلاغة's شواهد planning.

Not taught — and this is a deliberate refusal, not an oversight. G6 establishes the single most important prerequisite (الإعراب, via الآجرومية) and adds the first substantial شواهد stock (ديوان الشافعي، لامية ابن الوردي). It is exactly the year a curriculum is tempted to 'start التشبيه'. Refused: the student is simultaneously carrying الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الجزرية، الأخضري، التفسير العملي والترجمة. He also cannot yet hold literal and figurative senses of a word securely in an L2, which is the precondition for any figurative teaching.

Not taught. G7 is the heaviest new-متن year in the whole ladder (ملحة الإعراب + لامية الأفعال + الجزرية + تفسير + عقيدة + فقه + حديث + سيرة). Introducing البلاغة in the same year that its own prerequisite (ملحة) is being acquired would turn the slot into remedial نحو. تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري joins the شواهد stock this year.

gradeByGrade.text: لا كتاب — شواهد من القرآن والحديث والمحفوظات المقررة
gradeByGrade.content: التشبيه, and nothing else. أركانه الأربعة: المشبه، المشبه به، أداة التشبيه، وجه الشبه; distinguishing تشبيه from ordinary predication. The standing exercise is productive and comparative, never label-first: 'قل المعنى بعبارة أخرى، ثم قارن' and 'لماذا قال كذا ولم يقل كذا؟'. شواهد drawn from الرحمن (كأنهن الياقوت والمرجان), الجمعة (كمثل الحمار يحمل أسفارا), the prophetic similes, and the memorised dīwāns. Deliberate cultural bridge: Yoruba owe (proverb) and its comparison structures, used to show that the learner already possesses the cognitive move and is only acquiring its Arabic apparatus. EXPLICITLY FORBIDDEN at G8: the أقسام taxonomy (مرسل/مؤكد/مجمل/مفصل/بليغ), any البديع, any المعاني, and any بلاغة textbook. Three technical terms maximum across G8-G9.

gradeByGrade.text: لا كتاب — شواهد من القرآن والحديث والمحفوظات المقررة
gradeByGrade.content: الحقيقة والمجاز (the concept of القرينة المانعة من إرادة المعنى الأصلي), الاستعارة (تصريحية ومكنية — defined and distinguished, not subdivided), الكناية (عن صفة / عن موصوف). The standing exercise becomes three questions on every شاهد: ما المعنى الحقيقي؟ ما القرينة؟ ماذا كسب المتكلم بالعدول عن الحقيقة؟ Direct, planned service to الترجمة (running since G6): why a كناية cannot be carried literally into English or Yoruba, and what is lost when it is. Assessment becomes independent WITHOUT changing form: a named, separately reported بلاغة section inside the Arabic paper, with a hard format constraint — naming/identifying the device carries no more than about a quarter of the marks; the rest is شرح، إعادة صياغة، وتعليل. This gives the Council the diagnostic signal it needs before committing G10-G11 periods.

gradeByGrade.text: البلاغة الواضحة (الجارم وأمين)
gradeByGrade.content: The differentiation year. Two jobs. (1) Rebuild البيان systematically now that a book and a discipline-identity are justified: التشبيه بأقسامه، المجاز المرسل وعلاقاته، الاستعارة التصريحية والمكنية، الكناية — the G8-G9 intuitions now receive their taxonomy, in that order, because taxonomy after intuition is retention and taxonomy before intuition is cramming. (2) Open علم المعاني: الخبر والإنشاء وأغراض الخبر، تقديم المسند إليه وتأخيره، التعريف والتنكير، الحذف. Every المعاني lesson is run against a نحو fact the student already owns — البلاغة states the reason for the construction, it never re-teaches the إعراب. 2 periods/week.

gradeByGrade.text: البلاغة الواضحة (إتمام) + منتخبات من الجوهر المكنون للأخضري
gradeByGrade.content: Completion of علم المعاني: القصر بطرقه (إنما، النفي والاستثناء، العطف، التقديم)، الفصل والوصل، الإيجاز والإطناب والمساواة. Then علم البديع, taught last and taught small: الطباق، المقابلة، التورية، حسن التعليل؛ الجناس، السجع — with the explicit doctrine that البديع is تابع للمعنى لا مقصود لذاته, which is the only inoculation against ornament-hunting. Memorisation of الجوهر المكنون begins بابًا بابًا (selections only in the grade curriculum; the full منظومة sits in the opt-in mastery track). Descriptive, non-partisan presentation of the scholarly disagreement over المجاز في القرآن — presentable at G11 because the student can now hold a disagreement without it destabilising his reading. 2 periods/week.

gradeByGrade.text: جواهر البلاغة للهاشمي (مرجع) + منتخبات من دلائل الإعجاز للجرجاني
gradeByGrade.content: The apparatus is complete; the year's work is application to whole texts, which is exactly what النقد والآداب does — so a small traceable pair is correct and a duplicate standalone slot is not. Content: بلاغة تطبيقية على نصوص كاملة (نثر وشعر وقرآن); a bounded وحدة on نظرية النظم from teacher-selected passages of دلائل الإعجاز — that eloquence resides in تعليق الكلم بعضها ببعض, not in the rarity of single words; coordinated بلاغي analysis of Qur'anic passages feeding التفسير (البلاغة supplies the apparatus; it does not annex التفسير's hour); and figurative transfer into English and Yoruba with الترجمة. البلاغة keeps its own reported grade inside the pair. Claims about 1 of the pair's weekly periods; 0 new periods against the 19 ceiling. FALLBACK: if النقد والآداب is not established at G12, البلاغة reverts to مستقل at 2 periods.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G10 — البلاغة becomes مستقل, with its own book, its own paper and its own progression.

Why G10 and not G9: علم المعاني is the core of the discipline and is wholly parasitic on consolidated نحو. المعاني asks why a مسند إليه is معرفة rather than نكرة, مقدّم rather than مؤخر, محذوف rather than مذكور; why القصر is by إنما rather than النفي والاستثناء; when to فصل and when to وصل. A student still acquiring نحو cannot answer those questions — he will re-do نحو badly inside the بلاغة slot and be unable to tell which subject he is failing. Under this curriculum نحو runs الآجرومية (G6) → ملحة الإعراب (G7) → consolidation and extension (G8-G9); it is held, not merely met, at the end of G9. G9 is also the year البلاغة is being independently assessed for the first time in مضمّن form — the diagnostic year. You differentiate after the diagnostic, not during it.

Why G10 and not G11: the three sciences plus شواهد work plus application cannot be done in one year at 2 periods — a G11 start yields a survey, and a survey of البلاغة is memorised definitions. G10-G11 gives two clean years for the apparatus and leaves G12 free for application. Also, G11-G12 التفسير and أصول الفقه need البلاغة already in hand rather than arriving alongside them.

A note on the G10 coincidence with مصطلح الحديث [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 1]: this is not symmetry-copying. Both are second-order sciences — sciences ABOUT a first-order material (مصطلح about transmission, بلاغة about language) — and both require a consolidated first-order base plus the metalinguistic/formal reasoning that is secure around G10. The same criterion independently lands both in the same place. That is convergence, not imitation, and if the نحو ladder at G8-G9 turns out weaker than assumed, البلاغة moves to G11 regardless of where مصطلح sits. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]
prerequisites: Fluent, stable Arabic decoding and reading aloud — established G3-G5 through القراءة والتهجي (separate book, independently assessed). Without automatic decoding, all attention goes to word-recognition and none to the comparison of alternatives.

A working vocabulary large enough to hold BOTH the literal and the transferred sense of a word at once — built G3-G7 by the المفردات والجمل strand; adequate by G8, secure by G9. This is the specific L2 gate on الاستعارة, not a general 'more Arabic' wish.

إعراب of the nominal and verbal sentence: المبتدأ والخبر، الفاعل، المفعول، المعرفة والنكرة — established G6 by الآجرومية. Without it the student cannot even see that a construction could have been otherwise, which is the precondition of every بلاغة question.

The syntactic repertoire that علم المعاني actually operates on: التقديم والتأخير، الحذف، الحال، التمييز، أدوات النفي والاستثناء، الشرط، العطف — established through ملحة الإعراب at G7 and consolidated G8-G9. This is the direct gate on differentiation at G10.
الاشتقاق، الأوزان، صيغ المبالغة — established G6-G7 through البناء في الصرف and لامية الأفعال. Needed for حسن التعليل، المبالغة، and much of البديع.

A memorised stock of fine Arabic to serve as شواهد — accumulated continuously: حفظ القرآن G1-G12 (195h/yr, constitutionally ring-fenced, costing البلاغة nothing), الحديث from G3, and the النشيد والمحفوظات strand from G3 (ديوان الشافعي ولامية ابن الوردي at G6, تائية الإلبيري at G7). The two [UNVERIFIED] النشيد slots at G4 and G5 are excluded from this reservoir and nothing is substituted for them.

Ability to restate an Arabic sentence in different Arabic (إعادة الصياغة) — REQUIRED BY END OF G9 and NOT explicitly guaranteed anywhere in the submission. This is the pivotal prerequisite: if the student cannot produce an alternative wording, he cannot compare wordings, and البلاغة at G10 will collapse into definition-memorisation. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] — the اللغة العربية owner must carry this as a named, assessed outcome by G9.

Metalinguistic, formal-operational reasoning — the capacity to treat language as an object, to attribute intention to a speaker, and to judge fit-to-audience (مقتضى الحال). Typically emerging around G8, reliable by G10. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] — this is a developmental prerequisite, not a curricular one, and it is the reason no amount of clever sequencing can pull البلاغة into the الابتدائية years.

NOT a prerequisite, contrary to a common assumption: العروض. Knowledge of البحور helps read شواهد شعرية comfortably but is not needed for any of the three sciences. البلاغة must not be made to wait on العروض, and العروض must not be pulled early to serve it.

classicalTexts.title: البلاغة الواضحة — علي الجارم ومصطفى أمين
classicalTexts.justification: Deliberately a modern graded school manual, not a classical متن, and that is the point: first exposure to a science needs worked examples, staged exercises and plain definitions, which a متن by design does not provide. It is exercise-rich, sequenced البيان-then-المعاني-then-البديع, and has a long record of use with non-native learners in African and Asian Arabic schools. Its companion exercise volume supplies the comparative drills this design depends on. Using it does not break the institution's متن pedagogy — the متن arrives at G11 alongside it.

classicalTexts.title: الجوهر المكنون في الثلاثة الفنون — عبد الرحمن الأخضري
classicalTexts.grade: G11-G12 (selections in the grade curriculum; full منظومة in the opt-in mastery track)
classicalTexts.justification: A rajaz منظومة on المعاني والبيان والبديع, essentially a versified abridgement of the التلخيص tradition. Three reasons it is the right متن here: (1) it matches the institution's own established pedagogy of memorised منظومات (تحفة الأطفال، الجزرية، ملحة الإعراب، لامية الأفعال); (2) its author is already in the house — مختصر الأخضري is the retained فقه متن at G6, so the school's teachers and the local scholarly tradition already know him; (3) it has a genuine, long teaching presence in West African Arabic schooling, which matters for teacher supply and for external recognition in this region. It is dense in its own right, so the grade curriculum takes it بابًا بابًا with the full text reserved for the الإجازة-style parallel track.

classicalTexts.title: جواهر البلاغة في المعاني والبيان والبديع — أحمد الهاشمي
classicalTexts.justification: A comprehensive, well-organised modern compendium with abundant شواهد. Right as the reference the G12 student consults while doing applied analysis, not as a course to be marched through. Bridges the school manual and the classical tradition.

classicalTexts.title: دلائل الإعجاز — عبد القاهر الجرجاني
classicalTexts.grade: G12 (teacher-selected passages only, as a bounded وحدة)
classicalTexts.justification: The foundational argument of the discipline — نظرية النظم, that eloquence lies in the relations between words rather than in single words. Selected, teacher-mediated passages are what give the G12 graduate something to SAY about إعجاز القرآن instead of an assertion to repeat. The whole book is beyond a G12 secondary course at 1 period/week and must not be assigned whole.

classicalTexts.title: أسرار البلاغة — عبد القاهر الجرجاني
classicalTexts.justification: The companion work on التشبيه والاستعارة والمجاز. Named here so the Council can see the ceiling the G10-G12 course is pointing at; explicitly NOT placed inside G1-G12.

classicalTexts.title: الإيضاح في علوم البلاغة — الخطيب القزويني
classicalTexts.grade: Teacher reference only; not a student text at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: القزويني's own expanded treatment of the material he abridged in التلخيص. Useful for settling definitions and for teacher preparation; too technical to place in front of G10-G12 students at this period allocation.

classicalTexts.title: تلخيص المفتاح — الخطيب القزويني
classicalTexts.grade: Not used G1-G12; mastery-track / post-secondary horizon
classicalTexts.justification: The standard advanced madrasa متن (an abridgement of the third section of مفتاح العلوم للسكاكي, normally read with شروح). Placing it in a secondary course at 2 periods/week in an L2 setting would produce recitation without comprehension. Named explicitly so that no one later mistakes its absence for an oversight.

classicalTexts.title: عقود الجمان في المعاني والبيان — جلال الدين السيوطي
classicalTexts.grade: Not recommended G1-G12; alternative منظومة if the Council prefers it
classicalTexts.justification: A versification of the التلخيص material. A legitimate alternative to الجوهر المكنون, but longer and denser, and without the الأخضري continuity argument. Listed for completeness, not recommended.

classicalTexts.title: مفتاح العلوم — السكاكي
classicalTexts.justification: The source from which the whole التلخيص tradition descends. Listed only to mark the horizon and to record that its exclusion is deliberate.

classicalTexts.title: البلاغة العربية: أسسها وعلومها وفنونها — عبد الرحمن حسن حبنّكة الميداني
classicalTexts.justification: A modern systematic treatment useful for teacher formation, particularly for staff who studied البلاغة only as exam content. Recommended for the staff library rather than the syllabus.

classicalTexts.title: دروس البلاغة
classicalTexts.grade: Possible alternative to البلاغة الواضحة at G10 — VERIFY BEFORE ADOPTION
classicalTexts.justification: A short graded school text of the same Egyptian pedagogical generation, commonly cited as a compact alternative. I am not confident enough of the exact authorship attribution to state it, and I will not guess it. If the Council is interested, the title and its authors must be verified against a physical or catalogued copy before adoption. Marked uncertain deliberately — البلاغة الواضحة is the recommendation and this entry changes nothing if it is dropped.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Five specific failures, in order of how likely they are to actually happen here.

1. THE TAG-HUNTING PATHOLOGY. This is the dominant, worldwide failure mode of البلاغة teaching, and it is installed precisely by starting too early with a textbook and a labelling exam. The student learns to scan for كأن and write "تشبيه", to spot a pair of opposites and write "طباق", with no grasp of وجه الشبه or of why the device is there. It is self-reinforcing because it is the cheapest thing to mark, and once the exam rewards it the teaching follows it. It is close to irreversible: a G12 student trained this way cannot be retrained in one year. This is why G8-G9 has NO textbook, a three-term vocabulary cap, and a hard ceiling of roughly a quarter of marks for identification.

2. المعاني BEFORE نحو IS CONSOLIDATED becomes remedial نحو wearing a different name. If علم المعاني were opened at G8-G9, every lesson on التقديم والتأخير or الحذف would have to stop and re-teach the إعراب it presupposes. The school would pay for a بلاغة period and receive a weak نحو period, and the student would not know which subject he was failing.

3. THE L2 LITERAL-LAYER RISK, which is specific to this school and is the strongest argument against a G6 or G7 start. Teaching المجاز والكناية requires the learner to hold a word's literal sense firmly and then knowingly suspend it. A Yoruba-speaking learner whose Arabic vocabulary is still thin does not have a firm literal layer to suspend; teaching transfer too early destabilises it, and the student becomes uncertain what words mean at all. A native speaker can absorb an early مجاز lesson harmlessly; this cohort cannot.

4. REVERENCE AND ADAB. Applying analytical terminology to revelation before the تفسير content and the habit of reverence are in place risks the child treating the Qur'an as a specimen to be labelled. Related and specific: the status of المجاز في القرآن is genuinely disputed among scholars (some denied المجاز altogether). A G8 child cannot hold a disagreement of that kind; asserting either side to him is dishonest and presenting both confuses him. Hence: no Qur'anic مجاز analysis before G9, and the disagreement itself presented descriptively only from G11.

5. OPPORTUNITY COST AT THE WORST POSSIBLE YEARS. Any بلاغة period taken at G6 or G7 is taken directly from نحو and صرف in the two years when الآجرومية → ملحة and البناء → لامية are compounding. Those two years produce the prerequisite; spending them on the dependent is a straightforward architectural error, and it would also be taken from a 19-period ceiling that is already fully committed at G7.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Six specific costs of pushing البلاغة later than G8 مضمّن / G10 مستقل — for example the tempting "start it at G11, it's an advanced subject" default.

1. A ONE-YEAR البلاغة IS A SURVEY, AND A SURVEY IS DEFINITIONS. المعاني، البيان، البديع plus شواهد work plus application cannot be delivered in one year at 2 periods. A G11 start produces exactly the outcome the early-start risk was trying to avoid — memorised definitions — arriving by the opposite road.

2. THE FIRST CONSTITUTIONAL PROGRAMME IS LEFT STRUCTURALLY INCOMPLETE. التفسير runs from G6 to G12. Without البلاغة the student spends seven years in it able to state that the Qur'an is معجز but unable to demonstrate anything about HOW it says what it says. For a school whose first programme is القرآن وعلومه, that is not a refinement missing, it is a hole in the programme's own claim.

3. A LARGE MEMORISED CAPITAL DEPRECIATES UNUSED. This cohort will have memorised the Qur'an across twelve 195-hour years plus ديوان الشافعي، لامية ابن الوردي، تائية الإلبيري. If البلاغة arrives only at G12 the student will have carried all of that for a decade without ever being taught to see why any of it is fine. The محفوظات investment is already paid for; البلاغة is the instrument that realises the return.

4. أصول الفقه WILL HAVE TO DO IT BADLY AND TWICE. دلالات الألفاظ — الحقيقة والمجاز، العام والخاص، المطلق والمقيد، المنطوق والمفهوم — sits on a shared border with البلاغة. If البلاغة is late, أصول الفقه must teach الحقيقة والمجاز from scratch inside its own periods, at lower quality, and the student meets the same concept twice under two names.

5. الترجمة CALCIFIES INTO LITERALISM. الترجمة begins at G6 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 8] and increasingly handles figurative Arabic. A student with no figurative awareness by G9 will render كناية and استعارة word-for-word into English and Yoruba, producing renderings that are simply wrong. Translation habits set early are extremely persistent; correcting them at G12 is much harder than preventing them at G9.

6. EXTERNAL PLACEMENT. نحو، صرف، بلاغة is the expected triad wherever this school's graduates present themselves. A transcript with no traceable بلاغة grade before the final year weakens placement for exactly the students the school's international ambitions are aimed at.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 البلاغة stops being a body of knowledge to acquire and becomes an instrument used on whole texts, delivered مدمج with النقد والآداب and carrying its own reported grade. Its three G12 functions: applied analysis of complete literary texts (with النقد والآداب), a bounded وحدة on نظرية النظم from selected passages of دلائل الإعجاز, and a service function into التفسير and الترجمة — supplying the apparatus without annexing their hours.

What the graduate can actually do because of it:
- Take an unseen passage of Qur'an, hadith, or classical prose or verse and say, in Arabic, what the rhetorical choice is and why it was made: identify التقديم والتأخير، الحذف، القصر، الفصل والوصل، الإيجاز والإطناب، and state the مقتضى الحال that motivates each.
- Distinguish تشبيه from استعارة from كناية from مجاز مرسل, name their divisions, and produce شواهد from memory rather than from a handout.
- Recognise المحسنات البديعية and — the harder and more important skill — explain why they are subordinate to meaning, and identify where a text's ornament has outrun its sense.
- Argue, at an introductory but genuine level, that إعجاز القرآن lies in النظم (the relations between the words) rather than in strange vocabulary, and defend that position with a worked example. This is the single capability that most distinguishes this graduate from one who has merely finished تفسير.
- Carry an Arabic figure into English or Yoruba without literalism, and state precisely what is lost in the transfer — a directly employable skill in a Yoruba-speaking, English-official context.
- Preach, teach or address an audience with conscious attention to مقتضى الحال — matching the form of speech to the hearer. This is البلاغة's oldest practical payoff and its most useful one in the graduate's actual community.
- Sit an entry-level بلاغة placement examination for a تخصص in اللغة العربية or الشريعة, and, if he has taken the opt-in mastery track, present a memorised الجوهر المكنون as evidence of it.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Total new demand on the shared ceiling across all twelve years: 4 period-slots, both pairs at G10 and G11. البلاغة is a cheap subject if it is sequenced correctly and an expensive one if it is not.

G1-G2: 0 of ~7 periods/week. Nothing requested; nothing owed.
G3-G7: 0 of ~19 periods/week. Nothing requested. البلاغة makes only a design request to the محفوظات owner (choose pieces with شواهد value), which costs no time.
G8: 0 new periods. Requests roughly 25-30 minutes/week — about two-thirds of one 40-minute period — carved from within the existing اللغة العربية allocation, by agreement with that subject's owner, delivered inside the نصوص work rather than as a block.
G9: 0 new periods. Requests the equivalent of about 1 existing اللغة العربية period/week, still delivered within that subject's teaching. Note that the independent assessment at G9 costs marking time and moderation, not timetable.
G10: 2 of 19 periods/week, مستقل. This is ~10.5% of the ceiling and is the first real cost the subject imposes. It is affordable partly because redline 1 moved نخبة الفكر out of G6 into G10-G11 as مصطلح الحديث — so the Council should be aware that G10 is absorbing two newly differentiated subjects at once and check the total before ratifying.
G11: 2 of 19 periods/week, مستقل.
G12: 0 new periods. Requests about 1 of the النقد والآداب pair's weekly periods. FALLBACK, and the Council should price it: if النقد والآداب is not established at G12, البلاغة reverts to مستقل at 2 of 19 periods, and the twelve-year total rises from 4 slots to 6.

Outside the ceiling entirely: the opt-in mastery track (full الجوهر المكنون, wider منتخبات from الجرجاني), which is pace-based and separately governed on the Ḥifẓ Track precedent [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, redline 2] and takes no periods from the grade timetable.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FEEDS IN — النحو: the primary and non-negotiable feeder. الآجرومية (G6) supplies الإعراب; ملحة الإعراب (G7) and its G8-G9 consolidation supply the constructions that علم المعاني reasons about. البلاغة's whole G10-G11 course is the reasons behind choices نحو has already described.
FEEDS IN — الصرف: البناء في الصرف (G6) and لامية الأفعال (G7) supply الاشتقاق، الأوزان، صيغ المبالغة, needed for المبالغة، حسن التعليل and the لفظي side of البديع.

FEEDS IN — اللغة العربية: البلاغة's host at G8-G9 and its vocabulary supplier throughout. The single outstanding dependency is that اللغة العربية must guarantee إعادة الصياغة (Arabic-to-Arabic paraphrase) as an assessed outcome by G9.

FEEDS IN — النشيد والمحفوظات and حفظ القرآن: the شواهد reservoir. This is البلاغة's great structural advantage here — the Qur'an hour (195h/yr, ring-fenced) and the memorised dīwāns give the subject a body of fine Arabic already inside the student's head, at zero cost to the 19-period ceiling. Request to that owner: weigh شواهد value when selecting pieces from G3 onward.
FEEDS IN — الحديث and التفسير: prophetic similes and Qur'anic imagery as شواهد, and, from تفسير, the prior content-understanding without which بلاغي analysis of a verse is empty.

FEEDS OUT — التفسير (G11-G12 especially): البلاغة is what converts تفسير from paraphrase into analysis, and is the only route by which إعجاز becomes demonstrable rather than assertable. البلاغة supplies the apparatus into التفسير's hour; it does not take a share of it.
FEEDS OUT — أصول الفقه: دلالات الألفاظ rests directly on الحقيقة والمجاز، العام والخاص، المنطوق والمفهوم. If البلاغة is in place by G11, أصول الفقه inherits the concepts instead of re-teaching them.
FEEDS OUT — الإنشاء والخطابة: البلاغة owns analysis, that subject owns production. البلاغة must not become a composition class, and الإنشاء must not be asked to teach the devices.

FEEDS OUT — الترجمة (from G6): the concrete, early payoff. From G9 the student learns that a كناية or استعارة must be re-expressed rather than mapped word-for-word into English or Yoruba, and can state what is lost.

FEEDS OUT — النقد والآداب: البلاغة supplies the analytical apparatus; النقد applies it to judging texts, and at G12 they are paired. Demarcation must be written down: البلاغة owns the named devices and their مقتضى; النقد owns evaluation, literary history and schools.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — النحو: if a G10 بلاغة lesson spends its time on إعراب, the lesson has failed. البلاغة presumes the parse and argues about the choice.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE — أصول الفقه on المجاز: a real and easily-missed collision. Proposed demarcation: البلاغة owns المجاز as a rhetorical choice fitted to مقتضى الحال; أصول الفقه owns it as a rule bearing on استنباط. Needs a written ruling.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — العروض: البديع's المحسنات اللفظية (سجع، جناس، تصريع) brush against العروض والقافية. العروض owns الوزن والقافية; البلاغة owns the المحسنات. Neither waits on the other.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE — المنطق وعلم الكلام: the السكاكي-school presentation of البلاغة is logical in cast and its أقسام can easily degenerate into a تعريف-and-تقسيم exercise. Keep البلاغة's taxonomy tied to شواهد, not to definitional technique.

NO RELATIONSHIP TO PROTECT — الفقه، السيرة، التوحيد والعقيدة، التربية الإسلامية، الدراسات الحديثة، التجويد، الإملاء: these neither feed البلاغة nor draw on it in any planned way. Naming this explicitly prevents البلاغة being sprinkled into subjects where it would be ornamental.
departuresFromSubmission: The submission is silent on البلاغة. I am not treating that silence as neutral: I am converting it into an explicit refusal for G1-G7 and an explicit programme for G8-G12. The refusal is the more important half — a subject that is merely 'not yet mentioned' tends to get inserted opportunistically into whichever grade has a spare period, and البلاغة is particularly vulnerable to that because it sounds appealing at every age.

Declining a G6 placement, and declining a G7 placement, which is where this subject would most naturally have been dropped once redline 1 freed capacity at G6 by moving نخبة الفكر out. That freed capacity should not go to البلاغة. G6 and G7 are producing البلاغة's prerequisites (الآجرومية، ملحة، البناء، لامية) and spending them on the dependent is an architectural error.

Claiming a share of another owner's subject at G8-G9. البلاغة asks اللغة العربية to host it مضمّن and to carry a named بلاغة outcome. This is a claim on the اللغة العربية owner's planning and must be negotiated, not assumed. I have kept the claim small and specific (about two-thirds of a period at G8, about one at G9) precisely so it is negotiable.

Placing a binding condition on the اللغة العربية specification: إعادة الصياغة must be an assessed outcome by G9. This is the only prerequisite in the whole list that the current submission does not already deliver, and البلاغة at G10 fails without it.

Declining a standalone G12 slot, against the default expectation that senior subjects are مستقل in the final year. A G12 standalone البلاغة would duplicate النقد والآداب and الإنشاء والخطابة, and would take 2 periods at the most contested year on the ladder. مدمج with an independently reported grade preserves traceability [redline 9] at a third of the cost.

Asking the النشيد والمحفوظات owner to weigh شواهد value in selecting pieces from G3 onward — a request that reaches back seven years before البلاغة is taught at all. Any curriculum in which the analytical subjects place no requirements on the memorisation subjects will find at G10 that it has memorised the wrong things.

Declining to build anything on the two [UNVERIFIED] النشيد slots at G4 and G5 [redline 4], and declining to propose any substitute for them. البلاغة's شواهد base therefore rests on القرآن، الحديث، and the verified محفوظات (ديوان الشافعي، لامية ابن الوردي، تائية الإلبيري) only. Note in passing, without reopening anything: attributions within the ديوان attributed to الإمام الشافعي are debated piece by piece, which affects how شواهد from it should be introduced but not whether they can be used.

Recommending a modern school manual (البلاغة الواضحة) as the first text rather than a classical متن, which departs from the submission's consistent متن-first pattern (تحفة الأطفال، الجزرية، الآجرومية، ملحة، لامية الأفعال، الأخضري). The departure is deliberate and bounded: a متن (الجوهر المكنون) enters at G11, one year later, once there is something for it to compress.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Will اللغة العربية carry إعادة الصياغة — restating an Arabic sentence in different Arabic — as a named, assessed outcome by end of G9? This is the load-bearing dependency. If the answer is no, البلاغة at G10 will become definition-memorisation and the Council should either fix the dependency or move differentiation to G11.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] What is the نحو text and scope at G8-G9? The G10 differentiation assumes نحو beyond ملحة الإعراب is held, not merely met, by the end of G9. If نحو is still in acquisition through G10, البلاغة differentiates at G11 instead and G12 reverts to مستقل. This is the one input that would change the whole shape.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does النقد والآداب exist at G12, and as what? البلاغة's G12 form is مدمج with it. If that subject is not established there, البلاغة stays مستقل at 2 of 19 periods and the Council pays 2 more slots in the most contested year.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Demarcation with أصول الفقه over دلالات الألفاظ — specifically الحقيقة والمجاز and العام والخاص. Proposed: البلاغة owns المجاز as a rhetorical choice; أصول الفقه owns it as a rule of استنباط. Needs writing down before both subjects are timetabled, not after.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is the full الجوهر المكنون a grade requirement or a mastery-track requirement? My recommendation is the mastery track (opt-in, pace-based, on the Ḥifẓ Track precedent per redline 2), with selections only in the grade curriculum. The opposite choice would roughly double the G11-G12 memorisation load.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Teacher capacity, which is the real constraint and not the syllabus. البلاغة cannot be taught by a teacher who studied it only as exam content — it requires someone with ذوق who can improvise a comparison on an unseen line. Staffing must be confirmed before G10 adoption, and the G8-G9 مضمّن phase must be delivered by a teacher briefed against the tag-hunting failure mode, or it will actively cause the harm it was designed to prevent.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Doctrinal framing of المجاز في القرآن. The scholarly disagreement is real and touches the عقيدة strand. Proposal: no engagement before G11; descriptive, non-partisan presentation from G11. The عقيدة owner should confirm the framing rather than البلاغة deciding it alone.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Should the G11-G12 تفسير paper carry a named بلاغي component (إعجاز)? If yes, who sets and marks it? My preference: التفسير sets it, البلاغة supplies the apparatus and moderates — but this must not become a second بلاغة paper in disguise.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION, flagged for review] The G9 combination of مضمّن form with independent assessment is the sharpest test of the board's orthogonality principle in this subject. It is right — it gives a diagnostic signal before G10 periods are committed — but it carries a live risk of pulling G9 teaching toward labelling. The mark-format cap (identification ≤ ~25%) is the control. If the Council will not enforce the cap, G9 should revert to embedded assessment.

[OPEN] Yoruba owe (proverbial comparison) is proposed at G8 as a genuine cognitive bridge into التشبيه rather than as decoration. Confirming which owe are appropriate, and who selects them, is a matter for staff with the relevant cultural competence and is not something this specification should presume to fix.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: Two distinct answers, and they must not be collapsed. (1) The first meaningful appearance of the LEARNING is G5, مضمّن inside النشيد والمحفوظات: explicitly planned ear-work — شعر vs نثر, البيت/الصدر/العجز, hearing the recurring beat of an أرجوزة, hearing that a line is "broken" — with zero terminology, zero symbols, zero بحور names. For a discipline whose object is an auditory regularity, this IS real learning, not a mention. (2) The first meaningful appearance of العروض AS A SCIENCE — الكتابة العروضية، الرموز، التفعيلات، تسمية البحر — is G8. "Meaningful" for this discipline means the student can take an unseen بيت he has never heard and say something true about it that he could not say by ear alone. That is not possible before the phonetic and morphological prerequisites close at the end of G7. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] + [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and no embedded strand. The learner is at الحروف وقليل المفردات; he does not yet have the letter itself, let alone the syllable. Any rhythmic chanting that occurs in حفظ or النشيد is delivery training, not prosody, and must not be relabelled as العروض.

Not taught. Same reason as G1. Note the hard budget fact: only ~7 periods/week exist at G1-G2 for everything outside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour. There is no honest way to claim a share of that for prosody.

Not taught. النشيد والمحفوظات begins here (منظومة التوحيد والإيمان), but its planned learning is memorisation, doctrinal content and clear articulation. Calling this مضمّن عروض would be a paper claim — the form vocabulary requires that the learning be explicitly planned, and at G3 it is not, nor should it be.

Not taught. The student meets his first sustained أرجوزة this year (متن تحفة الأطفال والغلمان, which is رجز), but his whole attention is correctly on التجويد content and on securing the memorisation. Loading a second, competing frame on the same text at the moment of first encounter would degrade both.

gradeByGrade.partner: النشيد والمحفوظات (and the recitation of متن تحفة الأطفال in التجويد)
gradeByGrade.content: Explicitly planned rhythmic ear-training, no terminology. Outcomes: (a) distinguish شعر from نثر on hearing; (b) name البيت، الشطر، الصدر، العجز; (c) hear الروي — that all lines of a poem end on the same letter — and identify it; (d) clap/tap the recurring beat of an أرجوزة he already knows; (e) when the teacher deliberately recites a line with a word added or dropped, say THAT the line is wrong before being told. Outcome (e) is the whole point and is directly assessable in recitation. NOTE: the G5 النشيد text in the submission is [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification] ("الفواكه الساقطة"); this strand attaches to whatever confirmed text the Council substitutes, and must not be designed around the unverified title.

gradeByGrade.partner: النشيد والمحفوظات (ديوان الإمام الشافعي + لامية ابن الوردي)
gradeByGrade.content: Same strand, deepened by contrast. This is the first year the repertoire holds two rhythmically DIFFERENT bodies at once: the رجز of the didactic متون (تحفة، الجزرية، الآجرومية-adjacent material) against the قصائد of the ديوان. Planned outcome: the student hears that these are not the same beat, and that a line from one cannot be sung to the tune of the other. He is given no name for the difference. Still no symbols, no تفعيلات. Cost: zero additional periods.

gradeByGrade.partner: النشيد والمحفوظات (ديوان الشافعي + تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري), with reinforcement inside الجزرية and ملحة الإعراب recitation
gradeByGrade.content: Final pre-technical year. Planned outcome: fluent self-monitoring — when the student's own حفظ of a منظومة stumbles, he can locate WHERE the line went wrong by feel, even though he cannot yet say why. He also meets, inside الصرف (لامية الأفعال), the الميزان الصرفي in its mature form. This is deliberately NOT the year to introduce الميزان العروضي: the two must be separated in time or they fuse. G7 is also the single most loaded year in the submitted design (الجزرية + ملحة الإعراب + لامية الأفعال + التفسير all at once); it has nothing to give.

DIFFERENTIATION. A bounded short course of one term (≈13 weeks × 2 periods = ~26 periods ≈ 17 clock hours), taught in the النشيد والمحفوظات slot, which is the discipline's own feeder. Content, in order: (1) الكتابة العروضية — writing what is pronounced, not what is spelled: التنوين = نون ساكنة، الشدة = حرفان (ساكن فمتحرك)، حذف همزة الوصل في الدرج، إشباع حركة الروي، الحروف التي تُكتب ولا تُنطق; (2) الرمز — المتحرك والساكن; (3) المقاطع: السبب الخفيف والثقيل، الوتد المجموع والمفروق، الفاصلة; (4) التفعيلات الثمان (فعولن، مفاعيلن، مفاعلتن، فاعلن، فاعلاتن، متفاعلن، مستفعلن، مفعولات) and an explicit, taught contrast with الميزان الصرفي — same word-shape logic, different object, never to be mixed; (5) five متداولة بحور only, taught to fluency, not sixteen surveyed: الرجز (first, because it is the metre of the institution's own متون), الرمل، المتقارب، الكامل، الوافر; (6) the doctrinal boundary, taught explicitly and not as an aside: القرآن ليس بشعر، ولا يُقطَّع، ولا يُجرى عليه ميزان الخليل — the student now has the technical means to see why, and التجويد's أحكام are not عروض. Deliverable: the student can scan an unseen بيت from the five taught بحور.
gradeByGrade.text: Taught from a school-prepared graded booklet; the teacher's source of authority is ميزان الذهب في صناعة شعر العرب (أحمد الهاشمي). No classical matn is memorised this year.

gradeByGrade.partner: النشيد والمحفوظات / حفظ المتون across all three programmes
gradeByGrade.content: No new content, no periods, deliberate consolidation. The G8 tool is now put to work as standing practice: every new منظومة entering memorisation is scanned before it is memorised, and مراجعة errors are diagnosed metrically ('you have dropped a سبب here'), not just corrected. This is the year the skill either becomes automatic or is lost. Giving G9 a second block of new بحور instead would be worse: the science's difficulty is not coverage, it is automaticity. G9 is also protected here because it is the الإعدادية exit year and because البلاغة plausibly opens at G9-G10 — stacking عروض terminology against بديع terminology in the same year produces the classic confusion of زحاف/علة with جناس/طباق.

Completion rotation: one term, 1-2 periods/week (~20 periods), sitting in the اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب band. Content: (1) the remaining بحور — الطويل، البسيط، الخفيف، السريع، المنسرح، الهزج، المجتث، المديد، المضارع، المقتضب، المتدارك — taught for confident recognition rather than for production; (2) الزحافات والعلل systematically, which is the real content of the science and is what makes an actually-occurring بيت differ from its ideal تفعيلة; (3) القافية in full: الروي، الوصل، الخروج، الردف، التأسيس، الدخيل، حركات القافية، أنواعها، وعيوبها. This band is chosen deliberately: it is the same band in which the Council has already placed مصطلح الحديث (G10-G11) — the point at which the school treats tool-sciences as differentiable — and by G10 the student can hold an abstract system with named exceptions.
gradeByGrade.text: Proposed memorised matn: المقدمة الخزرجية (الرامزة) في علمي العروض والقافية — for the strong cohort and on the إجازة parallel track. Mainstream cohort uses the graded text; the Khazrajiyya is notoriously terse and must not be imposed on everyone. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

gradeByGrade.partner: النقد والآداب (and الإنشاء والخطابة where verse composition is attempted)
gradeByGrade.content: Applied, inside the host subject. Metre becomes one dimension of reading a poem rather than an object in itself: why a poet's choice of بحر suits his غرض, what the long بحور afford that the short ones do not, why the didactic tradition chose الرجز for متون, how a زحاف changes the movement of a line. No separate block, no separate periods. Also available as a technical service to the إجازة track for candidates carrying منظومات.

gradeByGrade.partner: النقد والآداب / الإنشاء والخطابة / حفظ المتون and the إجازة track
gradeByGrade.content: Service and quality-control role only. The graduate uses عروض to (a) verify and repair his own and others' حفظ of منظومات, (b) read a classical شرح that assumes عروض vocabulary without stalling, (c) evaluate a printed edition of a متن and detect a corrupt hemistich, (d) at the top end, compose correct رجز — e.g. a short منظومة summarising a fiqh or nahw chapter as a graduation exercise, which is the institution reproducing its own pedagogy. No standalone G12 slot, and none should be created.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G8 — as a وحدة (one term), NOT as a مستقل subject, and never as a مستقل subject at any grade. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

WHY NOT ONE YEAR EARLIER (G7): three concrete blockers, each dated. (a) الميزان الصرفي must be fully secure before الميزان العروضي is introduced, or they fuse — the well-known student failure is looking for فاء/عين/لام الكلمة inside فاعلن, or writing فاعِل for فاعلن. لامية الأفعال completes at the end of G7; before that the morphological balance is still being built and the two balances would be met simultaneously. (b) الكتابة العروضية is impossible without a secure written-versus-pronounced distinction (تنوين as نون ساكنة، الشدة as two letters، dropping همزة الوصل في الدرج، letters written but not sounded). That distinction is what الجزرية installs, and الجزرية runs G6-G7. A student who scans before it closes will get almost every line wrong and will conclude the science is arbitrary — the hardest attitude to reverse. (c) G7 is, on the submission's own face, the most loaded year in the whole ladder (الجزرية + ملحة الإعراب + لامية الأفعال + التفسير + العقيدة + الفقه + الحديث/السيرة inside 19 periods). Any period taken there is taken from عروض's own prerequisites: self-defeating.

WHY NOT ONE YEAR LATER (G9 or later): (a) The payoff of عروض in THIS institution is not literary appreciation, it is error-detection in a متن-based pedagogy. The student's heaviest منظومة load lies ahead of him in G9-G12 and on the إجازة track. Every year the tool is delayed, more mis-memorised hemistichs fossilise, and fossilised حفظ is extremely expensive to correct later. G8 is the last year that still sits upstream of most of the memorisation it protects. (b) G9 is the الإعدادية exit year and the plausible opening of البلاغة; introducing عروض there guarantees terminological interference between زحاف/علة and بديع. (c) Anything pushed into G10-G12 competes with أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث، البلاغة، المنطق، أصول التفسير. In that competition a small tool-science with no examination stake is always the first thing cut — meaning "G10 introduction" in practice means "never taught". Placing the foundation at G8 and only the completion rotation at G10 protects the discipline from its own budget vulnerability.
prerequisites: Fully vowelled reading and writing — the student can supply and read الشكل on an unpointed line. Established by G5 (القراءة والتهجي G1-G5 + الإملاء as the longitudinal Arabic skill, per accepted redline 7).

Phonetic analysis of the written line: التنوين = نون ساكنة; الشدة = ساكن + متحرك; همزة الوصل drops في الدرج; letters written but not pronounced; the behaviour of المد. This is the single most load-bearing prerequisite for الكتابة العروضية and it is not an Arabic-language competency in this curriculum — it is a التجويد competency. Established by تحفة الأطفال (G4-G5, أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين والمدود) and completed by الجزرية (G6-G7, المخارج والصفات، الوقف والابتداء). Closes end of G7.

الميزان الصرفي — فاء/عين/لام الكلمة، الزائد، المحذوف، أوزان المجرد والمزيد. Needed BOTH as a transferable habit of thought (a word has a shape independent of its letters) AND as a thing to be explicitly distinguished from the prosodic balance. Established by البناء في الصرف (G6) and لامية الأفعال (G7). Closes end of G7.

النحو sufficient to read a بيت correctly aloud — i.e. not to mis-vowel a word ending and thereby mis-scan it. الآجرومية (G6) is enough for the G8 unit; ملحة الإعراب (G7) makes it comfortable. Note that ملحة الإعراب is itself an أرجوزة, so the نحو text doubles as scanning material.

A substantial memorised poetic repertoire — realistically several hundred أبيات — so that التقطيع is checked against an ear rather than performed as blind symbol-manipulation. Established cumulatively by النشيد والمحفوظات (G3-G7) plus the أراجيز carried in other subjects (تحفة الأطفال، الجزرية، ملحة الإعراب). Sufficient by end of G7.

Sustained accurate chanting/الإنشاد — the ability to deliver a line at an even pace without swallowing or padding syllables. Without it the student cannot hear his own scansion. Established from G3 onward through النشيد.
Symbol-pattern fluency: mapping sounds to a two-value notation and counting positions reliably. Trivially satisfied by the morning national curriculum; listed only so it is not silently assumed away.

classicalTexts.title: ميزان الذهب في صناعة شعر العرب — السيد أحمد الهاشمي
classicalTexts.grade: G8 (teacher's source of authority for the school-prepared graded booklet; NOT a student matn at this age)
classicalTexts.justification: The standard modern school treatment of العروض والقافية: graded, exercise-based, written for classroom use rather than for a scholar. It is the right spine for a 26-period G8 unit precisely because it is not a مختصر that presupposes a teacher's commentary. Modern, not classical — stated plainly so no one mistakes it for a متن to be memorised.

classicalTexts.title: المقدمة الخزرجية (المعروفة بالرامزة) في علمي العروض والقافية — الخزرجي
classicalTexts.grade: G10 (proposed memorised matn for the strong cohort and for the إجازة parallel track; not imposed on the mainstream rotation)
classicalTexts.justification: A منظومة on عروض وقافية that is itself a poem — the science demonstrating itself, which suits a متن-based institution and sits in the West African/Maghribi teaching lineage this school inherits. Caveat stated honestly: it is called الرامزة because it is deliberately allusive and compressed; it is unusable without a teacher and unusable as a first encounter, which is exactly why it is placed at G10 after the G8 foundation and never at G8. I am confident the work exists as named; the author's full name as commonly given (ضياء الدين أبو محمد عبد الله بن محمد الخزرجي) should be verified against a printed edition before it is entered in any syllabus document.

classicalTexts.title: الكافي في العروض والقوافي — الخطيب التبريزي (يحيى بن علي)
classicalTexts.grade: Teacher reference across G8-G12; not a student text at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: A compact classical prose treatment of both عروض and قافية, useful as the authority a teacher consults when a modern textbook and a classical شرح disagree on a term. Prose, so it offers nothing to memorise, which is precisely its value as a reference rather than a matn.

classicalTexts.title: العيون الغامزة على خبايا الرامزة — الدماميني (شرح على الخزرجية)
classicalTexts.grade: Teacher reference at G10-G12 if الخزرجية is adopted
classicalTexts.justification: The commentary usually named alongside the Khazrajiyya. I believe this work and this attribution are correct, but I am not confident enough to have it printed in a syllabus without a librarian or a scholar checking a physical edition first. Listed as uncertain deliberately rather than asserted.

classicalTexts.title: أهدى سبيل إلى علمي الخليل — محمود مصطفى
classicalTexts.grade: Possible alternative/supplementary teacher reference at G8-G10
classicalTexts.justification: A modern school-level treatment of العروض والقافية that I recall as widely used, but I am not confident enough of the exact title-plus-author pairing to authorise it. Do not enter it in a syllabus on my say-so; verify first.

classicalTexts.title: العروض الواضح وعلم القافية — محمد علي الهاشمي
classicalTexts.grade: Possible alternative teacher reference at G8
classicalTexts.justification: Recalled as a modern graded treatment, but I cannot confirm the exact title and authorship to the standard this board requires. Verify before use; do not substitute a guess for it.

classicalTexts.title: كتاب العروض المنسوب إلى الخليل بن أحمد الفراهيدي
classicalTexts.grade: — (must NOT be scheduled as a teaching text at any grade)
classicalTexts.justification: Listed here as a negative entry, to pre-empt a plausible-looking error. الخليل is the founder of the science and the بحور are his, but his own book on العروض is not available as a transmitted, teachable text; the science reaches us through later writers. Anyone drafting the syllabus who reaches for 'the original' must be told this in advance.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Specific to this discipline and this ladder, not generic:

1. BALANCE FUSION. Introduce التفعيلات before لامية الأفعال closes (end of G7) and students merge الميزان الصرفي with الميزان العروضي — hunting for فاء/عين/لام inside فاعلن, treating مستفعلن as a صرف pattern, writing فاعِل for فاعلن. Once fused, the two are very hard to separate, and the damage lands on الصرف, which matters more.

2. SPELLING-DRIVEN SCANSION. Introduce الكتابة العروضية before الجزرية closes and the student scans what is written instead of what is said: he counts the silent ا of "هذا", keeps همزة الوصل in درج, treats التنوين as a mark rather than a نون. Every answer comes out wrong for reasons he cannot see. The predictable conclusion — "this science has no rules, only the teacher's verdict" — is the single most damaging attitude a tool-science can acquire, and it is not recoverable by re-teaching later.

3. DESTROYING THE FEEDER. At G5-G7 النشيد والمحفوظات is doing something العروض cannot do for itself: building the ear and the repertoire. Converting that slot into technical instruction consumes the prerequisite in order to teach the thing that depends on it. The correct early form is مضمّن precisely so the feeder keeps feeding.

4. SYMBOL-MANIPULATION WITHOUT HEARING. A younger student can be drilled to produce / and o correctly and still be unable to notice that a recited line is broken. That is a complete loss of the one payoff that justifies the subject in this school, while leaving an exam score that falsely reports success.

5. PURE DISPLACEMENT COST. At G6-G7 every period given to عروض comes out of الآجرومية، ملحة الإعراب، البناء، لامية الأفعال، الجزرية — its own prerequisites. There is no neutral place to take it from inside a 19-period ceiling.

6. DOCTRINAL CARELESSNESS AT THE WRONG AGE. The boundary "القرآن ليس بشعر ولا يُقطَّع" has to be taught alongside scansion. A child young enough to enjoy tapping out beats is old enough to start tapping them on the Qur'an hour. The boundary is stated clearly and technically at G8 to an adolescent who can hold it; giving a nine-year-old the tool without the boundary is an avoidable risk to the ring-fenced Qur'an hour.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Equally specific, and in this institution the delay risks are the larger of the two:

1. FOSSILISED حفظ. This is a متن-based school. From G8 onward the student is memorising منظومات continuously, and on the إجازة track possibly at volume. Without scansion he has no independent means of detecting that a hemistich he learned from a mishearing, a bad photocopy or a weak edition is corrupt. Mis-memorised lines set hard and are far more expensive to correct than to prevent. Every year of delay past G8 is another year of منظومات memorised without a check.

2. THE SUBJECT SILENTLY NEVER HAPPENS. Deferred to G10-G12, عروض competes with أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث، البلاغة، المنطق، أصول التفسير for a 19-period ceiling. A small, unexamined, "cultural-sounding" science loses that competition every single year. "Introduce it in الثانوية" is, in practice, the decision not to teach it — which is the default outcome the submission's silence would produce if nobody names it.

3. النقد والآداب COLLAPSES INTO PARAPHRASE. Without metre a student reading a قصيدة at G11-G12 can only discuss what it says. He cannot discuss how it is built, cannot explain why a line lands, cannot distinguish verse from ornate prose analytically. The literary subject is hollowed out one grade downstream.

4. CLASSICAL COMMENTARY BECOMES UNREADABLE IN PLACES. شروح of منظومات routinely make metrical remarks (a word read this way "for the metre", a ضرورة شعرية, a زحاف). A student without عروض hits these and either skips them or misreads them as grammar.

5. INSTITUTIONAL REPRODUCTION FAILS. A graduate who cannot scan cannot teach a منظومة accurately to the next cohort, cannot check an edition before putting it in front of children, and cannot compose the school's own didactic verse. For a school whose whole method is منظومات, that is a succession problem, not an enrichment gap.

6. THE ضرورة/إعجاز POINT GOES UNMADE. The claim that the Qur'an is not poetry is left as an assertion the student takes on trust, when it could be a thing he can demonstrate technically. Delay leaves that gap open through exactly the years when students start meeting the claim from outside.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12, العروض is not a subject on the timetable. It is a working instrument the graduate carries into three other places: النقد والآداب, الإنشاء والخطابة, and the maintenance of his own and others' حفظ (including on the إجازة track). Form: مضمّن. Periods: zero. Assessment: embedded in the host subjects; no separate G12 examination, and none should be invented.

What the graduate can actually do because of it:
- Take an unseen بيت he has never heard, write it in الكتابة العروضية correctly (تنوين as نون، الشدة as two letters، همزة الوصل dropped في الدرج، الروي given its إشباع), mark المتحرك والساكن, resolve the مقاطع, and name the بحر — fluently for the متداولة بحور, by recognition for the rare ones.
- Name the زحافات and العلل actually present in a line and explain why the real line differs from the ideal تفعيلة, rather than declaring the line broken.
- Analyse a قافية completely: الروي، الردف، التأسيس، الدخيل، الوصل، الخروج، حركات القافية، نوعها، and identify its عيوب.
- Hear a recited منظومة and locate the exact foot at which it went wrong, then repair it — on his own حفظ, on a student's, or against a printed edition he suspects.
- Read a classical شرح through its metrical remarks without stalling, and read a ضرورة شعرية as a ضرورة rather than as a grammatical error.
- Compose correct رجز: at minimum a short منظومة versifying a chapter of fiqh or nahw as a graduation exercise — i.e. he can add to the tradition his own school teaches by, not merely consume it.
- State and demonstrate, technically rather than merely doctrinally, why the Qur'an is not poetry and why the science of الخليل is not applied to it — and why the rhythms of التجويد belong to a different order entirely.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the ceiling of 19 periods/week at G3-G12 and 7 at G1-G2, this discipline is unusually cheap, and that cheapness is a load-bearing part of the argument for including it at all.

G1-G2: 0 periods. (No claim on the 7-period budget. None is defensible.)
G3-G4: 0 periods.
G5-G7: 0 ADDITIONAL periods. The مضمّن ear-strand lives entirely inside the existing النشيد والمحفوظات teaching and inside متن recitation; it changes what the teacher plans and marks, not what the timetable holds.
G8: 2 periods/week for ONE TERM ONLY (~13 weeks ≈ 26 periods ≈ 17 clock hours), taken from the النشيد والمحفوظات slot for that term. Net annual addition to the 19-period ceiling: ZERO if النشيد yields its slot for one term (recommended — the unit is an intensification of النشيد's own work, not a rival to it); otherwise +2 for one term and 0 for the other two.
G9: 0 periods. Consolidation only, inside existing حفظ and مراجعة practice.
G10: 1-2 periods/week for ONE TERM (~13-20 periods), taken inside the اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب band, not added on top of it. Net addition: 0 to +2, one term only.
G11-G12: 0 periods.

TOTAL LIFETIME COST across all twelve years: roughly 40-46 periods of dedicated time, about 27-31 clock hours — under half a percent of the non-Qur'an instructional budget of the whole 12-year ladder, and it never holds a permanent weekly slot in any year. Any proposal that gives العروض a مستقل weekly slot for a full year should be rejected on both curricular and budgetary grounds: the science does not need it, and the ceiling cannot bear it.
departuresFromSubmission: The submission is silent on العروض. I am refusing the two default readings of that silence. It is NOT a subject to be dropped, and it is NOT a 'secondary-years subject' to be parked in G10-G12 by default. Silence here is an unmade decision, and the decision I am making is: begin مضمّن at G5, differentiate as a وحدة at G8.

I am declining مستقل status at every one of the twelve grades. This overrides the implicit expectation — visible in how other الآلة sciences are handled in the submission — that a discipline earns a standalone identity when it matures. العروض's whole content is finite (الكتابة العروضية، المقاطع، التفعيلات، البحور، الزحافات والعلل، القافية) and teachable in roughly 30 clock hours. Giving it a permanent weekly slot would be forcing symmetry with its neighbours at real cost to النحو، الصرف، البلاغة and أصول الفقه, which are genuinely continuous disciplines.

I am assigning the G8 unit to the النشيد والمحفوظات slot. The submission treats النشيد as a pure memorisation-and-repertoire strand (منظومة التوحيد G3, ديوان الشافعي G6-G7, plus two [UNVERIFIED] titles). I am declaring النشيد to be عروض's feeder discipline and therefore the correct source of its time. This changes النشيد's status from decorative to structural and should be recorded as such.

I am adding an explicitly planned prosodic ear-strand to النشيد والمحفوظات from G5, which the submission does not contain. This is a change to what the النشيد teacher plans and marks, at zero timetable cost, and it is the difference between العروض being learnable at G8 and being merely examinable at G8.

I am placing an explicit doctrinal boundary — أن القرآن ليس بشعر ولا يُقطَّع، وأن أحكام التجويد ليست عروضاً — inside the G8 unit as required taught content, not as a teacher's aside. Nothing in the submission anticipates this, because nothing in the submission anticipates the subject; but a school with a constitutionally ring-fenced Qur'an hour cannot hand adolescents a scansion tool without simultaneously bounding it.

On the two [UNVERIFIED] titles (القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية at G4, الفواكه الساقطة at G5): I have designed the G5 ear-strand to attach to whatever confirmed النشيد text the Council substitutes, and have proposed no replacement text of my own, per accepted redline 4.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY — النشيد والمحفوظات (primary feeder). This is the relationship that determines the whole lifecycle. النشيد supplies the ear, the repertoire and, at G8, the timetable slot. Without it العروض would have to be built from nothing at G8 and would need three times the periods. In return, العروض at G9+ makes النشيد's memorisation faster and more accurate. Reciprocal, and the strongest link the subject has.

FED BY — التجويد (تحفة الأطفال G4-G5, الجزرية G6-G7).
