Non-obvious but decisive: التجويد is where this curriculum teaches the difference between the written letter and the pronounced sound, which is the entire technical basis of الكتابة العروضية. عروض's start date is set by الجزرية's finish date. The two sciences must nonetheless be kept strictly apart in the student's mind — see the prohibition below.
FED BY — الصرف (البناء في الصرف G6, لامية الأفعال G7). Supplies the habit of reading a word as a shape. Also supplies the thing عروض must be explicitly contrasted with, in the G8 unit itself.
FED BY — النحو (الآجرومية G6, ملحة الإعراب G7). A بيت cannot be scanned if it is mis-vowelled. ملحة الإعراب is itself an أرجوزة, so the نحو matn doubles as scanning material at G8 — use it.

FED BY — الإملاء / القراءة والتهجي. Supplies fully vowelled reading and writing by G5. Per accepted redline 7 الإملاء stays longitudinal inside اللغة العربية; عروض borrows from it and must not become a pretext to make it standalone.

FEEDS — حفظ المتون across ALL THREE programmes, and the إجازة parallel track. The error-detection and repair function is the subject's highest-value output in this specific institution and the main reason it differentiates at G8 rather than later.

FEEDS — النقد والآداب (G11-G12 presumptively). عروض gives that subject its formal dimension; without it, literary study reduces to paraphrase of content. The G10 completion rotation is deliberately sited in that band so the handover is immediate.

FEEDS — الإنشاء والخطابة, but only if the Council decides نظم (verse composition) is a wanted outcome. If yes, عروض becomes a production tool at G11-G12; if no, it stays purely analytic. This is a live dependency, not a settled one.

FEEDS — البلاغة, weakly and asymmetrically. البلاغة does not need عروض (معاني، بيان، بديع stand on their own), but a بلاغة teacher discussing موسيقى الشعر is better off with students who can scan. Do not make عروض a prerequisite for البلاغة; the sequencing runs the other way in convenience only.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE — البلاغة, specifically البديع. جناس، سجع، تصريع are sound-play at the level of the word; عروض is quantitative metre at the level of the syllable. Where the two brush against each other (التصريع, موسيقى داخلية) the ownership must be written into both syllabi. Teaching them in the same year invites terminological cross-contamination, which is a further reason for the G8/G10 placement against a G9-G10 البلاغة opening.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — الصرف's ميزان. The ONLY correct treatment is to teach the distinction explicitly and early in the G8 unit. Silence produces fusion.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — النشيد والمحفوظات. عروض is not a memorisation subject and must not be assessed by how much poetry the student holds. Its assessment object is analysis of unseen lines.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — النقد والآداب. عروض stops at the description of form. Judgement, taste, literary history and evaluation belong to النقد; that is why عروض hands over at G11 rather than expanding.

MUST NOT COLONISE — التجويد and حفظ القرآن. This is the hardest boundary in the subject and it is a prohibition, not an overlap to be managed: the Qur'an is not scanned, the بحور are not applied to it, and the مدود and غنن of التجويد are not prosodic quantities. The Qur'an hour is constitutionally ring-fenced; عروض has no business inside it in any form, at any grade. State this in the G8 syllabus in writing.
openQuestions: Does النشيد والمحفوظات actually hold a weekly period at G5-G9, or is it itself مضمّن inside اللغة العربية? The G8 وحدة is costed at zero net periods on the assumption that النشيد holds a slot it can lend for one term. If النشيد has no slot, the G8 unit costs a real +2 periods for one term and the Council must fund it explicitly. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

The G5 النشيد text in the submission is "الفواكه الساقطة" [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification]. The G5 ear-strand is designed to attach to whatever confirmed text replaces it; no substitute is proposed here, per accepted redline 4. The Council must confirm a G5 النشيد text before the G5 strand can be written into a syllabus.

Is المقدمة الخزرجية (الرامزة) adopted as a memorised matn at G10 and on the إجازة track, or does the mainstream cohort finish on a graded modern text with الخزرجية reserved for the إجازة layer only? The work's deliberate terseness makes universal imposition unwise. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Before anything is printed: verify against physical editions (a) the full name and dates of الخزرجي, (b) العيون الغامزة على خبايا الرامزة and its attribution to الدماميني, (c) أهدى سبيل إلى علمي الخليل and its attribution to محمود مصطفى, (d) العروض الواضح وعلم القافية and its attribution to محمد علي الهاشمي. Items (b), (c) and (d) are rated uncertain here and must not enter a syllabus on my recall alone.

Does the ثانوية exit certificate examine العروض, and if not, does its absence from the certificate guarantee it gets cut in practice? If the Council wants the subject to survive contact with a loaded G10-G12, it may need a named line on the certificate even though the subject has no standalone slot. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Is نظم (composing verse, minimally رجز) a wanted graduate outcome? This single ruling decides whether عروض at G11-G12 is analytic only or becomes a production tool inside الإنشاء والخطابة, and whether the G10 rotation needs a composition component. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Yoruba-context question: learners arrive with an oral-poetic ear formed in a rich local oral-verse culture. Should the G5-G7 مضمّن strand deliberately contrast Arabic quantitative metre with the rhythm of local oral verse, as a bridge — or keep the two apart to avoid transferring the wrong expectations? I judge this pedagogically promising but it is a local-culture ruling, not mine to make. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Teacher supply: العروض requires a teacher who can scan fluently and hear error live, and this is a scarcer competency than النحو or الفقه teaching. If no such teacher exists on staff, the honest sequence is to train one before G8 opens, not to run the unit from a textbook. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Sequencing dependency on البلاغة, which is undesigned: if البلاغة turns out to open at G8 rather than G9-G10, the terminological-interference argument would push the عروض foundation unit to G9 instead. This lifecycle should be re-checked once البلاغة's placement is fixed.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G10. "Meaningful" for this discipline has a precise test, and it is not "the student can recite a definition." المنطق is a second-order science: its objects are terms about terms (الكلي، الجزئي، الحد، الرسم) and propositions about propositions (التناقض، العكس، صورة القياس). A student is only learning when he can (a) take an unfamiliar term he has never been given a definition for and construct a جامع مانع definition of it, and (b) take an argument stated in ordinary Arabic prose and say whether the conclusion actually follows. Both require sustained second-order abstraction plus the Arabic to read a متن with a شرح unaided. The first point in this ladder where both are reliably present is G10 — after the الآجرومية (G6) → ملحة الإعراب (G7) → G8-G9 نحو consolidation sequence has closed, and at roughly age 15. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Anything earlier produces memorised jargon with no referent, which is precisely the historic failure mode of السلم المنورق in madrasa practice: students who can chant the نظم and cannot detect a bad definition. علم الكلام, the second half of this register entry, appears later still — G12 — and for a different reason (see differentiationPoint and prematureIntroductionRisks).

gradeByGrade.content: لا يُدرَّس ولا يُذكر. Not taught, and not claimed as embedded. The only cognitive substrate relevant at this age — distinguishing a thing from its name, and sorting objects by a shared property — is produced incidentally by القراءة والتهجي and by الحروف وقليل المفردات. Naming that 'منطق مضمّن' would be curriculum inflation: it would let the school report a subject it is not teaching. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

لا يُدرَّس. The 7-period G1-G2 ceiling is fully committed to القراءة والتهجي, اللغة العربية (الحروف والمفردات), التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي. Nothing may be taken from those for a discipline whose prerequisites are eight years away.

لا يُدرَّس. الحديث مضمّن and منظومة التوحيد والإيمان build memory and cadence, not inference. Any 'thinking skills' work at this stage belongs to the morning national curriculum's maths strand and is outside this scope.

لا يُدرَّس. Note for the board: the التوحيد والفقه مدمج block at G4 will naturally raise 'why' questions from children. Answering them well is عقيدة teaching, not كلام, and must not be re-badged as this subject.

لا يُدرَّس. This is the نواقض الإسلام year (retained under redline 6 with protective framing). Introducing any argumentative or disputational apparatus in the same year would directly undercut that protective framing by handing a 10-year-old the vocabulary of refutation. Explicitly kept clear. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

لا يُدرَّس. G6 is the heaviest entry year in the whole ladder (الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية، التفسير العملي والترجمة). The definitional habits المنطق will later formalise are being laid down here in their proper home: النحو's own تعريفات (الاسم ما دل على معنى في نفسه غير مقترن بزمن) are a worked example of حد with جنس and فصل. The نحو teacher should be briefed that this is what he is modelling — but it is taught as النحو and assessed as النحو.

لا يُدرَّس. ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال are consuming the abstraction budget. Introducing a competing system of definition here would cross-contaminate: students confuse النحو's حد with المنطق's حد before either is secure.
لا يُدرَّس. This is the year where the case for an early taster is most tempting and should be refused. See prematureIntroductionRisks.

لا يُدرَّس — deliberate, not neglect. A one-term G9 'introduction to المنطق' was considered and rejected: it would deliver الكلي/الجزئي/التصور/التصديق as vocabulary and stop short of القياس, which is the payoff that makes the vocabulary meaningful. Fragmenting the discipline across two years to look tidy would buy nothing and would cost a G9 slot in the exit year of الإعدادية. Concentrate instead at G10. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.text: السلم المنورق في علم المنطق — عبد الرحمن الأخضري (مع شرح مختار يختاره المدرّس)
gradeByGrade.content: المنطق: قسم التصورات. Two periods/week for ONE term only (recommended Term 2), in a term-rotation slot. Content, specifically: موضوع المنطق وثمرته وحكم الاشتغال به؛ العلم: تصور وتصديق؛ دلالة اللفظ (مطابقة، تضمن، التزام)؛ الكلي والجزئي؛ النسب الأربع بين الكليين (تساوٍ، تباين، عموم مطلق، عموم من وجه) with Venn-style board work; الكليات الخمس (جنس، نوع، فصل، خاص، عرض عام)؛ الحد التام والناقص والرسم التام والناقص؛ شروط التعريف (أن يكون جامعًا مانعًا، وامتناع الدور والتعريف بالأخفى والألفاظ المجازية). Taught through the نظم — the lines are memorised (cheap for a ḥuffāẓ cohort and it fixes the terminology) — but memorisation is NOT the assessment. Assessed on: critiquing supplied faulty definitions and naming the defect, and constructing a جامع مانع definition of a term not covered in class. Deliberate placement note: the الأخضري authorship links this directly to متن الأخضري already used for فقه at G6, which is a real continuity for a Maliki-milieu West African school. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.text: السلم المنورق (إتمام) — عبد الرحمن الأخضري؛ إيساغوجي للأبهري as an optional parallel/Ijazah-track متن
gradeByGrade.content: المنطق: قسم التصديقات. One period/week, full year, own subject identity, own mark. Content: القضية وأقسامها (حملية وشرطية؛ موجبة وسالبة؛ كلية وجزئية وشخصية ومهملة)؛ التناقض وشروطه الثمانية؛ العكس المستوي؛ القياس الاقتراني وشروط إنتاجه بالأشكال الأربعة؛ القياس الاستثنائي؛ مواد القياس (البرهان، الجدل، الخطابة، الشعر، المغالطة)؛ ثم وحدة صريحة في المغالطات الشائعة — مصادرة على المطلوب، الدور، التعميم الفاسد، مهاجمة الشخص، الاحتكام إلى الكثرة, taught with live Arabic, English and Yoruba examples drawn from public argument. One explicit lesson is reserved for القياس الأصولي vs القياس المنطقي — they share a name and are different operations, and this is the single most common confusion this subject can either cause or prevent. Mastery threshold: evaluates 8 of 10 unseen arguments correctly and states the defect in the invalid ones. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.text: No student متن prescribed. Teacher-reference works only (see classicalTexts).
gradeByGrade.content: علم الكلام, taught as a bounded component inside the G12 العقيدة block — one period/week of that block, with its own syllabus, its own section on the paper and its own mark, so it stays separately traceable. It is taught as a META-discipline: how Muslims argued creed, not a creed to adopt. Content: نشأة علم الكلام وأسبابها (الفتنة، الترجمة، الجدال مع المخالفين)؛ تعريف المتكلمين وأبرز المدارس (المعتزلة، الأشاعرة، الماتريدية، ومنهج أهل الحديث)؛ المسائل الكبرى التي دار حولها النزاع (الصفات، خلق القرآن، القدر، الإيمان والعمل، التحسين والتقبيح العقليان)؛ أنواع الأدلة المستعملة (دليل الحدوث، دليل الإمكان، دليل التمانع) analysed AS syllogisms using the G11 apparatus؛ موقف المانعين من الكلام وحججهم. المنطق itself is not timetabled at G12: its instrumental function is discharged and it is exercised مضمّن inside أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث, الإنشاء والخطابة and this كلام component. Mastery threshold: a 600–800 word Arabic essay stating one kalām dispute fairly from both sides and naming the type of دليل each side used. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G10 — المنطق differentiates as a distinct named entity there, under its own name, with its own mark, in a rotational term block. Why G10 and not G9: (a) the نحو ladder (الآجرومية G6 → ملحة الإعراب G7 → G8-G9 consolidation) only closes at the end of G9; السلم المنورق is a نظم whose language assumes a reader who can parse a line of poetry unaided, and a G9 student is still acquiring that. (b) G9 is the exit year of الإعدادية and its assessment load is already committed. (c) The abstraction required — holding a proposition as an object while judging a second proposition about it — is not securely available to most learners before roughly 15. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Why G10 and not G11: the receiving disciplines arrive at G10-G11. مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10-G11 under accepted redline 1, and its entire opening apparatus is definitional (تعريف الصحيح: ما اتصل سنده بنقل العدل الضابط... with شروط that must be جامعة مانعة). أصول الفقه on any plausible placement needs الحد، التقسيم، الكليات in the same window. If المنطق arrives at G11 instead, each of those subjects invents its own definitional vocabulary in G10, inconsistently, and the student meets the same concept three times under three names. G10-التصورات before or alongside مصطلح الحديث is the whole point of the placement. علم الكلام does NOT differentiate at all — it never becomes مستقل. It appears once, at G12, bound to العقيدة, and that is deliberate (see departuresFromSubmission).
prerequisites: Ability to read an unfamiliar Arabic نظم line and parse it syntactically without a teacher's crutch — established by the end of G9, on the الآجرومية (G6) → ملحة الإعراب (G7) → G8-G9 نحو consolidation track. Without this, السلم المنورق is decoded, not read.

الصرف to the level of recognising the pattern and root of an unfamiliar term before defining it — established G6 (البناء في الصرف) → G7 (لامية الأفعال). Definition-work constantly requires saying what وزن a term is and what its اشتقاق implies.

A settled, non-anxious عقيدة — i.e. the student has already been taught WHAT is believed and on what نص, before being shown that Muslims argued about it. Established across التوحيد والعقيدة G4-G6 and العقيدة G7-G9. This is the prerequisite for علم الكلام specifically, and it is why كلام is at G12 and not G10.

Familiarity with definition-by-genus-and-differentia as an already-lived experience, not a new idea — established informally by النحو's own تعريفات at G6 and by الفقه's شروط/أركان structure (الأخضري, G6). المنطق at G10 formalises something the student has been doing for four years; that is what makes it land.

Sustained second-order abstraction (reasoning about the form of a statement independently of whether its content is true) — not established by any single subject; it is a developmental threshold reached around G9-G10. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] The morning national curriculum's mathematics strand supports it but sits outside this scope and cannot be relied on.

Sufficient Arabic composition to write a paragraph of connected reasoned prose — needed for the G12 كلام essay threshold; established by الإنشاء والخطابة wherever that differentiates (G8-G10 range, another specialist's call). [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] if الإنشاء lands later than G11.

classicalTexts.title: السلم المنورق في علم المنطق — عبد الرحمن بن محمد الأخضري
classicalTexts.justification: The correct primary متن for this school. It is a short منظومة in علم المنطق, it is the standard elementary logic text across the Maghribi–West African Maliki teaching tradition into which Nigeria's Arabic-Islamic scholarship sits, and its author is the same الأخضري whose فقه متن is already retained at G6 under redline 3 — so the student meets a known author, which lowers the entry cost of an intimidating subject. Being versified, it suits a cohort that is already ḥuffāẓ: the terminology fixes cheaply in memory, freeing class time for the actual work of definition-critique and validity-testing. A شرح is required; the board should let the teacher choose one he can actually teach rather than mandating a specific commentary.

classicalTexts.title: إيساغوجي — أثير الدين المفضل بن عمر الأبهري
classicalTexts.grade: G11 optional parallel text; recommended as the Ijazah-track extension متن
classicalTexts.justification: The other standard elementary logic متن, in prose rather than نظم, and the one a graduate is most likely to meet as assumed background in a first-year أصول or منطق course abroad. Recommended as a parallel/opt-in text under the الإجازة track (accepted redline 2), not as a second compulsory متن — two elementary logic matns in the same year would be duplication, not depth.

classicalTexts.title: تهذيب المنطق — سعد الدين التفتازاني
classicalTexts.grade: Not prescribed to any grade; الإجازة track only, for the strongest G12 students
classicalTexts.justification: Denser and more compressed than السلم; correct as a mastery-track extension for a student who has finished السلم and wants more, and wrong as a class text at any grade here. Listing it as an available ceiling prevents the strongest students from stalling.

classicalTexts.title: الرسالة الشمسية في القواعد المنطقية — نجم الدين عمر الكاتبي القزويني
classicalTexts.justification: Beyond the ceiling of a 12-year school curriculum. Named here so the board knows where the ladder continues and does not mistake G11 for completion of the discipline.

classicalTexts.title: الرد على المنطقيين — ابن تيمية
classicalTexts.justification: The G12 كلام component teaches موقف المانعين من الكلام وحججهم, and that position must be represented from a primary work rather than caricatured in a teacher's summary. Teacher reading, not student text. The school must not teach المنطق for two years and then treat the critique of it as a footnote; nor should it teach the critique without the student having first learned the thing being critiqued — which is another reason the sequence is منطق G10-G11 then كلام G12.

classicalTexts.title: معيار العلم — أبو حامد الغزالي
classicalTexts.justification: Relevant to the G12 discussion of why a logic prolegomenon came to stand at the head of أصول works, which is exactly the bridge between this subject and أصول الفقه. Teacher reading only.

classicalTexts.title: أم البراهين (المقدمات / العقيدة الصغرى) — محمد بن يوسف السنوسي
classicalTexts.grade: G12 specimen ONLY, read ABOUT and not adopted — and only if the Council so rules
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident the work exists and that it is the most widely circulated Ash'ari creed epitome in West Africa; a Nigerian graduate will certainly encounter it. The G12 كلام component is supposed to show how kalām argues, and this is the nearest available specimen. BUT it is a creed text, and prescribing it in a school whose عقيدة strand includes نواقض الإسلام would create a direct contradiction between two subjects. My recommendation: extracts studied as an object of analysis (what kind of دليل is this? what question is it answering?), never as a creed to be memorised or adopted, and only with the عقيدة specialist co-teaching. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

classicalTexts.title: جوهرة التوحيد — إبراهيم اللقاني
classicalTexts.justification: Exists and is widely taught in the region; listed only so the board knows it was considered and set aside. Same conflict as أم البراهين, with no offsetting advantage over it for this purpose.

classicalTexts.title: إيضاح المبهم من معاني السلم — أحمد الدمنهوري
classicalTexts.grade: Candidate شرح for السلم at G10-G11
classicalTexts.justification: I believe a commentary of this title on السلم المنورق exists and is attributed to الدمنهوري, but I cannot confirm the exact title-author pairing to the standard this board requires. Do NOT print it in a syllabus on my authority — verify against a physical copy or a catalogued edition first, or let the teacher nominate a شرح he owns.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Specific, not generic. (1) Vacuous memorisation with zero transfer. A G7-G8 student can flawlessly recite «الكلي ما لا يمنع تصور مفهومه من وقوع الشركة فيه» and be unable to say whether "رجل" is كلي. This is the documented, ordinary failure of السلم in madrasa teaching, and it is worse than not teaching it, because the school then believes the subject has been covered and never revisits it. (2) Weaponised half-logic. A 12-year-old handed the FORM of refutation before the substance produces a child who "corrects" his teacher, his imam and his father with a malformed قياس. In a Yoruba Muslim community where the school's standing rests on producing respectful, recognisably well-formed students, this is a reputational risk to SHRS and it discredits the subject for the cohort behind. It is the same protective logic the Board already accepted for نواقض الإسلام at G5 (redline 6), applied to method rather than content. (3) Cross-contamination with النحو. The حد of المنطق and the تعريف of النحو look alike and behave differently. Introduced while الآجرومية/ملحة are still being consolidated (G6-G8), the two systems interfere and the student ends with a weaker grip on both. (4) علم الكلام before عقيدة is settled. Showing a 13-year-old that Muslims disputed the صفات and خلق القرآن, before العقيدة G4-G9 has finished giving him a settled position and its نصوص, delivers doubt without the equipment to resolve it. The classical caution against الكلام for beginners is a developmental judgement before it is a juristic one, and it is correct on developmental grounds alone. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] (5) Straight opportunity cost. Every period given to منطق at G7-G9 comes out of the 19 and is taken from النحو, الصرف and حفظ consolidation — which are this subject's own prerequisites. Early introduction literally consumes the conditions of its own success.
lifecycles.delayRisks: Also specific. (1) The receiving disciplines improvise. If المنطق is not in place by G10, مصطلح الحديث (differentiating G10-G11 per redline 1) and أصول الفقه each build their own ad-hoc definitional vocabulary. The student learns حد, رسم, جامع مانع, كلي three separate times under three teachers with three sets of terms, and never sees that they are one apparatus. This is not a hypothetical: it is what happens by default in curricula that omit المنطق. (2) The graduate is under-equipped for onward study. A leaver entering a Nigerian Arabic-Islamic degree, al-Azhar, or a Gulf/Madinah faculty meets منطق-level vocabulary as assumed background in first-year أصول and عقيدة courses, and meets the مقدمة المنطقية standing at the head of major أصول works. Without إيساغوجي/السلم-level competence he loses his first year to catching up. Given SHRS's stated international ambitions this is a direct cost to the institution's placement record. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] (3) No defence against modern polemic. This is the strongest argument and it is a live Nigerian one. The graduate will meet sectarian argument, online da'wah disputation, secular critique of Islam, and political-religious rhetoric, and if he has memorised conclusions without method, he can only answer by repeating conclusions louder. A student who can name a مصادرة على المطلوب or a تعميم فاسد in a text — in Arabic, English and Yoruba — is doing something no other subject on this register teaches him to do. (4) If it is not at G12 it is never. There is no G13. A discipline deferred past G12 is not deferred, it is deleted, for every student who does not continue to tertiary study — which is most of them. (5) Wasted downstream investment. أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث, النقد and الإنشاء والخطابة all run at reduced efficiency without it; delay does not save periods, it just spends them less well elsewhere.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 the subject has two distinct states and the board should not blur them. المنطق is no longer timetabled: it has become مضمّن, an operating tool exercised inside أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث, الإنشاء والخطابة and the كلام component. Its instrumental function is complete — a tool that still needs its own weekly period at G12 has not been learned. علم الكلام is the subject's only G12 presence: one period per week inside the العقيدة block, مدمج with العقيدة as its named partner, separately syllabused, separately marked. What the graduate can actually do because of this subject: define a term by حد تام or رسم and test any definition for being جامعًا مانعًا, catching دور and تعريف بالأخفى; take an argument buried in ordinary Arabic prose, restate it as a قياس, name its شكل and say whether the conclusion follows; state the نقيض and the عكس of a given proposition correctly; name and identify at least six common مغالطات in a live text — a khutbah, a newspaper column, a recorded debate — in Arabic, English or Yoruba; state the main questions over which علم الكلام arose, who held what, and what KIND of دليل each side used, without either adopting a school by slogan or condemning one by slogan; open an أصول الفقه work at its مقدمة منطقية and read it without stalling. That last one is the practical admissions-level test, and it is the honest measure of whether the G10-G12 allocation worked.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Deliberately the smallest footprint on this register, which is the reason it fits under the 19-period ceiling at all. G1–G9: ZERO periods. Nothing requested, nothing embedded, no claim on the 7-period G1-G2 budget or the 19-period G3-G9 budget. G10: 2 periods/week for ONE term only, held in a term-rotation slot shared with another bounded subject — annualised cost against the 19 is about 0.7 of a weekly period, and in the two terms it is not running the slot is free for its rotation partner (the partner is another specialist's call; العروض or a bounded الدراسات الحديثة unit are the natural candidates). G11: 1 period/week, full year, مستقل — a genuine, permanent 1-in-19 claim, and the only one this subject makes. G12: 1 period/week taken FROM WITHIN the existing العقيدة allocation, not added to it — net additional cost to the 19 is zero, conditional on العقيدة holding at least 2 periods/week at G12. If العقيدة at G12 is only 1 period/week, this design fails and the كلام component must either take a genuine extra period or be cut; that is a real dependency, not a formality. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Total lifetime footprint across all twelve years: approximately 1.7 period-years. The Qur'an hour is untouched at every grade.
departuresFromSubmission: The submission is silent on this subject across G1-G7, and I am RATIFYING that silence rather than filling it. The subject appears in the 26-subject register, but appearing in a register is not a claim on a grade. I place it nowhere in G1-G9 and I decline to invent a مضمّن presence to make the register look complete. Reason: everything that could honestly be called 'embedded logic' at G1-G9 is already the proper business of النحو (its تعريفات), الفقه (its شروط and أركان) and the morning maths strand. Re-badging their work as this subject would let SHRS report teaching it while teaching nothing.

I am SPLITTING the single register entry «المنطق وعلم الكلام» into two chronologically separated components with different forms, different partners and different justifications: المنطق at G10-G11, علم الكلام at G12 only. The register treats them as one subject because the classical curriculum links them; the pedagogy does not permit teaching them together, because علم الكلام is unteachable without المنطق already in hand, and المنطق has a large instrumental payoff in أصول and مصطلح that has nothing to do with كلام at all. Any timetable that lists them as one block at one grade is wrong.

I am RE-SCOPING علم الكلام from a creed subject to a meta-discipline — the historical and methodological study of how creed was argued and by whom — and binding it to العقيدة as its named partner rather than granting it standalone status. Reason: a standalone علم الكلام subject at this school would sit in unmanaged tension with the عقيدة strand (which includes نواقض الإسلام at G5 under redline 6). Bound to العقيدة, the same teacher governs both, method and content are seen together, and no student is taught a rival creed in one room and warned against it in another. This follows redline 9's preference for small traceable pairs.

I am QUESTIONING, not overriding, the Council's placement of the whole entry under Programme 2. For المنطق the placement is correct and I endorse it: منطق is an آلة, an instrumental science, and belongs with النحو، الصرف، البلاغة، العروض as a tool of reading and argument. For علم الكلام the placement is wrong on content — it is a Programme 3 discipline in everything but its register line, and at G12 it is taught inside a Programme 3 block by a Programme 3 teacher. I recommend the entry be administratively split at programme level: المنطق under Programme 2, علم الكلام cross-listed to Programme 3. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

I am REFUSING the symmetry pressure from neighbouring Programme 2 subjects. البلاغة, العروض and النقد will each make a case for a G8-G9 start. المنطق must not follow them merely to look consistent. Its prerequisite is not linguistic maturity, which arrives earlier; it is second-order abstraction, which does not.

I am DECLINING to prescribe a شرح for السلم by name. The one commentary title I could recall (إيضاح المبهم, attributed to الدمنهوري) I cannot confirm to this board's standard, and a wrong attribution printed in a syllabus is a serious failure. The teacher nominates a شرح he owns and can teach; the board verifies the edition.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY النحو (G6 الآجرومية → G7 ملحة الإعراب → G8-G9 consolidation): supplies the reading capacity for a نظم with شرح, and supplies the lived experience of definition-by-genus-and-differentia through its own تعريفات of الاسم والفعل والحرف. Without this, السلم is decoded rather than read.
FED BY الصرف (G6 البناء في الصرف → G7 لامية الأفعال): definition work requires identifying the وزن and اشتقاق of an unfamiliar term before defining it.

FED BY العقيدة (G4-G9): supplies the settled creed position that must exist BEFORE علم الكلام shows the student that it was disputed. This is a hard prerequisite for the G12 component, not a soft one.

FEEDS أصول الفقه, and this is the single most important downstream link. أصول supplies الحد، التقسيم، الكليات الخمس، شروط التعريف as assumed apparatus, and major أصول works open with a مقدمة منطقية. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: أصول has its own القياس الأصولي, which shares a name with القياس المنطقي and is a different operation. One G11 lesson is reserved to teach the distinction explicitly; المنطق does not teach القياس الأصولي and أصول does not re-teach the syllogism.

FEEDS مصطلح الحديث (differentiating G10-G11, with نخبة الفكر as its matn per redline 1). مصطلح is a definitional science end to end — تعريف الصحيح، الحسن، الشاذ، المعلل, each a حد with enumerated شروط that must be جامعة مانعة. Placing المنطق's التصورات at G10 exists precisely to arrive at or just before this. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: مصطلح's classifications of حديث are mustalah's own content; المنطق supplies only the form of a good definition.

FEEDS الإنشاء والخطابة: argument structure, and the مغالطات unit transfers directly into both composing a persuasive address and critiquing one. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: الخطابة owns delivery, arrangement and audience; المنطق owns validity. A بليغ invalid argument and a valid clumsy one must be distinguishable to the student.
FEEDS النقد والآداب: evaluation of a claim as distinct from appreciation of its expression.

FEEDS الدراسات الحديثة, and this is the highest practical payoff in the Nigerian setting. Modern ideological, sectarian and secular argument is the natural application field for the مغالطات unit. Recommend the G11 مغالطات examples be drawn jointly with the الدراسات الحديثة teacher.

FEEDS الترجمة (begun G6 per redline 8, developing later): translating an argument requires holding its structure invariant across Arabic, English and Yoruba — logic makes explicit what translation silently demands.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE البلاغة. البلاغة's دلالة (حقيقة، مجاز، كناية) and المنطق's دلالة (مطابقة، تضمن، التزام) look adjacent and are answering different questions: البلاغة asks what makes expression effective and beautiful, المنطق asks what a term actually refers to and whether truth is preserved. Both teachers should be briefed on the boundary; uncoordinated, they will contradict each other on مجاز.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE العقيدة. العقيدة teaches WHAT is believed and on what نص; علم الكلام at G12 teaches HOW it was argued and BY WHOM. Same block, same teacher, different syllabus lines, separate marks.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE الفقه (الأخضري G6 onward). Fiqh's شروط/أركان/موانع structure is a real logical structure but it is fiqh's own; المنطق does not colonise it.

NO RELATIONSHIP WITH, and must make no claim on, حفظ القرآن and التجويد. The ring-fenced Qur'an hour is untouched (لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى). Neither تحفة الأطفال nor الجزرية has any connection to this subject.
NEITHER of the two [UNVERIFIED] texts under redline 4 (القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية, الفواكه الساقطة) belongs to this subject, is proposed for it, or is substituted within it.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Programme placement. Should the register entry be split so that المنطق sits under Programme 2 (اللغة وعلومها, as an آلة alongside النحو والصرف والبلاغة) while علم الكلام is cross-listed to Programme 3 (الدراسات الإسلامية)? I recommend yes. Keeping علم الكلام under Programme 2 is defensible only administratively and will mislead anyone reading the curriculum.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Teacher capacity, and this is the real constraint on the whole allocation. Is there a member of staff who has himself studied السلم المنورق or إيساغوجي with a teacher and can teach the قياس with confidence? If not, everything above is notional. A مدرّس working from a printed شرح he did not study will produce exactly the memorise-the-نظم failure the design is built to avoid. Recommend the board answer this BEFORE approving the G10 slot, and if the answer is no, fund the training or defer the subject honestly rather than timetable it.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether أم البراهين للسنوسي (and, if so, which extracts) may be studied at G12 as an object of analysis — read ABOUT rather than adopted — given the school's عقيدة orientation and نواقض الإسلام at G5. The G12 component is weaker without a real specimen of kalām reasoning and incoherent if a rival creed is taught as creed. I need a ruling, not a workaround.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] The G10 rotation partner. المنطق occupies a term slot; which bounded subject holds the other two terms? العروض and a bounded الدراسات الحديثة unit are candidates, but this is a whole-timetable decision, not mine.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does العقيدة hold at least 2 periods/week at G12? The zero-net-cost G12 design depends on it. If العقيدة at G12 is 1 period, the كلام component needs a genuine extra period from the 19 or must be cut. Do not let this dependency be discovered at timetabling.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION, for confirmation] I recommend المنطق be offered as an الإجازة-track extension under redline 2 — إيساغوجي then تهذيب المنطق, mastery-paced and opt-in — for students who finish السلم early. The grade curriculum stops at G11; the ceiling should not.

Unresolved sequencing dependency: if الإنشاء والخطابة differentiates later than G11, the G12 كلام essay threshold (600-800 words of connected reasoned Arabic prose) may exceed what the cohort can write. The two specialists should compare placements before either is approved.

Unresolved: where exactly أصول الفقه lands. My G10 placement of التصورات assumes أصول arrives G10 or G11. If أصول is placed at G9, المنطق is late by one year and the G10 rotation should be reconsidered as a full-year G9 slot — which I would resist on developmental grounds, but the board should see the tension rather than have it hidden.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G8 — as الأدب (corpus reading), not as النقد. "Meaningful" for this discipline means: the first year a learner can read a literary text in Arabic and say something TRUE about it that goes beyond translation — paraphrase it in their own Arabic, name its غرض (حكمة / زهد / وصف / رثاء), and point at where its force sits. That capacity does not exist before G8 in this curriculum, because the learner only completes ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال at G7 [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, retained redline 3]. Before that, a line of verse is an unparseable object: تقديم وتأخير, حذف, and فاعل مؤخر — the ordinary furniture of poetry — are exactly what الآجرومية alone does not equip a child to survive. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Note carefully: this is the first appearance of THIS subject, not the first literary contact. Literary contact begins at G3 and is already correctly housed in النشيد والمحفوظات. النقد والآداب must not annex it.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and must not be. The learner is on الحروف وقليل المفردات; there is no reading fluency for a text to be read with. Any exposure to beautiful Arabic at this age happens inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour and inside اللغة العربية's vocabulary work, and belongs to those subjects.

Not taught. الحروف والمفردات stage. With only ~7 periods/week total at G1-G2 [RECOVERED], every period is load-bearing for decoding and for التوحيد/الفقه التطبيقي. A literature strand here would displace decoding and produce nothing.

Not taught as this subject. The corpus-contact function begins here and is already correctly assigned to النشيد والمحفوظات (منظومة التوحيد والإيمان). That is memorisation and ear-training, not أدب-as-study. Claiming مضمّن status here would double-count another subject's slot and yield no criticism-learning. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

Not taught. النشيد continues to build the رصيد السماعي — the stock of memorised verse in the ear — which is this subject's single most underrated prerequisite. (The G4 النشيد slot is currently occupied by a text marked [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification]; I design around it and make no substitution.)

Not taught. النحو والصرف are only مضمّن at G5; the learner cannot yet parse a line of verse. Introducing أدب here means handing a child a text 60-70% of whose lexicon is unknown, which trains the habit of skipping words and undoes the accuracy built by القراءة والتهجي. (The G5 النشيد slot is likewise [UNVERIFIED — text pending identification].)

Not taught. G6 is the most heavily loaded grade in the submission (تفسير عملي + ترجمة, الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء في الصرف, التوحيد والعقيدة, الفقه: الأخضري, الحديث, السيرة, النشيد) and is at or over the 19-period ceiling [RECOVERED]. Any أدب period here would have to be cut out of النحو or الفقه. Not acceptable. The النشيد selections (ديوان الشافعي, لامية ابن الوردي) are doing this subject's groundwork on someone else's budget — which is the correct arrangement.

Not taught. Equally loaded (ملحة الإعراب, لامية الأفعال, تفسير, الجزرية, عقيدة, فقه, حديث/مصطلح, سيرة, نشيد). G7 is the year the parsing prerequisite is being FORGED; it cannot simultaneously be the year it is spent. تائية أبي إسحاق الإلبيري in النشيد at G7 is ideal groundwork: a زهد/حكمة poem in the exact register the G8 نصوص strand will open with.

FIRST MEANINGFUL APPEARANCE. One lesson per week inside the existing اللغة العربية allocation — no new timetable block, no new periods. 8-10 short texts across the year, deliberately continuing the register the learner already has by heart: مقطوعات من شعر الحكمة والزهد, قصار الخطب, رسائل قصيرة, أمثال العرب مع قصصها. Learner work: شرح المفردات الغريبة with a dictionary; re-stating the بيت in their own Arabic; identifying the غرض (حكمة / زهد / وصف / رثاء); pointing at where a line's force sits WITHOUT naming it technically — naming صور is البلاغة's property and is not yet due. Assessed inside the اللغة العربية comprehension paper.

gradeByGrade.text: ديوان الحماسة لأبي تمام (منتخبات)
gradeByGrade.content: Becomes a named, separately traceable النصوص والأدب strand inside اللغة العربية — one period per week, outcomes and marks reported separately. Content: أدب الجاهلية وصدر الإسلام in curated selection; المعلقات by excerpt only (10-15 أبيات, not whole قصائد); خطب صدر الإسلام; منتخبات من ديوان الحماسة arranged by باب. Period framework (جاهلي / إسلامي) introduced and pegged to السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي so history is not taught twice. First written شرح of 60-100 words. التذوق begins to be required WITH A REASON attached — the first step away from taste toward argument.

gradeByGrade.text: المعلقات (منتخبات) — ديوان الحماسة (منتخبات)
gradeByGrade.content: Partner switches from اللغة العربية to البلاغة — the classical pairing, and a small pair rather than a mega-block [consistent with accepted redline 9]. Division of labour explicit: البلاغة owns definitions and التقسيمات; الأدب owns the texts they are applied to. Content: periodisation completed (الأموي، العباسي، الأندلسي) with 2-3 representative texts each; الأغراض الشعرية as a system (مدح، رثاء، وصف، حكمة، زهد، اعتذار); application of المعاني and البيان to the studied corpus; first use of التقطيع العروضي on a قصيدة actually being read. Written تحليل of 150-250 words, marked separately from the البلاغة paper.

gradeByGrade.text: العمدة في محاسن الشعر وآدابه ونقده لابن رشيق القيرواني (أبواب منتخبة) — مقدمة الشعر والشعراء لابن قتيبة
gradeByGrade.content: DIFFERENTIATION. Becomes a single named subject, 2 periods/week, carrying both halves: the corpus (الأدب) and the evaluative discipline (النقد). Content: ما النقد وما معاييره; عمود الشعر; قضية اللفظ والمعنى; الطبع والصنعة والمطبوع والمتكلف; عيوب الشعر; selected أبواب of العمدة as the teaching matn (short self-contained chapters — the only نقد work a school can carry on 2 periods/week); the مقدمة of الشعر والشعراء on classification and craft. Corpus alongside: المتنبي، أبو تمام، البحتري in curated selection. Output: written نقد of 300-400 words that must cite a شاهد — judgement without evidence is not accepted.

gradeByGrade.text: الموازنة بين الطائيين للآمدي — الوساطة بين المتنبي وخصومه للقاضي الجرجاني — مقدمة طبقات فحول الشعراء لابن سلام الجمحي (مقتطفات)
gradeByGrade.content: 2 periods/week. النقد التطبيقي والنظري. Content: comparative criticism as a METHOD, read through الموازنة and الوساطة — the student watches two critics disagree about the same poets and learns what disciplined disagreement looks like; السرقات الأدبية وحدودها; the مقدمة of طبقات فحول الشعراء on الانتحال and how a critic tests transmission; نظرية النظم from دلائل الإعجاز taught jointly with البلاغة (which owns it) and turned outward onto الإعجاز البياني للقرآن, feeding أصول التفسير; الأدب العربي الحديث ووظيفته; the Arabic literary production of West Africa [scope and named texts to be confirmed by the board — I will not name local works I cannot verify]. Terminal assessment: a 400-600 word نقد of an UNSEEN text, plus oral defence.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G11 — and specifically G11, not G10 and not G12. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

WHY NOT G10: النقد is not a body of content, it is the exercise of judgement using three instruments — الإعراب (what the sentence says), الوزن (how the line is built), and البلاغة (why this wording and not another). At G10 the third instrument is still being manufactured: on my assumed placement البلاغة's three branches are not complete until the end of G10. Criticism attempted with incomplete البلاغة is impressionism with vocabulary — the student says "this is more eloquent" and cannot finish the sentence. Worse, it inoculates: having "done نقد" at G10, the student meets the real discipline at G11 believing it is revision.

WHY NOT G12: two reasons. First, the discipline has a theoretical half and an applied half, and one year cannot carry the move from "here are the critics' criteria" to "here is my own argued judgement of an unseen text." Second, a subject existing only in the terminal year is certified on a single term's evidence, which is not a mastery threshold worth sealing. G11 gives the theory a year to settle before it is used under examination conditions.

WHY IT DIFFERENTIATES AT ALL rather than remaining مدمج forever: at G11 it acquires content that has no other owner. عمود الشعر, اللفظ والمعنى, الطبع والصنعة, السرقات — these are not البلاغة (a tool-kit), not العروض (mechanics), and not اللغة العربية (competence). Left مدمج, they get taught last and cut first. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]
prerequisites: Fluent decoding of vowelled and unvowelled Arabic — established by القراءة والتهجي, secure by G5 (independently assessed there from G1).
Sentence-level comprehension and vocabulary beyond concrete nouns — اللغة العربية, G6-G7.

إعراب of a line of verse, including تقديم وتأخير, حذف, and فاعل مؤخر — requires ملحة الإعراب, established G7, consolidated G8. This is the hardest gate: الآجرومية alone (G6) is NOT sufficient, because poetry's ordinary word order is exactly what الآجرومية's examples avoid.
الصرف: recognition of أوزان and المشتقات (اسم الفاعل، اسم المفعول، الصفة المشبهة، صيغ المبالغة) so a poet's morphological choices are visible AS choices — لامية الأفعال, G7.

A رصيد سماعي — a stock of verse held in memory and in the ear. Supplied by النشيد والمحفوظات, G3-G7 (منظومة التوحيد، ديوان الشافعي، لامية ابن الوردي، تائية الإلبيري). You cannot judge poetry you have never internalised; this is built over five years and cannot be compressed.
Dictionary skill: locating a root and reading a lexical entry — needed by G8, currently unassigned in the register; recommend اللغة العربية take it at G7. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
العروض: التقطيع and recognition of the بحور of the texts actually studied — needed operationally by G10. Assumed established as a bounded course at G8-G9; my G11 differentiation depends on it.
البلاغة: المعاني، البيان، البديع complete — needed by G11. Assumed complete by end of G10. If the board places البلاغة later, this subject's differentiation must move with it.
الإنشاء: ability to write a connected paragraph of argued Arabic — needed from G9 (60-100 words) scaling to G12 (400-600 words). Assumed established from G9.
الإملاء: orthographic accuracy sufficient for written criticism — a longitudinal اللغة العربية skill [accepted redline 7], sufficient by G9.
A historical frame (الجاهلية، صدر الإسلام، الأموي، العباسي، الأندلسي) — supplied by السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي from G6-G7 onward; this subject pegs to it and must never re-teach it.

classicalTexts.title: ديوان الحماسة لأبي تمام
classicalTexts.justification: The natural first anthology: organised by باب, short pieces, long madrasa history as a teaching collection. Curation still required — not every باب (e.g. النسيب) suits a G9 class; the board should approve the selected pieces rather than adopt the whole.

classicalTexts.title: المعلقات (السبع)
classicalTexts.justification: Unavoidable as the foundational corpus, but deliberately rationed: 10-15 أبيات at G9, longer selections only once البلاغة and العروض are in hand. Whole-قصيدة study before G10 produces vocabulary drowning, not literary learning.

classicalTexts.title: العمدة في محاسن الشعر وآدابه ونقده لابن رشيق القيرواني
classicalTexts.justification: The teaching matn for the differentiated year. Built of short self-contained أبواب (عمود الشعر، الطبع والصنعة، السرقات، عيوب الشعر) — exactly what 2 periods/week can carry, unlike the theoretical treatises. Selected أبواب, not the whole work.

classicalTexts.title: الشعر والشعراء لابن قتيبة الدينوري (المقدمة)
classicalTexts.justification: The مقدمة is the classic short teaching excerpt on the classification of poets and on craft. Short enough to read entire in a term, and it models a critic refusing to privilege the old merely for being old.

classicalTexts.title: الموازنة بين الطائيين (أبي تمام والبحتري) للآمدي
classicalTexts.justification: Selected passages. Its value is methodological: the student watches a critic compare two poets on STATED criteria rather than assert a preference. The best available model for the G12 terminal task.

classicalTexts.title: الوساطة بين المتنبي وخصومه للقاضي علي بن عبد العزيز الجرجاني
classicalTexts.justification: Selected passages, paired with الموازنة so the student sees critical disagreement conducted with evidence. Also the natural home for السرقات.

classicalTexts.title: طبقات فحول الشعراء لابن سلام الجمحي (مقدمة)
classicalTexts.justification: Excerpts on الانتحال and on testing transmission. Valuable beyond أدب: it exercises the same evidentiary instinct the student met in مصطلح الحديث at G10-G11, in a different register. Coordinate explicitly; do not build a second isnād course.

classicalTexts.title: نقد الشعر لقدامة بن جعفر
classicalTexts.justification: Short extracts on حد الشعر and on النعوت والعيوب. Its systematising, quasi-logical frame is demanding; use only extracts, and preferably after المنطق has given some tolerance for definition by genus and difference.

classicalTexts.title: دلائل الإعجاز لعبد القاهر الجرجاني
classicalTexts.grade: G12 (a few فصول, taught jointly with البلاغة)
classicalTexts.justification: نظرية النظم. This text is البلاغة's property, not mine — I claim a few فصول only, and only so the نقد student can turn the theory outward onto الإعجاز البياني. Flagged as the highest duplication risk in this subject's entire design.

classicalTexts.title: البيان والتبيين للجاحظ
classicalTexts.grade: G12 selected passages / teacher source from G9
classicalTexts.justification: Selected passages on البلاغة والخطابة and on the Arab conception of eloquence; also the primary quarry for anthology material at G9-G10.

classicalTexts.title: الكامل في اللغة والأدب للمبرد
classicalTexts.justification: A source for curated selections, not a set text. Its size makes it unusable as a school matn.

classicalTexts.title: أدب الكاتب لابن قتيبة
classicalTexts.justification: Lexical and stylistic reference for the teacher preparing نصوص; not a pupil text at any grade in this ladder.

classicalTexts.title: منهاج البلغاء وسراج الأدباء لحازم القرطاجني
classicalTexts.grade: teacher reference only — NOT a pupil text at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: It exists and is the most sophisticated theoretical work in the tradition, and for exactly that reason it must never be set for a G12 class. Naming it here is a fence, not a proposal.

classicalTexts.title: مقدمة ابن خلدون — الفصل في علم الأدب
classicalTexts.justification: Answers 'what is this discipline and what are its foundations' in the tradition's own words, including the four أصول it names (أدب الكاتب لابن قتيبة، الكامل للمبرد، البيان والتبيين للجاحظ، أمالي/نوادر أبي علي القالي). Short, high-yield.

classicalTexts.title: أدب الدنيا والدين للماوردي
classicalTexts.justification: Named only to mark a boundary. This is أدب in the ethical/conduct sense. If the board wants it, it belongs with التربية الإسلامية. Filing it here would silently convert a literature subject into a manners course.

classicalTexts.title: تاريخ آداب اللغة العربية لجرجي زيدان
classicalTexts.justification: The work exists and circulates widely as a literary history, but its interpretive framework is contested within the tradition. Usable by a trained teacher for chronology; must not be adopted as a set text.

classicalTexts.title: الوسيط في الأدب العربي وتاريخه (أحمد الإسكندري ومصطفى عناني)
classicalTexts.justification: I believe this exists as a standard school literary-history textbook, but I am not confident enough of the exact title/authorship pairing to let the G10 design rest on it. Verify before adoption; do not substitute a guess.

classicalTexts.title: جواهر الأدب (أحمد الهاشمي)
classicalTexts.justification: I can confirm this author's بلاغة compendium but not this specific title to the standard this board requires. Verify independently before any adoption.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Five specific risks, not one generic one.

1. LEXICAL DROWNING AND THE SKIPPING HABIT — the risk I would put first. جاهلي and early عباسي poetry carries a lexicon (الأطلال، النوق، السلاح، أسماء الخيل) that is 60-70% unknown to a G6-G7 learner. Faced with that density children do not look words up; they skip, and infer the gist from three recognisable words. That directly reverses the letter-by-letter accuracy القراءة والتهجي has built and independently assessed since G1. One year of this undoes five.

2. IMPRESSIONISM HARDENS INTO HABIT. النقد before البلاغة is complete produces students who say "this is more beautiful" and cannot continue the sentence. Unfounded judgement is not a neutral starting point that rigour later replaces — it is a habit, harder to remove than to prevent.

3. INOCULATION. A student who has "done نقد" at G9 or G10 meets the real discipline at G11 believing it is revision, and disengages exactly where the work begins.

4. CONTENT EXPOSURE. The classical corpus contains الخمريات، الغزل الصريح، الهجاء المقذع. An unfiltered ديوان in a G7-G8 class is a safeguarding and adab problem before it is a pedagogical one. Early introduction forces either unacceptable exposure or a corpus so sanitised it is no longer the corpus. Delay to G8+ with a board-approved anthology is the only clean resolution.

5. TIMETABLE THEFT, LITERALLY SELF-DEFEATING. G6 and G7 sit at or over the 19-period ceiling [RECOVERED]. Any أدب period inserted there is taken from النحو (الآجرومية / ملحة) or الفقه (الأخضري) — that is, taken from this subject's own prerequisites. Premature introduction would destroy the foundation it depends on.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Equally specific — and the reason I do NOT push this subject to G11-G12 only.

1. THE COLD-START FAILURE. If الأدب begins only at G11 alongside النقد, the student meets the جاهلي lexicon for the first time in the same year they are asked to JUDGE it. They will do neither. The G8 مضمّن ramp and the G9-G10 مدمج strand are not padding — they are what makes G11 possible on 2 periods/week. Cutting them is the most likely way this design fails in practice.

2. A BOOKISH GRADUATE WITH NO سليقة. Without sustained literary reading from G8, a student can parse flawlessly and still have no sense of register — unable to tell eloquent Arabic from correct-but-flat Arabic, unable to hear when a sentence is heavy. That degrades الإنشاء والخطابة (correct, lifeless Arabic), الترجمة (meaning rendered, tone lost), and the public quality of their Arabic in a Nigerian setting where Arabic is performed aloud before communities that can hear the difference.

3. إعجاز القرآن BECOMES A SLOGAN. The classical claim about the Qur'an's بيان is comparative in structure: it presupposes knowing what the Arabs themselves held to be the summit of eloquence. A student with no أدب can assert الإعجاز البياني but cannot substantiate a single instance of it. For a school whose first constitutional programme is القرآن وعلومه, that is not a literary gap but a theological one — and it is the strongest argument against treating أدب as garnish.

4. LOSS OF الشاهد. الشعر ديوان العرب is operational, not decorative: in تفسير and أصول الفقه, لغة العرب is evidence and شواهد شعرية are how meaning is established. A student who has never read poetry will memorise the شاهد without ever seeing it work.

5. EXTERNAL PARITY. أدب ونقد is a normal component of recognised Arabic secondary programmes [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE — I assert no institution's endorsement]. A graduate presenting to an Arabic faculty with no أدب is visibly short of a standard element, cutting against the school's stated international ambitions.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 this subject is the capstone of Programme 2 — the year the student stops receiving Arabic and starts judging it. Its final role is threefold: (a) convert the tools of البلاغة and العروض into argued judgement; (b) turn نظرية النظم outward onto the Qur'an, feeding أصول التفسير with substantiated rather than asserted claims about الإعجاز البياني; (c) model disciplined disagreement, through الموازنة and الوساطة, as a transferable intellectual habit.

WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO BECAUSE OF IT:
- Take an unfamiliar classical قصيدة and, with a dictionary, produce a correct شرح, determine its بحر by تقطيع, identify its غرض, place it in its period, and name and evaluate its صور.
- Write 400-600 words of criticism in Arabic arguing from a شاهد rather than from taste, and defend it orally under questioning.
- State the major critical controversies — عمود الشعر، اللفظ والمعنى، الطبع والصنعة، السرقات، القديم والحديث — and say which side they take and on what grounds.
- Bring شواهد شعرية to bear when reading تفسير and أصول الفقه instead of stepping over them.
- Write composition consciously modelled on an identified classical style, which is what makes G12 الإنشاء والخطابة more than template-filling.
- Hear the difference between Arabic that is correct and Arabic that is eloquent — the one outcome no examination fully captures and every listener notices.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the hard ceilings (19 periods/week at G3-G12; 7 at G1-G2) [RECOVERED]:

G1-G7: ZERO periods. This subject makes no claim on the two most over-subscribed stages in the ladder. That is a deliberate contribution to the budget, not an oversight — and it is affordable only because النشيد والمحفوظات carries corpus contact at G3-G7 on its own allocation.

G8: ZERO new periods. مضمّن — one existing اللغة العربية period per week is designated the نصوص lesson. Net claim on the 19: 0.

G9: 1 period/week, carved from the اللغة العربية block as a named strand. Net claim: 0 to +1, depending on whether the board protects اللغة العربية's total.

G10: 1 period/week inside the البلاغة pairing — the pair takes 3 (2 بلاغة + 1 أدب). Net claim attributable to this subject: +1.

G11: 2 periods/week, مستقل = 10.5% of the 19-period budget.

G12: 2 periods/week, مستقل = 10.5%.

LIFETIME COST: roughly 6 weekly periods spread across 5 of 12 years, zero at the front and two at the back. A subject asking nothing in G1-G7 and two periods in the final two years is affordable. A subject asking one period every year from G3 would consume 10 weekly periods and would have to be refused — which is precisely why I am not asking for that shape.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY — القراءة والتهجي (G1-G5): supplies decoding. Without it this subject has no object.
FED BY — اللغة العربية (G1-G12): supplies vocabulary, comprehension, and from G8 the host slot itself. This subject lives inside اللغة العربية for three years before it leaves home.

FED BY — النحو (الآجرومية G6, ملحة الإعراب G7): the parsing gate. ملحة specifically, because poetry's word order is what الآجرومية's examples avoid. If ملحة slips past G7, this subject's G8 entry slips with it.
FED BY — الصرف (البناء في الصرف G6, لامية الأفعال G7): makes a poet's morphological choices legible as choices.

FED BY — النشيد والمحفوظات (G3-G7): the most important and least visible feeder. It builds the رصيد السماعي over five years, and ديوان الشافعي / لامية ابن الوردي / تائية الإلبيري put exactly the right register — حكمة وزهد — in the ear before G8 opens with that register. IF النشيد والمحفوظات IS EVER CUT OR SHORTENED, THIS SUBJECT'S G8 ENTRY POINT COLLAPSES. That dependency should be recorded formally.
FED BY — العروض: supplies التقطيع and the بحور; needed operationally by G10. My entire G11 differentiation is contingent on العروض completing by G9.
FED BY — البلاغة: supplies the analytic instruments; needed complete by G11. The hardest dependency in this design.
FED BY — السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي (G6-G7 onward): supplies the periodisation frame. This subject PEGS to that chronology and never re-teaches it.
FED BY — الإملاء (longitudinal, via اللغة العربية [accepted redline 7]): written criticism must be orthographically sound from G9.
FEEDS — الإنشاء والخطابة: supplies style models. Composition without a read corpus is template-filling; this subject is what makes G12 خطابة worth hearing.
FEEDS — الترجمة (from G6): register and idiom. A translator who cannot read أدب renders meaning and loses tone. This subject is why G12 translation can be better than G8 translation.
FEEDS — التفسير and أصول التفسير: the الشاهد الشعري, and at G12 the substantiation of الإعجاز البياني via نظرية النظم. This is the subject's most important service to Programme 1.
FEEDS — أصول الفقه: دلالات الألفاظ (الحقيقة والمجاز، العموم والخصوص) rest on Arab usage. A student who has read أدب can see why the usūlī argument works rather than memorising that it does.

COORDINATES WITH, DOES NOT DUPLICATE — مصطلح الحديث (G10-G11, نخبة الفكر per accepted redline 1): the الانتحال discussion in طبقات فحول الشعراء at G12 exercises the same evidentiary instinct in a literary register. Teach the parallel in one explicit session; do not build a second isnād course.
COORDINATES WITH — المنطق وعلم الكلام: قدامة's definitional method at G12 goes easier if المنطق precedes it. Not a hard dependency.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE — البلاغة: owns the definitions and التقسيمات of التشبيه، الاستعارة، الكناية، البديع. النقد applies them and never re-teaches them. Highest duplication risk in the design, concentrated at G10 and on دلائل الإعجاز at G12.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — العروض: owns meter mechanics. النقد uses التقطيع as a finding, not as a topic.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — النشيد والمحفوظات: owns memorisation. This subject must never become more memorisation under a different name; its output is written and spoken argument.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — التربية الإسلامية: owns آداب/conduct. If 'الآداب' in this subject's title is read as manners, this subject is destroyed and التربية الإسلامية is duplicated. See open questions.
MUST NOT DUPLICATE — الدراسات الحديثة: owns modern general studies. The G12 'الأدب الحديث' unit is literary, not civic.
BOUNDARY — السيرة والحديث: خطبة الوداع and prophetic speech belong to them. This subject takes خطابة جاهلية and أموية, not prophetic text.
departuresFromSubmission: I RATIFY the submission's total omission of النقد والآداب from G1-G7 — but as a positive judgement, not an accepted gap. The omission is correct and I would have recommended it had it not been there. The board should RECORD it as a decision, so it does not later look like an oversight someone 'fixes' by inserting a G5 literature period.

I ATTACH A CONDITION to that ratification: the G1-G7 omission is tenable only because النشيد والمحفوظات carries corpus contact at G3-G7. That subject is currently unprotected. I request it be formally marked as a prerequisite feeder for النقد والآداب, so a future timetable squeeze cannot quietly remove it without the board seeing that G8-G12 أدب collapses with it.

I MAKE ONE SMALL DEMAND ON ANOTHER SUBJECT, COSTING NO PERIODS: the G6-G7 النشيد selections (ديوان الشافعي, لامية ابن الوردي, تائية الإلبيري) should be taught with meaning and imagery discussed, not recitation alone. They are already the right texts in the right register; a change in HOW they are handled converts them from memorisation into أدب groundwork at zero timetable cost.

I DESIGN AROUND the two [UNVERIFIED] texts at G4 and G5 النشيد. Because النشيد feeds this subject, their absence slightly thins the G4-G5 رصيد السماعي, but the G6-G7 selections carry the load. No substitution proposed, none needed, none permitted.

I FLAG, from within my own specialism, that 'ديوان الإمام الشافعي' as circulated is a later compilation and not all of its contents are securely attributable to الشافعي. This does not affect its use at G6-G7 as devotional and didactic verse and I do not ask for its removal — but the teacher's note should say so, because this school's own graduates will later read the criticism that says so, and should not first meet it as a surprise.

I DECLINE the default assumption that a Programme 2 subject must appear in every grade or mirror النحو/الصرف's shape. This subject is absent for seven consecutive years and then runs five. That asymmetry is the correct answer, not a compromise.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Semantic ruling on 'الآداب' in the register entry. I have read it as literature (plural of أدب as belles-lettres), which is what its Programme 2 placement and its pairing with النقد require. If the board intends آداب in the ethical sense (آداب طالب العلم), then this subject does not belong in Programme 2 at all, overlaps التربية الإسلامية entirely, and my whole design answers the wrong question. Settle this before anything else here is approved.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Placement of البلاغة and العروض. My G11 differentiation is contingent on البلاغة completing by end of G10 and العروض by G9 — both my inferences, not recovered facts. If البلاغة lands at G10-G11, G11 must become أدب-only and النقد shrinks to a G12 وحدة, materially weakening the graduate outcome. I ask to be re-consulted once the البلاغة and العروض specialists report.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Who approves the نصوص anthology? The classical corpus contains الخمريات، الغزل الصريح، الهجاء المقذع. I recommend a standing نصوص committee approving the G8-G12 selection text by text, with the anthology fixed in print rather than left to individual teachers. Without it, either a teacher exposes children to unsuitable material or — far more likely — teaches almost nothing and calls it caution.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Scope of West African / Nigerian Arabic literary production at G12. I recommend inclusion in principle — a graduate in Nigeria should know Arabic literary composition has a history in their own region — but I will not name specific local poets or works, because I cannot verify them to the standard this board has rightly set. This needs someone with direct knowledge of the regional corpus.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether the G12 terminal نقد is written in Arabic only, or in Arabic with an English/Yoruba abstract. The second makes this subject visibly serve the school's international ambitions and links cleanly to الترجمة, at the cost of some Arabic writing time.
[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Dictionary skill (locating a root, reading a lexical entry) is unassigned in the register. I need it by G8 and recommend اللغة العربية take it at G7. Someone must own it.

[NEW ENGINEERING DECISION — the binding practical constraint] Teacher capacity. G11-G12 النقد requires a teacher who has themselves studied البلاغة والنقد formally. Timetable space is the easy problem; a teacher who can conduct a defensible comparison of أبي تمام والبحتري is the hard one. Confirm staffing feasibility BEFORE approving the G11 مستقل slot, and treat a G11 أدب-only / G12 نقد-only fallback as the honest contingency if that staffing cannot be secured.

Verification requested on two candidate modern textbooks before any adoption: 'الوسيط في الأدب العربي وتاريخه' (الإسكندري وعناني) and 'جواهر الأدب' (الهاشمي). Both rated uncertain; the architecture depends on neither.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G5 for الإنشاء; G10 for الخطابة. "Meaningful" for a productive-language discipline means the point at which the learner generates Arabic that was not given to him and that he can vary, not the point at which he can copy or substitute into a model. Oral production inside اللغة العربية from G3 is real teaching but it is اللغة العربية's own work, not this subject's. G5 is the first grade where the learner has a productive lexicon and simple-sentence control (submitted G5: المفردات والجمل البسيطة) such that a separately traceable composition outcome — التعبير الموجه: describe, expand, order, complete — produces learning rather than transcription. For الخطابة, "meaningful" means composing and delivering a sustained address the speaker owns; anything earlier is recitation of someone else's words, which is النشيد والمحفوظات' job and is already covered G3-G7. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and correctly so. The 7-period ceiling and the الحروف وقليل المفردات stage mean there is nothing to compose with. Oral Arabic response (naming, single-word answers) occurs inside اللغة العربية as that subject's own work. Any slot taken here would come out of القراءة والتهجي, which is the true gate for everything downstream.

Not taught. Same reasoning as G1. The submission's omission at G1-G2 is correct and I am protecting it, not overriding it. Handwriting formation and الإملاء accuracy belong to القراءة والتهجي and اللغة العربية (redline 7).

التعبير الشفهي only: answering a teacher question in one complete Arabic sentence rather than a single word; naming and describing a classroom object; retelling in Arabic the one-line hadith met in الحديث مضمّن. No written composition. Learning is explicitly planned (a named oral-production outcome in the اللغة العربية scheme) but carries no separate mark and no separate block.

Oral production extends to two or three linked spoken sentences on a familiar topic (الأسرة، المدرسة، الوضوء). First guided written act: completing a supplied sentence stem and writing a caption of one sentence under a picture. Delivery is seeded, not taught, through النشيد والمحفوظات — reciting تحفة الأطفال lines and the نشيد before the class builds audience-facing poise that الخطابة will draw on six years later.

التعبير الموجه becomes a separately reported outcome inside اللغة العربية: describe a picture in three connected sentences; expand a bare sentence by adding a صفة or a ظرف; reorder four scrambled sentences into a coherent sequence; write two sentences about a فقه situation already met in الفقه والسيرة. The mark is separated from the اللغة العربية grade because productive skill is the first thing teachers cut under time pressure, and once it is invisible in the mark book it disappears. Costs no new period.

الفقرة: four to six sentences with deliberate أدوات الربط (و، ثم، لكن، لأن، حتى). رسالة قصيرة إلى صديق. وصف شخص أو مكان. The central pedagogical move is that الآجرومية and البناء في الصرف are applied in production, not only in إعراب exercises — the learner must build a correct جملة اسمية and جملة فعلية of his own, not parse one given to him. This also supplies the Arabic-side competence that the submitted G6 الترجمة silently presupposes: rendering meaning into Yoruba and English is receptive, but any rendering back into Arabic is composition, and the submission builds no such capacity. One period ring-fenced inside the existing اللغة العربية allocation; no new slot claimed.

Multi-paragraph سرد and وصف. التلخيص of a passage from السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي in the learner's own words — the hardest and most diagnostic composition task at this level, because paraphrase is impossible without comprehension. الرسالة الرسمية وغير الرسمية. First use of استشهاد: supporting a written point with an آية or a hadith already memorised, correctly introduced (قال الله تعالى / قال رسول الله ﷺ). Grammatical demand rises with ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال: correct التوابع and correct verb derivation are now marked in the learner's own prose. Portfolio of roughly eight pieces.

الإنشاء differentiates. أنواع النثر taught as a system: الوصف، السرد، الرسالة، التقرير. The paragraph-to-essay move: مقدمة، عرض، خاتمة as a planned written structure rather than an accident of length. Openings and closings as craft. Editing as a taught act — the learner marks and corrects his own draft against a rubric covering النحو، الصرف، الإملاء، الربط، الوضوح. Portfolio plus one timed composition per term. One period per week, newly claimed from the 19.

المقالة القصيرة (300-450 words) with a stated position and supporting evidence; الحجاج البسيط — claim, evidence, qualification. Plus a bounded term-3 وحدة في الإلقاء: breath, pace, pause, volume, posture, eye contact, and the memorisation and correct delivery of خطبة الحاجة. This وحدة is delivery mechanics only — the learner does not yet compose a خطبة. It exists to de-risk the G10 differentiation, and it runs inside this subject's own period, costing nothing extra.
gradeByGrade.text: خطبة الحاجة

gradeByGrade.content: الخطابة differentiates and joins الإنشاء; the register's compound name 'الإنشاء والخطابة' becomes literally true here and only here. بنية الخطبة: خطبة الجمعة، خطبة العيد، الكلمة القصيرة (مناسبة، تعزية، توجيه). Structural analysis of attested addresses — خطبة حجة الوداع and selections from جمهرة خطب العرب — examined for structure and effect, not memorised. Each student composes and delivers one 3-4 minute كلمة per term to his class. Composition side continues: مقالة with sourced citation. Two periods per week.
gradeByGrade.text: جمهرة خطب العرب (selections); خطبة حجة الوداع

gradeByGrade.content: Selections from البيان والتبيين للجاحظ — the canonical Arabic treatment of oratory — read for what makes an address land, with the Jāḥiẓian criteria of بلاغة، إيجاز، مطابقة المقام. أغراض الخطابة worked separately: الوعظ، التعليم، التحفيز، التعزية. Each student composes and delivers a 7-minute خطبة per term. Written مقالة 600-800 words. This is the grade where البلاغة is deliberately consumed rather than merely studied. A hard rule enters here and is enforced by this subject: no hadith is cited in a composition or an address unless the student can name its source — the direct payoff of مصطلح الحديث differentiating at G10-G11.
gradeByGrade.text: البيان والتبيين (selections)

gradeByGrade.content: Capstone. (1) خطبة كاملة of 7-10 minutes, composed by the student and delivered to a real audience beyond his own class. (2) رسالة أو مقالة of 800-1200 words on a topic drawn from the Islamic sciences, with correctly sourced evidence. (3) أدب الخطاب as explicit content: the ethics and limits of public address — the khatib exhorts and teaches, he does not pronounce فتوى, he does not pass judgement on named individuals or families, he refers what exceeds his competence. This module is the mature counterweight to نواقض الإسلام at G5 and discharges redline 6's concern at the one point in the ladder where the student actually acquires a public voice. (4) A prepared Yoruba or English rendering of his own address, executed with الترجمة. Two periods per week.
gradeByGrade.text: البيان والتبيين; جمهرة خطب العرب

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: Two differentiations, and they must not be collapsed. PRIMARY: الإنشاء becomes مستقل at G8. Not G7, because G7 is the year ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال are completed; until that toolkit closes, an independent composition subject spends its own hours re-teaching النحو and الصرف, which is self-defeating when those subjects already own the time. Not G9, because by G9 البلاغة and النقد والآداب begin to assume a learner who already produces text, and because the G10 خطابة differentiation needs at least two years of settled prose-composition beneath it — a khutbah is a composed text before it is a delivered one. SECONDARY: الخطابة appears as a named entity at G10 and merges into a single مستقل subject with الإنشاء. Not G9, because at G9 the learner is still at paragraph-to-short-essay level and the content base is thin — demanding a sustained structured address there produces memorised performance, the precise failure this school should avoid. Not G11, because public-speaking competence is built by repeated cycles (roughly 15-25 supervised deliveries with feedback); three years at a termly public delivery reaches that, one year does not. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]
prerequisites: Fluent Arabic script handwriting and word-level الإملاء accuracy — established G3-G4 through القراءة والتهجي (separate book, independently assessed) with الإملاء longitudinal inside اللغة العربية per redline 7. الإنشاء marks orthography; it does not teach it.
Productive (not merely recognitional) vocabulary of roughly 500-800 items — established G5 (اللغة العربية: المفردات والجمل البسيطة). This is the gate for G5's first traceable composition outcome.
Control of الجملة الاسمية والجملة الفعلية and their agreement — established G6 via الآجرومية. This is the gate for الفقرة.
Derivation of الماضي/المضارع/الأمر، المصدر، اسم الفاعل واسم المفعول — established G6-G7 via البناء في الصرف then لامية الأفعال. Without derivation the learner can only reuse verb forms he has met.
المعرب والمبني، العوامل، التوابع — established G7 via ملحة الإعراب. This is the gate for the G8 مستقل differentiation.
Content worth writing about: فقه (الأخضري, G6), حديث والسيرة (G4-G7), العقيدة والتوحيد (G3 onward). Composition with no subject matter degenerates into ornament. By G7 the content base is sufficient.
A memorised bank of Qur'anic and hadith material for استشهاد — supplied continuously by the ring-fenced Qur'an hour G1-G12, at zero cost to this subject.
Audience-facing poise and voice — seeded G3-G7 by النشيد والمحفوظات (recitation before the class), which is why الخطابة at G10 does not start from nothing.

البلاغة foundations: التشبيه، الاستعارة، الكناية، الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي، مطابقة الكلام لمقتضى الحال — needed live by G9 at the latest. This is a DEPENDENCY I cannot satisfy myself. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — see open questions]
Hadith-sourcing discipline sufficient to avoid citing what one cannot attribute — supplied by مصطلح الحديث at G10-G11 per redline 1, which is one further reason خطابة sits at G10 and not earlier.

classicalTexts.title: البيان والتبيين — الجاحظ
classicalTexts.justification: The canonical Arabic work on oratory and eloquence in speech, containing attested خطب of the Arabs and sustained discussion of what makes an address effective. Used for structural and rhetorical analysis of real addresses, never read whole — it is long, digressive and adult in register. Selections chosen for structure, not for ornament.

classicalTexts.title: جمهرة خطب العرب — أحمد زكي صفوت
classicalTexts.justification: A compiled anthology of Arabic addresses across the classical periods. Its value is that it puts many complete, short خطب side by side, which is exactly what a student learning بنية الخطبة needs. As a modern compilation it carries no matn status and requires no memorisation; teachers select and vet individual items for content suitability.

classicalTexts.title: خطبة الحاجة (إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه...)
classicalTexts.justification: Narrated from Ibn Mas'ūd and found in the Sunan collections; short, universally used as the opening of an Arabic address, and therefore the single highest-yield thing a student can memorise for خطابة.
