The narrow correct window is G5, sex-separated, female teacher for girls — which is a staffing precondition, not a note.

5. معاملات BEFORE TRANSACTING. Teaching البيع والربا at G5–G6 to children who neither earn nor lend is inert; the vocabulary is learned and the judgement is not. It is placed at G8 because that is roughly when students begin handling money, running small trades, and observing family finance.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Also specific, and in this discipline the delay risks are sharper than the earliness risks:

1. THE AGE-SEVEN THRESHOLD. If practical فقه does not begin at G1, the school has failed to teach a child to pray at the age the sharī'ah itself names for instruction. Habit formation in wuḍū' and ṣalāh is far harder at twelve than at six; this is not a gap that can be filled later at the same cost. The submission is right about G1 and I am protecting it against any future pressure to defer it for timetable reasons.

2. بلوغ ARRIVING BEFORE THE RULINGS DO. This is the single sharpest risk in the whole lifecycle. If أحكام الحيض والنفاس والاغتسال are delayed past G5, a girl will reach menarche without knowing that she does not pray, that she does not fast, that the missed fasts are made up and the missed prayers are not, and how to perform الغسل afterwards. The consequences are not academic: invalid or abandoned worship for a period, silent distress, and in some cases a permanent break in the habit of prayer. A boy who reaches احتلام without knowing موجبات الغسل prays in a state of جنابة. Any plan that pushes this content to G6 or G7 is, for a measurable fraction of the cohort, too late. This alone would justify differentiation at G5 even if every other argument failed.

3. NO INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT RECORD. If الفقه never becomes مستقل and is never independently assessed, a child can pass "التوحيد والفقه" on the strength of the التوحيد half. The school would then have no per-child evidence, at any point in twelve years, that this particular student's prayer is valid. That is the structural failure the submission's G1–G7 shape actually risks, and it is why I raise assessment to independent at G3 — three grades before differentiation, and at zero period cost, because the assessment site is the school's own prayer.

4. الدليل DELAYED PAST G10. A graduate who leaves with a taqlīd-only competence cannot answer "where is that in the Qur'an?" — which is the first question he will face in Nigeria from both non-Muslim interlocutors and reform-minded Muslims — and cannot enter the international academic settings SHRS aspires to, where the expected competence is to state a position, its evidence, and the grounds of disagreement. G10 is already the latest defensible point given that مصطلح الحديث only arrives at G10–G11.

5. فقه النوازل DELAYED PAST G11. Graduates enter Nigerian economic life — banking, insurance, NYSC placement, salaried employment, family trade — immediately on leaving. A curriculum that never reaches interest-bearing accounts, insurance, zakat on salaries, or the boundary between الشرع and العرف اليوربي in عقيقة and wedding custom has trained someone who can rule on a seventh-century marketplace and not on his own.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 الفقه is the subject in which the graduate's competence becomes publicly usable. It is no longer about the student's own obligations — those were settled years earlier — but about the student's capacity to serve and, critically, to know where that capacity ends.

Concretely, the G12 graduate can: perform and lead the full range of عبادات correctly including the عوارض that defeat most people (الجمع والقصر في السفر, صلاة المريض, صلاة الخوف at description level, سجود السهو in its cases); perform غسل الميت and lead صلاة الجنازة start to finish, which is the single most frequently demanded service a young graduate faces in a Nigerian community and the one most often botched; calculate زكاة المال and زكاة الفطر on real figures and divide a simple ميراث; state a ruling on a common question together with its آية or حديث, name the Maliki position, and identify the main disagreement and its سبب; recognise a ربوي or غرر-bearing structure inside an ordinary Nigerian financial product; distinguish a sharī'ah ruling from a Yoruba custom in عقيقة, تسمية, وليمة and تعزية without dismissing the custom where it is merely permissible; and explain any of the above in Arabic, English and Yoruba — the Yoruba register being the one that actually reaches the congregation.

And the competence that makes the rest safe: the trained reflex of لا أعلم، اسأل أهل العلم. The graduate can distinguish نقل from اجتهاد, can cite a position to its source rather than to his own authority, and knows that a secondary-school certificate in فقه licenses him to teach and to answer the ordinary, not to issue fatwa on the contested. A school that produces confident young men who will rule on anything has produced a liability. This is the one capstone outcome I would refuse to trade for any amount of additional content.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the [RECOVERED] ceilings of 7 periods/week at G1–G2 and ~19 periods/week at G3–G12, all 40 minutes:

G1–G2: ZERO dedicated periods. مضمّن inside the التوحيد العملي stream; realistically under one period-equivalent of embedded time per week. The practical work happens in the school's own daily congregational prayer, which occurs anyway on both the Mon–Wed 2–6pm and Sat–Sun 9am–3pm patterns and costs nothing. Explicitly NOT funded from the ring-fenced Qur'an hour.

G3–G4: 2 periods/week for the التوحيد والفقه pair, of which roughly 1 is attributable to فقه. Independent practical assessment adds no periods — it is observation during prayer with a duty teacher and a checklist.

G5–G6: 2 periods/week مستقل. PERIOD-NEUTRAL: funded entirely by returning السيرة to الحديث (its correct partner, and where the submission itself had it at G4), which frees exactly what الفقه needs. No net increase on the 19. The G5 sex-separated طهارة وحدة runs inside these 2 periods for ~3 weeks of one term; it needs staffing, not timetable.

G7–G9: 2 periods/week, rising to 3 in the single term at G9 that carries the الفرائض وحدة — and that third period is surrendered entirely if the register turns out to contain a separate علم المواريث.

G10–G12: 3 periods/week requested, with an explicit fallback because I know the G10–G12 ceiling is the tightest in the ladder. If the board cannot fund 3, the correct compression is to run أصول الفقه مدمج inside الفقه's 3 periods at G10 — separately traceable and independently assessed, per the form/assessment orthogonality — and let it go مستقل at G11–G12. The wrong compression is cutting الفقه to 2, which would force the abandonment of either فقه النوازل or the G12 practical certification, both of which are the point of the whole twelve years.

Total الفقه footprint across the ladder: ~0 / 0 / 1 / 1 / 2 / 2 / 2 / 2 / 2–3 / 3 / 3 / 3. Modest, and the two increases it asks for are both offset rather than additive.
departuresFromSubmission: REJECT the الفقه + السيرة pairing at G5–G6. السيرة is narrative-historical, الفقه is normative-taxonomic; they share no cognitive operation, no technical vocabulary, and no assessment logic, so nothing transfers in either direction. It is a leftover-slot pairing. It also breaks a genuinely good pair — الحديث والسيرة, which the submission itself correctly made at G4 and both of which are riwāya-based أخبار building the same competence. Restore الحديث والسيرة at G5–G6 and the periods for an independent الفقه appear at no net cost.

الفقه becomes مستقل at G5. The submission never lets it differentiate at any point through G7. Reasons in the differentiation field; the decisive one is that أحكام الحيض والاغتسال require a sex-separated وحدة, which cannot be delivered inside a shared block with السيرة, and cannot wait past G5 without arriving after بلوغ for part of the cohort.
G6 is مستقل with الأخضري, not الفقه والسيرة مدمج. A year that carries a matn cannot be a half-subject. The matn choice itself is protected and defended, not changed.

G7 is مستقل, not مدمج. You cannot give a subject its own matn at G6 and demote it to a shared block at G7 while the matn progression continues into الرسالة. This appears to be timetable drift rather than a considered judgement.

RAISE assessment to independently assessed from G3, and fully (practical + written) from G4 — the submission has no independent فقه assessment before G5 and arguably none before G7. The school must possess per-child evidence that the prayer of a nine-year-old is valid, one year before the age at which it becomes enforceable. A combined 'التوحيد والفقه: جيد' mark does not carry that information. This costs zero periods because the assessment site is the school's own congregational prayer.

NAME THE HOST for the G1–G2 مضمّن. The submission says الفقه التطبيقي مضمّن without saying inside what. Unhosted embedding is how content quietly disappears. Host it in the التوحيد العملي stream, and designate the school's daily prayer as the practical site — with the explicit protection that no part of it is funded from the ring-fenced Qur'an hour.

ADD a sex-separated وحدة at G5 covering أحكام الحيض والنفاس والاغتسال والاحتلام وعلامات البلوغ, with a female teacher for the girls. Absent from the submission entirely. This is a staffing precondition, not a syllabus note.

ADD an explicit pedagogical framing rule for G1–G7 mirroring accepted redline 6: فقه is taught as 'how I do this correctly', never as an invalidation checklist a child can turn on family, on the imam, or on a neighbouring tendency. The board applied this reasoning to نواقض الإسلام and did not notice that مبطلات الصلاة carries the identical hazard in a Nigerian setting with live intra-Muslim difference.
PROTECT, against future revision: G1 practical start; the الأخضري choice at G6; and the الأخضري → الرسالة Maliki line. These are right and the reasons are regional and specific, not conventional.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: التوحيد / العقيدة — partner G1–G4, then separates (forced by accepted redline 5, which sends التوحيد to pair with العقيدة at G5). The pairing is productive while it lasts because both disciplines are normative and share the same structural grammar: a thing has شروط, a thing has أركان, a thing can be invalidated. BOUNDARY: التوحيد owns أقسام التوحيد, الأسماء والصفات, نواقض الإسلام; الفقه owns نواقض الوضوء and مبطلات الصلاة. Both use the word نواقض, and the curriculum must make that a deliberately taught parallel at G5 rather than an accidental collision in a ten-year-old's head.

الحديث — feeds الفقه throughout, decisively from G8. أحاديث الأحكام are read in الحديث and applied in الفقه. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: الفقه does not annex عمدة الأحكام or any أحاديث الأحكام collection as its own text. Annexation doubles memorisation load and lets each subject assume the other did the work.

مصطلح الحديث — the gate on my entire G10–G12 stage. الفقه can only ask 'is this دليل sound?' once the student holds صحيح/حسن/ضعيف. Accepted redline 1 places differentiation at G10–G11, which synchronises exactly with my G10 pivot. The redline that removed نخبة الفكر from G6 is not merely a removal; it is the relocation that makes الفقه's own maturation possible.

أصول الفقه — my single most important unplaced dependency. I need أمر/نهي, عام/خاص, مطلق/مقيد, ناسخ/منسوخ by G10. Recommendation offered, not claimed: begin G10 مدمج inside الفقه (separately traceable, independently assessed), go مستقل G11–G12, with الورقات as matn. The placement decision belongs to that specialist and to the board.

السيرة — NOT a partner, at any grade. Whatever فقه content the Sīrah carries (how the Prophet actually prayed, fasted, traded) reaches الفقه through الحديث already. Pairing them duplicates nothing and enables nothing.

التفسير — آيات الأحكام feed الفقه from G8. BOUNDARY: التفسير explains the verse and its context; الفقه derives and applies the ruling. Written into both syllabi or it will be taught twice and owned by neither.

اللغة العربية / النحو / الصرف — purely enabling, never content. الصرف in particular is load-bearing in a way that is easy to miss: the فقه lexicon is disproportionately مزيد-derived, so البناء في الصرف (G6) and لامية الأفعال (G7) are what make the الأخضري/الرسالة vocabulary transparent rather than memorised.

الترجمة — begins G6 under accepted redline 8. The فقه lexicon is the single highest-value translation target in the school, because it is precisely what the graduate will have to render for a Yoruba-speaking congregation. The Yoruba فقه register should be taught deliberately from G6, not improvised at G12.

الدراسات الحديثة — partner for فقه النوازل at G11–G12, with a clean division: الدراسات الحديثة supplies the factual description of a modern institution (how a bank actually works, what an insurance contract actually does); الفقه supplies the حكم. Neither should attempt the other's half.

الإنشاء والخطابة — consumes الفقه at G11–G12. The graduate must be able to deliver a khutbah or a teaching session on a fiqh topic: that is خطابة's form and فقه's content. The two syllabi should share assessment tasks rather than each inventing its own.

التربية الإسلامية — UNDEFINED and a live duplication risk. If it means آداب وأخلاق وسلوك, then it and الفقه must be fenced: الفقه does not absorb آداب, and التربية الإسلامية does not teach عبادات. If it is intended as a general Islamic studies wrapper, it will silently swallow فقه العبادات in the early grades and the board will have two subjects teaching wuḍū'. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

التجويد — almost no overlap, with one real boundary worth naming: whether recitation without tajwid invalidates or diminishes the prayer is a فقه question, not a تجويد question, and should be answered in فقه at G7. Otherwise the two are independent.

The MORNING NATIONAL CURRICULUM — a genuine dependency that sits outside this scope entirely. زكاة at G7 needs fractions; الفرائض at G9 needs ratio and percentage. SHRS must verify these against the national scheme of work rather than assume them.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] MADHHAB POLICY. Is SHRS teaching فقه مالكي as the school's madhhab (تفقه على مذهب, with تقليد as the settled stance through G12), or using الأخضري and الرسالة as regional primers en route to a دليل-based, non-madhhab approach at G10–G12? My G1–G9 design is identical under both readings. My G10–G12 design is not: under the first, بداية المجتهد is read to understand other schools; under the second, it is read to choose among them. This cannot be decided by a subject specialist, and it must be decided before G8 texts are commissioned. It also intersects with an apparent tension already visible in the submission — Maliki fiqh alongside نواقض الإسلام and منظومة التوحيد in the creed strand, a combination common in Nigeria but not self-interpreting.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does the full 26-subject register contain a separate علم الفرائض / المواريث? I have placed a فرائض وحدة at G9 on the assumption it does not. If it does, I surrender the وحدة and the third period that carries it.
[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] What is التربية الإسلامية? Until it is defined, the duplication risk against فقه العبادات in G1–G6 and against آداب in G7–G9 cannot be assessed.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] When does أصول الفقه begin? الفقه needs it by G10. If it cannot be funded as مستقل, I have offered to carry it مدمج inside my G10 periods — but that is an offer, not a claim, and the أصول specialist should be heard first.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Is ابن عاشر (المرشد المعين) acceptable? I have declined to place it because its عقيدة أشعرية and تصوف sections would commit the school to a creed position through a fiqh text selection. If the board wants the most widely used West African primer, it must rule on the creed question first.

[STAFFING PRECONDITION, not a curriculum question] The G5 sex-separated طهارة وحدة requires a female teacher competent to deliver أحكام الحيض والنفاس to girls. If that post does not exist, the وحدة does not happen, and the sharpest delay risk in this lifecycle goes unmitigated. This should be raised with whoever holds recruitment, not left in a syllabus document.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Will the school formally designate the daily congregational prayer as the assessment site for فقه العبادات at G1–G6? This is what makes independent assessment from G3 cost zero periods. It requires a named duty teacher and a per-child checklist, and it must be written so that it cannot, under timetable pressure, be allowed to encroach on the ring-fenced Qur'an hour.

[CROSS-CURRICULAR] Confirm with the morning national stream that fractions are secure by ~G6 and ratio/percentage by ~G8. If not, زكاة moves to G8 and الفرائض to G10, and the G9–G10 content shifts accordingly.

[NOTED, NOT ACTED ON] No [UNVERIFIED] text touches this subject's allocation — الأخضري is the only text the submission named for الفقه, and I am confident in it. The two unverified titles sit in النشيد at G4 and G5 and are not mine to resolve.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G8 — but only in a precisely limited sense, and the discipline is not NAMED until G10. "Meaningful" for أصول الفقه cannot mean "the student hears a definition"; أصول الفقه is a second-order discipline whose entire subject matter is the relationship between a نص and a حكم. A student who does not already hold a body of أحكام in memory has nothing for the discipline to be about, and teaching it to him produces verbal recall with zero transfer — the single most common failure of أصول teaching in both traditional and modern institutions. The first point at which teaching it produces real learning is therefore G8, when the student has completed الأخضري (G6) plus a year of فقه beyond it, and can be asked "ما الدليل؟" about a ruling he already performs and already knows, and can answer from a نص he has already memorised. That is genuine أصول learning — evidence-consciousness, the habit that every later قاعدة attaches to — and it costs zero periods because it lives inside الفقه's existing lessons. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] The discipline's first appearance as itself, under its own name and with a matn, is G10.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, not alluded to, not prepared for. الفقه at G1 is التطبيقي (pictures, gestures, situations) per the submission; asking a six-year-old why a ruling is a ruling replaces an act with an argument. The only thing relevant to أصول being built here is Qur'anic text in memory through the ring-fenced حفظ hour — the raw material the discipline will one day reason from.
Not taught. Same reasoning as G1. Continued accumulation of memorised نصوص through the حفظ hour and continued embedding of practice through الفقه التطبيقي.

Not taught. الحديث enters مضمّن this year (submission) — the second body of نصوص the discipline will later need — but it is received as content, not as evidence. No causal or justificatory language about rulings.

Not taught. التوحيد والفقه مدمج this year. Nothing of أصول is introduced; the child's فقه vocabulary is still mostly حلال/حرام binary, which is the correct developmental level and must not be prematurely refined into the five أحكام تكليفية.

Not taught. النحو والصرف begin مضمّن this year — the start of the linguistic tooling أصول ultimately runs on — but the student has no syntax yet, only word-level work. Note: نواقض الإسلام sits at G5 under protective framing (redline 6); any أصول-style reasoning about evidence and inference near that content would be actively dangerous, and is excluded.

Not taught. This is the year the discipline's two feeders actually begin: الأخضري gives the first systematic فقه corpus (طهارة، صلاة، and the مالكي ordering of عبادات), and الآجرومية gives the first النحو. Both are absolute beginners' texts this year. Placing أصول beside them would be the exact error redline 1 corrected in مصطلح الحديث — a second-order technical discipline set beside a first-order beginner's matn.

Not taught, and I explicitly reject the symmetry argument that would put الورقات here beside ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال. G7 is already the densest matn year in the ladder (ملحة، لامية الأفعال، الجزرية، تفسير). What happens for أصول is prerequisite work owned by other subjects: ملحة الإعراب gives الجملة and the syntactic relations that دلالات النص later depends on; الفقه continues past الأخضري, growing the corpus of فروع.

Delivered entirely inside الفقه lessons, zero additional periods. Two objectives, written into the أصول syllabus and traced to it: (1) the five أحكام تكليفية — واجب، مندوب، حرام، مكروه، مباح — taught as a working classification and applied to rulings already held from الأخضري and G7 فقه, replacing the حلال/حرام binary; (2) the rule that no فقه ruling is taught this year without its نص being quoted alongside it — آية or حديث, named, in Arabic, from material already memorised. No أصول terminology whatsoever: no عام/خاص, no قياس, no definitions. The student learns that rulings come FROM somewhere before he learns any vocabulary for how.

Still inside الفقه lessons, zero additional periods, but now carrying its own mark line — a named section of the الفقه examination in which the student is given a ruling he knows and must state its دليل. Content: الأدلة الأربعة named and ordered (الكتاب، السنة، الإجماع، القياس), one transparent worked example each; الإجماع presented descriptively as the agreement of the علماء, with no حجية argument; القياس introduced through the single classic transparent case only (كل مسكر حرام قياسا على الخمر بجامع الإسكار), with العلة named in plain terms as the reason the ruling was given; and the working rule that صيغة الأمر تفيد الوجوب و صيغة النهي تفيد التحريم ما لم يصرفها صارف, with two or three worked صارف examples. Students do NOT perform قياس of their own this year — they read it, they do not do it.

DIFFERENTIATION. أصول الفقه becomes a named discipline with its own text and its own assessment, taught as the deliberate partner of الفقه: one paired block, each باب of الورقات cashed out the same week on a فقه مسألة the student already holds. First half of الورقات: تعريف أصول الفقه وأقسامه، حد العلم والظن، أقسام الكلام، الأمر والنهي، العام والخاص والتخصيص، المجمل والمبين، الظاهر والمؤول، أفعال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، النسخ وأقسامه. Runs in coordinated parallel with مصطلح الحديث, which begins this year under redline 1. The pairing with الفقه is not a compromise to save a period — it is the pedagogical safeguard against الورقات becoming memorised definitions.
gradeByGrade.text: الورقات لإمام الحرمين الجويني (first half)

gradeByGrade.content: Becomes مستقل because the remaining content exceeds what can ride inside فقه lessons and requires sustained sequence. الورقات completed: التعارض والترجيح، الإجماع وحجيته، الأخبار (المتواتر والآحاد) — this باب is scheduled AFTER مصطلح الحديث has delivered أقسام الخبر, a hard coordination lock — then القياس وأقسامه (علة، دلالة، شبه)، الحظر والإباحة، ترتيب الأدلة، صفة المفتي والمستفتي، الاجتهاد والتقليد. نظم الورقات للعمريطي memorised across the year, matching the institution's established منظومة culture. Assessment: written paper plus recitation of the نظم. Optional إجازة layer available here under the parallel opt-in track (redline 2) — never a gate on the grade.
gradeByGrade.text: الورقات (completed) + نظم الورقات للعمريطي (memorised)

gradeByGrade.content: Applied year — تخريج الفروع على الأصول. Eight to twelve مسائل on which the madhāhib genuinely differ are reconstructed back to their أصولي locus (e.g. whether an أمر here carries وجوب or ندب, whether a عام has been مخصص, whether a خبر is مقبول, whether a فعل نبوي is تشريع or عادة). Plus a bounded وحدة on القواعد الفقهية الكبرى الخمس (الأمور بمقاصدها؛ اليقين لا يزول بالشك؛ المشقة تجلب التيسير؛ الضرر يزال؛ العادة محكمة), and an introduction to مقاصد الشريعة through الضروريات الخمس (حفظ الدين والنفس والعقل والنسل والمال). Closing block on أدب الفتوى: what a school graduate may and may not do with this knowledge — transmit a ruling with its source, recognise when a question needs a مفتٍ, and say لا أدري. Assessment: written paper plus an oral تخريج viva on an unseen مسألة.
gradeByGrade.text: الورقات as reference + قواعد فقهية as a bounded unit

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G10. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Four conditions converge in that year and in no other. (1) مصطلح الحديث begins at G10 under redline 1; الورقات contains باب الأخبار, which cannot be taught without أقسام الخبر, so any earlier differentiation would force the teacher either to leave الورقات half-taught for years or to smuggle isnād vocabulary into G8-G9 — reimporting precisely what redline 1 expelled from G6. (2) By end of G9 the student has completed two full years of دليل-naming inside الفقه, so the الورقات definitions land on cases he already holds rather than on nothing. (3) الفقه itself changes character at G10, moving from ruling-memorisation to evidence-based study; if أصول arrived at G11 a whole year of فقه would be taught with tools the student lacks. (4) Differentiating at G11 would compress the discipline into two years and eliminate the G12 applied تخريج year, leaving a graduate who can recite أصول and cannot use it — the exact failure the whole sequence is engineered to prevent. NOT G9: fourteen-year-olds can follow a transparent قياس but not التعارض والترجيح, and البلاغة-level sensitivity to حقيقة/مجاز is not yet available. NOT G8: الأخضري is one year old. NOT G7: rejected explicitly — the symmetry instinct that says "another matn per year, so الورقات beside ملحة الإعراب" is the same error redline 1 already corrected once.
prerequisites: A held corpus of فروع فقهية the student can be questioned about — طهارة، صلاة، صيام، زكاة in ruling form, not merely in practice. Established by: G6 (الأخضري) and consolidated G7. Without this the discipline has no referents and collapses into verbal memorisation.

النحو to the level of الجملة and its إعراب — the ability to see that a sentence has structure carrying meaning. Established by: G6 (الآجرومية) and G7 (ملحة الإعراب). أصول الفقه is at bottom a discipline of textual semantics; a student who cannot parse cannot do it.
الصرف to the level of الأبنية والمشتقات, so that صيغة الأمر and صيغة النهي are recognisable as forms and not as vocabulary items. Established by: G6 (البناء في الصرف) and G7 (لامية الأفعال).

Command of a body of memorised نصوص — Qur'anic text and matn-level hadith — available for instant recall as evidence. Established by: the ring-fenced حفظ hour G1 onward, plus الحديث from G3 and الحديث والسيرة from G4.

أقسام الخبر — المتواتر والآحاد, and the basic vocabulary of acceptance and rejection. Established by: مصطلح الحديث at G10 under redline 1. This is the single binding coordination lock: the أصول باب الأخبار is scheduled at G11 precisely so this prerequisite exists first.

Sensitivity to حقيقة ومجاز and to the gap between wording and intent. Established by: البلاغة, wherever the board lands it — my G10 دلالات teaching assumes it is present by G10 at latest. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] if البلاغة is placed later.

Formal-operational reasoning: the capacity to abstract a rule from its instances, hold a conditional, and recognise that a ruling has a علة distinct from the case it appears in. Reached around G9-G10 in this ladder (roughly ages 14-15). This is a developmental prerequisite, not a curricular one, and no amount of clever sequencing moves it earlier.
تفسير competence sufficient to read an آية with its context rather than as an isolated slogan. Established by: التفسير العملي from G6 and التفسير from G7.

classicalTexts.title: الورقات في أصول الفقه لإمام الحرمين عبد الملك الجويني
classicalTexts.grade: G10 (first half) – G11 (completed), reference at G12
classicalTexts.justification: The universally used entry primer in أصول across madhāhib and across West Africa, short enough to be genuinely completed rather than perpetually begun, and structured in exactly the order a beginner needs (definitions, then الأمر والنهي, then العام والخاص, then الأدلة, then الاجتهاد). Its brevity is the point: it can be finished in two years alongside everything else at G10-G11 and still leave G12 free for application. It is Shafi'i in authorship, which raises a madhhab-alignment question given الأخضري at G6 — see open questions — but it is in practice taught as a neutral entry text everywhere.

classicalTexts.title: نظم الورقات لشرف الدين يحيى العمريطي
classicalTexts.justification: A versification of الورقات by the same author who versified الآجرومية. It fits the institution's established grain exactly — this school already builds on منظومات (تحفة الأطفال، الجزرية، ملحة الإعراب، لامية الأفعال), and the students are trained to memorise in verse. Memorising the نظم at G11 while working the prose at G10-G11 gives permanent retention at near-zero marginal cost. I am confident the work exists and is العمريطي's; if the board's own library copy shows a different attribution, verify before printing it in the syllabus.

classicalTexts.title: الأصول من علم الأصول لمحمد بن صالح العثيمين
classicalTexts.justification: A short modern primer, clear and example-rich, useful to the teacher for worked illustrations of العام والخاص and القياس in contemporary language. Listed as a teacher reference, not a student text: it is Hanbali-inflected and would cut across the school's apparent Maliki orientation if set as a student matn.

classicalTexts.title: مراقي السعود لعبد الله بن الحاج إبراهيم العلوي الشنقيطي
classicalTexts.grade: Not core. Optional extension on the parallel إجازة track, G12 and beyond
classicalTexts.justification: The standard Maliki/Shinqiti أصول manẓūma of the West African tradition, and the natural continuation for a student whose فقه is Maliki. It is well beyond secondary level in density and must not be set as a G12 requirement; naming it here marks the road onward rather than a place on the ladder. Its use should be governed by the opt-in mastery track, not the grade calendar.

classicalTexts.title: الموافقات لأبي إسحاق الشاطبي
classicalTexts.grade: Not a set text. Short prepared extracts only, G12 مقاصد unit
classicalTexts.justification: The foundational work on مقاصد الشريعة. Far too demanding as a studied text at G12 — reading it cold produces misunderstanding of exactly the kind that makes مقاصد into a licence. Use two or three teacher-prepared passages on الضروريات الخمس so the student knows the discipline and its source exist, and nothing more.

classicalTexts.title: الأشباه والنظائر (السيوطي / ابن نجيم)
classicalTexts.grade: Not used as a text at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: Both works exist and both are the classic repositories of القواعد الفقهية, but both are مذهب-specific reference compilations for advanced students, not teaching texts for a seventeen-year-old. The G12 القواعد unit should be taught from the five كبرى with worked فقه examples, drawn by the teacher, not from a compilation.

classicalTexts.title: قرة العين بشرح ورقات إمام الحرمين (attributed to أحمد بن زيني دحلان)
classicalTexts.justification: I recall a شرح of الورقات circulating under approximately this title with this attribution, but I cannot confirm the exact title or authorship to the standard this board requires. It is NOT built into the architecture. If the board wants a printed شرح for teacher use, verify the copy in hand before adopting it; there are several well-known شروح of الورقات and the choice among them is a library decision, not a curricular one.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Five specific failures, not generic ones. (1) THE DEFINITIONAL HUSK. A student taught الورقات before he holds فروع recites "العام ما عم شيئين فصاعدا" and cannot produce one مسألة it decides. This is not a hypothetical: it is the standard outcome wherever الورقات is set early, and it is worse than not teaching it, because the student and his file both record that he "did أصول" and he is never taught it again. (2) UNSUPERVISED قياس BY A CHILD. Teach قياس with its machinery to a twelve- or thirteen-year-old and he will run it — on food, on dress, on his family's practice — from a فروع base too thin to constrain him, and he will announce the results at home. In a Yoruba Muslim community where local practice, Salafi-oriented preaching and ṭarīqa practice already coexist under strain, this is the same social hazard the board already recognised in redline 6 on نواقض الإسلام, arriving through a different door. (3) REIMPORTING THE REDLINE-1 ERROR. الورقات contains باب الأخبار. Set it before G10 and the teacher must either skip the باب — leaving a short text unfinished for years, which teaches students that texts are not finished — or teach المتواتر والآحاد at G8-G9, which is isnād-criticism terminology at exactly the age redline 1 removed it from. (4) DESTABILISED PRACTICE. A student meets الخلاف before his own عبادات are settled and hears "some say it is not required" as "it is not required." At G8-G9 the correct posture is still doing the thing. (5) SELF-DEFEATING OPPORTUNITY COST. Two periods a week out of nineteen at G8-G9 would have to come from النحو والصرف consolidation — and thin النحو is precisely what makes أصول impossible later. Buying أصول early with النحو is paying for the house with the foundation.
lifecycles.delayRisks: Five, equally specific. (1) FROZEN فقه. If أصول does not arrive by G10, الفقه at G10-G12 remains a list of memorised rulings, and the graduate can answer only questions literally covered in الأخضري. Every question outside the text — and outside the text is where life is — has no method behind the answer. (2) THE NIGERIAN PUBLIC SPHERE. This graduate will walk straight into live, loud, public اختلاف: local Maliki practice, Salafi-oriented preaching, ṭarīqa practice, and an unlimited supply of English-language internet fatwa. Without أصول he has exactly two available postures — uncritical تقليد of whoever speaks with most force, or amateur self-authorised فتوى — and both are visible failure modes in the region today. This is the single strongest argument against pushing differentiation past G10. (3) TRANSLATION WITHOUT METHOD. Redline 8 puts الترجمة from G6 and it develops through the secondary years. A graduate rendering fiqh into Yoruba or English for a lay audience without أصول flattens اختلاف into dogma in the act of translating it; the translation itself becomes a ruling. (4) REMEDIAL ENTRY ABROAD. Any recognised Islamic university places أصول in year one or two with الورقات presumed known. Given the school's stated international ambitions, a graduate with no أصول enters below the line. (5) NO TIME TO APPLY IT. Differentiate at G11 and the discipline is theoretical when the student leaves; تخريج الفروع على الأصول, which is the only thing that converts أصول from recitation into capacity, needs a full year and needs the theory already in place.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 أصول الفقه is the discipline that converts twelve years of accumulated content into judgement, and it is the graduating discipline of Programme 3. It is مستقل, independently assessed by written paper and an oral تخريج viva on an unseen مسألة. Concretely, the graduate can: read a فقه text that cites evidence and follow the استدلال rather than only the conclusion; take a مسألة on which qualified people differ and locate WHERE they differ — whether the أمر carries وجوب or ندب, whether a عام has been مخصص, whether a فعل نبوي is تشريع or عادة, whether the خبر is accepted — instead of counting which side has more shouting; transmit a ruling together with its source and its madhhab attribution rather than as a bare verdict; recognise the boundary of his own authority, know which questions require a مفتٍ, and say لا أدري as a trained response rather than an embarrassment; explain to a Yoruba- or English-speaking lay audience why Muslims differ, without collapsing into relativism on one side or takfir on the other; and enter a university course in أصول at or above entry level, having completed الورقات with شرح and memorised نظم الورقات. What he cannot do, and must be explicitly taught that he cannot do, is issue فتوى. The G12 أدب الفتوى block exists to make that limit part of the competence rather than a gap in it.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Against the 19-period ceiling (7 at G1-G2), this subject is deliberately cheap and only becomes a line item late. G1-G7: ZERO periods — not taught at all, and the ceiling is untouched. G8-G9: ZERO ADDITIONAL periods — the مضمّن phase rides entirely inside the الفقه block that already exists; the objectives are booked to أصول, the minutes are booked to فقه. This is the design's main economy and the reason the discipline can differentiate at G10 without displacing anything. G10: ONE period, requested as an increase of the الفقه block from 2 to 3 periods, delivered as a paired فقه/أصول block with أصول separately traceable and separately assessed. Net new cost to the timetable: +1 of 19 (5%). G11: TWO periods مستقل. G12: TWO periods مستقل. Peak ask is therefore 2 periods of 19, about 10.5%, reached only in the final two years, and the discipline consumes nothing at all for the first seven grades and no marginal minutes for the next two. If the secondary timetable comes under pressure, the defensible cut is G12 to 1.5-2 periods with the مقاصد and قواعد units compressed; the cut that must NOT be made is removing the G10 paired period, because that is the year the whole sequence hinges on.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: الفقه — the primary feeder and the primary partner. الفقه supplies the corpus أصول reasons about (الأخضري G6 onward) and hosts أصول entirely at G8-G9 and half at G10. In return, أصول changes what الفقه can be at G11-G12: from ruling-memorisation to evidence-based study. BOUNDARY: أصول must never become a second فقه lesson listing rulings, and الفقه must never start teaching الورقات definitions on its own account. The G8-G9 objectives sit in the أصول syllabus and are delivered by the فقه teacher.

مصطلح الحديث (G10-G11, نخبة الفكر, redline 1) — a binding coordination lock, not a loose relationship. أصول USES المتواتر والآحاد and the accepted/rejected distinction in باب الأخبار; it does NOT teach الجرح والتعديل and does NOT train students to grade أسانيد. مصطلح owns the grading machinery; أصول owns the حجية question — whether and how a report that mustalah has graded functions as evidence for a ruling. The أصول باب الأخبار is scheduled at G11 so that مصطلح has delivered أقسام الخبر first.

النحو والصرف (الآجرومية G6, ملحة الإعراب G7, لامية الأفعال G7, and onward) — the deepest feeder. أصول الفقه is a discipline of textual semantics, and دلالات الألفاظ is unintelligible without syntax. Nothing flows the other way; أصول does not teach نحو and must not borrow نحو time.

البلاغة — feeds أصول with حقيقة ومجاز and sensitivity to intent beyond wording. BOUNDARY: البلاغة owns تشبيه، مجاز، كناية as literary phenomena; أصول borrows حقيقة ومجاز only insofar as they determine what a نص obliges. Neither should teach the other's examples.

أصول التفسير — the nearest neighbour and the likeliest source of duplication. أصول التفسير should own أسباب النزول، المكي والمدني، أنواع التفسير، and the Qur'anic instances of النسخ. أصول الفقه should own النسخ as a rule-structure (what it does to a حكم, its conditions, its ترتيب) and the دلالة categories as instruments of استنباط. This division needs a Council ruling rather than goodwill between two teachers.

المنطق وعلم الكلام — الورقات opens with حد العلم والظن and with definitional structure, which is منطق-adjacent. أصول borrows حد ورسم and nothing else; it does not teach الأشكال or القياس المنطقي. If المنطق is placed at G10-G11, its treatment of التعريف والتقسيم should precede or coincide with the الورقات opening, not repeat it.

الدراسات الحديثة — a downstream beneficiary that is worthless without أصول. Contemporary questions (banking, medicine, workplace, media) degenerate into opinion-trading unless the student can locate a new case against known evidence and known قواعد. Sequencing implication: الدراسات الحديثة should not carry contested contemporary rulings before G11.

الترجمة (from G6, redline 8) — أصول feeds it directly and urgently. Rendering a فقه ruling into Yoruba or English without أصول converts a madhhab position into an unqualified command in the act of translation. G12 أصول should include at least one exercise in translating a ruling WITH its attribution and its level of certainty intact.

الإنشاء والخطابة — أصول supplies the structure of a reasoned claim (claim, evidence, inference, qualification) and الخطابة supplies the delivery. The risk runs the other way: a student trained to speak persuasively before he is trained to reason from evidence gives sermons with confidence and no method.

العقيدة والتوحيد (integrated through the early and middle years, redline 5) — separate domain, and the separation must be maintained. The أدلة-and-inference apparatus of أصول الفقه governs الأحكام العملية, not matters of belief. A student who transfers قياس into العقيدة has been badly taught. State this explicitly to the G10 teacher.

السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي — supplies the context in which أفعال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم are read, which is required for the الورقات باب on whether a prophetic act is تشريع, خصوصية, or عادة. This is a genuine dependency, not a decorative one.

حفظ القرآن (ring-fenced hour, G1-G12) — supplies the evidence base itself. The whole design assumes that when a G10 student is asked for the دليل he can produce the آية from memory rather than look it up. Nothing is taken from this hour and nothing is added to it.
departuresFromSubmission: The submission omits أصول الفقه from G1-G7 entirely. I PROTECT that omission and endorse it explicitly — it is correct, and correct for the right reason, not by accident of an unfinished draft. Any later attempt to insert الورقات at G6 or G7 to match the matn-per-year pattern should be refused on the record.

I OVERRIDE the implicit default that a subject absent from G1-G7 is therefore a self-contained secondary add-on that can be designed without touching the earlier grades. أصول الفقه cannot be. It imposes a binding requirement on the G8-G9 الفقه syllabus — which the submission has not yet designed — that every ruling be taught with its نص and that the five أحكام تكليفية be in working use by end of G8. If the G8-G9 فقه syllabus is written without that requirement, the G10 differentiation fails and الورقات becomes the definitional husk described under premature-introduction risks.

I OVERRIDE any reading of the G6-G7 pattern (a new matn each year, paired with نحو and صرف) as applying to this discipline. أصول الفقه carries exactly one matn across the whole ladder — الورقات — plus its نظم. Adding a second أصول text at secondary level would be symmetry-driven and would damage the G12 applied year.

I DECLINE to claim the G8-G9 objectives are uncontroversially mine. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] I book them to أصول الفقه because they are written into its syllabus and traced to it, though delivered by the فقه teacher at zero period cost. If the Council prefers to book them to الفقه instead, the sequence is unchanged and I do not object — but then أصول الفقه's first appearance is G10, and the Council must guarantee in writing that the دليل-naming habit is contractually part of the G8-G9 فقه syllabus. What cannot happen is that the objectives sit in neither subject's document.
I note that neither [UNVERIFIED] text under redline 4 touches this subject, so no slot here is pending identification.
openQuestions: MADHHAB ALIGNMENT. الأخضري at G6 indicates a Maliki فقه orientation, consistent with the region. الورقات is Shafi'i in authorship though used as a neutral entry primer everywhere. Is the school's فقه formally Maliki? If so, should the G12 تخريج year be anchored in the Maliki أصول tradition (the مراقي السعود lineage) with الورقات retained only as the entry text? This changes what G12 examples look like and it changes teacher recruitment. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

OWNERSHIP OF النسخ. Both أصول التفسير and أصول الفقه have a legitimate claim. My proposal: the Qur'anic instances and their history to أصول التفسير, the rule-structure and conditions to أصول الفقه. Needs a ruling, because two teachers each assuming the other covers it produces a gap, and both covering it wastes scarce periods. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

OWNERSHIP OF القواعد الفقهية. It does not appear in the 26-subject register under its own name. I have placed the five كبرى as a bounded وحدة inside G12 أصول. It could equally sit inside الفقه. It must sit somewhere named. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
BOOKING OF THE G8-G9 OBJECTIVES — to أصول الفقه or to الفقه. See departures. Either answer works; no answer does not. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

PLACEMENT OF البلاغة. My G10 دلالات teaching assumes some sensitivity to حقيقة ومجاز is present by G10. If the board places البلاغة at G11 or later, the G10 الورقات treatment of الظاهر والمؤول needs the teacher to build that sensitivity from scratch, costing time I have not budgeted.

TEACHER CAPACITY. أصول الفقه at G10-G12 cannot be taught by a generalist Islamic Studies teacher working a term ahead of the class; it is the discipline where that fails most visibly, because the teacher's own worked examples are the entire instructional content. This is a staffing constraint on the G10 start date, and it is the most likely real-world reason for the sequence to fail. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

إجازة LINKAGE. Under redline 2 the Ijazah is a parallel opt-in mastery track. I have proposed نظم الورقات memorisation plus الورقات with شرح as an available إجازة layer at G11-G12. Whether the track admits non-Qur'anic matn certification at all is a governance question I do not own.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G3. "Meaningful" for this discipline means the point at which a memorised Arabic report can be correctly *attributed* by the child — i.e. the learner can answer من قال هذا؟ and distinguish كلام الله from كلام رسول الله ﷺ without prompting. Memorisation alone is not meaningful hadith learning; attribution is the whole point of the discipline. That threshold is reached at G3 because (a) two full years of the ring-fenced Qur'an hour [RECOVERED] have established Qur'an as a firmly bounded category of speech, (b) G3 is the first year اللغة العربية works at الكلمات level, so a hadith is parseable into recognised words rather than being pure sound, and (c) the period ceiling rises from ~7 to ~19 [RECOVERED], making a planned embedded strand affordable for the first time. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] + [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught as a distinct entity. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Prophetic content still reaches the child — wudu sequence, salah gestures, salam and its reply, adab of eating and entering — but it arrives through الفقه التطبيقي and التوحيد العملي as modelled practice, not as attributed text. The child does the Sunnah before the child cites the Sunnah. No hadith wording is set for verbatim memorisation this year.

Still not a distinct entity. One preparatory item is deliberately planted inside التوحيد العملي and made a gate for G3: the child must reliably say that the Qur'an is كلام الله and that the Prophet ﷺ also spoke, and must produce the ṣalawāt formula (صلى الله عليه وسلم) whenever his name is said. This is the single prerequisite hadith study cannot start without, and it is cheap to establish here and expensive to repair later.

First meaningful appearance. 8–10 hadith of ten words or fewer, memorised orally with a Yoruba and English gloss, each one attached to something the child is already doing in الفقه التطبيقي or التوحيد: الطهور شطر الإيمان (with wudu), المسلم من سلم المسلمون من لسانه ويده, لا يؤمن أحدكم حتى يحب لأخيه ما يحب لنفسه, الدين النصيحة, من غشنا فليس منا, تبسمك في وجه أخيك صدقة, الكلمة الطيبة صدقة, من لا يشكر الناس لا يشكر الله, إن الله جميل يحب الجمال. Three meta-facts, taught explicitly and examined orally: the word حديث; that this is كلام النبي ﷺ and NOT Qur'an; the ṣalawāt after his name. Hadith supplies the نص, الفقه supplies the عمل — it must not re-teach the wudu steps. Assessment is embedded (an oral recitation-and-attribution check reported as a named component inside the التوحيد والفقه mark) and deliberately NOT independent: at age eight the learner already carries one independently examined Arabic memorisation load in the ring-fenced Qur'an hour, and a second competing examined memorisation subject the same year is an over-count of the child, not of the curriculum.

PROTECTED from the submission — the الحديث+السيرة pairing at G4 is correct and should not be disturbed. 12–15 hadith, each anchored to an episode of the Prophet's life so the report acquires a speaker, a setting and an occasion: أنا وكافل اليتيم في الجنة هكذا, الراحمون يرحمهم الرحمن, خيركم خيركم لأهله, ارحموا من في الأرض يرحمكم من في السماء, لا يدخل الجنة من لا يأمن جاره بوائقه, من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليقل خيرا أو ليصمت, انصر أخاك ظالما أو مظلوما. The decisive new content is the الصحابي: Abu Hurayrah, Ibn Umar, Anas, Aisha, Ibn Abbas introduced as named human beings who heard and carried the words. This is the seed of isnād laid as biography, with zero terminology — no رواية, no سند, no صحيح/حسن/ضعيف. Independently assessed as a separately reported hadith component within the مدمج paper: attribution and meaning, not grammar.

gradeByGrade.text: الأربعون النووية (أحاديث ١–١٣)
gradeByGrade.content: POINT OF DIFFERENTIATION. Own book, own progression, own examination. Two things happen: (1) the cumulative corpus crosses ~25 items and is reorganised thematically — الإيمان، الطهارة والصلاة، الأخلاق، المعاملات — an organising logic السيرة cannot supply, since a life is chronological and a corpus is topical; (2) الأربعون النووية begins, hadith 1–13 (إنما الأعمال بالنيات, حديث جبريل, بني الإسلام على خمس, حديث ابن مسعود في خلق الإنسان, من أحدث في أمرنا, الحلال بين والحرام بين, الدين النصيحة onwards), memorised in full with meaning. الحديث here must NOT be allowed to carry نواقض الإسلام or any عقيدة polemic — that stays in التوحيد والعقيدة under its own protective framing (redline 6).

gradeByGrade.text: الأربعون النووية (أحاديث ١٤–٢٨)
gradeByGrade.content: CONTENT ONLY, per accepted redline 1 — and the redline's residue must not be quietly folded into الفقه or السيرة. الأربعون 14–28, now read as text rather than heard as sound: with الآجرومية and البناء في الصرف running the same year, the learner is asked word by word what the matn says — subject, verb, particle of negation, form of the verb — and only then what it obliges, prohibits or permits (فقه الحديث at matn level). One new labelling convention: the source collection is named (رواه البخاري / رواه مسلم / متفق عليه) as a bibliographic label the learner records. Named hard prohibition for this grade: no صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as technical categories, no isnād chain analysis, no نخبة الفكر, no مصطلح vocabulary of any kind.

gradeByGrade.text: الأربعون النووية (أحاديث ٢٩–٤٢) + زيادات ابن رجب
gradeByGrade.content: OVERRIDE of the submission's "الحديث/مصطلح الحديث مدمج" at G7: مصطلح is removed from G7 entirely (redline 1 places it at G10–G11), and what remains is not a half-subject to be attached to a neighbour — it is the completion of the spine text. الأربعون completed (29–42), plus ابن رجب's eight additions, giving a closed, certifiable corpus of ~50 hadith held verbatim. With ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال running, explanation begins shifting to Arabic medium for the simpler matns. رياض الصالحين enters as extensive graded READING (not memorisation) to build volume of exposure. This is also where الترجمة (begun G6) takes hadith as its content: rendering a matn into English and Yoruba without adding to it.

gradeByGrade.text: عمدة الأحكام (كتاب الطهارة، كتاب الصلاة)
gradeByGrade.content: Transition from the ethical-creedal corpus to the legal corpus. عمدة الأحكام begins — a collection restricted to what البخاري and مسلم agree upon, which is exactly the right first legal corpus for a learner who has no مصطلح yet: its authenticity question is answered by its own selection criterion, so the learner can work on wording and ruling without needing grading theory he does not have. كتاب الطهارة and كتاب الصلاة: ~80–100 hadith read closely, ~30 memorised. Non-duplication protocol with الفقه, stated in both syllabi: الفقه owns the ruling, its conditions and its application; الحديث owns the text — its exact wording, its narrator, the difference between روايات, and what the wording does and does not say. Explanation becomes predominantly Arabic-medium this year.

gradeByGrade.text: عمدة الأحكام (الزكاة، الصيام، الحج، البيوع، النكاح — selections) + الأدب المفرد (selections)
gradeByGrade.content: Core of عمدة الأحكام completed across the remaining kitābs in selection. Alongside it, الأدب المفرد selections restore the akhlāq strand so the discipline does not narrow into law just as the learner becomes capable of law. New competence: handling two wordings of the same event — comparing روايات for what one adds, without yet judging which is stronger. That withheld judgement is deliberate: it creates the felt need that مصطلح answers next year, which is why مصطلح lands well at G10 and would have landed as empty vocabulary at G6.

gradeByGrade.text: بلوغ المرام من أدلة الأحكام (كتاب الطهارة، كتاب الصلاة)
gradeByGrade.content: بلوغ المرام begins, running in parallel with مصطلح الحديث + نخبة الفكر, which differentiates this year as its own subject. The division of labour is absolute and must be written into both syllabi: مصطلح owns the theory — definitions, categories, isnād criticism, the نخبة apparatus; الحديث النبوي owns the corpus — the matn, its fiqh, and the practical reading of what Ibn Hajar has appended. The learner reads a full isnād aloud correctly and reads the compiler's grading notice as reported information; he does not yet adjudicate it. بلوغ المرام is chosen here precisely because it carries those notices on the page, making it the natural interface text without making it a مصطلح textbook.

gradeByGrade.text: بلوغ المرام (الزكاة، الصيام، الحج، البيوع، الجنايات — selections) + الشمائل المحمدية (bounded unit)
gradeByGrade.content: بلوغ المرام continued across the remaining kitābs in selection. With مصطلح now in its second year, the learner may for the first time state why a compiler graded a hadith as he did — using مصطلح's apparatus, assessed in مصطلح, applied here. One bounded unit of الشمائل المحمدية (الترمذي) runs for a single term as a deliberate corrective: after two years of legal corpus, the learner returns to the person of the Prophet ﷺ, his description, manner, dress and speech, so that the graduate's picture of him is not reducible to a body of rulings.

gradeByGrade.text: مختارات من صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم + جامع العلوم والحكم (selections)
gradeByGrade.content: The primary-source year — the first and only year the learner works in the actual مصادر rather than in compilations made for learners. Selected kitābs read directly: from صحيح البخاري كتاب الإيمان، كتاب العلم، كتاب الرقاق; from صحيح مسلم كتاب الإيمان، كتاب البر والصلة والآداب — with the full isnād on the page. Three capstone competences: (1) practical تخريج — given a matn, locate it in الكتب الستة and cite book, kitāb and bāb; (2) matn commentary — a written شرح of one hadith drawing on جامع العلوم والحكم (ابن رجب) as the model commentary on a corpus the learner has held since G5; (3) cumulative recitation of the standing corpus with attribution. Requires 3 periods; see the period note.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G5 — الحديث becomes مستقل with its own book, progression and examination. WHY G5 AND NOT G4: at G4 the entire corpus is organised by the Prophet's biography; every hadith is a caption to a sirah episode. It has nothing to be independent *about* — an independent subject needs an organising principle of its own, and at G4 السيرة supplies it. WHY G5 AND NOT G6: two reasons, one positive, one defensive. Positive — G5 is the first year the cumulative corpus crosses the threshold (~25 items) where narrative order fails and thematic order (إيمان / طهارة وصلاة / أخلاق / معاملات) becomes necessary, which is a logic no partner subject can supply; it is also the year النحو والصرف are being exercised (مضمّن + independently assessed in the submission), so the learner can be asked what a matn says word by word rather than what it means roughly. Defensive — G6 is already the heaviest year in the whole ladder (الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الجزرية، الأخضري، التفسير العملي، الترجمة all begin or run there). If hadith's differentiation were placed at G6 it would not differentiate; it would be the thing that gets squeezed to make room for five new matns. Establishing its own footing at G5 means it enters G6 already load-bearing. Additionally, G5 is forced by the submission's own structure: the submission moves السيرة to pair with الفقه at G5, which orphans الحديث. An orphaned discipline either goes مستقل or gets absorbed into a mega-block — and redline 9 forbids the mega-block. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]
prerequisites: Stable distinction between كلام الله and كلام رسوله ﷺ — the absolute gate. Established G1–G2 through the ring-fenced Qur'an hour plus التوحيد العملي; verified before the first hadith is set at G3. Without it the child files a hadith wording under 'Qur'an', which is the one error this discipline exists to prevent.
The ṣalawāt formula and the adab of naming the Prophet ﷺ — established G2 inside التوحيد العملي. Must precede the first hadith, not accompany it.
Arabic oral verbatim memorisation with meaning attached — established G1–G2 inside the Qur'an hour; hadith borrows the method, never the hour.
Word-level Arabic reading (القراءة والتهجي as a separate book, independently assessed) — established G3. Enables the G3 hadith to be seen as words, not heard as sound.
Arabic vocabulary and short-sentence comprehension — established G4 (اللغة العربية: المفردات والجمل القصيرة). Prerequisite for G4 attribution-plus-meaning assessment.
The Companions as named historical persons with lives and settings — established G4–G5 through السيرة. This is the non-technical substrate of isnād and must exist years before any isnād terminology.

Sentence-level إعراب — الآجرومية, established G6; and verb-form recognition — البناء في الصرف, established G6. Both are prerequisites for G6 word-by-word matn analysis; this is why matn ANALYSIS cannot start before G6 even though matn MEMORISATION starts at G3.

Fiqh chapter architecture (طهارة، صلاة، زكاة، صيام، حج، بيوع) — established G6 through متن الأخضري. Direct prerequisite for عمدة الأحكام at G8, which is organised by exactly that architecture. عمدة cannot precede الأخضري.
Rendering discipline into English and Yoruba without addition or paraphrase — established G6 through التفسير العملي والترجمة. Feeds hadith translation work from G7.
Extended Arabic reading stamina (multi-page classical prose) — established G7 through ملحة الإعراب and رياض الصالحين extensive reading. Prerequisite for the G8 shift to Arabic-medium explanation.

مصطلح terminology (صحيح، حسن، ضعيف، مرفوع، موقوف، متصل، مرسل) — established G10–G11 via نخبة الفكر. Explicitly NOT a prerequisite for anything before G10: the entire G3–G9 programme is designed to run without it, and any syllabus writer who reaches for it earlier has misread redline 1.

classicalTexts.title: الأربعون النووية — الإمام يحيى بن شرف النووي
classicalTexts.justification: The spine text of the discipline's middle years. Short, closed, thematically comprehensive across إيمان، عبادات، أخلاق، معاملات، رقائق, universally taught, and sized so that a learner genuinely completes it rather than sampling it. Its brevity is the pedagogical asset: forty-two matns can be held verbatim for life, which is the whole purpose of laying a corpus down in the 10–13 memorisation window.

classicalTexts.title: زيادات ابن رجب الحنبلي على الأربعين (the eight additional hadith completing fifty)
classicalTexts.justification: Extends the closed corpus to fifty without changing its character, and pre-positions the learner for جامع العلوم والحكم at G12, which comments on exactly this expanded set. Optional if the G7 period budget is tight.

classicalTexts.title: عمدة الأحكام — عبد الغني المقدسي
classicalTexts.justification: The correct first legal corpus for a learner who has no مصطلح yet, precisely because it is restricted to what البخاري and مسلم agree upon: its authenticity question is settled by its own selection criterion, so the learner works on wording and ruling without needing grading theory he will not have until G10. Its chapter order matches the fiqh architecture established by الأخضري at G6.

classicalTexts.title: الأدب المفرد — الإمام البخاري (selections)
classicalTexts.justification: Keeps the akhlāq strand alive at exactly the point where the legal corpus would otherwise narrow the subject into jurisprudence. Selections only; it is a large work and is used as reading, not memorisation.

classicalTexts.title: بلوغ المرام من أدلة الأحكام — الحافظ ابن حجر العسقلاني
classicalTexts.justification: The natural interface text for the years when مصطلح runs in parallel: it carries the compiler's grading notices on the page, so the learner meets real grading judgements as reported information in الحديث while the theory that explains them is taught next door in مصطلح. Broader than عمدة and explicitly builds on it.

classicalTexts.title: رياض الصالحين — الإمام النووي (selections, extensive reading)
classicalTexts.justification: Volume of exposure. Used as graded extensive reading to build Arabic reading stamina in hadith register; not memorised and not examined as a text, which is what keeps it affordable inside the period ceiling.

classicalTexts.title: الشمائل المحمدية — الإمام الترمذي (bounded one-term unit)
classicalTexts.justification: A deliberate corrective after two years of legal corpus: returns the learner to the person of the Prophet ﷺ — his description, manner, speech and dress — so that the graduate's conception of him is not reducible to a body of rulings. Bounded on purpose; it is a unit inside the subject, not a new strand.

classicalTexts.title: صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم (selected كتب read in the original)
classicalTexts.justification: The first and only year the learner works in the actual مصادر rather than in compilations made for learners, with full isnād on the page. Selection is essential — كتاب الإيمان، كتاب العلم، كتاب الرقاق from البخاري; كتاب الإيمان، كتاب البر والصلة والآداب from مسلم. Reading a source directly is a distinct competence from reading an abridgement, and a graduate who has never done it has not finished the discipline.

classicalTexts.title: جامع العلوم والحكم — ابن رجب الحنبلي (selections)
classicalTexts.justification: Capstone commentary, and the only one that is pedagogically efficient here: it comments on the fifty-hadith corpus the learner has held since G5–G7, so the G12 student meets a full classical شرح on texts he already owns by heart. Selections only — the complete work is far beyond a school year.

classicalTexts.title: التجريد الصريح لأحاديث الجامع الصحيح — الزبيدي (abridgement of البخاري)
classicalTexts.grade: G12 (alternative to direct reading, only if cohort Arabic requires it)
classicalTexts.justification: Offered only as a fallback if a cohort cannot sustain direct reading of البخاري at G12. I am confident an abridgement of this name exists; I am NOT fully confident of the compiler's full name and dates as I would state them, so the Council should have the exact bibliographic entry confirmed by a librarian before it is placed on any book list.

classicalTexts.title: No classical matn at G1–G4
classicalTexts.justification: Stated positively so that no syllabus writer fills the gap by guessing. There is no classical matn written for six-to-nine-year-olds in this discipline, and inventing an attribution to fill the column would be a scholarly failure. G3 and G4 use a school-compiled selection drawn from البخاري and مسلم, each item's source recorded in the teacher's book, compiled and checked by the school's own hadith specialist.

classicalTexts.title: نخبة الفكر — ابن حجر (NOT a text of this subject)
classicalTexts.grade: G10–G11, but under مصطلح الحديث, not under الحديث النبوي
classicalTexts.justification: Listed here only to mark the boundary. Per accepted redline 1 it is the matn of مصطلح الحديث. الحديث النبوي must never carry it, and no part of its apparatus may leak into this subject's syllabus before G10.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Three specific risks, all of them things that actually happen. (1) REGISTER CONTAMINATION at G1–G2. A six-year-old spending the ring-fenced hour memorising Qur'an, then in the same afternoon memorising Arabic prose by the same method, in the same cadence, from the same kind of card, has no cue by which to keep the two categories apart. The observable outcome is a child who recites hadith with Qur'anic cadence and, later, attributes a hadith wording to the Qur'an. The doctrinal cost of that specific error is wholly disproportionate to the gain of eight extra memorised lines, and it is why this design leaves G1–G2 at — rather than squeezing in a token strand. (2) ATTRIBUTION WITHOUT CAPACITY. A G1 child cannot reliably answer من قال هذا؟. Setting an attributed text a child cannot attribute trains precisely the habit the discipline exists to prevent: carrying a sentence with authority attached and no idea where the authority came from. In a Yoruba-speaking setting where hadith circulate as unattributed sermon paraphrase, this is not a theoretical harm. (3) مصطلح BEFORE CORPUS — the error the Redline Board already caught at G6. نخبة الفكر at G6 produces a twelve-year-old who can define صحيح، حسن، ضعيف، مرسل and cannot recognise a single isnād, because there is no corpus for the categories to sort. The second-order harm is worse and less noticed: teaching ضعيف and موضوع to a child with no stock of sound hadith produces reflexive suspicion of the hadith literature as such — the child learns that hadith are things that might be fake before he learns that hadith are how the Prophet ﷺ speaks to him. Recovering from that disposition at G10 is far harder than teaching the terminology late. There is also a budget risk: at 7 periods/week, a G1–G2 hadith block can only be bought from اللغة العربية (الحروف) or الفقه التطبيقي, and both trades are lower-yield.
lifecycles.delayRisks: Four specific risks, and they are as serious as the early-introduction risks. (1) THE PROPHET BECOMES A HISTORICAL FIGURE RATHER THAN A SOURCE OF BINDING SPEECH. If hadith does not begin by G3–G4, the learner's entire religious-textual diet until G6 is Qur'an plus fiqh rulings, and the Prophet ﷺ is met only inside السيرة — i.e. as someone things happened to, not as someone whose words oblige. The measurable consequence appears at G7: the learner can state a ruling and cannot state its دليل, because he has never held a دليل in his mouth. (2) THE MEMORISATION WINDOW CLOSES. Ages roughly 8–13 are where verbatim long-term retention is cheapest, and that window is already being used for the Qur'an — hadith rides on the same established method at near-zero extra cost. A corpus not laid down by G7 has to be built at G10–G12 instead, in direct competition with نخبة الفكر, البلاغة, the leaving qualification and the national morning curriculum. In practice it does not get built; it gets sampled. (3) THE LADDER COLLAPSES DOWNSTREAM. عمدة الأحكام at G8 is only feasible because الأربعون is complete at G7; بلوغ المرام at G10 is only feasible because عمدة is complete at G9; the G12 primary-source year is only feasible because بلوغ is done. Delaying the start by two years does not shift the ladder by two years — it deletes G12's primary-source year, which is the single thing that distinguishes a graduate of this school from a well-read student. It would also leave مصطلح الحديث at G10–G11 with no worked examples, re-creating the exact defect redline 1 corrected, one stage higher up. (4) THE REGIONAL RISK, WHICH IS SPECIFIC AND NOT GENERIC. In this region hadith circulate widely in Yoruba sermon paraphrase, often without attribution and sometimes without provenance. A learner who does not acquire an early, Arabic, attributed, source-labelled corpus acquires the ambient one by default, and by G10 the school is no longer teaching hadith — it is correcting hadith. Starting at G3 is cheaper than correcting at G10.
lifecycles.g12Role: مستقل, independently assessed, 3 periods — the primary-source year and the terminal year of the discipline. The learner leaves the graded compilations and reads selected كتب of صحيح البخاري and صحيح مسلم in the original with full isnād on the page, works جامع العلوم والحكم as a classical شرح on the fifty-hadith corpus he has held since G5–G7, and performs practical تخريج in الكتب الستة. WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO: recite from memory a standing corpus of roughly 120–150 hadith and name the Companion for each; read an isnād aloud correctly and say what each element is; take an unfamiliar matn, locate it in a primary collection and cite it by book, kitāb and bāb; state the grading a compiler assigned and, using مصطلح's apparatus (learned in that subject, applied in this one), say on what basis; write a شرح of a matn in Arabic that distinguishes what the wording obliges, what it permits, what it merely reports, and what it does not say; and render a hadith into English and Yoruba accurately without adding to it. Negatively but importantly: he can also say what he is NOT qualified to do — he does not issue تصحيح or تضعيف of his own, and he knows that reading a grading and making one are different acts. That restraint is a curricular outcome, not a modesty formula, and it should be examined.
lifecycles.periodsRequested: Against the ceiling of ~19 periods/week at G3–G12 and ~7 at G1–G2 [RECOVERED], with حفظ القرآن and practical تجويد outside the count. G1–G2: 0 dedicated periods (not taught; content reaches the child inside الفقه التطبيقي / التوحيد العملي, costing nothing from the 7). G3: 0 dedicated — approximately 15 minutes/week drawn from within التوحيد والفقه's own allocation, plus one short oral check per fortnight. G4: 0 dedicated — inside the 2 periods of الحديث والسيرة, of which roughly one is hadith. G5: 1–2 (2 preferred; 1 is workable for a 13-hadith year). G6: 2 — affordable: a plausible G6 count is التفسير+الترجمة 2, الجزرية 1, اللغة العربية 4, النحو 2, الصرف 1, التوحيد والعقيدة 2, الفقه والسيرة 2, النشيد 1, الحديث 2 = 17 of 19, leaving 2 in hand. G7: 2. G8–G9: 2 each. G10–G11: 2 each for الحديث النبوي, with مصطلح الحديث requesting its own 1–2 separately — the Council must confirm the combined hadith-family claim of 3–4 periods at G10–G11 fits alongside البلاغة، أصول الفقه and the other secondary-stage entrants, because it is the tightest point in the whole ladder. G12: 3, and I name the trade rather than assuming it — مصطلح الحديث should CONCLUDE at G11 (نخبة الفكر completed in two years) and release its periods to الحديث النبوي at G12, where its apparatus is then applied to primary sources. That is the natural shape anyway: theory finishes, application continues. Total across twelve years: roughly 20 weekly periods, none of them taken from the ring-fenced Qur'an hour.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: حفظ القرآن — feeds it the memorisation method, the Arabic ear and the very category-distinction that makes hadith intelligible. HARD RULE: hadith memorisation never enters the ring-fenced hour and never competes for it (لا تُقتطع). Hadith volume is deliberately capped at every grade so the corpus never rivals the Qur'an load; where a term is heavy in حفظ, hadith memorisation yields, not the reverse.

مصطلح الحديث (G10–G11, نخبة الفكر) — the single most important boundary. الحديث النبوي supplies the corpus that مصطلح sorts; مصطلح owns ALL terminology, isnād criticism and grading theory. الحديث must never teach صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as technical categories before G10, and must never re-teach them after G10. Recommend مصطلح concludes at G11 and hands its periods to الحديث at G12, where its apparatus is applied rather than re-explained.

الفقه (الأخضري G6 → عمدة الأحكام era G8–G9) — الفقه's chapter architecture is a prerequisite for عمدة. Non-duplication protocol to be written into both syllabi: الفقه owns the ruling, its conditions and its application; الحديث owns the text, its wording, its narrator, the differences between روايات, and what the wording does and does not say. Hadith class must not become a second fiqh class, and fiqh class must not set hadith for memorisation.

السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي — partner at G4 and the supplier of the Companions as named persons (the non-technical substrate of isnād). After G5 the two separate cleanly: السيرة narrates the life, الحديث holds the words. السيرة must not set matns for memorisation; الحديث must not re-narrate the biography.

التوحيد والعقيدة (kept integrated per redline 5) — receives أحاديث الإيمان, above all حديث جبريل at G5, as its textual base. HARD RULE in the other direction: نواقض الإسلام (G5) and all polemical or takfīr-adjacent material stay in التوحيد under its required protective framing (redline 6). Hadith class is not a venue for that content, and a hadith on الإيمان must not be turned into a kalām lesson.

التفسير / أصول التفسير — الحديث supplies أسباب النزول and التفسير بالمأثور. Boundary: التفسير owns the verse and its exegesis; الحديث owns the report as a report. Neither may examine the other's material as its own.

أصول الفقه (lifecycle open) — structurally depends on this subject: it cannot teach السنة as a دليل to a learner with no corpus. RECOMMENDATION to that subject's specialist: أصول الفقه should not begin before G10, by which point عمدة الأحكام (G8–G9) has given it a real stock of legal hadith to reason over.

اللغة العربية / النحو (الآجرومية G6، ملحة الإعراب G7) / الصرف (البناء G6، لامية الأفعال G7) — supply the parsing that makes G6 onward matn analysis possible. HARD RULE: hadith class uses إعراب as a tool and never becomes a grammar class; the hadith exam does not examine النحو.
الترجمة (begins G6) — from G7 hadith is a principal content supply for English and Yoruba rendering. Boundary: الترجمة examines the rendering, الحديث examines the understanding.

التربية الإسلامية (lifecycle open) — the highest duplication risk in the whole register, because akhlāq hadith are the obvious raw material for it. RECOMMENDATION: التربية الإسلامية should own formation, habit and conduct, and should NOT own hadith texts, set hadith for memorisation, or examine matns. If it needs a hadith it cites the one الحديث has already taught.

النشيد والمحفوظات — shares memorisation methodology and the school's recitation culture, and can carry hadith-derived منظومات. Must not duplicate the hadith corpus itself or set matns as its own examined material.

الإنشاء والخطابة (lifecycle open) — downstream consumer at G10–G12: the hadith corpus is the graduate's quotation stock for khuṭbah and written composition, and the discipline of quoting accurately with attribution is exactly what this subject should inherit from hadith.

البلاغة (lifecycle open) — may legitimately draw on hadith wording as exemplars of jawāmi' al-kalim at G11–G12. Coordination only: البلاغة analyses the expression, الحديث examines the meaning and ruling.

التجويد (تحفة الأطفال G4–G5، الجزرية G6–G7) — a NEGATIVE relationship that must be stated: tajwīd rules are for Qur'an. Hadith is recited clearly and correctly, not with tajwīd applied. Naming this prevents the register confusion described in the early-introduction risks.

الإجازة track (parallel, opt-in, per redline 2) — hadith is the discipline where ijāzah transmission is native. A hadith ijāzah strand (الأربعون النووية first, عمدة الأحكام later) should mirror the Ḥifẓ Track precedent: mastery-paced, opt-in, separately governed, never a grade gate. The grade curriculum continues to assess on the normal term calendar regardless.
departuresFromSubmission: G1–G2 ruled out AFFIRMATIVELY, not by silence. The submission does not mention hadith at G1–G2; I am recording a positive decision of — with reasons (register contamination, attribution without capacity, and the 7-period ceiling), so that no future drafter reads the blank as an oversight and fills it.

G3: the submission says الحديث مضمّن without naming a host. I name the host — التوحيد والفقه — because an embedded discipline with no named host is an unowned discipline (redline 9). I also set G3 assessment to EMBEDDED, not independent: a second independently examined Arabic memorisation subject at age eight, alongside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour, over-counts the child. This is a form/assessment decision made separately, as the architecture requires.

G4: NOT a departure — I am protecting the submission. الحديث مدمج with السيرة + independently assessed at G4 is correct and I am recording my defence of it so it is not traded away later: the pairing gives each hadith a speaker, a setting and an occasion, and it is how the Companions enter the curriculum as persons rather than as terminology.

G5: the submission lists الحديث as merely 'present', with no form, while simultaneously re-pairing السيرة with الفقه — which leaves hadith orphaned. I rule it مستقل + independently assessed at G5 and make this the point of differentiation. The alternative the submission implies — folding hadith into الفقه والسيرة — would create exactly the mega-block redline 9 forbids.

G6: the submission had الحديث/مصطلح الحديث مدمج نخبة الفكر; redline 1 removed the مصطلح half. I go further than the redline requires by ruling that the remaining half must NOT be quietly re-attached to الفقه or السيرة to save a period. G6 hadith is مستقل, content only, with an explicit written prohibition on any مصطلح vocabulary.

G7: OVERRIDE. The submission keeps الحديث/مصطلح الحديث مدمج at G7. مصطلح is removed from G7 entirely — redline 1 places it at G10–G11, and a G7 remainder is not a half-subject to be attached to a neighbour. G7 is مستقل and completes الأربعون, which is the year's real work.

G8–G12 (not designed in the submission): I rule الحديث النبوي مستقل and independently assessed in all five years, with عمدة الأحكام (G8–G9), بلوغ المرام (G10–G11) and primary sources (G12). I specifically reject the tempting economy of making G8–G9 مدمج with الفقه on the strength of عمدة's fiqh chapter order: the middle-secondary years are precisely when the learner must learn that a hadith is a text with its own integrity and not a proof-slip, and مدمج at that moment would teach the opposite.

G12 period claim of 3, with a named trade rather than an assumption: مصطلح الحديث should conclude at G11 and release its periods. I am stating the cost rather than presenting a 3-period request as free.

The G4 introduction of the الصحابي by name, and the G6 introduction of the source collection as a bibliographic label, are additions not in the submission. Both are deliberately non-technical and are the mechanism by which the learner arrives at G10 مصطلح with a corpus and a cast of narrators already in place — which is what makes redline 1's placement of نخبة الفكر work rather than merely later.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does practical تخريج (locating a hadith in its source and citing it) belong to الحديث النبوي at G12, as I have placed it, or to مصطلح الحديث? My position: the theory of علل، جرح وتعديل، أقسام الحديث belongs to مصطلح; the practical act of locating and citing belongs here, because it is a reading-and-source skill, not a criticism skill. This needs an explicit ruling so the two syllabi do not both claim it or both drop it.
