[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does the 19-period ceiling actually accommodate الحديث النبوي at 2 plus مصطلح الحديث at 1–2 simultaneously at G10–G11, alongside البلاغة، أصول الفقه، الإنشاء والخطابة and the other secondary entrants? This is the tightest point in the entire twelve-year ladder and it cannot be resolved by any single subject specialist. If it does not fit, my recommendation is to compress مصطلح to a single G11 year rather than to cut the hadith corpus.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Does التربية الإسلامية (lifecycle currently open) own any hadith texts? My recommendation is a firm no — it owns formation and conduct, and cites hadith already taught here. But that subject's specialist may disagree, and if both subjects set matns the duplication will be invisible on paper and obvious in the timetable.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] At which grade does explanation of hadith become Arabic-medium? I have placed the shift at G8, after ملحة الإعراب and a year of extensive رياض الصالحين reading. Yoruba and English gloss is used at G3–G5 and mixed at G6–G7. This interacts with الترجمة's own progression and should be set once for the whole الدراسات الإسلامية programme rather than per-subject.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] For G12, direct reading of selected كتب of البخاري and مسلم, or an abridgement for weaker cohorts? I strongly prefer direct reading — it is the competence that defines the graduate — but a cohort-level fallback policy should be set in advance rather than improvised in the year.

[UNVERIFIED / institutional, not curricular] Does the school actually hold a transmitted سند or ijāzah for الأربعون النووية through a named living chain? The hadith ijāzah strand proposed under redline 2 is only meaningful if it does. I make no claim that any chain exists here; if none does, the strand should be described honestly as a school mastery certificate and not as an ijāzah.

[UNVERIFIED] التجريد الصريح لأحاديث الجامع الصحيح (الزبيدي), listed as the G12 fallback abridgement — I am confident a work of this description exists but not confident enough of the full compiler attribution to have it printed on a book list without a librarian's confirmation. Do not substitute another abridgement for it if it cannot be confirmed; use direct reading of selections instead.

Neither of the two texts frozen by redline 4 (القصيدة اللامية لابن تيمية at G4, الفواكه الساقطة at G5) falls in this subject — both sit under النشيد والمحفوظات. No hadith slot depends on either, and I have designed nothing around them.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G8, as مضمّن descriptive orientation inside الحديث. For this discipline "meaningful" has a precise test: the student learns something about the hadith text that he can verify on the page in front of him and that changes how he reads it. Naming السند and المتن as the two visible parts of a printed hadith, naming the compilers whose books he is already reading, and distinguishing حديث قدسي from قرآن from حديث نبوي all pass that test at G8. The evaluative discipline proper — the one that gives a verdict on a report — has no meaningful appearance before G10, because before G10 any verdict the student gives is a recalled label, not a judgement, and the discipline is nothing but the judgement. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught in any form. The child meets the Prophet's words as meaning and manners only (الفقه التطبيقي، التوحيد العملي). There is no component of مصطلح that is age-appropriate: unlike تجويد or فقه, the discipline has no observational or practical entry point for a six-year-old.
Not taught. As G1. Nothing is lost by absence; the hadith stock that will later be classified is being built by exposure, not by terminology.

Not taught. الحديث enters as مضمّن content (submission). That content-only handling is correct and must be protected: the child learns short matns and what they mean. No mention of سند, no mention of صحيح/ضعيف.

Not taught. الحديث والسيرة مدمج carries matn and meaning. The Companions are being met as persons in السيرة — this is the raw material of the later رجال frame, but it must stay narrative here and must not become a taxonomy of transmitters.

Not taught. Hadith stock continues to accumulate. Note the interaction with accepted redline 6: a G5 already handling نواقض الإسلام must not simultaneously be handed a second classificatory apparatus that sorts religious material into valid and invalid.

Not taught. I concur with accepted redline 1 and add the discipline's own reason: at G6 the student is an absolute beginner in النحو (الآجرومية) and in الصرف (البناء في الصرف). The entire مصطلح taxonomy is a morphological system (مُرسَل، مُعضَل، مُنقطِع، مُدلَّس، مُدرَج، مُقلَب، مُضطرِب، مُصحَّف) carried in definitional prose. A first-year student of الآجرومية can hold neither. G6 teaches hadith CONTENT only — matn, meaning, application.

Not taught — this OVERRIDES the submission, which retains 'الحديث/مصطلح الحديث مدمج' at G7. Accepted redline 1 removed نخبة الفكر from G6 but left the same error standing one year later. G7 carries ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال simultaneously and is the heaviest linguistic year of the الإعدادية section. One extra year of النحو is not the amount of النحو this discipline needs. الحديث at G7 stays content: matn, meaning, and the فقه الحديث that السيرة and الفقه can carry.

Descriptive orientation only — roughly 6–8 lessons across the year taken from within الحديث's existing time: (1) السند والمتن identified physically on the page of the collection in use; (2) راوٍ، صحابي، تابعي, placed in the chronology السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي has already given; (3) حديث نبوي (قول، فعل، تقرير، صفة) vs حديث قدسي vs القرآن — a distinction of source and wording that prevents a persistent confusion; (4) the principal collections named with their compilers: صحيح البخاري، صحيح مسلم، سنن أبي داود، جامع الترمذي، سنن النسائي، سنن ابن ماجه، موطأ مالك، مسند أحمد. NO grading vocabulary, NO جرح وتعديل, NO classification of chains. This is literacy about the form of a text the student already reads, not criticism of it. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.text: منظومة البيقونية
gradeByGrade.content: A bounded one-term unit, ~1 period/week, carved from الحديث's allocation. Anchor matn: منظومة البيقونية (34 lines), memorised in the المحفوظات stream and explained here. Content is deliberately descriptive, not operative: (1) صحيح / حسن / ضعيف explained as readings of what compilers and editors already print in front of the student ('رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح') — he meets this vocabulary whether we teach it or not, and an untaught student builds a folk theory in silence; (2) the five شروط الصحيح NAMED — اتصال السند، عدالة الراوي، تمام ضبطه، انتفاء الشذوذ، انتفاء العلة — without being deployed on any case; (3) متواتر وآحاد; (4) مرفوع وموقوف ومقطوع as position in the chain, not as verdict; (5) an explicit and examinable rule of restraint: the student does not grade hadith, he reports the grading of those who do. The unit exists to make G10 possible and to pre-empt the untrained self-adjudicator. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

gradeByGrade.text: نخبة الفكر في مصطلح أهل الأثر — ابن حجر العسقلاني (taught through the author's own شرح: نزهة النظر)
gradeByGrade.content: DIFFERENTIATION YEAR. ~2 periods/week, full year, first half of the matn: التقسيم باعتبار عدد الطرق — المتواتر (لفظي ومعنوي) والآحاد: المشهور، العزيز، الغريب؛ المقبول والمردود؛ الصحيح لذاته ولغيره، الحسن لذاته ولغيره، والضعيف؛ المحكم ومختلف الحديث؛ الناسخ والمنسوخ in outline; then أسباب الطعن المتعلقة بالسقط من الإسناد: المعلَّق، المرسَل، المعضَل، المنقطِع، والتدليس (تدليس الإسناد وتدليس الشيوخ). Method throughout: every term is defined by its قيود and then tested against a real printed isnād, never memorised as a gloss. First تخريج exercises — locate a hadith by its wording in the collection in use, report its attribution and the compiler's own printed حكم. Independently assessed, with the paper weighted toward application to unseen isnāds rather than recall of definitions.

gradeByGrade.text: نخبة الفكر (completed) + an applied hadith corpus that prints gradings (e.g. بلوغ المرام), that corpus owned by الحديث
gradeByGrade.content: ~2 periods/week, full year: completion plus application. أسباب الطعن المتعلقة بالراوي — الكذب فالموضوع، التهمة فالمتروك، فحش الغلط فالمنكر، الوهم فالمعلَّل، المخالفة فالمدرَج والمقلوب والمزيد في متصل الأسانيد والمضطرِب والمصحَّف، الجهالة فالمبهم والمجهول، البدعة، وسوء الحفظ فالشاذ؛ المسند، العالي والنازل، المدبَّج ورواية الأقران، المؤتلف والمختلف؛ طرق التحمل والأداء وصيغها (سمعت، حدثنا، أخبرنا، عن، أنّ) وأثر الصيغة على الاتصال؛ مبادئ الجرح والتعديل ومراتب ألفاظه، طبقات الرواة، and how to use a تراجم source. The second half of the year is sustained applied work: تخريج ودراسة إسناد on graded exercises. Terminal mastery assessment on the matn plus an applied paper.

gradeByGrade.partner: الحديث (التخريج التطبيقي) and أصول الفقه (باب السنة)
gradeByGrade.content: No new مصطلح content is taught; the apparatus is now an instrument exercised inside other subjects. In الحديث: a capstone تخريج of a defined set of hadith with written دراسة — attribution, chain shape, reported gradings, and a cautious written note on what the student can and cannot conclude himself. In أصول الفقه: حجية خبر الواحد، الاحتجاج بالمرسل، تعارض الأدلة. In أصول التفسير: صحة المرويات في أسباب النزول والإسرائيليات. In الفقه: reading the evidence apparatus of the texts in use. The form is مضمّن but the assessment is independent — the capstone تخريج carries its own mark. This is a deliberate use of the orthogonality rule: the subject loses its slot and keeps its mark.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint: G10 — it becomes مستقل with نخبة الفكر at G10, and neither a year earlier nor a year later. NOT G9: the operative act of this discipline is testing a named case against a conjunctive definition (الصحيح = five simultaneous conditions) and entertaining the idea of a hidden defect (العلة) that contradicts every apparent sign of soundness. Those are formal-operational moves. At G9 the student can learn the words — which is exactly why G9 is a وحدة and not nothing — but applying them yields memorised labels indistinguishable from judgement, which is precisely the failure the G6 placement would have produced. NOT G11: مصطلح must be established before or alongside the Sunnah chapter of أصول الفقه and the المأثور material of أصول التفسير; if it lands at G11, those subjects must either wait or improvise their own authenticity criteria, which duplicates this discipline badly and leaves the graduate holding two incompatible accounts of the same material. G10 also leaves two years of use (G11 applied, G12 capstone), which is what converts the apparatus from exam content into reflex; a single terminal year would not. I therefore CONFIRM the redline's G10–G11 destination and its choice of نخبة الفكر as the matn — but only because I am also inserting the G8–G9 elementary layer beneath it. نخبة الفكر is not an entry text in any serious teaching tradition; it is an abridgement that presupposes the categories, and landing on it cold at G10 would reproduce the density problem at a later grade with a better-behaved class.
prerequisites: A worked stock of hadith matns met in Arabic (on the order of 100+), so that classification has something to classify — established cumulatively by G9 through الحديث (مضمّن G3, مدمج with السيرة G4–G5, content G6–G9).
Fluent reading of unvowelled scholarly Arabic prose — established by G7 (ملحة الإعراب) and consolidated G8–G9.

النحو adequate to parse definitional prose: الإضافة والإضافة المتتابعة، الحال، التمييز، الاستثناء، أدوات الشرط وجوابه، جملة الصلة، أسلوب الحصر — الآجرومية G6, ملحة الإعراب G7, consolidated by G9. A student who cannot parse a قيد inside a حدّ cannot learn a taxonomy that is made of قيود.

الصرف to the level of confidently distinguishing اسم الفاعل from اسم المفعول in مزيد forms — البناء في الصرف G6, لامية الأفعال G7. The single most under-recognised prerequisite: مدلِّس vs مدلَّس، مرسِل vs مرسَل، معلِّل vs معلَّل. A student who blurs these cannot hold the system, and the error fossilises.

A chronological and biographical frame — الصحابة، التابعون، عصر التدوين، and the compilers of the principal collections — السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي, established G6 and extended G7–G9. عدالة and ضبط are judgements about named people in time; without the frame they are empty adjectives.

Descriptive familiarity with سند/متن and with صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as printed editorial reports — G8 مضمّن and the G9 وحدة (my design). This is the prerequisite the submitted architecture did not provide at all.

Developmental, not curricular: definition by necessary-and-sufficient conditions, and the capacity to hold that a thing may be defective in a way not visible on its surface. Not scheduleable; reliably available around G9–G10 in this ladder. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE]

classicalTexts.title: منظومة البيقونية — عمر بن محمد البيقوني
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (وحدة); memorised in the المحفوظات stream
classicalTexts.justification: The standard elementary منظومة in the discipline: 34 lines naming the principal categories in verse. Short enough to memorise inside a one-term unit, and it does exactly the descriptive work G9 needs — it names categories without demanding critical deployment. It is also the conventional step that precedes نخبة الفكر in madrasah practice, which is precisely the step the submitted architecture was missing.

classicalTexts.title: نخبة الفكر في مصطلح أهل الأثر — ابن حجر العسقلاني
classicalTexts.justification: CONFIRMED as the redline specifies. It is the right matn for G10–G11 because its organisation is itself the pedagogy: it proceeds by exhaustive تقسيم — division by number of chains, then المقبول/المردود, then أسباب الطعن sorted by سقط versus طعن في الراوي. A student who learns this matn learns a decision procedure, not a glossary. Its famous density is a virtue at G10 with a teacher and البيقونية behind it, and a disaster at G6 with neither.

classicalTexts.title: نزهة النظر في توضيح نخبة الفكر — ابن حجر العسقلاني
classicalTexts.grade: G10–G11 (teaching شرح; direct student reference at G11)
classicalTexts.justification: The author's own commentary on his own matn, which removes the usual risk of a شرح importing a different framework. It is the text the teacher teaches FROM at G10 and that stronger G11 students read directly. Its availability is also the practical reason G10–G11 is teachable at all in a school without a specialist tradition already on site.

classicalTexts.title: بلوغ المرام من أدلة الأحكام — ابن حجر العسقلاني
classicalTexts.grade: G11–G12 (applied corpus — OWNED BY الحديث/الفقه, not by مصطلح)
classicalTexts.justification: Listed only because مصطلح needs an applied corpus, and this one prints attributions and gradings on nearly every hadith, making it ideal exercise material for تخريج. I am NOT claiming it as a مصطلح text and I am NOT bidding for its periods; the curricular home decision belongs to الحديث and الفقه. If the board places a different corpus there, مصطلح adapts.

classicalTexts.title: معرفة أنواع علم الحديث (مقدمة ابن الصلاح) — عثمان بن عبد الرحمن ابن الصلاح
classicalTexts.grade: NOT a student text anywhere in G1–G12 — teacher reference only
classicalTexts.justification: The foundational systematic work that the later tradition abridges, including نخبة الفكر's own lineage. Named so the board knows where the G12 graduate's next step lies, and as the reference a teacher of this subject should own. Placing it in the school ladder would be the same category of error as نخبة الفكر at G6.

classicalTexts.title: التقريب والتيسير — النووي
classicalTexts.grade: not scheduled; a known alternative entry route only if a teacher is trained in it
classicalTexts.justification: An abridgement of ابن الصلاح in prose. Mentioned to close the option honestly. I do not recommend substituting it for البيقونية here: prose is harder to memorise than a منظومة at G9, and the المحفوظات stream gives البيقونية a free carrier that prose would not have.

classicalTexts.title: ألفية العراقي (التبصرة والتذكرة) — زين الدين العراقي
classicalTexts.grade: outside the 12-year ladder entirely — do not schedule
classicalTexts.justification: Named only to close off a tempting error: it is not a G12 text. I am confident a versified work in this discipline by العراقي exists and is standard, but I am NOT confident of the exact title form as I have written it. Treat the title as unverified even though the work is real, and do not act on it.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
(1) THE SOCIAL RISK, which is the serious one. An 11–13 year old given صحيح/ضعيف vocabulary without the ضبط to apply it becomes a self-appointed adjudicator: 'هذا حديث ضعيف' said to a parent, to a mosque imam, to a local Yoruba scholar, on the authority of one half-understood matn. Hadith grading is contested public discourse in the Nigerian religious landscape and circulates through WhatsApp and radio; a child equipped with the labels and none of the restraint will be recruited into that discourse or will embarrass the school inside it. This is structurally the same hazard accepted redline 6 identified for نواقض الإسلام — a classificatory apparatus in hands that cannot apply it is socially dangerous, not merely ineffective — and it deserves the same explicit treatment. My G9 unit therefore makes the rule of restraint examinable content rather than a teacher's aside.
(2) MORPHOLOGICAL COLLAPSE. The whole taxonomy consists of مزيد participles separated by one vowel: مدلِّس/مدلَّس، مرسِل/مرسَل، معلِّل/معلَّل. A G6 who has just begun البناء في الصرف cannot hold the distinction, so he learns the labels as opaque sounds. These errors fossilise and are unusually hard to undo at G10, because by then the wrong form is automatic.
(3) BURNING THE MATN. نخبة الفكر done badly at G6 cannot be done freshly at G10. A text a class believes it has already finished is the hardest thing in a curriculum to teach properly, and this school gets one attempt.
(4) FALSE COMPETENCE IN ASSESSMENT. Definitions memorised at G6 test extremely well and predict nothing. The subject would report as a success while producing no capability — worse for the institution than reporting as absent, because nobody investigates a subject that is passing.
(5) OPPORTUNITY COST AT EXACTLY THE WRONG YEAR. G6–G7 periods spent on مصطلح are periods taken from النحو and الصرف, which are the very gate مصطلح is waiting on. Teaching it early actively postpones the conditions for teaching it well.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
(1) DOWNSTREAM SUBJECTS IMPROVISE. أصول الفقه cannot teach باب السنة — حجية خبر الواحد، الاحتجاج بالمرسل، تعارض الأدلة — without authenticity vocabulary, and أصول التفسير cannot handle التفسير بالمأثور، أسباب النزول، الإسرائيليات without it. Delay past G10 forces those subjects to build their own half-version of مصطلح, duplicating the discipline badly and leaving two incompatible vocabularies inside one graduate.
(2) SIX YEARS OF UNREADABLE APPARATUS. From G6 the student reads collections that print 'رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح' on the page. Delay means six years of treating that line as noise while quietly forming a folk theory of what it means. Folk theories formed in silence are harder to correct than errors made aloud — which is the positive argument for the G8–G9 descriptive layer, not merely a defensive one.
(3) NO TIME TO BECOME REFLEX. A single terminal year produces exam knowledge. تخريج is a habit: locate, check attribution, read the reported حكم, stop where your competence stops. Habits need at least two years of repeated use, which is why G10–G11 plus a G12 capstone is the minimum viable span and a G11-only placement is not.
(4) THE GRADUATE CANNOT PROTECT A CONGREGATION. Unattributed and fabricated فضائل hadith circulate heavily through West African popular religious media. A graduate who preaches, teaches or leads and cannot verify an attribution will transmit them — in the name of the institution that certified him.
(5) INTERNATIONAL TRANSFER. نخبة الفكر with a شرح is a normal entry expectation at the institutions SHRS graduates would apply to. Its absence from a transcript is immediately visible to an admitting faculty and reads as a structural gap, not a local preference.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 مصطلح الحديث is no longer a taught subject; it is an instrument — مضمّن inside الحديث/التخريج and أصول الفقه, and independently assessed through a capstone تخريج. Because of it the graduate can: locate a hadith in the principal printed collections from its wording; read an isnād and name its structural condition from what is visible (متصل، منقطع، معلق، مرسل، معضل، مدلَّس) without claiming more than the chain shows; read a compiler's or a critic's printed حكم and state exactly what it commits him to and what it does not; write a short تخريج مصغّر — attribution, chain shape, reported gradings, and a written note on the limits of his own conclusion; distinguish a claim he can verify from one requiring رجال expertise he does not have; recognise the marks of a circulating fabricated فضيلة and decline to transmit it; and follow the Sunnah chapter of أصول الفقه and the مأثور material of أصول التفسير in their own vocabulary. That last competency is the point and is easy to undervalue: trained epistemic restraint — knowing precisely where his own authority to grade ends — is as much the output of this discipline at G12 as any classification he can perform.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the 19-period ceiling (7 at G1–G2):
G1–G7: 0 periods. Zero claim on the tightest years of the ladder, including the 7-period floor at G1–G2, which this subject never touches.
G8: 0 additional periods. مضمّن — roughly 6–8 lessons taken from within الحديث's existing allocation, about 15 minutes of one hadith period per week for part of the year. Net new demand: nil.
G9: 1 period/week for ONE term only (وحدة), carved from الحديث's allocation rather than added. Net new demand across the year ≈ 0.3 of a period — effectively nil.
G10: 2 periods/week, full year. This is the peak and the only real claim on the ceiling: about 10.5% of the 19.
G11: 2 periods/week, full year.
G12: 0 dedicated periods. مضمّن inside one existing الحديث/تخريج period and inside أصول الفقه.
Total net new demand across twelve years: 2 periods for two years. Affordable — but only on a condition the board must see plainly: at G10–G11 this subject competes inside the same 19 with النحو، الصرف، البلاغة، أصول الفقه، الفقه، العقيدة، التفسير، أصول التفسير، السيرة، الإنشاء والخطابة. The 2 periods are affordable if by G10 السيرة has contracted from a full independent subject to a rotational or embedded presence and الحديث has moved from a content subject to an applied corpus that مصطلح partly serves. If both السيرة and الحديث remain at full independent weight at G10–G11, these 2 periods are not free and the board must rule on the trade. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
departuresFromSubmission: OVERRIDE G7. The submission keeps 'الحديث/مصطلح الحديث مدمج' at G7, and accepted redline 1 addressed only G6. I remove مصطلح from G7 as well. The redline's reasoning — that نخبة الفكر was placed alongside an absolute beginner in الآجرومية — does not stop being true when the student reaches ملحة الإعراب. G7 is the heaviest linguistic year of the الإعدادية section (ملحة الإعراب plus لامية الأفعال simultaneously), and one extra year of النحو is not the amount of النحو this discipline needs.

INSERT AN ELEMENTARY LAYER THAT NEITHER THE SUBMISSION NOR THE REDLINE SPECIFIES: G8 مضمّن (descriptive orientation, embedded assessment) and a G9 وحدة anchored on منظومة البيقونية. The redline moved نخبة الفكر to G10 but left nothing beneath it. نخبة الفكر is not an entry text — it is an abridgement that presupposes the categories — and arriving at it cold at G10 reproduces the density problem at a later grade. This is the substantive addition in my submission and the part most likely to be resisted on period grounds; its net cost is near zero because both layers are carved from الحديث, not added to the timetable.

CONFIRM AND PROTECT G10–G11 مستقل WITH نخبة الفكر, and specify that it is taught through the author's own شرح نزهة النظر rather than through a modern summary. I endorse the redline's destination on the discipline's own grounds, not by deference to the Board.

REFUSE CONTINUATION AS مستقل AT G12. The apparatus is delivered by the end of G11; a third independent year would teach more terminology to students who instead need to use what they already have. G12 becomes مضمّن plus an independently assessed capstone تخريج — the subject loses its slot and keeps its mark.

DECLINE ANY CLAIM ON G1–G7 PERIODS ENTIRELY, including a token presence. The submission gave مصطلح a foothold at the G6–G7 boundary. I return that time to النحو، الصرف and الحديث content, which are the actual prerequisites. A specialist who bids for early years to secure institutional standing for his discipline damages it.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY الحديث — the indispensable supply. مصطلح classifies reports; without a stock of matns met from G3 onward there is nothing to classify. The dependency is one-directional until G11, when it reverses and مصطلح begins serving الحديث's applied corpus.

FED BY الصرف — the deepest and least obvious dependency. The taxonomy is a set of مزيد participles distinguished by vocalisation (مدلِّس/مدلَّس). البناء في الصرف (G6) and لامية الأفعال (G7) are load-bearing for G10, not background colour.

FED BY النحو — نخبة الفكر and نزهة النظر are definitional prose built on إضافة chains, قيود, حصر and conditional structures. الآجرومية (G6) and ملحة الإعراب (G7) are the floor; consolidation through G8–G9 is what makes G10 readable at all.

FED BY السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي — supplies the persons and the chronology: الصحابة، التابعون، عصر التدوين, and the compilers. عدالة and ضبط are judgements about named people in time. CLEAN SPLIT REQUIRED: history owns who compiled what and when; مصطلح owns what counts as accepted and why. History must not drift into rijāl criteria, and مصطلح must not re-narrate the story of تدوين.

FEEDS أصول الفقه — the Sunnah chapter (حجية خبر الواحد، الاحتجاج بالمرسل، تعارض الأدلة) is unteachable without this vocabulary. STRICT BOUNDARY: أصول owns whether a report obliges action; مصطلح owns whether the report is established. Neither may argue the other's question, or the graduate ends up holding two accounts of the same material.

FEEDS أصول التفسير — صحة المرويات في أسباب النزول، حكم الإسرائيليات، المرفوع والموقوف في التفسير بالمأثور. Sequencing matters: if أصول التفسير sits at G10, its مأثور material must fall after مصطلح's first term. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

FEEDS الفقه — from G11 the student can read the evidence apparatus of a fiqh text rather than taking its citations on trust. This is the point at which فقه الدليل becomes possible at all in this curriculum.

TOUCHES العقيدة WITH CARE — the status of خبر الآحاد في العقائد is a contested question and a live one in this setting. مصطلح supplies the categories; it must not be the venue where the school's عقيدة position is settled. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — which subject owns that question, and what the school's stated handling is.]

MUST NOT DUPLICATE المنطق — الحدّ والرسم، التعريف بالجنس والفصل، التقسيم are general logic. If المنطق is placed at or before G10, مصطلح should draw on it by reference rather than re-teach it; if المنطق falls later or nowhere, مصطلح must carry a minimal definitional apparatus itself. This single ordering decision changes my G10 content by roughly three lessons. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

SERVES الإنشاء والخطابة and any da'wah-facing subject — a student who will preach must not cite what he cannot attribute. The restraint rule taught at G9 and examined at G12 belongs jointly to these subjects.

NO RELATIONSHIP WHATSOEVER TO the ring-fenced Qur'an hour. مصطلح makes no claim on it and nothing in this design touches حفظ، تجويد or التفسير العملي. Stated explicitly so no future timetable pressure treats that hour as a source for these periods.
openQuestions: Is there a teacher on staff who has himself studied نزهة النظر with a teacher? This subject fails more silently than any other in the register: a teacher working from the matn alone will deliver definitions, assess them successfully, and produce no capability, and nobody will notice for years. If the answer is no, the honest options are to recruit, to train one teacher deliberately over the next two years, or to run G10–G11 at reduced scope (البيقونية-level content extended, نخبة الفكر deferred) rather than nominally. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

Where does الحديث itself sit at G8–G12, and on which corpus? My G8 مضمّن and G9 وحدة are carved from الحديث's time, and my G11–G12 applied work depends on a corpus that prints gradings. If الحديث contracts or changes corpus, both ends of this design move.

At which grade does أصول الفقه begin, and where in its internal sequence does باب السنة fall? If أصول الفقه opens at G10 with the Sunnah chapter in term 1, it arrives before مصطلح has delivered the vocabulary it needs.
Is المنطق placed before, alongside, or after G10? See the duplication note in the relationships list — the answer changes my G10 content directly.

Language of instruction at G10: Arabic matn with Arabic شرح throughout, or Arabic matn with Yoruba/English explanation in the first year? A real pedagogical choice in a Yoruba-speaking setting with international ambitions, and it belongs to the board. Whichever is chosen, the technical terms are never translated — مرسل is مرسل.

Should the الإجازة parallel track (accepted redline 2) include a سماع-based إجازة in نخبة الفكر for G11–G12 students who want it? The text is short, the tradition of transmitting it by سماع is real, and it fits the opt-in mastery-paced model exactly. It would cost the grade curriculum nothing.
Who owns the question of خبر الآحاد في العقائد, and what does the school say about it? مصطلح will otherwise be pushed into settling it by default at G10.

Does the board accept that this subject makes no claim at all on G1–G7, including no token presence? I expect symmetry pressure from the shape of neighbouring Islamic-studies subjects, and I am recording in advance that I will not meet it.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance:
G1 — but the word "meaningful" has to be defined for this discipline before that answer means anything, because التربية الإسلامية is the one subject on the register whose learning is not produced by teaching it.

FIRST, THE SCOPE OVERRIDE, because the answer depends on it. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] The register entry "التربية الإسلامية" admits three readings and only one of them survives contact with the other 25 lifecycles.
(a) UMBRELLA reading — التربية الإسلامية as the national-curriculum container in which عقيدة + فقه + حديث + سيرة + تلاوة + أخلاق are taught and examined as one subject. This is the ordinary sense of the term in state systems, and it must be REJECTED here. SHRS has already differentiated all of Programme 3 by discipline, with separately traceable outcomes, separately dated matn progressions and separately assessed papers. Reinstating an umbrella would duplicate Programme 3 in its entirety and destroy exactly the traceability the Board has spent 25 lifecycles building. An umbrella cannot coexist with its own contents.
(b) NULL reading — the entry is a filing artefact; delete it. Also rejected, and the reason is the strongest finding in this submission: there is a real, large, unowned body of learning sitting in the gaps between الفقه (which owns صحة العبادة — whether the act is valid), العقيدة/التوحيد (which owns propositional belief), الحديث (which owns the matn and its meaning), and السيرة (which owns the narrative). None of them owns سلوك — habituated conduct, الآداب الشرعية, character, آفات النفس واللسان, أدب طالب العلم, أدب الخلاف. "النقد والآداب" (#13) does not own it either: that subject's أدب is belles-lettres, a name-clash the Board must record in writing so no registrar ever files الآداب الشرعية against it.
(c) PRACTICAL/FORMATIVE STRAND reading — التربية الإسلامية as the continuous formation strand: habituation → adab → التكليف → آفات العلم → أدب الخلاف والفتوى. This is the reading I adopt, and I ask the Board to attach a binding scope note to the register entry so the name is never re-read as (a).

NOW THE ANSWER. For every other subject on this register, "meaningful" means the learner acquires something retrievable and assessable. For التربية الإسلامية it means something else: the learner's conduct is actually altered and the alteration persists. Conduct at ages 6–9 is altered by regime, modelling and correction-in-the-moment — not by propositional instruction. A six-year-old who is made to line up straight, greet, say بسم الله, eat with his right hand, hand back what is not his, and be corrected the one time he lies, has learned التربية الإسلامية. A six-year-old who is TAUGHT a forty-minute lesson entitled "الصدق" has learned to say that الصدق is واجب, which is a different and much smaller thing, and which the register already gets for free from اللغة العربية's vocabulary strand.

So: the subject's first meaningful appearance is G1, and the submission is CORRECT not to name it there. التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي at G1–G2 do carry its content delivery — but they do not perform its function, because its function at G1–G6 is not a block of content at all; it is the school's habituation regime. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] That regime must therefore be constituted as an INSTITUTIONAL INSTRUMENT, not a timetable line: a written ميثاق السلوك (6–8 named behaviours per term per grade, G1–G6), a سجل الالتزام kept by the class teacher, a named owner (مشرف التربية / وكيل شؤون الطلاب), and a termly review. Without that instrument the subject has no reality at G1–G6 and the school will merely assert that "everyone teaches أخلاق", which in practice means nobody does and no scheme of work contains it. This is the single most important sentence in this submission.

The first meaningful INSTRUCTION — the first point at which explicit, named, examined teaching produces learning that habituation cannot — is G7, and that is a separate event. The two must never be collapsed.

gradeByGrade.content: No lesson, no book, no mark, no period. The curriculum IS the regime, and the regime is written down: a termly ميثاق السلوك of 6-8 named behaviours the class teacher models daily and corrects in the moment. Term-list for G1: صفوف الصلاة والسكينة فيها؛ انضباط طابور الوضوء؛ السلام ورده؛ الاستئذان قبل الدخول؛ التسمية والأكل باليمين؛ النظافة (اليدان، الثوب، المكان)؛ الصدق (the operative teaching is the teacher's measured, non-shaming response the first time a child lies — that response is the lesson); رد ما ليس لك. أذكار الصباح والنوم القصيرة enter through النشيد والمحفوظات's existing 5-minute daily slot, not through a new one. The Prophetic warrant is spoken by the teacher, never memorised as a proof-text at this age.

Same instrument, widened list: الاستئذان على الوالدين؛ آداب المسجد (الدخول باليمين، عدم المرور بين يدي المصلي، خفض الصوت)؛ مناولة المصحف واحترامه — deliberately tied to the ring-fenced Qur'an hour the child is already in five days a week؛ عدم الإضرار بالصغير؛ الوفاء بالوعد الصغير. FIRST CURRICULAR HANDOFF: the Arabic virtue-vocabulary (صدق، أمانة، رحمة، نظافة، حياء) is supplied to اللغة العربية's المفردات strand as its semantic field for the year — التربية supplies the meaning, العربية supplies the word. Zero additional cost; the words were going to be taught anyway.

G3 is when peer mockery begins, so the anti-mockery norm is named explicitly this year and not left implicit: لا تنابز بالألقاب، لا سخرية من صوت أحد في التسميع، ولا من لون أو نسب أو فقر. This is placed at G3 deliberately, because the Qur'an hour's individual تسميع creates public performance and therefore public failure — the discipline's first duty is to make that failure safe. Also: آداب المعلم والكتاب؛ الشكر لمن أحسن؛ الأمانة في العارية؛ إماطة الأذى. Instrument unchanged: ميثاق السلوك + سجل الالتزام, descriptive, unranked.

gradeByGrade.text: الأدب المفرد للإمام البخاري — اختيارات شفوية (النص مملوك لمادة الحديث، لا مَتْن لهذه المادة هنا)
gradeByGrade.content: The first year the strand has a textual warrant rather than only a regime, because الحديث والسيرة now holds a block. Method: ONE adab hadith per fortnight, taken orally from within الحديث's own allocation — البر بالوالدين، الرحمة بالصغير، الصدق، الحياء — plus ONE named Prophetic behaviour per term drawn from السيرة as أسوة (حلمه، وفاؤه، رفقه بالخادم). The hadith belongs to الحديث; the behavioural outcome is booked to التربية. Zero minutes are transferred. The discipline's rule from here to G6: it never re-teaches the text, only converts it into a named, observable behaviour on the ميثاق.

gradeByGrade.text: الأربعون النووية (1-13) — مشتركة، مملوكة لمادة الحديث
gradeByGrade.content: آفات اللسان enter at G5 — الغيبة، النميمة، الكذب، السخرية — and enter under a HARD pedagogical constraint that the Board must minute: they are taught in the FIRST PERSON ONLY, as things I must not do, never as a category of offence a child can diagnose in another person. [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION, by extension] This is the exact protective grammar redline 6 imposes on نواقض الإسلام, and it must be imposed here for the same reason and in the same year, because both land at G5. A child must not leave G5 holding two checklists — one theological, one moral — that he can apply to his mother, his uncle or his neighbour. Whoever teaches نواقض الإسلام at G5 and whoever owns the ميثاق at G5 must be given one combined briefing, not two.

gradeByGrade.text: الأربعون النووية (14-28) — مشتركة، مملوكة لمادة الحديث
gradeByGrade.content: آداب طلب العلم at an elementary level, landing in the year the matn load arrives (الآجرومية، البناء، الجزرية، الأخضري all at G6): كيف تجلس بين يدي معلمك، كيف تحفظ، الصبر على التكرار، لا تعجل بالسؤال قبل الفهم، تعظيم الكتاب. Also الوفاء، حفظ الحقوق، الأمانة في الامتحان — named explicitly in the year independent assessment multiplies. AND the pre-بلوغ signal: the class teacher begins to say, without teaching it, that within a year or two these acts become personally binding. This is preparation for G7, not instruction. It is deliberately vague and deliberately calm.

gradeByGrade.text: تعليم المتعلم طريق التعلم — برهان الإسلام الزرنوجي (فصول مختارة، بشرح المعلم)؛ الأربعون النووية 29-42 (مشتركة)
gradeByGrade.content: THE DIFFERENTIATION. One term only, ONE period/week, co-taught with الفقه and funded entirely from within الفقه's existing G7 allocation — net claim on the 19: ZERO. Named: «وحدة البلوغ والتكليف: آداب المسلم وأخلاقه». Content, in order: معنى التكليف وعلامات البلوغ؛ ما يجب بالبلوغ (الصلاة في وقتها، صوم رمضان كاملًا، الستر)؛ الطهارة للبالغ — الغسل، وأحكام الحيض للبنات؛ المسؤولية الفردية (كل امرئ بما كسب رهين)؛ اختيار الصاحب وأثره؛ الحياء؛ بر الوالدين في سن المراهقة تحديدًا، حين يبدأ الخلاف؛ التوبة معروضة كباب مفتوح لا كتهديد. الفقه supplies the أحكام half and marks it as فقه; التربية supplies the مسؤولية/أدب half and marks it as its own. DELIVERY CONSTRAINT: the unit is delivered in gender-separated groups, and the أحكام الحيض portion by a female teacher to the girls. If the school cannot staff that, the unit is not deliverable as designed. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

The newly-mukallaf year. ~10 minutes/week named inside الفقه's scheme of work — not goodwill, a written line in the scheme: الالتزام بالصلاة في وقتها بلا إيقاظ؛ أول رمضان كامل؛ أدب المسجد كرجل بالغ لا كطفل. AND the first pass at العرف واليوربا: where Yoruba social custom — forms of deference to elders, naming and marriage observances, occasions of mourning — aligns with الشرع, is neutral to it, or conflicts with it. Taught DESCRIPTIVELY, by a teacher who knows the community, with the explicit rule that a G8 pupil does not correct an elder. This content exists nowhere else on the register and it is the specific local liability of a curriculum that will teach كتاب التوحيد at G9.

Deliberately paired with العقيدة in the year العقيدة teaches نواقض as a studied text and selected أبواب of كتاب التوحيد. The adab layer is the counterweight, planned and minuted: كيف تحمل ما تعلمته من التوحيد دون احتقار لأهلك وجيرانك؛ الفرق بين تقرير الحكم وبين الحكم على المعيّن؛ أدب مخالفة الأب في مسألة دينية. Plus the adolescent conduct set: الغضب، الكذب المجامل، الخصوصية، and DIGITAL CONDUCT — الغيبة في المجموعات، نشر ما لم تتحقق منه، الصورة، الاسترسال الليلي. Digital conduct is placed here and not later because G9 is when the cohort actually acquires phones in this setting. ~10 minutes/week inside العقيدة's block. Zero periods.

gradeByGrade.text: تعليم المتعلم — الزرنوجي (اختيارات موسّعة)؛ مختصر منهاج القاصدين — نجم الدين ابن قدامة المقدسي (اختيارات: الكبر، العجب، الحسد، حب الرياسة)
gradeByGrade.content: One term, 1-2 periods/week, in the SAME rotation slot المنطق وعلم الكلام occupies at G10 — different terms, one slot, no new line on the timetable. Named: «آداب طالب العلم وآفات العلم». Why G10 and not another year: G10 is the year specialisation begins — أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث، البلاغة والمنطق all differentiate simultaneously — and a student who has just acquired four technical vocabularies in one year is a student in whom الكبر والعجب وحب الظهور are being born on schedule. The classical tradition put آفات العلم at exactly this point for exactly this reason. Assessment is embedded and reflective (a short تقرير ذاتي), NOT a paper on the definitions of الكبر — that would produce the failure this whole design exists to avoid. This unit also discharges the أدب الطلب requirement of the parallel opt-in الإجازة track, so the two are not duplicated.

gradeByGrade.text: أدب الدنيا والدين — الماوردي (اختيارات، قراءة موجَّهة)
gradeByGrade.content: أدب الخلاف is not taught abstractly; it is modelled on live material in the year أصول الفقه goes مستقل and العقيدة handles الفرق. Named objectives booked to التربية inside أصول's block: تحرير محل النزاع قبل الاعتراض؛ حسن النقل عن المخالف وعرض قوله في أقوى صوره؛ التمييز بين الخلاف المعتبر والقول الشاذ؛ الامتناع عن تبديع المعيّن أو تفسيقه. Zero periods. The real assessment vehicle at G11 is the tutoring duty — G11-G12 pupils tutor G3-G5 in the ميثاق behaviours and in تسميع — which costs no timetable, gives the school its habituation labour, and is the only honest test of formation: you find out what a young man's أدب is by watching him correct an eight-year-old.

gradeByGrade.text: تذكرة السامع والمتكلم في أدب العالم والمتعلم — بدر الدين ابن جماعة (اختيارات)؛ الأخلاق والسير في مداواة النفوس — ابن حزم الأندلسي (اختيارات)؛ أدب الدنيا والدين — الماوردي
gradeByGrade.content: ONE period/week, full year, مستقل: «أدب الفتوى والاختلاف والدعوة». This is the only permanent weekly claim the subject makes in twelve years and it is made in the one grade with slack (اللغة العربية has ended, الصرف is a وحدة, مصطلح is مضمّن). Content: حدود الأهلية — ما الذي يحق لخريج هذه المدرسة أن يقوله وما الذي لا يحق؛ «لا أدري» بوصفها فعلًا علميًّا لا عجزًا؛ الاستفتاء والإحالة — من تُحيل إليه النازلة وكيف؛ أدب المناظرة، مُقدَّمًا داخل ندوة المناظرة/التحقيق التي تشترك فيها العقيدة والإنشاء والخطابة (COUNTED ONCE against the ceiling, not three times)؛ الدعوة في السياق اليوربي بالإنجليزية واليوربا — بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة، بلا لغة تكفير؛ ميثاق التخرج الشخصي (ورد قرآني، أذكار، خدمة، سجل التدريس للصغار). Mark composition: portfolio + oral مناظرة performance + one written paper on أدب الخلاف. Conduct itself is reported, never converted into a numeric grade that can be gamed.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
There are TWO events and the Board must not merge them, because they answer different questions.

EVENT 1 — FIRST DISTINCT NAMED ENTITY: G7, as a وحدة of one term, co-taught with الفقه, titled «وحدة البلوغ والتكليف». This is the year the subject first exists under its own name with its own mark.

WHY G7 AND NOT G6: two independent reasons converge, and either alone would be sufficient. (i) Developmental — the unit's core is المسؤولية الفردية, and that requires the learner to be able to hold his own conduct as an object and judge it, which is a capacity that consolidates around age 12-13 and is not reliably present at 11. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Delivered at G6 it becomes recitation of rules about a state the child is not in. (ii) Curricular — G6 is the single most loaded grade in this entire ladder: الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الجزرية، الأخضري، التفسير العملي والترجمة all arrive in one year, and by the النحو specialist's own arithmetic G6 sits at exactly 19 of 19. There is no room and there is no attention. A unit inserted at G6 would be taught badly by an exhausted teacher to an overloaded cohort.

WHY G7 AND NOT G8: بلوغ. The unit is PREPARATORY — its function is to give the learner أحكام الطهارة والتكليف BEFORE they bind him, not after. G7 is roughly age 12-13 in this cohort; a material portion of the girls will reach بلوغ during or before that year, and some boys during it. Delivered at G8 the unit arrives after the fact for a substantial minority. The specific failure that follows is not abstract: an early-maturing girl who does not know أحكام الحيض والغسل, and is too embarrassed to ask a male teacher or a mother who assumes the school taught it, prays when she should not or abandons prayer when she should not, conceals it, and does so for months. G7 is the last year in which the unit is still preparatory for nearly everyone. That is the whole argument, and it is a date, not a preference.

EVENT 2 — FIRST AND ONLY مستقل YEAR: G12. Not a second differentiation of the same entity but a different entity with a different function — أدب الفتوى والاختلاف والدعوة. WHY G12 AND NOT G11: the capstone consumes أصول الفقه's vocabulary of اختلاف (مستقل only from G11), مصطلح الحديث's صحيح/ضعيف discrimination (G10-G11), and الترجمة's rendering capacity into English and Yoruba (مستقل at G11). All three close at the end of G11. Taught at G11 it would be taught to a student who cannot yet name the level of a disagreement, which is precisely the competence the unit is about. WHY NOT LATER: there is no later. G12 is the last year the institution has custody of this young man before his community starts asking him questions.

WHAT NEVER HAPPENS: التربية الإسلامية never becomes a weekly examined subject at G1-G6, and this is a positive finding, not a budget concession. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Converting habituation into a timetabled paper is the documented failure mode of the discipline: pupils score full marks on الأمانة and cheat in the examination that follows. Formation at that age is produced by نظام، قدوة ومصاحبة, and those are institutional instruments, not periods.
prerequisites: Performs الصلاة unaided with its أركان and شروط — established G3 (الفقه, مدمج inside التوحيد والفقه; practically drilled in the school's own daily congregational prayer from G1). Without this, the G7 unit's أحكام البالغ half has nothing to attach to.

Holds a memorised stock of hadith carrying adab content (البر، الصدق، الرحمة، الحياء) — established G5-G6 (الحديث مستقل from G5; الأربعون النووية 1-28). The strand converts hadith into behaviour; it cannot convert what the learner does not hold.
Holds السيرة as أسوة — a named Prophetic behaviour per term — established G4-G6 (السيرة inside the الحديث والسيرة pair). Character teaching without a modelled person is moralising.
Reads short vocalised Arabic prose fluently and unaided — established G5, the year القراءة والتهجي completes its function. Gate on any adab text at all.

Reads a lightly-vocalised classical adab text with teacher gloss — established G7 (الآجرومية at G6 → ملحة الإعراب at G7). This is the precise gate on تعليم المتعلم at G7; it is why the وحدة can carry a real text and not a worksheet.

Knows الأحكام الخمسة and the فرض عين/فرض كفاية distinction — established G6-G7 (الفقه مستقل from G5; المقدمة الأخضرية G6 completed G7). Required before التكليف can be taught as anything more than a word.

Reflective moral reasoning — the capacity to describe one's own conduct and evaluate it against a standard. NOT established by any subject; it is developmental, consolidating around G7. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] This is the binding constraint on the G7 placement and the Board should understand it is the one prerequisite the curriculum cannot manufacture earlier by teaching harder.

Distinguishes صحيح from ضعيف and knows that موضوع exists — established G10 (مصطلح الحديث مستقل). Required before G12, because the adab literature is where fabricated material circulates most freely; a graduate who preaches أخلاق from موضوعات has been failed twice.
Holds the vocabulary of اختلاف: قطعي/ظني، مجتهد/مقلد، خلاف معتبر/قول شاذ، تحرير محل النزاع — established G10-G11 (أصول الفقه, مضمّن G8-G9, مدمج G10, مستقل G11). The direct gate on the G12 capstone.

Renders religious counsel into English and Yoruba — established G11 (الترجمة مستقل). Gate on the G12 الدعوة component; without it the graduate can only address people who already speak Arabic, which in this region is a small fraction of those who will ask him.

classicalTexts.title: تعليم المتعلم طريق التعلم — برهان الإسلام الزرنوجي
classicalTexts.grade: G7 (فصول مختارة بشرح المعلم) → G10 (اختيارات موسّعة)
classicalTexts.justification: The standard classical treatise on آداب طالب العلم: نية طلب العلم، اختيار العلم والأستاذ والشريك، تعظيم العلم وأهله، الجد والمواظبة، بداية السبق ومقداره وترتيبه. Short, structured, and written for exactly the learner who has just begun carrying mutūn. Placed at G7 in selections because the language is manageable with gloss once ملحة الإعراب is running, and revisited at G10 in the آفات العلم rotation where its warnings about نية and تعظيم land on a student now acquiring technical vocabulary. Not taught cover to cover at either point.

classicalTexts.title: تذكرة السامع والمتكلم في أدب العالم والمتعلم — بدر الدين ابن جماعة
classicalTexts.justification: Its structure is the reason for the placement: it treats the أدب of the teacher and of the student as two sides of one relationship. SHRS's G12 leavers are, in this community, about to be asked to teach. The sections on أدب العالم في نفسه، في درسه، ومع طلبته are directly the graduate's next职 role, and no other text on this register covers them.

classicalTexts.title: مختصر منهاج القاصدين — نجم الدين ابن قدامة المقدسي (اختصار منهاج القاصدين لابن الجوزي)
classicalTexts.grade: G10 (اختيارات: الكبر، العجب، الحسد، حب الرياسة، آفات اللسان)
classicalTexts.justification: The most usable classical treatment of أمراض القلوب available at secondary level: bounded chapters, plain prose, diagnostic rather than exhortatory. Selections only — four to six فصول in one term. The Board should note the transmission chain openly when adopting it (ابن الجوزي's منهاج القاصدين abridging material from الإحياء, then abridged again by ابن قدامة) so that the question at issue in note 4 below is answered deliberately rather than by accident.

classicalTexts.title: أدب الدنيا والدين — أبو الحسن الماوردي
classicalTexts.justification: Explicitly released by the النقد والآداب specialist, who recorded that it is NOT theirs — so it is unclaimed and it belongs here. It is a genuine ethics text (أدب النفس، أدب المعاملة، فضل العقل، آفات الشهوة والغضب) at an Arabic register a G11 pupil can read after ملحة الإعراب and لامية الأفعال. It carries the G11 مضمّن load without needing a period.

classicalTexts.title: الأخلاق والسير في مداواة النفوس — ابن حزم الأندلسي
classicalTexts.justification: Short, aphoristic, first-person, unusually candid about self-deception and the love of being admired. Its value at G12 is tonal: it is a scholar writing about his own faults, which is exactly the posture the capstone is trying to produce and which no didactic text can model.

classicalTexts.title: الآداب الشرعية والمنح المرعية — شمس الدين ابن مفلح المقدسي
classicalTexts.grade: G10-G12 — TEACHER REFERENCE ONLY, explicitly not a pupil text at any grade
classicalTexts.justification: The most comprehensive classical compilation of الآداب الشرعية and the natural place for the teacher to source warrants for the ميثاق behaviours. Far too large and too discursive to set before a pupil; naming it as a pupil text at any grade would be an error.

classicalTexts.title: الأدب المفرد — الإمام البخاري
classicalTexts.grade: G4-G6 oral selections ONLY, under الحديث's ownership; G9 as a pupil text belonging to الحديث النبوي, not to this subject
classicalTexts.justification: SHARED, NOT CLAIMED. The الحديث specialist has already allocated it at G9. التربية الإسلامية draws one hadith per fortnight from it orally at G4-G6 within الحديث's own minutes and books the behavioural outcome, not the text. Recording it this way is what prevents a duplicated allocation later.

classicalTexts.title: رياض الصالحين — الإمام النووي
classicalTexts.grade: G7 onwards — OWNED BY الحديث النبوي (extensive reading); used by this subject only as a lookup source for the ميثاق
classicalTexts.justification: SHARED, NOT CLAIMED, for the same reason. Its أبواب الأدب are the obvious source for behavioural warrants, but the text is already allocated and must not be re-timetabled here.

classicalTexts.title: بهجة قلوب الأبرار وقرة عيون الأخيار في شرح جوامع الأخبار — عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
classicalTexts.justification: A short commentary on a bounded set of comprehensive hadith, many of them adab-bearing, in modern-accessible Arabic. Useful to the teacher preparing the G8-G9 مضمّن minutes; not a pupil allocation.

classicalTexts.title: آيات الوصايا: لقمان 12-19، الإسراء 23-39، الحجرات 11-12
classicalTexts.grade: G3-G9, inside the ring-fenced Qur'an hour via التفسير's مضمّن layer
classicalTexts.justification: Not a classical matn and costs nothing: these passages are already being memorised and glossed inside the protected hour. Naming them as this subject's Qur'anic spine means the التفسير teacher knows which behavioural outcomes to signal at that moment. الحجرات 11-12 in particular carries the G5 آفات اللسان content and the G3 anti-mockery norm at their source.

classicalTexts.title: أدب الطلب ومنتهى الأرب — محمد بن علي الشوكاني
classicalTexts.grade: NOT ALLOCATED — do not adopt until a physical copy is checked
classicalTexts.justification: I believe a work of this kind by الشوكاني exists, but I am not confident enough of the exact title wording to place it against a grade. Per the hard prohibition on uncertain attributions, it stays out of the architecture until verified. Nothing in the design depends on it; تعليم المتعلم covers the same function at G7 and G10.

classicalTexts.title: إحياء علوم الدين — أبو حامد الغزالي
classicalTexts.justification: The work certainly exists and is the fountainhead of most of this subject's later literature. I decline to place it, and the reason is institutional rather than scholarly: this register's matn selections mix a مالكي spine (الأخضري، الرسالة، مختصر خليل، ابن عاشر) with a نجدي creedal spine (ثلاثة الأصول، كتاب التوحيد، كشف الشبهات). Whether a تصوف-framed التزكية text is admissible inside that mix is a governance ruling about the school's identity, not a curriculum specialist's call. مختصر منهاج القاصدين is offered as the placement I can defend without pre-empting that ruling.

classicalTexts.title: Yoruba-language or ajami adab/waʿẓ corpus current in the region
classicalTexts.justification: There is very likely locally-current Yoruba adab material that would serve the G8-G9 عرف/شرع work and the G12 دعوة component better than anything I can name. I cannot verify any specific title or author and will not guess one. Referred to the Council with local scholarly consultation. [UNVERIFIED]

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
FIVE specific risks, each with a named mechanism. None of them is "children are too young."

1. IT CONVERTS FORMATION INTO PROPOSITIONS, WHICH IS A NET LOSS. Give التربية الإسلامية a weekly period at G2 and the assessable object becomes what the child can SAY about الصدق. The child learns the proposition, is marked on the proposition, and the proposition is thereafter the thing he has. Habituation, which was already happening for free in the prayer lines and the wudu queue, is not improved by the lesson and is quietly displaced by it, because the teacher who has "done" honesty on Tuesday attends less to the lie on Thursday. The subject would be, at G1-G6, strictly worse than its own absence.

2. THE ARITHMETIC AT G1-G2 IS BRUTAL AND NAMED. The non-Qur'an week is 7 periods. It is currently اللغة العربية 3 + القراءة والتهجي 3 + 1 shared practical block = 7 exactly, with zero slack. There is no such thing as "one small period for أخلاق" at G1-G2; there is only taking one from Arabic literacy. And Arabic reading fluency, completing at G5, is the gate on التفسير، النحو، الصرف، الفقه، الحديث and every matn from G6 onward. Trading 14% of the youngest learners' entire programme, for twelve years of downstream consequence, to teach a six-year-old to recite that lying is wrong, is the worst available trade on this register.

3. MORAL FATIGUE ARRIVES EXACTLY WHEN THE SUBJECT IS NEEDED. Explicit, weekly, examined exhortation beginning at age six exhausts its own authority by thirteen. The G7 بلوغ unit and the G9 adolescent work depend on the learner receiving them as new, serious and addressed to him personally. A cohort that has sat through six years of character lessons will hear the G7 unit as the seventh year of the same lesson and discount it. The design deliberately spends nothing at G1-G6 partly in order to have credibility left at G7 and G12.

4. IT MANUFACTURES CHILD POLICING — THE SAME FAILURE REDLINE 6 ALREADY IDENTIFIED. Teach الغيبة والنميمة as an examined taxonomy at G4-G5 and you hand a nine-year-old a category he will apply to his mother's conversation, his uncle's gathering, his teacher's remark. This is structurally identical to the نواقض الإسلام risk the Board has already ruled on, it lands in the SAME YEAR, and it therefore needs the same protective grammar and one combined teacher briefing, not two. This is the concrete reason آفات اللسان at G5 is first-person-only in this design.

5. أحكام البلوغ TAUGHT AT G4-G5 COLLIDES WITH THE COMMUNITY. Delivering menstruation and غسل content to nine- and ten-year-olds, in this setting, without the cohort being near بلوغ, is developmentally pointless and will be read by families as the school overreaching into what parents regard as theirs to time. It would cost the school the parental cooperation the G7 unit actually needs. The unit's placement at G7 is as much a consent decision as a pedagogical one.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
FOUR specific risks. The first two are dated failures, not tendencies.

1. THE بلوغ GAP — A FAILURE WITH A CALENDAR. If the explicit unit slips past G7, a real fraction of the cohort — girls disproportionately — crosses into تكليف without knowing أحكام الطهارة that determine whether their prayer is valid. The observable consequence is not ignorance in the abstract; it is a thirteen-year-old girl who prays during حيض or abandons prayer entirely after it, tells no one because the only teacher who covers "that" is male, and continues for a term or two. That is a concrete, predictable, preventable outcome of a one-year slip, and it is the single strongest reason the G7 unit exists.

2. THE ARMED GRADUATE. This is the largest institutional risk on the whole register and it belongs to this subject. By G12, SHRS will have given a young man مصطلح الحديث, أصول الفقه, العقيدة الطحاوية والواسطية, المنطق, البلاغة, and كشف الشبهات — that is, the complete apparatus for winning a religious argument — plus, per accepted redline 8 and الترجمة, the ability to deploy it in English and Yoruba to people who cannot check him. If أدب الخلاف والفتوى is not a named, owned, examined part of his final year, the school ships that capability with no formation in how to disagree, no working sense of the limits of his own أهلية, and no habituated "لا أدري". In a region with live intra-Muslim friction, that is not a soft loss; it is the most damaging thing this curriculum could plausibly produce, and it would be produced by omission rather than by anyone deciding it.

3. IDENTITY FUSED TO ATTAINMENT. If آفات العلم is not named by G10, the student who has just completed الآجرومية → ملحة → لامية الأفعال → نخبة الفكر attaches his sense of self to his mutūn. The visible symptoms are specific and familiar: contempt for the cohort below, correcting the imām audibly, an inability to be taught by anyone he has out-read. The classical tradition placed آفات العلم at precisely this point in a student's formation for precisely this reason, and G10 — the year four technical disciplines differentiate at once — is when it happens here.

4. THE OWNERSHIP VOID, WHICH IS THE DEFAULT OUTCOME. If the subject is not constituted at all, adab does not fall to another subject; it falls between four of them. الفقه owns validity, العقيدة owns belief, الحديث owns text, السيرة owns narrative — and each will reasonably assume a neighbour has سلوك. No scheme of work will contain it, no one will be accountable for it, and the school will nonetheless describe itself as a school of تربية. This is the failure that is already latent in the submission's silence, and it is why the correct response to that silence is not a timetable line but a named owner and a written instrument.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 the subject holds its only مستقل year — one period per week, «أدب الفتوى والاختلاف والدعوة» — and its function is terminal and specific: to govern the use of everything else the graduate is leaving with.

WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO BECAUSE OF IT:
- State an opponent's position in its strongest form, in Arabic, before advancing his own — and name the level of the disagreement using أصول vocabulary: قطعي or ظني, خلاف معتبر or قول شاذ, a difference of تحقيق مناط or of دليل.
- Say «لا أدري» as a deliberate scholarly act, and name the person or body he refers the questioner to. This is a trained behaviour with a script, not a disposition, and it is rehearsed in the seminar.
- Recognise the boundary of his own أهلية: he can transmit a settled ruling with its evidence; he does not issue فتوى in نوازل, in انتقال between madhhabs, or in matters touching marriage dissolution, inheritance shares in contested estates, or takfīr. He knows the list because he has been given the list.
- Deliver religious counsel to his own community in Yoruba and in English — drawing on الترجمة (G11) — without takfīr language and without implying that Yoruba social custom is as such suspect. He can distinguish, out loud and calmly, between a custom that conflicts with الشرع, one that is merely عرف, and one he simply dislikes.
- Verify an adab hadith before preaching from it, because he holds مصطلح (G10-G11) and has been made to apply it to this literature specifically, where fabricated material is thickest.
- Teach a younger pupil — he has been doing it under supervision since G11 — and knows the أدب of the teacher's side of that relationship from تذكرة السامع والمتكلم.
- Sustain a personal regime he set himself: a ميثاق التخرج carrying ورد قرآني, أذكار, a service commitment and a tutoring log, documented in a portfolio.

ASSESSMENT AT G12, precisely: independently assessed, with the mark composed of the portfolio, performance in the مناظرة/تحقيق seminar, and one written paper on أدب الخلاف. Conduct itself is REPORTED and never converted into a numeric grade. The distinction is load-bearing: the moment character becomes a scorable component of a leaving certificate, it becomes something to perform for the certificate, and the subject destroys in one year what it spent eleven building.

WHAT G12 IS NOT: it is not a revision of أخلاق. It is the year the school takes responsibility for what it has armed the graduate with.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the [RECOVERED] ceilings — 7 periods/week at G1-G2, ~19 at G3-G12, Qur'an hour ring-fenced and untouched (this subject asks nothing of it at any grade). Headline: ONE new permanent weekly period in twelve years.

G1-G2: ZERO of 7. Explicitly and permanently no claim. The only donors at this ceiling are اللغة العربية and القراءة والتهجي, and taking from either is indefensible (see premature-introduction risk 2). The instrument here is the ميثاق السلوك, which costs teacher planning time and a termly review meeting, not periods.

G3-G6: ZERO of 19. مضمّن throughout. Real cost is roughly 10-15 minutes/week absorbed inside blocks that already exist (التوحيد والفقه at G3; الحديث والسيرة at G4-G6), plus one fortnightly adab hadith taken from within الحديث's own minutes. What is being asked of those subjects is a change to their written scheme of work, not a transfer of time.

G7: ZERO NEW. The وحدة is 1 period/week for ONE term, carved from within الفقه's existing G7 allocation and co-taught — legitimate because half the unit's content (الطهارة للبالغ، ما يجب بالبلوغ) is فقه content الفقه must teach in that exact year regardless. Annualised marginal cost against the 19: nil. THE REAL COST AT G7 IS STAFFING, NOT TIME: gender-separated delivery with a female teacher for the girls' أحكام portion. If the Board cannot fund that, this unit does not exist as designed.

G8-G9: ZERO NEW. ~10 minutes/week each year, named in الفقه's scheme (G8) and العقيدة's scheme (G9). A claim on how an existing period is used, not on a new period.

G10: ZERO NEW. The دوراني unit runs 1-2 periods/week for ONE term in the SAME rotation slot المنطق وعلم الكلام occupies at G10, in a different term. The المنطق specialist has already recorded that the slot stands free in its other two terms and named a rotation partner as someone else's call — this is that partner. Annualised marginal cost: approximately 0.4 of one weekly period, and zero if the slot is counted once.

G11: ZERO NEW. مضمّن inside أصول الفقه's block as named, traceable objectives. The tutoring duty (G11-G12 pupils tutoring G3-G5) runs outside the timetable entirely — it is supervision and rota, not periods, and it returns labour to the habituation regime it costs nothing to run.

G12: ONE period of 19 (5.3%), full year, مستقل. This is the subject's only permanent weekly claim in the whole ladder, and it is made in the one grade that has slack — اللغة العربية has ended, الصرف is a وحدة, مصطلح الحديث is مضمّن. One of the period's uses, the مناظرة/تحقيق seminar, is CO-SERVED with العقيدة and الإنشاء والخطابة, all three of whom have now referenced the same seminar; it must be counted ONCE against the 19, not three times, and the Board should minute that explicitly or three specialists will each have booked it.

TWELVE-YEAR TOTAL MARGINAL DEMAND: 1 permanent weekly period (G12) + ~0.4 annualised at G10 + 0 elsewhere. FALLBACK IF THE G12 PERIOD IS REFUSED: مدمج with الإنشاء والخطابة's G12 seminar, separately traceable, separately marked, zero new periods. I record this fallback but do not recommend it — a capstone with no name of its own becomes a rubric nobody teaches.
departuresFromSubmission: THE SUBMISSION OMITS THE SUBJECT ENTIRELY FROM G1-G7, AND I DO NOT TREAT THAT AS DELETION. I read the omission as an unnamed function rather than an absent one: التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي at G1-G2 do deliver its content, and the submission is right to give it no line there. But an unnamed function has no owner, no scheme and no audit, which is precisely how a school ends up asserting it teaches أخلاق while no document contains it. Override: the subject is NAMED at all twelve grades, and refused a timetable line at ten of them.

I REJECT THE UMBRELLA READING OF THE REGISTER ENTRY OUTRIGHT. In state systems التربية الإسلامية is the container for عقيدة + فقه + حديث + سيرة + تلاوة + أخلاق examined as one subject. Adopting that here would duplicate the whole of Programme 3 and dissolve 25 separately-traced lifecycles. I ask the Board to minute a binding scope note: التربية الإسلامية at SHRS = السلوك والآداب الشرعية والتزكية, and nothing else.

I ADD AN INSTITUTIONAL INSTRUMENT THE SUBMISSION HAS NO CATEGORY FOR. The ميثاق السلوك (6-8 named behaviours per term per grade, G1-G6) and the سجل الالتزام, with a named owner (مشرف التربية / وكيل شؤون الطلاب) and a termly review, are not curriculum objects and do not appear on a timetable. Without them this subject is fictional at G1-G6. This is the most important departure in the submission and it needs a governance decision, not a curriculum one.

I ADD A G7 وحدة THE SUBMISSION HAS NO SLOT FOR — and fund it from inside الفقه rather than from a new period, because half its content is فقه content due in that exact year. The submission's G7 is already dense (التفسير 2, الجزرية 2, النحو 3, الصرف, العقيدة, الفقه, الحديث, السيرة 2); a new line there would be unaffordable and I do not request one.

I EXTEND REDLINE 6's PROTECTIVE FRAMING SIDEWAYS, WHICH THE SUBMISSION DOES NOT ANTICIPATE. The Board ruled that نواقض الإسلام at G5 needs protective, descriptive, non-accusatory framing. آفات اللسان also lands at G5 in my design, and carries an identical risk of handing a nine-year-old a category to apply to adults. The two must share one teacher briefing and one protective grammar, not two separate ones. This is an extension of an accepted redline, not a reopening of it.

I ADD A NAMED عرف/شرع STRAND ON YORUBA SOCIAL CUSTOM AT G8-G9 THAT APPEARS NOWHERE IN THE REGISTER. The curriculum teaches نواقض الإسلام at G5 and selected أبواب of كتاب التوحيد at G9. Nothing in the submission tells the learner how to hold that material without contempt for the customs of his own household. That gap is the specific local liability of this curriculum in this region, and an unowned gap is a guaranteed one.

I RESOLVE A NAME COLLISION THE REGISTER CREATES. Subject 13 is النقد والآداب, where الآداب means belles-lettres; this subject owns الآداب الشرعية. Two different disciplines, one word. The Board should record the distinction in the register itself or a future registrar will file one against the other.

I DECLINE TO ALLOCATE إحياء علوم الدين and refer it upward. The work exists and is the source of most of this subject's later literature, but the register's matn spine mixes a مالكي فقه line with a نجدي creedal line, and whether a تصوف-framed التزكية text is admissible inside that mix is a question about the school's identity, not a pedagogical judgement I am entitled to make on the Board's behalf.

I OBSERVE THAT THE G12 مناظرة/تحقيق SEMINAR HAS NOW BEEN CLAIMED BY THREE SPECIALISTS — العقيدة, الإنشاء والخطابة, and this subject. It is one seminar and must be counted once against the 19-period ceiling. If it is counted three times the G12 timetable is over-subscribed on paper by two periods that do not exist.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: الفقه (#19) — FEEDS IT AND CO-TEACHES IT. الفقه establishes the prerequisite (prayer performed unaided, G3) and supplies the أحكام half of the G7 بلوغ unit from its own allocation. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: التربية never re-teaches شروط وأركان الصلاة or the الأحكام الخمسة. الفقه owns whether the act is VALID; التربية owns whether it is performed, sustained, and performed with أدب. Clean, auditable line.

الحديث النبوي (#21) — ITS TEXTUAL SUPPLY LINE, G4-G7. Every adab warrant this subject uses comes from الحديث's own allocation and remains الحديث's property: الأدب المفرد (allocated G9), رياض الصالحين (G7 onward), الأربعون النووية. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: التربية never teaches the matn, its تخريج or its فقه; it converts one hadith per fortnight into a named observable behaviour on the ميثاق. Zero minutes transfer.

السيرة النبوية (#24) — SUPPLIES الأسوة. One named Prophetic behaviour per term at G4-G6 (حلمه، وفاؤه، رفقه بالخادم); الشمائل المحمدية at G8 is السيرة's, and its chapters on أخلاقه are the richest adab material in the ladder. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: chronology, غزوات, geography, and مصادر السيرة are never touched here.

العقيدة (#17) — HOSTS IT AT G9 AND IS ITS MOST IMPORTANT COUNTERWEIGHT. G9 is where العقيدة studies نواقض as a text and selected أبواب of كتاب التوحيد; التربية's G9 minutes sit inside that block and teach the distinction between تقرير الحكم and الحكم على المعيّن, and how to hold this material without contempt for family. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: propositional creed, its دلائل, its نواقض. HARD BOUNDARY: this subject never does takfīr-adjacent content in any form; it is structurally the brake, not a second accelerator.

التوحيد (#18) — the G1-G2 practical block (التوحيد العملي) is jointly held: التوحيد owns the creedal content, التربية owns the habituation mode of its delivery. Neither claims a period; both must be named in the same scheme of work so the block has one owner in practice.

أصول الفقه (#20) — ITS G11 HOST AND THE SOURCE OF ITS G12 VOCABULARY. أصول supplies قطعي/ظني، مجتهد/مقلد، خلاف معتبر/شاذ، تحرير محل النزاع; التربية supplies the أدب of using them. The pairing is load-bearing: أدب الخلاف taught without أصول is sentiment, and أصول taught without أدب الخلاف is a weapon.

مصطلح الحديث (#22) — A HARD PREREQUISITE FOR G12. The adab and رقائق literature is where fabricated material circulates most freely. A graduate preaching أخلاق from موضوعات has been failed twice over. مصطلح's صحيح/ضعيف discrimination (G10-G11) must be applied to THIS literature specifically, as a named exercise, before the G12 دعوة component runs.

الإنشاء والخطابة (#14) — CO-SERVES THE G12 SEMINAR. الإنشاء owns the skill of speaking and arranging an argument; التربية owns the أدب of it: الصدق في النقل، ترك السخرية، أدب المخاطبة، عرض قول المخالف في أقوى صوره. One seminar, two traceable outcome sets, ONE count against the ceiling.

الترجمة (#16) — GATE ON THE G12 دعوة COMPONENT. الترجمة مستقل at G11 gives the rendering capacity into English and Yoruba; without it the graduate's counsel reaches only those who already read Arabic, which in this region is a small minority of those who will ask him.
النشيد والمحفوظات (#4) — CARRIES THE أذكار AT G1-G3 AT ZERO COST, inside its existing 5-minute daily slot. التربية supplies which أذكار and why; النشيد supplies the delivery mechanism.

اللغة العربية (#7) — RECEIVES, DOES NOT GIVE. التربية hands العربية its G2-G3 virtue-vocabulary semantic field (صدق، أمانة، رحمة، حياء) — words العربية was going to teach anyway, now with a reason. In return العربية's literacy completion at G5 and النحو's الآجرومية/ملحة at G6-G7 are what make a real adab text readable at G7.

النقد والآداب (#13) — NO RELATIONSHIP AT ALL, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Its الآداب is belles-lettres. The one substantive contact is that its specialist explicitly released أدب الدنيا والدين للماوردي as not theirs, which frees it for allocation here at G11-G12. The name collision must be minuted in the register.

التفسير (#5) — supplies the Qur'anic spine at zero cost: لقمان 12-19، الإسراء 23-39، الحجرات 11-12 are already being glossed inside the ring-fenced hour. التربية asks only that the التفسير teacher be told which behavioural outcomes to signal at those āyāt.

الدراسات الحديثة (#25, not yet designed) — THE BOUNDARY MUST BE RULED BEFORE #25 IS WRITTEN. My proposed line: التربية الإسلامية owns the conduct of the individual believer (digital conduct, صحبة, عرف vs شرع in his own household); الدراسات الحديثة owns the external contemporary phenomenon as an object of analysis. Without this ruling the two will duplicate each other on exactly the topics that matter most.

الإجازة (parallel opt-in track, redline 2) — the G10 آداب طالب العلم rotation discharges that track's adab-of-the-سند requirement. Recorded here so the Ijazah track does not build its own duplicate adab component.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Register scope note. Will the Board formally record that التربية الإسلامية at SHRS means السلوك والآداب الشرعية والتزكية and is NOT the umbrella subject of that name? Related and practical: SHRS has international ambitions and Nigerian accreditation exposure, and both WAEC/NECO 'Islamic Studies' and Arab accreditors will read the name in the umbrella sense. The school needs a MAPPING TABLE — its 25 named disciplines against the external umbrella paper — or it will be asked why its التربية الإسلامية syllabus contains no عقيدة.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Staffing of the G7 unit. Gender-separated delivery with a female teacher for the girls' أحكام الحيض والغسل portion is a precondition, not a preference. Can the school staff it? If not, the unit cannot run as designed and the board must choose a fallback (mothers' briefing plus a written pupil handbook is the only one I can defend, and it is weaker).

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Governance of the سجل الالتزام. Who owns it, is it shown to parents, and is it ever admissible in promotion or disciplinary decisions? If it becomes an instrument of surveillance or of promotion it will be gamed by pupils and weaponised by staff, and it will stop measuring anything. My recommendation is: descriptive, teacher-held, shared with parents termly in narrative form, never numeric, never used in promotion — but this is a governance ruling.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Admissibility of تصوف-framed التزكية material — إحياء علوم الدين and, by descent, مختصر منهاج القاصدين. The register's matn spine mixes مالكي فقه with a نجدي creedal line. This is a question about the school's declared identity and must be answered deliberately, not by whichever text a teacher happens to own.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Boundary with الدراسات الحديثة (#25), which has not been designed. Digital conduct, gender and society, and contemporary ethics can land in either. Rule the line before #25 is drafted, not after.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] The G12 seminar is now claimed by three specialists (العقيدة, الإنشاء والخطابة, التربية الإسلامية). Confirm it is ONE seminar counted ONCE against the 19, and name its owning department.

[UNVERIFIED — referred out] Is there a Yoruba-language or ajami adab/waʿẓ corpus current in this community that should be adopted for the G8-G9 عرف/شرع work and the G12 دعوة component? I cannot verify any title or author and will not guess one. This needs local scholarly consultation, and the answer would materially improve the design.

[UNVERIFIED — title only] أدب الطلب ومنتهى الأرب attributed to الشوكاني. I believe a work of this kind exists but am not confident of the exact wording of the title and have therefore left it out of the architecture. Nothing depends on it; verify before adopting.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Grant or refuse the single G12 period. Refusal is survivable (fallback: مدمج with الإنشاء والخطابة's seminar) but I record my judgement that a capstone without its own name becomes a rubric nobody teaches.

[OPEN — data, not judgement] Actual بلوغ distribution in this cohort. The G7 placement rests on the assumption that G7 ≈ age 12-13 and that most of the cohort has not yet reached بلوغ. If SHRS admits over-age pupils at G1, or if intake age drifts, the unit may need to move to G6 despite the G6 matn load. The school should check its own enrolment ages before ratifying G7.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: Two thresholds, and they must not be collapsed. (1) G1 — the affective threshold. Told stories of the Prophet ﷺ produce durable, real learning in a six-year-old: attachment (المحبة), the exemplar met as a person rather than as a proposition, and the daily reflex of الصلاة عليه. That is genuine learning and it costs zero periods — but it is قصص النبي, not السيرة. (2) G4 — the first meaningful appearance of السيرة AS A DISCIPLINE. For this discipline "meaningful" has a precise test: the sequence itself becomes the object of learning. The learner holds episodes in order, knows that one caused the next, and can answer "what happened before this, and why did it lead to that?"
