Secure temporal ordering with causal linkage across more than two events is available around age 9 [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE], and G4 is where the submission already gives the subject a block and an independent mark — which I protect unchanged [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION]. Note what this rules out: any attempt to make G1–G3 "السيرة proper" by attaching dates or a syllabus to it would not advance the discipline, it would only convert free affective learning into an unaffordable timetable line. Note also what it rules IN: the submission's silence at G1–G3 is the largest single error in its treatment of this subject, because those are the highest-yield narrative years and they cost nothing.

gradeByGrade.content: Oral, in Yoruba/English with Arabic proper names kept in Arabic. The doctrinal hook is already present in the submission: شهادة أن محمدًا رسول الله — the one we follow, so we must know who he is. This makes التوحيد العملي the correct host and الفقه التطبيقي the wrong one. Content: اسمه ونسبه إلى عبد المطلب؛ آمنة وعبد الله؛ ميلاده بمكة؛ حليمة السعدية؛ يتمه ومن كفله (عبد المطلب ثم أبو طالب)؛ مكة والكعبة as the place; two character episodes told as stories (رفقه بالأطفال، رحمته بالحيوان); and the daily habit of saying صلى الله عليه وسلم whenever his name is heard — which #21 الحديث names as its own single G3 precondition, so establishing it here pays a second subject for free. NO dates, NO chronology, NO conflict material of any kind. Recall is oral and folded into the التوحيد العملي embedded check; nothing is reported separately.

Same host, extended. الصادق الأمين and what that meant to the people who dealt with him; بناء الكعبة and the الحجر الأسود arbitration told as a story about fairness that a seven-year-old can act out; زواجه بخديجة; التحنث في غار حراء and the beginning of revelation told simply (اقرأ، جبريل، رجوعه إلى خديجة); the near family and the earliest believers as named persons with relationships — خديجة، أبو بكر، علي، زيد. Still no chronology and no dates. Persecution is touched only as "some people were unkind to him and he was patient" — deliberately, because a child of seven who learns the detail repeats it out of context. DEPARTURE from the predecessor draft: assessment is raised from none to embedded, because by G2 there is a definite body of names, relationships and three stories that can and should be checked orally inside التوحيد's own check. Embedded assessment costs no periods; it only costs marking attention.

gradeByGrade.partner: الحديث (which is itself مضمّن inside the التوحيد والفقه block at G3 — the block is the physical host)
gradeByGrade.content: [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] The host moves from التوحيد to الحديث, because G3 is where short hadith matns begin (#21) and every hadith has an occasion, a speaker and a setting. 12–15 episodes, each attached to a hadith or to a habit being formed (السلام، الصدق، بر الوالدين، الرحمة، الأمانة). Introduces مكة، المدينة and الهجرة as two places and one named event, undated. FIRST TIMELINE — two boxes only: قبل البعثة / بعد البعثة, physically drawn and repeatedly used. That two-box timeline is the single competency this year exists to build, and it is the gate on G4. Coordination note the predecessor draft missed: at G3 الحديث does not yet hold periods of its own, so السيرة is embedded inside an embedded strand. The actual host block is التوحيد والفقه; the disciplinary partner is الحديث. Both must be named in the scheme of work or the strand will silently evaporate.

PROTECTED AS SUBMITTED — right partner, right year, right assessment posture, and #21 الحديث independently protects the same pairing from its side, which is the strongest possible cross-check. The Meccan period, first pass, in sequence and in the language of instruction: النسب، الميلاد، اليتم، الرعي والتجارة، خديجة، الحجر الأسود، البعثة، الدعوة السرية، السابقون الأولون، الدعوة الجهرية، أذى قريش للمستضعفين (بلال and سمية named; the teaching point is صبر, not suffering rendered in detail). The Companions are met as named human beings who were present — which #22 مصطلح الحديث explicitly banks as the raw material of a much later رجال frame, on condition it stays narrative here. It stays narrative here. Assessed as a separately traceable and separately scored strand within the الحديث والسيرة paper: hadith items and sirah items marked apart, both reported.

gradeByGrade.text: كتاب مدرسي مُصنَّف داخليًّا بلغة التدريس (لا متن عربي في هذه السنة)
gradeByGrade.content: POINT OF DIFFERENTIATION — and an override of both the submission and the previous specialist draft. Content: the Meccan period completed and closed — هجرة الحبشة، الحصار في الشعب، عام الحزن (وفاة خديجة وأبي طالب)، رحلة الطائف، الإسراء والمعراج، بيعتا العقبة، ثم الهجرة (الغار، سراقة، قباء، دخول المدينة). This is taught as ONE causal arc — rejection → endurance → withdrawal → migration — because a ten-year-old can for the first time hold a year-long arc in which the ending is explained by the beginning. That capacity is exactly what a topical hadith corpus cannot exercise and a normative فقه grid cannot exercise. Deliberately sited beside the G5 نواقض الإسلام block: what the Prophet ﷺ actually did to those who rejected him — أهل الطائف، جيرانه، عمه — is the concrete protective framing redline 6 requires, and it is more effective than any caveat added to نواقض itself. Medium: language of instruction, with Arabic proper names and a controlled Arabic term list (هجرة، بيعة، صحابي، قريش). 1 period/week.

gradeByGrade.text: استمرار الكتاب المدرسي الداخلي؛ نصوص عربية قصيرة مشكولة مقتبسة، لا متن كامل
gradeByGrade.content: First narrative pass COMPLETED and CLOSED at the الوفاة. المدينة: بناء المسجد، المؤاخاة، صحيفة المدينة (taught as a written covenant governing life with non-Muslim neighbours — directly load-bearing in this community and not an antiquarian detail)، تحويل القبلة، بدر، أحد، الخندق، الحديبية، الرسائل إلى الملوك، فتح مكة، حنين، تبوك، عام الوفود، حجة الوداع، المرض والوفاة. Rule for the مغازي at this grade: each is narrated as an event with a cause, a course and an outcome; no tactical detail, no casualty catalogue, no graphic material; their ETHICS are deferred entire to G11, and the teacher is told so explicitly. Short vowelled Arabic passages are read from the graded reader as اللغة العربية reaches الجمل البسيطة, but the year is still taught in the language of instruction. Closing the pass here is what allows التفسير to use المكي والمدني operationally at G6–G7 (#5 depends on exactly this) and what allows G7 to begin an Arabic re-read rather than a continuation. 1 period/week — and at G6 that is the last free period in the week; see periodsRequested.

gradeByGrade.text: نور اليقين في سيرة سيد المرسلين (محمد الخضري بك) — نص الطالب؛ الرحيق المختوم (صفي الرحمن المباركفوري) — مرجع المعلم
gradeByGrade.content: MEDIUM CHANGE, not differentiation (the submission and the previous draft conflate these; see differentiationPoint). OVERRIDE of the submission's مدمج مع التاريخ. Second pass begins, now Arabic-medium and now apparatus-bearing: المكي والهجرة re-read from a graded Arabic prose text; التاريخ الهجري introduced and actual dating attached to events the student already knows; maps built in-subject (مكة، الطائف، الحبشة، يثرب، طرق القوافل) — this subject builds its own geography rather than assuming it; أنساب قريش only to the depth the narrative needs; سرية / غزوة / وفد / بيعة / معاهدة taught as Arabic vocabulary. This is the first content subject the student reads in Arabic, and it is deliberately the easiest one: narrative prose with a known storyline is the correct place to make that transition, not a technical matn. Feeds #14 الإنشاء's G7 تلخيص task directly. 2 periods/week (see the trade named in periodsRequested).

gradeByGrade.text: الشمائل المحمدية (الترمذي) — أبواب مختارة؛ استكمال نور اليقين / الرحيق المختوم
gradeByGrade.content: FINAL STANDING YEAR. The Medinan period in Arabic with dates and geography; الغزوات year by year; الوفود; أمهات المؤمنين taught factually and respectfully; خصائصه ﷺ; مرضه ووفاته. الشمائل المحمدية enters as the first genuine matn this subject owns — chosen because its أبواب are short, concrete and self-contained (خلقه، صفته، أخلاقه، عبادته), so a G8 reader finishes units instead of drowning in continuous narrative, and because it supplies the شمائل dimension that an event-driven sirah leaves out. THE SENSITIVE EPISODES ARE HANDLED HERE, ONCE, WITH BOARD-APPROVED FRAMING: بنو قريظة، حادثة الإفك، تعدد الزوجات وسن عائشة عند الزواج. In a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian setting with mixed schooling and active Christian-missionary polemic, the student WILL meet these — the only real choice is whether he meets them first from his own teacher at fourteen with a historical frame, or first from an opponent. Avoidance is not neutrality; it is a decision to lose the first encounter. At the end of G8 the narrative function of this subject is complete and the standing 2-period line is handed to التاريخ الإسلامي from G9.

gradeByGrade.text: السيرة النبوية لابن هشام؛ الطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد؛ المغازي للواقدي؛ البداية والنهاية لابن كثير — تُعرَض وتُعايَن، ولا تُقرأ كاملة
gradeByGrade.content: ONE TERM, 1 period/week. مصادر السيرة — how we know any of this. ابن إسحاق and how his material reached us through ابن هشام; الواقدي and ابن سعد; sirah material inside the hadith collections; البداية والنهاية as a later synthesis drawing on earlier compilations; what a كتاب مغازي is; the classical practice of holding سير/مغازي reports to a different threshold from أحكام reports; and how to check whether a story circulating in مولد season is in the sources at all. Strictly DESCRIPTIVE historiography — NO isnād-criticism terminology, no صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as technical categories. That apparatus is مصطلح الحديث's property at G10–G11 (same logic as redline 1, applied to myself). This unit exists precisely to hand the student a felt problem one year before مصطلح hands him the instrument that solves it; #22 مصطلح names exactly this chronology and biographical frame as its own prerequisite.

gradeByGrade.partner: التفسير (or أصول التفسير where that subject holds the G10 slot — coordinate with #6)
gradeByGrade.content: ZERO dedicated periods. The sirah chronology is now spent, not taught: المكي والمدني as a real division applied to the student's secure timeline; أسباب النزول for the passages the تفسير course actually covers; تدرج التشريع (الخمر، القتال، الحجاب) understood as a chronological phenomenon rather than a list of abrogations. Assessed inside the host subject. This embedding is also what makes مصطلح الحديث affordable at G10 — #22 states plainly that its 2 periods are payable only if السيرة has contracted to a rotational or embedded presence by then. It has.

gradeByGrade.text: زاد المعاد في هدي خير العباد (ابن قيم الجوزية) — مقتطفات
gradeByGrade.content: ONE TERM, 2 periods/week. فقه السيرة والدروس المستنبطة — a different object from the narrative, which is why this is re-differentiation rather than revision. القيادة والشورى؛ صلح الحديبية as a study in strategic patience and in accepting terms that look like defeat؛ التعامل مع المخالف؛ the ethics of the مغازي addressed directly and adequately now that the student can hold moral complexity (deferred from G6 for exactly this reason)؛ دلائل النبوة as narrated evidence, with its kalām-level argument left to العقيدة؛ and a bounded segment on explaining the Prophet's life to contemporary objectors — explanation, not polemic, and covering the objections actually in circulation locally, which the student has already met at G8 with a frame. Rotational rather than مستقل because the G10–G12 timetable, with البلاغة، أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، مصطلح، الترجمة and النقد all entering, cannot honestly carry another year-long block, and I will not pretend otherwise. Scheduling note: place this rotation in a different term from التجويد's G11 rotation (#2), which also asks 2 periods for one term.

gradeByGrade.text: السيرة النبوية لابن هشام — مقاطع مختارة تُقرأ بالعربية على محتوى معلوم
gradeByGrade.content: ZERO dedicated periods and no separate examination paper. السيرة becomes the CONTENT OF OUTPUT: the student prepares and delivers sirah talks in Arabic, English and Yoruba inside the existing الإنشاء والخطابة allocation (#14 holds 2 periods at G12, one of them a delivery workshop); selected passages of سيرة ابن هشام are read in the original as an Arabic reading exercise on material already known — the correct terminal use of a hard classical text; and the graduation project must include at least one sirah topic researched from named sources and defended orally. Independently assessed as a portfolio/capstone component. Boundary with #14: الإنشاء assesses composition and delivery; السيرة assesses accuracy of content, correct sourcing, and whether the lesson drawn is defensible from the episode.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G5 — السيرة becomes a distinct named entity (مستقل) at G5, and a second, differently-purposed entity (فقه السيرة, دوراني) at G11. I am overriding the submission (which never differentiates it at all through G7) AND the earlier specialist draft (which put differentiation at G7). The G7 event is real but it is a MEDIUM CHANGE — the subject goes Arabic-medium and text-based — not a differentiation. Conflating the two is precisely what produced the submission's مدمج-with-التاريخ at G7.

WHY G5 AND NOT G4: at G4 the الحديث+السيرة pairing is still doing genuine two-way work — the hadith acquires a speaker, a setting and an occasion; the sirah acquires a reason to be attended to closely. A nine-year-old's chronology is still the two-box timeline of G3 being consolidated. Differentiating at G4 would break a functioning pair to gain nothing.

WHY G5 AND NOT G6 OR G7 — the decisive argument, and it is disciplinary, not administrative: G5 is the year BOTH possible hosts leave, and they leave for the same underlying reason. #21 الحديث becomes مستقل at G5 because its corpus crosses ~25 items and is reorganised THEMATICALLY (الإيمان، الطهارة والصلاة، الأخلاق، المعاملات) — its own specialist writes that this is "an organising logic السيرة cannot supply, since a life is chronological and a corpus is topical." #19 الفقه becomes مستقل at G5 around an explicit normative grid (شروط، أركان، واجبات، سنن، مبطلات) and rejects السيرة as a partner sharing "no cognitive operation, no technical vocabulary, and no assessment logic." Both are right. The moment at which narrative organisation diverges irreconcilably from topical organisation and from normative organisation IS the moment السيرة must stand on its own. To hold differentiation back to G7 would leave the discipline homeless for two full years — parked in a block whose organising principle actively destroys its method — and a curriculum that does that has not designed the subject, it has mislaid it.

WHY THIS IS AFFORDABLE AT G5 AND NOT MERELY DESIRABLE: differentiation here costs ONE period, because مستقل does not entail an Arabic matn. السيرة is the only discipline in Programme 3 that can carry a full independent identity in the language of instruction — its medium is narrative, not a technical register. The reading-capacity argument (correct in itself) gates the Arabic TEXT at G7; it does not gate independence. The G5 timetable has roughly six free periods on any honest reconstruction. G6, by contrast, has one, and G7 is over the ceiling — so deferring differentiation to the loaded years would also have been the more expensive choice.

WHY THE SECOND DIFFERENTIATION IS G11 AND NOT G12: فقه السيرة requires moral complexity (available by G10–G11), a completed narrative (G8), source awareness (G9) and مصطلح's apparatus (G10). G12 is taken by the capstone; placing the analytic pass there means it is done badly or abandoned. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]
prerequisites: Oral narrative comprehension in the language of instruction (Yoruba/English). Established: G1. Note deliberately that this is NOT an Arabic prerequisite — السيرة is the one Islamic-studies discipline that can begin at full value before any Arabic exists, which is why it starts at G1 and why its independence at G5 does not wait on a matn.

Knowledge that محمد ﷺ is رسول الله as a doctrinal commitment rather than a fact about a stranger. Established: G1, inside التوحيد العملي — which is why التوحيد العملي is the correct G1–G2 host and الفقه التطبيقي is not.

The habit of الصلاة والسلام عليه on hearing his name. Established: G1–G2. #21 الحديث names this as its own single precondition for starting at G3, so this subject establishes it for two disciplines at zero cost.

Temporal ordering across more than two events (before / after / then / because). Established: G3 via the two-box timeline قبل البعثة / بعد البعثة; secure by G4. This is the gate on the first meaningful appearance.

The capacity to hold a single causal arc across a whole year of teaching — not just to order two events but to explain an ending by a beginning. Available around age 10. Established: G5, and it is the gate on differentiation.
Short hadith matn exposure, so narrative and speech can be paired. Established: G3 (الحديث مضمّن), consolidated G4.
Reading connected Arabic sentences. Established: G5–G6 (المفردات والجمل البسيطة). Necessary but nowhere near sufficient for an Arabic sirah text.

النحو adequate to parse narrative prose — strings of الفعل الماضي, الفاعل, الظرف, particles of sequence and of time. Established: الآجرومية completed G6 → ملحة الإعراب G7 [redline 3]. This is the specific gate on the G7 MEDIUM CHANGE, not on differentiation.

الصرف sufficient to see through the derived forms that saturate sirah narration (استقبل، انصرف، اجتمعت، تحالفوا، استُشهد). Established: البناء في الصرف G6 → لامية الأفعال G7 [redline 3]. Operative at G7–G8.

Conscious awareness of the المكي/المدني distinction in the Qur'an as a distinction, not merely as exposure. Established: التفسير G6–G7. The ring-fenced حفظ hour supplies twelve years of exposure from G1; exposure is not the distinction.

Map-reading and relative location. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] — this may already be delivered by the morning national curriculum's social studies. I have costed السيرة as building it itself at G7 in 2–3 lessons, to be safe. If the morning programme delivers it, those lessons are recoverable.

Moral capacity to hold conflict, treaty and warfare material without either glorifying it or being frightened by it. Narrative treatment: G6. Ethical/analytic treatment: G11. This gap is deliberate and is the reason the مغازي are narrated at G6 and only argued at G11.

Familiarity with the named Companions as persons in time. Established: G2 (names and relationships) → G4–G6 (roles in events) → G8 (as transmitters' subjects). Required before the G9 مصادر unit, which assumes the student knows who is being transmitted from, and required by #22 مصطلح at G10.

Enough security in the student's own religious identity to meet a hostile account of the Prophet without either distress or reflexive aggression. Established: G1–G7 cumulatively through التوحيد والعقيدة. This is the real gate on the G8 sensitive-episode block and on the G11 apologetic segment.

classicalTexts.title: الشمائل المحمدية — أبو عيسى الترمذي
classicalTexts.grade: G8 (أبواب مختارة: خلقه، صفته، أخلاقه، عبادته)
classicalTexts.justification: The first genuine matn this subject should own. Its chapters are short, self-contained and concrete, so a G8 reader completes units rather than drowning in continuous narrative, and it supplies the شمائل dimension that an event-driven sirah leaves out — the Prophet as a person, arriving in the last standing year, just before the subject closes. CONFLICT TO RESOLVE: #21 الحديث also claims this work, for a one-term corrective unit at G11. It must be read once. My proposal: السيرة takes the chapters listed above at G8 as content; if الحديث still wants a G11 unit it takes DIFFERENT أبواب and reads them as a رواية/إسناد exercise on material already known — a different portion for a different purpose. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

classicalTexts.title: نور اليقين في سيرة سيد المرسلين — محمد الخضري بك
classicalTexts.grade: G7 (primary student text), continuing into G8
classicalTexts.justification: Written deliberately as a school sirah text: ordered, accessible Arabic prose with a clear chronological spine. It is pitched almost exactly at a student who has completed الآجرومية and is starting ملحة الإعراب, which is what makes the G7 medium change real rather than aspirational. Modern (early 20th c.), and I say so rather than dressing it as classical.

classicalTexts.title: الرحيق المختوم — صفي الرحمن المباركفوري
classicalTexts.grade: G7–G8, teacher reference and source of the dating and geography apparatus
classicalTexts.justification: Modern (20th c.) — flagged, not disguised. Its value here is organisational: clear dating, clear geography, campaign-by-campaign structure. It is the teacher's scaffold for building G7–G8 lessons and maps, not a matn for students to work through.

classicalTexts.title: زاد المعاد في هدي خير العباد — ابن قيم الجوزية
classicalTexts.grade: G11 (excerpts only, for the فقه السيرة rotation)
classicalTexts.justification: The right text for the analytic pass precisely because it is not a narrative: it reads the Prophet's conduct for its هدي, which is exactly what the G11 rotation is for. Excerpts only — the full work is far beyond a one-term rotation and pretending otherwise would misstate the time available.

classicalTexts.title: السيرة النبوية لابن هشام (تهذيب سيرة ابن إسحاق)
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (object of study in مصادر السيرة); G12 (short passages read in the original)
classicalTexts.justification: At G9 the student does not read it through — he learns what it is, how ابن إسحاق's material reached us through it, and what that implies for any given story. At G12 selected passages serve as an Arabic reading exercise on content already secure, which is the correct terminal use of a hard classical text.

classicalTexts.title: الطبقات الكبرى — ابن سعد
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (named and sampled inside مصادر السيرة)
classicalTexts.justification: Part of the source landscape the G9 unit maps, and the natural bridge from sirah to الصحابة والتابعون as historical persons — which #22 مصطلح needs by G10. Shown, described, one or two entries opened; never assigned.

classicalTexts.title: المغازي — الواقدي
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (named within the source landscape, with the standard reservations about the author as a transmitter stated plainly)
classicalTexts.justification: A source-map that omits it is dishonest. Its inclusion is also the most instructive single item in the unit: that a major early مغازي source is itself contested is exactly the felt problem مصطلح الحديث will resolve a year later.

classicalTexts.title: البداية والنهاية — ابن كثير (the sirah section)
classicalTexts.grade: G9 (named as a later compiling synthesis)
classicalTexts.justification: Teaches the difference between an early compilation and a later synthesis drawing on earlier ones. Also the natural handover point to التاريخ الإسلامي, which will use the same work for the post-وفاة period — one book, two subjects, no duplication.

classicalTexts.title: عيون الأثر في فنون المغازي والشمائل والسير — ابن سيد الناس
classicalTexts.justification: Too demanding for any student slot in this ladder. Listed so the department holds a classical reference of record rather than relying wholly on modern secondary works. Its title also documents the classical pairing of المغازي والشمائل والسير that this design follows.

classicalTexts.title: الدرر في اختصار المغازي والسير — ابن عبد البر
classicalTexts.grade: Teacher reference only, G7–G8 (no student allocation)
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident the work exists and is correctly attributed to ابن عبد البر القرطبي. I have NOT verified a specific edition against a physical copy, so I make no student allocation on it and recommend the department verify before any classroom use. It is listed because a classical مختصر is the right thing for a teacher to have beside نور اليقين.

classicalTexts.title: مختصر سيرة الرسول — محمد بن عبد الوهاب
classicalTexts.grade: Optional alternative/supplement at G7–G8 — NOT recommended by me
classicalTexts.justification: The work exists and is a genuine abridgement usable at this level. I am not recommending it: in the Yoruba-speaking Nigerian context its authorship carries institutional signalling that is a governance question about the school's public orientation, not a pedagogical one. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] if the school wishes to adopt it.

classicalTexts.title: بانت سعاد — قصيدة كعب بن زهير
classicalTexts.grade: G8–G9 IF the النشيد والمحفوظات line wants it — I claim no period for it
classicalTexts.justification: A genuine text from the Prophet's own lifetime, tied to an episode the student meets at G6 and again at G8. Raised only as an option for النشيد (#4); the allocation is not mine to make and I do not claim time for poetry.

classicalTexts.title: قصيدة البردة — البوصيري
classicalTexts.justification: The work certainly exists and is culturally live in this region, so silence about it would be unhelpful to the Board. I am not recommending it: parts of it are contested on عقيدة grounds, and a school whose G5 line includes نواقض الإسلام cannot adopt or refuse it by accident. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] — a governance decision about the school's relation to the local Muslim community, not a sirah-specialist judgement.

classicalTexts.title: الأرجوزة الميئية في ذكر حال أشرف البرية — منسوبة إلى ابن أبي العز الحنفي
classicalTexts.justification: A memorisable versified sirah would be genuinely useful to the النشيد والمحفوظات line at G6–G7, and I raise this because the gap is real. But I am not certain enough of the attribution to build any allocation on it. Verify independently before any use; per the prohibition on shaky attributions I place nothing and propose no substitute.

lifecycles.lifecycleVerdict: continuous — present in some form at all twelve grades, but with a deliberately limited-span مستقل identity (G5–G8 only) and a second, differently-purposed rotation at G11. The single label understates the shape, so state it precisely: the NARRATIVE function completes at the end of G8 and hands off to التاريخ الإسلامي; the subject then survives as an applied and analytic presence (G9 وحدة, G10 مضمّن, G11 دوراني, G12 مضمّن) at near-zero timetable cost. Calling it "limited-span" would wrongly license dropping it from G1–G3 and G9–G12, where it does real work for free and where two other subjects (مصطلح الحديث, الإنشاء والخطابة) depend on it. Calling it simply "continuous" would overstate its claim on periods and invite a standing block it does not need after G8. It is the only subject in the register that voluntarily surrenders a full standing line mid-ladder — and that surrender is what funds التاريخ الإسلامي.
lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks: Four specific failures, none of them generic. (1) المغازي taught to G1–G3. بدر، أحد، بني قريظة or the killing of named opponents told to a six-to-eight-year-old produces either fear or a militarised picture of the Prophet ﷺ — and the live, non-hypothetical risk in a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian setting with religiously mixed neighbourhoods and mixed morning schooling is that the child repeats it out of context to playmates and family. This is the identical failure mode redline 6 identified for نواقض الإسلام, and it applies here with equal force. Hence: no conflict material before G4, none in detail before G6, contested episodes not before G8. (2) The sensitive episodes early. بنو قريظة، حادثة الإفك، تعدد الزوجات وسن عائشة require a historical and ethical frame the student does not possess before G8. Met earlier they produce distress, garbled repetition, or — worst — the habit of not asking the teacher, which permanently relocates the question to the internet. (3) An Arabic sirah text before G7. Putting نور اليقين in front of a G5–G6 student still on المفردات والجمل البسيطة converts the sirah hour into a vocabulary hour: the student decodes, learns no chronology, and the school records a subject that did not happen. This is the single most likely way this allocation fails in practice, and it is why differentiation at G5 is explicitly in the language of instruction. (4) Apologetics before G10–G11. Teaching a ten- or twelve-year-old to "answer attacks on the Prophet" arms him with rehearsed polemic he cannot control, and — the part usually missed — forces him to rehearse the ATTACK in order to learn the answer, planting it before he can weigh it. In a mixed-school environment this converts a curriculum into a playground dispute. The G8 treatment is historical framing of episodes; the G11 segment is explanation to an objector; neither is debate training, and no grade before G10 does either. A fifth, structural: differentiating before G5 (at G3–G4) would give the subject an examination and a slot before the child can hold a year-long arc, producing story-time with a test attached and breaking a hadith pairing that is still productive.
lifecycles.delayRisks: These are the larger risks in this case, and they are equally specific. (1) Downstream starvation of التفسير. If the first narrative pass is not complete by end of G6, the G6–G7 تفسير has no chronological frame for المكي والمدني or أسباب النزول — #5 التفسير names this dependency explicitly — and تفسير degenerates into atomised verse-glossing: the student learns what words mean and never why a passage came when it came. (2) التاريخ الإسلامي cannot start. History must open at the وفاة. If السيرة still holds a standing block at G9–G10, التاريخ starts at G10–G11 and cannot cross from الخلافة الراشدة to the modern period before graduation. Worse, #17 العقيدة states a hard dependency that the timeline must have reached الفتنة and العصر العباسي by end of G9 or its G10 الفرق unit becomes a list of insults; and #13 النقد pegs its literary periodisation to the same line. Delaying السيرة's close therefore breaks three subjects, not one, and leaves a graduate who can narrate eleven years of history and nothing of the following thirteen centuries — a conspicuous failure for a school with international ambitions. (3) مصطلح الحديث arrives unmotivated. If مصادر السيرة is not taught before G10, الإسناد is met as an abstract apparatus answering a question the student has never asked — precisely the error the Board corrected by moving نخبة الفكر out of G6. Delaying the G9 unit reintroduces that error at a different address. (4) The affective window closes and is not left empty. Attachment to the Prophet ﷺ — which is what actually sustains a ring-fenced Qur'an hour across twelve years — is formed by narrative in the early years. Waiting for "readiness" forfeits G1–G3, and the vacuum fills locally with مولد-season embellishment and with hostile accounts from mixed-school peers, both of which the school then spends G8, G9 and G11 undoing. Teaching it at G1 costs zero periods; not teaching it at G1 costs remedial time in three later grades. (5) Two years homeless. Deferring differentiation past G5 — the failure mode of both the submission and the earlier draft — parks the discipline in a block (فقه, or a thematically reorganised حديث) whose organising logic destroys chronology, for exactly the two years the chronology is being built. (6) فقه السيرة pushed to G12 collides with the graduation capstone and is done badly or dropped, and with it goes the only place the ethics of the مغازي are ever addressed.
lifecycles.g12Role: At G12 السيرة holds no dedicated periods and no separate examination paper. Its role is as the content of output: مضمّن inside الإنشاء والخطابة and the graduation project, plus short passages of سيرة ابن هشام read in the original as an Arabic reading exercise on material already known. What the graduate can concretely do because of this subject: (a) narrate the sirah in continuous chronological order in Arabic with the principal dates — البعثة، الهجرة، بدر ٢هـ، أحد ٣هـ، الخندق ٥هـ، الحديبية ٦هـ، فتح مكة ٨هـ، تبوك ٩هـ، حجة الوداع ١٠هـ، الوفاة ١١هـ; (b) take any sūrah or passage from the تفسير course and place it in its Meccan or Medinan phase, and give its سبب نزول where one was taught — the competence that makes حفظ into understanding; (c) name the works the narrative rests on, distinguish an early compilation from a later synthesis, and say why a given popular story is or is not in them; (d) deliver a prepared ten-to-fifteen-minute sirah talk in Arabic, English and Yoruba, with a lesson drawn from the episode that he can defend from the episode — the single most immediately usable competency this subject produces in this community, and the one that makes the graduate useful in a mosque the week after he leaves; (e) meet a popular embellishment or a hostile misrepresentation of the Prophet ﷺ and respond with neither credulity nor reflexive denial, because he knows where the reports come from and what standard applies to them. That last capability is the entire reason the G9 وحدة and the G11 rotation exist, and no other subject in the register produces it: العقيدة argues doctrine, مصطلح grades reports, التاريخ narrates centuries — only السيرة puts a defensible account of this particular life in the graduate's mouth.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the [RECOVERED] ceilings of ~7 periods/week at G1–G2 and ~19 at G3–G12, with the 195-hour Qur'an hour ring-fenced and outside the count. I ask nothing from that hour at any grade.

G1–G2: ZERO dedicated periods. مضمّن inside the existing التوحيد العملي allocation — roughly 10 minutes twice a week within periods already counted. At a 7-period ceiling any dedicated claim here would be indefensible, and none is made.
G3: ZERO dedicated. Inside the التوحيد والفقه block, alongside the الحديث strand; ~10–15 min/week.
G4: ZERO NEW. The submission already funds a 2-period الحديث والسيرة pair; sirah occupies roughly one period-equivalent of it. Net change to the 19: zero.
G5: 1 period — the first genuine claim, 1 of 19. Affordable with room: an honest G5 reconstruction is اللغة العربية 5 + التجويد 1 + التوحيد والعقيدة 2–3 + الفقه 2 + الحديث 1–2 + السيرة 1 = 12–14 of 19, with القراءة والتهجي، النشيد، الإنشاء، الإملاء all sitting inside other allocations. My override also RELIEVES الفقه of a passenger, which is exactly the relief #19 says it needs.
G6: 1 period — and I state plainly that this is the LAST FREE PERIOD in the G6 week. Reconstruction: اللغة العربية 4 + الجزرية 2 + التفسير والترجمة 2 + النحو 2 + الصرف 1 + التوحيد والعقيدة 2–3 + الفقه 2 + الحديث 2 + السيرة 1 = 18–19 of 19. If the Board rules the عقيدة pair at 3, G6 is exactly full and nothing else may be added anywhere. FALLBACK if it will not fit: run G6 السيرة at 1 period for two terms only and move تبوك→الوفاة into the opening of G7. I do not prefer this; I name it so the Board is choosing rather than discovering.
G7: 2 periods — CONTESTED, and I will not pretend otherwise. The aggregate of specialists' asks at G7 exceeds 19 before السيRة is counted. Two honest ways to pay: (i) the التوحيد والعقيدة pair runs at 2 rather than 3 (#18 states 2; #17 asks 3 — the Board must settle this anyway), which releases exactly the period needed; or (ii) السيرة runs 1 standing period plus a 2-period block in one term for the dating-and-geography apparatus, ≈1.3 annualised. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED].
G8: 2 periods — the last standing block this subject ever holds. Partly self-funding: التجويد's matn ladder completes at G7 (#2 drops to ~1.3 at G8 and 0 at G9) and القراءة والتهجي completed at G5, so Programme 1 is releasing time in exactly these years. #5 التفسير claims part of that release for its G8 مستقل status; the Board must split it.
G9: 1 period for ONE TERM only (وحدة مصادر السيرة) ≈ 0.33 annualised. In the same year the 2-period standing line vacated by السيرة passes to التاريخ الإسلامي. Schedule the unit in Term 1 so it precedes #6 أصول التفسير's Term-2 أسباب النزول unit.
G10: ZERO dedicated — مضمّن in التفسير (or أصول التفسير). #22 مصطلح الحديث's G10 affordability is conditional on exactly this contraction.
G11: 2 periods for ONE TERM only (دوراني فقه السيرة) ≈ 0.7 annualised, and in a different term from التجويد's G11 rotation.
G12: ZERO dedicated — مضمّن in الإنشاء والخطابة and the capstone.

TOTAL twelve-year standing claim: four years of standing time (1+1+2+2 = 6 period-years) plus two single terms. Everything else is delivered inside allocations that already exist. The structural point the Board should weigh: from G9 onward this subject gives back more timetable than it takes, and the 2 periods it holds at G7–G8 are the same 2 periods التاريخ الإسلامي inherits from G9 — the line does not grow, it changes owner. That is what makes this allocation real rather than aspirational.
departuresFromSubmission: G5 — REJECT الفقه والسيرة مدمج. الفقه is normative and taxonomic; السيرة is narrative and chronological. They share no cognitive operation, no technical register and no assessment logic. The pairing reduces السيرة to a supplier of proof-texts for أحكام and loses the chronological thread that is its entire method, while giving الفقه a passenger it cannot assess on its own terms. #19 الفقه rejects the same pairing independently from its side, which settles it.

G5 — DIFFERENTIATE. This is my principal departure and it goes beyond the submission and beyond the earlier specialist draft (which placed differentiation at G7). At G5 both possible hosts leave for the same reason — الحديث reorganises topically, الفقه organises normatively — and narrative organisation has nowhere left to live. السيرة becomes مستقل at 1 period in the language of instruction. A discipline must not be parked for two years in a block whose organising principle destroys its method.

G5–G6 — DO NOT re-pair with الحديث. I record this as an explicit departure from the previous draft on this subject, which returned السيرة to الحديث at G5–G6. That is no longer available: #21 الحديث becomes مستقل at G5 with its own book, corpus and examination, and its own specialist gives the disciplinary reason. A مدمج pair requires two willing partners.

G6 — REJECT THE DOUBLE PLACEMENT. The submission puts السيرة inside الفقه والسيرة AND again as مضمّن with التاريخ الإسلامي in the same year. A discipline with two homes has none, which is exactly what redline 9 forbids. Single home at G6: مستقل.

G6–G7 — REJECT THE FUSION WITH التاريخ الإسلامي IN PRINCIPLE, not merely in placement. Blending them permanently causes one of two errors: it historicises the sirah, stripping its normative function as الأسوة الحسنة; or it lends later Islamic history a quasi-scriptural status it does not have. السيرة CLOSES as its own entity at the end of G8; التاريخ الإسلامي opens at G9 from the وفاة. This is the most consequential departure here and it is also what solves the period problem.

G7 — UPGRADE from مدمج مع التاريخ to مستقل, and RENAME the event: G7 is a change of medium (Arabic-medium, text-based, dated) on a subject that is already independent, not the moment of differentiation. The submission's conflation of the two is what produced the fusion with التاريخ.

G1–G3 — ADD a presence the submission omits entirely. The submission's first mention of السيرة is G4, leaving three years of the highest-yield narrative window empty at a point when the subject costs nothing and when one of its by-products (the ṣalawāt habit) is a stated precondition of another subject.

G4 — PROTECT UNCHANGED. الحديث والسيرة مدمج + independently assessed is correct as submitted: right partner, right year, right assessment posture. I add only the requirement that the two strands be scored and reported separately within the paper, which redline 9 already implies.

G8–G12 — DESIGNED FRESH, since the submission stops at G7. The shape after G8 is deliberately cheap (one term at G9, embedded at G10, one term at G11, embedded at G12) because the ثانوية years cannot carry another year-long block once البلاغة، أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، مصطلح، الترجمة and النقد enter, and #22 مصطلح states its own affordability depends on precisely this contraction.

ASSESSMENT — decided separately from form throughout, as required. Independently assessed at G4 while مدمج; independently assessed G5–G9 while variously مستقل and وحدة; embedded at G2–G3 and again at G10 while مضمّن; independently assessed at G11–G12 including at G12 where the form is مضمّن and the instrument is a portfolio rather than a paper. Form and assessment never move together by default here.

G8 — ADD an explicit, Board-approved treatment of the contested episodes (بنو قريظة، حادثة الإفك، تعدد الزوجات وسن عائشة). The submission is silent on them at every grade, which in practice means they are met first from a hostile source. Silence is a decision, and it is the wrong one.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FEEDS التاريخ الإسلامي — the single most important downstream relationship and the one that shapes this whole lifecycle. السيرة supplies the entire chronological and geographical scaffold, then hands over at the وفاة. Boundary rule, to be written into both syllabi: everything up to and including the وفاة belongs to السيرة; everything after belongs to التاريخ; neither crosses. The 2-period line السيرة vacates at G9 is the line التاريخ inherits.

FEEDS التفسير (#5) — أسباب النزول، المكي والمدني، تدرج التشريع are sirah chronology in Qur'anic application. #5 names السيرة as its feeder for exactly this from G4 onward and makes its G7 operational use of المكي/المدني conditional on it. This is why السيرة is مضمّن INSIDE التفسير at G10 rather than simply absent.

FEEDS أصول التفسير (#6) — its G9 أسباب النزول وحدة lists السيرة as an established prerequisite, and its G11 مقدمة ابن تيمية work assumes the Companions as persons in time. Coordination: my G9 مصادر unit should run in Term 1, its أسباب unit in Term 2. If أصول التفسير holds the G10 slot, my G10 embedding moves there.

FEEDS مصطلح الحديث (#22) — the G9 مصادر السيرة unit is engineered as its runway: it gives the student the question (how do we know a report is sound?) one year before مصطلح gives the apparatus. #22 independently lists chronology, الصحابة والتابعون، عصر التدوين and the compilers as its prerequisites, and states that its G10 periods are affordable only if السيرة has contracted by then. Reciprocal obligation: السيرة must NOT pre-empt it — no isnād-criticism terminology, no صحيح/حسن/ضعيف as technical categories, at any grade.

FEEDS العقيدة (#17) — النبوة، دلائل النبوة، صدق الخبر and the recognition of a rasūl are narrated in السيرة and argued in العقيدة. #17 also makes its G10 الفرق unit depend on the historical line reaching الفتنة and العصر العباسي by end of G9 — which is a demand on التاريخ that only becomes satisfiable because السيرة closes at G8. السيرة narrates; العقيدة argues; neither retells the other.
FEEDS التوحيد (#18) — and is fed by it. At G5 السيرة supplies the concrete protective framing redline 6 requires for نواقض الإسلام: the Prophet's own conduct toward those who rejected him.

FEEDS الإنشاء والخطابة (#14) — G7 تلخيص of a sirah passage (#14's own most diagnostic composition task), and at G12 sirah is the content on which the graduate's trilingual دعوة speaking is built. This is the subject's terminal payoff and the reason it does not simply stop at G8. Boundary: #14 assesses composition and delivery; السيرة assesses accuracy, sourcing and defensibility of the lesson drawn.

FEEDS النقد والآداب (#13) — supplies the periodisation frame (جاهلي / صدر الإسلام) that #13 pegs to and undertakes never to re-teach. Boundary stated by #13 and accepted here: خطبة حجة الوداع and prophetic speech belong to السيرة والحديث; #13 takes خطابة جاهلية وأموية. #14 analyses خطبة الوداع structurally at G10 — one text, three angles, taught once.
FED BY التوحيد العملي — the G1–G2 host and the doctrinal reason the subject exists at G1 at all (شهادة أن محمدًا رسول الله).

FED BY الحديث (#21) — the G3 host and the G4 partner, and the supplier of the texts whose occasions السيرة narrates. After G4 the relationship inverts: السيرة supplies the setting, الحديث owns the corpus.

FED BY اللغة العربية والنحو والصرف (#7, #8, #9) — الآجرومية (G6) → ملحة الإعراب (G7), البناء في الصرف (G6) → لامية الأفعال (G7) are the specific gate on the G7 medium change. Without them the Arabic text is a decoding exercise.

FED BY حفظ القرآن — twelve years of ring-fenced memorisation put سور الأنفال، آل عمران، الأحزاب، الفتح، التوبة in the student's mouth before he knows the events behind them. السيرة supplies the events; the Qur'an supplies the text. This exchange costs no periods and is the clearest case of the constitutional hour paying into Programme 3.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE الفقه — السيرة narrates the Prophet's practice; it does not adjudicate أحكام, carries no مسائل خلافية, and derives no rulings. This is the substantive reason for rejecting the G5–G6 فقه pairing, not merely a timetable preference.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE الحديث — a hadith used inside a sirah lesson is used for its occasion, not set as a matn for memorisation. The محفوظ list belongs wholly to الحديث; السيرة borrows texts and never sets them. Live case to resolve: الشمائل المحمدية, claimed by both (G8 here, G11 there).
MUST NOT DUPLICATE العقيدة — دلائل النبوة are narrated here and argued there. السيرة must not drift into kalām, and العقيدة must not retell the biography.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE النشيد والمحفوظات (#4) — sirah-adjacent poetry (بانت سعاد, any versified sirah) may be sirah-relevant, but allocation, memorisation and assessment belong to النشيد. السيرة claims no period for poetry.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE الترجمة (#16) — the G12 trilingual sirah talks are assessed for content and delivery by السيرة والخطابة; translation competence as such is الترجمة's to assess. At G6 الترجمة takes its content from التفسير العملي per redline 8, not from السيرة.
COORDINATE WITH الدراسات الحديثة (lifecycle not yet determined) — the G11 segment on contemporary misrepresentation is sirah in content but modern in its interlocutor.
openQuestions: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] The whole design hands a 2-period standing line to التاريخ الإسلامي at G9 and assumes التاريخ teaches nothing before then. That subject's lifecycle is NOT YET WRITTEN (subjects 23, 25, 26 are missing from the register). Meanwhile #17 العقيدة states a hard dependency that the historical line must reach الفتنة and العصر العباسي by end of G9 — one year after opening. If the التاريخ specialist judges that impossible, the only remedy is to compress السيرة's Arabic pass into G7 alone and open التاريخ at G8. I have costed my fallback: نور اليقين only at G7 at 2 periods, الشمائل released to الحديث at G11, the G9 مصادر unit retained. What is lost is the year in which the student's picture of the Prophet as a person is completed. The Board should hear both specialists before ruling.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] الشمائل المحمدية is claimed twice — by السيرة at G8 (content: خلقه، صفته، أخلاقه، عبادته) and by #21 الحديث at G11 (a one-term corrective after two years of legal corpus). Both purposes are real. My proposal is different أبواب for different purposes with a written non-duplication protocol; the alternative is to award it wholly to one subject. It must not simply be taught twice by accident.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] The G6–G8 period arithmetic does not close. On any honest reconstruction the aggregate of specialists' asks reaches or exceeds 19 at G6, G7 and G8 before السيرة is counted, and #17 العقيدة (3 periods for the pair) and #18 التوحيد (2) disagree with each other about the same block. My G7 claim of 2 depends on that disagreement being settled at 2. This is a register-wide finding, not a sirah problem, but my allocation is not real until it is resolved.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Ratification of the framing text for the G8 sensitive episodes (بنو قريظة، حادثة الإفك، تعدد الزوجات وسن عائشة عند الزواج), on the same basis the Board ratified protective framing for نواقض الإسلام. I hold they must be taught at G8 — avoidance guarantees the student meets them first from a hostile source — but the framing should be Board-approved written material, not left to the judgement of an individual teacher in the room.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Removing السيرة from the G5–G6 فقه blocks leaves الفقه without the partner the submission gave it. #19 الفقه has already answered from its own side (مستقل at G5, الأخضري at G6) and welcomes the separation, but the Board should record that the two rulings are consistent rather than discovering it later.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] قصيدة البردة للبوصيري and مختصر سيرة الرسول لمحمد بن عبد الوهاب both exist and are both live in this region for opposite institutional reasons. I recommend neither. Both are governance questions about the school's public orientation in a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian context, not sirah-specialist judgements — but the school cannot answer them by silence, because the community will read silence either way.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether the school marks ربيع الأول / مولد season, and if so what the السيرة department's role in it is. The G9 مصادر unit teaches students to check whether a circulating story is attested, which will produce questions about local practice within days of being taught. That is a feature, but it needs an institutional answer prepared in advance.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Whether map-reading and timeline skills are delivered by the morning national curriculum's social studies. I have costed السيرة as building them itself at G7 (2–3 lessons); if the morning programme already delivers them, those lessons are recoverable.
Whether the G11 فقه السيرة rotation carries its own line on the leaving certificate or is reported inside التاريخ or العقيدة. It is independently assessed either way; only the reporting is open.

Whether the G11 segment on answering contemporary misrepresentation is taught by the السيرة teacher alone or jointly with whoever holds الدراسات الحديثة, once that subject's lifecycle is determined. The content is sirah; the interlocutor is modern.

My view, flagged so the omission is deliberate rather than accidental: the parallel الإجازة track (redline 2) should have NO sirah component. الإجازة is a transmission-and-mastery instrument suited to القرآن and to matn-based disciplines; الشمائل المحمدية is the only sirah text in this ladder that could plausibly carry one, and attaching a certification to it would distort a subject whose G8 purpose is acquaintance with a person, not certified transmission.

[UNVERIFIED-adjacent] Two texts I have deliberately NOT allocated pending verification: الدرر في اختصار المغازي والسير لابن عبد البر (I am confident of the work and its author but have verified no edition — teacher reference only, no student use until checked) and الأرجوزة الميئية attributed to ابن أبي العز الحنفي (attribution not confirmed by me; no placement, and I propose no substitute for it).

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance: G6, مضمّن inside السيرة. "Meaningful" for this discipline means the point at which the learner can hold a DATED FRAMEWORK rather than a sequence of stories — i.e. can order events on a hijri counting line, say what came before and after, and place an event in a named region on a map. Narrative capacity (following one protagonist through episodes) arrives much earlier, around G4, and is precisely what السيرة uses; it is NOT history. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Chronological decentring — holding simultaneous actors, dated intervals, and causation across generations — becomes reliable around age 10-11, which is G6 here. Before that, "teaching Islamic history" produces a bag of edifying anecdotes labelled history, which is not a weaker version of the subject but a different and later-obstructive one. A second, independent constraint fixes the same grade: at G6 the Arabic level is المفردات والجمل البسيطة, so G6 history must be teacher-narrated from a controlled-vocabulary reader, not read from continuous Arabic prose — which is exactly why G6 is مضمّن and cannot be مستقل.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and deliberately so. The learner is on الحروف وقليل المفردات; there is no سيرة host, no dated framework, and no Arabic capacity to carry historical prose. Any 'history' at this grade would be isolated anecdote delivered in Yoruba or English. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Absence here is a positive prohibition, not an oversight.

Not taught. Same reasoning as G1. The 7-period ceiling at G1-G2 is fully consumed by حفظ, القراءة والتهجي, التجويد العملي, الحروف والمفردات, التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي; history has no claim against any of these.
Not taught. الحديث enters مضمّن this year and السيرة has not yet begun. History cannot precede the biography it continues. The learner's Arabic is at الكلمات level.

Not taught. السيرة begins this year (الحديث والسيرة مدمج). ALL available narrative capacity and narrative time is committed to the Prophetic biography, which is the higher-priority formation. Introducing caliphal or dynastic material here would dilute السيرة at the exact moment السيرة needs undivided narrative attention.

Not taught as a distinct entity. The hinge event — وفاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وبيعة أبي بكر — is deposited this year inside السيرة (الفقه والسيرة مدمج) and is taught AS سيرة: the end of one life, not the beginning of a state. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] It is tagged in the سيرة scheme of work as a 'carry-forward' to be recalled at G6, so G6 opens on known ground rather than cold.

gradeByGrade.partner: السيرة النبوية (within the السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي pairing)
gradeByGrade.text: no student matn; teacher sources: البداية والنهاية لابن كثير
gradeByGrade.content: دولة الخلافة الراشدة as a bounded, dated period. الخلفاء الأربعة in order; أبو بكر: حروب الردة، جمع القرآن؛ عمر: الفتوح، تمصير الأمصار (البصرة، الكوفة، الفسطاط)، وضع التقويم الهجري؛ عثمان: توحيد المصاحف؛ علي: انتقال مركز الخلافة إلى الكوفة. Two new instruments are introduced and are the real content of the year: (1) الخط الزمني الهجري — a hijri counting line the learner physically builds and places events on; (2) a wall map of الجزيرة، الشام، العراق، مصر، فارس with events pinned to places. Taught by teacher narration plus a controlled-vocabulary Arabic reader — NOT from continuous Arabic prose, which the G6 Arabic level (المفردات والجمل البسيطة) cannot carry. EXPLICITLY NOT TAUGHT AT G6: any adjudication of الفتنة. مقتل عثمان is stated as an event committed by rebels; there is no companion-versus-companion analysis. Assessment is ordering, dating and map-labelling plus factual recall — never evaluative judgement on the Companions.

gradeByGrade.partner: السيرة النبوية (final year of the pairing; السيرة's share is completion and revision only)
gradeByGrade.text: no student matn; teacher sources: البداية والنهاية، تاريخ الأمم الإسلامية: الدولة الأموية للخضري
gradeByGrade.content: Two blocks. (1) الفتنة taught under an explicit doctrinal restraint protocol — منهج الكف عما شجر بين الصحابة, taught as a stated commitment anchored in the عقيدة line (which is running مدمج this year), not as evasion: the learner is taught the events occurred, that the Companions involved were interpreting, that we withhold verdict, and WHY that withholding is itself a doctrinal position. (2) الدولة الأموية: معاوية وتأسيس الدولة، عبد الملك بن مروان وتعريب الدواوين وسك العملة، عمر بن عبد العزيز، اتساع الفتوح إلى الأندلس وما وراء النهر والسند، أسباب سقوط الدولة. Map extends to الأندلس، المغرب، ما وراء النهر. [CURRENT COUNCIL DIRECTION] retained as مدمج, but the content is NOT 'more سيرة' — سيرة's subject matter has ended and this is the last year the tether serves any purpose.

gradeByGrade.text: تاريخ الأمم الإسلامية: الدولة العباسية للخضري (graded Arabic narrative); teacher reference: الطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد
gradeByGrade.content: POINT OF DIFFERENTIATION. Two interlocked strands. (1) العصر العباسي الأول: قيام الدولة، بناء بغداد، هارون الرشيد، المأمون وبيت الحكمة وحركة الترجمة. (2) — and this is the strand that justifies independence — نشأة العلوم الإسلامية: تدوين الحديث (أمر عمر بن عبد العزيز، ودور ابن شهاب الزهري)؛ نشأة المذاهب الفقهية الأربعة with dates, teachers and cities (أبو حنيفة/الكوفة، مالك/المدينة، الشافعي، أحمد/بغداد)؛ نشأة النحو (أبو الأسود الدؤلي، الخليل بن أحمد، سيبويه) والمدرستان البصرية والكوفية؛ نشأة علم القراءات والتجويد وتدوينه. Concrete deliverable: the learner builds a personal timeline chart placing EVERY text he is currently studying against its author's lifetime — الآجرومية/ملحة الإعراب, البناء, الجزرية, الأخضري — so that his own syllabus becomes a historical object. This converts the Islamic sciences from arbitrary authority into intelligible human scholarly effort, at the exact grade where he has enough of each science for the genealogy to mean something.

gradeByGrade.text: إحياء السنة وإخماد البدعة لعثمان بن فودي (extracts, as a primary source only); إنفاق الميسور في تاريخ بلاد التكرور لمحمد بلّو (teacher source)
gradeByGrade.content: (1) المحنة وخلق القرآن وموقف الإمام أحمد — the hinge into doctrinal history. (2) نشأة الفرق: الخوارج، المعتزلة، الشيعة — WHEN, WHERE and out of WHAT events only. The refutation of their doctrines belongs to العقيدة and must not be duplicated here; تاريخ says when and where, العقيدة says what is true. (3) تفكك الخلافة والدويلات؛ الأندلس من الفتح إلى ملوك الطوائف؛ المغرب: المرابطون والموحدون. (4) THE AFRICAN STRAND, non-negotiable for this institution: التجارة عبر الصحراء، غانة ومالي وسنغاي، تمبكتو وجامع سنكري وعلماؤها، دخول الإسلام إلى بلاد الهوسا، حركة الشيخ عثمان بن فودي، إلورن ودخول الإسلام إلى أرض اليوربا. Placed at G9 because this is the terminal year of الإعدادية and the last year that reaches every learner before any attrition — every SHRS student must leave with his own community located on the timeline he has built.

gradeByGrade.text: تاريخ الرسل والملوك للطبري (selected passages); الكامل في التاريخ لابن الأثير (reference)
gradeByGrade.content: THE CRITICAL TURN — timed to مصطلح الحديث, which differentiates at G10-G11 with نخبة الفكر. (1) منهج نقد الرواية التاريخية: how the evidentiary standards of التاريخ differ from those of الحديث; الطبري's own declared method of transmitting as received with responsibility resting on the transmitters; why the report-corpus on الفتنة and كربلاء is critically weak and who its principal early transmitters were; how to read a chronicle without either credulity or blanket rejection. This is the year the learner acquires the tools to revisit G7 material as an analyst rather than a recipient. (2) Narrative span, compressible: السلاجقة، الحروب الصليبية، صلاح الدين، الغزو المغولي وسقوط بغداد ٦٥٦هـ، المماليك وعين جالوت، سقوط غرناطة ٨٩٧هـ، قيام الدولة العثمانية وفتح القسطنطينية.

(1) التاريخ الحديث: الدولة العثمانية المتأخرة والتنظيمات؛ الاستعمار الأوروبي للعالم الإسلامي؛ إلغاء الخلافة ١٩٢٤؛ حركات الإصلاح والاستقلال؛ نشأة الدولة القومية في العالم الإسلامي. Nigeria-specific: الاستعمار البريطاني، الحكم غير المباشر وإمارات الشمال، أوضاع المسلمين في الجنوب الغربي، نشأة المؤسسات التعليمية الإسلامية. (2) منهج البحث التاريخي: distinguishing primary from secondary sources, referencing conventions, weighing conflicting accounts. Deliverable: a documented research paper in Arabic (~2000 words) on a bounded historical question, drafted and submitted this year.

gradeByGrade.text: مقدمة ابن خلدون — مختارات
gradeByGrade.content: A bounded terminal unit, not a full-year subject — a deliberate de-escalation to protect G12 for the terminal sciences (أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، البلاغة، إكمال المصطلح). Three components: (1) مختارات من مقدمة ابن خلدون — العصبية، أطوار الدولة الخمسة، أثر العمران والحضارة في نشأة العلوم. This is the one historical work the graduate should actually have READ from, and it converts twelve years of narrative into an analytical instrument. (2) Oral defence of the G11 research paper before a panel. (3) A synthesis seminar in which the learner traces a single line — a science, a text, or his own community's Islam — from its origin to the present across the whole timeline he has built since G6.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G8 — it becomes مستقل there, with its own progression, own periods and no host. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

Note the distinction: it is NAMED at G6 (in the label "السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي") but is not yet a distinct entity. Differentiation means having no host left and having its own reason to exist.

WHY NOT G7 (one year earlier): two things are still true at G7 that are false at G8. (a) السيرة still has live subject matter — الفتنة is the direct continuation of the Companions' story, so تاريخ still has a legitimate and pedagogically useful host. (b) The strand that justifies independence — نشأة العلوم الإسلامية — has nothing to attach to at G7: the learner has one year of formal النحو (ملحة الإعراب), no فقه مذهبي, and no مصطلح. Telling a G7 learner about البصريين والكوفيين is telling him about a dispute over a subject he barely has. At G8 he has enough of each science for its genealogy to land.

WHY NOT G9 (one year later): (a) السيرة's subject matter ends at 11 AH; keeping the "السيرة والتاريخ" label past G7 is a fiction under which سيرة revision reliably eats تاريخ's time, because revision of known material is always easier to teach than new chronology. (b) G9 is the terminal year of الإعدادية and carries the West African strand, which cannot be compressed. Differentiating at G9 would force الأموي, العباسي, نشأة العلوم, الفرق, الأندلس and غرب إفريقيا into a single year — guaranteeing either superficiality or the loss of the African strand, which is the one part that cannot be lost. (c) G8 differentiation buys a genuine two-year مستقل run within الإعدادية rather than a one-year token.
prerequisites: السيرة النبوية through وفاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وبيعة أبي بكر — established G4-G5 (الحديث والسيرة مدمج G4; الفقه والسيرة مدمج G5). Without the biography closed, the caliphate has no starting point and G6 opens on nothing.

Arabic reading at المفردات والجمل البسيطة with teacher-mediated narrative comprehension — established G5-G6. This is the ceiling that forces G6 to be مضمّن with a controlled-vocabulary reader. Continuous Arabic historical prose is only sustainable from G8, which is a second reason differentiation lands at G8 and not before.

Chronological sequencing: ordering dated events, counting intervals, distinguishing التقويم الهجري from الميلادي. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Number-line competence itself is an EXTERNAL dependency on the morning national curriculum (maths, outside this scope) and is reliably present by G5-G6; the hijri-specific application is established BY this subject at G6, not assumed.

Basic geographical literacy of الجزيرة، الشام، العراق، مصر، فارس، خراسان، المغرب، الأندلس. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] NO subject in the 26-subject register establishes this, and the morning geography curriculum cannot be assumed to cover the 7th-century Near East. التاريخ الإسلامي must carry its own map work at G6-G7 as part of its own content — this is costed into its G6-G7 share and is not free.

عقيدة sufficient to hold منهج الكف عما شجر بين الصحابة as a doctrinal commitment rather than a dodge — established G5-G7 (التوحيد والعقيدة مدمج G5-G6, العقيدة مدمج G7). This is the specific prerequisite that fixes الفتنة at G7 and not earlier.

The ability to distinguish رواية from حكم, and to ask who transmitted a report and by what standard — established by مصطلح الحديث at G10-G11 (accepted redline 1, نخبة الفكر). This is the prerequisite that fixes the critical turn at G10. History cannot become critical before the learner owns the critical apparatus, and this curriculum places that apparatus at G10.

Arabic prose composition adequate for a referenced essay — depends on الإنشاء والخطابة, whose grade placement is not yet determined. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] If الإنشاء والخطابة is not established by G10, the G11 research paper must be scaled down to a structured source-analysis exercise rather than a continuous essay.

classicalTexts.title: مقدمة ابن خلدون — عبد الرحمن بن خلدون (ت ٨٠٨هـ)
classicalTexts.justification: The single most important text for this subject and the only one the graduate should actually have READ from rather than heard about. Selected chapters only: العصبية، أطوار الدولة، أثر العمران في نشأة العلوم. It is a theory of history, not a chronicle, which is exactly what a terminal وحدة needs — it converts twelve years of accumulated narrative into an analytical instrument the graduate can apply to any polity, including his own. Placed at G12 because it requires both the full narrative base (G6-G11) and abstract reasoning maturity; placed nowhere earlier for the same reason.

classicalTexts.title: تاريخ الرسل والملوك (تاريخ الطبري) — أبو جعفر محمد بن جرير الطبري (ت ٣١٠هـ)
classicalTexts.grade: G10-G11 (selected passages); teacher source from G8
classicalTexts.justification: Never a student reader — it is enormous and its reports are uncritically compiled by design. Used at G10 as the CASE STUDY for منهج نقد الرواية التاريخية: al-Ṭabarī's own stated method of transmitting reports as he received them, with responsibility resting on the transmitters, is the cleanest possible entry into why historical reports and hadith are held to different standards. Its الفتنة material is the worked example.

classicalTexts.title: البداية والنهاية — ابن كثير (ت ٧٧٤هـ)
classicalTexts.grade: teacher source G6-G9; selected student passages G10-G11
classicalTexts.justification: The most usable single teacher reference across the whole G6-G11 span because it is comparatively critical in its handling of reports and its Arabic is more accessible than al-Ṭabarī's. Not a student text below G10 — length and register both rule that out.

classicalTexts.title: الكامل في التاريخ — ابن الأثير (ت ٦٣٠هـ)
classicalTexts.justification: Reference for the Crusades, Seljuk and Mongol sections specifically, where it is a near-contemporary witness. Consultation only, not a set text.

classicalTexts.title: الطبقات الكبرى — ابن سعد (ت ٢٣٠هـ)
classicalTexts.justification: Teacher reference for the biographical layer of نشأة العلوم at G8 — generations, cities and teacher-chains of the early scholars. Its value here is structural (it IS a طبقات work, which models how the learner should organise the G8 timeline chart), not as reading.

classicalTexts.title: تاريخ الأمم الإسلامية: الدولة الأموية / الدولة العباسية — محمد الخضري بك
classicalTexts.grade: G7 (Umayyad volume, teacher source) and G8 (Abbasid volume, graded student narrative)
classicalTexts.justification: Modern, not classical, and included precisely for that reason: it is the closest widely-available thing to a school-level continuous Arabic historical narrative, pitched between the chronicles and a textbook. The G8 volume is the first point a student reads continuous Arabic history rather than being narrated to. Caveat: printings and exact volume titling vary between editions; the council should fix one edition for the school.

classicalTexts.title: إحياء السنة وإخماد البدعة — الشيخ عثمان بن فودي (ت ١٢٣٢هـ/١٨١٧م)
classicalTexts.justification: Used as a PRIMARY SOURCE DOCUMENT for the West African reform movement, not as a history syllabus — it is a work of فقه and إصلاح, and misusing it as a history text would both distort it and duplicate الفقه. Two or three extracts, read as evidence of what the movement was arguing for.

classicalTexts.title: إنفاق الميسور في تاريخ بلاد التكرور — محمد بلّو بن عثمان بن فودي
classicalTexts.justification: A near-contemporary indigenous historical account of the Sokoto movement and its context — valuable because it lets the African strand be taught from a West African Muslim source rather than only from European colonial-era scholarship. Caveat: availability of a clean, usable school edition in Nigeria needs checking before it is written into the scheme of work.

classicalTexts.title: [NO CLASSICAL MATN FOR MEMORISATION]
classicalTexts.justification: An honest and load-bearing negative finding, stated because this curriculum is matn-driven and the board may expect one. I am NOT aware of a standard classical منظومة or متن in التاريخ الإسلامي holding the pedagogical status that الآجرومية holds in النحو or الجزرية in التجويد, and I will not invent or approximate one. History in this curriculum is taught from compiled sources, maps, timelines and modern graded narratives — and its assessment must be built for that, not retrofitted onto a memorisation model.

classicalTexts.title: [Yorubaland and Nigeria-specific historical materials]
classicalTexts.justification: There is no text on the entry and development of Islam in Yorubaland that I can name with the confidence this board requires. I will not guess a title or an author. This material must be commissioned or locally sourced and put through scholarly review before use. Marking it here rather than filling the gap with a plausible-sounding title is deliberate.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Four specific failures, not generic ones.

1. SECTARIAN FORMATION, and it is irreversible. If الفتنة — صفين، الجمل، مقتل عثمان، كربلاء — reaches a learner before he has the عقيدة grounding to hold منهج الكف as a principled position, he will not suspend judgement; children do not suspend judgement, they take sides. A partisan identity formed at nine is extremely durable and the school will spend years failing to dislodge it. This is not hypothetical in a Nigerian context where an organised Shia presence and active sectarian polemic exist. The whole G6/G7 split — Rāshidūn narrative at G6 with the Fitna explicitly excluded, Fitna at G7 under a stated protocol — exists to manage exactly this.

2. THE BAG-OF-STORIES PATHOLOGY. Teaching "history" at G3-G5 means teaching disconnected moral anecdotes about caliphs, because that is all the learner can hold. The damage is not that little is learned — it is that the learner then knows what "Islamic history" IS, and real chronological history at G6-G8 arrives as a demotion: harder, drier, and apparently the same subject. Recovering a subject from a false early definition is substantially harder than teaching it late.

3. IT CANNIBALISES السيرة AT THE EXACT WRONG MOMENT. G4-G6 is when the Prophetic biography must have undivided narrative time. Any caliphal or dynastic content inserted at G4-G5 comes out of سيرة's hours, and سيرة is the higher-priority formation. The submission is RIGHT to leave G1-G5 empty and I am protecting that, not merely tolerating it.

4. LANGUAGE REGRESSION. At G4-G5 the Arabic level (المفردات، الجمل القصيرة) cannot carry historical prose. Teaching history there means teaching it in Yoruba or English by default. The subject then has to be re-established in Arabic later, and the learner carries an English/Yoruba conceptual vocabulary for a subject whose sources are all Arabic — a cost paid at G10 when he meets الطبري.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Four specific failures if differentiation slips past G8 or the African strand slips past G9.

1. THE SCIENCES BECOME ARBITRARY AUTHORITY. If the learner studies الآجرومية then ملحة الإعراب, البناء then لامية الأفعال, الأخضري, الجزرية, and eventually نخبة الفكر — for six or seven years — without ever being told who wrote these, when, where, in response to what, and what came before them, the Islamic sciences present themselves as a fixed inheritance handed down from nowhere. That produces a specific and well-known brittleness: a graduate who cannot distinguish the science from its textbook, cannot tolerate the discovery that scholars disagreed, and is destabilised the first time he meets a critical account of his own tradition. G8 is the earliest grade at which he has enough of each science for the genealogy to be meaningful, and every year past G8 is a year of accumulating that deficit.

2. THE STREET GETS THERE FIRST ON الفتنة. By 13-14, in a connected environment, the learner WILL encounter Sunni-Shia polemic — on social media, from peers, from preachers. The school's only real advantage is priority: the first coherent account a learner receives is the one subsequent accounts are measured against. Delaying past G7 forfeits that advantage and converts the school's teaching from formation into correction.

3. THE IDENTITY COST IS THE SHARPEST ONE HERE. A Yoruba Muslim learner with no account of how Islam reached his own land is defenceless against the live Nigerian claim that Islam is a foreign Arab imposition on Yoruba people, and equally defenceless against the inverse error of treating West African Islam as a derivative periphery. The African strand must land at G9 because G9 is the last year that reaches EVERY learner before any attrition, and because it must arrive before a competing narrative of his own identity has consolidated. Pushing it to G10-G11 means it reaches fewer learners, later, and against resistance.

4. THE CRITICAL TURN CANNOT BE DELAYED PAST G10 WITHOUT WASTING مصطلح الحديث. مصطلح differentiates at G10-G11. If history's critical strand does not run alongside it, the learner acquires isnād criticism as a technical apparatus with exactly one application (hadith) and never learns that evidentiary standards are a general intellectual habit. The two subjects are worth substantially more running together than staggered.
lifecycles.g12Role:
At G12 the subject is a bounded وحدة, not a full-year course — deliberately de-escalated so that the terminal sciences (أصول الفقه، أصول التفسير، البلاغة، إكمال مصطلح الحديث) can have G12. Its role is synthesis and theorisation, not further narrative.

The graduate can, concretely:
1. Place any major figure, text or institution of the Islamic sciences on a dated hijri timeline and state what preceded it and what produced it — including every matn he himself studied.
2. Read a historical report and ask who transmitted it, through whom, and by what standard it was preserved — and articulate precisely why the evidentiary standards of التاريخ differ from those of الحديث, rather than either accepting chronicles credulously or dismissing the whole corpus.
3. Narrate the entry and development of Islam in West Africa and in Yorubaland, name its scholars and institutions, and situate his own community within the global arc rather than outside it.
4. Give a restrained, doctrinally grounded account of الفتنة that neither adjudicates between Companions nor evades the fact that it happened — and explain why the restraint is a position, not an absence of one.
5. Apply Ibn Khaldūn's categories — عصبية، أطوار الدولة، the relation of عمران to the flourishing of the sciences — to analyse the rise and decline of a polity, including a modern one.
6. Produce and orally defend a referenced historical essay in Arabic, using primary and secondary sources and weighing conflicting accounts.

Capability 6 is the one that carries the school's international ambitions: it is a transferable research competence recognisable to any external examiner, produced in Arabic.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the 19-period ceiling (7 at G1-G2). [RECOVERED ceiling respected throughout.]

G1-G5: 0 periods. No claim whatsoever.
G6: 0 NEW periods. مضمّن — the السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي pairing needs 2 periods/week, of which التاريخ takes roughly one third, concentrated in terms 2-3. Net new cost against the ceiling: zero, since the submission already funds a سيرة line at G6.
G7: 0 NEW periods. مدمج — the pairing keeps 2 periods/week; التاريخ now takes roughly half, since سيرة's share is completion and revision only.
G8: 2 periods/week. FIRM. This is the differentiation year and the نشأة العلوم strand is the whole justification; it cannot be done in one period.
G9: 2 periods/week. FIRM. Carries المحنة، الفرق، الأندلس والمغرب AND the West African strand. Cutting to 1 means the African strand is what gets dropped, and that is unacceptable.
G10: 2 periods/week requested. FALLBACK if the board cannot fund it against أصول الفقه، البلاغة، أصول التفسير، المنطق: 1 period/week + دوراني concentration in one term. If that fallback is taken, what is sacrificed is the exhaustive dynastic narrative (Seljuk and Mamluk detail compresses to a mapped chronology). What is PROTECTED and not negotiable is منهج نقد الرواية التاريخية.
G11: 2 periods/week requested; same fallback structure. Protected core: the modern period through 1924 and colonisation, plus the research paper. Sacrificial: breadth of regional coverage.
G12: ~2 periods/week for one or two terms only — approximately 1 period/week annualised. وحدة form.

Peak draw on the ceiling is 2 of 19 (about 10.5%), at G8-G11 only. Total across the twelve years this subject asks for roughly 9 period-equivalents out of a possible 12 × 19. That is a deliberately modest claim and I would rather hold it than win a larger allocation that has to be defended every year against the terminal sciences.

[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] If the board wants an externally examinable full-year history course at G12 for international recognition, that requires +2 periods at G12 taken from a named subject. I am not requesting it, but I am naming the tradeoff rather than leaving it implicit.
relationshipToOtherSubjects: السيرة النبوية — FEEDS IT, then hands over. سيرة is تاريخ's host at G6-G7 and its indispensable precondition. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: تاريخ never re-teaches the غزوات or the Meccan/Medinan periods. The handover is clean and dated: سيرة's subject matter ends at 11 AH, and from G8 the tether is cut. Keeping a 'السيرة والتاريخ' label past G7 would be a fiction under which سيرة revision quietly consumes تاريخ's hours.

مصطلح الحديث — TWO-WAY, and the most important relationship in the upper school. مصطلح (G10-G11, نخبة الفكر, accepted redline 1) FEEDS تاريخ the critical apparatus that makes the G10 turn possible. تاريخ FEEDS مصطلح the historical context of التدوين, the الطبقات, and the البلدان of the narrators — without which مصطلح is abstract machinery. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: تاريخ does not teach أقسام الحديث or the grading terminology; it teaches what happened, and borrows the terminology.

العقيدة / التوحيد — SHARPEST DUPLICATION RISK, and the boundary must be stated in both schemes of work. تاريخ supplies المحنة وخلق القرآن (G9) and نشأة الفرق: الخوارج، المعتزلة، الشيعة (G9) — strictly WHEN, WHERE, and out of WHAT EVENTS. The doctrinal refutation of those groups is العقيدة's and only العقيدة's. The rule: تاريخ says when and where; العقيدة says what is true. Conversely العقيدة FEEDS تاريخ the منهج الكف عما شجر بين الصحابة that makes G7 teachable at all.

علوم القرآن والتفسير — FEEDS AND IS FED. تاريخ narrates جمع القرآن في عهد أبي بكر وتوحيد المصاحف في عهد عثمان (G6) as EVENTS with dates, actors and places. علوم القرآن analyses the resulting مصحف — رسم، قراءات، أسباب النزول. Clean division, but it must be written down or both will teach the same story twice.

الفقه وأصول الفقه — تاريخ's single biggest gift, at G8: نشأة المذاهب الأربعة with dates, teachers, cities and the conditions that produced them. This converts 'our madhhab' from inherited loyalty into intelligible scholarly development, and it is the historical precondition for أصول الفقه making sense whenever that subject is placed. MUST NOT DUPLICATE: تاريخ does not teach any مسألة فقهية or any أصولي rule.

النحو والصرف — تاريخ supplies نشأة النحو (أبو الأسود، الخليل، سيبويه) والخلاف بين البصريين والوكوفيين at G8, at the point the learner has moved from الآجرومية to ملحة الإعراب and can feel that grammar was made by people. One-directional: النحو gives تاريخ nothing but the Arabic capacity to read its sources.

النقد والآداب — SHARED PERIODISATION, HIGH DUPLICATION RISK. Both subjects use العصر الأموي and العصر العباسي as organising frames.
