Boundary: تاريخ owns the political, institutional and scholarly frame; الأدب owns the texts and their criticism. تاريخ does not do literary analysis; الأدب does not do dynastic narrative.

الدراسات الحديثة — THE G11 BOUNDARY, and it needs a ruling. Proposed line: تاريخ الإسلامي runs to the establishment of the modern state system (1924 and decolonisation) and stops. الدراسات الحديثة takes contemporary issues from there. Without this line drawn explicitly, G11 will be taught twice.

الترجمة — LIGHT, OPPORTUNISTIC. From G6, historical terminology (الخلافة، الفتوح، التدوين، الأمصار) rendered into English and Yoruba is natural material for the الترجمة line begun at G6 (accepted redline 8). Not a structural dependency; do not let it become one.

الإنشاء والخطابة — FEEDS تاريخ at G11. The documented research paper depends on Arabic prose composition being established. If الإنشاء والخطابة is not in place by G10, the G11 deliverable must be rescaled (see prerequisites).

التربية الإسلامية — تاريخ supplies exemplars but is NOT moral exhortation. If تاريخ drifts into homily it has become التربية الإسلامية with dates attached, and the discipline is lost. The G6 assessment design (ordering, dating, mapping, recall — never evaluative judgement) is the structural guard against this drift.
حفظ القرآن — no interaction. تاريخ makes no claim on the ring-fenced Qur'an hour at any grade.
departuresFromSubmission: BREAKING THE سيرة TETHER AT G8. The submission pairs تاريخ with السيرة at G6 and G7 and stops designing. Left as an open-ended pairing it would continue by default. I am ending it at G7 and making تاريخ مستقل from G8. Reason: سيرة's subject matter ends at 11 AH. After the Rāshidūn there is no سيرة to integrate with, and a pairing with an exhausted partner is a mechanism by which revision of familiar material displaces new chronology every single year.

RULING OUT G1-G5 EXPLICITLY, NOT MERELY LEAVING IT BLANK. The submission is silent on G1-G5. I am converting that silence into a reasoned prohibition with stated grounds, so that it is not later 'corrected' by a well-meaning addition of caliph-stories at G4. On this point the submission is RIGHT and I am protecting it.

سيرة IS DOUBLE-BOOKED AT G6 IN THE SUBMISSION — it appears both in 'الفقه والسيرة مدمج' and in 'السيرة والتاريخ الإسلامي مضمّن'. This is an internal inconsistency that directly affects my subject. Recommendation: سيرة's G6 curricular home is the السيرة والتاريخ pairing; الفقه at G6 carries متن الأخضري alone and does not also carry سيرة. If the board rules the other way, تاريخ at G6 loses its host and I would have to request a دوراني slot instead.

SPECIFYING THE G6 DELIVERY MODE, which the submission does not. G6 history must be teacher-narrated from a controlled-vocabulary Arabic reader, NOT read from continuous prose, because the G6 Arabic level is المفردات والجمل البسيطة. If this is not written into the scheme of work, G6 history will silently be taught in Yoruba or English.

FIXING WHAT G7 IS. The submission says only 'مدمج with السيرة'. I am specifying that G7 is الفتنة under an explicit doctrinal restraint protocol plus الدولة الأموية — NOT additional سيرة. Without this, G7 becomes a revision year and the Umayyad period is never taught.

EXCLUDING الفتنة FROM G6 EXPLICITLY. The Rāshidūn period as normally taught includes مقتل عثمان and its aftermath. I am cutting the G6 treatment at the event and holding all analysis to G7, and I am making that a stated exclusion in the G6 scheme of work rather than leaving it to individual teachers.

DE-ESCALATING G12 TO وحدة. The obvious default for an undesigned G12 is to continue مستقل. I am declining that. History's narrative function is complete by G11; G12 belongs to the terminal sciences. A bounded ابن خلدون unit plus the research defence is a real terminal form, not a token one, and it costs the ceiling roughly one period rather than two.

NAMING A PREREQUISITE NO SUBJECT OWNS. Geographical literacy of the 7th-century Near East is assumed by every history syllabus and established by none of the 26 subjects. I am absorbing it into تاريخ's own G6-G7 content and costing it, rather than assuming the morning curriculum covers it.

REFUSING TO NAME A MATN. The curriculum is matn-driven and a submission for this subject would normally be expected to produce one. There is no classical منظومة in التاريخ الإسلامي of comparable pedagogical standing, and I will not supply a plausible-sounding substitute. The assessment model for this subject must be built for timelines, maps, source-handling and essays — not retrofitted onto memorisation.
openQuestions: Who owns the 7th-century map work — التاريخ الإسلامي, or can the morning national geography curriculum be relied on? I have costed it into تاريخ at G6-G7. If the morning curriculum can carry it, تاريخ's G6-G7 share shrinks and السيرة gains.
G6 سيرة double-booking: is سيرة's home at G6 the 'الفقه والسيرة' pairing or the 'السيرة والتاريخ' pairing? It cannot be both. My subject's G6 existence depends on the answer.

G10-G11 period funding: 2+2, or the 1+دوراني fallback? This is a real competition against أصول الفقه، البلاغة، أصول التفسير and المنطق وعلم الكلام, none of whose placements are yet fixed. I have named what I would sacrifice under the fallback and what I would not.

Is كربلاء taught at G7 within the restraint protocol, or held to G10 where the source-critical apparatus exists? I lean G7 — the street will reach the learner before G10 in a Nigerian context with an organised Shia presence — but the pastoral risk is real and this is properly a council ruling, not a specialist's.
The G11 boundary with الدراسات الحديثة. I propose التاريخ الإسلامي stops at 1924 and decolonisation. Until that is ruled on, both subjects will plan the same content.

G9 Yorubaland and Nigeria materials: there is NO text I can name with confidence. This must be commissioned or locally sourced and scholarly-reviewed before it enters the scheme of work. I have deliberately left the slot empty rather than fill it with a plausible title.

Language of instruction for the G9 West African strand. Arabic primary sources exist (إنفاق الميسور، إحياء السنة), but usable secondary material on Yorubaland is likely to be English. If part of G9 runs in English, that must be a decided policy, not an accident.

Whether G12 history should be externally examinable for international recognition. That would require +2 periods at G12 taken from a named subject. I am not requesting it; the board should decide whether the international ambition requires it.
Placement of الإنشاء والخطابة. The G11 research paper depends on it being established by G10. If it lands later, the G11 deliverable must be rescaled.

Teacher capacity. This subject requires a teacher who can handle الفتنة under restraint at G7, source criticism at G10, and West African Islamic history at G9. That is an unusual combination and may be the binding constraint rather than the timetable. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] on whether such a teacher exists or must be developed.

lifecycles.firstMeaningfulAppearance:
G8 — مضمّن inside الفقه, and the gap between "first mention" and "first meaningful appearance" is unusually wide here, so the word has to be defined precisely.

For this discipline, "meaningful" CANNOT mean "the child hears about a modern topic." Children hear about modern topics from G1 — الفقه التطبيقي [#19] teaches wuḍūʾ at a tap and ṣalāh in a school building from G1, and التربية الإسلامية [#25] holds the daily-conduct layer. Contemporary CONTENT is already present in this curriculum, on other subjects' allocations, correctly. Adding a named "contemporary issues" slot to deliver more of it would duplicate two subjects and teach nothing new.

"Meaningful" for الدراسات الحديثة means the first point at which a lesson yields a TRANSFERABLE ANALYTIC MOVE rather than a transferable opinion. This subject has no content of its own — no matn, no ʿilm, no independent method. Its entire substance is: take a question the classical books do not directly answer, and process it. So the first meaningful moment is the first moment a student can perform even one step of that processing correctly. That step is التكييف الفقهي — "which established category does this new thing resemble, and on what ʿilla?"

That becomes possible at G8 and not before, for three concrete reasons drawn from this curriculum's own ladder: (1) by end of G7 the student holds a فقه ladder with enough أبواب (الأخضري completed at G6, فقه مستقل since G5 [#19]) that he has a stock of categories to map ONTO — تكييف with three categories in hand is guessing; (2) أصول الفقه begins its مضمّن phase inside الفقه at exactly G8 [#20], which is when the words علة، قياس، عام، خاص، أمر، نهي first exist in the student's mouth at all, and تكييف is literally a sentence about an علة; (3) at G8 the student is old enough to hold a proposition as provisional — "this resembles X" — without converting it into an identity commitment, which a G5-G6 child developmentally cannot do [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE].

Note carefully: G8 is the first MEANINGFUL appearance. It is not the differentiation point, which is four years later. This subject has the longest gap in the register between becoming useful and becoming a subject, and that gap is the design, not a delay.

gradeByGrade.content: Not taught, and this is a positive finding rather than a gap. The G1 ceiling is ~7 periods for the whole of Programmes 2 and 3 [RECOVERED]; any claim here would come out of اللغة العربية or القراءة والتهجي, which are the load-bearing floor of everything after. The contemporary-world needs of a six-year-old are entirely met by الفقه التطبيقي مضمّن (pictures, gestures, real situations — the submission's own G1 design) and by التوحيد العملي. There is no residue for this subject to pick up.
Not taught. Same reasoning as G1. Zero claim on the 7-period budget.

Not taught. The child has just moved to the 19-period ceiling and every one of those periods is claimed by literacy, حفظ support, and the التوحيد والفقه pair. Nothing in this subject's method is available: there is no أصول vocabulary, no stock of أبواب, and no capacity for suspended judgement.
Not taught.

Not taught — and G5 is the grade where the temptation is strongest and most dangerous. G5 carries نواقض الإسلام, which redline 6 already flags as requiring protective, descriptive, non-accusatory framing. A contemporary-issues slot sitting next to نواقض الإسلام in the same year, with a ten-year-old who has no أصول and no مصطلح, is the exact configuration that produces a child who applies a checklist to his own family and neighbours. I recommend the board treat this as a standing prohibition, not merely an absence.

Not taught. G6 is arithmetically the tightest grade in the ladder (التفسير العملي + الترجمة, الجزرية, اللغة العربية, النحو + الآجرومية, الصرف + البناء, التوحيد والعقيدة, الفقه + الأخضري, الحديث, السيرة). There is no period, and there is no method. Note that the contemporary-language function that a naive reading might assign here — rendering Islamic content into English and Yoruba — is already owned by الترجمة from G6 [#16, redline 8].
Not taught. Last year of total absence. أصول الفقه does not yet exist even مضمّن [#20], so the machinery required for the subject's single analytic move is not present.

FIRST MEANINGFUL APPEARANCE. No block, no book, no mark of its own. Mechanism: at the close of each باب in the existing الفقه allocation, the فقه teacher runs ONE exercise scheduled in the scheme of work — سؤال التكييف: «هذه المسألة أشبه بأيّ باب درسناه؟ ولماذا؟». Roughly 3-5 such lessons across the year, each ~20 minutes inside a period already counted.

Specific worked material, tied to the أبواب the G8 فقه course actually covers: الطهارة — المناديل المبللة، المياه المعالجة، الطهارة بالمواد الكحولية; الصلاة — الصلاة في المدرسة النهارية وفي المواصلات، تحديد القبلة بالتطبيقات; الصيام — الحقن وبخاخ الربو (presented DESCRIPTIVELY: which category have scholars placed these in and on what ʿilla — never as a ruling the student issues).

The permitted output is a single sentence of the form «هذه أشبه بـ… لأن العلة…». Fatwa language (حلال، حرام، يجوز، لا يجوز) is explicitly OUT OF BOUNDS for the student at this stage and the teacher enforces that. The answer «لا أدري، وهذه تُسأل عنها أهل العلم» is marked as correct, not as a failure — this is the single most important habit the subject installs and it must be installed before the student is capable of bluffing. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

Same mechanism, extended and given its defining concept. Roughly 6 lessons across the year inside الفقه's existing allocation, following the ladder into المعاملات: البيع عبر الإنترنت، الدفع الإلكتروني والمحافظ الرقمية، العربون، المسابقات ذات رسوم الاشتراك، بيع ما ليس عندك.

The one NEW thing taught this year is the distinction on which the whole subject rests: مسألة لها نظير مباشر (the books answer it, look it up — that is الفقه's job) versus نازلة (no direct precedent; it has to be processed). G9 is the first grade where a student can FEEL that distinction rather than be told it, because he now holds enough أبواب to notice when something genuinely fits none of them. Before G9 every question looks unprecedented because the student's stock of precedent is small.

Still no mark of its own, still no fatwa language permitted. Assessment rides inside فقه's own paper as one applied question.

gradeByGrade.text: مختارات من «إعلام الموقعين عن رب العالمين» لابن قيّم الجوزية — فصل تغيّر الفتوى واختلافها بحسب تغيّر الأزمنة والأمكنة والأحوال والنيّات والعوائد. Selected passages only; NOT adopted as a matn and not memorised.
gradeByGrade.content:
THE METHOD UNIT — the subject's first dedicated time, and it teaches the method, deliberately NOT the issues. 2 periods/week for ONE TERM ONLY, held in the existing G10 term-rotation slot that المنطق (one term) and العروض (one term) occupy, using the third term which those two leave idle. Subject #12's own specialist already named «a bounded الدراسات الحديثة unit» as the natural partner for this slot; I am taking that invitation. NET NEW CLAIM ON THE 19: ZERO.

Content, in order: (1) تصوّر المسألة قبل الحكم عليها — the rule that you must understand how a thing actually works before ruling on it, worked on one technical example described accurately by someone who knows the mechanism (Council should source this; a teacher guessing at how a financial product or a technology works is the classic failure of this subject). (2) التكييف الفقهي formalised — naming the analogue and stating the claimed علة, now with a written structure rather than a sentence. (3) تغيّر الفتوى بتغيّر الزمان والمكان والحال والعرف, from the إعلام الموقعين passages — AND its limits: what does not change, and why الثابت بالنص القطعي is outside this door. This second half is the safety interlock; teaching the first half alone produces a student who believes everything is negotiable. (4) مصادر الفتوى المعاصرة: the individual مفتٍ versus collective الاجتهاد الجماعي / المجامع الفقهية; what collegial deliberation adds when a question requires non-shariah expertise; and what a fatwa's authority actually is — it addresses a questioner in a situation, it is not legislation binding on everyone. (5) تقويم الفتوى الإلكترونية — the protective core: who said this, to whom, when, on what evidence; is the hadith cited even ثابت (direct live use of the same year's مصطلح الحديث [#22], which is مستقل at G10 — this coordination is the reason the unit sits at G10 and nowhere else); is my situation the questioner's situation.

Independently assessed despite the light form (form and assessment are orthogonal): ONE unseen scenario, ~60 minutes, requiring a تكييف plus a source-evaluation note. It is reported as its own line because the G12 year is built on this method landing, and an embedded mark would make that unauditable.

DELIBERATE STEP DOWN in form from G10, which I want the board to see as intentional rather than as an oversight. G11 is the second-heaviest year on the ladder (أصول الفقه becomes مستقل, مصطلح الحديث holds 2 periods, المنطق becomes مستقل, النقد والآداب becomes مستقل, الترجمة makes its only new 2-period claim). There is no period to be had, and — separately from the budget — there is a positive reason to sit inside أصول this year: أصول الفقه taught without contemporary تطبيق is inert, so the أصول teacher wants this material.

Mechanism: ~20-25 minutes/week drawn from within أصول الفقه's own block, named in أصول's scheme of work as the تطبيقات المعاصرة strand. Zero additional periods.

Content, keyed to أصول's own sequence: العرف applied to a live Nigerian custom question; المصلحة المرسلة with its actual controls, not as a licence; سدّ الذرائع and, equally, the abuse of سدّ الذرائع; and — load-bearing for this student population — الضرورة والحاجة with their شروط, because «ضرورة» is the word a Nigerian teenager will hear invoked to justify almost anything, and he must know that it has conditions, a limit (تُقدَّر بقدرها) and an expiry. Plus the application of القواعد الفقهية already met in فقه — اليقين لا يزول بالشك، المشقة تجلب التيسير، الضرر يزال، العادة محكمة — taught here purely as application, with ownership of the theory left with أصول/فقه.

GOVERNANCE CONDITION: because this strand is invisible in the timetable, it evaporates unless the required تطبيقات are written into أصول الفقه's approved scheme of work and its case list is signed off. Without that condition, do not approve this arrangement.

Assessment embedded: forms the applied component of أصول الفقه's own mark.

gradeByGrade.text: مذكرة النوازل المدرسية — a school-built case dossier (no classical matn; see classicalTexts). Supported by مختارات من «إعلام الموقعين» لابن القيم and «قواعد الأحكام في مصالح الأنام» للعز بن عبد السلام, passages only.
gradeByGrade.content:
DIFFERENTIATION. 2 periods/week, full year, own identity, own mark. The only standing timetable claim this subject makes in twelve years.

The year is built on two things. (1) A CASE LIST of 8-10 نوازل chosen for Nigerian salience, deliberately spread across domains so the student does not leave thinking نوازل means money: المعاملات المالية (البنوك التقليدية والإسلامية، التأمين، القروض الدراسية، التمويل)؛ الطب (نقل الدم، التبرّع بالأعضاء، تنظيم النسل)؛ الإعلام والرقمي (الخصوصية، الصور، استعمال الذكاء الاصطناعي في طلب العلم والإفتاء)؛ الأسرة والعمل (العمل المختلط، السكن الجامعي، الوظيفة في مؤسسة ذات نشاط مختلط)؛ العلاقة بغير المسلمين في المجتمع النيجيري (التهنئة، الجوار، المشاركة الوطنية والمدنية). Each case runs the same seven-step protocol: تحرير محل السؤال ← تصوير الواقع بدقّة ← التكييف الفقهي ← الأدلة وتمحيصها ← أقوال المعاصرين ومستنداتها ← تحرير الخلاف: أين اختلفوا حقًّا ولماذا ← الموقف مع بيان أسبابه، أو التوقّف المسوَّغ.

(2) THE بحث: one research paper of 1,500-2,500 words in Arabic on a single نازلة, individually assigned. This is a SHARED artefact, not a new one — الإملاء [#15] already books the G12 بحث as its orthographic threshold and الإنشاء والخطابة [#14] already books a G12 رسالة/مقالة. One artefact, double-marked on separate criteria: الدراسات الحديثة marks the reasoning and sourcing; الإنشاء والخطابة marks the construction and register; الإملاء applies its published standard as a pass/return gate. This is the main reason a 2-period ask is affordable at all.

(3) A terminal competency drilled explicitly, not left to osmosis: متى تقول «لا أدري»، ولمن تُحيل، وكيف تُحيل. The graduate will be treated as a scholar by people who know less than he does, within weeks of leaving. The referral protocol is examined.

(4) Oral rendering: each case must be explainable to a lay questioner in English and in Yoruba without misrepresenting the scholarly position — cashing in الترجمة [#16], which is مستقل at G12. The graduate's questioners will not ask in Arabic.

BOUNDARY WITH أصول الفقه G12: أصول's G12 year is تخريج الفروع على الأصول — established madhhab differences reconstructed BACKWARD to their أصولي locus. This subject runs the same machinery FORWARD onto questions with no فرع to reconstruct. Same tools, opposite direction, no overlap. BOUNDARY WITH العقيدة G12: العقيدة holds the مناظرة period; this subject's oral assessment is a viva on the student's own بحث, not a debate, so the two do not collide.

Independently assessed: 50% البحث، 30% ورقة تحريرية على سيناريو غير مرئي، 20% مناقشة شفوية للبحث.

lifecycles.differentiationPoint:
G12, as مستقل, 2 periods/week. This is the latest differentiation point of any subject on the register and it needs a defence rather than an apology.

WHY NOT G11. At G11 أصول الفقه is in its FIRST مستقل year — التعارض والترجيح، الإجماع، الأخبار are being formalised that very year [#20]. الدراسات الحديثة has no method of its own; it borrows أصول's. Differentiating at G11 means running a subject whose entire toolkit is being manufactured in the room next door, in the same twelve weeks. The predictable output is confident misapplication — students deploying مصلحة مرسلة and عرف with a two-month-old grip on their controls. Separately and independently: G11 is the second-heaviest grade in the ladder and the periods are not there. Either reason alone is sufficient; together they are decisive.

WHY NOT G10. G10 is the peak load year (مصطلح الحديث differentiates, أصول الفقه differentiates as مدمج, البلاغة differentiates, العقيدة and المنطق are both live). More importantly, at G10 أصول is only مدمج — the student has the vocabulary but not the system. What G10 CAN carry, and does carry in this design, is the method unit in a rotation slot that already exists and is otherwise idle. That is a genuine presence, not a placeholder; but it is not differentiation.

WHY NOT G13. There is no G13. G12 is the last year the institution has custody of the student. That is not a residual argument — it is the positive one.

THE POSITIVE CASE FOR G12 SPECIFICALLY. This subject is a capstone by nature, not by convenience. It is the only entity on the 26-subject register whose object requires simultaneous, live use of أصول الفقه, الفقه, مصطلح الحديث, العقيدة, المنطق and الترجمة on a single question. Every other subject examines itself: تفسير examines تفسير, فقه examines فقه. Nothing else in twelve years asks the student to demonstrate that the twelve years converge. A capstone placed in the middle of a wall is not a capstone; it is a weak course. All six of its feeder disciplines reach مستقل status at G10-G11 and no earlier, so G12 is the first year — and the only year — in which the convergence is even possible.

And the exit argument is concrete, not rhetorical: the G12 student is weeks away from a Nigerian university or workplace where, in month one, he will meet interest-bearing student finance, mixed residence, insurance, workplace compromise and secular law — and will be asked about all of them by peers because he is «the one who went to the Islamic school». Differentiating at the point of departure means the method is fresh, the supervision is present, and the first unprecedented question he faces alone is his second, not his first. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]
prerequisites: A stock of فقه categories large enough that mapping ONTO them is analysis rather than guessing. Established by: الأخضري completed at G6 [retained redline 3], فقه مستقل G5-G12 [#19]; the stock is adequate for عبادات by G8 and for معاملات by G9.

The أصول vocabulary required to state a تكييف at all — علة، قياس، أمر، نهي، عام، خاص، مطلق، مقيد. Established by: أصول الفقه مضمّن inside الفقه at G8-G9, formalised on الورقات at G10 [#20]. Without علة the sentence «هذه أشبه بـ… لأن…» cannot be completed, which is why nothing is possible before G8.

The full أصولي system — التعارض والترجيح، الإجماع، الأخبار، العرف، المصلحة، سد الذرائع، الضرورة وشروطها. Established by: أصول الفقه مستقل at G11, applied at G12 [#20]. This is the prerequisite that fixes the differentiation year.

The ability to ask «is this hadith even ثابت?» of a citation encountered in the wild. Established by: مصطلح الحديث مستقل at G10 [#22]. This is the specific competence that converts internet fatwa consumption from passive to critical, and it is why the G10 method unit sits at G10 and not G9.

Creedal security sufficient that a question about secularism, interfaith conduct or political authority is examined rather than survived. Established by: التوحيد والعقيدة مدمج G5-G9, العقيدة مستقل from G8, التوحيد مستقل from G10 [#17, #18]. An unsettled student handed a contemporary creedal question does not analyse it; he adopts whatever position relieves the anxiety.

Arabic reading fluency in CONTEMPORARY expository register — fatwa prose, council resolutions, academic فقه articles. This is not the matn register the ladder mostly trains. Established by: اللغة العربية through G9 plus the حصة النصوص strand at G8-G9 [#7, #13]. Council should note this is a distinct reading skill and the G10 unit is the first place it is exercised.

Two-way rendering into English and Yoruba. Established by: الترجمة مدمج from G6 [redline 8], inside النصوص G8-G9, مستقل G11-G12 [#16]. Required because the questions arrive in English and Yoruba and the answers must return in them.
The capacity to build and deliver a reasoned written and oral case. Established by: الإنشاء والخطابة مستقل G8-G12 [#14]. The G12 بحث is impossible without it, and is in fact co-owned with it.
Argument hygiene — تعريف، تقسيم، تحرير محل النزاع، فساد الاستدلال. Established by: المنطق دوراني G10, مستقل G11 [#12]. Directly supplies the first step of the G12 seven-step protocol.

A developmental prerequisite that no subject establishes: the capacity to hold a proposition as provisional without converting it into identity. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Roughly mid-adolescence. This is the real reason the subject cannot be pulled down to G5-G6 by adding scaffolding — the obstacle is not knowledge, it is that a ten-year-old who is given a position keeps it.

classicalTexts.title: لا متن لهذه المادة — NO CLASSICAL MATN IS ASSIGNED
classicalTexts.justification: This is the most important finding in the section and it should be recorded as a decision, not as an absence. الدراسات الحديثة has no classical matn because its object postdates the matn tradition by definition: a نازلة is precisely a question the classical books did not face. Manufacturing or borrowing a matn for it would be a category error and would quietly convert the subject into a second فقه or a second أصول course. Its primary text is a SCHOOL-BUILT dossier (مذكرة النوازل المدرسية) of contemporary cases with primary sources attached, revised on a fixed cycle because its content genuinely ages — the only subject on the register of which that is true. The board must budget for that revision cycle; a dossier written once and used for a decade is worse than no dossier.

classicalTexts.title: إعلام الموقعين عن رب العالمين — ابن قيّم الجوزية
classicalTexts.justification: Exists, and the attribution is secure. Used ONLY for the فصل on تغيّر الفتوى واختلافها بحسب تغيّر الأزمنة والأمكنة والأحوال والنيّات والعوائد — the closest thing the classical library holds to a foundational statement for this discipline. It is a large multi-volume work, not a matn: selected passages, read with the teacher, never memorised, never set as a course. It must be taught together with its limits (what does NOT change), because the passage taken alone is the single most misused text in contemporary Islamic discourse.

classicalTexts.title: قواعد الأحكام في مصالح الأنام — العز بن عبد السلام
classicalTexts.justification: Exists; attribution secure. Supplies the مصلحة/مفسدة weighing vocabulary that the G12 case protocol needs at the تحرير الخلاف step. Passages only. The theory of مصلحة belongs to أصول الفقه [#20]; this subject borrows the worked weighing, not the doctrine, and the board should hold that boundary or the two courses will merge in practice.

classicalTexts.title: الأشباه والنظائر — جلال الدين السيوطي
classicalTexts.grade: G12 (reference shelf only, not a taught text)
classicalTexts.justification: Exists; attribution secure (note there is also a distinct الأشباه والنظائر by ابن نجيم in the Hanafi tradition — do not conflate them). Named here only as a reference the student is shown how to CONSULT for قواعد فقهية when building a تكييف. It is not timetabled, not examined, and not assigned reading. Listing it is a library decision, not a curricular one.

classicalTexts.title: الموافقات — الشاطبي
classicalTexts.justification: Exists; attribution secure; Maliki, which matters given the Maliki heritage encoded in الأخضري at G6. I am explicitly DECLINING to claim it. مقاصد belongs to أصول الفقه, and a G12 student who meets مقاصد first through a contemporary-issues course will use it as a solvent for rulings he finds inconvenient — the most common failure mode in modern Islamic education. If the Council wants مقاصد taught, it should be commissioned from أصول الفقه's specialist, not from here.

classicalTexts.title: منظومة القواعد الفقهية — عبد الرحمن بن ناصر السعدي
classicalTexts.justification: I am confident a short منظومة on القواعد الفقهية by السعدي exists, but the exact citation form of its title varies in circulation and I have not verified a single authoritative title here. In any case it is not this subject's text — if any subject memorises it, that is فقه's or أصول الفقه's call, and this subject would simply benefit. Flagged so the board does not assume I have endorsed a specific edition.

classicalTexts.title: قرارات المجامع الفقهية وفتاوى اللجان المعاصرة (genre, not a named work)
classicalTexts.grade: G10 (how to read them), G12 (read directly)
classicalTexts.justification: The honest primary sources of this subject are contemporary, not classical: published resolutions of collective juristic bodies and the fatwa output of standing committees. I am deliberately NOT naming specific bodies, resolution numbers or dates — a wrong citation here would be exactly the failure the brief warns against, and the choice of WHICH bodies is authoritative for this school is a governance question, not a scholarly one I can settle. See openQuestions.

lifecycles.prematureIntroductionRisks:
Five specific mechanisms, in descending order of seriousness. None of these is a generic "too hard for them" argument.

1. SAFEGUARDING — the takfīrī and extremist-recruitment pathway. Contemporary political-religious questions (the legitimacy of the Nigerian state, dealing with a non-Muslim government, the status of Muslims who differ, what the northern security discourse means) placed in front of a 12-14 year old who has no أصول, no مصطلح and no مقاصد is precisely the input that recruitment narratives are engineered to exploit: a simple, total, emotionally satisfying framework offered to a student who has questions and no apparatus. This is not hypothetical for a Nigerian institution with international ambitions. The G10-G12 placement is a safeguarding decision as much as a pedagogical one, and I recommend the board record it as such.

2. MANUFACTURING CONFIDENT IGNORANCE, which is costlier to undo than ignorance. A G6-G8 student who has "covered" البنوك، التأمين، التصوير، الموسيقى without أصول does not leave with knowledge; he leaves with a POSITION, unsupported and adolescent-identity-attached. Unteaching a held position costs several times what teaching a new one costs, and the student experiences the correction as betrayal by the institution. The subject would spend G10-G12 dismantling its own G7 output.

3. SYMMETRICAL DISTORTION IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Without تكييف the student defaults to one of two failure states. Maximalist: everything modern is forbidden — in a setting where he must use banks, hospitals, a national morning curriculum, and mixed public institutions, this produces either paralysis or (far more commonly) the quiet private decision that the whole religious curriculum is unlivable, which is a total loss. Minimalist: everything is fine, adjust as needed — which makes the twelve-year classical ladder look like decoration.

4. CANNIBALISATION OF THE LADDER. An early "relevant" subject running alongside الآجرومية and البناء في الصرف teaches a 12-year-old, by contrast, that the matn work is the boring part and the opinions are the real part. This is a documented motivational failure in classical curricula that add a modern strand too early, and it damages the subjects it sits next to more than it damages itself.

5. THE REDLINE-6 PRECEDENT. The institution has already recognised that نواقض الإسلام at G5 needs protective, descriptive framing so a child cannot turn it on his own family. Contemporary issues carry the identical hazard — a child with a list of modern «harams» and no method will apply it to his mother's savings account, his father's employment, his relatives' celebrations, and his Christian neighbours. A G5-G7 slot would reproduce that hazard without redline 6's protections. I recommend a standing prohibition on this subject appearing before G8 in any form.
lifecycles.delayRisks:
Four specific mechanisms. These are why the answer is not simply "teach it at G12 and forget it."

1. THE VACUUM IS NOT EMPTY — it is filled by WhatsApp. By G8 a Nigerian student in a phone-owning household has already encountered clipped preaching, viral fatwa screenshots, and confident strangers. If the school's first word on contemporary questions comes at G10, the school is not forming his position; it is arriving after it, as a corrective. This is the single reason I have NOT left G8-G9 empty. The G8-G9 مضمّن strand is designed to occupy that window at zero cost, and — crucially — it occupies it with a HABIT (ask which category, ask who said it, say لا أدري) rather than with answers, which is the only thing that can be safely installed at that age and the only thing that generalises to content the school will never see.

2. INSTITUTIONAL CREDIBILITY WITH PARENTS. Families paying for an afternoon Islamic school alongside a national morning curriculum will ask what it does about the world their child lives in. A curriculum with literally nothing under this heading before G12 is exposed to the charge of irrelevance — and the honest defence is that the answer lives in الفقه التطبيقي from G1 and التربية الإسلامية throughout. That defence only works if the school can SHOW it. Recommendation: publish the map (which subject answers which kind of contemporary question at which stage) rather than solving a communications problem by adding a premature subject line.

3. OMISSION AT G12 — the failure this subject exists to prevent. If the subject were pushed past G12, i.e. simply not taught, the graduate would leave holding a full toolkit having never once been supervised while using it on a question nobody had answered for him. He would have twelve years of derivation practice on problems with known answers. The first unprecedented question would then be faced alone, unsupervised, and with social pressure to answer it. That is the exact profile of the confidently wrong young graduate, and it is produced by well-taught classical curricula that stop at the classical.

4. A DATED, CONCRETE HARM. The G12 leaver meets, typically within the first term of a Nigerian university or first employment: interest-bearing student finance, compulsory insurance products, mixed-gender residence, workplace practices, secular legal obligations, and peers who will treat him as the local authority because of where he studied. The cost of delay here is not abstract underpreparation; it is a specific set of decisions with a known date, made by someone who is simultaneously under-equipped and over-credited.
lifecycles.g12Role:
FINAL ROLE: the integration instrument. مستقل, 2 periods/week, independently assessed — the only standing timetable claim the subject makes in twelve years, deliberately spent in the year the student leaves.

It is the sole place on the 26-subject register where the graduate must demonstrate that twelve years of separately-taught sciences converge on one question. Every other G12 entity examines its own domain; أصول الفقه's own G12 year runs تخريج الفروع على الأصول — established differences reconstructed BACKWARD to their أصولي locus. This subject runs the identical machinery FORWARD, onto questions that have no فرع to reconstruct. That directional difference is the whole justification for its separate existence and the board should hold the two apart on exactly that line.

WHAT THE GRADUATE CAN ACTUALLY DO, stated as testable acts rather than as attributes:
1. Take an unfamiliar question and state it precisely — تحرير محل السؤال — separating the actual question from the questioner's framing of it.
2. Describe accurately how the thing in question actually works before ruling on it, and recognise when he does not know how it works and must ask someone who does (a banker, a physician, an engineer). فقه الواقع as a procedural step, not a slogan.
3. Produce a written تكييف naming at least one classical analogue and the ʿilla being claimed, and say what would defeat that analogy.
4. Take any evidence cited at him and ask whether it is ثابت — grading, source, and the honest limit of what he personally can conclude — using the مصطلح apparatus from G10-G11.
5. Locate and read at least two contemporary scholarly treatments in Arabic, identify the actual point of disagreement rather than the rhetorical one, and distinguish what is قطعي and settled from what is legitimately contested.
6. Render all of the above accurately to a lay questioner in English and in Yoruba, without flattening a contested question into a single confident answer. His questioners will not ask in Arabic, and this is where الترجمة is finally cashed.
7. Write a 1,500-2,500 word Arabic بحث on a single نازلة with correct sourcing — double-marked with الإنشاء والخطابة on construction and gated by الإملاء's published orthographic standard.
8. Decline. Identify which questions exceed him, say «لا أدري» without loss of face, and route the questioner to someone competent. This is examined, not hoped for. It is the competency most likely to matter and the one most likely to be skipped if it is not on the paper.
lifecycles.periodsRequested:
Against the [RECOVERED] ceiling of ~19 periods/week at G3-G12 and ~7 at G1-G2, with the 195-hour Qur'an hour ring-fenced and untouched — this subject asks nothing from it at any grade.

G1-G2: ZERO of 7. No claim whatsoever on the tightest budget in the ladder. Recorded as a deliberate contribution.
G3-G7: ZERO of 19. No claim, no embedding, no minutes borrowed from anyone. Five consecutive grades of nil.
G8: ZERO additional. Approximately 3-5 lessons across the year, ~20 minutes each, inside الفقه's existing block. Annualised ≈0.1 period-equivalent. Net new demand: nil.
G9: ZERO additional. Approximately 6 lessons inside الفقه's existing block. Annualised ≈0.15 period-equivalent. Net new demand: nil.
G10: ZERO NET NEW. 2 periods/week for ONE TERM, occupying the third term of the G10 term-rotation slot that المنطق and العروض use for one term each and leave idle for the third. Annualised ≈0.7 of a weekly period, but the slot already exists in the 19 — the claim is on an idle term, not on a new line. Subject #12's specialist proposed this pairing independently; both specialists arriving at it separately should count for something.
G11: ZERO additional. ~20-25 minutes/week (≈0.5 period-equivalent) drawn from inside أصول الفقه's own block as the named تطبيقات المعاصرة strand. Net new demand: nil, CONDITIONAL on the strand being written into أصول's approved scheme of work.
G12: 2 of 19 — the subject's only standing claim in the entire ladder. One of the two is instruction (the case list); the second is supervision of the بحث, an artefact already booked by الإنشاء والخطابة [#14] and gated by الإملاء [#15]. So the honest EFFECTIVE net new demand at G12 is roughly 1.5 periods, with ~0.5 recovered through shared supervision of a single piece of work rather than three subjects each demanding their own.

LIFETIME TOTAL NEW CLAIM ON THE CONTESTED POOL: approximately 1.5 periods, in one year out of twelve.

G12 FEASIBILITY CHECK, since G12 is where the ask lands. G12 is the year with the most freed capacity in the ladder: اللغة العربية closes (—), الصرف drops to وحدة, البلاغة folds into النقد والآداب, مصطلح الحديث becomes مضمّن, السيرة becomes مضمّن, أصول التفسير folds into التفسير, الإملاء is مضمّن, النشيد is وحدة, التجويد is مضمّن, العروض is مضمّن, المنطق folds into العقيدة. A plausible G12 shape: التفسير (+أصول التفسير) 3 | النحو 2 | النقد والآداب (+البلاغة) 2 | الإنشاء والخطابة 2 | العقيدة (+علم الكلام) 2 | التوحيد 1 | الفقه 2 | أصول الفقه 2 | الحديث 2 | الترجمة 2 | الدراسات الحديثة 2 = 22. That is OVER the 19 before التاريخ الإسلامي [#23] and التربية الإسلامية [#25] are placed at all, which means G12 requires a board-level reconciliation regardless of this subject's request. I am not pretending my two periods are free: I am stating that this is the ONE year where I insist, that the request is 2 and not 3, and that if the board must cut, my declared fallback is 1 period plus a timetabled fortnightly supervision block for the بحث — below which the subject should not run at all, because a single period cannot carry both a case list and supervised research, and running it at 1 period unsupported would produce exactly the opinion-without-method outcome the whole design exists to prevent. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]
relationshipToOtherSubjects: FED BY أصول الفقه [#20] — the load-bearing dependency. It supplies the entire method: قياس، علة، عرف، مصلحة، سد الذرائع، ضرورة وشروطها، تعارض وترجيح. Its ladder (مضمّن G8-G9, مدمج G10, مستقل G11-G12) is what dictates this subject's every placement decision. If أصول slips a year, this subject slips with it.

FED BY الفقه [#19] — supplies the stock of أبواب that تكييف maps onto, and hosts the entire G8-G9 phase at zero cost. Boundary: any question with a settled classical answer is فقه's, permanently. This subject's object is specifically what the books did not face.

FED BY مصطلح الحديث [#22] — supplies the ability to interrogate a citation. Its G10 مستقل year is the direct reason the G10 method unit sits at G10. Boundary: this subject does not teach مصطلح, it consumes it; the only new thing it adds is the habit of applying it to material found in the wild rather than to material set by a teacher.

FED BY العقيدة [#17] and التوحيد [#18] — supply the limits. HARD BOUNDARY: rulings on شرك, نواقض الإسلام, and the status of traditional Yoruba religious practice belong to العقيدة and are NOT 'contemporary issues'. They must never be re-opened under this subject's name. Redline 5 (العقيدة and التوحيد stay integrated early) and redline 6 (نواقض needs protective framing) both point the same way: this material has an owner and a framing, and importing it here would strip both.

FED BY المنطق [#12] — supplies تعريف، تقسيم، تحرير محل النزاع، فساد الاستدلال, which is step one of the G12 protocol. Reciprocally, this subject is the natural rotation partner for المنطق's G10 slot, an arrangement #12's own specialist proposed. Boundary: this subject does not teach logic; it uses it.

FED BY اللغة العربية [#7] and النقد والآداب [#13] — the حصة النصوص work at G8-G9 is what makes contemporary Arabic expository prose readable. Council should note that fatwa and council-resolution register is NOT the matn register the ladder mostly trains, and this is the first subject that requires it.

FED BY and FEEDS الترجمة [#16] — takes English/Yoruba rendering as a prerequisite (redline 8 establishes it at G6) and returns to it, at G12, the hardest rendering task on the register: conveying a contested ruling to a lay questioner in Yoruba or English without collapsing it into false certainty.

FEEDS الإنشاء والخطابة [#14] — the G12 بحث is a SHARED artefact, not a duplicated one: this subject owns the reasoning and sourcing, الإنشاء owns the construction and register, and الإملاء [#15] applies its published orthographic gate. Three subjects, one piece of work, three separately reported marks. This shared artefact is the main economy that makes a 2-period G12 ask affordable.
FEEDS الفقه [#19] in return — the worked نوازل from G12 become the applied exercise set the فقه teacher can use, closing the loop.

MUST NOT DUPLICATE التربية الإسلامية [#25] — the sharpest boundary on this list and the one most likely to be breached in practice. التربية holds the BEHAVIOURAL layer: how a Muslim conducts himself now, including digital adab, money habits, conduct with non-Muslim neighbours. الدراسات الحديثة holds the ANALYTIC layer: how a question with no precedent is processed. Same topics can appear in both, at different ages, doing different work. If the board lets this subject drift into 'how to be a good modern Muslim', it will have built a second التربية الإسلامية at senior level and lost the only analytic capstone on the register. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — #25's specialist has not yet reported and this boundary needs both signatures.]

MUST NOT DUPLICATE أصول الفقه's G12 year — أصول runs تخريج الفروع على الأصول (backward, onto settled classical differences); this runs forward onto unprecedented questions. Same tools, opposite direction. Both specialists should hold this line explicitly in their schemes of work.

MUST NOT BECOME a current-affairs slot, a comparative-religion slot, a politics slot, or a general 'Islamic culture' slot. Operating rule for the board: if the question has a settled classical answer it is فقه's; if it is about conduct it is التربية الإسلامية's; if it is about creed it is العقيدة's; if it is about the past it is التاريخ الإسلامي's [#23]. What remains after those four subtractions is this subject's, and it is a much smaller set than the name suggests.

RELATES TO التاريخ الإسلامي [#23, not yet captured] — history supplies the demonstration that jurists have faced unprecedented situations before and that the tradition has a record of doing this. Useful, not prerequisite. Flagged for coordination once #23 reports.

NO RELATIONSHIP TO the ring-fenced Qur'an hour. This subject asks nothing from it at any grade, and the الإجازة parallel track [redline 2] is untouched by it — الدراسات الحديثة is grade-curriculum only and makes no mastery-track claim.
departuresFromSubmission: I CONFIRM rather than override the submission's total omission of this subject from G1-G7. The omission is correct and I want it recorded as a ratified decision rather than as an undesigned gap, because the pressure to 'make the curriculum relevant' will otherwise reappear at every future review and will point straight at the primary years. Five consecutive grades of nil (G3-G7) plus two at G1-G2 is the deliberate position, not the leftover one.

I DEPART from the submission's characterisation in its own note. The note reads 'contemporary studies — applying Islamic knowledge to modern questions.' I accept the definition and then narrow it hard: applying knowledge presupposes both the knowledge and a METHOD of application, so this subject's object is نوازل specifically — questions without direct classical precedent — and not 'modern topics' in general. Modern topics are already distributed across الفقه التطبيقي, التربية الإسلامية and العقيدة, correctly. Left unnarrowed, this subject becomes the register's dumping ground and quietly duplicates three others.

I DESIGN the G8-G12 span the submission left open, and I refuse the two obvious defaults. Default one: 'it sounds modern, put it early so the curriculum looks relevant' — rejected on safeguarding and pedagogical grounds (see prematureIntroductionRisks). Default two: 'it sounds advanced, put it at G11-G12 and forget the rest' — rejected because it leaves the G8-G9 window to WhatsApp. The answer is an unusually long, unusually cheap مضمّن run followed by a single مستقل year.

I DECLINE a standing weekly slot at every grade except G12, including at G10 and G11 where a less disciplined design would ask for one. The G10 presence occupies an idle rotation term; the G11 presence occupies minutes inside أصول الفقه. Lifetime new claim on the contested pool: about 1.5 periods, in one year.

I DELIBERATELY set the G11 form (مضمّن) LOWER than the G10 form (دوراني), and the G11 assessment (embedded) lower than G10's (independently assessed). This non-monotonic shape is intentional and I am flagging it so it is not 'corrected' by a later editor: G10's method unit must be independently certified because the G12 year is built on it; G11's application work genuinely IS أصول الفقه's exercise set and giving it a phantom subject line for half a period's worth of minutes would be dishonest bookkeeping. Form and assessment are orthogonal and this subject uses that orthogonality in both directions.

I ACCEPT and BUILD ON redline 2's logic without claiming any part of the الإجازة track. Nothing in this subject is mastery-paced or opt-in; it is grade-curriculum only. I note this explicitly because a 'contemporary issues' subject is a natural candidate for being pushed into an optional enrichment track, and that would be a mistake — the protective competencies here (evaluating a fatwa found online, saying لا أدري) must reach every graduate, not the keen ones.
openQuestions: WHICH contemporary juristic authorities the school's مذكرة النوازل draws on. This is the largest unresolved question and it is a governance one, not a scholarly one I can settle. The school's own فقه ladder encodes Maliki heritage (الأخضري at G6, retained by redline 3), consistent with Yorubaland's Maliki tradition; contemporary Nigerian religious discourse is considerably more mixed. Naming no bodies produces an incoherent dossier; naming them is a madhhab and alignment decision belonging to the Council. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

WHETHER politically-charged Nigerian questions enter the G12 case list at all — relations with the Nigerian state and secular law, security and extremism narratives, civic and electoral participation, interfaith marriage — and if so with what protective framing. This is structurally identical to redline 6's treatment of نواقض الإسلام and should be ruled on by the same body, in writing, with the framing specified rather than left to the teacher. My recommendation is that a narrow, explicitly protective treatment is safer than silence at G12, because silence at G12 means the student meets these framed by someone else within months. But it is not my ruling to make. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

WHO teaches G12. This is plausibly the hardest single staffing line on the 26-subject register: it requires genuine أصول الفقه competence AND literacy in contemporary Nigerian religious, financial and civic reality AND the temperament to model التوقف rather than performance. A teacher with the first and not the second produces classical answers to misdescribed questions; with the second and not the first, a current-affairs class with Islamic decoration. If the Council cannot staff this, the honest response is to run G8-G11 as designed (which costs nothing and needs no specialist) and defer the G12 مستقل year rather than run it badly. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

WHETHER the G12 بحث may be submitted in English by students whose Arabic prose is weak. My position is Arabic for the written بحث with English and Yoruba required for the ORAL rendering, since the whole ladder has been building toward Arabic academic production and الترجمة [#16] is مستقل at G12. But this has real implications for pass rates and for the shared marking arrangement with الإنشاء والخطابة, so it is a board call. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

WHETHER subject #25 التربية الإسلامية's specialist accepts the behavioural/analytic boundary drawn here. #25 has not yet reported. This boundary needs two signatures, not one, and it should be settled before either scheme of work is written. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

WHETHER G11 can be upgraded from مضمّن to دوراني if a period frees at that grade. My design assumes it cannot — G11 is the second-heaviest year. If reconciliation of G11 releases capacity, a one-term دوراني block would meaningfully strengthen the G12 year by moving two or three cases earlier. This is an improvement, not a necessity; do not fund it at another subject's expense.

WHETHER the board will fund the مذكرة النوازل revision cycle. This is the only subject on the register whose primary text genuinely ages. A dossier written once and reused for a decade is worse than no dossier, because it teaches students that the tradition's engagement with their world stopped before they were born. I recommend a fixed three-year revision requirement written into the subject's charter. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

G12 TIMETABLE RECONCILIATION. My own feasibility check puts a plausible G12 at ~22 periods against a ceiling of 19, BEFORE التاريخ الإسلامي [#23] and التربية الإسلامية [#25] are placed. G12 needs a board-level reconciliation regardless of this subject. My declared fallback is stated in periodsRequested: 2 requested, 1 plus fortnightly supervision as the floor, and below that the subject should not run at all rather than run as opinions without method.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن / القراءة والتهجي / التجويد / التفسير / النشيد — G1-G3
objections.objection: THE RING-FENCED HOUR IS OVER-SUBSCRIBED AND THE ARITHMETIC DOES NOT CLOSE. No single-subject reviewer could see this. At G1, five lifecycles all bill against the same 60 minutes: حفظ claims 'two sub-blocks of ~25-30 min' (=50-60 min); القراءة والتهجي claims 20-25 min/day; النشيد claims ~5 min/day at the opening of the تهجي block; التجويد is مضمّن inside the حفظ block; التفسير gives oral Yoruba meaning at the point of memorisation. 50-60 + 20-25 + 5 + n = impossible. At G2 the same collision persists (حفظ's block vs 20 min تهجي); at G3 the hour additionally has to absorb النظر المصاحب, 15 min of تهجي, AND التجويد's diagnostic articulation screen 'run inside the Qur'an hour'. Every one of these subjects reports 'ZERO periods' as its headline virtue, and that virtue is what each uses to defend its allocation to the Board. The zero is real only because the overflow was pushed somewhere that was already full. There is a second, graver aspect: the constitution says الحصة القرآنية لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى. القراءة والتهجي at G1-G2 does not teach the muṣḥaf at all — it teaches القاعدة النورانية/البغدادية, a separate primer, with its own book and its own independent assessment. Housing 40% of the ring-fenced hour in a non-Qur'anic primer is precisely the encroachment the ring-fence exists to forbid, however pedagogically sensible the primer is.
objections.recommendation: Before any allocation is approved, publish a single MINUTE LEDGER for the 60-minute hour at G1, G2, G3, G4, G5 and G6, signed off jointly rather than per-subject, showing every claimant's minutes summing to exactly 60. My proposed ledger: G1 — حفظ 30 (two blocks of 15, not 25-30), تهجي 20, نشيد 5, تفسير/معنى 5, تجويد 0 (correction happens inside حفظ's 30, not beside it). G2 — حفظ 35 / تهجي 18 / نشيد 4 / معنى 3. G3 — حفظ 40 / تهجي 15 / معنى 5. G4 — حفظ 45 / قراءة 10 / معنى 5. G5 — حفظ 48 / قراءة 8 / معنى 4. Then amend حفظ's G1 text to '~15-min sub-blocks' and stop describing the hour as if حفظ held all of it. Separately, put to the Council the constitutional question of whether القاعدة (a non-Qur'anic primer) may live inside the ring-fenced hour at all; if the ruling is no, القراءة والتهجي must be funded from the 7-period ceiling at G1-G2 and the النشيد slot moves with it.

objections.grade: القراءة والتهجي / التفسير — G6
objections.objection: THE SAME TEACHING IS FUNDED TWICE. القراءة والتهجي G6 states that its Qur'an-hour minutes 'pass to التفسير العملي للقرآن + الترجمة'. التفسير G6 states it takes '2 periods of 19' from the timetable ceiling, with its own block, its own book and independent assessment. Both cannot be true. If التفسير genuinely occupies inherited Qur'an-hour minutes, it must not also bill 2 periods and the Board has been shown a 2-period cost that does not exist. If it genuinely takes 2 timetable periods, then القراءة والتهجي's bequest is fictional and the vacated minutes should revert to حفظ — which is what the ring-fence requires. There is a third reading, which is the dangerous one: تفسير takes both, and the Qur'an hour quietly loses 10-15 minutes a day of حفظ from G6 onward to a subject with its own timetabled block. That is a breach of لا تُقتطع dressed as a handover.
objections.recommendation: Rule explicitly: from G6 the vacated تهجي minutes revert to حفظ (whose acquisition target rises to +2 juz that year and needs them), and التفسير العملي is funded entirely from its 2 timetable periods. Delete the 'minutes pass to التفسير' sentence from القراءة والتهجي G6. Keep only one exception, and name it: the معنى prompt attached to the ورد at the moment of memorisation (3-5 min) stays inside the hour permanently, because it is حفظ's own quality control, not a تفسير lesson.

objections.grade: التجويد / حفظ القرآن / القراءة والتهجي — G1 (structural precondition), affecting G4-G12
objections.objection: NO رواية HAS BEEN DECLARED, AND THE ENTIRE تجويد LADDER IS UNDECIDABLE WITHOUT IT. Three lifecycles flag this independently — حفظ calls it a hard structural precondition, التجويد lists 'a declared house رواية' as a prerequisite the curriculum does not have, القراءة والتهجي notes that Warsh maṣāḥif mark waqf differently — and no one owns it. This is not an administrative loose end; it is the single disciplinary decision on which the whole of Programme 1 hangs, and in this specific region it is contested. Warsh عن نافع is the historically dominant transmission across West Africa and is the transmission paired with the Maliki madhhab this school has already adopted at G6 via الأخضري; Ḥafṣ عن عاصم is the print default of most imported maṣāḥif. The content of تحفة and الجزرية is not riwāyah-neutral in application: مد البدل is two ḥarakāt in Ḥafṣ and admits 2/4/6 in Warsh; مقادير المد, صلة ميم الجمع, التقليل, الهمزتان and the treatment of هاء الضمير all differ. If the school teaches تحفة with Ḥafṣ values while the child's family and mosque recite Warsh, the school spends twelve years correcting children against their own community's sound practice and calling it لحن. That is a scholarly error, not a preference. It also decides between القاعدة النورانية and القاعدة البغدادية, which the القراءة والتهجي lifecycle already correctly makes conditional.
objections.recommendation: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] Rule on رواية, طريق and a single fixed muṣḥaf edition BEFORE the next G1 intake, and record the ruling as constitutional (unchangeable mid-ladder). Then require التجويد to re-issue G4-G7 with the riwāyah's مقادير stated numerically in the scheme of work, and to add one explicit lesson at G6 — 'ما تختلف فيه الروايات' — which names that other transmissions exist, are sound, and are what the child may hear at home, so the difference is met as knowledge rather than as correction. Remove الشاطبية from التجويد's text list entirely: it is a سبع قراءات matn, out of scope once a single riwāyah is declared, and leaving it listed invites a later reviewer to place it.

objections.grade: التجويد G8 vs حفظ القرآن G5/G7
objections.objection: THE وقف والابتداء PREREQUISITE CONTRADICTS ITSELF ACROSS TWO SUBJECTS. حفظ G7 states 'الجزرية continues; its باب معرفة الوقوف is now directly load-bearing on long-surah memorization', and حفظ's prerequisite list says waqf is established 'formally from G6-G7 via الجزرية's باب معرفة الوقوف'. التجويد does the opposite: it explicitly DEFERS the وقف والابتداء section out of الجزرية to a standalone G8 وحدة, arguing — correctly — that waqf judgement is syntactic, not phonetic, and needs الآجرومية and ملحة. So حفظ at G5 and G7 is relying on a competency that التجويد does not deliver until G8. حفظ's G5 case is worse: البقرة's long āyāt arrive at G5, three years before the unit exists.
objections.recommendation: Keep التجويد's G8 siting — the argument for it is the better one and splitting a manẓūma by pedagogical function is normal practice. Fix حفظ instead. Amend حفظ G5 and G7 to rely on علامات الوقف as MARK-FOLLOWING, which القراءة والتهجي already teaches systematically at G4 (م، لا، ج، صلى، قلى، المعانقة), and state plainly that waqf as JUDGEMENT — stopping where the school's muṣḥaf has no mark — begins at G8. Delete 'formally from G6-G7 via باب معرفة الوقوف' from حفظ's prerequisite list and replace with 'mark-governed from G4 (القراءة والتهجي); judgement-governed from G8 (وحدة الوقف والابتداء)'.

objections.grade: القراءة والتهجي G5-G12 / التفسير G8
objections.objection: NO SUBJECT IN THIS PROGRAMME OWNS THE MOVE FROM VOCALISED TO UNVOCALISED READING, AND TWO LIFECYCLES CONTRADICT EACH OTHER ABOUT IT. القراءة والتهجي states a load-bearing NEGATIVE prerequisite: النحو is not needed because the muṣḥaf is fully vocalised, and 'unvocalised reading, which genuinely does require الصرف والإعراب, cannot belong to this subject' — then the subject ends at G5. التفسير's prerequisite list opens with 'Fluent decoding of unvocalized-to-vocalized Arabic script, including unfamiliar Qur'anic words — القراءة والتهجي, functional by G4, secure by G5'. That competency is explicitly disowned by the subject named as its supplier. From G8 the pupil is handed تفسير الجلالين as his own reading text; at G9-G12 ابن كثير, and extracts of الطبري and القرطبي. All are unvocalised prose. The curriculum has produced a pupil who reads the muṣḥaf beautifully and cannot open a تفسير.
objections.recommendation: Either (a) declare this an INTERFACE owed by Programme 2's اللغة العربية, with a named gate: 'reads an unseen unvocalised classical prose paragraph aloud with correct إعراب-driven vowelling, end of G7' — and make التفسير's G8 مستقل status conditional on that gate existing; or (b) reopen القراءة والتهجي as a دوراني rotation of one term at G7, titled قراءة النص غير المشكول, costing 1 period, sited after ملحة الإعراب. Option (a) is correct on disciplinary grounds — unvocalised reading is a نحو/صرف competency, not a تهجي one — but it must be written down as a dependency with a gate year, not assumed. Correct التفسير's prerequisite #1 either way: it currently asserts a delivery that nobody makes.

objections.grade: التفسير — G8 (and G9-G11)
objections.objection: تفسير الجلالين IS PLACED WHERE ITS DIFFICULTY DOES NOT FIT, AND IS ASKED TO DO A JOB IT WAS NOT WRITTEN FOR. الجلالين is the most compressed تفسير in common circulation. It works by substitution-gloss and heavy ellipsis, it presumes the reader can supply the omitted نحو, and in the teaching tradition it is a text read WITH a shaykh by students who already have an آلة — it is notoriously easy to misread alone, which is why شروح and حواشٍ on it exist in the first place. Giving it to a G8 pupil as his PUPIL-READ SPINE, one year after ملحة الإعراب and with no unvocalised-prose reading behind him (see the preceding objection), asks a محرّر for the advanced reader to serve as a first reader. The predictable failure is that the pupil takes the gloss for the verse. Three further problems stack at the same grade: (i) التفسير itself flags الجلالين as 'subject to the عقيدة ruling' — that ruling has not been made, and الجلالين's handling of آيات الصفات is on the opposite side of the line from السعدي and ابن كثير, the programme's other two texts; (ii) the pupil therefore meets three different positions on the attributes — from his matn, from his teacher's source, and from his mosque — in a year where no grade is assigned to explain that these ARE positions; (iii) the alternative already sits in التفسير's own text list and is better on every count.
objections.recommendation: Move الجلالين out of G8-G9 entirely. At G8-G9 the pupil-read text should be أيسر التفاسير (الجزائري) or تيسير الكريم الرحمن (السعدي) — both already listed, both written for the learner, both continuous prose the pupil can actually construe. Re-enter الجلالين at G11 as a STUDIED text rather than a spine — ten to fifteen worked passages whose whole point is to show what a محرّر compresses and how to unpack it — once بلاغة and ملحة/لامية-level صرف can carry it. That converts a misplacement into a genuine competency: reading a terse classical gloss. Make the عقيدة ruling a precondition of that G11 placement, not of the G8 one.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات — G4 (submitted slot); unpacking grade absent programme-wide
objections.objection: THE LĀMIYYAH SHOULD NOT GO BACK INTO G4, AND ITS ATTRIBUTION SHOULD NOT BE STATED FLATLY. Two things, and the lens requires me to say the second plainly. FIRST, ATTRIBUTION: the short creedal lāmiyyah beginning يا سائلي عن مذهبي وعقيدتي is real and is COMMONLY ascribed to Ibn Taymiyyah in the printed and manuscript tradition, but that ascription is traditional rather than settled and has been questioned. I can confirm the poem exists; I cannot confirm the attribution to the standard the school's own hard prohibition demands. The Director General's identification resolves which text is meant; it does not by itself resolve authorship, and the curriculum should say 'منسوبة إلى ابن تيمية' rather than 'لابن تيمية'. SECOND, PLACEMENT: memorise-now/comprehend-later is a legitimate and traditional method — but the tradition applies it overwhelmingly to the Qur'an and to ALĀT texts (تحفة, الآجرومية, البناء), whose content is procedural and whose delayed comprehension carries no doctrinal freight. Applying it to a polemical creedal poem is a different act. The specific content the DG names — الصفات, خلق القرآن, الرؤية — is precisely the set of questions on which this school's orientation diverges from the Ashʿarī, Tijānī and Qādirī milieu that surrounds it in Yorubaland. A nine-year-old chanting, by تلقين and with no explanation by design, a versified position against what his grandmother holds, is the same pastoral hazard redline 6 already recognised for نواقض الإسلام at G5 — except that نواقض at least gets protective framing, whereas النشيد's method is explicitly chant-without-doctrine. Finally, the unpacking job the DG asks me to locate is NOT assigned anywhere in this programme. The only places the attributes are treated interpretively are التفسير G10-G11 and أصول التفسير G11 (المتشابه, آيات الصفات) — and those treat them as a hermeneutic question, not as creed. A seven-year gap between memorisation and explanation, with the explanation owned by the wrong discipline, is the failure the DG named.
objections.recommendation: Do not place it at G4. Place it at G7-G8 in النشيد's repertoire, where the learner has الآجرومية and ملحة and can at least construe the lines he is saying, and make its placement CONDITIONAL on Programme 3's العقيدة owning the same content in the same year or the next — so the gap is zero-to-one year, not seven. Cite it in all documents as 'القصيدة اللامية في السنة، المنسوبة إلى ابن تيمية'. Extend redline 6's protective-framing requirement to it explicitly. If Programme 3 does not claim the unpacking at G7-G9, the poem should not be memorised at any grade: [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED], and the default answer in the absence of a host is no.

objections.grade: Programme-level — أصول التفسير G9 / التفسير G7-G12
objections.objection: A PROGRAMME NAMED القرآن وعلومه HAS NO SUBJECT CALLED علوم القرآن. Six subjects, and the علوم are represented only by a one-term وحدة at G9 smuggled into the أصول التفسير lifecycle, plus ad-hoc 'operational, not systematic' use of المكي والمدني and أسباب النزول inside التفسير at G7-G9. علوم القرآن and أصول التفسير are related but classically distinguished disciplines — the first is the descriptive science of the Book (نزوله، جمعه، رسمه، مكيه ومدنيه، أسباب نزوله، ناسخه ومنسوخه، قراءاته، إعجازه), the second is the method of interpreting it. Collapsing the first into a single term of the second leaves two named chapters with no owner anywhere in twelve years: (i) الناسخ والمنسوخ في القرآن — assigned away to أصول الفقه in the prerequisite list, but أصول الفقه treats النسخ as a legal-theoretic category, not as the exegetical problem of آية العدة, آيات القتال, آية النجوى; (ii) القراءات — and this one bites hard. From G11 the pupil reads ابن كثير and extracts of الطبري and القرطبي, which are saturated with 'وقرأ نافع' and 'وفي قراءة ابن مسعود'. With one declared riwāyah and no framework at all, the pupil will read these as errors or as evidence of corruption. That is a formation failure in a graduate of a Qur'an programme.
objections.recommendation: Keep the G9 وحدة but re-own it: make علوم القرآن a دوراني strand owned by التفسير, running one term at G9 (descriptive: النزول، الجمع، الرسم، المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول) and one term at G11 (analytic: الناسخ والمنسوخ في القرآن، مدخل إلى القراءات وأن الاختلاف اختلاف تنوع منقول متواتر لا اختلاف تضاد). The G11 term costs nothing new if it is taken from التفسير's 3 periods for one term. Amend أصول التفسير to drop the G9 وحدة from its own lifecycle — a second-order discipline should not be the custodian of a first-order one — and amend its prerequisite list to receive النسخ from this strand rather than from أصول الفقه.

objections.grade: أصول التفسير — G11
objections.objection: مقدمة في أصول التفسير IS BEING ASKED TO SERVE AS A SYLLABUS AND IT IS NOT ONE. It is a risāla written in answer to a questioner, not a teaching matn. Its architecture is built around اختلاف السلف في التفسير, the ranking of sources, and the criticism of interpretation by mere رأي; it is polemical in places, its named targets belong to a controversy landscape a G11 pupil in Lagos does not inhabit, and — decisively for this purpose — it does NOT cover most of what the G11 course is scheduled to deliver. The lifecycle's own G11 content list (مصادر التفسير مرتبة، الإجماع، الاختلاف، المتشابه، الإسرائيليات) partly outruns the text, which is why القواعد الحسان had to be bolted on as an 'applied companion'. Calling it the SPINE inverts the relationship: the syllabus becomes whatever the risāla happens to discuss, and the gaps get filled by teacher improvisation. This is the classic failure of treating a famous short work as a curriculum because it is short and famous.
objections.recommendation: Invert it. Make the SYLLABUS the spine — a modern structured أصول التفسير course, for which فصول في أصول التفسير (الطيار) is already listed as the teacher's manual and is the right shape — and read مقدمة ابن تيمية INSIDE it as a studied risāla occupying one term, with its own examined outcomes: what it argues, why it ranks sources as it does, and what it does not cover. That keeps the text (which is worth reading and is a deliberate orientation signal the Council has already accepted) without asking it to carry a year. Keep القواعد الحسان as the applied companion; it is well chosen.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن — G4→G5 transition
objections.objection: THE المفصل IS ABANDONED HALF-FINISHED. The ladder does جزء عم (30) at G1-G2, جزء تبارك (29) at G3-G4, then jumps to البقرة at G5. Juz 27 and 28 are skipped — الرحمن، الواقعة، الحديد، المجادلة، الحشر، الممتحنة، الصف، الجمعة، المنافقون، التغابن، الطلاق، التحريم، and the ق/الذاريات/الطور/النجم/القمر group. That is not an arbitrary block: it is exactly the graded intermediate register between جزء تبارك and البقرة, and it is the reason the customary sequence completes المفصل before turning to الطوال. The lifecycle then writes at G5 that البقرة is 'the first encounter with long-āyah register, legal narrative and non-rhymed prose — a genuinely different memorization problem', and treats that discontinuity as unavoidable. It is not unavoidable; the tradition supplies the bridge and the design steps over it. The skipped juz are also not recovered later: with a floor reaching cumulative 22 by G12 and the front sweep starting at juz 1, the standard full-course pupil reaches roughly juz 20 and never meets juz 21-28 at all. Separately, the stated G12 'expected band ٢٥-٣٠ for the full-course student' does not follow from the published floors and should not be printed where parents will read it as a target.
objections.recommendation: Insert جزء قد سمع (28) and then جزء اقترب (27) between جزء تبارك and البقرة — one juz at G5, one at G6 — before the switch to الفاتحة/البقرة, which then begins at G6 or G7. This costs no additional time; it re-sequences the same acquisition. Re-publish the cumulative floors on that basis, and state plainly and in one place that the floor is a FLOOR, with the realistic completion band for a full-course pupil stated honestly (juz held, in juz, never as a percentage or a pass).

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن G9-G12 / التجويد G11-G12
objections.objection: THREE LIFECYCLES CLAIM الإقراء AND THEY ARE SEQUENCED BACKWARDS. حفظ assigns supervised إقراء DUTY from G9 ('G9 students take structured تسميع from G1-G2 children'), continues it at G10, and makes it 20% of the G12 hour. التجويد teaches the COMPETENCY — hearing another's error, typing it as مخرج/صفة/حكم/مقدار مد/وقف/جلي vs خفي, prescribing the corrective drill, and how to correct a child without shaming him — in a one-term unit at G11, and then has its own G12 supervised حلقة. So for two full years, fifteen-year-olds are placed in front of six-year-olds and asked to correct their recitation before anyone has taught them how, and then at G12 two subjects each run a supervised junior حلقة with no statement of whose record is authoritative. Untrained correction at G1-G2 is not neutral: a mistyped correction installs a fossilised error in a beginner, which حفظ's own prerequisite list correctly identifies as the most expensive failure in the whole subject.
objections.recommendation: Move التجويد's وحدة الإقراء وتصحيح التلاوة from G11 to G9, one term, 1 period, sited in term 1 — so training precedes duty by design. That also relieves the G11 period pinch (next objection). Then merge the two G12 حلقة claims into ONE moderated حلقة with one error log, owned by حفظ (which holds the hour) and moderated against التجويد's error taxonomy. Delete التجويد's separate G12 حلقة and keep its G12 role as the taxonomy and the moderation standard.

objections.grade: Programme-level — G11
objections.objection: PROGRAMME 1 CLAIMS UP TO SEVEN OF NINETEEN PERIODS IN THE MOST CONTESTED YEAR IN THE LADDER. At G11 this programme bills التفسير 3 + أصول التفسير 2 + التجويد's إقراء unit 2 (one term) = up to 7, or 37% of the ceiling. G11 is also the year that نخبة الفكر and مصطلح الحديث are running (redline 1), the year أصول الفقه lands on one of the two recommendations in these very lifecycles, the year البلاغة must already be in place for التفسير البياني and أصول التفسير's handling of المتشابه, plus الفقه, العقيدة, النقد والآداب, الإنشاء والخطابة and النشيد's مضمّن host. Twelve periods cannot carry all of Programme 2 and all of Programme 3 in the heaviest second-order year of the ladder. An allocation that cannot fit is not a real allocation, by the architecture's own rule. G6 carries a parallel but smaller version of the same pressure (التجويد 2 + التفسير 2 = 4, in the year الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء and الأخضري all arrive — النشيد's lifecycle already spotted this and contracted itself, which is the right instinct and the only one of the six to show it).
objections.recommendation: Cap Programme 1 at G11 to 4 periods: التفسير 2 (not 3) and أصول التفسير 2. Move the إقراء unit to G9 as above. Recover التفسير's lost G11 period by moving the التفسير البياني strand to G12, where it sits naturally alongside التفسير الموضوعي and where البلاغة will certainly be in place. Publish a programme-by-grade period table for all three programmes side by side before any of the three is approved — no per-subject reviewer and no per-programme reviewer can see the ceiling breach; only the combined table can.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات — G5 (submitted slot for الفواكه الساقطة)
objections.objection: THE الإلوري TEXT IS ALMOST CERTAINLY MISPLACED AT G5, AND THE ARCHITECTURAL POINT IT CARRIES IS LOST THERE. The Director General has confirmed the author — الشيخ آدم عبد الله الإلوري, founder of مركز التعليم العربي الإسلامي in Agege — and I take that as settled. I cannot confirm the title as one of his works, and the DG has himself said the contents, length and register remain unverified; so nothing about its difficulty is known. But what IS known is decisive: الإلوري wrote in an elevated classical adab register, for readers formed in Arabic. The G5 pupil at SHRS is at المفردات والجمل البسيطة. The probability that any work of his is a G5 memorisation text is low. Worse, the architectural significance the DG names — that indigenous West African Arabic scholarship stands alongside the Eastern classical canon — cannot land on a ten-year-old chanting lines he cannot construe. It lands on a G10-G11 learner who has read المتنبي and the المعلقات and can see for himself that a Nigerian shaykh writes in that register, in that tradition, at that standard. Placed at G5 the text is decoration; placed at G10-G11 it is an argument.
objections.recommendation: Hold the G5 slot as it currently stands — the school-compiled مجموعة, which is the right answer for that age — and mark الفواكه الساقطة [PENDING REGISTER ASSESSMENT], not [UNVERIFIED]. Obtain a copy, and place it by its actual register: if verse of moderate difficulty, G9-G10 in النشيد's repertoire; if adab prose, G10-G11 as a set text inside النقد والآداب, where its point is strongest. Either way, name a second الإلوري or West African work alongside it once verified, so the indigenous strand is a strand and not a single gesture. Do not place it anywhere until someone at SHRS has read it — this is a text the school is closer to than any reviewer.

objections.grade: التفسير G8-G12 / أصول التفسير G11-G12 — orientation
objections.objection: THE ORIENTATION MIX IS DEFENSIBLE BUT IS NEVER NAMED AT ANY GRADE, AND THAT IS WHAT MAKES IT INCOHERENT. The Director General asks whether the combination is coherent. My answer: the combination itself is entirely normal in contemporary Nigerian Islamic education — Maliki فقه with an Athari creedal and exegetical text selection is one of the standard shapes on the ground, and there is nothing disciplinarily unsound in it. What is unsound is that the pupil is never told he is standing anywhere. He reads الأخضري (Maliki) at G6, hears السعدي through his teacher at G6-G9, is given الجلالين — two Shafiʿi-Ashʿarī authors whose handling of آيات الصفات runs the other way — as his own text at G8-G11, memorises a poem against that position (if it returns), and walks past ابن كثير, الطبري and القرطبي at G11-G12. Five positions, twelve years, no grade assigned to say that these are positions held by scholars for reasons. A graduate who cannot describe the map he is standing on will either think there is no map, or think everyone off his own square is in error. For a school with stated international ambitions, sitting in a Yoruba milieu that is largely not on its square, that is the more serious formation risk than any single text.
objections.recommendation: Designate ONE grade as the owner. التفسير G11 already carries 'اختلاف المفسرين — how to read a difference of opinion'; make that strand explicitly responsible for مناهج المفسرين: تفسير بالمأثور vs بالرأي المحمود; the مدارس (أثرية، أشعرية، لغوية، فقهية مذهبية); why الجلالين construes an آية صفة one way and ابن كثير another; and the discipline of stating another's position accurately before disagreeing with it. Name the school's own position explicitly and as a position, not as the absence of one. Sequence فقه المذهب (Maliki) and عقيدة orientation as two separate declarations, since they are two separate decisions. Whether the orientation is right is the Council's to decide; whether it is taught as an orientation is a curriculum requirement, and currently it is not.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن / القراءة والتهجي — G1-G3
