objections.objection: THE INDIGENOUS METHOD IS DISCARDED WITHOUT BEING CONSIDERED, IN A DESIGN THAT ELSEWHERE GOES OUT OF ITS WAY TO HONOUR INDIGENOUS SCHOLARSHIP. حفظ G1-G3 mandates تلقين سمعي with no muṣḥaf in the child's hand, the muṣḥaf entering only at G3 as نظر مصاحب and G4 as reading. That is the Eastern halaqah model, imported whole. The method native to this exact region — the ile-kewu / الواح tradition — puts a writing surface in the child's hand from the first week: the verse is written, read, memorised, washed and rewritten, and the WRITING is the memorisation mechanism, not an accessory to it. The design does not reject this on argued grounds; it does not mention it. That omission is doubly odd in an architecture that has just accepted an الإلوري text precisely in order to bring West African scholarship in. It also forfeits something the design needs elsewhere: redline 7 requires إملاء to be exercised longitudinally rather than timetabled, النشيد wants written استظهار from G5, and القراءة والتهجي needs رسم familiarity early — the لوح delivers all three inside the Qur'an hour at zero period cost.
objections.recommendation: Require حفظ to state a position on the لوح rather than leave it unaddressed, and I would recommend adopting it at G1-G3 as the writing surface inside the hour: the child writes the current ورد, reads it, memorises from his own hand, and clears it. It makes the 'no muṣḥaf until G4' rule coherent rather than merely restrictive (the child has a text — his own), it front-loads رسم and إملاء at no cost, and it makes the school legible to the families it is recruiting from. If the Council rejects it, the rejection should be written down with its reason, because parents will ask.

objections.grade: أصول التفسير G11 / مصطلح الحديث G10-G11
objections.objection: أصول التفسير FIXES ITSELF AT G11 'AND NOT G10' BECAUSE IT NEEDS مصطلح الحديث FIRST — AND THEN LANDS IN THE SAME YEAR AS IT. The argument given is correct and important: التفسير بالمأثور cannot be taught to a pupil with no capacity to ask whether a report is established, or you manufacture someone who accepts any attributed tafsir. But redline 1 sites مصطلح at G10-G11 with نخبة الفكر as the matn, which means the pupil may be acquiring صحيح/حسن/ضعيف and إسناد in the very term he is being asked to use them on tafsir reports. A prerequisite that arrives concurrently is not a prerequisite. The lifecycle half-sees this for أصول الفقه (it asks for explicit within-year sequencing there) but not for مصطلح, which is the one it called binding.
objections.recommendation: Require an explicit within-year sequencing ruling for G10-G11 across the two programmes: مصطلح الحديث must complete its تقسيم الخبر / أقسام الحديث المقبول والمردود block by end of G10 or G11 term 1. Site أصول التفسير's التفسير بالمأثور chapter in G11 term 2 accordingly, and put the مصادر والاختلاف material in term 1 where it needs nothing from مصطلح. If مصطلح cannot deliver by G11 term 1, أصول التفسير's مأثور chapter moves to G12 and merges with the التفسير capstone — which the G12 مدمج form already accommodates.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن — G1-G2
objections.objection: THE G1-G2 FLOOR IS VERY LOW AGAINST LOCAL NORMS AND IS PUBLISHED AS THOUGH IT WERE THE STANDARD. جزء عم over two years is 390 ring-fenced hours for one juz. The reasons offered — five-year-olds, L1 phoneme remediation, تلقين without a text — are real and I do not dispute the caution. But this school sits in a region where ile-kewu children commonly hold considerably more than one juz by that age, and where parents will compare. Publishing the floor without publishing that it IS a floor will do two things: parents will read the school as slower than the alأlfa down the road, and teachers will teach to the floor, which is what floors do when nothing sits above them.
objections.recommendation: Keep the floor — it is defensible and the phoneme work behind it is the right investment. But publish it as a THREE-BAND statement at G1-G2 (floor / expected / extension), state in one sentence for parents why the first two years buy pronunciation and habit rather than volume, and require the halaqah record to show how many children are above the floor. Add the extension band explicitly so a fast child is not held at جزء عم for two years.

objections.grade: التجويد — text list (unplaced entries)
objections.objection: THE CONFIDENCE TAGS ON TWO UNPLACED TEXTS ARE MISCALIBRATED IN THE CAUTIOUS DIRECTION, WHICH IS THE HARMLESS DIRECTION BUT IS STILL WRONG. منار الهدى في بيان الوقف والابتدا is tagged 'unverified' and merely 'attributed to الأشموني'; to the best of my knowledge it is a genuine and standard work of الأشموني on الوقف والابتدا, correctly attributed. المكتفى في الوقف والابتدا is tagged 'uncertain'; to the best of my knowledge it is a genuine work of أبي عمرو الداني. Neither is placed at any grade so nothing is broken. I raise it only because the programme's credibility on text identification rests on the tags being calibrated in BOTH directions: a register that flags real works as doubtful while carrying genuinely doubtful items elsewhere teaches readers to ignore the tags. I state my own confidence here as high but not absolute, and would have the school's own scholars confirm rather than take my word.
objections.recommendation: Re-tag both as 'believed genuine, pending SHRS verification' and keep both unplaced — neither is a school text; منار الهدى is the teacher's reference behind the G8 وحدة and should be listed as such, which is a useful clarification rather than a correction. Establish one rule for the whole architecture: every text carries a tag, the tag is set by the same person for all three programmes, and 'unverified' means 'we could not confirm this exists as named', not 'we have not personally read it'.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن G12 / التجويد G10, G12
objections.objection: THE TERMINAL TAJWĪD EXAMINATION IS CLAIMED TWICE AND SITED IN TWO DIFFERENT YEARS. التجويد runs a TERMINAL PRACTICAL CERTIFICATION IN تلاوة مجودة at G10 (unseen page, sight-read, zero لحن جلي to pass) and then explicitly sets no paper at G11-G12. حفظ's G12 exit requires 'an applied-tajwīd examination against الجزرية'. Two terminal tajwīd instruments, two years apart, two owners, no statement of which certificate the graduate holds or whether the G10 one can be lost. Minor, but it is the kind of thing that becomes a dispute at the first graduation.
objections.recommendation: Declare التجويد's G10 certificate the terminal institutional إتقان التلاوة award, and re-describe حفظ's G12 instrument as what it actually is: a REVALIDATION of that certificate applied to the candidate's own memorised portion, owned by حفظ, using التجويد's published tolerances. One standard, one taxonomy, two moments. Say on the certificate itself that it is not an إجازة بالسند — التجويد's lifecycle already gets this right and it should be carried through to G12.

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: The ring-fenced Qur'an hour is over-subscribed and the arithmetic does not close. At G1, five lifecycles bill against the same sixty minutes — حفظ's two sub-blocks of 25-30 min, القراءة والتهجي's 20-25 min, النشيد's 5, التجويد مضمّن, التفسير's oral meaning — and every one of them presents 'ZERO periods from the 19/7 ceiling' to the Board as its headline virtue. That zero is real only because the overflow was pushed into a container that was already full, and no per-subject reviewer could see it. The same defect recurs at G6, where القراءة والتهجي bequeaths its Qur'an-hour minutes to التفسير while التفسير simultaneously bills two timetable periods for the same teaching. This is the precise failure mode the lens exists to catch: the disciplines have not been sequenced on their own logic, they have been squeezed into the one budget line that appeared free, and the constitutional protection (لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى) has been quietly converted from a shield for حفظ into a loophole through which four other subjects are funded. Nothing else in the programme should be approved until a signed minute ledger for the hour at G1-G6 sums to sixty.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives:
Several judgements here are genuinely good and should be protected by name, not merely left alone.

THE تحفة → الجزرية LADDER AND ITS GATING (التجويد G4-G7). Siting تحفة at G4 rather than G3 on the argument that its first half is visual rule-triggering on سكون/تنوين/شدة, and that a child who cannot sort those on the page is chanting noise, is exactly right and is the reasoning the tradition would give. What protects it: the G3 diagnostic articulation screen, and the prerequisite that القراءة والتهجي reaches الكلمات at G3. Do not let anyone move تحفة earlier to 'start tajwīd sooner'.

DEFERRING الوقف والابتداء OUT OF الجزرية TO G8. The argument — that waqf is the one part of علم التجويد that is not phonetic at all, that it is a judgement about where a meaning completes, and that the judgement is impossible without نحو — is the single best piece of disciplinary reasoning in the six submissions. It splits a manẓūma by function rather than by page, which is what a teacher who understands the text does. Protect it against the tidiness objection that a matn should be finished where it starts. (حفظ must be corrected to match it; see objection 4.)

التفسير DIFFERENTIATING AT G6, GATED ON الآجرومية AND البناء. This is لا تفسير قبل آلة, correctly operationalised: the pupil gets the apparatus for saying WHY a verse means what it means in the same year he is first asked to say it. The five preceding years of مضمّن meaning-attachment mean the first tafsir lesson is not the first time meaning has been attached to memorised sound. Protect the gate specifically: if الآجرومية ever moves, G6 tafsir moves with it.

سورة يوسف AT G9, AND THE الإسرائيليات TREATMENT SITED THERE. One unbroken Makkan narrative, long enough to teach stamina, rich without being legally dense, is the right first sustained تفسير. And يوسف is precisely where the tafsir tradition's إسرائيليات load is heaviest, so teaching the pupil to notice an unsourced story, mark it and withhold judgement lands on real examples rather than on a rule. This is well made.

أصول التفسير DECLINING TO STAY مستقل AT G12. The observation that أصول التفسير is by its nature a مقدمة discipline — its classical literature is literally titled muqaddima — acquired compactly once and then used permanently, and that keeping it independent in the senior year would force the invention of filler, resists the strongest gravitational pull in curriculum design: senior year equals more. It is the correct asymmetry.

النشيد CONTRACTING AT G6 AND DECLINING مستقل STATUS ALTOGETHER. The reasoning that memorisation CAPACITY rather than timetable space is the binding constraint in the year الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء and الأخضري all arrive, and that a subject whose content all belongs to named neighbours should hold method and repertoire rather than claim a block, is the only place in the six lifecycles where a specialist argued his own subject downward. It should be commended publicly, because it is the behaviour the architecture needs from every future reviewer.

REFUSING TO ADOPT 'منظومة التوحيد والإيمان' AT G3. Correct. I cannot confirm such a titled work either, and the substitution of a school-compiled مجموعة of short affirmative أبيات is the right answer for that age independent of the verification question.

THE TEXT REGISTER IS, ON THE WHOLE, SOUND. تحفة (الجمزوري), المقدمة الجزرية (ابن الجزري), لامية ابن الوردي, تائية الإلبيري, بانت سعاد, المعلقات, السعدي, ابن كثير, الجلالين, أيسر التفاسير, القواعد الحسان, فصول الطيار, مباحث القطان, الإتقان, الفوز الكبير — these are correctly named and correctly attributed as far as I can judge, and لامية العرب is correctly carried as المنسوبة إلى الشنفرى. The disputes in my objections are about PLACEMENT and about what a text is asked to do, not about whether the texts exist. That is a materially better starting position than most curriculum submissions of this size.

objections.grade: G5-G12 (التفسير × حفظ القرآن — cross-subject)
objections.objection: THE MEANING GAP. The two lifecycles agree on the rule 'do not explain what is not memorised' and both honour it — but nobody checked its converse. حفظ's front is: G5 = البقرة, G6 = through النساء, G7 = through الأنعام, G9 = ~13 juz, G12 = 19-22 juz. التفسير's coverage is: جزء عم (G6), جزء تبارك + الحجرات (G7), لقمان (G8), يوسف (G9), البقرة first half (G10), selected آيات الأحكام + بياني passages (G11), themes (G12). Roughly three quarters of what the graduate memorises is never explained at any grade. تفسير itself TERMINATES its cheap مضمّن meaning-at-the-point-of-memorisation layer at G5 — the one mechanism that tracked the ḥifẓ front, that worked, and that cost zero periods — for no stated developmental reason, precisely in the year the child starts on البقرة. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] The consequence is not abstract: a 10-13 year old memorises the legal, polemical and قتال material of البقرة–المائدة–التوبة with zero framing, in a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian context with live inter-religious sensitivity. The Board already accepted (redline 6) that نواقض الإسلام needs protective, descriptive framing because a child could misapply it to family and community. That principle has been applied to one small fiqh text and withheld from the largest memorised corpus in the school. This is also exactly the DG's own note (b) — memorise-now/comprehend-later requires a named grade that does the unpacking — generalised from one poem to twenty juz.
objections.recommendation: Reinstate the مضمّن meaning layer inside the ring-fenced hour for ALL of G5-G12, not G1-G5: 5-8 minutes at the point of memorisation, in Yoruba/English at G5-G7 and in Arabic from G8, giving for each new passage (i) who is addressed, (ii) what is commanded/described/promised, (iii) where framing is needed — addressee, historical referent, and the explicit statement that a verse about a specific group at a specific time is not a licence about a neighbour today. Zero periods; it is the identical mechanism التفسير already runs at G1-G4 and it is delivered by the same حفظ teacher. Separately, publish a coverage map of حفظ front versus تفسير coverage per grade so the gap is visible to the Board, and require تفسير G8-G11 to select at least one sura per year from the material memorised at G5-G7 rather than only from the مفصّل.

objections.grade: G6 (all six subjects)
objections.objection: THE G6 PILE-UP — nobody coordinated, and five of six subjects escalate in the same year. At G6 the 11-year-old receives simultaneously: الجزرية (new matn, تجويد rises 1→2 periods), الآجرومية, البناء في الصرف, الأخضري — four new independently assessed classical متون — plus التفسير differentiating as a new named subject with its own book, plus الترجمة beginning in TWO target languages, plus حفظ raising its acquisition rate from +1.5 to +2 juz, plus أصول التفسير opening a مضمّن strand inside the تفسير block. النشيد والمحفوظات is the ONLY subject that noticed and contracted (to 20-30 lines) — and it is the one subject whose contraction buys the least, because the binding constraint at G6 is memorisation capacity and the other five subjects took all of it. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Memorisation of four unfamiliar technical rajaz/verse متون in one year, concurrent with the highest ḥifẓ rate the child has ever carried and a new subject in a new register, exceeds what a normal 11-year-old in an afternoon/weekend school will consolidate. The predictable outcome is chanted متون nobody can apply — the precise failure this review exists to catch.
objections.recommendation: Within Programme 1's own authority: (a) hold حفظ acquisition FLAT at G6 (+1.5 juz, same as G5), using حفظ's own G4 principle that a method/load change absorbs the gain; (b) start الجزرية's مخارج section in term 2 of G6 rather than term 1, and carry the الصفات section into G7, keeping تجويد at 1 period in G6 and 2 in G7 (التجويد's own prerequisite argument requires that مخارج precede الصفات, not that both fit in one year); (c) restrict the G6 تفسير block to ONE rendering language (see the separate G6 objection). Recommend to the Council that البناء في الصرف and الأخضري are not both landed in G6 — that is Programme 2/3's call, but this Board should be told that Programme 1 alone already fills G6's memorisation budget.

objections.grade: G9, G11, G12 (حفظ القرآن × التجويد)
objections.objection: PEER-إقراء IS PROPOSED WITHOUT A SAFEGUARDING FRAME OR A COMPETENCE FLOOR. Three separate lifecycles assign adolescents to instruct young children inside the Qur'an hour: حفظ G9 has 14-year-olds taking individual تسميع from G1-G2 children (ages 5-7); تجويد G12 assigns each 17-year-old a small group of G1-G4 pupils; حفظ G12 gives 20% of the hour to إقراء. The pedagogy is genuinely excellent and I want it kept. But (i) adolescents supervising 5-9 year olds individually in a religious halaqah is a child-protection configuration that requires an explicit written policy — permanent line of sight, never one-to-one out of view, an absolute prohibition on physical correction (a live regional practice in Qur'anic halaqāt), a named reporting route a 6-year-old can actually use, and screening of the senior students. Not one of the six lifecycles mentions any of this; تجويد G11's 'how to correct a seven-year-old without shaming him' is a good instinct and nowhere near sufficient. (ii) There is a competence contradiction: the G9 student who corrects a G1 child's articulation does not himself hold the institutional إتقان التلاوة certificate until G10 and has not done the إقراء unit until G11. Fossilised mispronunciation installed by an uncertified 14-year-old is, by حفظ's own prerequisite note, more expensive to remediate than the original acquisition.
objections.recommendation: Do not approve peer-إقراء without a named SHRS safeguarding policy attached to the Qur'an hour, covering line-of-sight, no unobserved one-to-one, no physical correction, a child-accessible reporting route, and vetting of senior students. Restrict G9 duty to سرد-LISTENING ONLY: the G9 student follows the muṣḥaf, logs errors, and reports them to the teacher — he does not correct the child. Student CORRECTION of juniors begins only after the G11 إقراء unit and the G10 إتقان التلاوة certificate, i.e. G11-G12 only, in groups, in the teacher's sight.

objections.grade: G12 (all six subjects)
objections.objection: FIVE PROGRAMME-1 CAPSTONES IN ONE YEAR, ON TOP OF EXTERNAL SCHOOL-LEAVING EXAMINATIONS. G12 requires: a panel سرد of up to 22 juz plus an applied-tajwīd examination against الجزرية (حفظ); running a moderated حلقة for G1-G4 pupils with a per-child error log (تجويد); a public مجلس إلقاء with a newly memorised substantial قصيدة, parsed and contextualised on demand (النشيد); preparation and public delivery of a tafsir of an assigned sura in Arabic and then rendered into English and Yoruba (التفسير); and a further أصول التفسير capstone. That is five terminal performance assessments from ONE programme, before Programmes 2 and 3 add theirs, in the same calendar year in which the same 17-year-old sits the national school-leaving examinations from the morning curriculum. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] The morning curriculum is out of scope; the adolescent carrying both is not. The reliable outcome of stacking terminal assessments is that the student optimises for whichever is externally consequential and performs the rest at a floor the school will nonetheless certify.
objections.recommendation: Designate ONE Programme 1 capstone — the تفسير delivery, which already integrates نحو، صرف، بلاغة، حديث، فقه، عقيدة and is explicitly designed as the integrating act — and make the أصول التفسير capstone a scored component of it rather than a separate event. Move the النشيد مجلس إلقاء to G11 term 3. Schedule the حفظ panel سرد in G12 term 1, deliberately clear of the external examination window. Convert the تجويد حلقة from a capstone to a continuous embedded record across the year, as its own lifecycle in fact already describes.

objections.grade: G2-G4 (حفظ القرآن × القراءة والتهجي)
objections.objection: THE TWO SUBJECTS STATE INCOMPATIBLE FACTS ABOUT THE SAME CHILD'S READING, AND THE DISAGREEMENT HOLDS ABLE LEARNERS BACK FOR UP TO A YEAR. حفظ fixes its method hinge (تلقين سمعي → نظر ثم حفظ) at G4 and justifies it by asserting decoding is only at 'word level at G3, short-sentence level at G4'. القراءة والتهجي — the subject that actually owns decoding — says the child performs 'first decoding of the muṣḥaf's shortest sūrahs of جزء عمّ' at G2 and passes an end-of-G3 GATE of reading an UNSEEN muṣḥaf page at phrase level. Both cannot be true. On القراءة's own schedule (20-25 min/day at G1-G2, i.e. well over 100 hours of primer work per year — more than a قاعدة نورانية course normally needs) a typical child is decoding connected muṣḥaf text by end of G2. There is also an operational contradiction inside a single 60-minute hour: حفظ mandates 'بلا مصحف بيد الطالب' at G1-G2 and eye-following only at G3, while القراءة has the same child holding and decoding the muṣḥaf in the adjacent sub-block. A single cohort-wide hinge at G4 is in any case the wrong instrument: it is guaranteed to be a year late for the strong reader and a year early for the weak one.
objections.recommendation: Resolve the conflict by making القراءة والتهجي the single owner of the published reading-progression ladder, and rewrite حفظ's prerequisite list to match it. Then make the method hinge CRITERION-REFERENCED, not grade-referenced: an individual child converts to نظر ثم حفظ when he passes the القراءة gate — which for some will be mid-G3 and for others G5 — with G4 stated as the expected median, not the rule. State the muṣḥaf rule explicitly and identically in both lifecycles ('the muṣḥaf is open in the child's hand during the القراءة sub-block from G2; it is closed during the تلقين sub-block until the child passes the decoding gate') and give the child the reason, so the same hour does not appear to contain two contradictory rules about the same book.

objections.grade: G4 (النشيد والمحفوظات) — القصيدة اللامية في السنة
objections.objection: A CONTESTED CREEDAL TEXT PLACED AT AGE 9 WITH NO GRADE ASSIGNED TO UNPACK IT. The DG's identification makes the submission's G4 slot live again, and the DG's own note (b) asks which grade unpacks it. On the architecture as submitted the answer is: none. Memorise-now/comprehend-later is legitimate and traditional — but its legitimacy differs by text type. It is unproblematic for the Qur'an (which carries its own warrant) and for procedural متون such as تحفة الأطفال, whose content the child applies the same week he chants it. A versified creed on الصفات، خلق القرآن and الرؤية is a third category: contested propositions, historically polemical, which a 9-year-old will repeat as flat assertions to family and community without being able to state what is being denied, by whom, or why it mattered. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] A child at 9 cannot yet distinguish 'this is my school's position in a real historical dispute' from 'this is what everyone knows', which is the exact developmental limitation redline 6 recognised for نواقض الإسلام. Nothing between G4 and G11 touches آيات الصفات or المتشابه; أصول التفسير G11 is the first and only place, and it arrives seven years late and in a meta-discipline, not in عقيدة.
objections.recommendation: Do not place it at G4. Place it at G9-G10, inside العقيدة rather than inside النشيد, as a paired memorisation-plus-exposition unit: the same grade that memorises it explains it, with the historical controversy named and the school's position stated as a position. This satisfies the DG's note (b) by construction rather than by promise. If the Council nevertheless wants it memorised young, the absolute minimum condition is that a named grade and a named subject be written into the architecture as the unpacking owner before approval, and that G4 teachers be given a scripted framing that the lines are being learned now to be understood later — not as a creed the child is to argue.

objections.grade: G6 (التفسير × الترجمة × أصول التفسير)
objections.objection: THE G6 BLOCK CARRIES FIVE SIMULTANEOUS DEMANDS, AND ONE OF THEM RESTS ON A COMPETENCE THE SCHOOL NEVER TEACHES. Two periods a week (80 minutes) at G6 are asked to carry: verse-by-verse Arabic tafsir; إعراب application using الآجرومية acquired the same year; صرف application using البناء acquired the same year; rendering into ENGLISH; rendering into YORUBA; plus أصول التفسير's three مضمّن habits with a parallel-verse notebook. For an 11-year-old that is the 'miniature university timetable' failure displaced from G1 to G6. Worse, التفسير's own prerequisite list disposes of the hardest dependency in a single line — 'Yoruba and English literacy sufficient to render meaning accurately — supplied by the separate morning national curriculum (outside this scope)'. Yoruba literacy, with its subdots and tone diacritics, is a taught skill of highly variable provision; if the child cannot write Yoruba accurately, an INDEPENDENTLY ASSESSED G6 outcome is measuring the morning curriculum's Yoruba teaching, not this school's tafsir teaching. An out-of-scope, unverified assumption must not sit underneath an assessed outcome.
objections.recommendation: At G6 the block carries تفسير + ONE written target language (English, which the child is certainly being taught to write), with Yoruba rendering ORAL ONLY and assessed orally — which preserves redline 8 intact, since redline 8 requires meaningful Arabic content rendered into English and Yoruba, not written Yoruba. Introduce written Yoruba rendering at G8, conditional on a verified Yoruba-literacy check. At G6 restrict أصول التفسير to habit (1) القرآن يفسّر بعضه بعضًا only, deferring the rest to G7, and restrict إعراب application to verses already parsed in that week's نحو lesson rather than fresh parsing inside the tafsir hour.

objections.grade: G1-G12 (حفظ × القراءة والتهجي × التجويد × التفسير × النشيد)
objections.objection: FOUR SUBJECTS EACH DECLARE 'ZERO PERIODS — I LIVE INSIDE THE QUR'AN HOUR' AND NOBODY HAS ADDED UP THE MINUTES. At G1 the claims are: القراءة والتهجي 20-25 min/day; النشيد 4-6 min/day at the opening of the القراءة block (whether inside or on top of the 20-25 is not stated); التجويد articulation correction مضمّن, unquantified; التفسير oral meaning-giving, unquantified; and حفظ itself, which also mandates that the 60 minutes be split into two sub-blocks with movement between them. The residue for actual new memorisation is roughly 30 minutes minus two transitions. That happens to be survivable at G1 because the G1 target (~22 short surahs) is modest — but at G3 the same hour must carry 15 min of decoding, the تجويد diagnostic screen, the تفسير word-meaning assessment, a new ورد from جزء تبارك, daily مراجعة, AND periodic سرد متصل of the whole of جزء عمّ, which alone runs 35-45 minutes on the days it occurs. Three subjects are also nested: النشيد inside القراءة inside the ring-fenced hour. No one owns the minute. More seriously, the constitutional wording — لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى — is arguably being breached by consent rather than by conflict: at G1-G2 roughly half the protected hour is literacy instruction, not Qur'an.
objections.recommendation: Before approval, publish a single MINUTE BUDGET for the ring-fenced hour at each grade G1-G12, summing to exactly 60, signed off by all claimant subjects, showing: ورد جديد / مراجعة / تهجي أو قراءة / تصحيح تجويدي / معنى / إقراء / transitions. Put سرد متصل days on the calendar as named events with their own protected time rather than assuming they fit a normal day. Ask the Council to rule explicitly that decoding, meaning and articulation delivered inside the hour count as SERVING the Qur'an hour and are not an اقتطاع — a ruling the architecture currently assumes it already has.

objections.grade: G1-G3 (whole programme — scheduling)
objections.objection: NEW ACQUISITION IS SCHEDULED AT THE WORST HOUR OF THE CHILD'S WEEK, AND THE YOUNGEST CHILD HAS NO REST DAY. The school runs Mon/Tue/Wed 2:00-6:00pm and Sat/Sun 9:00am-3:00pm. For a 5-6 year old, the weekday Qur'an hour lands in the post-lunch trough AFTER a full morning of the national curriculum, and the two weekend days remove the rest days entirely: 39 weeks with no unstructured day. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Encoding of novel verbal material at that age is materially worse under accumulated fatigue than at first-session freshness; review and overlearned rehearsal are far more robust to it. Not one of the six lifecycles addresses where in the week its content sits — every one of them treats the five hours as interchangeable. حفظ's G1 row is the only place that shows any awareness of the child's state, and it addresses block length, not time of day.
objections.recommendation: At G1-G3, place الورد الجديد (new acquisition) in the Saturday and Sunday 9:00am blocks, at the front of the session, and make the three weekday afternoon hours predominantly مراجعة, chant, تلقين by ear and oral meaning-giving — all overlearned or low-encoding-load activity. This changes nothing constitutionally: it is still 60 min × 5 days × 39 weeks. Additionally ask the Council to rule on a reduced weekend attendance at G1-G2 (one weekend day rather than two), since the G1-G2 dawām is already recovered as reduced and the seven-day week is a welfare question the curriculum cannot answer by itself.

objections.grade: G1-G2 (حفظ، القراءة والتهجي، التجويد، النشيد)
objections.objection: THREE OR MORE ASSESSMENT LINES ON A FIVE-YEAR-OLD, WITH NO STIPULATION OF FORM. From Programme 1 alone the G1 child carries: حفظ 'independently assessed', القراءة والتهجي 'independently assessed', التجويد 'embedded assessment', النشيد 'embedded assessment' — before Programmes 2 and 3 add anything. The standing instruction for G1-G3 is 'rich but clean — not a miniature university timetable'. The period count honours it (zero of seven, which is genuinely excellent); the ASSESSMENT count does not. What makes this actionable rather than pedantic is that no lifecycle says what 'independently assessed' MEANS at age 5. حفظ is scrupulous about this at G9 ('issued honestly, in juz, never as pass/fail') and says nothing about it at G1, where the stakes for a child's relationship to the Qur'an are far higher. A ranked mark on a 5-year-old's Qur'an recitation, in a community where parents compare, is how a child learns at 5 that the Qur'an is a thing he is bad at.
objections.recommendation: Stipulate in the architecture that at G1-G2 every independent assessment in Programme 1 is oral, individual, formative, teacher-recorded, and reported as a descriptive profile against named milestones — no numeric mark, no rank, no pass/fail, no cohort comparison on any document a parent sees. Cap Programme 1's G1-G2 report lines at TWO (حفظ, and القراءة والتهجي), with تجويد and النشيد reported as narrative comments inside those two rather than as lines of their own.

objections.grade: G1-G2 (حفظ القرآن — block structure)
objections.objection: THE TWO-SUB-BLOCK SPLIT IS THE RIGHT INSTINCT AND STILL TOO COARSE. حفظ correctly rejects a monolithic 60-minute seated block at G1 and splits it into two of 25-30 minutes. But sustained attention to a seated verbal-repetition task at ages 5-6 runs closer to 10-15 minutes, and this hour sits at the end of a full school day. A 25-30 minute sub-block will, in practice, deliver its last ten minutes to a child who is no longer encoding, which is worse than a break because it trains the child to be present and disengaged in the Qur'an hour — a habit that then has to be broken at G3.
objections.recommendation: At G1, structure the hour as four micro-blocks of ~12-13 minutes with deliberate state changes between them, and write the state change into the METHOD rather than treating it as a break: standing group chant → seated individual تسميع → eye-following → movement-based letter/sura recall. At G2, three blocks of ~18 minutes. Return to the two-block structure from G3. This costs nothing and is fully compatible with the ring-fence.

objections.grade: G5-G7 (القراءة والتهجي)
objections.objection: THE REMEDIATION CLINIC IS THE PLACE A QUARTER OF THE COHORT WILL BE SENT, AND IT HAS NO PERIODS, NO TEACHER AND NO TIMETABLE. القراءة والتهجي terminates at G5 behind a hard exit gate — first-sight fluent reading of an unseen vocalised muṣḥaf page — and routes non-attainers to a دوراني clinic 'outside the cohort curriculum... governed on the parallel track'. In any real cohort, and particularly in an afternoon/weekend school with variable attendance and mixed prior slate-school exposure, a substantial minority will not clear that gate at G5. The design then removes their only decoding instruction and routes them to an entity with no allocation. From G6 onward every single subject in this programme — الجزرية, التفسير العملي, and later every matn — assumes first-sight reading. A child who cannot decode at G6 will sit through six years of instruction he cannot access, and the architecture will not notice because nothing after G5 assesses reading at all.
objections.recommendation: Fund the clinic: 1 period/week at G6 and G7 from the 19-period ceiling (affordable precisely because Programme 1 spends only 2-3 periods at G6-G7), with a named teacher and a two-year cap. Publish an expected attainment rate for the G5 gate; if more than about a fifth of a cohort fails it, the school must treat that as evidence about the gate or the teaching, not about the children, and review G1-G3 delivery. Re-test decoding once at G7 for every pupil, not just referrals — a silent assumption must be checked at least once after the subject dies.

objections.grade: G3 (التجويد — diagnostic articulation screen)
objections.objection: THE BEST INSTRUMENT IN THE SUBMISSION IS COSTED AT ZERO, WHICH MEANS IT WILL NOT HAPPEN. The G3 screen — every child recorded on all 28 letters in isolation, in a word, and in a Qur'anic phrase, every error typed by category, a written remediation plan per child — is developmentally exactly right and I want it protected. But it is declared to cost 0 periods on the grounds that it runs 'inside the Qur'an hour'. For a halaqah of twenty children, recording alone is 200-300 minutes of hour time — a full week of the protected hour — before any analysis, and the per-child typing and remediation planning is many hours of teacher work that no lifecycle budgets. Costing a real instrument at zero is how the instrument becomes a tick-box the teacher completes from memory at the end of term, which is worse than not having it, because the school will then believe it has screened.
objections.recommendation: Fund it honestly and shrink it to what is diagnostic: a ~40-item screen built on the L1 interference set and minimal pairs (ح/ه، ع/ء، ق/ك، ص/س، ط/ت، ض/د، ذ/ز/ظ، غ/خ, plus مد length and gemination), each item in isolation and in one Qur'anic word — not all 28 letters in three environments. Run it in a named assessment window with released teacher time, and state the teacher-hours in the allocation so the Board is approving a real cost. Pair it with حفظ's intake hearing screen, since an uncorrected mild hearing loss and an articulation error are indistinguishable on this instrument.

objections.grade: G10-G12 (حفظ القرآن — review arithmetic)
objections.objection: THE REVIEW TARGETS DO NOT CLOSE, SO THE SCHOOL WILL CERTIFY JUZ THE GRADUATE CANNOT HOLD. At G12 the hour is stated as ~60% مراجعة / 20% ورد جديد / 20% إقراء, against a cumulative floor of 22 juz and an expected band of 25-30, with a review architecture guaranteeing every memorised juz is recited at least monthly (established at G8) and a G11 المراجعة الكبرى of the entire stock before a panel. 60% of 60 minutes is 36 minutes a day. A monthly full cycle over 22 juz is ~440 pages a month, i.e. ~20 pages per school day, in 36 minutes — under two minutes a page, which is at or below the physical floor of حدر recitation with zero time for correction, and it leaves nothing for the 20% إقراء the same row demands. The G11 panel المراجعة الكبرى is not in the hour at all. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] When a retention schedule cannot physically execute, what degrades is not the schedule but the standard: the monthly cycle silently becomes quarterly, the إتقان threshold is applied loosely, and the school certifies a number of juz the graduate cannot recite six months after leaving. That is the central 'encountered, not possessed' failure of any ḥifẓ programme.
objections.recommendation: Recompute the G10-G12 hour from the review requirement backwards rather than from the acquisition target forwards, and lower the acquisition floor until the arithmetic closes — a defensible, honestly certified 18 juz is worth more than a nominal 22 that decays. Reduce the guaranteed review cycle from monthly to six-weekly beyond 15 juz and say so explicitly. Schedule the G11 المراجعة الكبرى as a named calendared block with its own time, not inside the daily hour. Retain حفظ's own excellent rule that a juz counts as محفوظ only at a stated إتقان standard — that rule is the thing that protects the certificate, and it only works if the target is reachable.

objections.grade: G10-G11 (النشيد والمحفوظات)
objections.objection: THE SUBJECT IS HANDED TO TWO HOSTS THAT MAY NOT EXIST, AND WILL SILENTLY DISAPPEAR FOR TWO YEARS IF THEY DO NOT. النشيد becomes مضمّن inside النقد والآداب at G10 and inside الإنشاء والخطابة at G11, and flags both as [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] because neither host is allocated. Its last dedicated time is one term at G9 and its next is one term at G12. If the hosts do not materialise, an able 15-16 year old — precisely at the age where memorised classical verse becomes assimilable as literature rather than as sound, and precisely after G8-G9 have built the ear for metre — carries no repertoire at all for two years and then is asked at G12 to curate a portfolio and perform a new قصيدة cold. This is the 'able learner held back' failure in its clearest form in this programme.
objections.recommendation: Write a conditional into the lifecycle now rather than discovering it in 2029: if النقد والآداب and الإنشاء والخطابة are not allocated at G10-G11, النشيد reverts to دوراني — one term of 1 period at each of G10 and G11 — continuing the G8-G9 pattern with بانت سعاد and the المعلقات selection as already specified. State also that whichever host exists absorbs the memorisation-and-delivery standard as a named, separately traceable outcome, so the competency is not lost inside a literature grade.

objections.grade: G5 / G8-G9 (النشيد والمحفوظات) — الفواكه الساقطة
objections.objection: THE ARCHITECTURAL ARGUMENT IS STRONG AND THE G5 PLACEMENT IS UNSUPPORTABLE. The DG's point — that this brings indigenous West African Arabic scholarship into the memorisation strand rather than only Eastern classical texts — is genuinely important developmentally, not merely symbolically: a Yoruba-speaking child who meets Arabic scholarship exclusively as something produced elsewhere and long ago forms a different relationship to the discipline than one who knows his own region produces it. That argument should be accepted. But the specific placement cannot be: the work's length, register and contents remain unverified, and its fitness for a MEMORISATION strand is entirely unestablished — [UNVERIFIED] whether it is verse at all. Placing an unread text at G5 (age 10), in a slot whose whole justification is that pieces lengthen to 12-20 line units, is placing a load of unknown size on a known-tight year.
objections.recommendation: Adopt the PRINCIPLE now as a standing requirement: the محفوظات repertoire must include at least one named West African work, explicitly identified to the pupils as such. Do not place this title until a physical copy has been obtained and assessed for genre, length and reading level. Provisionally earmark G8-G9 — the دوراني terms, where the learner can parse rather than only echo — and accept that if the work proves to be prose it belongs in النقد والآداب or التاريخ الإسلامي, not in النشيد. Under no circumstances substitute another text to fill the G5 slot; the G5 slot should simply close and its lines return to the school مجموعة.

objections.grade: G6-G7 (النشيد والمحفوظات × التجويد)
objections.objection: THE MEMORISATION SERVICE THAT MAKES THE متون TRACTABLE IS WITHDRAWN IN THE YEAR IT IS MOST NEEDED. النشيد states at G4-G5 that one of its two functions is supplying the chanted تلقين by which تحفة الأطفال is committed to memory — that is, تحفة's memorisation is quietly cross-subsidised by another subject's minutes, which is fine and clever. At G6 النشيد contracts to مضمّن and cuts its literary load, explicitly because of the متن pile-up, and says the technical متون 'are assessed by their owning subjects'. But الجزرية at G6-G7 is roughly 107 lines against تحفة's 61, at 2 periods a week, and no lifecycle now says who provides the chanted تلقين method for it. التجويد's G6-G7 rows describe مخارج demonstration and production drill, not memorisation technique. The likely outcome is that الجزرية is assigned as homework memorisation to an 11-year-old and arrives half-learned.
objections.recommendation: State explicitly that النشيد's contraction at G6-G7 is a contraction of REPERTOIRE, not of METHOD SERVICE: the chanted تلقين function continues unbroken for الجزرية at G6-G7 exactly as it ran for تحفة at G4-G5, at zero additional period cost, inside اللغة العربية's opening minutes. Write the service into both lifecycles so neither subject can assume the other is doing it.

objections.grade: G9-G12 (التجويد) — علم القراءات
objections.objection: THE ABLE SENIOR HAS NOWHERE TO GO IN THIS DISCIPLINE, AND THE ORPHANED TEXTS PROVE IT. التجويد declares علم التجويد a finite syllabus complete at G8, then runs G9 consolidation, G10 مضمّن certification, a one-term G11 إقراء unit, and G12 as reproduction. The texts table lists الشاطبية, المكتفى and منار الهدى with grade '—'. Meanwhile حفظ G10 states that a student who has already completed 30 juz 'converts the hour entirely' to review — for three further years, 585 hours, with no new discipline offered. For a school with declared international ambitions and an opt-in إجازة track, the student capable at G11 of مدخل إلى علم القراءات or of the differences between the transmitted روايات is offered nothing at all, and the orphaned texts are neither assigned nor declared out of scope. That is the opposite failure to the one this review usually catches: not a child rushed, but a capable 16-year-old parked.
objections.recommendation: Assign مدخل إلى علم القراءات — at minimum the concept of الرواية and the principal differences between the school's declared رواية and one other — explicitly to the parallel opt-in إجازة track at G11-G12, governed like the Ḥifẓ Track under redline 2, at zero cost to the 19-period ceiling. If the Council declines, then say so in the architecture: move الشاطبية and المكتفى from the texts table to a stated 'out of scope at SHRS, for post-secondary study' note, so that no teacher improvises them and no able student is told there is nothing further. Also note that the house رواية ruling flagged by both حفظ and التجويد is a prerequisite for even this minimal step and remains undecided.

objections.grade: G9 and G11 (أصول التفسير)
objections.objection: THE جمع القرآن UNIT IS PITCHED DESCRIPTIVELY AT EXACTLY THE AGE THE ADOLESCENT WILL MEET IT POLEMICALLY ELSEWHERE. The G9 وحدة مدخل إلى علوم القرآن is well judged in its restraint — نزول منجّمًا، المكي والمدني، أسباب النزول، جمع القرآن في عهد أبي بكر وعثمان ورسم المصحف, taught as history and not yet as method. I would keep the restraint. But a 14-year-old in Nigeria with a phone will encounter the adversarial version of the compilation narrative, framed as a discovery being kept from him, within months of being taught the neutral version. A purely descriptive account that never acknowledges that anyone makes an argument out of this leaves him with the impression, later, that the school told him half the story. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] Adolescence is the developmental window in which a perceived omission by an authority is read as concealment, and it is the window in which inoculation works.
objections.recommendation: Keep G9 descriptive as designed — 14 is too early for the critical treatment and the lifecycle is right about that. Add one named lesson in the G11 مستقل year, where تواتر، إسناد and the صحيح/حسن/ضعيف apparatus from مصطلح الحديث are actually available, whose stated job is to name the common objections about جمع القرآن and رسم المصحف and work through them with the student. Write it into the G11 content list so it is not left to whichever teacher happens to be asked.

objections.grade: G6 (التجويد) — الصفات ذات الضد
objections.objection: TERMS WITH NO PERFORMANCE CONSEQUENCE ARE BEING TAUGHT AS ASSESSED CATEGORIES TO AN ELEVEN-YEAR-OLD. The G6 row teaches the full الصفات اللازمة ذات الضد set including الإذلاق والإصمات. الهمس/الجهر، الشدة/التوسط/الرخاوة، الاستعلاء/الاستفال، الإطباق/الانفتاح all have consequences the child can hear in his own mouth and produce on demand — they are competencies. الإذلاق/الإصمات is a classificatory property of the letters with essentially no bearing on how the child recites; assessed as a named category at G6 it is the definition of recognising a term without possessing a competency, in the single most overloaded year of the ladder.
objections.recommendation: At G6 assess only the four contrastive pairs the child can produce and hear, each demonstrated on his own articulation. Let الإذلاق والإصمات be memorised as part of the matn without being an assessed category, and treat them at recognition level at G7 where they belong, inside the text rather than on the examination.

objections.grade: G1 (حفظ القرآن) — intake screening
objections.objection: THE HEARING SCREEN IS CORRECT AND SCOPED TOO NARROWLY. حفظ's first prerequisite — that functional hearing and auditory discrimination be SCREENED at intake rather than assumed, because an undetected mild loss is indistinguishable from 'a slow child' in a تلقين halaqah — is the single best developmental observation in the submission and must be protected. But it is written as a G1 intake item, and a Nigerian private school of this kind takes transfer pupils at every grade. A child entering at G6 from a slate school carries the same risk and arrives into a year with no decoding instruction left to diagnose him.
objections.recommendation: Extend the screen to EVERY intake at every grade, not G1 only, and pair it at mid-ladder entry with the shortened G3 articulation screen and a decoding placement check from القراءة والتهجي. Name a provider and a cost in the allocation so it is a funded procedure rather than an aspiration.

objections.grade: G3 (حفظ القرآن)
objections.objection: THE سرد متصل MILESTONE HAS NO TIME ALLOCATED ON THE DAYS IT OCCURS. G3 requires إتقان جزء عمّ كاملاً بالسرد المتصل في جلسة واحدة — continuous unprompted recitation of the whole juz in one sitting by an eight-year-old. As a milestone it is excellent and parent-legible. But it runs 35-45 minutes of continuous recitation, in an hour that on the same design also owes 15 minutes to decoding, a new ورد from جزء تبارك, daily مراجعة and the تفسير meaning check — and it demands sustained single-task attention from an 8-year-old at the end of a school day, which is at the outer edge of what that age sustains.
objections.recommendation: Calendar the سرد متصل as named events — once per term, in a Saturday morning block, with the full hour given to it and nothing else scheduled — and allow it to be taken in two halves at G3 with the single-sitting version required only at the end-of-year attempt. Record it as a milestone achieved, never as a timed test.

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: THE MEANING GAP (التفسير × حفظ, G5-G12). The two subjects jointly enforce 'do not explain what is not memorised' and neither checked its converse. حفظ closes its cheap, zero-period, meaning-at-the-point-of-memorisation layer at G5 — exactly when the child leaves the مفصّل and starts on البقرة — and تفسير's own coverage (جزء عم, جزء تبارك, الحجرات, لقمان, يوسف, half of البقرة, selected آيات) never catches the ḥifẓ front again. Roughly three quarters of the twenty-plus juz the graduate is certified to hold is never explained at any grade by any subject. Concretely, a 10-13 year old memorises the legal, polemical and قتال material of البقرة–المائدة–التوبة with no framing whatsoever, in a Yoruba-speaking Nigerian context with live inter-religious sensitivity — while the architecture, by redline 6, insists on protective descriptive framing for one short fiqh text at G5 on precisely the ground that a child could misapply it to family and community. The principle has been applied to the smallest text and withheld from the largest corpus. This is also the DG's own note (b) — memorise now, comprehend later, but name the grade that unpacks it — scaled from one poem to twenty juz, and the answer the architecture currently gives is 'no grade'. The fix costs zero periods because the mechanism already exists at G1-G4: keep the مضمّن meaning layer running inside the ring-fenced hour for the whole ladder, tracking the ḥifẓ front, delivered by the same teacher in five to eight minutes a day.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives:
Several things here are better than what most schools of this type ever write down, and they should be protected explicitly in the approved text so that later revisions cannot quietly erode them.

1. ZERO PERIODS AT G1-G2 FROM ALL SIX SUBJECTS. An entire programme makes no claim at all on the tightest budget in the ladder. That is the single strongest developmental feature of this submission and the reason G1-G2 is not a miniature university timetable in period terms. Protect it by writing it as a standing rule: Programme 1 may not request a timetabled period at G1-G2 under any future revision.

2. حفظ G1-G2 تلقين WITHOUT A MUṢḤAF IN THE CHILD'S HAND, and the split block. Refusing to make a pre-literate 5-year-old stare at a text he cannot decode is developmentally correct and unusual. The G3 النظر المصاحب step — page-image anchoring a full year before decoding load — is a genuinely sophisticated piece of sequencing.

3. القراءة والتهجي PLANNING ITS OWN DEATH AT G5, and refusing مستقل status on the ground that decoding severed from the text being decoded is dead drill. A subject that declines to perpetuate itself once its function is complete is rare; both judgements are right.

4. التجويد AT G4 AND NOT G3. The argument — that تحفة's first half is rule-triggering on a VISUAL cue, so the child must first be able to see and sort سكون / تنوين / شدة on the page, or the matn becomes a chant he never applies — is exactly the right form of reasoning and reaches the right answer.

5. THE G8 وقف والابتداء UNIT DEFERRED UNTIL النحو EXISTS. The best single piece of prerequisite reasoning in the submission: recognising that where a meaning completes is a syntactic judgement, not a phonetic one, and refusing to teach it at G6-G7 where it would have been a list to memorise.

6. أصول التفسير REFUSING TO DIFFERENTIATE BEFORE G11 AND DECLINING مستقل STATUS AT G12. A meta-discipline that declines to inflate itself, declines to be introduced as a third meta-discipline in the same year as مصطلح الحديث and أصول الفقه on explicit cognitive-load grounds, and states that keeping it مستقل at G12 would force the invention of filler. That is the correct instinct in all three places.

7. النشيد CONTRACTING AT G6. The only subject in the programme that looked sideways, saw the متن pile-up, and gave something up. It should be commended in front of the other five.

8. THE INTAKE HEARING SCREEN and the G3 ARTICULATION SCREEN. Both are the right instruments for the right reason — that an undetected hearing loss or a fossilised L1 substitution is otherwise misread as a slow child for years. They need funding, not defending.

9. THE FIXED MUṢḤAF EDITION FROM G4, NEVER CHANGED, and the insistence that the house رواية be settled before G1. Page-image anchoring is a real retention mechanism and this is the correct structural protection of it.

10. THE RULE THAT NO SEPARATE MATN IS MEMORISED INSIDE THE تفسير LESSON, and that تفسير works only on what is already or currently being memorised. Keep the rule; fix the coverage gap it has concealed (see the strongest objection).

11. التفسير G1-G4 GIVING MEANING IN YORUBA AT THE POINT OF MEMORISATION. First-language meaning-attachment for a 5-9 year old is correct and cheap; the error is stopping it, not starting it.

12. تجويد G11's INSTRUCTION ON HOW TO CORRECT A SEVEN-YEAR-OLD WITHOUT SHAMING HIM. The right instinct, in the right place, and the seed of the safeguarding policy the programme still needs.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن + القراءة والتهجي + التفسير + النشيد — G1, G2, G3 (the ring-fenced hour)
objections.objection: The 60-minute Qur'an hour is claimed by four subjects and has never been budgeted in minutes. Add the claims as written: حفظ G1 states the hour 'is SPLIT into two sub-blocks of ~25-30 min' (= 50-60 min); القراءة والتهجي claims 20-25 min/day at G1 and 20 at G2; التفسير claims an oral meaning gloss at the point of memorisation (realistically 3-5 min); النشيد claims 4-6 min (it at least locates itself inside the القراءة block, so it is not double-counted). Total claimed at G1: 73-90 minutes against 60 — oversubscribed by 22% to 50%. G2 is the same. G3 adds a 15-min تهجي slice plus the تجويد diagnostic screen 'run inside the Qur'an hour', on top of a حفظ milestone of 'إتقان جزء عمّ كاملاً بالسرد المتصل في جلسة واحدة' — a single child's continuous سرد of juz 30 is 30-40 minutes on its own. Every one of the six lifecycles reports its own cost as 'ZERO periods' and is individually truthful; nobody has added them up. This is precisely the failure the ring-fence invites: because the hour is constitutionally protected it is treated as free, and five subjects have been quietly funded out of it.
objections.recommendation: Do not approve Programme 1 without a MINUTE BUDGET TABLE for the hour at every grade G1-G12, summing to exactly 60, signed by all six subject owners. My proposed G1-G2 figures: حفظ 30 (two sub-blocks of 15, not 25-30), القراءة والتهجي 20, نشيد 5 (opening the تهجي block), تفسير 5, تجويد 0 additional (correction inside the حفظ block). حفظ must formally amend its G1 text from '~25-30 min' to '~15 min'. At G3: حفظ 40, تهجي 15, تفسير 5. The G3 'سرد متصل في جلسة واحدة' milestone must be re-specified as an individually scheduled assessment event outside the daily rotation, not something the daily hour can absorb.

objections.grade: التفسير G6-G7 vs القراءة والتهجي G6 vs أصول التفسير G6
objections.objection: التفسير العملي للقرآن والترجمة is budgeted TWICE, in two different currencies, by two different lifecycles. القراءة والتهجي #3 at G6 says its vacated minutes 'pass to التفسير العملي للقرآن + الترجمة … inside a constitutionally fixed 60 minutes' — i.e. التفسير at G6-G7 lives in the hour and costs nothing. التفسير #5 at G6 says '2 periods of 19'. أصول التفسير #6 at G6 relies on التفسير 'which already has its own separate block'. Both cannot be true; the difference is 2 periods a week at G6 and again at G7, at the single densest year of the ladder. Worse, the القراءة والتهجي version is constitutionally defective: the ring-fence reads لا تُقتطع لصالح مادة أخرى, and moving a non-Qur'an-memorisation subject into the hour is exactly a cut in favour of another subject. It also collides head-on with حفظ, whose G6-G7 floors are +2 and +2.5 juz — its heaviest acquisition years to that point — which cannot be delivered from a residual 40 minutes.
objections.recommendation: Rule that التفسير العملي at G6-G7 is timetabled from the 19-period ceiling at 2 periods, NOT from the hour, and strike the transfer clause from القراءة والتهجي's G6 entry. The minutes that القراءة والتهجي vacates at G6 return to حفظ (which needs them for the G6-G7 acquisition step-up), not to a third subject. If the Council instead wants التفسير in the hour, that is a constitutional amendment to the ring-fence and must be minuted as one.

objections.grade: أصول التفسير G10-G11 vs التفسير G10
objections.objection: Two lifecycles place مقدمة في أصول التفسير لابن تيمية in different grades, on mutually exclusive arguments, and each was written believing it had the decision. التفسير #5 at G10 states 'أصول التفسير must be in place by this grade… my recommendation is that it be مدمج into التفسير's own block' with مقدمة ابن تيمية as the text. أصول التفسير #6 places the same matn at G11 مستقل and argues explicitly that G10 is impossible, because مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10-G11 (accepted redline 1) and التفسير بالمأثور cannot be taught before the learner can ask whether a report is established, and because stacking a third meta-discipline into G10 alongside مصطلح and أصول الفقه is a load failure. On the merits #6 is right and #5 is wrong — but #5's G10 content ('the method vocabulary named', التفسير التحليلي of البقرة) is built on a supplier that arrives a year after it is used.
objections.recommendation: Adopt #6: أصول التفسير is مستقل at G11, 2 periods, with مقدمة ابن تيمية. Amend التفسير G10 to strike 'the method vocabulary named' and the أصول التفسير interface entirely; G10 التفسير runs as verse-by-verse تحليلي with إعراب and (if البلاغة exists) بلاغة, and the method is named at G11 and applied retrospectively to the G10 البقرة work as the G11 opening exercise. Both lifecycle documents must be edited so the Council sees one placement, not two.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن G9 vs التجويد G11
objections.objection: Prerequisite inversion with a child-protection edge. حفظ #1 at G9 institutes 'First supervised إقراء duty: G9 students take structured تسميع from G1-G2 children'. التجويد #2 puts وحدة الإقراء وتصحيح التلاوة at G11 — the unit that teaches error typing (مخرج / صفة / حكم / مقدار مد / وقف / جلي vs خفي), the prescription of corrective drills, and 'how to correct a seven-year-old without shaming him'. So for two full years, untrained 14-15 year olds are placed in front of 6 year olds at exactly the stage where, by حفظ's own prerequisite list, 'memorized mispronunciation fossilizes and later costs more to remediate than the original acquisition cost'. A G9 who cannot type an error either lets it pass or mis-corrects it, and either way the damage lands on the youngest cohort in the school. The irony is that التجويد's own stated prerequisites for the unit — الجزرية complete at G7, the وقف unit at G8 — are all satisfied by the end of G8. G11 is later than the discipline requires.
objections.recommendation: Move وحدة الإقراء وتصحيح التلاوة from G11 to G9, term 1, 2 periods for one term. تجويد G9 is currently مضمّن with explicitly 'no new doctrine', so the year has the capacity. حفظ's G9 إقراء duty then begins in term 2, after the unit, not before it. This also relieves the G11 period peak (see the G11 aggregate objection) by 2. Until the unit runs, no student below G11 takes تسميع from a child unsupervised, and the supervising teacher — not the student — records the error log.

objections.grade: حفظ القرآن G10, G11, G12
objections.objection: The senior acquisition floors are arithmetically impossible against the hour splits stated in the same entries. Take the figures as given: 195 hours/year = 11,700 minutes. At G8, acquisition dominates (call it 55-60% of the hour) = roughly 110 hours for +2.5 juz ≈ 50 pages ≈ 130 min/page. At G10 the entry says مراجعة rises to ~50%, leaving ~97 hours for +3 juz (60 pages) = 97 min/page. At G12 the entry fixes the split at '~60% مراجعة كبرى وسرد، ~20% ورد جديد، ~20% إقراء' — 20% of 195 hours is 39 hours, against a floor of +3 juz = 60 pages = 39 min/page. That is three times the G8 acquisition rate on one third of the time, while simultaneously carrying مراجعة of a 19-22 juz stock and teaching a junior halaqah. The floors and the splits were plainly written independently of each other. A floor a student cannot hit is not a floor; it is a guaranteed failure rate at the exit year, published in a certificate.
objections.recommendation: Hold the splits and cut the floors, since the splits encode the correct pedagogy for those years. Revised floors: G10 +2.5 (cumulative 15.5), G11 +2 (17.5), G12 +1.5 (19), with the published band for the full-course student stated as 19-24 and the Ḥifẓ Track student at 30. Alternatively hold the floors and move the inversion a year later (G12 split becomes 40/40/20), but then the G12 certification workload has nowhere to sit. Either way حفظ must publish one table of {grade, % acquisition, hours, pages, min/page} so the rate curve is visible and monotonic.

objections.grade: All six subjects — G1-G12 (operational staffing of the ring-fenced hour)
objections.objection: No lifecycle states the most consequential operational fact in the programme: the 60-minute hour runs at EVERY grade, every day. With one class per grade that is twelve simultaneous specialist halaqāt, five days a week, each needing a teacher who can run تلقين, hear لحن خفي, and take individual تسميع. The school's dawām is Mon-Wed 2-6pm and Sat-Sun 9am-3pm, which is a genuinely constrained labour pool — these are not full-time daytime posts. Layered on top: حفظ G10 says 30-juz completers 'convert the hour entirely', which means two differentiated halaqāt per grade at G10-G12 precisely where the most qualified staff are needed; التجويد G6-G7 requires a teacher who can demonstrate مخارج and صفات physically (a مقرئ, and a school will have one, not twelve); the إجازة track at G11-G12 requires a مُقرئ مجاز بالسند, who is a named individual, not a recruitable role at this market's salary; and the G12 تفسير capstone requires an assessor competent in Arabic, English and Yoruba simultaneously. Separately, the throughput arithmetic is unmodelled: at G3, a 40-minute حفظ slice shared by a halaqah of 15 gives each child under 3 minutes of individual تسميع a day, which cannot deliver the stated G3 milestone.
objections.recommendation: Publish a staffing model before approval containing: (a) maximum halaqah size by stage (I would propose 10 at G1-G3, 15 at G4-G7, 20 at G8-G12, on the basis that individual تسميع time per child is the binding resource, not seats); (b) the resulting number of concurrent Qur'an-hour teachers and the number that must be مقرئ-grade; (c) an explicit ruling on whether any grades are combined into multi-grade halaqāt — noting that combining breaks the per-grade content ladder every lifecycle assumes; (d) named identification of the مُقرئ مجاز, with the إجازة track declared NOT OFFERED in any year no such person is on staff, rather than promised and then withdrawn.

objections.grade: All six subjects — precondition to G1 (الرواية والرسم)
objections.objection: Three lifecycles independently flag the riwāyah/rasm ruling as an unmade prerequisite, and one of them (القراءة والتهجي) makes its own G1 text choice conditional on it — which means the programme cannot legally begin G1 until the Council rules. This is not a formality in this location. The architecture is silently Ḥafṣ-shaped throughout: the تحفة/الجزرية مد counts and بسملة وجوه taught at G4-G7, and القراءة والتهجي's own G4 note that 'the معانقة marks in the Ḥafṣ muṣḥaf — Warsh maṣāḥif mark waqf differently'. It sits in a region where Warsh عن نافع has deep historical presence alongside the Maliki spine the architecture has already adopted at G6 (الأخضري). Nobody has stated the fork. Deciding it after G1 admissions is destructive — حفظ's own prerequisite list says changing riwāyah mid-ḥifẓ is destructive and changing print layout degrades page-image anchoring.
objections.recommendation: Rule the riwāyah and the single muṣḥaf edition BEFORE the first G1 intake, and record it as a constitutional item alongside the ring-fence. If the ruling is Ḥafṣ, the architecture stands as written and the only action is procurement of a single edition in bulk. If the ruling is Warsh, then: the تحفة and الجزرية teaching materials must be re-specified for Warsh مد measures and أصول, القراءة والتهجي's G4 waqf-mark content must be rewritten, الشاطبية must be struck from التجويد's text list (it belongs to a قراءات strand this school has not staffed), and a Warsh-competent مقرئ becomes the binding hire. Cost the Warsh branch before choosing it.

objections.grade: التفسير G8
objections.objection: The 'budget-neutral' claim is arithmetically false and, being stated in bold as a [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION], is exactly the kind of claim a board approves without checking. The entry says التفسير becomes مستقل at G8 'budget-neutral, because القراءة والتهجي completes at G5 and the التجويد matn ladder completes at G7, so التفسير inherits periods Programme 1 already held'. But القراءة والتهجي held ZERO periods of the 19 at every grade — that is its own headline claim, stated three times. It lived entirely in the hour. It therefore bequeaths nothing to the timetable. التجويد held 2 at G7 and still holds a وحدة at G8 (cost unstated, presumably 1-2). The genuinely freed allocation at G8 is at most 1-2 periods, not 3. The net new claim on the 19-period ceiling at G8 is therefore +1 to +3, borne by Programmes 2 and 3, at the year they are absorbing مصطلح-preparatory hadith work and post-ملحة نحو.
objections.recommendation: Restate التفسير G8 at 2 periods, matching what التجويد actually vacates, and note the third period as deferred to G10 when the G8 تجويد وحدة also ends. Strike the phrase 'budget-neutral' from the lifecycle and replace it with the actual arithmetic: 'net claim on the 19-period ceiling: +1 period relative to G7'.

objections.grade: All six subjects — G7, G8, G9, G11, G12 (missing figures)
objections.objection: The programme cannot be costed because four to six grade-year period figures are simply not stated anywhere in the six submissions: التجويد at G7 (the الجزرية body year) and at G8 (the two-term وقف وحدة); أصول التفسير at G9 (the one-term علوم القرآن وحدة); and التفسير from G7 onward, where the periods narrative is truncated. Each lifecycle opens its budget section by invoking the 19-period ceiling and then does not complete the table. Reconstructing from what IS stated, Programme 1 claims roughly: G1-G3 = 0, G4-G5 = 1, G6 = 4, G7 = 4, G8 = 4-5, G9 = 4-5, G10 = 3, G11 = 5-7, G12 = 4. That leaves 12-15 of 19 for the whole of Programmes 2 and 3 — roughly twenty subjects — at G6-G12. I cannot tell the Council whether that fits, and neither can they, because the numbers do not exist.
objections.recommendation: Before any Council vote, produce a single 12-row consolidated period table for Programme 1 with a column per subject and a per-grade total, with every cell filled and no cell reading 'see narrative'. Any subject that cannot state a number for a grade is deemed to be requesting zero at that grade. Then hand the per-grade totals to Programmes 2 and 3 as their actual remaining budget — 19 minus Programme 1's total — before they finalise their own allocations.

objections.grade: التفسير G11 (term 1) + أصول التفسير G11 + التجويد G11
objections.objection: G11 is Programme 1's peak claim and the likeliest breach point of the whole ceiling. As submitted: التفسير 3 (مستقل, آيات الأحكام plus بياني), أصول التفسير 2 (مستقل, مقدمة ابن تيمية), التجويد 2 for one term (وحدة الإقراء). That is 7 of 19 in term 1, leaving 12 for Programme 2 (نحو at post-ملحة level, صرف, بلاغة, عروض, نقد وآداب, إنشاء وخطابة, ترجمة) and Programme 3 (فقه, أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث with نخبة الفكر per redline 1, حديث, عقيدة, سيرة, مواريث) combined — fourteen or more subjects on twelve periods. It does not fit, and the deficit is concentrated in the one term where three second-order disciplines (أصول التفسير, أصول الفقه, مصطلح الحديث) all sit together, which is also a memorisation and abstraction peak.
objections.recommendation: Move وحدة الإقراء to G9 as recommended above, which takes G11 to 5. Then cut التفسير G11 from 3 to 2 by making the التفسير البياني strand conditional on البلاغة having actually landed by G10 — التفسير's own lifecycle already says that strand must be 'cut, not faked' if البلاغة is absent, so make the cut the default and the inclusion the exception. Target Programme 1 at G11: 4 periods, not 7.

objections.grade: التفسير G6
objections.objection: A same-year prerequisite dressed as an earlier-grade one. The differentiation argument for G6 rests on الآجرومية 'supplying the إعراب apparatus — مبتدأ وخبر، فاعل ومفعول به، الجار والمجرور، علامات الإعراب' and البناء في الصرف supplying الميزان الصرفي. Both begin at G6 from absolute zero. In term 1 of G6 the learner has none of it; الآجرومية's own باب المعربات is not reached early. So التفسير G6 as written asks a pupil to 'then the إعراب that fixes the sentence meaning, using precisely the categories acquired that same year' in a year where the categories are being acquired in parallel, not in advance. This is the identical error redline 1 corrected elsewhere (نخبة الفكر beside الآجرومية).
objections.recommendation: Sequence within the year explicitly. G6 التفسير terms 1-2: word meaning and sentence meaning only, plus the Yoruba/English rendering — no إعراب vocabulary. Term 3: إعراب-supported reading restricted to the four categories الآجرومية has actually delivered by then, on verses already memorised. Write the term boundary into the lifecycle rather than leaving it to the teacher, and make the same edit to أصول التفسير's G6 مضمّن strand, which inherits the same assumption.

objections.grade: التجويد G3 (the diagnostic articulation screen)
objections.objection: As specified this is the single least staffable item in the programme. Every child is to be recorded producing all 28 letters in isolation, in a word, and in a Qur'anic phrase; every error typed into five categories including epenthesis and tonal contour; a written remediation plan per child. That is roughly 15 minutes of recording plus analysis per child — for a 60-child cohort, 30-plus hours of specialist time inside a year the entry also says costs zero periods because it runs 'inside the Qur'an hour'. It also assumes an error taxonomy (epenthesis, tonal transfer) that belongs to articulatory phonetics training a typical Qur'an teacher in this market does not hold. An unstaffable screen is worse than no screen, because the architecture then treats the G4 تحفة gate as verified when it has not been.
objections.recommendation: Reduce to a 12-item screening probe built only on the L1-interference contrast set the lifecycle itself names — ع/ء، ح/ه، ق/ك، ص/س، ط/ت، ض/د، ذ/ز/ظ، غ/خ — each in one word and one memorised phrase. Three to four minutes per child, scored pass/refer only, administered by the class حفظ teacher on a two-page tick sheet. Refer-cases go to ONE trained remediation teacher who writes the plan. This is deliverable inside two weeks of the hour and requires one trained person, not twelve. Keep حفظ's separate recommendation of an audiological screen at intake — it is correct and it is cheaper than any of this.

objections.grade: القراءة والتهجي G3 gate vs G6 remediation clinic
objections.objection: The hard gate sits at end of G3 ('reads an unseen vocalised muṣḥaf page') but the remediation route does not open until G6, and even then it is described as serving 'identified G5 non-attainers ONLY'. There is no route for a G3 non-attainer. Meanwhile التجويد's own prerequisite list makes the G3 gate the hard condition for تحفة at G4, and حفظ makes it the hard condition for the G4 method hinge (تلقين → نظر ثم حفظ). So a child who fails the G3 gate is promoted into two subjects that both explicitly depend on it, and waits two years for help. In practice the class teacher will quietly keep him on تلقين, he will not be able to apply a single تحفة rule to a page, and the G5 exit certification will record a failure that was engineered at G3.
objections.recommendation: Open the دوراني remediation clinic at G4, triggered by the G3 gate, not at G6 triggered by G5. Specify it as it is already specified for G6 — parallel track, outside the cohort curriculum, zero claim on the 19 — and specify that a G3 non-attainer stays on تلقين سمعي for حفظ (deferring the method hinge to G5 for him individually) rather than being pushed through it. Name who staffs the clinic in the staffing model; it is the same person as the articulation-screen remediation teacher.

objections.grade: التفسير G9 vs أصول التفسير G9
objections.objection: Direct content collision in the same year, invisible to both authors. التفسير G9 states 'أسباب النزول now handled as a category, sequenced with السيرة' and introduces الإسرائيليات. أصول التفسير G9's one-term وحدة مدخل إلى علوم القرآن covers أسباب النزول ('what a sabab is and that only some verses have one'), المكي والمدني and جمع القرآن. Two subjects, one year, the same category taught twice — and taught with different framings, one operational and one descriptive-historical, which is worse than simple duplication because the learner gets two accounts of the same thing from two teachers. There is a related, milder overlap at G7, where التفسير claims 'first operational use of المكي والمدني and سبب النزول' while أصول التفسير's G7 مضمّن strand claims the same habit-formation.
objections.recommendation: Assign ownership explicitly in both documents. أصول التفسير owns the CATEGORY and its history at G9 (what a sabab is, the types, جمع القرآن, المكي والمدني as recognisable classes). التفسير owns the APPLICATION to سورة يوسف and owns الإسرائيليات (which is a source-criticism habit sitting naturally in narrative tafsir). At G7, التفسير owns the operational use and أصول التفسير's strand is limited to naming the habit, not teaching the class. Sequence the G9 وحدة into term 1 so that التفسير's يوسف work in terms 2-3 applies rather than anticipates it.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات G3 → التجويد G4
objections.objection: التجويد's prerequisite list names 'capacity to memorise رجز verse — established by G3 through النشيد والمحفوظات (منظومة التوحيد والإيمان at G3 in the submission)' and calls it 'a real and often-missed dependency' because تحفة is a 61-line rajaz poem. But النشيد's own lifecycle has REJECTED منظومة التوحيد والإيمان as unverified and not adopted, replacing it with 'a school-compiled مجموعة' of 60-80 lines of 'short affirmative أبيات'. So the prerequisite now rests on (a) a book that does not exist and must be authored before G3 can run, and (b) a repertoire specified as SHORT pieces, when the capacity actually required at G4 is sustained memorisation of a single long rajaz matn. Short pieces do not build long-piece stamina; that is the same distinction النشيد itself draws at G5 when it lengthens pieces to '12-20 line units' and calls it 'the first demand on sustained memory architecture rather than rote span' — which is a year too late for تحفة.
objections.recommendation: Specify the G3 مجموعة, in النشيد's lifecycle, as containing at least two pieces of 15-20 lines in رجز, memorised as continuous wholes, precisely to build the capacity تحفة will draw on at G4. Name the authoring of the مجموعة as a pre-launch deliverable with an owner and a date — it is a hard dependency for G3, G4 and G5 and currently has neither. Until it exists, G3 النشيد cannot be scheduled.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات G4 — القصيدة اللامية في السنة
objections.objection: Now that the exclusion is void, the placement creates a forward prerequisite with no consumer anywhere in this programme. Memorising a versified creed at G4 on a memorise-now/comprehend-later basis is legitimate and traditional, but it obliges some later grade to unpack it — and the unpacking of divine attributes, خلق القرآن and الرؤية belongs to العقيدة, which is in Programme 3 and outside this programme's authority. Nothing in Programme 1's six lifecycles picks it up at any grade. Programme 1 therefore cannot honestly place this text at G4; it would be shipping an unfunded obligation to another programme. A second-order point on coherence, which the Council rules on and I only flag: with الأخضري as the fiqh spine at G6 and two Ibn Taymiyyah texts (this poem at G4, مقدمة في أصول التفسير at G11), the school's creed formation and its fiqh spine come from different traditions, and no subject in Programme 1 names that or equips the graduate to hold both coherently.
objections.recommendation: Preferred: move the لامية from G4 to G9-G10 in النشيد, where memorisation and comprehension coincide, the learner has إعراب adequate to parse it, and the dependency on another programme disappears entirely. It costs nothing to move — النشيد at G9 is دوراني and at G10 is مضمّن. Fallback if the Council wants it young: G4 placement is conditional on a written commitment from Programme 3 naming the specific G10 or G11 العقيدة unit that unpacks it, minuted before approval. If that commitment is not obtained, the G4 slot stays empty — it is currently empty anyway and nothing breaks.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات G5 — الفواكه الساقطة
objections.objection: Authorship is now confirmed (الإلوري) and the architectural argument for an indigenous West African strand is sound. But the placement is not executable: the work's contents, LENGTH and register remain unverified, and النشيد's G5 budget is a line count (~100 lines for the year). You cannot timetable a line count for a text nobody has read. More fundamentally, it is not established that the work is verse at all, and النشيد at G5 is a verse-memorisation strand with a written استظهار component — if the text is prose it does not belong in this subject at all, it belongs to القراءة or to النقد والآداب, and placing it here would be a category error made in order to honour a good architectural instinct.
objections.recommendation: Keep the G5 slot open and record the REQUIREMENT rather than the text: 'the G5 repertoire must include indigenous West African Arabic verse'. Commission acquisition of a physical copy of الفواكه الساقطة and a written vetting note stating genre, length in lines or pages, and register, with an owner and a date. If it is verse and within budget, it fills the slot; if it is prose, it is referred to Programme 2 and a different West African verse text is sought to fill the requirement. Do not substitute, and do not schedule anything at G5 until the vetting note exists.

objections.grade: النشيد والمحفوظات G10, G11, G12
objections.objection: Two consecutive grades are hosted by subjects that may not exist. G10 is مضمّن in النقد والآداب and G11 مضمّن in الإنشاء والخطابة, both flagged by the author as [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] on host availability. If either host is absent, النشيد does not fail loudly — it silently disappears, because a مضمّن subject with no host has no timetable line to go missing. The G12 capstone then asks the graduate to curate 'his accumulated محفوظات to a stated cumulative threshold', a threshold set on the assumption of two years of accumulation that never happened. There is a related forward-orphan at G9, where the subject justifies itself by claiming to build 'the ear' as 'the prerequisite for العروض' — a subject that is also unallocated and may never arrive.
objections.recommendation: State the G12 cumulative threshold on G3-G9 repertoire ONLY, with G10-G11 additions declared explicitly conditional and additive. Add a fallback line to G10 and G11: if the named host does not exist, النشيد reverts to مضمّن inside اللغة العربية at the same zero cost, rather than lapsing.
