Strike the العروض justification from G9's rationale and rest that year on what it actually delivers — a memorised literary repertoire — so the year does not depend on a subject that has not been allocated.

objections.grade: التجويد G10
objections.objection: The form is مضمّن at 'zero period cost' but the assessment is a terminal practical certification in تلاوة مجودة: every student individually sight-reads an unseen muṣḥaf page before an examiner, judged on zero لحن جلي, a published tolerance for لحن خفي, all تحفة and الجزرية أحكام realised, and every وقف defensible. That is a 10-15 minute individual viva per student requiring a مقرئ-grade examiner. For a cohort of 60 that is 10-15 examiner-hours plus moderation, and it appears in no budget — not in periods, not in the hour's minutes, not in the staffing model. Assessment being orthogonal to form is correct doctrine and I am not disputing the design; I am disputing that its cost has been recorded as zero.
objections.recommendation: Name the assessment window explicitly — e.g. the last two weeks of term 3, running inside the G10 Qur'an hour with the halaqah's own review continuing under a second adult — and name the examiner ratio and who moderates. Record the examiner-hours in the staffing model. Do the same for the G5 القراءة والتهجي exit certification, the G9 حفظ panel statement, the G11 المراجعة الكبرى panel and the G12 سرد panel, all of which have the same unrecorded cost.

objections.grade: القراءة والتهجي G4 vs التجويد G8
objections.objection: An undemarcated boundary that will produce a contradiction in the child's head. القراءة والتهجي at G4 teaches 'علامات الوقف (م، لا، ج، صلى، قلى…)' systematically, as muṣḥaf convention. التجويد at G8 then argues that الوقف والابتداء 'is not phonetic at all — it is a judgement about where a MEANING completes, and that judgement is impossible without نحو'. Both are defensible and they are about different things — obeying a printed mark versus judging an unmarked stop — but neither lifecycle says so, and a G4 child taught 'stop where the mark says' for four years arrives at G8 to be told the real criterion is something else entirely.
objections.recommendation: Write the demarcation into both documents in one sentence each. القراءة والتهجي G4: the marks are read as the editor's guidance for a reader who cannot yet judge, and this is said to the child. التجويد G8: the unit teaches the judgement the marks encode, including why a competent reader may stop where no mark appears. This costs nothing and removes a real source of confusion.

objections.grade: التجويد G12 + التفسير G12 + النشيد G12 + حفظ G12
objections.objection: Four capstone-grade assessment events land in one year, all performance-based, all requiring panels, and all in a programme whose G12 students are simultaneously carrying a +3 juz acquisition floor (itself disputed above) and 20% of their hour as إقراء duty: حفظ's panel سرد of the certified portion plus an applied-tajwīd examination against الجزرية; التفسير's capstone تفسير delivered in Arabic then rendered into English and Yoruba before an audience; النشيد's public مجلس إلقاء with parse-on-demand; and, for opt-in students, the إجازة بالسند. Programmes 2 and 3 will add their own. Nobody owns the G12 calendar.
objections.recommendation: Publish a single G12 assessment calendar across all three programmes before approval, spreading the four Programme 1 events across three terms, and explicitly permit the التفسير capstone and the النشيد مجلس to be held as one public event with two separately scored components — they share an audience, a panel slot and a hall.

objections.grade: التجويد — text list (الشاطبية, المكتفى, منار الهدى)
objections.objection: Three texts appear on the list at grade '—'. الشاطبية is a قراءات matn; its presence on the list of a school with no قراءات strand and no قراءات staffing is an invitation to drift, particularly once an إجازة track exists and someone reasonably asks what the ijazah is in. منار الهدى is marked unverified as to attribution and المكتفى uncertain; neither should sit on a list the Council reads as the subject's bibliography.
objections.recommendation: Split the text list into 'prescribed' (تحفة, الجزرية) and 'teacher reference, not taught' and move all three there, with الشاطبية annotated 'requires a قراءات strand that does not exist; not to be introduced without a separate Council ruling and a named قارئ'. Restate explicitly that the إجازة on offer is in the school's single ruled riwāyah only.

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: The ring-fenced 60-minute Qur'an hour is oversubscribed and has never been budgeted in minutes. Four subjects — حفظ, القراءة والتهجي, التفسير and النشيد — each truthfully report 'ZERO periods' because each is funded out of the hour, and nobody added them up: at G1 the stated claims total 73-90 minutes against 60. The same blind spot then produces the G6-G7 double-budgeting of التفسير العملي (in the hour per القراءة والتهجي, at 2 periods of 19 per التفسير) and the G10-G12 حفظ floors that demand three times the G8 acquisition rate from one third of the time. The ring-fence was written to protect the hour from being raided by other subjects; because it is constitutionally protected it has instead been treated as free, and five subjects have been quietly funded out of it. Nothing in Programme 1 should be approved before a signed minute-budget table for the hour at every grade, summing to exactly 60.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives: Genuinely sound and to be protected, with what protects each: (1) The G4 method hinge in حفظ — تلقين سمعي converting to نظر ثم حفظ — gated on القراءة والتهجي's end-of-G3 decoding gate, with acquisition pace deliberately NOT raised in the hinge year. This is the best-sequenced transition in the programme; it is protected by the explicit gate and by the refusal to take the efficiency gain in the same year. (2) التجويد differentiating at G4 rather than G3, gated on the child's ability to SEE and sort سكون / تنوين / شدة, with the correct diagnosis that an earlier start converts تحفة into meaningless chant. The argument is from the matn's own trigger structure, not from convenience. (3) Deferring الوقف والابتداء to G8 on نحو grounds (الآجرومية G6, ملحة G7) and holding it out of the G6-G7 الجزرية years. This is the single sharpest piece of prerequisite reasoning in all six submissions and must not be traded away when G8 comes under period pressure. (4) القراءة والتهجي terminating at G5 rather than persisting out of habit, and its 'negative prerequisite' — النحو is NOT required, because the muṣḥaf is vocalised — which is what correctly licenses the subject to finish BEFORE النحو begins. Textbook correct asymmetry. (5) التفسير's G1-G5 zero-period مضمّن layer, asking nothing of the timetable until the pupil can use it, which is the only responsible posture against a 7-period ceiling at G1-G2. (6) أصول التفسير's double refusal — not before G6, and NOT مستقل at G12 — both argued from prerequisite and from the discipline's own مقدمة character rather than from senior-year symmetry. Its G11 argument against G10 placement is also correct and should defeat التفسير's competing claim. (7) النشيد's deliberate contraction at G6 because G6 is the peak new-متن year (الجزرية, الآجرومية, البناء, الأخضري arriving together) and memorisation capacity, not timetable space, is the binding constraint. It is the only place in the entire submission where a subject voluntarily surrenders load, and it is exactly right. (8) The mandated single fixed muṣḥaf edition from G4 onward — operationally trivial, pedagogically load-bearing through page-image anchoring, and cheap. (9) حفظ's G9 and G12 certification stated honestly in juz held at a named إتقان level, never as pass/fail, with the G12 band published as a range. (10) حفظ's recommendation of an audiological screen at intake, on the correct reasoning that undetected hearing loss is indistinguishable from 'a slow child' in a تلقين halaqah.

objections.grade: G8 — all subjects claiming اللغة العربية's block (البلاغة #10, النقد والآداب #13, الترجمة #16, الإملاء #15, الإنشاء #14)
objections.objection: The اللغة العربية G8 block is sold at least four times over, and no per-subject reviewer could see it. البلاغة asks for '25-30 minutes/week, about two-thirds of one period' inside اللغة العربية. النقد asks for 'one lesson per week inside the existing اللغة العربية allocation'. الترجمة ring-fences 'ONE period of the existing اللغة العربية (النصوص) allocation'. الإملاء takes a further slice. All three of البلاغة، النقد، الترجمة name the SAME حصة النصوص as their host. Meanwhile #7 declares G8 'the unvocalised transition year, and it deserves a whole year to itself'. If اللغة العربية holds ~4 periods at G8, roughly 2.7 of them are pre-claimed by other subjects and the transition work — the single hardest cognitive shift in the twelve years for a Yoruba-L1 reader — gets about one period. Developmentally this is the worst possible year to fragment: withdrawing vowels while simultaneously running three other analytic frames over the same text saturates a 13-year-old's working memory and guarantees that he learns the labels of بلاغة and نقد while never becoming an unvocalised reader.
objections.recommendation: Constitute a single named حصة النصوص at G8-G9 of 2 periods/week with ONE reported نصوص mark carrying three traceable components, and publish a term rotation rather than a weekly triple-booking: G8 T1 unvocalised reading only (اللغة العربية alone, no other lens); T2 rendering (الترجمة); T3 التشبيه (البلاغة). النقد's G8 مضمّن presence moves to G9, where it is already scheduled to become a named strand. Withdraw the separate independently-assessed status of الترجمة at G8 — one 13-year-old cannot carry three independent assessments on one weekly lesson. Publish the G8 aggregate period table for all three programmes before approval; it does not currently exist anywhere in the submission.

objections.grade: G6-G7 — النحو (الآجرومية), الصرف (البناء, لامية الأفعال), اللغة العربية, النشيد, plus Programmes 1 and 3
objections.objection: Four separate reviewers independently declare G6 or G7 the most heavily loaded grade in the ladder (#10: 'exactly the year a curriculum is tempted...refused'; #13: 'the most heavily loaded grade in the submission...at or over the 19-period ceiling'; #11: 'G7 is the heaviest new-متن year in the whole ladder'), and each responds only by refusing to add its own subject. Nobody reduces the load. In G6 alone an eleven-year-old meets, for the first time, الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية، ديوان الشافعي، لامية ابن الوردي and التفسير العملي with rendering into two languages. That is five to seven new texts in one year, each carrying an out-of-period memorisation obligation, for a child who is in national school from morning, in this school 2-6pm three days and 9am-3pm on both weekend days, and therefore has essentially no independent study window. The constraint that breaks is not periods; it is unsupervised time to memorise, and no lifecycle has costed it.
objections.recommendation: Cap new text intake at three per grade per learner across all three programmes at G6 and G7, and publish a whole-school intake calendar. Programme 2's movable pieces are: (a) النشيد carries ONE new body at G6, not two — move لامية ابن الوردي to G8 (it is زهد/حكمة material and pairs with تائية الإلبيري, not against it); (b) strike القراءة الراشدة (in any case marked 'uncertain') from G6 and have اللغة العربية work its G6 comprehension programme on texts the child already holds — the matn prose, the memorised Qur'an, قصص النبيين — which is both cheaper and pedagogically superior; (c) cost حفظ minutes explicitly in the scheme of work for every matn, and require that the sum at G6 and G7 be deliverable inside timetabled supervised study, not at home.

objections.grade: G6 — اللغة العربية (#7), and the method by which its G6 override was reached
objections.objection: #7's G6 'HARD OVERRIDE' reasons as follows: G6 carries five Arabic-text loads while the submission describes the learner as being at 'simple sentences'; both cannot be true; therefore the learner's Arabic must be higher than described. That inference runs in the wrong direction. The equally available — and from a developmental standpoint far more likely — reading is that the G6 text load is wrong, not that the eleven-year-old is stronger than the submission says. #7 resolved a contradiction by raising demand on the child rather than by questioning the demand. Every downstream prerequisite in the programme now silently inherits that raised baseline.
objections.recommendation: Do not adopt the G6 language uplift as an assumption. Convert it into a testable claim: define an end-of-G5 reading and comprehension benchmark (fluent oral reading of a vocalised 8-10 sentence unseen expository passage with literal and one-step inferential questions answered in Arabic), administer it to the first cohort, and place the G6 matn intake at the level that benchmark actually returns. If the cohort does not clear it, the correct response is to lighten G6, not to declare the child advanced.

objections.grade: G2 / G3 / G5 — القراءة والتهجي gate as cited by اللغة العربية (#7), الصرف (#9), الإملاء (#15), النقد (#13), الترجمة (#16)
objections.objection: The programme does not agree on when decoding automaticity arrives, and every G5-G6 pivot rests on it. #15 has sound→letter correspondence 'secure by end of G2'. #7 asserts at G3 that 'a child who has decoded for two full years can already read words' and builds its whole G3 sentence-level override on it. #9 says 'automatic decoding... established G3'. #13 says 'fluent decoding of vowelled and unvowelled Arabic — secure by G5'. #16 says 'automatic Arabic decoding — established by القراءة والتهجي, G5'. These are not phrasings of one claim; they are three different years for the same gate, and the gap is precisely the G3-G5 window in which #7 accelerates and #8/#9 plant the نحو/صرف substrate. If the true date is G5, #7's G3 override is built on a capacity the child does not yet have, and the G5 'pivot year' collapses.
objections.recommendation: Fix one date by measurement, not by assertion. Require القراءة والتهجي to publish a single decoding-automaticity criterion (e.g. accurate oral reading of unseen fully-vocalised connected text at a stated words-per-minute with ≤2% error) and an end-of-G3 screening administered to every child. Rewrite the prerequisite line in all five lifecycles to cite that one criterion and that one date. Children who do not clear it at G3 enter a named support route (see the remediation objection below) rather than proceeding into #7's G4 paragraph-level work.

objections.grade: G6 — النحو (#8) and الصرف (#9)
objections.objection: The two subjects have allocated the same periods twice. #8 requests '3 requested, 2 acceptable' for النحو at G6. #9 states G6 runs 'inside a combined النحو والصرف block of 4 periods/week'. If النحو takes 3, الصرف has ONE period — 39 periods, about 26 clock hours — in which to introduce الميزان الصرفي (the discipline's hardest abstraction, and #9's own stated cognitive gate), حروف الزيادة, the six أبواب of الثلاثي المجرد with their مضارع vowels, and the first المزيد بحرف, on a matn. If الصرف takes 2, النحو has 2 for the complete الآجرومية. Both cannot happen. This is invisible to each specialist and fatal in delivery: in practice the النحو teacher, holding the examined matn, will take the time, and الميزان will be taught in the last ten minutes of a grammar lesson — which is exactly how learners come to treat الوزن as letter-matching and collapse at the first مزيد, the failure mode #9 names.
objections.recommendation: Ring-fence the split inside the combined block explicitly: 4 periods = 2.5 النحو / 1.5 الصرف, published in the scheme of work with الصرف holding a whole period on a fixed day (a half-period is unteachable for an abstraction of this kind). Fund this by the الآجرومية re-pacing proposed below, which reduces what النحو must cover at G6. If the Council will not fund 4 periods, the honest consequence is that الميزان moves to G7 — not that it is squeezed.

objections.grade: G9-G10 — اللغة العربية (#7) terminal handover, affecting every G10-G12 subject in the programme
objections.objection: #7 ends اللغة العربية as a general subject at G9 on the premise that the handover to autonomous unvocalised reading is complete, and every single G10-G12 subject in this programme — البلاغة، النقد، المنطق، الترجمة، الإنشاء، النحو — states that it assumes it. There is no remediation route anywhere in the architecture for the learner who does not clear that gate. In a Yoruba-L1 cohort, in an afternoon and weekend school, some proportion will not, and that is a developmental certainty, not a risk. Those students enter G10 into six subjects that all presuppose a competency they lack, with no named path back. What they will actually acquire is terminology — they will learn to say كناية and قياس اقتراني and produce nothing.
objections.recommendation: Make the end-of-G9 assessment a gate with consequences, not a report line: an unseen unvocalised prose reading-and-comprehension test plus the formal oral examination #7 already proposes. Attach a دوراني دعم strand at G10-G11 — one period, one term per year, hosted inside اللغة العربية's existing G10 مدمج allocation with النقد والآداب, entered by diagnostic and exited by re-test. Cost to the 19-period ceiling: zero at G10, one period at G11. Without it the programme has a G10 cliff and will not know it until the first cohort reaches G12.

objections.grade: G3-G5 (placement) and G12 (comprehension) — القصيدة اللامية في السنة لابن تيمية, النشيد والمحفوظات and المنطق وعلم الكلام (#12)
objections.objection: The brief asks whether some later grade is explicitly assigned the job of unpacking a creedal poem memorised young. Across these ten lifecycles, no grade is. The only place in the entire Programme 2 submission where divine attributes, الرؤية and كلام الله are discussed at all is #12's G12 علم الكلام component — one period per week, inside Programme 3's العقيدة block, and explicitly framed as a META-discipline: 'how Muslims argued creed, not a creed to adopt'. That is a survey of a historical dispute, not a line-by-line explanation of a poem the student has been reciting since he was eight. A seven-to-nine year gap between memorisation and comprehension on creedal content is not the traditional memorise-now/comprehend-later model; in that model the gap is bridged by a teacher's shorter شرح within a few years. Left unbridged, an adolescent does not hold the words neutrally — he constructs his own reading of the الصفات lines he repeats weekly, and Programme 2 contains no mechanism whatever for detecting or correcting that reading.
objections.recommendation: Two actions. (1) If the لامية is adopted into النشيد والمحفوظات, place it no earlier than G6-G7 — not because a younger child cannot memorise it, but to keep the memorisation-to-comprehension gap under three years. (2) Name the unpacking grade explicitly: a line-by-line شرح of the poem inside العقيدة at G9, where the student has the نحو from ملحة الإعراب to parse the verse and three years of grounded عقيدة behind him, and BEFORE #12's G12 course frames the historical controversy. Sequence matters: content first, dispute second. Both actions touch Programme 3 and النشيد (#4), so route as [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] — but the architecture must not be approved with the comprehension leg simply absent.

objections.grade: G1-G2 — اللغة العربية (#7) at 3 of 7 periods, with القراءة والتهجي at 3
objections.objection: #7's own indicative fit is اللغة العربية 3 + القراءة والتهجي 3 + one shared practical period = the entire 7-period budget. Programme 2 therefore takes 6 of 7 periods at G1-G2, leaving a single 40-minute period per week for التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي combined — roughly 26 hours a year, for both, for a six-year-old. From a developmental standpoint that is the wrong trade. A six-year-old can perform wuḍūʾ and ṣalāh now; the learning is enacted through the body, which is exactly the modality that works at that age, and it is immediately usable in his actual life. Arabic literacy is a capability he cannot use for several years. Funding six periods of literacy by starving the one thing a six-year-old can actually do is the classic error of treating the youngest years as a run-up to the later ones. It also directly contradicts the standing instruction that G1-G3 be 'rich but clean' — six of seven periods on one programme is not balance, it is a preparatory academy.
objections.recommendation: Rebalance G1-G2 to القراءة والتهجي 3 + اللغة العربية 2 + العملي (توحيد/فقه) 2. اللغة العربية loses nothing real: #7's own G1 content is لغة الفصل (اجلس، قم، افتح الكتاب، أعد) and the four question frames, which are by design delivered as the medium of every lesson and every transition, not as a taught block. Instruct that all G1-G2 teachers conduct classroom management in Arabic, and اللغة العربية's two periods then carry the lexical fields, the oral frames and listening work with the same reach.

objections.grade: G6 — النحو (#8), المقدمة الآجرومية
objections.objection: #8 places the complete الآجرومية in one year at 2-3 periods: T1 الكلام، الإعراب وأقسامه، العلامات الأصلية، المعرب بالحركات والحروف، رفع المضارع ونصبه وجزمه; T2 the whole of المرفوعات including كان وإن وظن وأخواتها AND التوابع الأربعة; T3 المنصوبات والمخفوضات. At 2 periods that is roughly 52 clock hours for an eleven-year-old meeting case marking for the first time in his life, in a language whose case system has no analogue in either of the two languages he knows — a point #8 itself makes. Worse, the stated reason the ladder must fit G6-G12 is arithmetic: 'الآجرومية (1) + ملحة (1) + قطر (2) + الألفية (3) is seven years and there are exactly seven [grades]'. That is forced symmetry driving the compression, which the brief expressly prohibits, and the cost is borne entirely at the year where the learner is youngest and the load is heaviest.
objections.recommendation: Re-pace inside the retained progression, which keeps redline 3 intact. G6 covers أقسام الكلام، الإعراب وعلاماته، المعرب بالحركات والحروف، الأفعال، and المرفوعات only. G7 opens with المنصوبات والمخفوضات (six to eight weeks) before ملحة الإعراب begins — ملحة is a second pass over the same ground, so it absorbs the slippage without loss. Recover the year at the top: G12 already covers only 'الألفية's remaining أبواب that the school elects', so الألفية runs G11-G12 rather than G10-G12, and G10 consolidates قطر at analytic depth. No text is dropped, no redline is touched, and the compression is removed from the youngest year that carries it.

objections.grade: G1-G2 — اللغة العربية (#7) as described by itself versus by #8, #9, #10, #11, #12, #13
objections.objection: #7 states that at G1 اللغة العربية teaches NO letters, because القراءة والتهجي owns الحروف, and that the year is entirely oral. Six other lifecycles in this same programme describe اللغة العربية at G1-G2 as 'الحروف وقليل المفردات' and 'الحروف والمفردات' and build their reasoning on it (#9 G1: 'Arabic time is spent on الحروف وأصواتها'; #12 G2; #13 G1-G2; #10 G2; #11 G1; #8 G1). The owner overrode the register description and nobody else received it. This is not a drafting nuisance: the G1 decision — oral-only listening and speaking before print — is the single most developmentally important call in Programme 2, and it will be lost the moment a teacher is handed a scheme written from the other description. Every prerequisite ladder in the programme is also calibrated to the superseded version.
objections.recommendation: Reissue the 26-subject register entry for اللغة العربية G1-G2 to read 'استماع وتحدث — لا حروف' and require every other Programme 2 lifecycle to re-cite it. Then re-audit each prerequisite chain against the revised G1-G5 description, because several downstream gates (#9's vocabulary assumptions, #13's decoding date, #16's G6 comprehension assumption) were written against the old one and may now be either over- or under-stated.

objections.grade: G8 — العروض (#11) وحدة, against اللغة العربية's (#7) unvocalised transition
objections.objection: العروض places its bounded unit at G8, and its first content block is الكتابة العروضية — writing exactly what is pronounced, with تنوين spelled as نون ساكنة, شدة as two letters, وصل hamza dropped, every vowel realised. That is a maximally vocalised, phonetic-transcription operation. #7 makes G8 the year the same child is trained to read with vowels progressively withdrawn. For a thirteen-year-old these are directly opposed operations on the same script in the same term, and the predictable result is interference in both directions: over-vowelling in reading, and scanning by spelling rather than by sound. العروض's stated prerequisites (لامية الأفعال complete end of G7, التجويد closed end of G7) are satisfied a year later just as well.
objections.recommendation: Move the العروض وحدة to G9, Terms 2-3. #11's own G9 entry is 'no new content, no periods, deliberate consolidation', so the year absorbs the unit at no cost and loses nothing — the consolidation simply becomes G10's دوراني block, which already exists. This also removes 2 periods from G8, the collision year identified above, which is the second reason to do it.

objections.grade: G9 — النقد والآداب (#13), المعلقات
objections.objection: #13 argues at G5 that introducing أدب early 'means handing a child a text 60-70% of whose lexicon is unknown, which trains the habit of skipping words' — and then at G9 prescribes المعلقات by excerpt. For a fourteen-year-old Yoruba-speaking learner in Lagos, المعلقات has the highest unknown-lexis proportion of anything in the Arabic corpus: pre-Islamic gharīb, desert realia, camel anatomy, armour and encampment vocabulary for which he has no referential world at all, in a syntax that is deliberately unusual. The subject's own developmental rule, applied consistently, excludes المعلقات at G9.
objections.recommendation: At G9 run ديوان الحماسة (already prescribed there) and خطب صدر الإسلام only — الحماسة is short, thematically arranged by باب, largely Islamic-era, and its lexis is within reach. Defer المعلقات entirely to G10-G11, where #13 already places the extended selection and where البلاغة has arrived to make the reading worth the cost. Zero-cost change; the G9 student reads poetry he can construe instead of poetry he decodes.

objections.grade: G6 — الإملاء (#15), الهمزة المتوسطة
objections.objection: #15 correctly calls الهمزة المتوسطة 'the largest and most systematic block in Arabic orthography' and then places all of it at G6. Operationally it is a three-to-four step conditional procedure — rank الحركات, locate the hamza's own حركة, locate the preceding letter's, compare, select the seat — that must run in working memory while the hand is writing and while the child is also composing content. At eleven, in the year he is also taking on الآجرومية, البناء, الأخضري, الجزرية and rendering into two languages, the procedure will not automate; it will be applied in dictation and abandoned in إنشاء, which is precisely the Friday-9/10-Monday-misspelling failure #15's own design exists to prevent. The stated milestone that 'the entire رسم إملائي rule-set is complete by end of G7' is a tidiness target, not a requirement.
objections.recommendation: Split the block: G6 takes the ياء and واو seats only (the high-frequency majority and the two unambiguous cases); G7 takes the ألف seat, على السطر, and the edge cases; الهمزة المتطرفة moves to G8, where #15's own stated function change — 'holding a standard under composition load' — is the right frame for it. Move the completion milestone to end of G8. No periods are involved, so this is free.

objections.grade: G6 — الترجمة (#16) against النحو's (#8) no-relay prerequisite
objections.objection: #8 states as a non-negotiable prerequisite 'comprehension of a simple Arabic sentence WITHOUT relay through Yoruba or English', and warns that the relay habit 'once formed, persists into G10-G12 and hollows out التفسير and أصول الفقه'. In the same year, G6, الترجمة becomes a timetabled, independently assessed subject requiring systematic oral Yoruba and written English rendering. The same eleven-year-old is being told to stop relaying and rewarded with a mark for relaying. #16 has the right guard — the compulsory Arabic-to-Arabic gloss of the hard word before any rendering — but introduces it at G8, two years after the practice begins, by which time the habit is set.
objections.recommendation: Move the Arabic-to-Arabic gloss protocol to G6, lesson one, and print it in the التفسير العملي book as the standing procedure of the strand: the student must state the meaning in easier Arabic before he is permitted to render. That single change converts the conflict into #8's own best asset — a rendering task that forces Arabic-internal comprehension. Also state in both schemes that rendering is only ever performed on passages already memorised and already glossed in Arabic.

objections.grade: G9 — الإنشاء والخطابة (#14) against البلاغة (#10)
objections.objection: #14 lists as a live G9 prerequisite 'البلاغة foundations: التشبيه، الاستعارة، الكناية، الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي، مطابقة الكلام لمقتضى الحال' and flags that it cannot satisfy this itself. Reading the two lifecycles together resolves it, and the answer is that the dependency is not met: #10 delivers التشبيه at G8 and المجاز/الاستعارة/الكناية at G9, but الخبر والإنشاء وأغراض الخبر and مطابقة مقتضى الحال arrive only at G10 with علم المعاني. The G9 requirement is a year early. Left unresolved, the G9 إنشاء teacher will improvise a rhetoric lesson inside a composition period, teaching the terms badly and ahead of the discipline that owns them.
objections.recommendation: Resolve in #14's favour and downward: strike الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي and مطابقة مقتضى الحال from the G9 prerequisite list and cite them at G10, where they genuinely arrive. The G9 task — المقالة القصيرة of 300-450 words with claim, evidence and qualification — does not need them; it needs التشبيه and الاستعارة, which #10 does deliver by end of G9. Close the [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] flag on this basis.

objections.grade: G10 — الإنشاء والخطابة (#14), أدب الخطاب
objections.objection: Students begin composing and delivering public addresses at G10, aged about fifteen, and the ethics and limits of public address — that the khaṭīb exhorts and teaches, does not pronounce fatwā, does not pass judgement on named individuals — are taught at G12, two years later. An adolescent is being given a pulpit, in a community setting, before he is told what the pulpit is not for. That is the same risk redline 6 addresses in the نواقض framing, transposed into a more public register and with a wider audience: a fifteen-year-old's address is heard by adults who will take it as the school's teaching.
objections.recommendation: Move أدب الخطاب to G10 Term 1 as the opening unit of the خطابة differentiation, before any student composes an address, and make it a gate: no student delivers publicly until it is passed. Retain the fuller G12 treatment as the mature revisit. Also require that every G10-G11 student address be reviewed in script by the teacher before delivery — which #14 already implies by treating the khutbah as a composed text first, but does not state as a rule.

objections.grade: G10-G12 — العروض (#11, الخزرجية), البلاغة (#10, الجوهر المكنون), المنطق (#12, إيساغوجي / تهذيب المنطق)
objections.objection: Three subjects route their extension material to 'the إجازة track' or 'the strong cohort'. Per redline 2, the Ijazah track is a Qur'an-mastery, pace-based, opt-in route modelled on the Ḥifẓ Track — it is not an Arabic-sciences acceleration route and has no governance, staffing or assessment machinery for الخزرجية or تهذيب المنطق. So the linguistically able learner in this programme has, in fact, no home: his extension texts are parked in a track that is about something else. This is the opposite failure the brief asks me to check, and it is present — not as a learner held back inside a childish course, but as a learner with no route upward and a set of texts that exist on paper only.
objections.recommendation: Either (a) constitute a named, opt-in مسار التوسع في العلوم العربية, governed on the Ijazah pattern — pace-based, separately assessed, not a timetable claim — and route الخزرجية، الجوهر المكنون (full منظومة)، إيساغوجي، تهذيب المنطق and any صرف beyond G9 into it; or (b) strike those texts from the lifecycles entirely. Leaving them as unowned aspirations attached to the wrong track is the worst of the three options, because it lets the architecture claim provision it does not make.

objections.grade: G6-G12 — الترجمة (#16), the English direction
objections.objection: The English half of الترجمة rests entirely on 'written English at sentence-and-paragraph level' arriving from the morning national curriculum, which #16 correctly places outside scope and correctly flags as needing confirmation by G6. It is the only external dependency in Programme 2 and it carries a strand that runs continuously from G6 to a G12 capstone requiring a 600-900 word written English translation with commentary. If the morning curriculum's English writing is weaker than assumed — which for a Nigerian G6 cohort is entirely possible — the G6-G7 rendering lessons will be assessing English composition under the name of الترجمة, and children will be marked down at Arabic for a weakness in a language taught by a different school.
objections.recommendation: Require an end-of-G5 English writing diagnostic (a short descriptive paragraph, marked for sentence control and not for style) before the G6 English direction is timetabled. Publish the fallback in advance: if the cohort does not clear it, G6-G7 الترجمة runs oral Yoruba only, the written English direction opens at G8, and the G12 capstone's English piece is reduced in length accordingly. This costs nothing and prevents a misdiagnosis that would follow a child for six years.

objections.grade: G10-G11 — البلاغة (#10, الجوهر المكنون), النحو (#8, الألفية), المنطق (#12, السلم المنورق)
objections.objection: At G10 and G11 the same student is asked to begin or continue memorising three separate منظومات — ألفية ابن مالك (G10-G12), السلم المنورق (G10-G11), and الجوهر المكنون بابًا بابًا (G11) — on top of the constitutionally ring-fenced Qur'an hour, which never reduces. No lifecycle costed the total. Memorisation capacity at sixteen is real, but memorisation TIME in this timetable is not: the same absence of independent study windows that bites at G6 bites harder at G16-year-old level where each line is longer and denser. The predictable outcome is that all three are memorised shallowly and none is retained, which is worse than memorising one well.
objections.recommendation: Cap concurrent new منظومة memorisation outside the Qur'an hour at ONE per year per student, and publish the resulting allocation: الألفية holds G10-G12 (it is the longest-serving instrument), السلم المنورق is carried as a read-and-understood matn with only its definitional lines memorised, and الجوهر المكنون moves wholly to the opt-in extension track proposed above — #10 already half-concedes this by restricting the grade curriculum to 'selections'. Make the concession complete.

objections.grade: G1-G3 — all Programme 2 subjects present (اللغة العربية, القراءة والتهجي, الإملاء مضمّن, الإنشاء مضمّن)
objections.objection: No lifecycle addresses lesson-internal structure at G1-G3, and the period is 40 minutes long, delivered between 2pm and 6pm to a child who has been in a different school since morning, or at the end of a six-hour Saturday. For a six- or seven-year-old the unit of sustained attention for NEW learning is roughly ten to fifteen minutes; a 40-minute block at 4:40pm will deliver perhaps one such unit. #7's G1 content list — four question frames, seven lexical fields, greetings and permission formulae, الجملة الاسمية — is substantial for the 78 hours available, and it is planned as though the hour were a morning hour. The standing instruction for these grades is 'rich but clean'; nothing in the submission operationalises that at the level where it is actually decided, which is inside the lesson.
objections.recommendation: Issue a G1-G3 lesson-form rule alongside the allocations: every G1-G2 period is planned as three segments of ten to twelve minutes with a movement or recitation break between, no new-learning segment is placed in the final period of a 2-6pm day, and all G1-G2 assessment is observational and oral — no written test papers. #15's G2 model (the closing eight to ten minutes of an existing lesson) is the right template and should be named as such. Timetable the last G1-G2 period of each day as practical/oral work by rule, not by teacher discretion.

objections.grade: G9 — اللغة العربية (#7), the ~4,000-5,000 word target
objections.objection: The G9 exit target of 4,000-5,000 words 'including the religious-technical register' is stated without an instrument, a counting convention (lemma or word family?), a distinction between receptive and productive, or any interim benchmark between G4's asserted 1,000 and G9's 4,000-5,000. For an L2 learner in an afternoon school this is an ambitious figure, and the whole G10-G12 edifice — البلاغة، النقد، المنطق، الترجمة — is built on it. A target that cannot be measured cannot fail, which means the programme will discover the shortfall only when G10 students cannot read.
objections.recommendation: Require اللغة العربية to publish a vocabulary specification: a defined counting convention, a receptive/productive split, a named test format, and end-of-year checkpoints at G4, G6 and G8 as well as G9. Pair it with the end-of-G9 gate and remediation route above. Where the Qur'anic and matn lexis is counted toward the total, count it separately, because recognition of a memorised Qur'anic word is not the same competency as productive control of it, and conflating the two will flatter the figure substantially in this particular school.

objections.grade: G10-G12 — الترجمة (#16), written Yoruba
objections.objection: #16 correctly identifies written Yoruba orthography — tone marking, ẹ/ọ/ṣ — as [UNVERIFIED] and possibly absent from the morning curriculum, and correctly keeps Yoruba oral 'until at least G10'. But the G11 content invokes a school Arabic-Yoruba term list and the G12 capstone appears to require written Yoruba work. If any written Yoruba is assessed at G11-G12, the competency is owned by nobody across twelve years, and the student is marked in an orthography he was never taught. This matters beyond the mark: Yoruba is the language the graduate will actually preach and teach in.
objections.recommendation: Decide explicitly and publish the decision. Either add a bounded Yoruba-orthography وحدة at G10 (six to eight periods inside الترجمة's existing fortnightly slot: tone marking, the sub-dot letters, the standard Islamic term orthography), or restrict ALL Yoruba work in this subject to oral through G12 and remove any written Yoruba from the G11-G12 assessment. Do not leave the G12 capstone specification ambiguous on this point.

objections.grade: G3-G7 (proposed) — الفواكه الساقطة, الشيخ آدم عبد الله الإلوري
objections.objection: Author confirmed, contents, length and register not. From a developmental standpoint that is not a minor gap: a memorisation load cannot be assigned without a line or syllable count, and a text cannot be placed in a grade without knowing its register. The architectural argument for the work — bringing indigenous West African Arabic scholarship into a strand otherwise composed entirely of Eastern classical texts — is genuinely strong and worth acting on, and for a Yoruba-speaking cohort the identification value of a Nigerian scholar's Arabic is real and rare. But it cannot be scheduled on that argument alone.
objections.recommendation: Do not place it in النشيد والمحفوظات or assign it any memorisation load until a physical copy is sighted and a line count and register assessment are recorded. The lowest-risk and highest-value home for it, once sighted, is as a READ (not memorised) text in النقد والآداب at G10-G12, alongside the periodisation work — where a Nigerian author sits deliberately beside الأندلسي and العباسي material and makes a point that a memorisation slot cannot. Route to the النشيد owner (#4) with that recommendation and the sighting requirement attached.

objections.grade: G12 — المنطق وعلم الكلام (#12), مدمج with العقيدة
objections.objection: A Programme 2 subject's only G12 presence is a component inside a Programme 3 block, assessed on Programme 3's paper. #12 handles the traceability carefully (own syllabus, own section, own mark), so this is not a redline-9 violation. But it does mean that the programme cannot report its own G12 outcome for this subject without reaching into another programme's assessment, and that the teacher delivering it is an عقيدة teacher, not a منطق teacher — the two G10-G11 years having been taught by someone else.
objections.recommendation: State in the register that the G12 كلام component is taught by the G10-G11 المنطق teacher, not by the عقيدة teacher, even though it sits inside the عقيدة block — continuity of teacher is what makes the meta-disciplinary stance survivable at seventeen. Record the mark in both programmes' returns.

objections.grade: G11-G12 — النقد والآداب (#13), reading list volume
objections.objection: At 2 periods a week the G11-G12 student is scheduled against أبواب منتخبة of العمدة, مقدمة الشعر والشعراء, الموازنة, الوساطة, مقدمة طبقات فحول الشعراء, extracts of نقد الشعر, فصول of دلائل الإعجاز, passages of البيان والتبيين, and a section of مقدمة ابن خلدون. The capability is plausible at sixteen and seventeen given the Arabic this curriculum builds; the volume is not, at 78 periods a year shared between two disciplines. Without a stated budget the teacher will sample everything and land nothing, which for a capstone subject is the specific failure of producing a graduate who can name critics and cannot criticise.
objections.recommendation: Convert the text list from a syllabus into a menu with a published budget: name a maximum page or line allocation per text per year, and organise G12 around ONE sustained dispute — الموازنة and الوساطة read against each other on the same poets — rather than surveying five critics. Everything else becomes optional teacher reference. #13's stated aim, 'model disciplined disagreement', is better served by one argument followed properly than by nine extracts.

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: At G8 the اللغة العربية block is sold at least four times over. البلاغة claims two-thirds of a period inside it, النقد claims one lesson per week inside it, الترجمة ring-fences a full period of it, and الإملاء takes a further slice — and البلاغة، النقد and الترجمة all name the SAME حصة النصوص as their host. Meanwhile the subject's own owner declares G8 'the unvocalised transition year, and it deserves a whole year to itself'. No per-subject reviewer could see this, because each one was being scrupulous about not requesting a new period and each believed the existing period was free. The developmental consequence is precise: withdrawing vowels is the single hardest cognitive shift in the twelve years for a Yoruba-L1 reader, and running three other analytic frames plus three separate assessment regimes over the same text in the same weeks will produce a thirteen-year-old who can say تشبيه and كناية and cannot read an unvowelled page — the exact recognise-a-term-without-possessing-a-competency failure this review exists to catch. G8 must be re-planned as a single 2-period حصة النصوص with one mark, three traceable components and a published term rotation, and the whole-school G8 period table must be produced before approval.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives:
A great deal, and it should be protected by name rather than quietly carried along with the fixes.

1. اللغة العربية G1: oral-only, no letters, listening and speaking before print, with lexical fields the child physically inhabits. This is the best G1 decision in the programme and the only one in Programme 2 that fully respects what a six-year-old L2 learner needs. What protects it: the التجويد phonology gift from the ring-fenced Qur'an hour, which genuinely does build the ع ح خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق contrasts for free — #7 is right that in most Arabic-as-L2 settings this consumes months and here it does not.

2. البلاغة G8-G9: التشبيه first and alone, no book, no taxonomy, شواهد drawn exclusively from material already in long-term memory, and the standing exercise 'قل المعنى بعبارة أخرى، ثم قارن' — productive before terminological. Working on memorised material frees working memory for the comparison itself, which is the whole cognitive point. This is the finest piece of developmental design in the submission and the sequence (intuition, then taxonomy at G10) is exactly right.

3. الصرف's staged abstraction argument: الميزان at G6 because symbolic placeholding (ف ع ل standing for any three consonants, by position) is the gate; الإعلال at G8 because tolerating an underlying form that never surfaces (قال analysed as قول) is a strictly harder abstraction. That is reasoning from the child's actual cognition rather than from the shape of the discipline, and it is the strongest single argument anywhere in these ten lifecycles.

4. المنطق's nine consecutive refusals, G1-G9, and above all the G5 refusal: not handing a ten-year-old the vocabulary of refutation in the same year as نواقض الإسلام. That is a genuine developmental insight and it actively reinforces redline 6 rather than merely complying with it.

5. الإملاء's zero permanent periods across all twelve grades, differentiating at G5 into a named, assessed strand with no timetable line. This is the model the rest of the programme should have followed — it vindicates redline 7 on the discipline's own grounds, it keeps spelling attached to the composition where transfer must happen, and its G10 وحدة on الرسم العثماني versus الرسم الإملائي is exactly the right content in exactly the right place for a Qur'an-memorising school.

6. الإنشاء's slow productive ramp: G3 one complete spoken sentence instead of one word; G5 a separately reported mark on productive skill precisely because productive work is the first thing teachers cut under time pressure; G9 delivery mechanics and خطبة الحاجة before any composed address; G10-G12 escalating from three minutes to ten to a real audience. The progression is patient and correctly ordered.

7. العروض's G5-G7 ear-strand at genuinely zero cost — hearing before naming, self-monitoring before notation, and the explicit refusal to introduce الميزان العروضي in the year الميزان الصرفي matures. Separating the two balances in time is right and the reason given is the right reason.

8. الترجمة's G6 debut on already-memorised material only, with ترجمة المعاني taught in lesson one and printed on page one. In a region with a live public Yoruba tafsir practice, teaching an eleven-year-old the framing before he ever renders a verse is both developmentally and doctrinally the correct order.

9. النقد والآداب claiming zero periods across G1-G7. A capstone subject that declines to colonise the early years, and says so as a deliberate contribution to the budget rather than as modesty, is behaving correctly.

10. The general refusal across this programme to manufacture early presence — seven of the ten subjects carry a genuine '—' at G1-G3 with a stated reason, and several explicitly reject a tempting taster. That collective discipline is what makes 'rich but clean' achievable at all, and it should be recorded as the programme's principal achievement.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب / البلاغة / الترجمة / الإملاء / النحو — G8–G9
objections.objection: The اللغة العربية block is sold four times over at G8–G9 while its owner declares G8 "the unvocalised transition year, and it deserves a whole year to itself." النقد والآداب takes one lesson/week "inside the existing اللغة العربية allocation"; البلاغة takes "25–30 minutes/week"; الترجمة ring-fences "ONE period of the existing اللغة العربية (النصوص) allocation"; الإملاء takes a further slice; and at G6–G7 الإنشاء والخطابة has already ring-fenced one period inside the same block. Each declares "0 new periods" and each is individually honest; the aggregate is roughly 2.7–3 periods/week of a block that is probably 4–5, leaving اللغة العربية between one and two periods to run the single hardest transition in an L2 Arabic curriculum. Separately, النحو at G8 also runs a named وحدة "قراءة النص غير المشكول" — so the same competency is timetabled twice, in two subjects, in the same year, with neither knowing.
objections.recommendation: Publish an explicit G8–G9 block map for اللغة العربية before approval: state its period count and allot named sub-periods (النصوص/النقد 1، الترجمة 1، البلاغة 0.5، الإملاء embedded) with a protected residue of not less than 2 periods for the vowel-withdrawal programme itself. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION] Assign the unvowelled transition to ONE owner — اللغة العربية, since it controls the graded withdrawal of حركات across three terms — and reduce النحو's G8 وحدة to an applied إعراب-recovery exercise on texts اللغة العربية has already de-vowelled, not a parallel course.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب / البلاغة / الإملاء / العروض — G10
objections.objection: At G10 the اللغة العربية block ceases to exist, but three subjects are still billeted on it, and the pairing declarations contradict each other three ways. اللغة العربية G10 says it is مدمج with النقد والآداب. النقد والآداب G10 says its partner "switches from اللغة العربية to البلاغة". البلاغة G10 declares itself مستقل with no partner — and الترجمة G10 says it runs a fortnightly session inside البلاغة's allocation, which البلاغة does not budget. Meanwhile الإملاء's 8–10 period رسم عثماني وحدة is "hosted inside اللغة العربية's existing allocation" and العروض's completion rotation sits "in the اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب band" — both hosted on a block that, on اللغة العربية's own account, no longer exists as a standalone entity at G10. This is not a rounding error; four subjects' G10 delivery has no confirmed home.
objections.recommendation: Rule G10 explicitly. Recommended: النقد والآداب مدمج + البلاغة is the pair (it is the classical pairing and the strongest argument in either paper); اللغة العربية's المطالعة الموسّعة strand becomes a named, separately-marked strand INSIDE that pair rather than a third partner; and الإملاء's رسم عثماني وحدة and العروض's completion rotation are moved into a single shared one-term rotation slot with a named owner and a stated period count, not "hosted" language. No subject may declare a host in its own lifecycle without that host's lifecycle carrying the reciprocal entry.

objections.grade: البلاغة / النقد والآداب / المنطق — differentiation arguments, G10–G12
objections.objection: Three subjects build their differentiation case on a نحو ladder that is not the submitted one. البلاغة: "نحو runs الآجرومية (G6) → ملحة الإعراب (G7) → consolidation and extension (G8-G9)". النقد والآداب and المنطق say the same. The actual النحو lifecycle runs قطر الندى at G8–G9 and ألفية ابن مالك at G10–G12 at 3/3/2/2 periods. So all three consuming subjects believe نحو is finished and quiet by G10, when in fact it is at its heaviest and most abstract (شرح ابن عقيل, أوضح المسالك, إعراب الجمل, third-contact material treated as an object of theory). Every "the student is free at G10" claim in Programme 2 is computed against a phantom.
objections.recommendation: Re-run البلاغة, النقد والآداب and المنطق's differentiation arguments against the real ladder and restate the dependency line in each as "الآجرومية G6 → ملحة G7 → قطر الندى G8–G9 → الألفية G10–G12 (running concurrently)". If, restated, the G10–G12 load does not fit, the release valve النحو itself offers should be taken: النحو already concedes 2 periods rather than 3 at G6, and الآجرومية is a short matn that does not need a full year at 3 periods.

objections.grade: Programme 2 aggregate — G10–G12
objections.objection: Five subjects differentiate into independent identity inside two years: الإنشاء والخطابة (خطابة joins, G10), البلاغة (مستقل G10), النقد والآداب (مستقل G11), الترجمة (مستقل G11), المنطق (مستقل G11) — while النحو carries الألفية and الصرف, العروض and الإملاء all claim embedded time in the same blocks. A G11 tally from the papers themselves: النحو 2 + البلاغة 2 + النقد 2 + الترجمة 2 + الإنشاء ~2 + المنطق 1 + اللغة العربية's وحدة ≈ 1 = roughly 12 of the 19 [RECOVERED] periods, before Programme 3 places أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث، الفقه، العقيدة، التفسير، الحديث، السيرة. That is not an allocation.
objections.recommendation: Programme 2 must arrive at G11 holding no more than 8 periods. Concrete route: الترجمة stays مدمج at G11 and differentiates only at G12 (see below); المنطق's التصديقات runs as a second دوراني term block rather than a full-year مستقل line; النقد والآداب runs 2 but absorbs البلاغة's G11 second period as a single 3-period أدب وبلاغة pair rather than two 2-period lines; النحو holds at 2. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

objections.grade: الصرف — G7–G9 (لامية الأفعال)
objections.objection: لامية الأفعال is being asked to do a job it was not written for. It is a compressed mnemonic أرجوزة/لامية on أبنية الأفعال والمصادر, composed as a summary FOR someone who already holds the science — which is exactly why بحرق had to write a شرح for it. The lifecycle uses it first at G7 for المزيد والمصادر القياسية (defensible as a memorised table), then makes it the SPINE for the two hardest chapters in the discipline at G8–G9: المعتل بأنواعه، الإعلال بالقلب والنقل والحذف، الإبدال، الإدغام، المشتقات. I am not confident the لامية carries a systematic treatment of الإعلال والإبدال والإدغام of the density G8–G9 assumes, and the lifecycle's own text table already hedges by adding "a modern exercise book (procurement decision)" at G8. Building two years of a science on a matn whose coverage has not been confirmed is the failure mode this review exists to catch.
objections.recommendation: Verify against a physical copy with شرح بحرق exactly which أبواب the لامية covers BEFORE adoption, and do not print the G8–G9 syllabus until that check is done. [PROFESSIONAL INFERENCE] The sound structure is a prose spine plus a memorised summary: run G8–G9 المعتل والإعلال والإبدال والإدغام from a prose treatment written for school use — شذا العرف في فن الصرف (أحمد الحملاوي) is the obvious candidate and is exactly this level — and retain لامية الأفعال as the memorised compression, recited and cashed against the prose, not as the source of instruction. التصريف العزي للزنجاني, which the paper already lists as a fallback, is the classical alternative.

objections.grade: النقد والآداب — G9 (المعلقات)
objections.objection: Reading order is chronological where it should be difficulty-ordered, and the subject contradicts its own G8 logic to do it. G8 correctly opens on شعر الحكمة والزهد, قصار الخطب and أمثال — the accessible register. G9 then jumps to أدب الجاهلية and puts المعلقات in front of a Yoruba-speaking L2 learner who has only just crossed into unvowelled text at G8 and holds roughly 4,000–5,000 words. المعلقات are the lexically hardest Arabic in the canon: غريب اللغة, pre-Islamic material culture, ellipsis and inversion of exactly the kind الآجرومية's examples avoid. Excerpting to 10–15 أبيات reduces the quantity of غريب, not its density. The predictable result is a شرح-dictation lesson in which the teacher translates and the student copies — the precise habit النحو's own paper warns against ("إعراب performed on a sentence the student does not understand is arithmetic on nonsense").
objections.recommendation: Keep the historical FRAME chronological (الجاهلي → صدر الإسلام → أموي → عباسي → أندلسي, pegged to السيرة والتاريخ as proposed) but read backwards in difficulty: G9 = ديوان الحماسة by باب plus عباسي/أندلسي زهد وحكمة; G10 = صدر الإسلام والأموي plus خطب; المعلقات enter at G11 only, when البلاغة's بيان is taxonomised, العروض's الطويل والبسيط are in hand and the dictionary/غريب skill is established. [NEW ENGINEERING DECISION]

objections.grade: العروض G8/G10 vs النقد والآداب G9–G10
objections.objection: العروض's G8 unit teaches a starter set of بحور and defers الطويل، البسيط، الخفيف، السريع، المنسرح — plus the whole of الزحافات والعلل — to a G10 rotation. النقد والآداب starts reading المعلقات at G9 and treats الأغراض الشعرية systematically at G10. The metres of that corpus are overwhelmingly الطويل، الكامل، الوافر، البسيط، الخفيف: the student meets the poems in the two years when the metres they are actually written in have not been taught, and scans with ideal تفعيلات that almost never occur unaltered in real verse because الزحافات are two years away. النقد's own prerequisite list says العروض is "needed operationally by G10" and "assumed established as a bounded course at G8-G9" — but العروض's completion is AT G10, concurrent, not prior.
objections.recommendation: Move الطويل والبسيط into the G8 unit — neither is cognitively harder than الكامل, only longer — and move the most frequent زحافات (الخبن، الإضمار، الكف، القبض) into G9's consolidation year as applied repair work on متون already memorised. Leave the rare بحور، العلل and القافية at G10. If the Council instead keeps العروض as submitted, النقد's poetic reading must move to G10–G11 (which the difficulty argument above already recommends).

objections.grade: المنطق وعلم الكلام — programme placement, G10–G12
objections.objection: This subject is in the wrong programme and the register entry fuses two sciences that the lifecycle itself then separates. المنطق is an آلة science of the العلوم العقلية, and علم الكلام belongs to أصول الدين — neither is one of علوم العربية. The consequence is not cosmetic: the G12 كلام component is delivered inside the Programme 3 العقيدة block, taught by the عقيدة teacher, marked on the عقيدة paper — i.e. a Programme 2 subject whose only G12 presence is hosted, staffed and examined by another programme that did not design it. Meanwhile المنطق's real consumers (أصول الفقه، مصطلح الحديث) are also in Programme 3.
objections.recommendation: Split the register entry. Keep المنطق in Programme 2 for timetabling only, labelled explicitly as آلة, with a one-line note that its disciplinary classification is عقلي not عربي so no future reader infers that the school treats logic as a branch of Arabic. Transfer علم الكلام outright to the Programme 3 العقيدة lifecycle as a named, separately-marked G12 component with its own syllabus — the design as written is sound, it is merely owned by the wrong programme. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

objections.grade: المنطق — G10 Term 2
objections.objection: The آلة is being delivered after its consumer has opened. أصول الفقه arrives at G10 (stated in الترجمة's own differentiation argument) and مصطلح الحديث differentiates at G10–G11 [redline 1]. Both open on definitional and divisional apparatus — الحد والرسم، التصور والتصديق، القياس، التقسيم — which is precisely what المنطق's قسم التصورات supplies. Scheduling المنطق in Term 2 means أصول الفقه spends Term 1 improvising the definitional vocabulary, and then the منطق teacher re-teaches it in Term 2 with a different terminology.
objections.recommendation: Move the G10 المنطق rotation to Term 1 and write into أصول الفقه's scheme that its مقدمات (الحد، التصور والتصديق، أقسام الدلالة) are scheduled after it and cross-referenced to السلم rather than re-defined. Costs nothing — it is a term swap inside an already-agreed rotation slot.

objections.grade: Programme-wide orientation — G6 (الأخضري فقه), G10–G12 (السلم المنورق، الجوهر المكنون، الرد على المنطقيين)
objections.objection: Assessing coherence, not permissibility, as instructed: the Programme 2 matn corpus is more doctrinally loaded than any of the ten papers notices, because no single reviewer saw it assembled. عبد الرحمن الأخضري supplies three texts across the architecture — الأخضري in فقه at G6 [redline 3], السلم المنورق at G10–G11, الجوهر المكنون at G11–G12 — a coherent Mālikī-Ashʿarī Algerian matn family that carries its own assumptions about the status of منطق and of كلام. Set against that: the G12 teacher-reference list for المنطق includes ابن تيمية's الرد على المنطقيين, and the wider architecture now carries القصيدة اللامية في السنة and مقدمة في أصول التفسير. This combination is real and common in contemporary Nigerian Islamic education. It is nonetheless a definite commitment, and it is unmanaged: two teachers could teach السلم's own opening lines on حكم الاشتغال بالمنطق in flatly contradictory ways, in the same school, in the same year.
objections.recommendation: The Council, not a curriculum reviewer, rules on orientation — but it must rule explicitly rather than inherit a position by accident of text selection. Minimum action: issue one written teaching brief covering السلم المنورق، الجوهر المكنون and the الأخضري فقه spine, stating how the school teaches a matn whose tradition it does not wholly adopt, and stating whether الرد على المنطقيين is offered to G12 teachers as a counter-position taught as such or withdrawn. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

objections.grade: Programme-wide — القصيدة اللامية في السنة, unpacking grade absent
objections.objection: Responding to the Director General's consequence (b): nothing in Programme 2 unpacks the poem, and nothing in Programme 2 should. If the لامية is memorised young on a memorise-now/comprehend-later basis, the unpacking job is creedal exposition (الصفات، خلق القرآن، الرؤية) and belongs to العقيدة. The only Programme 2 slot that touches creed at all is the G12 علم الكلام component — and that component is deliberately, and correctly, built as a META-discipline ("how Muslims argued creed, not a creed to adopt"). Using it to explain a creedal matn the student has carried since G4–G5 would destroy exactly the meta/first-order boundary that makes the G12 component safe. As the papers stand, the graduate carries a memorised creedal poem that no named grade in any programme is assigned to explain.
objections.recommendation: Assign the unpacking explicitly to العقيدة at G9 or G10 — after the settled, non-anxious creed the المنطق paper rightly names as a prerequisite, and before the G12 كلام component historicises the debates. Name the grade in the العقيدة lifecycle as a numbered outcome ("شرح القصيدة اللامية بيتًا بيتًا"), not as an aspiration. If the Council declines to assign it, the honest alternative is to remove the poem from the memorisation load rather than leave it unexplained. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

objections.grade: النقد والآداب — G9–G12 (absence of West African Arabic letters)
objections.objection: The literature-and-criticism arc of a Nigerian institution with West African scholarly roots contains not one West African author across four years. The canon is entirely Mashriqi: جاهلي، أموي، عباسي، أندلسي, الحماسة, المعلقات, الآمدي, الجرجاني, ابن سلام, ابن قتيبة, ابن رشيق. This was invisible to the per-subject reviewer and is now urgent, because the Director General has confirmed the author of الفواكه الساقطة as الشيخ آدم عبد الله الإلوري — the founder of مركز التعليم العربي الإسلامي in Agege — which gives the memorisation/literary strand an indigenous anchor it currently lacks, and gives النقد والآداب an obvious and defensible home for it.
objections.recommendation: Add a bounded وحدة at G11 or G12: الأدب العربي في غرب إفريقيا — one term, inside النقد والآداب's existing 2 periods, no new line. Build it on the CONFIRMED author and a reading list verified locally from physical copies; do NOT build it on الفواكه الساقطة's contents, length or register, which remain [UNVERIFIED] and must not be asserted. If the text proves suitable on inspection, it becomes the unit's centre; if not, the unit stands on other verified Nigerian Arabic writing and the school has still closed a real gap.

objections.grade: النقد والآداب G12 vs الإنشاء والخطابة G11–G12 (البيان والتبيين)
objections.objection: One book, two owners, same years, neither aware. الإنشاء والخطابة takes البيان والتبيين at G11–G12 as its oratory spine ("the canonical Arabic treatment of oratory", read for بلاغة، إيجاز، مطابقة المقام). النقد والآداب takes البيان والتبيين at G12 as selected passages and as a teacher source from G9. Two subjects will order the same volume, select overlapping passages, and the student will meet الجاحظ twice without either teacher knowing the other did it. (The parallel double-claim on نظرية النظم was correctly resolved — النقد defers ownership to البلاغة — which shows the mechanism works when a subject notices.)
objections.recommendation: Split الجاحظ by function in both schemes of work: الإنشاء والخطابة takes the خطب and the criteria of effective address; النقد والآداب takes the أدبي/نقدي material and الجاحظ's own judgements on poets and critics. Print the specific أبواب each subject owns in both documents. Apply the same rule to جواهر الأدب and أدب الكاتب, each of which currently appears in two lifecycles.

objections.grade: الإنشاء والخطابة — G9 vs البلاغة G8–G11
objections.objection: الإنشاء's own prerequisite list names an unsatisfied dependency and then proceeds anyway. It requires "التشبيه، الاستعارة، الكناية، الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي، مطابقة الكلام لمقتضى الحال — needed live by G9 at the latest", flagging it [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]. البلاغة delivers the first three by G9 (مضمّن), but الخبر والإنشاء arrives at G10 and مقتضى الحال/القصر/الفصل والوصل at G10–G11. So half the G9 rubric marks a competence that will not exist for another one to two years — and the mark will be recorded against the student.
objections.recommendation: Cheapest correct fix: cut the G9 الإنشاء rubric back to the بيان items البلاغة actually delivers by G9 (تشبيه، استعارة، كناية used in the student's own production), and move الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي and مطابقة مقتضى الحال into the G10–G11 rubric, where البلاغة supplies them in the same year. Do not move البلاغة forward — its refusal to differentiate before G10 is the strongest argument in the paper and must not be traded away to fix a rubric.

objections.grade: الصرف G6/G10/G11 and G12 vs النحو G6/G10–G12
objections.objection: الصرف declares itself مدمج or مضمّن with النحو at G6, G7, G10 and G11; النحو declares itself مستقل with no partner at every one of those grades and budgets no time for a partner. الصرف asks for "a combined النحو والصرف block of 4 periods/week" at G6 while النحو asks for 3 for itself alone. Worse at the far end: النحو's G12 entry hands الإعلال والإبدال والإدغام "to الصرف, not taught twice" — but الصرف's own verdict is that the science closed at G9 and G12 is a one-term revision وحدة of about one period a week. النحو is handing a live teaching obligation to a subject that has already shut, and the hand-off is scheduled by nobody.
objections.recommendation: Write the reciprocal entries. At G6–G7 declare a single named نحو وصرف block of 4 periods with an internal 3/1 split and a stated intra-year sequencing constraint (المثنى والجموع والأسماء الخمسة before المعربات بالحروف; أقسام الكلمة before متن البناء opens). At G10–G11 the الصرف application slice must appear as a line in النحو's own scheme or it will not happen. At G12, schedule الصرف's revision وحدة in the SAME term النحو reaches الإعلال والإبدال في الألفية, and name which teacher marks it.

objections.grade: الترجمة — G11
objections.objection: الترجمة takes 2 مستقل periods in G11, the most congested year in the ladder, for a discipline that has no classical matn, whose G11 content is method and term-list work, and whose own capstone is portfolio-based. Its argument against differentiating at G12 is that the defining competence needs two years — but that conflates learning with identity: the competence can be built مدمج (as it has been, successfully, since G6) and the independent identity can arrive with the capstone. Of every independent claim at G10–G12 this is the one whose removal costs the least learning.
objections.recommendation: Hold الترجمة مدمج at G11 with النقد والآداب or البلاغة (one period ring-fenced and separately marked, exactly as at G8–G10), and differentiate to مستقل 2 periods at G12 with the portfolio as submitted. This returns 2 periods to the worst year in the architecture without losing a single stated G12 outcome.

objections.grade: الترجمة — G6
objections.objection: G6 الترجمة is independently assessed from Term 1, but its own prerequisite list requires "الإعراب sufficient to identify فاعل، مفعول، مضاف and not invert agent and patient — established by النحو / متن الآجرومية, G6" — i.e. established in the same year. النحو's G6 term plan reaches المرفوعات (including الفاعل) only in Term 2 and المنصوبات in Term 3. So for two of three terms the student is assessed on a rendering skill whose grammatical gate is still being built, and a نحو failure will be recorded as a ترجمة failure — the exact misdiagnosis the lifecycle warns against at G5.
objections.recommendation: Keep the G6 debut (it is Council direction and the material is already-memorised, already-glossed Qur'an), but restrict Terms 1–2 to oral Yoruba rendering with embedded assessment, and place the independent ترجمة mark in Term 3 only, after النحو has delivered الفاعل والمفعول. Costs nothing and removes the misdiagnosis.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية / القراءة والتهجي — G1–G2
objections.objection: اللغة العربية asks for 3 of 7 periods and names القراءة والتهجي at 3 more, leaving "1 shared" — roughly one period for everything else at G1–G2. Yet four other lifecycles in this set describe the G1–G2 budget as "fully committed to القراءة والتهجي, اللغة العربية, التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي" — that is, they assume two Programme 3 subjects are running which Programme 2's own arithmetic leaves no room for. One of the two descriptions is false and the papers cannot tell which.
objections.recommendation: Publish the G1–G2 seven-period grid as a single ruled table before approval. If التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي are to be real timetabled entities, اللغة العربية should take 2 and القراءة والتهجي 3, freeing 2. If instead they are delivered عملي inside routine and the Qur'an hour, say so explicitly in their own lifecycles so no later reader assumes periods that do not exist. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]

objections.grade: البلاغة — G11 (الجوهر المكنون)
objections.objection: The memorised منظومة is ordered against the taught sequence. البلاغة teaches بيان first (G8–G10) then معاني (G10–G11) then بديع last, following البلاغة الواضحة — a defensible pedagogical inversion of the classical القزويني order, and the paper argues for it well. But الجوهر المكنون is itself arranged معاني → بيان → بديع. Memorising it "بابًا بابًا" from G11 therefore runs the student through the tradition's order while the class works in the opposite one, and the متن's معاني chapters will be memorised before its own بيان chapters are reached in class — for no gain.
objections.recommendation: Either sequence the memorisation to follow the taught order (بيان أبواب first, then معاني, then بديع) and say in the scheme of work that this is a deliberate re-ordering of the منظومة, or defer the memorisation wholesale to G12 and the إجازة track, where it functions as consolidation of an apparatus already complete. Also state in the teacher brief that the منظومة's own arrangement is the classical one, so students are not left thinking the textbook order is the tradition's.

objections.grade: النقد والآداب — G11 (العمدة) and G12 source load
objections.objection: Two smaller disciplinary slips. (1) العمدة لابن رشيق is called "the teaching matn". It is not a matn — it is a large كتاب أدبي ونقدي of many أبواب. Calling it a matn in a school where matn has a precise operational meaning (memorised, recited, cashed on worked examples) invites a teacher to set it for حفظ. (2) G12 carries الموازنة، الوساطة، مقدمة طبقات فحول الشعراء، نقد الشعر لقدامة، مقدمة ابن خلدون، البيان والتبيين and (jointly) دلائل الإعجاز in 2 periods/week — around 78 periods for seven primary sources. That is a reading list, not a syllabus.
objections.recommendation: Replace "teaching matn" with "الكتاب المقرر، أبواب منتخبة" and state that nothing in العمدة is memorised. For G12, make الموازنة and الوساطة the two spines (the paper's own best idea — watching two critics disagree about the same poets is the year's actual method), reduce ابن سلام and قدامة to a single session each read as specimens, and leave دلائل الإعجاز entirely to البلاغة, which already owns it.

objections.grade: Text-verification flags — العروض, النقد والآداب, الإنشاء, الترجمة, الإملاء
objections.objection: Several works are marked "uncertain" that are in fact well attested, while the one flag that genuinely matters is buried. Attested and routinely printed: العيون الغامزة على خبايا الرامزة (الدماميني); أهدى سبيل إلى علمي الخليل (محمود مصطفى); العروض الواضح وعلم القافية (محمد علي الهاشمي); الوسيط في الأدب العربي وتاريخه (الإسكندري وعناني); مورد الظمآن في رسم أحرف القرآن (الخراز); الجاحظ's remarks on الترجمان in كتاب الحيوان; and جواهر الأدب, whose full title is جواهر الأدب في أدبيات وإنشاء لغة العرب (أحمد الهاشمي) — the truncated title is what made it look doubtful. Leaving these as design uncertainty lets a procurement question masquerade as an architectural one.
objections.recommendation: Downgrade these from [UNVERIFIED] to "confirm edition on procurement" and remove them from the open-questions list. Keep two flags exactly as they stand, because they are correct and load-bearing: متن البناء's AUTHOR must not be printed until a physical copy is checked, and كتاب العروض المنسوب إلى الخليل must never be scheduled as a teaching text. Also treat القراءة الراشدة (اللغة العربية G6–G8) as attested in madrasa use but unresolved as to edition and level — inspect a copy before it becomes the G6 spine, since the whole G6 override rests on it.

objections.grade: الإملاء — G10–G12 (رسم عثماني، عقيلة أتراب القصائد)
objections.objection: The G10 وحدة on الرسم العثماني والرسم الإملائي and the optional عقيلة أتراب القصائد are both رسم المصحف material — a branch of علوم القرآن والقراءات, not of Arabic orthography. المقنع للداني is a رسم work and عقيلة أتراب القصائد is الشاطبي's منظومة on رسم المصحف, written for the قراءات student. Housing them in الإملاء is understandable (nothing else claims them) but it puts a Programme 1 discipline inside a Programme 2 subject with no coordination clause, and the Qur'an programme may well teach the same material — differently.
objections.recommendation: Keep the G10 وحدة in الإملاء, since its practical ruling (quote Qur'an as Qur'an in رسم عثماني, everything else in رسم إملائي) is an editorial standard the Arabic side must enforce. But state in both lifecycles that رسم المصحف is owned by the Qur'an programme, and move عقيلة أتراب القصائد out of الإملاء into the Qur'an programme's إجازة track, where a قراءات منظومة belongs.

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: اللغة العربية's teaching block is sold four times over at G8–G9 and then abolished at G10. النقد والآداب, البلاغة, الترجمة and الإملاء each declare "zero new periods" and each funds itself from inside اللغة العربية's allocation; individually every claim is honest, and in aggregate they consume most of a block whose owner has simultaneously declared G8 a whole year devoted to the unvowelled-text transition — the single hardest passage in an Arabic-as-L2 ladder, and the stated prerequisite for the entire secondary stage of all three programmes. Then at G10 اللغة العربية stops existing as a standalone entity, and الإملاء's رسم عثماني وحدة and العروض's completion rotation are still billeted on it, while اللغة العربية, البلاغة and النقد والآداب give three mutually contradictory accounts of who is paired with whom. No per-subject reviewer could see this; every one of them was telling the truth about their own page. The architecture must not be approved until the G8–G10 blocks are published as ruled grids with named sub-periods and reciprocal partner entries in both lifecycles of every pair.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives: The disciplinary spine of Programme 2 is genuinely sound and several of its refusals are better than what a conventional school would produce. Protect these. (1) The نحو ladder الآجرومية G6 → ملحة الإعراب G7 → قطر الندى G8–G9 → الألفية G10–G12 is the customary order, correctly paced, and its treatment of ملحة as a second differently-shaped pass over the same ground rather than a level above it is exactly right; so is the decision to spend the institution's memorisation advantage on an أرجوزة at G7, and to omit شذور الذهب openly rather than pretend to cover it. (2) البلاغة's refusal to differentiate before G10, on the ground that علم المعاني is parasitic on consolidated نحو and would otherwise become remedial نحو under a بلاغة label, is the strongest single argument in the ten papers and must not be traded away to fix any downstream rubric. Its doctrine that البديع تابع للمعنى لا مقصود لذاته is the correct inoculation and its refusal of تلخيص المفتاح, مفتاح العلوم and الإيضاح as student texts is right. (3) العروض's placement of الميزان العروضي at G8, deliberately separated in time from الميزان الصرفي so the two balances do not fuse, is a real disciplinary insight, as is its refusal to schedule the كتاب العروض attributed to الخليل. (4) الصرف's placement of الميزان الصرفي at G6 on the symbolic-placeholder argument, its honest [UNVERIFIED] flag on متن البناء's author, and its refusal of الشافية لابن الحاجب are all correct and the author flag must be kept. (5) الإملاء's refusal of a standalone timetable line — argued on the discipline's own grounds rather than as compliance with redline 7 — is the best-reasoned entry on the register, and its rule sequencing (الألف اللينة after the ثلاثي root test, الهمزة المتوسطة after وزن awareness, الهمزة المتطرفة after الإعلال والإبدال) is genuinely derived from the morphology rather than from a spelling book's table of contents. (6) The G12 pairing of الموازنة بين الطائيين with الوساطة بين المتنبي وخصومه, used to teach disciplined disagreement rather than conclusions, is the right capstone for النقد and is worth more than the five other primary sources currently stacked beside it. (7) الإنشاء's rejection of مقامات الحريري is defensible and consistent with the programme's meaning-over-ornament stance, and its G9 خطبة الحاجة / G10 خطبة حجة الوداع sequence — memorise the formula, analyse the model, then compose — is sound craft teaching. (8) المنطق's insistence that كلام be taught as a meta-discipline (how Muslims argued creed, not a creed to adopt) and only after a settled creed, and its refusal to plant a phantom مضمّن منطق in the early years, are both correct; the subject's only real fault is that it has been filed under the wrong programme. (9) الترجمة's ترجمة المعاني framing from lesson one, and its restriction of G6 rendering to already-memorised, non-contested Qur'anic material, protect a genuinely hazardous debut.

objections.grade: Programme-wide — G8 and G11 (aggregate period arithmetic)
objections.objection: Every one of these ten specialists correctly refused to place its subject at G6-G7 because G6-G7 is the heaviest matn-entry stage. None of them checked where the deferred load landed. It landed on G8 and G11, and it is not affordable there.
