Counting only the numbers the lifecycles themselves state: G11 = النحو 2 + البلاغة 2 (its own '4 period-slots total, G10 and G11') + النقد والآداب 2 (stated) + الإنشاء والخطابة ~2 + الترجمة ~2 (مستقل) + المنطق 1 (full-year standalone) + اللغة العربية's one-term modern-register وحدة annualised ~0.7 = 11.7 of 19. G8 = اللغة العربية ~4 (its own 'whole year to itself' for the unvocalised transition) + النحو 3 + الصرف 2 (مستقل differentiation) + الإنشاء 2 (مستقل differentiation) + العروض's one-term unit annualised ~0.7 = 11.7 of 19. In both years Programme 2 alone takes ~62% of a ceiling it shares with the whole of Programme 3 and any Programme 1 subject needing a slot. At G11 the residual is 7.3 periods for العقيدة، الفقه، أصول الفقه، الحديث/مصطلح الحديث، السيرة والتاريخ، الأخلاق and أصول التفسير — one period per week each. أصول الفقه on one period per week is not an allocation. By contrast Programme 2's claim at G6, the year everyone feared, is only 7-8 of 19, because at G6 the programme is compact (اللغة العربية + one نحو/صرف block). The load model the whole programme reasoned from is inverted.
objections.recommendation: Re-sequence to flatten G8 and G11, not G6. At G11: (a) hold الترجمة at مدمج with البلاغة for one more year and differentiate it مستقل at G12 only — its own G11 argument is that the student can now NAME the loss, and naming happens inside البلاغة's block; saves 2. (b) Convert المنطق's G11 التصديقات from a full-year 1-period standalone into a second one-term دوراني block in the same rotation slot as its G10 التصورات; saves ~0.7 and removes the worst timetable shape on the register. (c) Host اللغة العربية's G11 modern-register وحدة inside الترجمة, whose G11 content is register and audience; saves 0.7. Net G11 ≈ 8.3 of 19, leaving ~10.7 for Programmes 1 and 3. At G8: defer الصرف's مستقل differentiation to G9 (keeping G8 مدمج with النحو in a 4-period block, which is what الصرف itself proposes for G6-G7) and move العروض's bounded unit from G8 to G9, where the programme's own text says the skill must be consolidated anyway.

objections.grade: البلاغة G8-G9 / النقد والآداب G8-G9 / الترجمة G8-G9 — the single حصة النصوص
objections.objection: Three subjects independently designate the same lesson as their host and none of them knows the others exist. البلاغة G8-G9: 'مضمّن, partner اللغة العربية (حصة النصوص)', requesting 'roughly 25-30 minutes/week'. النقد والآداب G8: 'One lesson per week inside the existing اللغة العربية allocation… the نصوص lesson', becoming at G9 'one period per week, outcomes and marks reported separately'. الترجمة G8-G9: 'ONE period of the existing اللغة العربية (النصوص) allocation is ring-fenced as the rendering session.' That is ~2.6 periods of claim against one period of host. It is not a rounding problem: two of the three claims are for a whole period and are independently assessed, so neither can be silently compressed. Worse, all three are claiming the period in the year اللغة العربية itself calls 'the unvocalised transition year, and it deserves a whole year to itself'.
objections.recommendation: Arbitrate explicitly in the scheme of work rather than leaving it to the teacher. Concrete split at G8-G9: make the نصوص period a rotating three-week cycle inside one named period — week 1 نقد (شرح المفردات، إعادة الصياغة), week 2 بلاغة (the standing 'لماذا قال كذا ولم يقل كذا؟' exercise on the same text), week 3 ترجمة (rendering the same text, which is pedagogically the best of the three arrangements because the loss-note then has a بلاغة vocabulary already attached to it). One text, three lenses, one period. If the Council prefers three separate weekly contacts, then اللغة العربية must be funded at 5 periods at G8-G9 and that 1 extra period must be taken from a named Programme 3 subject by decision, not by drift.

objections.grade: النقد والآداب G11 vs البلاغة G10-G11
objections.objection: A stated prerequisite is not delivered on time and the subject owner said so himself without knowing it. النقد's prerequisite list: 'البلاغة: المعاني، البيان، البديع complete — needed by G11. Assumed complete by end of G10. If the board places البلاغة later, this subject's differentiation must move with it.' البلاغة's actual lifecycle: G10 rebuilds البيان and OPENS علم المعاني; G11 completes علم المعاني (القصر، الفصل والوصل، الإيجاز والإطناب) and only then teaches علم البديع. So البلاغة closes at the end of G11, not G10. النقد's مستقل differentiation at G11 therefore runs in the same year as the completion of its own third instrument — precisely the condition النقد used to rule out a G10 differentiation ('criticism attempted with incomplete البلاغة is impressionism with vocabulary'). The trigger clause النقد wrote for itself has fired.
objections.recommendation: Cheapest fix, preserving both placements: compress البلاغة so that البيان and علم المعاني both close at the end of G10, and move علم البديع — which البلاغة itself calls 'taught last and taught small' — into G11 as a bounded وحدة delivered inside النقد والآداب's block, where البديع belongs anyway because it is judged, not catalogued. البلاغة then genuinely IS complete at end of G10 and النقد's G11 differentiation stands. Fallback if the Council will not compress البلاغة: keep النقد مدمج with البلاغة at G11 and differentiate it مستقل at G12 only, accepting a one-year مستقل span — which is honest for a discipline that is the exercise of instruments rather than a body of content.

objections.grade: الإملاء G10 / العروض G10 / اللغة العربية G10
objections.objection: Two subjects host bounded units inside an allocation that does not exist. اللغة العربية at G10 is مدمج inside النقد والآداب as the المطالعة الموسّعة strand — it holds no block of its own. Yet الإملاء's G10 وحدة (8-10 periods on الرسم الإملائي vs الرسم العثماني) is 'hosted inside اللغة العربية's existing allocation', and العروض's G10 completion rotation is '1-2 periods/week… sitting in the اللغة العربية / النقد والآداب band'. Both are drawing on an account that closed. This is not a technicality: الإملاء's whole twelve-year case rests on 'ZERO permanent periods at every grade', and that claim is only true if a host exists at every grade where it teaches something new. At G10 it does not.
objections.recommendation: Create one named 2-period rotation band at G10 and put all three of the programme's bounded G10 claimants in it, one per term: Term 1 الإملاء (الرسم العثماني وحدة), Term 2 المنطق (التصورات — which already requests 'a term-rotation slot shared with another bounded subject'), Term 3 العروض (completion rotation). This costs 2 permanent periods of the 19 instead of three scattered and unfunded claims, gives each unit a real host, and satisfies المنطق's own stated preference. Amend الإملاء's period line to read 'ZERO permanent periods G1-G9 and G11-G12; one shared rotation term at G10' rather than zero throughout.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية G10 / النقد والآداب G10 and G12 / البلاغة G10 and G12
objections.objection: Three subjects declare مدمج pairings that their named partners do not reciprocate, and مدمج is defined as combination with ONE named partner. (a) اللغة العربية G10: 'مدمج, partner النقد والآداب'. النقد G10: 'Partner switches FROM اللغة العربية TO البلاغة.' اللغة العربية is being folded into a subject that has just declared it is no longer its partner. (b) النقد G10 names البلاغة as its partner; البلاغة G10 declares itself مستقل with no partner and describes G10 as its own differentiation year with its own book and paper. (c) البلاغة G12: 'مدمج, partner النقد والآداب'; النقد G12: 'مستقل, 2 periods/week.' Every one of these determines whether the timetable holds one block or two, and whether a head of department is scheduling one teacher or two. As submitted, G10 could be read as needing anywhere between 2 and 6 periods for the same three subjects.
objections.recommendation: Rule the pairings explicitly and write them in both directions or not at all. Recommended settlement: G10 = one 3-period النصوص والبلاغة block holding البلاغة (lead, own mark), النقد والآداب (own mark) and اللغة العربية's المطالعة الموسّعة strand (own mark) — a three-strand block is larger than redline 9 prefers, so the alternative is to drop اللغة العربية's المطالعة strand to a reading log administered by النقد with no separate teaching claim. G12 = one 3-period block with النقد والآداب as lead and البلاغة التطبيقية as a named traceable component, which is what البلاغة's own G12 text says and what النقد's G12 content (نظرية النظم 'taught jointly with البلاغة, which owns it') already assumes. Adopt a standing rule: no مدمج pairing is valid on the register unless both subjects' entries name each other.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية G5 (and G4)
objections.objection: Four separate subjects bank independently assessed strands inside one host block, and the host is left with no time for the work it says defines the year. At G5, اللغة العربية hosts: النحو مضمّن (independently assessed, '~1 of اللغة العربية's own periods ring-fenced inside its block'), الصرف مضمّن (independently assessed, 'approximately one period-equivalent inside اللغة العربية's existing allocation, plus a named assessment component'), الإملاء مضمّن (its stated DIFFERENTIATION YEAR — 'a named strand with its own published rule syllabus and its own mark'), and الإنشاء والخطابة مضمّن (independently assessed, 'a separately reported outcome inside اللغة العربية'). On a realistic G5 allocation of 4 periods, at least 2 are consumed by named guests and the remaining 2 must also carry the إملاء rule syllabus and the إنشاء التعبير الموجه tasks. اللغة العربية calls G5 'the pivot year' and assigns itself functional grammar through sentences plus continued reading of قصص النبيين. There is no time left in which to do it. The same pattern begins at G4 (الصرف مضمّن + الإنشاء مضمّن + الإملاء مضمّن).
objections.recommendation: Fund the host or cut the guests. Either (a) allocate اللغة العربية 5 periods at G4-G5 and publish the internal split as a binding scheme (2 general language, 1 نحو/صرف substrate, 1 قراءة موسعة, 1 تعبير وإملاء) — which means naming the Programme 3 subject that surrenders a period at G4-G5, by decision; or (b) reduce G5 to two assessed guest strands by (i) merging الصرف's and النحو's G5 substrate into a single 'قواعد وظيفية' strand with one mark — النحو's own insistence that it is 'NOT paired with الصرف' at G5 is a discipline-purity argument with no timetable payoff at age ten — and (ii) reporting الإملاء and الإنشاء as sub-strand marks on the اللغة العربية line rather than as separate register entries until G8.

objections.grade: اللغة العربية G1-G2 vs البلاغة G2 / المنطق G2 / النقد والآداب G2
objections.objection: The G1-G2 budget is contradicted between lifecycles and, as اللغة العربية states it, Programme 3 receives nothing. اللغة العربية asks for 3 of the 7 periods and prints its indicative fit as 'اللغة العربية 3 + القراءة والتهجي 3 + 1 shared practical' = 7 of 7. That leaves one shared period for التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي together, at the stage where a child learns الوضوء and الصلاة. Meanwhile المنطق's G2 entry asserts 'the 7-period G1-G2 ceiling is fully committed to القراءة والتهجي, اللغة العربية, التوحيد العملي and الفقه التطبيقي' as four funded subjects, and النقد's G2 entry says 'every period is load-bearing for decoding and for التوحيد/الفقه التطبيقي'. Three lifecycles are reasoning from a G1-G2 timetable that اللغة العربية's own arithmetic does not permit. Since these are the two years on which everything from G6 is built, the discrepancy cannot be left to be discovered in September.
objections.recommendation: Publish one binding G1-G2 grid before any lifecycle is approved. The defensible version at 7 periods: اللغة العربية 3 (oral, per its own case), القراءة والتهجي 2, التوحيد والفقه العملي 2 taught as one practical block. That means اللغة العربية keeps its 3 and القراءة والتهجي drops to 2 — acceptable only because the ring-fenced 60-minute Qur'an hour already delivers five hours a week of supervised letter-and-syllable decoding, which اللغة العربية correctly identifies as a free structural subsidy. If the Council will not cut القراءة والتهجي to 2, then اللغة العربية takes 2 and the G3 syllabus must be re-written to absorb the deficit — but that decision must be taken now, not inherited.

objections.grade: Programme-wide staffing — اللغة العربية G1-G5
objections.objection: The architecture's single largest staffing dependency is the least discussed and the least available. Everything from G6 onward — الآجرومية، البناء في الصرف، الأخضري، الجزرية، التفسير العملي — rests on اللغة العربية delivering, to Yoruba-speaking six-to-ten-year-olds, a communicative second-language Arabic programme: oral-first, lexical-field based, ~500 receptive words by G2, ~1,000 productive by G4, comprehension without relay through Yoruba by G5 (which النحو correctly calls 'the hardest and most frequently missing prerequisite in non-Arabophone settings'). That is a specific professional skill — L2 methodology with العربية بين يديك — and it is not the skill the institution's own pipeline produces. A Nigerian Islamic school's realistic staff pool is matn-trained: graduates who can teach الآجرومية and الأخضري and who will, under pressure, teach G3 Arabic by translation and rote because that is how they were taught. If G1-G5 is staffed that way, the G5 no-relay-comprehension prerequisite silently fails and is not detected until G8, when a cohort that has 'passed' five years of Arabic cannot read unvocalised prose.
objections.recommendation: Treat G1-G5 Arabic as a specialist post, not a junior one, and gate it: (a) appoint and pay for at least one trained L2-methodology teacher for G1-G5 rather than assigning the youngest grades to the most junior staff; (b) make the G5 no-relay comprehension standard an externally moderated checkpoint — a short oral in which a child answers Arabic questions on an unseen simple passage in Arabic, administered by a teacher who is not his own; (c) publish that checkpoint's pass rate to the Council annually, because it is the leading indicator for the whole secondary stage. Also brief the الآجرومية teacher at G6 in writing that the G5 functional grammar is his floor, so he does not re-teach it and lose Term 1.

objections.grade: Cross-programme — القراءة والتهجي span (affects اللغة العربية, الصرف, البلاغة, العروض, النقد والآداب, الترجمة, الإملاء)
objections.objection: Seven Programme 2 lifecycles depend on القراءة والتهجي and they do not agree on when it ends — and it is not in this programme, so none of them can settle it. اللغة العربية: 'established by القراءة والتهجي, G1-G2, reinforced through G3'. الصرف: 'القراءة والتهجي (G1–G3)'. الإملاء: partners it at G2-G3 only. But العروض: 'القراءة والتهجي G1-G5'. النقد: 'secure by G5 (independently assessed there from G1)'. البلاغة: 'established G3-G5'. الترجمة: 'established by القراءة والتهجي, G5'. The two readings have different consequences in both directions. If it truly ends at G3, then العروض's and البلاغة's decoding prerequisites are unfunded at G4-G5 and الترجمة's G6 debut rests on a competence nobody is still building. If it runs to G5, it is consuming 2-3 periods a week at G4 and G5 that no Programme 2 period table has counted — exactly the years where اللغة العربية is already hosting four assessed guest strands.
objections.recommendation: Obtain a single ruling on القراءة والتهجي's span and period cost at G4-G5 before any of these ten lifecycles is signed, and force all seven prerequisite lists to quote that ruling verbatim. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]. Professional recommendation from this lens: القراءة والتهجي as a separately timetabled subject should end at G3, with its residual function (fluent oral reading of vocalised connected text) transferring to اللغة العربية at G4 as a named, assessed reading-fluency strand — because the ring-fenced Qur'an hour continues to supply five hours a week of supervised decoding practice for the remaining nine years, and paying periods for a fourth and fifth year of decoding is the most expensive way to buy something the school already gets free.

objections.grade: النحو G6-G7 vs الصرف G6-G7
objections.objection: An unreciprocated pairing with a concrete arithmetic consequence. الصرف declares itself 'مدمج, partner النحو' at G6 and G7 and prices itself 'inside a combined النحو والصرف block of 4 periods/week'. النحو declares itself مستقل at G6 and G7 with no partner, never mentions الصرف, and prices itself at 'G6 3 requested, 2 acceptable | G7 3'. So G6-G7 is either one 4-period block or two blocks totalling 5-6, and the two owners have not noticed the difference. The G7 case is the sharp one: if the combined block is 4 and النحو takes its requested 3, لامية الأفعال gets one period a week — and G7 asks الصرف to cover المزيد بحرفين وبثلاثة, الرباعي, the full المصدر القياسي table (which الصرف itself calls 'the highest-yield rule in the discipline… unlocks the وزن of several hundred Qur'anic words') AND memorise a portion of a versified matn. One period a week does not deliver that, and ملحة الإعراب (a full أرجوزة) does not shrink to accommodate it.
objections.recommendation: Rule a single combined block and publish its internal split: G6 = 4 periods (نحو 2.5 / صرف 1.5), G7 = 4 periods (نحو 2.5 / صرف 1.5). النحو's 'G6 3 requested, 2 acceptable' concedes the G6 case already; G7 must concede the same. Additionally, instruct the G7 صرف scheme to place المصدر القياسي table in Term 1, so that if time is lost it is lost from الرباعي and افعوعل, not from the table the whole Qur'anic-vocabulary payoff depends on. Amend النحو's entry at G6-G7 to read 'مدمج, partner الصرف' so the register is internally consistent.

objections.grade: العروض G8 and G9 (host: النشيد والمحفوظات)
objections.objection: The differentiation of العروض is hosted in a slot that may not exist. العروض's G8 unit — its only real claim on the timetable, 2 periods for one term — is 'taught in the النشيد والمحفوظات slot, which is the discipline's own feeder', and its G9 consolidation is 'مضمّن, partner النشيد والمحفوظات'. But every reference to النشيد across all ten lifecycles stops at G7: منظومة التوحيد والإيمان (G3), the two formerly-[UNVERIFIED] slots (G4, G5), ديوان الشافعي and لامية ابن الوردي (G6), تائية الإلبيري (G7). No lifecycle names a G8 or G9 النشيد text, and النقد والآداب explicitly describes النشيد as carrying corpus contact 'at G3-G7 on its own allocation'. If النشيد والمحفوظات's own lifecycle ends or goes مضمّن at G8, العروض has no host, no periods, and no differentiation — and the 'unusually cheap' argument that justifies including العروض at all collapses.
objections.recommendation: Confirm النشيد والمحفوظات's span before approving العروض. If النشيد runs to G9 as a timetabled entity, العروض's placement stands unchanged and should be protected. If it does not, move العروض's bounded unit to the G10 rotation band proposed above (Term 3), keep G8-G9 as continued مضمّن ear-training inside متن recitation at zero cost, and accept that التقطيع arrives two years later — which is survivable, because العروض is correctly identified as not being a prerequisite for البلاغة or for anything else in the programme.

objections.grade: العروض G5-G7 (following the identification of الفواكه الساقطة)
objections.objection: The exclusion order on the two formerly-[UNVERIFIED] texts is now void, which re-opens a dependency العروض had designed around. العروض's G5 مضمّن strand names its partner as 'النشيد والمحفوظات' and sets outcomes that only a versified text can deliver: name البيت، الشطر، الصدر، العجز; hear الروي; clap the recurring beat of an أرجوزة. With الفواكه الساقطة now attributed to الشيخ آدم عبد الله الإلوري but its contents, length and register still unverified, it is not known whether the G4-G5 النشيد material is verse at all. If it is prose, العروض's G5 outcomes have no text to sit on. The same uncertainty affects البلاغة and النقد, which both wrote 'the G4 and G5 النشيد slots are [UNVERIFIED]; I design around them and substitute nothing' — a decision that is now stale but not yet safely reversible.
objections.recommendation: Do not assert what is in الفواكه الساقطة. Instruct العروض to write its G5 strand against متن تحفة الأطفال — a رجز the child is already memorising in التجويد at G4-G5, which العروض already names as a reinforcement site — so the strand is independent of whatever the النشيد slot turns out to hold. Then, once a physical copy of الفواكه الساقطة is examined and its form established, re-issue one instruction to البلاغة, النقد والآداب and العروض telling them whether the G4-G5 stock is available as شواهد and as scanning material. Until then, none of the three should plan on it.

objections.grade: المنطق وعلم الكلام G12 / cross-programme العقيدة (unpacking the القصيدة اللامية في السنة)
objections.objection: On the new identification, the poem is short enough to memorise young and dense creed in content — divine attributes, the uncreated Qur'an, الرؤية. Read across the whole register, the ONLY place those three topics are ever explicitly opened is المنطق's G12 علم الكلام component, which covers 'خلق القرآن' and 'الصفات' — and it opens them as a meta-discipline, 'how Muslims argued creed, not a creed to adopt', one period a week inside the العقيدة block. That is the wrong instrument for the job. A student who memorised a creedal poem at G4-G5 needs someone to tell him what the poem he already carries MEANS, affirmatively, in his own school's voice. Handing that job to a G12 survey of الفرق, eight years later, produces exactly the outcome the Council's own note warns against: a graduate carrying a creedal text nobody explained. Compounding this, المنطق's G12 block is مدمج with العقيدة — a Programme 3 subject whose specialist has not been consulted in this paper and may have budgeted that period for something else.
objections.recommendation: Assign the unpacking explicitly to العقيدة, not to المنطق, and place it at G9 — the year the student is doctrinally settled per المنطق's own prerequisite ('a settled, non-anxious عقيدة… taught WHAT is believed and on what نص, before being shown that Muslims argued about it'), and three years before the كلام survey that then has something to argue about. Write it into العقيدة's G9 scheme as a named bounded unit: 'شرح ما حُفظ — القصيدة اللامية في السنة'. Then المنطق's G12 كلام component works as designed, because the student meets the disputes holding a text he understands. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED — العقيدة is outside Programme 2 and its owner must accept the G9 unit and its period cost.]

objections.grade: الإنشاء والخطابة G9 vs البلاغة G9-G10
objections.objection: A dependency the subject owner flagged as unsatisfiable is in fact only half satisfiable, and the half that fails is the half his G9 task needs most. الإنشاء states: 'البلاغة foundations: التشبيه، الاستعارة، الكناية، الخبر والإنشاء الطلبي، مطابقة الكلام لمقتضى الحال — needed live by G9 at the latest. This is a DEPENDENCY I cannot satisfy myself.' Cross-reading البلاغة: التشبيه lands G8 and الاستعارة والكناية land G9 — so the first three are met. But الخبر والإنشاء وأغراض الخبر and مقتضى الحال are explicitly G10 content ('Open علم المعاني: الخبر والإنشاء وأغراض الخبر…'). The G9 المقالة القصيرة with 'a stated position and supporting evidence' and the G9 الحجاج البسيط are precisely the tasks that need audience-fit and the خبر/إنشاء distinction. As written, a G9 rubric will mark students on a criterion the curriculum has not taught.
objections.recommendation: Strike مطابقة المقام and any خبر/إنشاء criterion from the G9 الإنشاء rubric and move them into the G10 rubric, where الخطابة differentiates and where البلاغة delivers them in the same year — the natural and correct pairing, since audience-fit is the whole content of خطابة. At G9, mark structure, evidence, connectives, النحو/الصرف/الإملاء accuracy, and the use of تشبيه/استعارة/كناية, all of which are delivered. Record this in both lifecycles so the dependency is visibly closed rather than left as an open question.

objections.grade: الترجمة G12 (and G6) — dependency on the morning national curriculum
objections.objection: The programme's flagship graduate deliverable rests on a curriculum this school does not run, does not staff and does not assess. الترجمة's G12 capstone requires 'a 600–900 word unseen Arabic prose text… into written English with a translator's commentary justifying every contested choice'. Its own prerequisite list concedes: 'Written English at sentence-and-paragraph level — comes from the MORNING national curriculum, outside this scope; must be confirmed to exist by G6 or the English direction slips.' Confirming it at G6 is not sufficient: the gap between Primary-6 English and the analytic English prose required for a translator's commentary is six years of a curriculum with its own attrition, its own staffing problems and no accountability to this Council. If a cohort's morning English is weak, a student fails a Programme 2 subject for a reason Programme 2 neither caused nor can remedy — and the school's stated international ambition is carried by the one subject it controls least.
objections.recommendation: Build the capstone so that it cannot be sunk by the morning school. (a) Make the G12 portfolio's guaranteed core the two pieces this school does control: the oral Yoruba rendering of a Qur'anic passage with its تفسير, correctly framed as ترجمة المعاني, and an Arabic-language explication of the source text's difficulties. (b) Make the English-direction piece a graded extension with an explicit entry gate applied at G10 — a short English writing sample; students below the threshold take a supported route and are not penalised in the Arabic competencies. (c) Ask the Director General to open a standing liaison with the morning curriculum's English department, because that is the only real fix and it is an institutional act, not a curricular one.

objections.grade: المنطق وعلم الكلام G11
objections.objection: A one-period-per-week, full-year, standalone subject is the least efficient shape available on a 19-period timetable, and this subject chose it after having already accepted the efficient shape a year earlier. المنطق is دوراني at G10 ('2 periods/week for ONE term… in a term-rotation slot shared with another bounded subject — annualised cost about 0.7 of a weekly period') and then مستقل at G11 at 1 period/week all year. The G11 form costs more of the annualised budget (1.0 vs 0.7), occupies a permanent line on the register in the programme's tightest year, produces the pedagogically weakest contact pattern for a technical science (a single 40-minute slot a week with a full week's forgetting between them), and needs the same scarce teacher to be timetabled across all three terms rather than one.
objections.recommendation: Make G11 التصديقات a second دوراني term in the same rotation band as G10 التصورات — 2 periods for one term, annualised 0.7. The content (القضية، التناقض، العكس، أشكال القياس، المغالطات) is better served by a concentrated block than by a thin year-long drip, and the same teacher then carries one term at G10 and one at G11 instead of a year-long single period plus a term. If the Council wants المنطق to carry its own line on the register for status reasons, دوراني carries a line and a mark just as مستقل does — form and register-visibility are separate questions.

objections.grade: Programme-wide assessment operations — G5 through G9
objections.objection: The count of independently reported marks has not been costed as an operational load, and it falls on an afternoon school. In Programme 2 alone, G5 produces five independently assessed entities (اللغة العربية، النحو، الصرف، الإملاء، الإنشاء) from roughly four to five periods of teaching, probably by one or two teachers. G9 produces at least six (اللغة العربية، النحو، الصرف، النقد والآداب، الإنشاء، الترجمة) plus البلاغة's independently assessed مضمّن strand — seven. Add Programme 1 and Programme 3 and a G9 report carries somewhere near fifteen separately reported marks, three times a year, produced by staff teaching from 2pm and on weekends. 'Independently assessed' is correctly identified in this architecture as orthogonal to form and costs no teaching periods — but it costs marking hours, moderation, and a report-card format nobody has designed, and when that load exceeds capacity the marks become nominal, which destroys exactly the traceability the form vocabulary exists to protect.
objections.recommendation: Separate 'independently assessed' from 'separately reported on the parent's report card'. Publish a two-tier reporting standard: tier 1 = subject lines on the report card (اللغة العربية، النحو والصرف، الدراسات… ); tier 2 = named strand marks printed underneath the parent subject line (إملاء، تعبير، نصوص، ترجمة). Every strand keeps its own mark, its own rubric and its own place in the mark book — traceability intact — without generating fifteen top-level lines. Then cost the marking: at G8-G9 the نصوص period alone generates three assessed strands, and whoever teaches it needs the time to mark them.

objections.grade: الصرف G10 vs اللغة العربية G7
objections.objection: Two subjects teach dictionary work three years apart without either knowing about the other, so the second will either repeat the first or assume a level the first did not reach. اللغة العربية G7: 'Dictionary skills' taught, with its own prerequisite note that root awareness comes from الصرف at G6-G7. الصرف G10: 'التجريد واستعمال المعجم — extracting the root from a word in running text and locating it in a root-ordered lexicon (لسان العرب، القاموس المحيط…)'. This is genuinely a progression if it is planned as one — school dictionary at G7, root-ordered classical lexicon at G10 — but nothing in either lifecycle says so, and the G10 teacher who assumes nothing was done at G7 will spend weeks on الجذر الثلاثي that the student has used since G7.
objections.recommendation: Write the split into both schemes explicitly: G7 اللغة العربية teaches locating a word in a modern school dictionary arranged by root, on sound trilaterals only; G10 الصرف teaches extraction from running text including المزيد، المعتل and مواضع الإبدال, and navigation of لسان العرب and القاموس المحيط with their conventions. Also note the third consumer: الترجمة's G8 'compulsory Arabic-to-Arabic gloss of the hard word before any rendering' depends on the G7 skill and should be listed as its first cash-out.

objections.grade: العروض — differentiation rationale (G7/G8 blockers) vs الصرف G8-G9
objections.objection: A placement argument rests on a misstatement of the partner subject's lifecycle. العروض rules out G7 partly because 'لامية الأفعال completes at the end of G7; before that the morphological balance is still being built', and lists الميزان الصرفي as 'Established by البناء في الصرف (G6) and لامية الأفعال (G7). Closes end of G7.' But الصرف's actual lifecycle assigns only the أبنية والمصادر portion of لامية الأفعال to G7 and completes the text across G8 (المعتل sections) and G9. So الصرف does not close at end of G7; it closes at G9. The placement itself survives — the specific component العروض needs, الميزان and أوزان المجرد والمزيد, genuinely is complete by end of G7 — but the reasoning as written is wrong, and a reviewer at the Council who checks it will lose confidence in a decision that is in fact correct.
objections.recommendation: Correct العروض's prerequisite entry to read: 'الميزان الصرفي وأوزان المجرد والمزيد — established by البناء في الصرف (G6) and by the أبنية والمصادر portion of لامية الأفعال (G7). Note that الصرف itself continues to G9 (المعتل والإعلال); العروض depends only on the portion that closes at end of G7.' Then the G8 placement stands on an accurate statement. Also flag the live risk this reveals: العروض's G8 unit now runs in the same year الصرف differentiates into مستقل and teaches الإعلال بالقلب — two balance-systems and a system of underlying forms in one year — which is a further argument for moving the العروض unit to G9 or to the G10 rotation band.

objections.grade: الترجمة G6-G11 — the Arabic–Yoruba Islamic term list
objections.objection: The subject depends from G6 on an institutional artefact that does not exist, has no owner and has no delivery date. الترجمة's G11 content includes 'the school's Arabic–Yoruba Islamic term list, including semantic drift' — but consistent terminology is needed from the G6 debut, because the whole protective design of the G6-G7 work (fixed ترجمة المعاني framing, transliterate-only categories, never presenting a rendering as the Qur'an) depends on every teacher using the same Yoruba renderings of the same Arabic terms. If three teachers render صلاة، إيمان، تقوى، شرك differently across G6, G7 and G8, the G11 lesson on semantic drift will be describing the school's own inconsistency. This is also a live pastoral matter in a region with an active public Yoruba tafsir practice, which الترجمة itself names.
objections.recommendation: Commission the term list now as a named institutional deliverable with an owner and a deadline, not as G11 lesson content: a small working group (the Arabic head, the تفسير teacher, and a Yoruba-literate scholar) producing a first tranche of 150-300 core terms before the first G6 cohort reaches it, and reviewed annually. Then الترجمة at G11 teaches students to interrogate and extend an existing list — which is a far better lesson than asking them to invent one — and G6-G9 teaching has a standard to hold. [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED on ownership and on whether the list is published beyond the school.]

programmeRedlines.strongestSingleObjection: Ten specialists each reasoned, correctly and independently, that G6-G7 was too heavy for their subject — and every one of them therefore deferred into G8 and G10-G11. Nobody counted the destination. Using only the numbers the lifecycles themselves print, Programme 2 alone claims ~11.7 of the 19 shared periods at G8 and ~11.7 at G11, against only 7-8 at G6, the year they all feared. At G11 that leaves roughly 7.3 periods for العقيدة، الفقه، أصول الفقه، الحديث ومصطلح الحديث، السيرة والتاريخ، الأخلاق and أصول التفسير — about one period per week each, in the single heaviest year of the Islamic sciences. أصول الفقه on one period a week is not an allocation, and Programme 3's specialists have not yet been told that Programme 2 has already spent their budget. The same displacement produces the sharp secondary failures: three subjects (البلاغة، النقد والآداب، الترجمة) each claiming the same single حصة النصوص at G8-G9, and two subjects (الإملاء، العروض) hosting bounded units at G10 inside an اللغة العربية allocation that no longer exists. This is not a flaw in any one lifecycle; it is the aggregation failure that only a cross-subject reading can see, and it is the reason the programme must not be approved as submitted.
programmeRedlines.whatSurvives:
Five things are genuinely sound and should be protected against any re-sequencing done in response to the objections above.

1. THE CEILING IS REAL, AND THE PROGRAMME IS RIGHT TO TREAT IT AS HARD. Checked independently against the operating hours: Mon/Tue/Wed 2-6pm and Sat/Sun 9am-3pm gives 4+4+4+6+6 = 24 clock hours; removing the ring-fenced 60-minute Qur'an hour on five days leaves 19 hours, i.e. ~28.5 slots of 40 minutes before anything else. Subtracting one ṣalāh break per day (~100 min), daily breaks (~100 min) and transitions across 6-9 lessons a day (~150 min) consumes roughly 350 of the ~380 minutes of difference. The [RECOVERED] figure of 19 is therefore arithmetically consistent with the school's own timetable and carries no hidden slack. No subject may argue for extra periods on the theory that the ceiling is conservative.

2. THE NHW LADDER'S ARITHMETIC IS EXACT AND SHOULD NOT BE DISTURBED. الآجرومية (1) + ملحة الإعراب (1) + قطر الندى (2) + الألفية (3) = 7 years = G6 through G12 with nothing to spare. Any proposal to delay النحو's differentiation to G7 breaks the ladder, and any proposal to add a fifth text breaks the budget. النحو's G6 placement is protected by redline 3 and by its own G5 functional-grammar substrate, which is correctly specified as pre-terminological.

3. THREE SUBJECTS' OPEN QUESTIONS CLOSE ON A CROSS-READING AND NEED NO COUNCIL TIME. (a) النقد والآداب flags dictionary skill as 'currently unassigned in the register; recommend اللغة العربية take it at G7 [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]' — اللغة العربية already teaches it at G7. (b) البلاغة flags إعادة الصياغة as 'the pivotal prerequisite… NOT explicitly guaranteed anywhere [COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED]' — اللغة العربية teaches التلخيص وإعادة الصياغة at G7 and 500-800 word drafted-and-corrected essays at G9. (c) المنطق flags composition as '[COUNCIL DECISION REQUIRED] if الإنشاء lands later than G11' — الإنشاء differentiates at G8 and writes 300-450 words at G9. All three should be marked closed in the papers rather than carried forward.

4. THE ZERO-CLAIM DISCIPLINE IS THE PROGRAMME'S BEST FEATURE AND MUST NOT BE TRADED AWAY UNDER PRESSURE. الإملاء at zero permanent periods across twelve years is the correct reading of redline 7 and is argued on the discipline's own grounds, not merely as compliance. المنطق claims nothing G1-G9; النقد claims nothing G1-G7; البلاغة claims nothing G1-G7 and four period-slots in total; العروض claims nothing beyond one bounded unit and one rotation and explicitly refuses مستقل status forever. الصرف's refusal to hold a standing G10-G12 slot — on the ground that a finite science that has closed should not keep being timetabled — is the single most disciplined judgement in the paper and is worth more to the budget than any economy imposed from outside. When the Council makes the cuts the objections above require, these five must not be the ones asked to give again.

5. THE الأخضري CONVERGENCE IS A REAL STAFFING ASSET, NOT AN ACCIDENT. The register draws three separate texts from عبد الرحمن الأخضري — the فقه matn at G6, السلم المنورق at G10-G11, and الجوهر المكنون at G11-G12 — alongside a Maliki spine. In a Nigerian context that is one coherent Maghribi-West African teaching tradition, and a teacher formed in it can carry all three, which materially reduces the number of scarce specialists the school must recruit. The rarest profiles remain the G11-G12 نقد teacher (العمدة، الموازنة، الوساطة، دلائل الإعجاز) and the G11-G12 الترجمة teacher (classical Arabic + academic written English + Yoruba); those two posts, not the نحو posts, are where recruitment will actually fail, and the Council should plan for them now.
